title: Sales Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Sales is a growing organization focused on delivering effective sales solutions and building long-term relationships with customers. The company values transparent communication, consistent performance, and a consultative approach to selling. Team members collaborate closely to understand client needs and offer products or services that create measurable business impact. Sales encourages continuous learning, supports professional development, and provides opportunities for advancement based on results and initiative.
  
**Role Description**
The Sales Specialist role is a full-time, on-site position based in Hyderabad. The Sales Specialist will identify and engage potential customers, present product or service offerings, and manage the full sales cycle from initial contact to closing. The role involves maintaining strong customer relationships, responding to inquiries, and providing guidance to ensure a positive customer experience. The Sales Specialist will work with internal teams to meet sales targets, prepare sales reports, and participate in sales meetings and training sessions. The position requires proactive prospecting, regular follow-up with leads, and consistent achievement of individual and team performance goals.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Communication and Customer Service skills.
* Candidates should possess solid Sales and Sales Management skills.
* Candidates should possess Training skills to support onboarding and product knowledge sharing.
* Candidates should have proficiency with CRM tools, basic MS Office, and data entry for sales reporting.
* Candidates should have a proven track record of meeting sales targets and working in a goal-driven environment.
* Candidates should demonstrate problem-solving ability, negotiation skills, and a customer-focused mindset.
* Candidates should have a bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in inside sales, field sales, or account management is preferred.

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description**
S.R. Portable Cabins is a Hyderabad-based manufacturer and supplier of portable and prefabricated cabins, serving clients across India. The company delivers practical space solutions such as site office cabins, security cabins, labour accommodation, toilet cabins, storage containers, portable shops, and customized cabins. Its products support construction, infrastructure, industrial, and commercial projects that require flexible and durable space. S.R. Portable Cabins emphasizes quality construction, robust materials, functional designs, and reliable, timely delivery. The team is committed to providing cost-effective solutions that meet diverse project needs.

**Role Description**
The Senior Sales Executive role is a full-time, on-site position based in Hyderabad. In this role, the individual actively identifies and develops new business opportunities for portable and prefabricated cabins, including site offices, security cabins, and customized solutions. Day-to-day responsibilities include generating leads, conducting client meetings and site visits, preparing proposals and quotations, and managing the end-to-end sales cycle from inquiry to order closure. The Senior Sales Executive maintains strong relationships with existing clients, follows up on deliveries and installations, and coordinates with production and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction. The role also involves tracking market trends, competing products, and pricing to support sales planning and revenue growth.

**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in B2B sales, client relationship management, and account servicing within construction, infrastructure, industrial, or related sectors.
* Ability to conduct market research, identify new business opportunities, and develop targeted sales strategies and presentations.
* Competence in negotiation, proposal writing, and handling commercial terms, quotations, and contracts.
* Comfort with field work, including regular client visits, site inspections, and on-site coordination.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills, with proficiency in Hindi, Telgu and English languages; confident in phone, email, and in-person interactions.
* Basic computer literacy, including use of MS Office, email, and CRM or sales tracking tools.
* Proven experience in sales or business development (preferably 3–5 years) in portable cabins, prefabricated structures, or building materials is an advantage.
* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Self-motivated, target-oriented, and able to work with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively with internal teams.

title: Export Business Development Executive

title: Business Development Executive
description:
**About Plattr

Plattr is a growing food-tech company providing food and catering solutions for corporate clients, events and individual customers. We focus on delivering convenient, reliable and quality food services.

We are looking for an experienced and customer-focused Business Development Executive (BDE) to handle incoming customer enquiries, understand their requirements, prepare quotations, follow up with prospects and convert enquiries into confirmed orders.

This is an inbound business development role. All leads will be provided by the company. Independent lead generation is not required.

Key Responsibilities

\* Handle incoming customer enquiries and respond promptly during working hours.

\* Understand customer requirements, including event date, location, occasion, guest count, food preferences and budget.

\* Prepare and share quotations based on customer requirements.

\* Follow up regularly with potential customers to improve lead conversion.

\* Handle customer queries, objections and negotiations within approved company guidelines.

\* Convert qualified enquiries into confirmed orders.

\* Maintain professional communication through calls, WhatsApp and email.

\* Coordinate with operations and marketing teams to ensure smooth order execution.

\* Maintain accurate lead details, quotations, follow-ups and conversion records in the CRM.

\* Achieve assigned business development targets and contribute to business growth.

Required Skills & Qualifications

\* 1–3 years of experience in business development, inside sales, telesales or customer relationship management.

\* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

\* Strong negotiation and customer-handling abilities.

\* Experience managing incoming leads and converting enquiries into customers.

\* Ability to manage multiple enquiries and follow-ups.

\* Basic knowledge of CRM tools, MS Excel or Google Sheets.

\* Strong organisational and problem-solving skills.

\* Customer-focused and target-oriented approach.

\* Experience in food tech, catering, hospitality, event management or food delivery is an added advantage.

Compensation

\* Fixed Salary: ₹20,000 per month.

\* Performance-Based Incentives: Up to ₹30,000 per month.

\* Total Earning Potential: Up to ₹50,000 per month, depending on individual performance.

What We Offer

\* Opportunity to work with a growing food-tech company.

\* Company-provided incoming leads.

\* Performance-based earning opportunities.

\* Hands-on experience in business development and client relationship management.

\* Professional learning and career growth opportunities.

\* Collaborative working environment.

Join Plattr!

If you have experience handling customer enquiries, building client relationships and converting leads into business, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now and become part of Plattr’s growing team!**

title: 03112026 - Senior Sales Manager - Hyderabad
description:
**Department: Audiology & Hearing Care Channels**

**1. Job Purpose**

The Senior Sales Manager (SSM) drives revenue growth by managing and expanding business with mid-to-high potential hearing aid dealers, independent audiology practices, and regional retail clinics. This role focuses on increasing share-of-wallet within an assigned territory, ensuring high product adoption, and delivering localized sales strategies.

The SSM operates with a focused regional revenue target tailored to premium account management, which is structurally distinct from the macro-level enterprise targets managed by our Business Development Managers (BDMs).

**2. Core Role Demarcation (SSM)**

To maintain structural clarity across our sales vertical, this position is differentiated from the Business Development Manager (BDM) role across three primary pillars:

* **Portfolio Scope:**
  The SSM manages and nurtures existing mid-to-high tier retail dealers. The BDM focuses strictly on untapped corporate chains, hospital networks, and government tenders.
* **Revenue Scale:**
  The SSM target is scaled to regional dealer capacity, sitting structurally lower than national or macro-level BDM revenue targets.
* **Sales Cycle:**
  The SSM handles high-frequency, relationship-driven monthly sales and restocking cycles. The BDM handles long-cycle institutional contract acquisitions.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**Account Management & Growth**

* **Portfolio Ownership:**
  Cultivate and expand a dedicated portfolio of mid-to-high potential hearing care professionals (HCPs) and independent dealers.
* **Market Share Expansion:**
  Increase product mix and "share of wallet" within accounts currently sourcing from multiple hearing aid manufacturers.
* **Relationship Cultivation:**
  Build deep, consultative partnerships with audiologists, clinic owners, and ENT specialists.

**Sales Execution & Revenue**

* **Revenue Generation:**
  Consistently achieve assigned quarterly and annual sales volume and revenue targets for the specific territory.
* **Commercial Negotiation:**
  Manage commercial terms, discount structures, and volume rebates within pre-approved regional parameters.
* **Promotional Execution:**
  Design and implement hyper-local marketing campaigns, dispensing days, and consumer pull-actions with retail partners.

**Enablement & Market Intelligence**

* **Training Coordination:**
  Partner with internal Audiology Trainers to upskill dealer staff on new software, chip platforms, and fitting rationale.
* **Competitor Intelligence:**
  Monitor competitor pricing, product launch cycles, and dealer incentives to proactively protect market share.

**4. Requirements & Qualifications**

**Experience & Education**

* **Experience:**
  4-5 years of proven B2B sales experience specifically within the hearing aid industry, medical devices, or optical retail.
* **Industry Track Record:**
  Demonstrated success selling to independent audiologists, retail dispensers, or hearing care networks.
* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field.

**Skills & Competencies**

* **Sales Methodology:**
  Strong relationship builder utilizing a consultative, value-based selling approach rather than transactional sales.
* **Technical Familiarity:**
  Basic understanding of hearing aid fitting concepts and technology platforms.
* **Tools & Planning:**
  Proficiency in territory planning and CRM software usage (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).
* **Mobility:**
  Willingness to travel up to 50–60% within the assigned territory to maintain high-frequency, face-to-face contact with dealers.

**About us:**

Headquartered in Denmark, GN Hearing is among the leading manufacturers of hearing aids in the world. The company offers a full range of instruments and accessories under several brands. The company has subsidiaries in more than 25 countries and distributors in 80 more. Driven by technological innovations and commercial excellence, GN Hearing has been the growing faster than the industry for the last many years.

In India, the hearing aid industry at wholesale prices is approximately INR 750 crores annually. Private retail consumption accounts for over 85% of the hearing aid market in revenue terms with the balance coming from government tenders. The market is growing @10~12% p.a. and likely to grow at these rates for the next decade due to very favorable demographics viz.

• 90% of hearing aid users are in the 50+ group.

• They are living longer due to healthier lifestyles.

• Leading a more active retired life and would like to enjoy life with friends and family.

• Have the money to fund hearing aids.

In the hearing-impaired population, the hearing aid penetration level is only 2%. In developed countries the penetration is in the 20~40% levels.

In India, GN is headquartered in Navi Mumbai. In 2023, GN posted revenues of INR 131 cr (USD 16 mln). GN has been the fastest growing company since 2012 growing revenues @ 18% CAGR. GN is now the 2nd largest company in the lucrative retail market with a 20% market share, up from 5% market share in 2011. GN is the most profitable company in the industry with the highest % EBITA margin. Leadership in technology, a clear India strategy and strong execution have been the drivers of this performance.

Given the strong momentum, GN has an opportunity to drive growth higher than the current already high rate. GN has put in place aggressive plans for the 2023~2025 strategy period. The strategy involves executing on multiple key sales initiatives in parallel with speed and accuracy. GN operates through a direct dealer network of about 700 customers. The larger key customers account for a disproportionate share of the industry potential and consequently GNs business.

Hearing aids are dispensed as a medical device and the dealer (dispenser) makes the brand choice. Among other things, fast, accurate and at times customized service solutions to these larger customers are important to succeed with them. The customized solutions tend to put a strain on operations increasing complexity. The relatively small size of the business is deceptive when compared to the complexity of the challenges involved.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Matilda Cloud is one of the most consequential platforms being built in cloud right now. We help enterprises do what most of them know they need to do but cannot figure out how to do well: assess complex multi-cloud estates, migrate workloads without breaking the business, modernize what is worth modernizing, and run all of it with intelligence baked in. Our platform pairs machine learning with real-time operational data to automate work that has historically required armies of consultants and months of risk.

We are looking for a high-energy, results-obsessed Business Development Manager to help us capture market share and accelerate Matilda Cloud's growth trajectory. This is not a role for someone looking to manage existing accounts and coast. This is a role for someone who wakes up every morning thinking about the next deal, the next partnership, and the next breakthrough.

You will own a region end to end carrying an individual quota, building co-sell pipeline with AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud partner teams, and owning the system integrator ecosystem in your market. You will engage directly with enterprise customers who are ready to transform how they operate in the cloud, and you will close the business yourself.

**This is a quota-carrying seat, not a program or partner-operations role.**

**WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT**

We have the technology, the vision, and the team. Now we are building the sales force that will take us from high-growth startup to market leader. This is a chance to own your market, close transformative deals, and grow alongside a company with serious momentum.

You will have direct visibility with senior leadership and the ability to shape how we go to market. Your ceiling is your ambition.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

**1. Quota and Sales Execution**

* Carry and deliver an individual revenue quota for your region.
* Own and drive the full sales cycle from prospecting through close, targeting mid-market and enterprise accounts. You personally own deals from first contact to signature.
* Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities with a sense of urgency and purpose.
* Deliver accurate pipeline forecasts, account plans, and executive-level reporting that informs company strategy.

**2. Partner-Led Go-to-Market**

* Build and own Matilda Cloud's relationships with AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud partner teams in your region — the partner development managers, the partner sales teams, and the funding and program owners.
* Own the system integrator ecosystem across India — the major Indian and global SIs (TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HCL, Cognizant, Tech Mahindra, LTIMindtree) and the Big 4.
* Drive joint GTM motions, co-sell pipeline, and partner-sourced revenue, and operate the mechanics yourself: deal registration, co-sell funding, and marketplace transactions.
* Build and execute territory strategy across India and the broader South Asia region. This is a greenfield territory build with a partner-led go-to-market motion at its core.
* Represent Matilda Cloud at industry conferences, trade shows, and networking events as an ambassador for our brand and mission.

**3. Customer Relationships**

* Forge deep relationships with enterprise decision makers, technology leaders, and channel partners who value innovation.
* Build a trusted presence with customers across the full sales cycle — from cold outreach to boardroom close.

**4. Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Collaborate cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Product, and Marketing to craft compelling, tailored proposals, demos, and business cases.
* Partner with customer success to ensure new customers are set up for long-term retention and expansion.

**5. Market Intelligence**

* Stay sharp on market trends, competitor positioning, and the evolving cloud landscape to keep us ahead of the curve.
* Bring insights from the field back to product, marketing, and leadership to sharpen our go-to-market motion.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* Energized by the hunt — you thrive on prospecting, building relationships, and closing.
* A strategic thinker with the hustle to back it up — you plan your market and then execute relentlessly.
* An exceptional communicator with executive presence — you can hold a room from a cold call to a boardroom close.
* Technically credible on your own. You are the face of a technical product and can hold a conversation with a CTO or cloud architect without a presales engineer in the room.
* A growth-mindset seller who treats every quarter as a chance to set a new bar.
* A natural collaborator who makes product, marketing, and customer success feel like partners, not support functions.
* Honest, high-agency, and accountable — you take ownership, tell the truth, and do not wait to be asked.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

**Required**

* **A track record of carrying and meeting an individual sales quota.**
  This is the requirement we weight most heavily. We will ask about documented attainment against a personal number — percentage to target, bookings closed, or partner-sourced revenue you owned.
* **Full-cycle ownership.**
  You have personally owned deals from first contact to signature, rather than generating opportunities for others to close.
* **Established relationships with global system integrators.**
  You know people by name at the major Indian and global SIs (TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HCL, Cognizant, Tech Mahindra, LTIMindtree, Capgemini, Accenture), the Big 4, or integrators of comparable global scale such as Kyndryl, DXC, Atos, NTT DATA, CGI, or Genpact — and you could pick up the phone to them this week. We will ask who they are and what those relationships have produced.
* **Vendor-side co-sell experience.**
  You have worked on the software vendor or hyperscaler side of the partnership — as the person who engages the hyperscaler partner manager, or as that partner manager yourself.
* **Hands-on co-sell and marketplace mechanics.**
  You have worked directly in the partner systems rather than alongside them — AWS Partner Central and ACE deal registration, CPPO and Marketplace private offers, MAP, MDF or PFF, or the Microsoft equivalents (Partner Center, MACC, IP Co-Sell, PAL/CPOR/DPOR, ECIF) or Google equivalents (Partner Advantage, AMMP, DAF, RAMP, PSF) — and can walk us through how a deal gets registered, funded, and progressed.
* **At least 3 years selling cloud solutions**
  (SaaS, IaaS, PaaS, or hybrid cloud) within a broader business development or enterprise sales career. There is no upper limit on total years of experience.
* **Commercial fluency in at least two of AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud**
  (all three is a differentiator), and a working understanding of how large enterprises evaluate, fund, and approve cloud decisions.
* **Exceptional communication, storytelling, and executive presence**
  — able to hold a room from a cold call to a boardroom close.
* Located in India; must be eligible to work without sponsorship.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Alliance or partner-facing role managing SI relationships and partner-sourced revenue.
* Experience selling cloud management, FinOps, or infrastructure automation platforms.
* Enterprise buyers in telecom, financial services, utilities, transportation, or big data.
* A new-logo track record, and a startup or high-growth background building pipeline without an inbound engine.
* Fluency in English required; Hindi or additional regional language proficiency a plus.
* Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
* MBA or equivalent experience.

**WHY MATILDA CLOUD, WHY NOW**

Joining Matilda Cloud means joining a company at an inflection point — with the technology, the vision, and the team. Now we are building the sales force that will take us from high-growth startup to market leader.

Competitive base salary plus an uncapped commission structure. A seat at the table with direct visibility with senior leadership. A culture that celebrates wins, moves fast, and invests in your growth at every stage. Remote-first flexibility with the backing and resources of a well-funded, mission-driven company.

description:
**Overview**
**About Certara**
Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.
  
  
Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.
  
  
As an Enterprise Account Manager you will be working with world class expert drug development consultants in client engagements and be supported during the Business Development process by required expert teams. As a precursor to consultant engagement with the client, our candidates will be responsible for identifying and pursuing strategic business with clients after qualifying them with a needs assessment including, understanding their business model and corporate objectives, understanding their development program focus, objectives and priorities, understanding their critical decisions and challenges and financial position. It is after this qualification process that the appropriate Certara consulting resources are identified for engagement and are introduced to the client as the Certara resource team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Identify and pursue strategic business with new clients
* Identify and pursue business growth opportunities within assigned clients
* Conduct proper discovery to understand and qualify client needs, including understanding of business model and corporate objectives, development program focus, and priorities
* Negotiate contract terms by understanding critical decision timelines, challenges, and financial position
* Lead and facilitate client meetings with consulting resources, ensure internal stakeholders are properly briefed on client meeting plan and management
* Act as main liaison for client and Certara
* Facilitate execution of CDA/ MSA
* Collaborate with project team to ensure timely delivery and quality of all project deliverables
* Communicate issues, issue status, and issue resolution on a regular basis
* Provide leadership and timely feedback to keep all stakeholders, including senior management, informed of project progress
* Ensure Salesforce is properly updated

**Qualifications**

* Minimum a Bachelor’s Degree (science related curriculum a plus) with a demonstrated career path in Business Development to support the sought drug development experience and understanding required for this position.
* A seasoned and well-rounded biopharmaceutical executive is required with minimum combined business development experience of 3+ years
* Thorough understanding of the drug development processes, with the ability to converse with C-suite leadership in Biopharma companies, is essential. Thorough understanding of Clinical Pharmacology and Model Informed Drug Development (PK/PD, QSP, PBPK and MBMA) is a plus.
* Possesses broad knowledge of the pharmaceutical space and current macro trends within the industry. Able to lead strategic business planning process based on a thorough understanding of industry trends and opportunities and effectively solve strategic challenges.
* Proven ability to lead initiatives: work collaboratively with teams to achieve objectives. Achieves organizational focus on key priorities. Provides clear direction, delegates, actively communicates. Superior project management skills.
* Proven success in working collaboratively with cross functional commercialization teams with a strong business orientation and ability to view issues from multiple functional perspectives.
* Experienced and adept in a variety of negotiating settings. Able to engage effectively; establishes a clear negotiation strategy and manages a tight process.
* Proven experience in identifying, evaluating and pursuing business development opportunities within new and existing key markets.
* Demonstrated ability to gain credibility through successful leadership in a matrix environment, across a range of functions, position levels and geography
* Strong communication and influencing skills

*Certara bases all employment-related decision on merit, taking into consideration qualifications, skills, achievement, and performance. title: International Business Development Executive
description:
**About MonkyVision:**

MonkyVision Creative Solutions is a fast-growing creative digital marketing agency helping global brands through design, animation, video production, content, and digital growth strategies. We operate with an elite-team mindset built on ownership, honest communication, continuous learning, and measurable performance.

**Role Overview:**

We are hiring a Business Development Specialist to own the complete client acquisition journey - from identifying opportunities through Upwork, outbound outreach, referrals, website enquiries, networking, and partnerships to discovery, proposals, negotiation, closure, and sales-to-project handover. The role will represent MonkyVision as a company ambassador and build a documented, technology-enabled 365-day sales engine.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Upwork Account Management:** Find relevant projects, manage daily bidding, write personalised proposals, handle messages and interviews, coordinate pricing and agreements, and track proposals, contracts, reviews, and revenue.
* **International Lead Generation:** Generate qualified opportunities across the US, UK, Canada, Australia, Europe, Singapore, UAE, New Zealand, and other relevant markets using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Clutch, Crunchbase, Fiverr, directories, communities, and emerging platforms.
* **Full-Cycle Sales:** Research decision-makers, run personalised outreach, qualify leads, conduct discovery calls, prepare proposals, negotiate, close deals, and complete a smooth sales-to-project handover.
* **Referrals & Partnerships:** Build referral opportunities through clients, professional contacts, freelancers, agencies, and strategic partners; maintain partner records and coordinate approved referral arrangements.
* **Brand Ambassador & Networking:** Represent MonkyVision professionally and attend relevant networking events, business meetups, conferences, workshops, webinars, and industry communities. Build relationships, present the company's capabilities, and complete structured post-event follow-ups.
* **Website Lead Management:** Monitor forms, consultation requests, emails, and website enquiries; respond promptly, qualify each lead, and maintain accurate source, status, next-action, and conversion records.
* **365-Day Sales Engine & SOPs:** Build a year-round sales plan covering daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly activity. Document SOPs, playbooks, templates, scripts, checklists, follow-up sequences, proposal formats, objection handling, and handover processes.
* **Automation & Technology:** Use CRM, AI, automation, and no-code tools for research, enrichment, outreach, reminders, follow-ups, integrations, and reporting while keeping communication personalised and human.
* **Reporting & Improvement:** Maintain an accurate pipeline and communication history; prepare weekly and monthly dashboards; track outreach, calls, proposals, conversions, pipeline value, and revenue; improve the system using performance data and market feedback.

**Requirements:**

**Experience & Skills:**

* **3-6** years of business development or sales experience in a startup, creative/digital agency, or service business.
* Proven Upwork bidding, client communication, and complete sales-cycle experience.
* Experience acquiring international clients, including markets such as the US, UK, Canada, Australia, Europe, Singapore, and UAE.
* Strong knowledge of multi-platform lead generation, proposals, negotiation, reporting, and closing.
* Experience creating sales trackers, SOPs, playbooks, dashboards, and repeatable workflows.
* Understanding of digital marketing, SEO, performance marketing, design, animation, or video production.
* Familiarity with CRM, AI lead-generation, outreach, automation, and no-code integration tools.
* Excellent written and spoken English, strong follow-up skills, and willingness to attend relevant events and workshops.

**Mindset & Creativity:**

* **Extreme Ownership:** Independently plan, execute, solve problems, and take opportunities through to closure.
* **Revenue Focus:** Prioritise qualified opportunities, conversion, pipeline health, and measurable business results.
* **System Builder:** Create repeatable processes and maintain accurate CRM discipline instead of relying on memory.
* **Technology-Enabled Thinking:** Use AI and automation intelligently without outsourcing critical thinking or making communication robotic.
* **Relationship Mindset:** Build trust, partnerships, referral networks, and long-term commercial relationships.

**Attitude:**

* **Persistent & Accountable:** Follow up consistently and ensure every lead has a clear status, next action, and follow-up date.
* **Analytical:** Use reports and conversion data to improve decisions and performance.
* **Professional Reliability:** Respect deadlines and represent MonkyVision confidently in every interaction.
* **Open to Feedback:** Accept direct feedback and continuously refine processes and communication.
* **Growth Mindset:** Keep learning new markets, platforms, tools, and sales strategies.

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Qualified leads and discovery calls generated
* Proposals submitted and deals closed
* Monthly sales pipeline and revenue generated
* Upwork, website, and referral lead conversion
* Follow-up completion and CRM accuracy
* 365-day sales-plan execution, including SOPs, automation, and networking activities

**Benefits & Perks:**

* Full-time stability
* Reporting directly to the founder
* Clear career growth opportunities
* Exposure to international clients
* Freedom to test AI-powered sales strategies
* Continuous learning and skill development

**Closing:**

title: Director- Finance
description:
India - Hyderabad

JOB ID: R-258441 LOCATION: India - Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Nov. 02, 2026 CATEGORY: Finance

**ABOUT AMGEN**

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.
  
  
The Director of Finance at Amgen will be responsible for overseeing, managing, and coordinating all financial operations within the company. You'll also be in charge of developing the financial strategy, financial planning and forecasting, cost and revenue management, both short term and long term.
  
  
In this vital role, you will lead the build-out and ongoing leadership of a high-performing finance team at Amgen India, designed to support Operations Finance and our global Operations business partners. You will play a critical role in shaping a scalable, efficient, and insight-driven finance support model, delivering high-quality financial planning, reporting, and analytics across a broad set of manufacturing, supply chain, and operational functions.

This role will partner closely with Operations Finance leadership and business stakeholders to enhance decision support, improve financial visibility, and drive consistency, standardization, and continuous improvement in financial processes and outputs.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities include:**

* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing finance team within Amgen India, including talent strategy, capability development, and ways of working.
* Help establish and scale standardized processes for financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and analytics in support of Operations Finance.
* Partner with Operations Finance and business leaders to deliver actionable financial insights that support decision-making, resource allocation, and performance optimization.
* Oversee delivery of core finance activities including Business Plan, Latest Estimates, and long-range planning across supported functions, as well as Standard Costing and Cost of Goods Manufactured (COGM) processes.
* Build strong partnerships with Corporate FP&A and Operations teams at Amgen India.
* Ensure timely and accurate monthly financial reporting, forecasting, and variance analysis, with clear communication of key drivers and risks.
* Drive consistency and simplification across financial processes, tools, and data, enabling scalable and efficient support models.
* Support financial analysis for key operational initiatives, including capacity expansions, network changes, productivity programs, and cost optimization efforts.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, and other partners to improve cost, service, and financial performance.
* Act as a key liaison between onshore Finance teams and the Capability Center, ensuring alignment on priorities, deliverables, and service levels.
* Identify and implement opportunities to enhance data quality, automation, and reporting capabilities.
* Help define and evolve the future-state operating model for finance support within Amgen India, driving standardization and best practices.
  

  

**Functional Skills Required:**

* Experience in finance, FP&A, operations finance, or manufacturing finance.
* Demonstrated experience building and leading teams, ideally within a shared services or capability center environment.
* Strong understanding of standard costing process, Cost of Goods Manufacturing (COGM), and Cost of Sales processes.
* Experience supporting global operations, supply chain, or manufacturing organizations.
* Strong financial planning, forecasting, modeling, and variance analysis capabilities.
* Ability to translate complex financial data into clear, actionable business insights.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and work effectively across a matrixed organization.
* Experience driving process improvement, standardization, and scalable finance solutions.
* Strong communication skills and executive presence.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* Experience leading change and shaping operating models, including transitioning work into centralized or capability center structures.
* Passion for talent development and team building, with a focus on coaching, engagement, and creating a high-performance, inclusive culture.
  

  

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT**

Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

title: Now on Now Go To Market Sr. Manager
description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

Key Responsibilities

**Drive Now on Now GTM execution and field activation**, expanding how ServiceNow’s Customer Zero story is embedded across Executive Briefing Centers (EBCs), strategic customer engagements, workshops, industry events, webinars, and other high-impact GTM motions.

**Design and execute scalable GTM motions** that increase customer engagement with Now on Now, building strong partnerships across Sales, Solution Consulting, Global Solutions, Marketing, Customer Success, and other GTM organizations.

**Create demand for Now on Now engagements** by proactively identifying opportunities where ServiceNow’s internal transformation, innovation, and business outcomes can help advance strategic customer conversations.

**Build and activate a strong practitioner and executive community**, enabling ServiceNow leaders and subject-matter experts to effectively share how ServiceNow uses its own platform, AI capabilities, and workflows to transform the business.

**Translate ServiceNow’s Customer Zero experience into compelling customer stories**, connecting our internal use of ServiceNow products and AI to customer priorities, business challenges, measurable outcomes, and strategic transformation opportunities.

**Partner with Digital Technology and solution teams** to maintain a strong understanding of the ServiceNow product portfolio and identify new Customer Zero stories as capabilities are deployed internally.

**Orchestrate high-impact customer engagements**, bringing together the right executives, practitioners, content, demonstrations, and proof points based on the customer's priorities and stage in the sales cycle.

**Develop reusable GTM assets and enablement** that allow Sales, Solution Consulting, and other field teams to more easily incorporate Now on Now into customer conversations.

**Use engagement and customer-demand data to identify trends and opportunities**, including emerging solution areas, customer priorities, practitioner demand, and opportunities to scale successful engagement patterns.

**Track and communicate the business impact of Now on Now**, developing dashboards and executive insights around engagement volume, customer demand, practitioner activation, strategic account penetration, and influenced business outcomes.

**Continuously improve the Now on Now engagement model**, removing friction, simplifying how field teams access Customer Zero expertise, and developing scalable approaches that increase the program's reach and impact.

 **Qualifications**

**Experience:** 10+ years of relevant experience, including 7+ years in go-to-market strategy, solution consulting, product marketing, sales strategy, customer engagement, or a related function within enterprise technology.

**GTM Expertise:** Demonstrated experience developing and executing programs that connect product capabilities, customer needs, and field sales motions.

**ServiceNow Knowledge:** Strong understanding of the ServiceNow platform, product portfolio, and value proposition, with the ability to connect technology capabilities to business outcomes.

**Executive & Customer Engagement:** Experience working with senior executives, customers, sales leaders, and technical practitioners, with the confidence to facilitate strategic conversations and influence across organizational boundaries.

**Storytelling:** Strong ability to translate complex technology and transformation initiatives into clear, compelling business narratives appropriate for executive and customer audiences.

**Cross-functional Leadership:** Proven ability to lead through influence and successfully orchestrate initiatives across Sales, Solution Consulting, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and other matrixed organizations.

**AI & Enterprise Technology:** Strong understanding of enterprise AI, automation, workflow transformation, and emerging technology trends, with the ability to articulate their relevance to customer transformation.

**Analytical Skills:** Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with experience using engagement, customer, and business data to identify trends, prioritize opportunities, and measure program impact.

**Communication:** Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with audiences ranging from practitioners to senior executives.

**Adaptability:** Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities, technology, and customer needs evolve quickly.

**Education:** Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. MBA or advanced degree preferred.

**We're Hiring | Sales Executive – Field Sales & Business Development**

**Company:**
HyNex Systems LLP

**Location:**
Mumbai & MMR

**Experience:**
Freshers and candidates with 1–3 years of relevant experience can apply.

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

HyNex Systems LLP specialises in mechanical and automated car parking solutions.

We are looking for a
**field-oriented Sales Executive**
who can develop business opportunities across Mumbai and MMR.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Visit construction sites, builders, developers, architects and consultants.
* Generate B2B leads and identify potential projects.
* Meet decision-makers and understand project requirements.
* Collect project details and drawings.
* Coordinate quotations, follow-ups and order conversion.
* Develop and maintain strong client relationships.

* Freshers with good communication skills, confidence and a strong interest in field sales are welcome.
* Experience in real estate, construction, building materials, engineering products or industrial equipment will be an advantage.
* Good communication, negotiation and client-handling skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively across Mumbai & MMR.

**Important:**
This is a field-based B2B sales position, not a telecalling or inside-sales role. Candidates must be comfortable with regular site visits, client meetings and outdoor sales activities.

title: Strategic Account Executive
description:
Our Strategic Account Executives target and close new business with Datadog’s largest, most strategic customers and prospects. In this role you’ll be focused on uncovering the pain points organizations face as they operate in or migrate to a cloud environment at scale as well as delivering the appropriate Datadog solution.
  
  
*At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.*
**What You’ll Do:**

* Prospect into large Fortune 1000 companies while running an efficient sales process
* Maintain, build and own specific relationship maps for your territory including existing relationships and aspirational contacts
* Develop a deep comprehension of customer's business
* Negotiate favorable pricing and business terms with large commercial enterprises by selling value and ROI
* Handle existing customer expectations while expanding reach and depth into assigned territory
* Demonstrate resourcefulness when faced with challenges that defy easy solution
* Have intuitive sense of necessary steps to close business and gain customer validation
* Identify robust set of business drivers behind all opportunities
* Ensure high forecasting accuracy and consistency

**Who You Are:**

* Someone with 8+ years closing experience within enterprise
* Driven and have met/exceeded direct sales goals of 1M+ and operated with an average deal size of $100k+
* Able to demonstrate methodology to prospect and build pipeline on your own
* Experienced in working for an innovative tech company (SaaS, IT infrastructure or similar preferred)
* Experienced in selling into large Fortune 1000 companies with the ability to win new logos
* Able to sit up to 4 hours, traveling to and from client sites
* Able to travel via auto, train or air up to 70% of the time

*Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.*
**Benefits and Growth:**

* High income earning opportunities based on self performance
* New hire stock equity (RSU) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
* Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
* Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message
* Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
* An inclusive company culture, opportunity to join our Community Guilds
* Generous and competitive medical benefits package
* Retirement savings match
* Pet adoption and insurance program

*Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.*
**About Datadog:**
Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

title: Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Ctrl Plus Z is a growing organization focused on delivering efficient, innovative solutions to its clients. The company values a proactive approach to problem-solving, strong relationship-building, and consistent, high-quality service. Team members are encouraged to take ownership of their work, collaborate across functions, and contribute ideas that drive business growth. Ctrl Plus Z offers opportunities for professional development and advancement for individuals who are motivated, adaptable, and customer-focused.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Sales Executive role based in Thane. The Sales Executive will identify and pursue new business opportunities in UAE and India (Through cold calling), build and maintain strong relationships with prospects and existing clients, and conduct regular meetings, presentations, and product demonstrations. The role involves managing the sales pipeline, preparing proposals and quotations, negotiating terms, and closing deals to meet or exceed sales targets. The Sales Executive will collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and customer satisfaction, maintain accurate sales records and reports, and stay informed about market trends and competitors. The position requires consistent on-site presence for client visits, team coordination, and local market engagement.

**Qualifications**

* Strong sales, negotiation, and deal-closing skills, with a proven ability to manage a sales pipeline and meet targets.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to build and maintain client relationships.
* Ability to conduct market research, understand customer needs, and translate them into effective sales solutions.
* Good organizational and time-management skills, with attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
* Comfort with using CRM tools, productivity software, and basic data analysis to track and improve performance.
* Ability to work independently on-site in Thane while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field preferred; relevant sales experience will be highly valued.
* Prior experience in B2B or service-based sales is an advantage, along with a customer-centric and ethical approach.

title: Enterprise Business Specialist
description:

You will leverage your expertise to develop strategies that will drive Logitech’s presence in these markets. Your role will involve building and maintaining strong relationships with CIO departments, selling innovative solutions, and achieving specific quarterly and annual sales targets.

* Develop and manage sales pipelines with the goal of achieving quarterly and annual targets.
* Identify and close new business opportunities in the B2B, Government, Education, and Enterprise sectors.
* Build long-term relationships with customers, particularly within CIO departments.
* Collaborate with partners to generate and follow up on leads, ensuring comprehensive reporting to the business.

title: Inside Sales Executive
description:
**About us**

Yocket was established in 2015 with a mission to connect people to the world's best learning

opportunities. We are the largest and most active online platform for international education!

Today, Yocket is the largest community-driven online platform for international education.

We specialize in premium counselling services for students with ambitions of pursuing higher

education abroad by connecting them to the best universities in the world. We offer a

comprehensive range of services, including expert counselling, test preparation, visa assistance, and even loans to facilitate your educational journey.

To date, we have helped more than 10,00,000 students across countries pursue their higher

education. Our students have secured admissions in all of the world's top 100 global universities,

including prestigious institutions such as Harvard University, Massachusetts Institute of Technology,

Stanford University, University of Oxford, University of California, and Columbia University.

At Yocket, we strive to help our employees find passion and purpose. Join us in changing how students make decisions about education. If you wish to create an impact and help students get the best education by taking our vision ahead, we would love to have you on our team!

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a high-energy, target-oriented Business Development Associate with proven B2C

sales experience. You’ll play a critical role in driving revenue and converting leads.

**The charter for this role will include:**

* Generate direct revenue through high-quality B2C consultative sales.
* Consistently meet and exceed monthly/quarterly sales targets.
* Engage with leads via calls, WhatsApp, and emails; follow up proactively and drive conversions.
* Build rapport and trust with students and parents to understand their goals and recommend the right services

**Ideal Persona :**

* Minimum 1 year of B2C sales experience (EdTech preferred but not required).
* Proven experience in selling and revenue generation with a strong track record of meeting/exceeding targets.
* Excellent communication, persuasion, and negotiation skills.
* Experience in EdTech or similar high-velocity B2C environments.
* Familiarity with CRM tools and structured sales processes.
* Highly organized, disciplined, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in any field.

**Why Join Yocket?**

* Impactful Work: Help students achieve life-changing education goals.
* High-Growth Environment: Be part of a rapidly scaling EdTech brand with strong career progression.
* Culture that Values Ideas: No-boss culture, transparent communication, and strong ownership.

**Benefits:**

* Medical insurance for you & your family
* Access to mental-health counselling
* Learning & development opportunities

**Location: Kurla**

title: Sales Representative
description:
EfficientIP is a network automation and security company, specializing in DDI (DNS, DHCP, IP Address Management). Our Smart DDI approach offers enterprises and service providers a unique appliance-based solution to intelligently simplify and automate design, deployment and management of their critical network infrastructure.

Through patented technology, our 360º solution suite secures DNS services to safeguard sensitive data and ensure application access. Companies in all sectors rely on our offerings to face the challenges of key IT initiatives such as cloud, IoT, 5G, and mobility.

**Description**

We’re looking for motivated talents, seeking an opportunity that can lead to professional growth in Sales in a scaling organization. You’ll have the freedom to think outside the box so you’ll need to be great at working independently with great organization skills.

If you consider yourself to be curious, creative and pretty fearless, as well as a natural people-person who’s great at building links, we would love to hear from you!

**What will you do?**

* Primary responsibilities are direct Sales through a 1 or 2 tier distribution approach.
* Relationships with the large GSI’s are desirable
* Targeting the biggest potential customers across the Market. Primarily verticals Telco/ISP& #39;s, High Education, Retail, Local and central Government. These prospects are either companies looking for DDI solutions or companies that are looking for replacing their existing DDI solution.
* DDI experience desirable or IT security.
* Deliver Sales in line with objectives that will be defined and agreed in a compensation plan.
* Sales revenue is made from Products, First Year Maintenance and Professional Services.
* Establish/maintain, appropriate relationships with the key players in the targeted GSI space. To make sure they adopt Efficient IP technology and are “certified” and confident with selling Efficient IP solutions.
* Make sure EfficientIP is giving a high quality of service in the territory and protect the existing maintenance renewal.
* Coordinate with headquarters, send the regular reports, follow the policies and processes in place.

**You’ll be great for this role if you have these qualifications:**

A proven software solution sales executive with at least 6 years experience, ideally:

* Educated to Degree + 4 years
* Successful track record selling complex software solutions in companies like:Software Vendors in the Security environment (F5, Fortinet, Check Point, Blue Cat,...)
* Providers of network Solutions
* Competition such as Infoblox, Blue Cat,...
* Hunting Profile
* Proven in a similar challenge of working large organizations, to quickly develop tactical deals in the short term that will form the basis for an enterprise wide relationship in the medium /long term.
* Good understanding of network solutions (e.g. IP Management, IP servers like DNS & DHCP)
* Ability to work in a small entity, in a start up mode.
* Ability to use a CRM / Sales Force Automation system (SalesForce.com, Siebel, Sugar,...).
* Good communicator with his manager with respect to sales opportunity analysis, accurate,
* timely forecasting and collaborating with other team members.
* **Must be located in Mumbai.**

**Working conditions**

We offer a great opportunity to grow with our company, in a rapidly advancing and strongly innovative environment.

At EfficientIP, we fully believe in congeniality in the workplace and in our relationships with our customers, partners and colleagues. We ensure a positive work environment that is encouraging, enthusiastic and motivating to our team.

This approach breaks down barriers in order to stimulate our company’s ambition of constant overachievement.

You will be part of a fun & ambitious team!

**To apply, please send your cv and cover letter to careers@efficientip.com**

title: Business Development Executive
description:
We're building Suman, an app (Android, iOS and web) that helps Indians with burnout, family pressure, log kya kahenge and everything in between. So we're not going to pretend this job is about "pushing product."

Here's the truth: we're a team of people who give a damn. Suman is a personal wellness companion that actually speaks Hindi, Hinglish and English, and gets your stress without judgment. Therapists can also use it to stay connected with their clients between sessions. We need one more person, this time out in the field.

Mumbai · In the field · Full-time

Fair pay, travel allowance and incentives. Own your territory.

What you'll work on:

→ Meeting psychologists, psychiatrists and counsellors across Mumbai and Thane.

→ Showing them how Suman supports their clients between sessions, and exactly what they see and what stays private.

→ Sitting with them as they connect their first client, then coming back to fix whatever gets in the way.

→ Helping run small evening workshops for clinicians in your area.

→ Bringing back what clinicians tell you, so we build what they actually need.

A client sees their therapist for one hour a week. You'll help Suman be there for the other 167.

Few points:

→ Best suited for 2-6 years in pharma field sales (Medical Representative or Business Executive), ideally in a CNS or psychiatry division. Psychology graduates who love meeting people, apply too.

→ You know Mumbai and Thane, and the locals don't scare you. English and Hindi; Marathi is a bonus.

→ We don't work on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays.

→ Done with your visits early? The rest of the day is yours. We count the therapists you help get started, not hours or kilometres.

→ A short call report each evening and one weekly review. No micromanaging.

→ Salary on the last working day of every month.

We'd love someone who fits that culture and can start within 2 months. Once you're in, our notice period is a humane 15 days, because life's too short for long goodbyes.

[Applications are only accepted through LinkedIn.]

title: Enterprise Account Executive, Industries - BFSI
description:
**About Anthropic**
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an Enterprise Account Executive, Industries - BFSI to pioneer Anthropic's enterprise AI adoption across India's banking, financial services, and insurance sector. You will build our presence from the ground up, securing transformative deals with leading banks, NBFCs, insurers, and fintechs, and establishing Anthropic as their trusted AI partner for digital transformation. You will navigate the complex, regulated environment of Indian financial institutions and position Claude as the AI solution that drives both efficiency and innovation while maintaining the highest standards of safety and reliability. As one of our first industry specialists in India, you will shape our BFSI go-to-market strategy and build the playbook for how Anthropic serves financial institutions, working closely with global teams while adapting our approach to local market dynamics. This position is based in Bangalore, Mumbai, or NCR, with travel across India.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Establish Anthropic's enterprise presence across India's BFSI sector, including public and private sector banks, NBFCs, insurers, asset managers, and fintechs
* Develop BFSI-specific strategies that account for RBI, IRDAI, and SEBI requirements, data localization needs, and sector compliance standards
* Build relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs, Chief Risk and Compliance Officers, digital transformation leaders, and innovation heads at India's top financial institutions
* Create the India BFSI playbook for enterprise AI adoption, documenting successful approaches that can scale across the region
* Own end-to-end sales cycles for complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals, often involving board-level decisions
* Drive strategic expansion within lighthouse accounts that can serve as references for the entire BFSI industry
* Navigate procurement processes unique to Indian financial institutions, including vendor risk assessments, rate contracts, empanelment procedures, and multi-year agreements
* Collaborate with system integrators and consulting partners who often influence technology decisions at banks and insurers
* Co-innovate with customers to develop BFSI use cases, from vernacular customer service and fraud detection to credit underwriting and automated compliance reporting
* Understand sector-specific challenges such as financial inclusion, legacy core banking modernization, and data security in regulated environments
* Position AI strategically within the context of Digital India initiatives and financial sector modernization programs
* Ensure successful deployments that can scale from proof-of-concept to enterprise-wide implementation
* Partner with global product teams to prioritize features critical for Indian financial institutions, such as multi-language support, data residency, auditability, and integration with local systems
* Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to navigate India's evolving AI and data protection regulations
* Provide market intelligence on competitive dynamics, pricing expectations, and emerging BFSI use cases unique to India
* Build internal alignment between Anthropic's global strategy and India's market requirements

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 15+ years of enterprise sales experience in the Indian market, with a proven track record of closing large, complex deals, ideally across BFSI sector
* Deep understanding of how Indian financial institutions operate, including decision-making processes, budget cycles, and stakeholder dynamics
* Experience selling transformational technology (Cloud, AI/ML, Digital Transformation platforms) to Indian enterprises
* Established relationships with senior executives across banks, NBFCs, insurers, or fintechs
* Understanding of the Indian regulatory landscape, including RBI, NSE, IRDAI, and SEBI requirements, data protection laws, and sector-specific compliance
* Consultative selling expertise, with the ability to position AI as a strategic business driver rather than just a technology solution
* Complex deal structuring experience, including multi-year contracts, phased deployments, and outcome-based pricing
* Technical acumen to engage credibly with CTOs, architects, and data science teams
* Cross-cultural communication skills to work effectively with both Indian stakeholders and global teams
* Entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to build a market from scratch with limited local resources initially
* Patient yet persistent approach to long enterprise sales cycles, while maintaining momentum

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience selling directly into large Indian banks, insurers, or financial conglomerates
* Relationships with Indian system integrators such as TCS, Infosys, Wipro, and HCL, particularly their BFSI practices
* Familiarity with Indian business groups and conglomerates, and how decisions flow within these complex organizations
* Track record of first-in-market roles or launching new products in India
* Domain expertise in areas critical to Indian financial services, such as UPI payments, core banking systems, KYC/AML compliance, Aadhaar integration, or insurance underwriting
* Knowledge of government initiatives such as Digital India and their impact on financial sector technology adoption
* Experience navigating public sector bank and PSU sales processes is a plus

**Logistics**
**Minimum education:**
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
  
  
**Required field of study:**
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
  
  
**Minimum years of experience:**
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
  
  
**Location-based hybrid policy:**
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
  
  
**Visa sponsorship:**
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
  
  
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.**
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
  
  
**Your safety matters to us.**
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
  
  
**How We're Different**
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
  
  
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
  
  
**Come work with us!**
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
**Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:**
Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Senior Manager, Strategic Sourcing
description:
**Date Posted:**

2026-11-03

**Country:**

India

**Location:**

Head Office 9th Floor, Magnus Tower, Mindspace, Link Road, Malad (West), MUMBAI-400064, India  
  

We are seeking a high-performing procurement leader to lead India's Indirect Strategic Sourcing function and drive value creation through category management, supplier partnerships, cost optimization, and business collaboration.

  

**Opportunity**

Lead the India Indirect Strategic Sourcing function and shape category strategy, sourcing execution, productivity delivery and supplier governance across Professional Services, IT and Digital Technology, Telecom, Travel and Hotels, Fleet, Energy, Gas and Chemicals, MRO, Facilities, Corporate Services, Insurance, Office Supplies, Packing, Consumables, Rent and other indirect categories. Lead the sourcing team and partner with senior India, APAC and Global stakeholders.

  

The role is accountable for approximately USD 20 million of indirect spend and Pan-India supplier-base governance, including supplier segmentation, consolidation and low-spend tail reduction, while safeguarding service continuity.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Category strategy and sourcing execution**
  + Develop fact-based category strategies across assigned indirect categories using spend insights, demand forecasts, supply-market intelligence, cost drivers and stakeholder requirements.
  + Lead sourcing initiatives from opportunity assessment through supplier selection, negotiation, contracting, transition and post-award governance.
  + Create scalable sourcing approaches that improve commercial outcomes, service quality, standardization and speed of execution.
* **Productivity, demand management and value realization**
  + Build and maintain a qualified savings and cost-avoidance pipeline, ensuring assumptions, baselines and benefits are aligned with Finance.
  + Monitor project delivery, resolve execution barriers and provide transparent reporting on pipeline health, realize benefits and risks.
  + Conduct quarterly spend governance with internal stakeholders, challenge specifications, consumption patterns and service models with stakeholders to unlock demand-side value, not only price reductions.
* **Business partnership and influence**
  + Partner with senior leaders across Finance, HR, Digital Technology, Operations, Legal, Real Estate, Service and other functions to understand priorities early and shape effective sourcing solutions.
  + Act as a trusted partner, balancing business speed, total cost, service continuity, compliance and risk.
  + Facilitate cross-functional decisions through clear recommendations, robust data and effective stakeholder alignment.
  + Coordinate insurance management for projects and employees with internal stakeholders and service providers, ensuring timely coverage and effective issue resolution.
* **Supplier governance, contracting and risk**
  + Lead high-value negotiations and establish commercial models, contractual protections, performance measures and governance mechanisms.
  + Own Pan-India supplier-base rationalization through commodity and sub-commodity segmentation, supplier consolidation and low-spend tail reduction, while maintaining competition, resilience and service continuity.
  + Ensure the timely execution and renewal of supplier agreements, periodic supplier evaluations, performance monitoring, corrective-action closure and development of alternate suppliers.
  + Review requests for new-vendor creation, validate the business requirement and prioritize the use or expansion of existing capable suppliers before approving additions.
  + Coordinate supplier consolidation and vendor-master updates with relevant stakeholders
  + Ensure contractual obligations, policy compliance, business continuity and third-party risks are actively managed.
* **APAC and Global collaboration**
  + Collaborate with APAC and Global category leaders to leverage regional or global agreements, share local market intelligence and accelerate adoption of global strategies.
  + Represent India requirements in regional initiatives and ensure regional strategies are translated into practical local execution.
  + Promote standard processes, digital sourcing tools, analytics and knowledge sharing across the broader sourcing network.
* **Escalation management and issue resolution**
  + Own and manage operational escalations related to supplier performance, service disruptions, corrective actions, commercial or contractual matters and stakeholder concerns, ensuring timely resolution, clear accountability and business continuity.
* **People leadership and functional excellence**
  + Set clear objectives, coach team members and build capability in Indirect category, analytics, negotiation, contracting and stakeholder engagement.
  + Create a high-accountability and collaborative culture focused on business outcomes, integrity and continuous improvement.
  + Strengthen sourcing processes, controls, documentation and management reporting to improve consistency and audit readiness.

**Support APA initiatives**

Beyond managing India responsibilities, the candidate will support APAC lead for APAC-wide procurement initiatives through coordination of regional projects, consolidation of savings and performance data, preparation of management reports, tracking of key actions, and timely response to global leadership and business information requests.  

  

**KPIs**

* Delivery of agreed productivity, cost optimization and working-capital outcomes with Finance validation.
* Healthy forward pipeline with sufficient coverage, timely implementation and clear risk management.
* Improved addressable spend, contract coverage, policy compliance and supplier consolidation, supported by measurable reductions in active supplier count and low-spend tail without adverse impact on service continuity.
* Stronger supplier performance, service reliability and commercial governance.
* Timely execution and renewal of supplier agreements, supplier evaluations and scheduled audits.
* Improved vendor-master accuracy and disciplined governance of new-vendor additions.
* High stakeholder confidence in sourcing as an early, value-adding business partner.
Enhanced team capability, ownership and execution discipline.  

  

**What you will need to be successful**

* BE/B.Tech., Graduate in Supply Chain, Business, Commerce or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification or MBA preferred.
* 12+ years of procurement and strategic sourcing experience, including significant indirect category-management.
* Proven experience leading cross-functional sourcing and delivering measurable value in a MNC and matrix org.
* Strong commercial acumen, supplier-performance analysis, negotiation, and contract-management capability.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate ambiguity and convert plan into execution.
* People leadership experience with a track record of coaching and developing sourcing professionals.
* Mature executive presence with excellent written, verbal and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate sourcing recommendations clearly to business stakeholders.
Experience in elevators, construction, engineering services, industrial products or consumer durables is preferred.  

  

**Apply now and help us build what's next!**

  

If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day.

Otis is the world’s leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, and service company. We move 2.4 billion people every day and maintain approximately 2.4 million customer units worldwide, the industry's largest Service portfolio.

You may recognize our products in some of the world’s most famous landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa and the Petronas Twin Towers! We are 72,000 people strong, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales, and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians, all committed to meeting the diverse needs of our customers and passengers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. We are proud to be a diverse, global team with a proven legacy of innovation that continues to be the bedrock of a fast-moving, high-performance company.

When you join Otis, you become part of an innovative global industry leader with a resilient business model. You’ll belong to a diverse, trusted, and caring community where your contributions, and the skills and capabilities you’ll gain working alongside the best and brightest, keep us connected and on the cutting edge.

We provide opportunities, training, and resources, that build leadership and capabilities in Sales, Field, Engineering and Major Projects and our Employee Scholar Program is a notable point of pride, through which Otis sponsors colleagues to pursue degrees or certification programs.

Today, our focus more than ever is on people. As a global, people-powered company, we put people – passengers, customers, and colleagues – at the center of everything we do. We are guided by our values that we call our Three Absolutes – prioritizing Safety, Ethics, Quality in all that we do.
