description:
**Import & Export Specialist**
==============================

**Job Details**
---------------

**Job Title:** Import & Export Specialist

**Location:** Mumbai, India

**Work Arrangement:** Onsite

**About the Role**
------------------

The Import & Export Specialist is responsible for overseeing and managing all international trade activities related to the import and export of specialty chemicals. This role ensures regulatory compliance, efficient logistics execution, cost optimization, inventory availability, and seamless coordination with suppliers, customers, freight partners, customs authorities, and regulatory agencies. The incumbent will manage the end-to-end movement of chemical products while ensuring adherence to global trade regulations, hazardous goods requirements, and company quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Import Operations Management:**

* Oversee the entire import and export process, from initial order placement through to delivery and distribution.
* Coordinate with international suppliers and vendors to ensure timely and accurate order fulfilment.
* Manage and monitor import documentation, including bills of lading, import declarations, and customs forms.

**Regulatory Compliance:**

* Ensure all import activities comply with relevant local, national, and international regulations and standards.
* Stay updated on changes in import regulations and implement necessary adjustments to processes.

**Logistics Coordination:**

* Collaborate with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and shipping carriers to manage transportation and logistics.
* Track shipments and resolve any issues related to delays, damages, or discrepancies.

* Evaluate supplier performance and identify opportunities for cost savings and process improvements.

**Reporting and Analysis:**

* Prepare and present reports on import activities, including cost analysis, shipment status, and compliance.
* Analyze import data to identify trends and areas for improvement.

**Export Operations Management**

* Manage the complete export process from customer order receipt through shipment and final delivery to international customers and distributors.
* Coordinate with overseas customers, distributors, and internal commercial teams to ensure timely execution of export orders.
* Prepare, review, and maintain all export documentation including:
* + Commercial Invoices
  + Packing Lists
  + Certificates of Origin
  + Export Declarations
  + Shipping Instructions
  + Bills of Lading / Airway Bills
  + SDS/MSDS and Dangerous Goods Declarations
* Ensure compliance with export control regulations, trade sanctions, licensing requirements, and destination-country import requirements.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders, customs brokers, shipping lines, and airlines for efficient movement of export shipments.
* Manage export logistics for specialty chemicals, including hazardous and non-hazardous products, ensuring compliance with IMDG, IATA, ADR, and other applicable regulations.
* Monitor export shipment status and proactively resolve issues related to documentation, customs clearance, transportation delays, or customer delivery requirements.
* Support regional sales teams by ensuring export operations meet customer service expectations and business commitments.
* Identify opportunities to optimize export freight costs, transit times, and service levels.
* Maintain accurate export records and ensure compliance with statutory and audit requirements.
* Oversee export incentive schemes, duty drawback programs, and free trade agreements where applicable.

**Skills**
----------

* Integrity - Display professionalism and integrity when carrying out his / her responsibilities. Does the right thing when nobody’s looking. Honest in all internal and external customer relations. Exhibits ethical and moral behavior in everyday business conduct. Is as straightforward as possible in all situations. Treating others with respect.
  

* Relationships – Builds and sustains professional working relationships. Makes the effort to know a variety of people in the organization. Establishes effective working partnerships with all internal and external parties.
  

* Self & Business Discipline – Consistently displays core values (integrity, customer service, relationship excellence). Fulfils commitments.
  

* Service orientation – provides high quality service. Responds promptly to service requests.
  

* Confidentiality – Understands confidentiality of employee information. Maintain and adheres to organizational confidentiality policies. Knows how to keep company-related data confidential.
  

* Initiative – Shows inclination to initiate, rather than to react. Initiates individual or group projects, and takes complete responsibility for their success.
  

* Teamwork & Communication Skills – Works and communicate well with managers, executives, and all members of the Company. Share necessary information. Communicates effectively with all levels.

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration or any relevant field.
* Must be completed Certified course of Import/Export
* Required Minimum 5-7 years’ experience in International trade & shipments
* Fluency in spoken and written English.
* Possess strong MS Office skills.
* Knowledge of JD Edward’s or Oracle application software is must.

About Vijay InvestEdge

Established in 1994, Vijay InvestEdge is an AMFI-registered Mutual Fund Distributor based in Pune, built on the principles of trust, integrity, transparency, and long-term client relationships.

We believe wealth creation is not about chasing short-term returns or meeting transactional targets. It is about understanding clients’ financial goals, maintaining disciplined investment practices, and building lasting relationships that compound in value over time.

The Role: What You Will Own

This is a growth-oriented role, not simply a client servicing position. You will be responsible for developing client relationships, acquiring new clients, and growing your portfolio through consistent engagement and a strong understanding of client needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Build and grow a client portfolio:**
  Develop and manage relationships with retail investors and emerging HNI clients, with a focus on long-term retention and portfolio growth.
* **Drive new client acquisition:**
  Generate business through referrals, professional networking, existing relationships, and proactive outreach.
* **Understand client objectives:**
  Engage with clients to understand their financial goals, investment horizon, risk appetite, and liquidity requirements.
* **Conduct structured portfolio reviews:**
  Discuss portfolio performance, asset allocation, investment suitability, and opportunities for portfolio improvement.
* **Expand existing relationships:**
  Identify opportunities to deepen client engagement and grow assets under management through relevant mutual fund offerings.
* **Take ownership of portfolio movements:**
  Monitor inflows, redemptions, and changes in client portfolios, proactively addressing concerns and strengthening investor confidence.
* **Ensure disciplined execution:**
  Work closely with research and operations teams to deliver timely, accurate, and consistent client service.
* **Maintain a structured approach:**
  Follow defined processes for client engagement, reviews, follow-ups, reporting, and business development.

Who We’re Looking For

We are looking for an experienced professional who combines relationship-building skills with commercial awareness, investment knowledge, and an ownership mindset.

**Essential Experience**

* 7–10 years of experience in wealth management, mutual fund distribution, or a related financial services business.
* At least 7 years of relevant experience in business relationship management and mutual funds.
* Demonstrated ability to acquire clients, manage relationships, and grow a client portfolio.

**Skills and Mindset**

* Strong communication, networking, and relationship-management skills.
* A sound understanding of mutual funds, investment risk, asset allocation, and long-term investing.
* The ability to translate client requirements into suitable investment solutions within the applicable regulatory and distribution framework.
* A disciplined approach to follow-ups, portfolio reviews, and business development.
* Commercial awareness and the ability to identify opportunities for sustainable business growth.
* A self-driven, accountable, and ambitious approach to professional development.

What to Expect at Vijay InvestEdge

**A role with ownership, accountability, and room to grow.**

* **Structured working environment:**
  Work within defined processes designed to improve client experience, execution, and consistency.
* **Collaborative execution:**
  Partner with Research, Marketing and Operations to deliver a coordinated client experience.
* **Long-term career development:**
  Build expertise, strengthen client relationships, and grow alongside an expanding wealth distribution business.
* **A relationship-first culture:**
  Focus on trust, investor understanding, and sustainable business rather than purely transactional interactions.

We are building a platform where the right people can grow their professional capabilities, create lasting client relationships, and contribute meaningfully to the business.

Who Should Apply?

This opportunity is best suited to professionals who already understand the mutual fund distribution business and are ready to take greater ownership of client acquisition, portfolio growth, and relationship management.

If your primary focus is only on servicing an existing client base, this may not be the right fit.

**If you want to build a strong client book, take ownership of business growth, and build a serious long-term career in wealth management, we would like to hear from you.**

title: Business Development Manager - Environmental India (f/m/d)
description:
Your role
  
  
The Business Development Manager (BDM) India is responsible for driving sustainable growth within the Environmental Segment by identifying and developing market opportunities, building strategic customer and partner relationships, and expanding sales of integrated solutions for anaerobic digestion, manure management, and municipal and industrial wastewater treatment applications. The role combines commercial leadership, market development, strategic account management, channel partner support, and aftermarket growth to help customers improve operational efficiency, resource recovery, renewable energy production, and environmental sustainability.
  
  
Acting as the primary commercial lead for the Environmental Segment in India, the BDM develops and executes growth strategies, identifies new business opportunities, manages key accounts, and strengthens the regional partner network. In close collaboration with engineering, product management, manufacturing, and service teams in Germany and Italy, the BDM ensures the delivery of high-quality, value-driven solutions that address customer needs and support long-term business success.
  
  
The role is responsible for promoting the complete Environmental Segment portfolio, including pumps, mixers, separation technologies, modules, hygienizing biocells, relevant accessories, and lifecycle service offerings.
  
  
*Uniquely, this role will work closely with the Divisional Business Line Managers for Environmental, and the Sales Distribution Managers.*
Your day-to-day
  
  

* Identify and develop optimal revenue models, sales/distribution channels, pricing, and new product development strategies.
* Negotiate strategic partnerships.
* Prioritize and track investments across new product development initiatives.
* Share best practices and collaborate with colleagues across different departments to drive business success.
* Carry out a detailed analysis of the market in which the company operates to identify avenues for development: new markets, customers, growth areas, new trends etc.
* Devising and planning the strategic guidelines and short, medium and long-term sales actions needed to achieve the objective (identifying priority targets, key contacts, contact actions, follow-ups, etc.) for each targeted market.
* Accountable of the Turnover and the margin in the segment.
* Define commercial opportunities and identify market needs in order to increase the number of new project requests.
* Provide technical support, product selection guidance, and pump sizing recommendations.
* Conduct site visits, system audits, and troubleshooting support as needed.
* Train distributors and representatives on products, applications, and value‑propositions.
* Support project execution teams to ensure customer expectations and scope requirements are.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline reports, and CRM updates.
* Provide regular feedback to leadership regarding opportunities, risks, and product needs.

**Your Skills And Experience**
We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role.
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering preferred (Mechanical, Chemical, Industrial) or equivalent technical experience.
* 5–8 years of outside sales experience in industrial pumps, fluid‑handling equipment, rotating machinery, or engineered capital equipment.
* Knowledge of the market and the application required to set up the right commercial strategy.
* Strong understanding of fluid dynamics, pump sizing, and system design principles.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple deadlines.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and CRM tools.
* Willingness to travel extensively throughout the region.
* Bilingual Indi/English required; German and Italian is a plus.

**Your Compensation And Benefits**
We offer compensation that reflects the skills, experience, and responsibilities of the role. Pay also depends on the country where the job role is based, as compensation practices vary across our markets. During the recruitment process, we share clear information about the pay and benefits for your location, so you know what to expect before moving forward.
  
  
Your location
  
  
This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our offices in either Pune, India or Wangen in Allgäu region, Germany or Correggio, Italy.
  
  
Why it is great to work with us
  
  
Your career grows through your skills, your curiosity, and the people you work with. You join a global network where we learn from each other and share knowledge openly. We focus on long‑term development and encourage you to explore new ideas that help us move forward. Innovation is part of how we think and act – we test, improve, and use what we learn to create solutions that matter. You can make a meaningful impact by contributing with your insights and taking ownership of your work, supported by flexible ways of working and leaders who empower you.
  
  
Application process
  
  
**About**
Our selection process includes interviews and, for some roles, skills assessments that help us gain a deeper understanding of your profile. We look forward to getting to know you, learning about your strengths, and discussing how you can grow with us. If you have questions during the process or need support, please contact us:
  
  
Talent Acquisition: Katharina Schneider
  
  
**Uniting curious minds**
Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

**Practice Development Manager (Medical Devices / Digital Dentistry)**

Delhi NCR | Field sales, full time

I'm hiring a Practice Development Manager in Delhi NCR for a global MedTech leader in digital dentistry. You'll own a territory of dental and orthodontic practices, grow existing accounts, bring new doctors on board and help them move to digital workflows such as intraoral scanning, digital treatment planning and clear aligner therapy.

This is a sales role with clear numbers attached. What changes is the conversation. You'll sit with doctors and their teams as a business partner, look at how the practice runs and where it can grow, and sell on value rather than price. Parts of the territory are underpenetrated, so we need someone who enjoys building demand from a low base.

**What you'll do**

• Build and run a territory plan using account data and opportunity analysis

• Grow revenue with existing doctors and activate new practices

• Run consultative, value-led conversations with clinicians and handle competitive objections

• Drive adoption of digital workflows and help practices fit them into daily operations

• Work with clinical, marketing and training teams on doctor education and events

**What you need**

• 6 to 9 years of sales experience, with at least 4 years in medical devices

• Direct selling to doctors (surgeons, specialists, dentists). This is mandatory. Distributor-only or trade sales profiles won't fit

• Experience with an MNC medical device company or a global MNC pharma company

• A record of beating targets that you can back with numbers: rankings, awards, growth %

• Stable career history, around 2.5 to 3 years or more in each organisation

• Experience growing a low-revenue or new territory

• Degree in science, pharmacy, biomedical, engineering or similar. MBA is a plus

Dental or orthodontic experience helps but isn't required. Backgrounds that tend to do well: orthopaedics, cardiology, ophthalmology and surgical devices, diagnostics, capital equipment, and specialty pharma with strong doctor relationships.

**Package**

Fixed CTC up to ₹20 LPA, plus retirals, incentives of up to 65%, and medical insurance.

Many device sales people see dentistry as niche. In practice, this role builds clinician influence, digital adoption skills, territory ownership and practice consulting experience, all of which carry across healthcare technology. The company is also expanding its presence in India.

The candidate will lead by example, provide hands-on sales support, conduct regular performance reviews, and implement strategies to improve productivity, customer engagement, and overall sales performance.

1. Team Management & Leadership

Lead, supervise, and motivate a team of telesales executives to achieve individual and team sales targets.

Allocate leads, assign daily calling targets, and monitor team productivity.

Conduct daily team briefings, performance reviews, and sales huddles.

Coach team members on communication, pitching, objection handling, negotiation, and closing techniques.

Identify performance gaps and provide regular feedback, training, and development support.

Drive achievement of daily, weekly, and monthly sales and revenue targets.

Develop effective calling strategies to improve customer engagement and lead conversion.

Monitor the sales pipeline and ensure timely follow-up on qualified prospects.

Support executives in handling high-value prospects, complex objections, and sales closures.

3. Sales Process & Performance Monitoring

Track team performance through CRM systems, sales dashboards, and daily MIS reports.

Maintain accurate lead records, sales updates, and pipeline reports.

Identify bottlenecks in the sales process and recommend improvements.

Share daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports with the reporting manager.

4. Training & Continuous Improvement

Conduct regular training sessions on product knowledge, sales scripts, customer handling, and closing techniques.

Develop and refine calling scripts, objection-handling responses, and follow-up strategies.

Encourage a competitive yet collaborative sales culture.

Recognize high performers and create improvement plans for underperforming team members.

Continuously identify ways to improve team productivity, sales efficiency, and customer experience.

Graduate in any discipline; a relevant business or management qualification is an advantage.

3-6 years of experience in telesales, inside sales, telemarketing, or business development.

Prior experience managing or supervising a telesales team is strongly preferred.

Proven track record of achieving sales targets and driving revenue.

Excellent verbal communication, leadership, negotiation, and persuasion skills.

Strong understanding of sales funnels, lead qualification, follow-up management, and conversion strategies.

Ability to coach team members, handle escalations, and manage performance challenges.

Familiarity with CRM systems, MS Excel, sales dashboards, and reporting tools.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to use performance data to improve results.

Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities in a target-driven environment.

Experience selling digital marketing, SEO, website development, IT solutions, or other B2B services will be an added advantage.

What We Offer:

Competitive fixed salary with performance-based incentives.

Opportunity to lead and grow a sales team.

A target-driven environment with performance-linked career progression.

Exposure to digital business solutions and B2B sales.

title: Account Executive - SMB
description:
**Why this role exists**

As an Account Executive for the SMB segment at JustCall, you will generate and close revenue through both inbound and outbound sales. You'll convert high-intent demo requests and free-trial signups while building your own pipeline through cold calls, cold emails, and LinkedIn outreach. You'll uncover each prospect's communication and workflow challenges, then show how JustCall solves them.

This is a high-velocity, quota-carrying role where you take deals from first conversation to close. Success is measured by revenue delivered, not activity alone.

**What you’ll actually do**

* **Convert inbound demo requests and free-trial signups**
  into qualified opportunities, prioritizing high-intent leads with timely follow-up.
* **Build your own pipeline**
  through cold calling, cold emailing, and LinkedIn outreach so you're never reliant on inbound alone.
* **Run discovery**
  to understand each prospect's calling, SMS, and customer communication workflows, the business cost of their challenges, and their buying process, stakeholders, and timelines.
* **Deliver tailored demos**
  that connect JustCall's capabilities to the prospect's pain points and clearly show business value and ROI.
* **Handle objections**
  on pricing, competitors, integrations, and switching costs, then negotiate and close new business.
* **Own an individual revenue quota**
  and consistently hit or exceed monthly and quarterly targets
  **.**
* **Keep CRM records, pipeline stages, and forecasts accurate**
  while tracking lead-to-opportunity conversion, win rate, average deal size, and sales cycle.

**What we’re looking for**

* **4+ years of closing sales experience**
  - including prospecting, ideally at a technology company, with a track record of top performance.
* **Full-cycle ownership**
  - you’ve run deals from first touch to signed contract, not just worked leads someone else qualified.
* **Comfort with high-volume, high-velocity, multi-threaded selling**
  - juggling several live deals at once, each at a different stage.
* **Strong stakeholder management**
  - you can navigate deals involving multiple business units and decision-makers.
* **Sharp discovery and communication skills**
  - you ask the right questions and translate customer needs into a compelling case for JustCall.
* **Adaptability in a fast-changing environment**
  - comfortable working cross-functionally as priorities shift.
* **A genuine customer-first mindset**
  - you treat objections and feedback as data, not obstacles.

**Edges that help**

* Experience selling into CCaaS, CPaaS, CRM, or sales-engagement categories.
* Familiarity with multichannel communication tools - calling, texting, WhatsApp, email - in a single platform.
* A track record closing high velocity SaaS deals with multiple stakeholders.
* Experience partnering with RevOps, Sales Ops, or IT during evaluation and close.
* Flexibility to work across multiple time zones (NAMER, EMEA, ANZ)

**How we work**

* Outcomes over output. We measure product impact by retention curves, revenue influence, and customer trust - not features shipped.
* High ownership from day one - you'll shape the product org, not inherit a finished one.
* Fast cycles, real ambiguity, and the expectation that you bring a sharp point of view and move quickly on it.

title: AI Business Consultant - SaaS/B2B - Domestic Market
description:
Role Overview

MyOperator is transitioning from a Cloud Telephony leader to India's leading Business AI Operator — and this role will be central to driving that growth through outbound sales.

As an Business Consultant Outbound Sales – AI Products, you will own the end-to-end sales cycle for new customer acquisition, from identifying and prospecting potential customers to conducting discovery conversations, presenting solutions, and closing deals. You will proactively engage businesses through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn, and other outbound channels to generate qualified opportunities and drive new Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR).

You will be expected to understand customer challenges, identify opportunities where AI-powered communication can create business value, and communicate the ROI of MyOperator's solutions to decision-makers. This is a hands-on, target-driven role for someone who can build their own pipeline, manage a disciplined sales process, and consistently convert prospects into customers.

About MyOperator

MyOperator is a Business AI Operator and category leader that unifies WhatsApp, Calls, and AI-powered chatbots & voice bots into one intelligent business communication platform. Unlike fragmented communication tools, MyOperator combines automation, intelligence, and workflow integration to help businesses run WhatsApp campaigns, manage calls, deploy AI chatbots, and track performance — all from a single no-code platform. Trusted by 12,000+ brands including Amazon, Domino’s, Apollo, and Razor-pay, MyOperator enables faster responses, higher resolution rates, and scalable customer engagement.

Key Responsibility Areas

* Own Outbound Sales Targets: Drive new customer acquisition and revenue by consistently achieving individual sales targets and new ARR goals.
* Prospecting and Pipeline Generation: Research target companies, identify relevant industries and decision-makers, and build a qualified pipeline through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn prospecting, and other outbound channels.
* Lead Qualification and Discovery: Conduct consultative discovery conversations to understand customer requirements, existing communication infrastructure, operational challenges, and opportunities for automation.
* Product Demonstrations and Solution Pitching: Present MyOperator's AI-powered communication solutions, including WhatsApp, cloud telephony, AI chatbots, and voice bots, by connecting product capabilities to customer pain points and measurable business outcomes.
* CXO and Decision-Maker Engagement: Build relationships with business owners, CXOs, functional heads, and other key stakeholders to influence buying decisions and drive adoption of MyOperator's solutions.
* End-to-End Sales Cycle Management: Manage opportunities from initial outreach and qualification through product demonstrations, proposals, commercial negotiations, follow-ups, and deal closure.
* Consultative Selling and Objection Handling: Understand customer needs, address concerns around implementation, pricing, integration, and business value, and position MyOperator as a solution to their communication and customer engagement challenges.
* Pipeline and CRM Management: Maintain accurate records of prospect interactions, activities, follow-ups, opportunity stages, and sales forecasts in Zoho or the designated CRM. Ensure consistent pipeline hygiene and timely follow-through.
* Revenue and Conversion Optimisation: Monitor individual performance metrics, including outreach activity, connect rates, meetings booked, qualified opportunities, conversion rates, sales cycle, and revenue generated. Identify improvement areas to achieve targets consistently.
* Market and Competitor Insights: Stay informed about industry trends, competing solutions, customer expectations, and emerging AI communication use cases to strengthen prospecting and sales conversations.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Share prospect feedback, objections, market insights, and closed-lost reasons with sales leadership, marketing, and product teams to improve sales messaging, targeting, and product positioning.

Requirements — Must Have

* 2–5 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably in SaaS, cloud telephony, CPaaS, CRM, communication technology, or other subscription-based technology products.
* Demonstrated experience in outbound sales, including cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn prospecting, or other proactive lead-generation channels.
* Proven track record of meeting individual sales targets, generating qualified pipelines, and closing new business.
* Experience managing the sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through product presentations, negotiations, and deal closure.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to understand customer environments, identify pain points, and position technology solutions in terms of business value and ROI.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and objection-handling skills, with the ability to engage business owners, CXOs, and key decision-makers.
* Hands-on experience using CRM tools such as Zoho, Salesforce, or equivalent platforms to manage pipelines, activities, and follow-ups.
* Self-driven, target-oriented, and comfortable working in a performance-driven environment with ownership of individual revenue outcomes.

Requirements — Good to Have

* Prior experience selling B2B SaaS, CPaaS, cloud telephony, WhatsApp Business solutions, conversational AI, chatbots, or voice AI products.
* Experience selling to SMB and mid-market customers across sectors such as BFSI, e-commerce, logistics, healthcare, retail, and other customer-facing industries.
* Familiarity with AI-powered business communication, workflow automation, customer engagement platforms, and contact-centre solutions.
* Experience engaging senior stakeholders and conducting consultative sales conversations with CXOs, business heads, and functional leaders.
* Familiarity with sales engagement tools, prospect research platforms, structured outreach sequences, and data-driven pipeline management.
* A track record of consistent performance, career progression, and stable tenure in previous organisations.

This Profile Is Not For

* Candidates whose experience is limited to inbound lead handling or converting marketing-generated enquiries without substantial outbound prospecting experience.
* Candidates focused exclusively on lead generation or appointment setting, without experience managing opportunities through negotiation and closure.
* Candidates with only B2C sales experience and no demonstrated exposure to B2B selling or business decision-makers.
* Candidates from traditional telecom, hardware, or offline commodity sales without relevant SaaS, subscription-based, or technology sales experience.
* Candidates who rely entirely on pre-assigned leads and lack the ability to independently research prospects, generate pipeline, and drive new customer acquisition.

title: VP -Product
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**POSITION DESCRIPTION**

apexanalytix is the world's leading provider of supplier onboarding, risk management and recovery solutions. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Greensboro, NC, apexanalytix is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management Solutions, recognized for both Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute. More than 320 of the world's largest companies use our AI-native, Quantum Era-ready platform to protect over $9.5 trillion in annual spend.

apexanalytix is seeking an experienced Head of Product to own product strategy and execution across apexanalytix's full platform.

The portfolio spans three connected pillars — supplier onboarding, supplier risk management, and audit and recovery — delivered through a configurable enterprise platform, a self-service data validation and risk API business, and a supplier-facing community platform, with a substantial AI and automation capability underpinning all of them. apexanalytix has also been named Risk Management Company of the Year by SupplyTech Breakthrough and rated the top Supplier Relationship Management and Risk solution by Spend Matters.

This role sits at the center of the business — translating customer and market needs into a coherent, prioritized roadmap across that portfolio, and holding product managers and cross-functional partners in Engineering, Design and Go-to-Market accountable to it. This is a player-coach role: you'll set direction across the full portfolio while staying close enough to individual product areas to make sharp calls when it matters.

This role will lead a team of product managers covering apexanalytix's core product lines, working in close collaboration with Engineering, Sales, Customer Success and Marketing to ensure the roadmap reflects both customer value and business priority.

**The Portfolio:**

Supplier management and risk platform. Multi-tenant enterprise SaaS covering supplier registration and onboarding, self-registration and invite flows, document collection and e-signature, validation gates, approval and status workflow, risk scoring and scorecards, segmentation, revalidation, ERP integration, tax and withholding validation, and consent management. This platform is delivered largely through configuration rather than code — dozens of distinct tenant-scoped configurable surfaces mean a significant share of what a client experiences as "the product" is a configuration decision, not a release.

QubitOn. A product-led, self-service data validation and risk API business with a published price list from a free tier through pay-as-you-go, Pro and Enterprise. Over 70 capabilities spanning data validation, banking and financial verification in 180+ countries, global tax ID and regulatory validation, business intelligence and golden-record matching, compliance and watchlist screening, risk scoring, monitoring and questionnaires — backed by 280M+ verified golden records from 1,000+ sources across 250+ countries. Packaged offerings include BankPro and Registration Essentials, and the platform is also delivered through a self-service developer portal.

Conductor. The supplier-side platform, serving our clients' suppliers and customers rather than the clients themselves: signup, identity and passkey authentication, invite and onboarding flows, invoice visibility and risk information. This is the second side of a two-sided market, with its own adoption dynamics.

Cyberrisk. Third-party and supplier cyber risk monitoring, adjacent to the supplier risk and TPRM capability in the core platform.

Audit, recovery and payment integrity. The accounts payable and contract compliance recovery audit practices — apexanalytix is the largest commercial AP recovery audit firm in the world — and firststrike® Fraud Detect, the duplicate payment prevention product that grew out of our audit algorithms and has run in daily client operations since 2006. A services-plus-software business with a contingency commercial model.

apexanalytix Learn. Subscription-based training and enablement.

AI-enabled capability. A significant AI and automation capability — document intelligence, conversational assistants, supplier intelligence, ESG scoring and AI-assisted audit — built and delivered by a separate AI & Automation organization. This role owns what is packaged, positioned and priced from it for clients, and the prioritized demand signal into that organization.

**Trusted Advisor**

* Leverages deep subject-matter expertise across apexanalytix's product portfolio to advise executive leadership on product strategy and investment trade-offs.
* Acts as the voice of the customer and internal advocate, ensuring insights from enterprise clients (many on the Global 2000) shape the roadmap rather than getting lost between teams.
* Partners with Engineering, Design and Go-to-Market leaders to translate business priorities into a shared, prioritized product roadmap.
* Roles and Requirements
* Owns end-to-end product strategy and roadmap across apexanalytix's core product lines, ensuring alignment with overall company strategy and value-creation priorities.
* Leads, mentors and develops a team of product managers, setting a consistent bar for discovery, prioritization and go-to-market execution across product areas.
* Partners with Engineering leadership to translate roadmap priorities into delivery plans, balancing new feature development against platform investment.
* Owns the commitment-to-delivery discipline: every commitment made to a client, prospect or analyst has a named owner, an entry in the delivery system of record, and a date Engineering has agreed to.
* Owns the configuration-versus-code boundary for the supplier management platform — deciding what becomes a configurable capability, what remains a per-tenant configuration, and what becomes a product feature — and is accountable for the long-run support and upgrade cost of that choice.
* Drives customer discovery and market research to validate product bets, working directly with enterprise customers, Sales and Customer Success.
* Owns the supplier-side product experience as a first-class concern with its own adoption metrics, not as a downstream consequence of client-side decisions.
* Defines and tracks product success metrics — adoption, retention, revenue impact, API consumption and supplier activation — and reports progress to executive leadership.
* Leads pricing and packaging decisions in partnership with Finance and Sales leadership across materially different commercial models: enterprise SaaS subscription, usage-metered self-service API with a published free tier, contingency-based recovery audit services, and subscription-based offerings such as apexanalytix Learn.
* Represents Product in executive reviews and with industry analysts, providing clear, data-driven narratives on roadmap progress and business impact.
* Champions a consistent product management practice — discovery frameworks, roadmap cadence, prioritization criteria — across the team.

**Required Skills**

* 10+ years of product management experience, including 4+ years leading and developing a team of product managers.
* Experience owning product strategy for a B2B enterprise SaaS platform, ideally serving large, complex enterprise customers.
* Direct experience with at least two distinct commercial models — enterprise subscription, usage-metered/API, marketplace or network, or services-attached.
* Experience with a self-service or product-led growth motion, including free-tier design, conversion funnel, usage-based pricing and developer experience.
* Experience with a highly configurable enterprise product, and a clear point of view on where configurability creates leverage and where it creates unmanageable divergence.
* Strong technical fluency — comfortable partnering directly with engineering leadership on architecture and platform trade-offs, even without a hands-on engineering background.
* Proven track record turning customer and market insight into a prioritized, well-communicated roadmap.
* Experience with pricing/packaging strategy and business-case development for new products or product lines.
* Strong executive presence — able to represent Product credibly in front of executive leadership, industry analysts and, as needed, the Board.
* Experience working with a distributed engineering organization across US and India time zones.
* Strong communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience in supply chain, procurement, accounts payable, fintech, audit, third-party risk or data/analytics domains.
* Experience with a two-sided or network product where adoption on the non-paying side determines the value of the paying side.
* Experience packaging and pricing AI capability as a product, including the guardrail, assurance and liability considerations that accompany it.
* Experience in regulated or attested environments (SOC 2, FedRAMP) where compliance shapes the roadmap.
* Education Levels/Credentials (Degree types and Emphasis) - Undergraduate degree required; MBA or other graduate business degree a strong plus but not required.

**Location**

* apexanalytix Headquarters (HQ) at Greensboro, NC, USA (hybrid).

**Travel required — occasional, including periodic travel to the Noida, India GCC and to enterprise clients.**

**Scope Boundaries:**

**This role owns what gets built and why, for whom, and at what price. Engineering delivery and release execution sit with the VP, Head of Software Development; technical architecture with the Architect; platform strategy and infrastructure investment with the SVP, Global Head of Engineering & Infrastructure; security policy and compliance attestation with the CISO; and AI and automation delivery with a separate AI & Automation organization.**

Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/

Benefits

At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence. With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

### **ABOUT XAPADS MEDIA**

  

Xapads Media is a leading global AdTech company delivering innovative digital advertising solutions to brands, agencies, and app developers worldwide. With a global presence of 200+ employees across multiple international offices, Xapads combines technology, data insights, and market expertise to drive high-impact advertising outcomes.

Recognized as a Great Place to Work for five consecutive years and ranked among the Top 100 Companies for Women, Xapads is committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture that values professional growth, operational excellence, and workplace diversity.

### **ABOUT THE SEGMENT**

The Social Media and Brand Communications team builds global awareness, authority, and engagement across all Xapads product lines and international markets. The team simplifies complex programmatic, advertising technology, and publisher monetizing concepts into sharp, compelling narratives across social media, digital campaigns, executive thought leadership, and corporate communications.

### **THE ROLE**

The Copywriter will strengthen Xapads’ brand and social communication capabilities by creating clear, engaging, and persuasive content across global digital channels. Operating as a core creative storyteller, this person will translate complex AdTech products, business objectives, and campaign briefs into impactful copy that highlights Xapads’ value proposition. The role independently owns content from brief interpretation and research through drafting, executive ghostwriting, editing, and final publishing handoff while maintaining strong brand consistency across all platforms.

### **WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* **End-to-End Content Ownership:** Own assigned content deliverables from brief interpretation and independent research through drafting, editing, fact-checking, and final handoff.
* **Social & Campaign Messaging:** Own social media copy, campaign narratives, ad copy, and pitch messaging across global brand initiatives.
* **Executive & Brand Voice:** Own executive ghostwriting and thought-leadership communications, capturing leadership perspectives in a credible, authentic tone.
* **Brand Consistency:** Ensure consistent brand voice, terminology, narrative quality, and clarity across all digital channels and client-facing presentations.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Campaign & Social Copywriting:** Create compelling copy for social media platforms, brand campaigns, advertising materials, PR initiatives, award submissions, and client pitches.
* **AdTech Simplification:** Translate technical AdTech, programmatic, mobile performance, and digital advertising concepts into clear, accessible, and creative communications.
* **Long-Form & Thought Leadership:** Develop long-form articles, case studies, blogs, and executive ghostwritten pieces for leadership LinkedIn profiles and industry publications.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with design, social media, marketing, product, SEO, sales, and executive leadership to brainstorm creative concepts, messaging strategies, and campaign plans.
* **Editing & Quality Assurance:** Edit and refine content to preserve accuracy, logical flow, proper grammar, brand voice, and clear calls-to-action.
* **SEO & Workflow Optimization:** Apply foundational SEO principles to web and long-form content while utilizing AI-assisted tools responsibly to support research and workflow efficiency.

### **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* **Relevant Experience:** 1–3 years of professional copywriting or content writing experience in an agency (creative/digital) or in-house marketing setting. A strong portfolio showcasing creative storytelling and campaign execution is essential.
* **Core Writing & Grammar Skills:** Exceptional command of American English grammar, vocabulary, structural editing, and proofreading.
* **Executive Ghostwriting Capability:** Demonstrated ability to interview leaders or subject-matter experts and translate raw inputs into credible, well-structured thought-leadership posts.
* **Research & Fact-Checking:** Strong ability to research unfamiliar B2B or technical topics, verify claims independently, and explain complex subjects simply.
* **Adaptable Tone:** Ability to tailor voice, messaging depth, and calls-to-action based on target audiences, digital platforms, and business goals.

### **GOOD TO HAVE**

* **Industry Background:** Prior copywriting experience in B2B technology, SaaS, digital advertising, ad-tech, or programmatic media ecosystems.
* **Agency Background:** Hands-on experience working in creative or digital marketing agencies.
* **SEO & AI Familiarity:** Basic knowledge of search intent, keyword integration, and experience leveraging AI tools for content research and workflow support.

  

**Life at Xapads Media:**

At Xapads Media, we place a strong emphasis on employee growth and continuous development. Individuals are encouraged to build expertise, take ownership of their work, and explore areas that align with their interests over time.

Our culture supports collaboration, knowledge sharing, and open communication. Teams engage in ongoing discussions, exchange ideas, and contribute to broader conversations across the business.

We also value moments that bring teams together-recognising achievements, sharing progress, and building a sense of collective momentum.

To learn more about our culture and ways of working, visit: https://www.xapads.com/life-at-xapads

To apply for this position, send an email to our careers mailbox (career@xapads.com). In the email make sure to include your resume and any additional information you would feel relevant for this role.

**6. Customer Engagement & Relationship Building**

Ownership & Accountability

title: Sales Executive Machine Sales
description:
**Who We Are**

We are an **ERP-led business transformation and implementation organization** focused on helping clients move from fragmented processes and systems to **integrated, standardized and best-practice-driven operations**.

Our approach to ERP implementation has two key tracks:

**1. Industry Best Practices & ERP Transformation**  
We evaluate the client’s existing processes against relevant industry and functional best practices and enable these through leading ERP platforms such as SAP and Microsoft Dynamics. The objective is not simply to implement software, but to establish standardized processes, controls and operating models that reflect proven industry practices.

**2. Sustained Organizational Change**  
ERP implementation also requires sustained organizational transformation and change management. We work with the client to embed the new processes, behaviours and practices into the day-to-day working habits of their workforce. This ensures that the implemented solution delivers lasting business value rather than becoming only a technology implementation.

**Our Client Segment**

The role will support clients across three broad segments:

* Multinational companies operating in India and other regions.
* Large Indian corporates with complex and diverse finance operations.
* Fast-growing, family-owned and professionally managed mid-sized businesses, generally in the ₹200–800 crore range

**Our Focus Areas -**

In Acxiom, you will get opportunities to work across 16 industry segments ranging from Retail, Pharmacy, Healthcare, E- Commerce, FMCG, Industrial Manufacturing, Jewellery, Service Sector and many other industries where you will learn how different industries work at financial as well as at operational level.

Our clients typically come from **non-ERP or fragmented-system environments**, where decision maker are CXO / MD and **has ROI as prime Driver for selecting any ERP Solution**. We are looking for someone with Machine sales experience and having similar sales cycle (Long Term Maturity with decisions- top to bottom) in the targeted Industry segments. Our ideal candidate will be someone who understand the mindset of such decision makers and gets to sell a solution that may stimulate overall scale of growth for the client.

**Role, Scope & Responsibilities:**

We are looking for a high-energy, aggressive **Sales Hunter** to drive the sales of our high-value **Core Manufacturing Machines** across the North Region (**Delhi, Jaipur, Lucknow, Ludhiana**). You will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, navigating complex multi-stakeholder sales cycles, and closing high-ticket deals directly with business owners and top decision-makers.

If you are an absolute closer who thrives on the road and loves winning big deals, this role is for you

* **New Business Hunting:** Actively prospect and map manufacturing clusters in your assigned territory to build a robust pipeline of new clients.
* **CXO-Level Pitching:** Engage and build relationships directly with business owners, promoters, and MDs (not just purchase managers) to pitch high-value machinery solutions.
* **Complex Deal Management:** Navigate long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from initial technical evaluation to commercial negotiations and final sign-off.
* **Deal Closure:** Consistently hit revenue targets by aggressively pursuing and closing high-value capital equipment deals (**₹1 CR to ₹1.5 CR** ticket sizes).
* **Territory Coverage:** Travel extensively across industrial hubs in North India to meet prospective clients and conduct on-site assessments.

**Ideal Candidate**

* **Target Background:** Any Graduate / PG with5-8 years of experience hardcore B2B field sales experience within capital equipment or industrial manufacturing sectors.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Proven track record selling core manufacturing machines such as CNC, VMC, Milling, Drilling, Turning, Lathe, Hydraulic Presses, or MIG Welding Cells.
* **Deal Size:** Demonstrated experience in successfully closing individual deals valued **at 50 lacs to 1.5 cr (or above)**
* **Travel:** 100% openness to **extensive travel** across industrial zones.
* **Core Instinct:** A pure **Sales Hunter** mindset with exceptional negotiation and closing skills.
* **Professional Stability:** A stable and progressive career track record, preferably with limited employer changes (1–3 organisations) and meaningful tenure of 7–8 years or more with leading organisations
* Must have done sales **within the territory** and **also having a network and connects with the Owners/ MD of the companies.**
* **Basic knowledge and readiness of ERP will be imparted to the candidate.**

**Out of Scope (What This Role Is NOT)**

*This role is not intended for a Consumable product/Parts Sales’ specialist.*

The role may not be suitable for candidates who:

* Candidates whose experience is limited only to **Consumables, Small Tools, or Accessories sales**.
* Candidates who only deal up to the **Purchase Manager / Procurement** level without reaching the final decision-makers.
* **Account Farmers** who only manage and nurture existing accounts instead of generating new business.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a motivated and technically interested **Industrial Magnet Sales Executive** to join our B2B sales team.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying industrial customers, connecting with decision-makers, scheduling appointments, visiting customers, understanding their magnet requirements, and developing business opportunities.

Our products include **Rare Earth Magnets, Permanent Magnets, and Neodymium (NdFeB) Magnets** used in various industrial applications, including motors, EV motors, BLDC motors, automation, pumps and other manufacturing applications.

A Chemistry background is required because the candidate should be able to understand basic material and magnet-related specifications and communicate effectively with customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and research potential **B2B industrial customers** across India.
* Generate leads through online research, databases, references, cold calling and other sources.
* Contact companies and decision-makers to understand their requirements.
* **Schedule appointments before visiting customers**.
* Visit industrial customers and manufacturing units for business development.
* Understand the customer's product, motor/application and magnet requirement.
* Identify whether the customer is using **NdFeB, ferrite or other permanent magnets**.
* Collect technical requirements such as magnet type, grade, size, shape, coating, tolerance and application.
* Coordinate with the technical/internal team for drawings, samples, specifications and quotations.
* Follow up with customers from initial enquiry to quotation, sample approval and order.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, customer meetings, requirements, quotations and follow-ups.
* Develop long-term relationships with Purchase, Procurement, R&D, Motor Design and management teams.
* Achieve assigned sales and lead-generation targets.
* Travel to different cities and states across India for customer meetings when required.

**Target Customers / Industries**

The candidate will primarily target manufacturers and companies using magnets in their products, including:

* EV manufacturers and EV motor manufacturers
* Electric 2-wheeler and 3-wheeler manufacturers
* EV component and e-axle manufacturers
* Industrial motor manufacturers
* BLDC, PMSM and servo motor manufacturers
* DC motor manufacturers
* Fan and BLDC fan manufacturers
* Pump and compressor manufacturers
* Automation and robotics companies
* Wind-energy equipment manufacturers
* Elevator and traction-machine manufacturers
* Automotive component manufacturers
* Electronics and sensor manufacturers

The sales guide highlights EV/automotive, BLDC fans, industrial motors, wind, elevators, solar pumps, robotics/automation and pumps as key target sectors.

**What the Candidate Needs to Understand**

The candidate does not need extensive prior magnet-sales experience. However, they should be willing to learn about:

* Permanent magnets
* Rare Earth Magnets
* Neodymium (NdFeB) Magnets
* Ferrite Magnets
* Basic magnet grades and specifications
* Magnet dimensions, shape and coating
* Motor applications
* EV and DC/BLDC/PMSM motor applications
* Industrial B2B sales processes

For example, NdFeB magnets are used in EV motors, industrial motors, robotics, automation, speakers and sensors.

**Candidate Profile**

* **Graduate with Chemistry background is mandatory.**
* Freshers are welcome.
* Strong interest in building a career in **B2B/industrial sales**.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Confident in speaking with company owners, purchase managers and technical teams.
* Comfortable making cold calls and following up with customers.
* Willing to visit factories and industrial areas.
* Willing to **travel anywhere in India** for customer meetings.
* Good basic understanding of Chemistry/materials is preferred.
* Must be willing to learn technical product specifications.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel, email and CRM/lead management is preferred.
* Having a two-wheeler and a valid driving licence would be an advantage.

**Sales Process**

The candidate will generally follow this process:

**Lead Generation → Customer Calling → Requirement Identification → Appointment → Customer Visit → Technical Requirement Collection → Quotation → Follow-up → Sample/Approval → Order**

The candidate should focus on understanding the customer's actual application and requirements rather than simply asking whether they need magnets.

**Key Performance Indicators**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Number of qualified B2B leads generated
* Number of customer calls
* Appointments scheduled
* Customer visits completed
* New customer accounts developed
* Quotations generated
* Follow-ups and conversion
* Sales revenue generated
* Customer relationship development
* Accuracy of customer/technical information collected

**Important Requirement**

**This is a field-oriented B2B industrial sales role. Candidates must be comfortable with customer visits and travelling across India.**

The candidate should have the ability to communicate with both **commercial and technical contacts**, including Purchase Managers, Procurement teams, R&D/Motor Design teams and business owners.

title: CRM Head
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION: HEAD – CUSTOMER RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT (CRM)**

**Role Title:** Head – CRM

**Function:** CRM & Contact Center Operations

**Experience:** 6 – 8 Years

**Domain Split:** 60% Production (Conversions) | 40% Services (Support/SLA)

**Span of Control:** 8 – 20 Telecallers (with TL Layer)

**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana

**Role Overview**

The Head – CRM will steer and scale the end-to-end customer relationship and contact center operations across both outbound conversion/production (60%) and inbound service/retention (40%) functions. Operating out of Gurugram, this role assumes full accountability for driving floor productivity, achieving SLA benchmarks, eliminating lead leakage, standardizing SOPs, and coaching a team of 8 to 20 telecallers to deliver exceptional business throughput and customer lifetime value.

**Key Responsibilities & Deliverables**

**Production & Conversion Leadership (60% Weightage)**

· **Lead Funnel Management:** End-to-end ownership of the inbound and outbound lead lifecycle, ensuring strict <15-minute first turnaround time (TAT), zero lead leakage, and rigorous follow-up cadences across all acquisition channels.

· **Sales & Conversion Drive:** Drive aggressive conversion % targets by coaching executives on pitch delivery, objection handling, pricing negotiations, and customer trust building.

· **Active Floor Governance:** Conduct regular call barging, whisper coaching, live call audits, and mandatory daily morning huddles to instill target discipline and sales rigor across the floor.

· **Script & Pitch Refinement:** Continuously evaluate objection patterns (pricing, trust, competitor comparison) and update calling scripts, counter-objection frameworks, and FAQ documents to lift close rates.

**Service Excellence, Retention & SLA Delivery (40% Weightage)**

· **SLA & TAT Governance:** Enforce strict adherence to resolution SLAs, First Contact Resolution (FCR), Average Handling Time (AHT), and turnaround times on customer grievances and queries.

· **Quality Benchmarking:** Implement rigorous call/chat auditing standards targeting 90%+ audit quality benchmarks; identify systemic compliance or communication gaps through Root Cause Analysis (RCA).

· **Lifecycle & Retention Programs:** Formulate retention workflows, lost/dormant lead re-engagement cadences, and referral programs to boost CSAT, Customer Lifetime Value (CLV), and Net Promoter Scores (NPS).

· **Cross-Functional Operations:** Partner seamlessly with operations, fulfillment, warehouse/branch teams to troubleshoot operational bottlenecks and preserve customer trust.

**Team Management, Productivity & People Development**

· **Workforce & Capacity Planning:** Design monthly and weekly caller rosters, capacity models, seat allocation, shrinkage mitigation, and login adherence schedules for 8–20 telecallers.

· **Ramp-Up & Training Enablement:** Accelerate new-hire speed-to-productivity (NHT and OJT) using structured standard training modules, FAQs, and mock scenarios, cutting induction ramp-up days.

· **Performance Management:** Establish transparent KRAs/KPIs; institute structured Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) and supportive coaching paths for underperformers while recognizing high achievers.

· **Floor Motivation & Culture:** Design and implement daily/weekly incentive contests, recognition programs, and floor energy drivers to minimize churn and foster a high-performance environment.

**Process Standardization, CRM Tools & Executive MIS**

· **SOP Architecture:** Document, maintain, and enforce SOPs across calling scripts, disposition codes, customer escalation trees, and database hygiene.

· **Dialer & CRM Administration:** Optimize automated dialers, IVR routing, lead allocation logic, call recording mechanisms, and CRM workflows to maximize talk time and connectivity.

· **Executive MIS & Analytics:** Deliver comprehensive daily, weekly, and monthly MIS dashboards highlighting lead-to-conversion rates, SLA adherence, dialer efficiency, caller productivity, quality audit scores, and agent attrition.

**Candidate Profile & Qualifications**

· **Total Experience:** 6 to 8 years of solid experience in CRM, contact center operations, or inside sales/customer success management, with at least 2–3 years leading a team.

· **Balanced Capability:** Demonstrated track record of handling both high-velocity conversion/outbound operations (production side) and structured grievance/inbound SLA governance (services side).

· **Operational Leadership:** Proven experience managing 8 to 20 telecallers, including workforce scheduling, shrinkage control, new-hire onboarding, and performance management.

· **Training & Coaching Acumen:** Skilled in structured coaching, conducting call quality audits, and building objection-handling frameworks that directly translate into measurable conversion gains.

· **Analytical & Technical Skills:** Hands-on proficiency with CRM software, auto-dialers (predictive/progressive), IVR systems, and MS Excel dashboards for daily executive MIS generation.

· **Education:** Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, Post-Graduate diploma, or certifications in Training/Quality (e.g., TTT, Six Sigma) are strong advantages.

title: Inside Sales Specialist
description:
**Company Description**

Prorata is India’s first fractional car ownership platform, enabling individuals to co-own premium cars for leisure and lifestyle use by investing as little as 8.33% of the vehicle’s total cost. The model is structured around selling 12 ownership tickets per car, each providing 30 days of usage per year over a 5-year period, with the option to purchase up to 3 tickets for additional days. After 5 years, the car is sold to the highest bidder and the resale value is shared among co-owners according to their ownership percentage. Prorata forms local groups of interested co-owners within a defined radius and coordinates usage through its app, offering doorstep pickup and drop services. The platform is designed for occasional, experiential usage rather than daily commuting, and more information is available via the company’s app and website.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time Inside Sales Specialist role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area, with a hybrid work arrangement that allows some work-from-home flexibility. The Inside Sales Specialist will handle inbound and outbound calls, engage prospective customers, explain Prorata’s fractional car ownership model, and convert qualified leads into paying co-owners. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing lead pipelines, following up on app and web inquiries, scheduling and conducting online or phone-based product demonstrations, and maintaining accurate records in the CRM system. The role also involves coordinating with operations and marketing teams, addressing customer questions, ensuring a smooth onboarding experience, and supporting co-owners throughout their lifecycle to promote satisfaction and retention. The specialist is expected to meet sales targets, provide feedback on customer needs, and contribute to continuous improvement of sales processes.

* Candidates should possess strong Inside Sales skills with experience in consultative selling and closing deals over phone or online channels.

* Candidates should possess Customer Service and Customer Satisfaction skills, with a focus on building trust, resolving issues, and supporting long-term relationships.

* Ability to work in a hybrid setup within the Kolkata metropolitan area, manage time effectively, and use CRM and basic office software tools.

* Confident in front of camera to create content for social media platforms.
* Preferred qualification: diploma or bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in sales.

The company operates across Quick Commerce, Modern Trade, and General Trade, with a strong presence on platforms such as Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket, Flipkart Minutes, and Amazon Fresh.
  
  
**Job Overview**
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Key Account Manager – Q-Commerce to manage and drive the overall business for both Ambient and Frozen product categories.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing national/platform-level sales, developing strong relationships with Quick Commerce platforms, driving business growth, improving product availability, managing listings, promotions, pricing, inventory, and ensuring operational excellence.
  
  
The role will involve managing both regular ambient products and temperature-sensitive frozen products, ensuring proper cold chain management, inventory control, and business expansion across platforms.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Key Account & Business Management

Manage and grow business across Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket, Flipkart Minutes, and Amazon Fresh.
  
  
Act as the primary point of contact for Quick Commerce platform central teams.
  
  
Build and maintain strong relationships with platform category managers and key stakeholders.
  
  
Drive sales targets, revenue growth, account profitability, and business expansion.
  
  
Lead commercial negotiations, visibility packages, pricing discussions, and Joint Business Planning (JBP).
  
  

* Sales & Category Management – Ambient and Frozen

Drive sales growth across both Ambient and Frozen product categories.
  
  
Develop category-wise sales strategies and expansion plans.
  
  
Monitor primary and secondary sales performance across platforms.
  
  
Ensure product assortment, pricing, and availability across relevant platforms.
  
  
Identify opportunities for new product launches and category expansion.
  
  

* Availability & Inventory Management

Monitor daily product availability and stock levels across platforms.
  
  
Identify and resolve Out-of-Stock (OOS) issues.
  
  
Coordinate with supply chain and warehouse teams to ensure timely stock replenishment.
  
  
Maintain healthy inventory levels and minimize stock-outs and product expiry.
  
  
Prepare rolling forecasts and monitor forecast accuracy.
  
  

* Frozen Category & Cold Chain Management

Ensure proper cold chain compliance throughout transportation and storage.
  
  
Coordinate reefer dispatches, temperature monitoring, and cold chain documentation.
  
  
Manage freezer capacity at distribution centres (DCs) and dark stores.
  
  
Coordinate freezer allocation and infrastructure requirements with platform teams.
  
  
Handle temperature-related rejections and resolve operational issues.
  
  
Monitor FEFO (First Expiry, First Out), shelf life, ageing inventory, and expiry risks.
  
  

* Promotions, Listings & New Product Launches

Plan and execute promotional campaigns across Quick Commerce platforms.
  
  
Manage product listings, catalogue accuracy, pricing, and visibility.
  
  
Coordinate new product launches (NPD) and ensure timely platform onboarding.
  
  
Monitor promotional performance and analyse ROI.
  
  
Ensure promotional activities are aligned with stock availability and inventory requirements.
  
  

* Reporting & Analytics

Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales and business performance reports.
  
  
Monitor platform-wise sales, availability, inventory, and category performance.
  
  
Track key business KPIs and identify improvement opportunities.
  
  
Conduct regular business reviews with management and platform partners.
  
  
Maintain dashboards and provide actionable business insights.
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
4–8 years of experience in FMCG, Food & Beverage, or food distribution sales.
  
  
Minimum 2+ years of direct experience managing Quick Commerce or E-commerce key accounts.
  
  
Hands-on experience with platforms such as Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket, Amazon, or Flipkart.
  
  
Experience managing both Ambient and Frozen/Food categories will be highly preferred.
  
  
Strong understanding of sales growth, account management, commercial negotiations, and category management.
  
  
Knowledge of inventory management, forecasting, product availability, and supply chain operations.
  
  
Understanding of cold chain logistics, temperature-controlled storage, and frozen product handling.
  
  
Strong analytical skills with advanced Excel and familiarity with Power BI, GobbleCube, or platform dashboards.
  
  
Ability to manage platform relationships and independently drive business targets.
  
  
Graduate degree required; MBA or Supply Chain qualification preferred.
  
  
**Preferred Industry Background**

FMCG and Food & Beverage

title: Head of Merchandising & Business Development
description:
We're Hiring: Head of Merchandising & Business Development
  
  
Company: Zaayara Textile Pvt. Ltd.
  
Location: Haripal, Hooghly, West Bengal, India
  
Work Mode: On-site
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
About the Role
  
  
Zaayara Textile Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced, proactive, and result-oriented Head of Merchandising & Business Development to lead our merchandising operations, develop international business opportunities, and expand our buyer network.
  
  
The ideal candidate must have strong experience in the textile and apparel industry, particularly in generating international buyer leads, identifying potential customers, developing business relationships, negotiating commercial terms, and converting business opportunities into confirmed orders.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete merchandising and order execution cycle, from buyer acquisition and product development to production coordination, quality assurance, and final shipment.
  
  
We are looking for someone who can independently generate business, bring new buyers, secure purchase orders, and ensure smooth execution of every order.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Buyer Acquisition & Business Development
  
  
- Identify, research, and generate qualified domestic and international buyer leads for textile and apparel products.
  
- Proactively approach international buyers, importers, wholesalers, retailers, brands, sourcing houses, and buying agencies.
  
- Develop and maintain a strong network of international buyers and business partners.
  
- Generate new business opportunities through LinkedIn, B2B marketplaces, email outreach, trade directories, exhibitions, and industry networking.
  
- Convert potential buyer leads into business enquiries, sampling opportunities, and confirmed purchase orders.
  
- Independently manage buyer communication, business negotiations, quotations, and follow-ups.
  
- Develop long-term relationships with existing and prospective buyers.
  
- Achieve monthly and quarterly buyer acquisition and order generation targets.
  
  
2. Order Generation & Merchandising
  
  
- Generate new business enquiries and secure confirmed purchase orders.
  
- Lead the complete order execution cycle from product development to final shipment.
  
- Understand buyer requirements, product specifications, pricing, quantities, and delivery schedules.
  
- Coordinate with Design, Production, Sourcing, Quality, Stores, and external vendors.
  
- Prepare and monitor development plans, production schedules, and critical timelines.
  
- Ensure timely availability of fabrics, leather, trims, accessories, and other raw materials.
  
- Monitor production progress and proactively resolve delays and bottlenecks.
  
- Ensure products meet approved samples, specifications, and buyer quality standards.
  
- Coordinate sampling, approvals, order confirmations, and pre-production requirements.
  
  
3. Production & Shipment Management
  
  
- Monitor production activities against committed delivery timelines.
  
- Coordinate with quality teams for inspections, rework, and corrective actions.
  
- Follow up on product development issues, rejections, and production challenges.
  
- Ensure timely completion of orders and shipment documentation.
  
- Coordinate pre-shipment requirements and dispatch activities.
  
- Maintain accurate buyer, order, production, and shipment records.
  
  
4. Vendor & Buyer Relationship Management
  
  
- Maintain regular communication with international buyers regarding enquiries, samples, approvals, production progress, and delivery.
  
- Negotiate with suppliers and vendors regarding pricing, quality, quantities, and delivery commitments.
  
- Identify potential execution risks and implement corrective measures.
  
- Provide regular business development and order status reports to management.
  
  
Required Experience & Qualifications
  
  
- Minimum 5–8 years of relevant experience in textile, garments, apparel merchandising, export merchandising, or textile business development.
  
- Proven experience in generating new buyer leads and acquiring business orders.
  
- Strong understanding of international textile and apparel markets.
  
- Demonstrated ability to convert buyer enquiries into confirmed purchase orders.
  
- Experience dealing with international buyers, importers, wholesalers, retailers, and buying houses.
  
- Excellent knowledge of merchandising, product development, costing, sampling, production, and shipment processes.
  
- Practical experience with B2B platforms, LinkedIn prospecting, email marketing, and international buyer acquisition.
  
- Strong negotiation, communication, and relationship management skills.
  
- Ability to independently manage business development and merchandising operations.
  
- Good command of English and professional business communication.
  
  
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
Performance will be evaluated based on:
  
  
1. Number of qualified new buyer leads generated.
  
2. Number of new domestic and international buyers acquired.
  
3. Number and value of confirmed purchase orders generated.
  
4. Conversion rate from enquiries to confirmed orders.
  
5. Revenue generated through new business development.
  
6. Timely execution and delivery of confirmed orders.
  
7. Buyer satisfaction and long-term business relationships.
  
  
Preferred Candidate Profile
  
  
We are particularly interested in candidates who already have an established network of textile and apparel buyers and can demonstrate a successful track record of bringing business enquiries and confirmed orders.
  
  
Candidates with previous experience in textile exports, international merchandising, buying houses, garment manufacturing, and global sourcing will be preferred.
  
  
Important: This is not just a merchandising position. We are looking for a business-oriented professional who can generate buyers, bring orders, develop new markets, and take responsibility for end-to-end business growth.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Interested and qualified candidates can share their updated CV along with details of their previous experience, buyer network, business development achievements, and order generation track record.
  
  
Company: Zaayara Textile Pvt. Ltd.
  
Work Location: Haripal, Hooghly, West Bengal, India.
  
  
Join Zaayara Textile Pvt. Ltd. and become part of our journey towards expanding our textile business in domestic and international markets.
  
  
Mail Us: request@pritservices.com
