title: Premium Universities Admissions Counsellor
description:
About Taksheela Institute of Education

Taksheela Institute of Education (TIE) is an established study-abroad consultancy with over a decade of experience supporting admissions to prestigious global institutions and affordable Ivy League & Top US Universities/G5 & Russell Group Universities (UK). TIE offers personalised counselling, profile building, university shortlisting and end-to-end admissions support. Its institutional partnerships and technology-enabled StudyMatch platform help make international education more accessible and achievable.

About the Role

We seek an experienced counsellor who can independently lead undergraduate and postgraduate applications to selective universities in the United States and United Kingdom, including Ivy League institutions, other leading US universities, G5 and Russell Group universities. The role combines admission strategy, authentic student profile development, application quality and confident parent counselling.

Key Responsibilities

·  Evaluate academics, activities, leadership, research and student competitiveness; create balanced US/UK university shortlists and realistic admission strategies.

·  Own Common App, UCAS and university-specific applications, including activity lists, personal statements, supplemental essays, SOPs, CVs and LOR strategy.

·  Mentor authentic profile development through academic projects, extracurricular activities, research and internships; coach interviews and application narratives.

·  Manage Early Decision/Early Action and UK deadlines, submission requirements, application quality and progress updates.

·  Conduct premium student and parent consultations; explain admission selectivity, costs, financial aid/scholarships and timelines without guaranteeing outcomes.

·  Manage assigned cases through decisions; coordinate essay mentors, profile-building and application teams; support conversion of qualified enquiries into paid counselling.

·  Maintain CRM records, university trackers, application calendars and timely reporting to the Business Head.

Required Qualifications & Experience

·  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree; 4–7 years of hands-on premium US/UK university admissions counselling.

·  Proven Common App and UCAS experience, with strong command of holistic admission assessment and profile building.

·  Excellent English writing, essay-review, mentoring, presentation and parent relationship skills.

·  Ability to manage complex applications independently and provide anonymised examples of personally managed selective-university admits.

Preferred Experience

·  Admission outcomes at Ivy League, Top 30 US, G5, Russel Group or other highly selective universities; US financial aid and UK scholarship familiarity.

Performance Measures

·  Quality of eligibility assessment, competitive shortlists and authentic essays; timely, accurate submissions.

·  Admissions outcomes in context of student profiles; student/parent satisfaction, case ownership, retention and contribution to paid conversions.

What We Offer

Opportunity to guide ambitious students to leading global institutions, work in a collaborative premium admissions team and contribute to TIE’s technology-enabled StudyMatch ecosystem.

How to Apply

Send your updated CV and a brief anonymized summary of selective US/UK admissions personally handled, highlighting your role in university strategy, essays and profile development. Email: taksheelahr@gmail.com

Trading Business / Commercial Operations

Full-Time

Smarketz is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Operations Manager with 7–10 years of experience in trading business operations, business development, and customer success management (CSM).
 

The candidate will be responsible for managing day-to-day business operations, streamlining internal processes, maintaining customer relationships, coordinating with sales and business development teams, and ensuring efficient business performance. About Shree Ji Steel

Shree Ji Steel Private Limited is a rapidly growing company in the **iron and steel industry**, engaged in the manufacturing, trading, and export of high-quality steel products.

We serve customers across India and focus on **quality, competitive pricing, customer satisfaction, transparent business practices, and long-term B2B relationships**.

We are looking for an energetic and target-oriented **Telecaller Executive** to support our sales team through **outbound calling, lead generation, prospect identification, initial customer communication, and lead qualification**.

Job Summary

The Telecaller Executive will be responsible for contacting prospective customers, introducing the company and its product range, understanding basic customer requirements, qualifying potential business opportunities, and forwarding genuine leads to the concerned Sales Executive.

The candidate will act as one of the **first points of contact between Shree Ji Steel and potential customers** and will play an important role in generating new sales opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Lead Generation

* Make outbound calls to potential customers using company databases, online sources, and assigned lead lists.
* Identify companies, businesses, contractors, dealers, and decision-makers who may have requirements for steel products.
* Generate new business leads through telecalling and other assigned lead-generation activities.
* Introduce **Shree Ji Steel and its product range** professionally to prospective customers.
* Identify potential customers based on their industry, business type, location, and requirements.
* Maintain a consistent daily calling and lead-generation activity.

2. Lead Qualification

* Understand the customer's basic requirement during the initial conversation.
* Collect relevant information such as:
* Product required
* Size / specification
* Approximate quantity
* Application / project requirement
* Delivery location
* Expected purchase timeline
* Company name
* Contact person
* Designation
* Contact details
* Identify whether the prospect has a genuine or potential business requirement.
* Categorize leads according to quality, requirement, and potential.
* Forward qualified leads to the concerned **Sales Executive / Business Development Team**.

3. Initial Customer Communication

* Clearly explain the company's profile, product categories, and business capabilities.
* Communicate professionally with prospective customers over the phone.
* Understand customer requirements through effective questioning and active listening.
* Answer basic questions about the company and product range.
* Create initial customer interest and identify potential business opportunities.
* Do not make unauthorized commitments regarding **pricing, delivery, credit terms, or product availability**.
* Escalate technical, pricing, commercial, or detailed product queries to the appropriate sales team.

4. Sales Team Coordination

* Share qualified leads and complete customer requirement details with the concerned Sales Executive.
* Ensure that customer information is accurate and complete before transferring the lead.
* Coordinate internally regarding newly generated leads and lead allocation.
* Inform the sales team about important information received from prospects.
* Maintain proper lead ownership and avoid duplicate lead entries.
* Follow the company's lead-transfer process.

5. CRM & Daily Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of calls, prospects, requirements, and lead status in the company's CRM/software.
* Update daily calling and lead-generation activities on time.
* Maintain an organized database of potential customers and decision-makers.
* Prepare daily and weekly calling and lead-generation reports.
* Track:
* Total calls made
* Connected calls
* Unconnected calls
* Interested prospects
* Qualified leads
* Leads transferred to Sales
* Ensure that all customer information is entered accurately into the CRM/system.

**What This Role Does NOT Include**

The Telecaller Executive will primarily focus on **lead generation and lead qualification**.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal communication skills in **English, Hindi, and Bengali**.
* Good listening, questioning, and customer-interaction skills.
* Ability to identify genuine business opportunities.
* Strong convincing and interpersonal skills.
* Professional telephone etiquette.
* Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.
* Good data-entry and documentation skills.
* Basic knowledge of **MS Excel, MS Word, CRM, and calling software**.
* Good coordination and follow-up skills.
* Ability to accurately record customer requirements.
* Target-oriented approach with a positive attitude.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a sales team.
* Willingness to learn about **steel products and the B2B sales process**.

Qualifications & Eligibility

* Graduate in any discipline preferred.
* **1–2 years of experience** in Telecalling, Pre-Sales, Lead Generation, Inside Sales, Customer Support, or a similar role preferred.
* Experience in **steel, construction materials, building materials, engineering, manufacturing, industrial products, or B2B sales** will be an added advantage.
* Candidates with strong communication skills and an interest in sales may also apply.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Daily outbound calls.
* Connected calls.
* Meaningful customer conversations.
* Qualified leads generated.
* Lead qualification rate.
* Accuracy and completeness of customer information.

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1750373

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY GDS – Assurance FAAS – Manager – Control & Compliance**

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

**The opportunity**

Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) professionals provides advisory services including Accounting and regulatory support for accounting change and special matters; accounting processes and controls support. We are looking for a professional to join EY FAAS, having expertise across the FAAS solutions and specifically for engagements related to Process and Control, Process compliance and reviews, SOX and, Developing Standard Operating Procedure manuals, Enterprise Risk Management & Payment application.

FAAS is a dynamic group of people focused on helping our clients solving tomorrow’s problems today through integrated solution service offerings in the area of risk, such as internal control assessment, risk management and financial controls. Risk continues to move up the agenda and our team work with many of today's front-running companies. Our clients want integrated, strategic, tech-enabled, end-to-end solutions and we deliver tailored risk offerings putting client value and relationships at the core of what we do. You can expect to work with senior client personnel and drive high quality work products.

Our Risk team consists of talented colleagues who invite you to bring your natural curiosity and innovative thoughts to work each day. Working within our team, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. We offer excellent career development, diverse opportunities and fantastic work life balance including hybrid working. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

**Your key responsibilities**

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated manager to join our dynamic Control & Compliance team. The ideal candidate will bring technical expertise in risk management, internal control assessment and implementation of internal control framework. In this role, you will lead the delivery of high-quality outcomes across a portfolio of clients in the internal audit and internal controls space. You will manage multiple engagement teams and stakeholders, both internally and externally, taking full ownership of projects and relationships. Your focus will be on delivering impactful results, on time, within budget and in line with EY’s quality and risk management practices. Key responsibilities include:

* Client Delivery and Project Management: Lead and manage multiple client engagements. Oversee planning, fieldwork and reporting of findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Ensuring high-quality deliverables, on time within budget.
* Technical Expertise: Act as a key trusted advisor in discussing complex regulations with clients, including UK Corporate Reform, US Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance, Global Internal Audit Standards and other industry-specific regulatory compliance requirements.
* Quality and Risk Management: Ensure compliance with EY’s quality and risk management processes across client acceptance, contracting and engagement delivery. Proactively identify and manage risks across engagements, escalating issues where appropriate.
* Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and proactively manage client expectations to ensure alignment on project goals, timelines and deliverables. Collaborate cross-functionally with other EY service lines and subject matter experts to deliver high quality insights. Collaborate with internal leader/s, provide regular updates on engagement progress and support internal decision-making through clear communication and proactive escalation and the ability to flex communication styles.
* Team Leadership and Development: Mentor and coach junior team members through effective supervision to develop their technical and professional skills. Support career development through performance reviews and providing timely, regular and actionable feedback. You will contribute to a positive team environment by demonstrating consistent commitment and optimism toward work challenges.
* Business Development: Build the EY brand through high quality delivery. Support in the identification of new opportunities and development of proposals. Build EY’s market presence through contribution to thought leadership and client events.
* Promoting EY’s values: Champion EY’s commitments to integrity, respect and teaming in all client and internal interactions. Foster an inclusive and diverse working environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.
* Practice development: contribute to practice development and internal initiatives such as learning and development programmes and solution development.

  

**Skills and Experience**

You will be a trusted manager with proven technical expertise in risk, control and compliance that will complement our teams in delivering high-quality solutions to our clients. Your skills and experience will include:

* Control & Compliance experience: Proven and relevant professional experience across core process and controls solutions (e.g. internal audit, SOX and internal controls) in consulting, government or industry. Extensive experience in process mapping, walkthroughs, risk analysis (strategic, financial, operational and compliance) and control identification and design assessment. The ability to act as a trusted advisor to clients on risk and control issues, such as controls remediation or Enterprise Risk Management.
* Technical skills and knowledge: In depth understanding of core business processes, associated risks, and leading practice controls. Strong leadership and communication skills, technical knowledge, and the ability to write at a publication quality level in order to communicate findings and recommendations to clients. Strong business acumen, including the ability to compile information quickly and accurately, and to test data and assumptions for informed decision-making.
* Engagement management: Track record demonstrating success in leading high-performing teams, mentor junior staff and foster a culture of continuous learning. Experienced in managing complex project and multiple stakeholder groups including senior clients and internal leadership. Demonstrated ability to balance project management and delivery skills across a range of clients, including financial management, quality, and risk management requirements.
* Communication and interpersonal skills: Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and build trust at all levels. Being an active listener, having self-awareness when dealing with others, and adapting your own approach to differences in individual style and backgrounds, recognising the risk of unconscious biases.
* Client delivery: Demonstrated success in delivering high-quality, client-focused solutions on time and within budget with a commitment to going above and beyond for clients.
* Commercial acumen: Commercially aware, with a track record of developing relevant propositions and sales collateral and supporting business development efforts.
* Technology and innovation: Proficient in leveraging technology such as data analytics, automation, and AI in project delivery. Experience with data visualisation tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and core business systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle). Proficient across the Microsoft Office suite (e.g. PowerPoint, Excel and Word). Ability to develop dashboards across key data visualization tools and produce visual reports to track key risks and control metrics, noted as desirable but not essential.
* Professional attributes: Self-stater with a proactive mindset, natural curiosity and commitment to delivering excellence for our clients. Ability to work in areas of uncertainty and navigate ambiguous situations, adaptable and inclusive, with strong self-awareness and the ability to work effectively across diverse teams. Up to date with industry trends, emerging risks, and the UK regulatory landscape. Adaptability and the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.

DosBros has
**60+ locations globally across the USA, India and Canada**
, with an expanding presence in India.

We are on an ambitious journey to build DosBros into one of India's leading Mexican QSR brands, with a strong focus on expansion, brand building, innovation, strategic partnerships and business growth.

As we scale across cities and explore new business opportunities, we are looking for an ambitious and entrepreneurial individual to work directly with the Founder and senior management.

**About the Role**

This is a high-ownership, generalist internship for someone who wants to understand how businesses are built, scaled and funded.

You will act as
**Entrepreneur in Residence**
and will work across business strategy, growth initiatives, brand management, marketing, fundraising and business development. You will be involved in evaluating new opportunities, coordinating strategic projects, strengthening brand presence, supporting investor outreach and helping convert business plans into execution.

This is not a conventional desk internship. We are looking for someone who can think independently, work with data, communicate effectively, manage multiple priorities and take ownership of outcomes.

**Think like an entrepreneur. Operate like a business owner. Execute with ownership.**

* Work directly with the Founder and senior management on strategic initiatives, business planning and growth strategies.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis and feasibility assessments to evaluate new business opportunities.
* Identify new revenue streams, business models and expansion possibilities.

* Track business performance, analyse data and convert findings into actionable recommendations.

title: Franchise Development Manager
description:
**Company:**
the EleFant

**Location:**
Ahmedabad

**Department:**
Franchise Development & Business Expansion

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
5–10 years

**Reporting to:**
Chief Revenue Officer / Head of Business Development

**About the EleFant**

At the EleFant, we're on a mission to change the way India interacts with toys.

We are building a technology-led toy and book library that gives children access to a wide range of toys, books and play experiences through convenient memberships, with doorstep delivery and exchanges.

Featured on Shark Tank India, the EleFant is expanding its presence across the country through a unique
**FICO (Franchise Invested, Company Operated)**
model.

Under this model, franchise partners invest in the business infrastructure, while the EleFant manages operations, technology, customer acquisition and service delivery as defined in the franchise agreement.

We are looking for an ambitious Franchise Development Manager who can accelerate our expansion by bringing the right investors and business partners into the EleFant ecosystem.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**high-energy, commercially strong Franchise Development Manager**
who can take ownership of franchise acquisition, investor engagement and deal closures.

This is a revenue-generating role requiring strong relationship-building, consultative selling, negotiation and business development skills.

The ideal candidate understands how to sell a business opportunity, not just a product.

**Your success will be measured by the number, quality and value of franchise partnerships you close.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Franchise Sales & Revenue Ownership**

* Own monthly, quarterly and annual franchise acquisition targets.
* Generate and convert qualified franchise investor leads.
* Independently manage the entire franchise sales cycle from initial enquiry to agreement execution and payment collection.
* Present the EleFant's FICO model, business proposition, financial structure and commercial opportunity to prospective investors.
* Conduct investor meetings, online presentations and detailed commercial discussions.
* Handle objections related to investment structure, business performance, returns, operational responsibility and risk.
* Negotiate commercial terms within approved company guidelines.
* Ensure timely closures and collection of franchise investment commitments.

**2. Investor Lead Generation & Channel Development**

* Identify HNIs, business owners, professionals, family offices and potential franchise investors.
* Build relationships with franchise consultants, wealth advisers, business networks and referral partners.
* Develop investor acquisition channels through LinkedIn, BNI, business associations, networking events and other relevant platforms.
* Build partnerships with brokers and intermediaries who can refer qualified franchise investors.
* Generate opportunities through existing franchise-partner referrals.
* Work closely with Marketing to improve campaign quality, targeting and lead conversion.
* Build a sustainable pipeline rather than relying only on inbound leads.

**3. Franchise Investor Relationship Management**

* Understand each prospective investor's financial capacity, expectations, investment horizon and preferred geography.
* Develop trust through transparent and professional communication.
* Explain franchise investment terms, contractual responsibilities, commercial assumptions and associated risks accurately.
* Conduct structured follow-ups and move prospects through the sales funnel.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective franchise partners.
* Identify opportunities for additional investments and territory expansion among existing partners.
* Coordinate with senior management on strategic or high-value investment opportunities.

**4. Franchise Sales Process & CRM Management**

* Maintain complete and accurate investor information in the CRM.
* Track lead sources, qualification, meetings, proposals, negotiations and closures.
* Ensure disciplined follow-ups with every qualified prospect.
* Maintain visibility over high-intent, documentation-pending and payment-pending opportunities.
* Build reliable weekly and monthly closure forecasts.
* Identify bottlenecks and take proactive steps to improve conversion rates.
* Share actionable market feedback to improve franchise pitches and sales materials.

**5. Coordination & Deal Execution**

* Coordinate with Finance, Legal and Operations for franchise agreement execution.
* Ensure complete investor documentation and adherence to internal approval processes.
* Work with the onboarding team for smooth handover after commercial closure.
* Ensure franchise partners receive accurate information regarding their rights, obligations and investment terms.
* Support compliance with applicable internal policies and legal requirements.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5–10 years of experience in franchise development, business development, investment sales or high-ticket consultative selling.
* Proven track record of independently closing franchise or business investment deals.
* Experience selling franchise opportunities, commercial assets, business partnerships or other high-value propositions.
* Strong network among business owners, HNIs, franchise consultants and professional communities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-management skills.
* Ability to understand and explain commercial structures, business economics and contractual terms.
* Strong follow-up discipline and ability to manage longer sales cycles.
* Comfortable with CRM systems, spreadsheets and pipeline management.
* Willingness to travel for investor meetings, networking events and business expansion.
* Proficiency in English and Hindi; Gujarati or other regional languages would be an advantage.

**Preferred industry experience:**
Franchise consulting, organized retail, consumer services, investment-led franchise businesses, education franchises, hospitality, wealth distribution or high-ticket B2B sales.

**Who Will Be a Great Fit?**

We are looking for someone who:

* Has the confidence to speak with investors committing significant capital.
* Can develop their own network instead of depending entirely on company leads.
* Understands that franchise selling is about trust, business fundamentals and long-term relationships.
* Has strong commercial judgment and the ability to close deals.
* Is persistent without being pushy.
* Takes complete ownership of targets and commitments.

* Effective follow-up of outstanding documentation, payments and tasks.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
CallHippo is looking for a proactive, relationship and growth number driven **Customer Success Manager** to own and grow a portfolio of 60 to 70 accounts spanning SMB and Mid-Market/Enterprise customers. You'll be the primary point of contact for your customers - driving adoption, retention, and expansion, while working closely with the Head of Customer Success to convert every customer conversation into a concrete growth action.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Account Management & Relationship Building**

* Own end-to-end relationship management for 60 to 70 assigned accounts (SMB and Mid-Market/Enterprise mix).
* Build strong, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers within each account.
* Conduct regular check-ins, onboarding calls, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to understand customer goals and usage.
* Document every customer call as a clear MOM (Minutes of Meeting) with action items, owners, and timelines.
* Proactively follow up on MOM action items to ensure customer needs are addressed and value is delivered.

### **Retention**

* Own the **retention/renewal outcome** for your book of accounts — track usage, engagement, and health scores to flag at-risk customers early.
* Build and execute save plans for at-risk accounts in collaboration with your Head of Customer Success.
* Drive product adoption and feature utilization to increase stickiness and reduce churn risk.

### **Cross-Sell & Upsell**

* Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities within your portfolio based on customer usage patterns and business needs.
* Position relevant CallHippo features/plans/add-ons that solve customer pain points and add value.
* Work with Sales/Account Executives to convert expansion opportunities into closed revenue.
* Track and report on pipeline of upsell/cross-sell opportunities within your accounts. Targets of cross sell/ upsell must be accomplished and number driven mindset is non negotiable.

### **Collaboration & Reporting**

* Escalate product issues or feedback to Support/Product teams and follow through to resolution.
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in the CRM/CS platform (account notes, health scores, MOMs, opportunities).
* Share customer insights and trends with the Head of Customer Success to inform team-wide strategy.
* Participate in team reviews, pipeline discussions, and coaching sessions.

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

* **2–5 years** of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a client-facing role, ideally in SaaS/B2B tech.
* Demonstrated ability to manage a **high-volume portfolio** (60+ accounts) without losing personal touch.
* Strong **relationship-building** skills — comfortable engaging with stakeholders from SMB founders to Enterprise decision-makers.
* Experience or aptitude in **cross-sell/upselling** — able to spot opportunities and have value-based conversations. Number driven mindset and targets (OKRs) are non-negotiable.
* Excellent **organizational skills** — able to track and follow through on MOM action items across a large account base consistently.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal; comfortable running calls, QBRs, and email follow-ups.
* Familiarity with CRM/CS tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, Gainsight, Freshsuccess, or similar).
* Data-driven mindset — comfortable using account health metrics and usage data to prioritize outreach.
* Experience in telephony/VoIP or SaaS products is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like (First 3 Months)**
--------------------------------------------

* Fully ramped on assigned portfolio with strong relationships established across key accounts.
* Consistent MOM documentation and action-item follow-through for every customer interaction.
* Healthy retention rate within your book of accounts, with early identification and resolution of at-risk customers.
* Active, tracked pipeline of cross-sell/upsell opportunities with measurable conversions.
* Recognized by customers and internal stakeholders as a trusted, reliable point of contact.

**Why Join CallHippo**
----------------------

* Own a meaningful, high-trust relationship with a diverse set of customers from SMB to Enterprise.
* Clear growth path into senior CSM or Customer Success leadership roles.
* Collaborative, fast-paced environment with direct visibility into company revenue impact.

**About Navpath**

Navpath Maritime Academy is a respected IMU CET coaching institute in Kottayam, training aspiring Merchant Navy officers. We are growing steadily, with new batches launching in July 2026, and are building a team that can match that pace.

**Job Role**

This is not a typical script-reading telecaller role. We are looking for confident communicators who can take ownership of a lead from first call to confirmed admission. You will speak with parents and prospective students every day, build trust, answer real questions about a serious career choice, and convert genuine interest into enrollments.

You will also help us understand which leads are converting and which are not, so the team can adjust messaging and campaigns intelligently.

Morning Shift: 9 am - 5 pm (Full Time)

Evening Shift: 5 pm - 11 pm (Part Time)

**What You'll Do Day-to-Day**

* Call prospective students and parents from our daily lead list. Follow up consistently until they decide, one way or the other.
* Handle inbound calls and WhatsApp enquiries warmly and professionally.
* Counsel families on courses, fees, scholarship test, and the admission process. Handle objections calmly.
* Schedule and confirm campus visits, scholarship tests, and demo classes.
* Maintain a clean, up-to-date lead record — every call logged, every status updated, no lead going cold.
* Spot patterns in your conversations — which messages land, which objections repeat, which lead sources convert. Share these insights with the marketing team weekly.
* Support WhatsApp broadcasts and basic marketing activities when the team needs an extra pair of hands.

**Who We're Looking For**

* Fluent Malayalam and confident working English. You will speak to families across Kerala — clarity matters more than accent.
* Graduate preferred. Plus Two with a strong skill profile and proven communication ability also welcome.
* 1-3 years in telecalling, sales, admissions counselling, EdTech, or BPO is preferred. Strong freshers who can demonstrate real communication skill are also encouraged to apply.
* Comfortable with target-driven environments. Patient with parents, persuasive with students.
* Hands-on with smartphone, WhatsApp, Excel or Google Sheets, and basic CRM tools.
* Honest, disciplined, ethical. We build relationships with families that last years — your conduct represents us.
* Willing to learn the maritime industry basics on the job, so you can speak credibly with serious aspirants.

**Skills That Will Help You Stand Out**

* Prior education or coaching institute experience

description:
Job Description (JD)

Master Data Management (MDM) Executive

Position Details

Job Title: Master Data Management (MDM) Executive

Department: Information Technology

Location: Arrikar Foods Pvt Ltd

Reporting To: Head of IT

Job Purpose

The Master Data Management (MDM) Executive is responsible for maintaining, governing, and

ensuring the accuracy of business master data in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and integrated business

applications. The role supports Sales, Distribution, Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain, and

Operations by managing customer, material, vendor, pricing, route, scheme, target, and incentive

master data while ensuring compliance with organizational data governance standards.

Key Responsibilities

1. Customer Master Data Management

* Create, modify, extend, block, and archive customer master records.
* Validate customer creation requests and supporting documents.
* Manage customer hierarchy, sales area extensions, and customer group assignments.
* Prevent duplicate customer creation and maintain data quality.
* Support customer route and territory mapping.

2. Material Master Management

* Create and maintain Finished Goods (FG), Raw Materials (RM), Packaging Materials (PM), and

Trading Goods.

* Maintain product hierarchies, material groups, units of measure, weight, dimensions, and tax

classifications.

* Support new product launches, SKU modifications, and product discontinuation processes.
* Ensure accuracy of inventory-related master data.

3. Vendor & Business Partner Management

* Create and maintain vendor master records and business partners.
* Update banking, tax, payment, and purchasing information.
* Support procurement and finance-related master data requirements.
* Ensure compliance with approval of workflows.

4. Pricing Management

* Create and maintain sales prices and pricing conditions.
* Update customer-specific and channel-specific pricing structures.
* Maintain discount structures and pricing master records.
* Verify pricing accuracy before deployment.

5. Route & Territory Management

* Create and maintain:

o Routes

o Beats

o Vans

o Territories

o Sales Zones

o Sales Hierarchies

* Map customers to routes and sales territories.
* Support route restructuring and sales realignment activities.

6. Scheme Management

* Configure and maintain trade schemes and promotional offers.
* Create customer-wise, product-wise, channel-wise, and territory-wise schemes.
* Maintain quantity-based, value-based, and free-goods promotional schemes.
* Ensure scheme validity periods and eligibility criteria are correctly configured.
* Support trade marketing and sales teams in implementing promotional campaigns.

7. Target Management

* Upload and maintain:

o Sales Officer Targets

o Sales Executive Targets

o ASM/RSM Targets

o Distributor Targets

o Territory Targets

* Update monthly, quarterly, and annual targets.
* Support sales planning and management review processes.
* Ensure proper target alignment with business objectives.

8. Incentive Metrics Management

* Configure incentive parameters and achievement slabs.
* Maintain incentive eligibility criteria.
* Set up:

o Primary sales incentives

o Secondary sales incentives

o Collection incentives

o Distribution incentives

o Product-focused incentives

* Update incentive payout structures as approved by management.
* Validate incentive calculation logic and reports.
* Coordinate with Sales and Finance teams for incentive processing.

9. Data Governance & Compliance

* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency of master data.
* Perform periodic data audits and cleansing activities.
* Identify and remove duplicate master records.
* Maintain audit trails and approval documentation.
* Enforce master data governance policies and SOPs.

10. SAP & Business Support

* Provide day-to-day support for master data-related issues.
* Coordinate with business users and SAP support partners.
* Support system enhancements, testing, and process improvements.
* Participate in UAT and regression testing activities.
* Assist in rollout of new business processes and functionalities.

11. Reporting & Analytics

* Generate master data quality reports.
* Prepare reports related to:

o Customer Master

o Material Master

o Pricing

o Schemes

o Targets

o Incentives

o Routes

* Monitor and report data quality KPIs.
* Support management reporting requirements.

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Commerce, Business

Administration, or related discipline.

* SAP certification is an added advantage.

Experience

* 3-5 years of experience in Master Data Management.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud or SAP ERP.
* Experience in FMCG, Distribution, Manufacturing, or Consumer Products industry preferred.

Technical Skills

* SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud
* SAP Fiori Applications
* Customer Master Management
* Material Master Management
* Vendor Master Management
* Pricing Configuration
* Route & Territory Management
* Scheme Management
* Target & Incentive Management
* Microsoft Excel (Advanced)
* Data Validation & Reporting

Behavioral Competencies

* Strong analytical skills
* Attention to detail
* Problem-solving ability
* Process-oriented mindset
* Effective communication skills
* Cross-functional coordination
* Time management and prioritization

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Data Quality

* Master data accuracy > 99%
* Zero duplicate records
* Audit compliance adherence

Service Delivery

* MDM request closure within SLA
* Timely customer and material creation
* Timely pricing and route updates

Scheme & Incentive Management

* 100% accurate scheme setup
* Timely target uploads and revisions
* Accurate incentive metric configuration
* Reduction in incentive disputes

Business Support

* User satisfaction score
* Issue resolution turnaround time
* Successful UAT and process support

title: F&B Controls Executive
description:
**Job Description**

We're seeking a detail-oriented and analytically-minded F&B Controls Executive to join our team in Kochi, India. In this pivotal role, you'll be the financial guardian of our food and beverage operations, ensuring cost efficiency, operational compliance, and profitability across all F&B outlets. You'll work collaboratively with culinary, operations, and finance teams to strengthen our cost control framework while maintaining the highest standards of quality and guest satisfaction. If you're passionate about hospitality with a sharp commercial mindset and a love for working with data and numbers, we'd love to hear from you.

* Monitor and control food and beverage costs by analyzing daily purchases, issues, transfers, and stock movements to identify trends and variances
* Conduct regular and systematic inventory counts of food, beverages, and operating equipment, ensuring accurate stock reconciliation and timely reporting
* Verify recipes, menu pricing, and portion standards against approved cost percentages, recommending adjustments to maintain profitability targets
* Review daily revenue reports, voids, discounts, complimentary items, and wastage data, investigating significant variances and proposing corrective actions
* Prepare comprehensive daily, weekly, and monthly F&B control reports, including detailed food cost, beverage cost, and inventory analysis for management review
* Collaborate closely with Culinary, Food & Beverage, Purchasing, Receiving, and Finance teams to strengthen cost controls, identify inefficiencies, and drive operational improvements
* Execute spot checks and audits across stores, bars, restaurants, and banquet operations to ensure strict compliance with company policies and internal control procedures
* Support month-end inventory valuation, financial closing processes, and audit activities to ensure accuracy and transparency
* Identify and evaluate cost-saving opportunities while maintaining quality standards, service excellence, and positive guest experiences
* Maintain organized records and documentation of all control activities, audits, and recommendations for management and audit purposes

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Hospitality Management, or a related field
* Proven experience as an F&B Controls Executive, Cost Controller, F&B Cost Analyst, or Finance Executive within a hotel or hospitality environment
* Strong expertise in food and beverage cost control, inventory management, recipe costing, and stock reconciliation methodologies
* Proficiency with hotel Property Management Systems (PMS), Point of Sale (POS) systems, and inventory management software
* Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, pivot tables, and report creation
* Excellent analytical, numerical, and problem-solving abilities with exceptional attention to detail
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence operational teams and build effective working relationships
* Demonstrated experience in variance analysis, investigation, and corrective action implementation
* Familiarity with month-end closing procedures, financial audits, and audit support processes
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced hospitality environment
* Proactive, organized approach with strong time management and prioritization skills
* Knowledge of hospitality industry standards, best practices, and cost control benchmarks
* Experience with spot checks, audits, and compliance verification procedures
* Ability to prepare clear, concise reports and present findings to senior management

title: Senior Application Engineer
description:
Celeros Flow Technology, LLC

Primarily the Applications Engineer will assist global customers to identify / verify their requirements and specifications and will prepare competitive costings / quotations / tenders that are both technically and commercially accurate, in accordance with Company policies and procedures. The incumbent will interface with both Customers and internal stakeholders including Sales, Engineering and Design to provide support and solutions that meet the needs and expectations of Customers, strengthening relationships and positively impacting the opportunity to win orders globally for Celeros ClydeUnion Pump product line. Incumbent should be based at
**Delhi / NCR region or Bengaluru**

* Essential knowledge and experience in reviewing highly detailed specifications and writing comprehensive and accurate bids

title: Senior AI Solutions Architect
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Job Profile Summary**
The Senior AI Solutions Architect is an advanced subject matter expert responsible for shaping, validating and assuring complex artificial intelligence solutions during the opportunity-to-order lifecycle.
  
  
The role operates as the primary technical and delivery interlock between regional go-to-market teams and the Global AI Delivery Unit. It enables sellers and regional solution teams to access AI delivery expertise without requiring core delivery resources to become extensively engaged in routine pre-sales activity.
  
  
The Senior AI Solutions Architect works with clients, sales teams, solution teams, commercial management, delivery leaders and specialist technical teams to translate business needs into secure, scalable, commercially viable and delivery-ready AI solutions.
  
  
The role contributes to, or leads, the development of solution architectures, prototypes and proofs of concept where required. It validates solution feasibility, delivery scope, resource requirements, effort estimates, commercial assumptions, delivery risks and contractual commitments before NTT DATA enters into a client agreement.
  
  
As part of the Global AI Delivery Unit, the role helps protect delivery outcomes and the AI Delivery P&L by ensuring that proposed solutions have an appropriate delivery structure, cost-recovery model, risk position and transition plan before customer signature.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Deal intake and GTM interlock**

* Act as the primary technical and delivery interlock for assigned AI opportunities from qualified intake through solution approval, contracting and handover to delivery.
* Engage with regional GTM, sales and solution teams early in the opportunity lifecycle to understand the client’s business problem, intended outcomes, technical environment, data landscape and commercial requirements.
* Assess whether the opportunity is sufficiently qualified for Global AI Delivery engagement and identify any additional information, discovery or customer validation required.
* Review use-case descriptions and business requirements to assess whether the proposed use of AI is appropriate, feasible and aligned with measurable client outcomes.
* Support structured discovery sessions with clients and internal stakeholders, translating business requirements into actionable technical and delivery requirements.
* Identify the specialist capabilities required to support the pursuit and coordinate targeted engagement from Global AI Delivery Unit, security, legal, commercial and regional delivery teams.
* Manage the involvement of delivery specialists carefully, ensuring that delivery expertise is used for material design decisions and specialist validation without drawing delivery teams unnecessarily into general pre-sales activity.
* Maintain clear communication with opportunity owners regarding solution status, outstanding decisions, risks, dependencies and readiness for assurance.

**AI solution architecture and design**

* Shape or own the end-to-end architecture of AI solutions across application, model, data, integration, infrastructure and security domains.
* Evaluate architecture options and select appropriate AI models, cloud services, orchestration frameworks and third-party technologies, balancing cost, performance, scalability, security and delivery complexity.
* Define secure integration, functional and non-functional requirements, data governance and responsible AI requirements for the proposed solution.
* Align solutions with NTT DATA reference architectures, reusable assets, delivery patterns and approved technology standards.

**Prototyping and feasibility validation**

* Develop, lead or coordinate prototypes and proofs of concept where required to validate feasibility, reduce delivery risk or demonstrate the proposed solution.
* Test material assumptions relating to model performance, data, integration, security, scalability, latency and consumption cost, with clear success and exit criteria.
* Translate prototype findings into the production architecture, estimate, assumptions and risk position, engaging specialist engineering support where required.

**Delivery planning and resource model**

* Translate the solution into a realistic delivery approach covering workstreams, deliverables, milestones, dependencies and mobilisation.
* Define or validate the resource model, effort estimates, skills, location strategy and use of global delivery centres, partners or subcontractors.
* Assess delivery timelines and define appropriate governance, roles, responsibilities, escalation and change control.
* Identify requirements for managed services, production support, model monitoring, platform operations or continuous optimisation where applicable.

**Commercial solution development**

* Work with commercial, finance, sales and delivery stakeholders to develop a commercial construct aligned to the architecture and delivery model.
* Validate estimates, rate-card assumptions, third-party costs, consumption charges and contingency, ensuring all material delivery costs are represented.
* Ensure the resource model, delivery estimate, pricing, contribution and margin assumptions remain internally consistent, with uncertainty managed through appropriate commercial mechanisms.
* Support pricing and approval processes and challenge commercial constructs that create unmanageable technical or delivery risk for NTT DATA.

**Scope and statement-of-work development**

* Support the drafting and review of proposals and statements of work, defining scope, deliverables, milestones, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, client responsibilities and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure contractual artefacts accurately reflect the approved architecture, delivery approach, resource plan and commercial model, without ambiguous or unbounded commitments.
* Coordinate legal, security, data protection and responsible AI input and support negotiation of technical and delivery-related contractual terms.

**Deal assurance and governance**

* Assess the completeness and quality of the proposed solution across architecture, technical feasibility, delivery readiness, resource requirements, commercial consistency and risk treatment.
* Identify material technical, data, security, privacy, legal, commercial and delivery risks and ensure appropriate owners and mitigations are in place.
* Prepare and present assigned opportunities for relevant assurance and approval gates, coordinating required stakeholder review and sign-off.
* Provide a clear, evidence-based assurance recommendation: proceed, proceed subject to conditions, return for rework or do not proceed in the proposed form.
* Track assurance conditions, escalate material concerns and maintain appropriate decision records; ensure independent review where the architect has materially developed the solution.

**Transition and handover to delivery**

* Maintain a controlled solution baseline through contracting and mobilisation, ensuring material changes are reflected consistently across deal artefacts.
* Lead the transition to delivery, providing the approved architecture, scope, commercial baseline, resource plan, assumptions, dependencies, risks and client commitments.
* Support early mobilisation, resolve gaps between what was sold and what is being delivered, and capture feedback to improve future solutioning and estimates.

**Reuse and capability development**

* Contribute reusable AI architectures, delivery patterns, prototypes, estimation models, proposal assets and commercial assumptions informed by pursuit and delivery experience.
* Share knowledge, coach regional teams and continuously improve the methods, templates and governance controls used by the AI Deal Intake, Assurance & Governance function.

**Knowledge and Attributes**

* Advanced enterprise solution architecture knowledge across application, integration, data, infrastructure, cloud and security domains.
* Strong understanding of AI, generative AI and agentic AI solution patterns, including model selection and evaluation, RAG, prompting, grounding, data pipelines, APIs and vector databases.
* Strong knowledge of major cloud platforms and their AI, data, integration and security capabilities, with working knowledge of software engineering, DevOps, MLOps and LLMOps.
* Ability to develop or lead prototypes and assess the path from proof of concept to a secure, scalable and supportable production solution.
* Strong understanding of security, privacy, compliance, data governance and responsible AI considerations.
* Commercial acumen across estimates, rate cards, pricing models, third-party costs, contribution, margin, contingency and cost recovery.
* Understanding of statements of work, contractual assumptions, acceptance criteria, client dependencies, change control and delivery transition.
* Strong client-facing consulting, communication and stakeholder-management skills across technical, commercial, delivery and executive audiences.
* Ability to exercise constructive challenge, make evidence-based decisions and manage multiple complex opportunities under demanding pursuit timelines.
* Strong analytical capability and attention to detail when reviewing solution, commercial and contractual artefacts.

**Academic Qualifications And Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in computer science, engineering, data science, information systems, business or a related field.
* Relevant cloud or AI certification from Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services or Google Cloud Platform is preferred.
* Enterprise or solution architecture certification such as TOGAF is advantageous; additional AI, security, privacy, agile, project or service-management certifications are beneficial.

**Ideal / Desired Experience**

* Extensive experience in enterprise solution architecture, technical consulting, AI engineering or complex technology delivery, preferably within a large-scale technology-services environment.
* Experience working across pre-sales and delivery, engaging senior clients and translating business needs into viable technical solutions.
* Demonstrated experience designing or validating enterprise AI and generative AI solutions, including prototypes and integration with enterprise platforms and data.
* Experience with one or more major cloud platforms and their AI, data and integration services.
* Experience defining delivery scope, work breakdown structures, resource models, effort estimates and delivery plans.
* Experience contributing to commercial models, pricing assumptions, rate-card constructs or business cases for complex technology engagements.
* Experience drafting or reviewing statements of work, managing technical and delivery risk, and supporting formal solution or deal-assurance reviews.
* Experience transitioning solutions into delivery and working across sales, commercial, engineering, delivery, security, legal and partner teams; regulated environments and AI managed services/MLOps/LLMOps experience are advantageous.

**Workplace type:**
Hybrid Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune
  
  
Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
  
  
responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
  
  
unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
  
  
application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
  
  
confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
  
  
than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as
  
  
established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each
  
  
year in R&D.

title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About The Team**
The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  
  
You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.
  
  
You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.
  
  
This role can be based in Delhi, Mumbai, or Bangalore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.
* Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.
* Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.
* Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
* Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.
* Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.
* Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.
* Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.
* Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.
* Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.
* Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.
* Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.
* Have guided enterprise organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact.
* Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers.
* Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.
* Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows.
* Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.
* Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.
* Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.
* Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant industry or strong fluency with the needs of digital-native businesses.
* Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan.
* Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping organizations deploy advanced AI responsibly.

**About OpenAI**
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

title: Digital Experience- Consultant
description:
**Job Description:**

We are looking for an experienced IT Consultant - Automotive Domain to join our dynamic team. This individual will play a pivotal role in advising automotive clients on digital transformation strategies, leveraging AI, data analytics, cloud solutions, and other digital technologies to transform their businesses. You will be working with senior executives to shape their digital strategies, help them adopt digital, data centric, AI-powered solutions, and optimize their business processes for the future.

Your expertise will enable our clients to adopt the latest trends in digital technology, such as connected vehicles, AI-driven customer experiences, and data analytics, and apply these innovations to their operations. This is a strategic consulting role, where you will act as a trusted advisor to clients in the automotive space, driving both operational and customer experience improvements through digital transformation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Client Engagement & Strategic Consultation:
* Work closely with automotive clients, but not limited to, to understand their unique business challenges and digital transformation needs.
* Advise on strategies to implement cutting-edge digital solutions, focusing on AI, cloud computing, data analytics, and digital platforms.
* Develop and pitch tailored digital transformation roadmaps, helping automotive companies reimagine their business models for the future.

**Digital Transformation Strategy:**

* Guide clients on the application of AI, machine learning, cloud technologies, and advanced analytics to modernize their operations.
* Provide thought leadership on how digital technologies can improve automotive business processes, such as customer engagement, marketing automation, supply chain optimization, and after-sales services.
* Assist clients in developing and deploying AI and data analytics models for predictive insights, demand forecasting, and customer behavior analysis.

**AI and Data Analytics:**

* Help automotive clients harness the power of AI for customer-facing applications such as personalized experiences, chatbots, and virtual assistants.
* Advise on leveraging data analytics to enhance decision-making, improve operational efficiency, and drive customer insights.
* Guide clients on AI and machine learning strategies, including predictive analytics and automation of business processes.

**Technology Integration & Cloud Transformation:**

* Advise clients on integrating cloud platforms and digital tools that facilitate scalability, agility, and innovation.
* Help clients migrate their operations to the cloud, supporting them through the planning, execution, and optimization of their digital infrastructure.
* Provide strategic direction for digital platform adoption, including the integration of advanced tools like CRM systems, ERP solutions, and digital marketing platforms.

**Market Research & Trend Analysis:**

* Stay ahead of key digital trends in the automotive sector, including connected vehicles, AI-powered customer experience, mobility as a service (MaaS), and smart supply chain technologies.
* Keep clients informed about emerging digital trends and advise them on how to adopt new technologies to stay competitive.

**Pre-Sales & Proposal Development:**

* Collaborate with the sales team to identify new business opportunities by creating compelling proposals and presenting digital transformation solutions.
* Develop impactful presentations and white papers that highlight the benefits of digital transformation initiatives in the automotive industry.

**Client Support & Relationship Management:**

* Build strong relationships with key stakeholders at automotive companies, serving as their go-to advisor on digital strategy.
* Assist clients in evaluating the ROI of their digital transformation initiatives and ensure that they are achieving measurable results.

**Key Digital Trends in the Automotive Industry:**

As part of your role, you’ll work with clients to integrate the following key digital trends shaping the automotive landscape:

**Connected Vehicles & IoT:**

* Enable automotive companies to leverage connected vehicle technologies to enhance customer engagement and vehicle performance monitoring.

**Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Machine Learning:**

* Advise on using AI for personalized customer experiences, predictive maintenance, and optimized supply chain management.

**Customer-Centric Digital Experiences:**

* Drive the adoption of AI-powered customer engagement platforms, including chatbots and virtual assistants, to enhance user experiences.

**Cloud & SaaS Solutions:**

* Help clients adopt cloud-based solutions that improve scalability, enhance collaboration, and reduce IT infrastructure costs.

**Mobility as a Service (MaaS):**

**Data-Driven Decision Making:**

* Help clients build data strategies that leverage advanced analytics to drive smarter business decisions, improve operational efficiency, and predict customer behaviors.

**Experience:**

* 17+ years of experience in IT consulting with a focus on digital transformation and strategy.
* Proven track record in consulting for the automotive industry, with expertise in AI, cloud technologies, data

title: Associate Manager
description:
**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a dedicated and innovative RGM Lead Consultant with 5 to 7 years of experience to join our dynamic team in Bengaluru. This role leads the design and delivery of an integrated Revenue Growth Management (RGM) decision engine that operates at the PPG/retailer level and connects insights to actions across the entire value chain. You will help our CPG and retail clients turn data into decisions across business diagnosis, shopper understanding, availability, assortment, price-pack architecture, pricing and promotions, retail execution, and value realization — powering their Annual Business Planning (ABP) and Joint Business Planning (JBP) cycles.

**Key Responsibilities :**

* Lead and mentor a team of analysts and consultants to develop and deploy advanced analytics that power an end-to-end RGM solution while fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation.
* Drive business diagnosis by building category health, competitor, promotion / flyer-feature, rolling retailer-profit, and innovation-performance analyses that identify winners and drainers and answer "how is the business doing?"
* Translate shopper understanding into commercial action through occasion analysis and pack-switching studies that reveal who is buying, why, and what they need.
* Strengthen availability and replenishment with demand forecasting that improves fill rate and reduces out-of-stocks, ensuring the plan can satisfy demand.
* Optimize shelf and assortment through SKU prioritization and white-space detection to define what should be on the shelf and where unaddressed growth exists.
* Design price-pack architecture using PPA and pack analytics, pack-and-mix optimization, trade-up and cannibalization analysis, and mix-and-margin simulation to determine which packs should win were.
* Develop pricing and promotion recommendations — price-gap and price-recommendation engines, trade promotion and spend optimization (TPO / TSO), promo calendar and scenario planning, and offer / tactic optimization — that rank the best net-P&L levers while respecting that the retailer decides.
* Enable retail execution with execution trackers and feedback loops, pre / post-event tracking, and retailer scorecards and compliance to confirm plans are executed correctly.
* Measure value realization through attribution and impact measurement, KPI dashboards, test-and-learn frameworks, and continuous optimization — closing the loop so performance feeds back and insight feeds forward via model refreshes and elasticity updates.
* Utilize MySQL and Python to extract, engineer, and analyze large, multi-source datasets (sales, volume, share, OOS, fill rate, promo ROI, margin), ensuring accuracy and relevance in reporting for strategic decision-making.
* Partner cross-functionally with client sales, category, finance, and supply teams to embed analytics into ABP and JBP and to influence stakeholders at all levels.

**Expected Outcomes :**

* Deliver a ranked view of the best net-P&L levers, along with a clean price ladder and well-defined SKU roles, that measurably increases revenue, volume, and market share within the first year.
* Improve margin, profitability, and trade-spend ROI across own-brand, private-label, and co-manufacturer portfolios through optimized price-pack and promotion decisions.
* Raise availability and fill rate and strengthen retailer partnerships by aligning demand, assortment, and execution plans within the ABP and JBP process.
* Achieve a minimum of 20% improvement in forecasting and elasticity-model accuracy through advanced analytics, disciplined test-and-learn, and continuous optimization.
* Establish best practices in data engineering, modeling, and value tracking that enhance team productivity and make value realization visible and repeatable.

**Qualifications (Skills/Competencies) :**

* 5 to 7 years in analytics or consulting with a strong foundation in Revenue Growth Management, pricing and promotion, and market-mix / elasticity modeling.
* Proficiency in MySQL for large-scale data extraction and manipulation, with Python for data analysis and model development highly desirable.
* Hands-on experience across the RGM toolkit: price-pack architecture, trade promotion and spend optimization (TPO / TSO), demand forecasting, assortment and white-space analysis, and promo scenario planning.
* Solid understanding of statistics and a proven ability to apply statistical methods to real-world commercial challenges
* CPG / retail domain knowledge, including familiarity with syndicated and point-of-sale data (e.g., Nielsen, Circana / IRI) and ABP / JBP planning cycles (preferred).
* Ability to build KPI dashboards and clearly communicate insights, with excellent leadership skills and a proven ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for data analytics and a proven track record of leading teams to success, we encourage you to apply. Join us in shaping the future of revenue growth management and making a significant impact in a collaborative and inclusive environment. Your insights could be the key to our clients' next big breakthrough!
