description:
**The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership**
With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership.
  
  
At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.
  
  
**About The Role**
Edwards / Kidde Commercial, business brands of Kidde Global Solutions, Strategic Accounts organization is currently searching for a dynamic Strategic Accounts Manager (SAM) to manage and increase sales of fire alarm, air sampling smoke detection, & emergency call / mass notification solutions to clients in the Data Center / Semiconductor, Hospitality, and Modular Construction verticals. This is a remote field position, and all locations will be considered.
  
  
The primary responsibility of the SAM is to drive incremental solution sales, which are delivered by the Edwards and Kidde Commercial channel partner networks, achieving an annual Sales target by developing, implementing, and executing a Strategic Account plan that achieves or exceeds the vertical segment plan. Experience developing and managing strong owner/executive relationships with C-suite and corporate headquarters personnel, consulting engineers, and general contractors / developers. The SAM must be capable of flexibly pivoting across these verticals, adapting account strategies and stakeholder messaging to address the distinct buying processes, technical requirements, and project delivery structures unique to each segment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Account Management: Build and manage relationships with key stakeholders across design, construction, ownership, and operations to position Edwards and Kidde Commercial solutions in new and replacement projects. Key stakeholders include:
* Data Center / Mission Critical: Engineering firms, hyperscale and colocation owners/operators, and senior design, construction, project, and operations leaders.
* Hospitality: Brand and ownership executives, design and construction leaders, facilities teams, property managers, and design consultants.
* Modular Construction: Modular manufacturers, general contractors, developers, and owners.
* Collaboration: Partner with sales and technical teams to align strategies and deliver solutions that support customer goals across target verticals.
* Consultation: Advise engineers, architects, and decision makers on standardization, fire and life safety requirements, and applicable codes and brand standards.
* Solution Design and Support: Assess client needs and support tailored solutions, specifications, and presentations across varied project delivery models.
* Strategic Planning: Develop and maintain account plans aligned to customer goals, buying criteria, and value drivers.
* Vertical Market Agility: Adapt strategy and messaging across Data Center / Mission Critical, Hospitality, and Modular Construction segments.
* Client Needs Analysis: Use consultative selling and active listening to identify priorities and recommend solutions that fit stakeholder needs.
* Complex Account Management: Manage relationships across large organizations and multi-site project portfolios.
* Market Engagement: Participate in industry events and internal initiatives to expand relationships and stay current on market trends.
* Opportunity and Demand Generation: Identify new opportunities, expand demand, and grow market share within target segments.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of selling experience, preferably 2 to 3 years of executive/end client/C-suite level sales experience in fire/life safety or equivalent type industry
* Demonstrated experience or strong working knowledge in at least one of the following verticals: Data Center / Mission Critical, Hospitality, or Modular Construction.
* Experience in a consultative selling environment; active listening skills to identify client needs, build long-term relationships, and deliver tailored solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
* Valid Driver’s License.
* Travel Required 70%.
* Proficient in Microsoft O365 and collaboration/webinar tools (Zoom, Microsoft Teams, etc.) and SalesForce.
* Proficiency in speaking English

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
* Technical certification, associate degree, or higher preferred.
* Experience calling on hospitality ownership groups, hotel brand management companies, and hotel design & construction teams.
* Experience calling on electrical and fire protection engineers supporting designs and construction companies involved in designing and building data centers and semiconductor facilities.
* Familiarity with modular construction delivery methodologies, manufacturers, and the associated procurement process.
* Strong consultative selling skills and demonstrated ability to manage large, complex corporate accounts across multiple simultaneous verticals.
* Demonstrated ability to engage C-Suite and Director of Engineering decision makers, understand customer business objectives, define relevant solutions, and communicate value-added benefit effectively.
* Proven ability to influence and work effectively across all levels of an organization.
* Organized with strong attention to detail, while able to manage multiple priorities across distinct vertical segments.

**World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety**
Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

* Own retention, expansion, and overall growth across your book of business
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Support, and Risk teams to provide informed recommendations that enhance the customer experience
* Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams to drive efficiencies throughout the account lifecycle

**What You Will Need**

* 2+ years in Sales/Sales Development, Customer Success, Account Management, Project Management, or Implementations, with experience advising clients and driving revenue expansion
* Experience engaging with financial decision-makers (Owners/CEOs, CFO, Controller, Director of Finance) at companies with up to 50 employees

* Ability to understand diverse business requirements across industries and translate them into a compelling vision for customers
* High emotional intelligence, coachability, and a genuine passion for delighting clients

* 2+ years managing multiple SMB customers while implementing or administering expense or corporate card programs

To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

title: AI Solution Lead
description:
**Position: AI Solution Lead**
**Location: Bangalore, Hybrid**
**Business Unit: Technology, Data & AI**
**About Sattva**
**We**
**Partner**
**to deliver social impact at scale**
Sattva Consulting is a global impact consulting firm from India. Since 2009 we have been engaging with communities, business and government to achieve societal impact at scale. We believe that Civil society, Business and Government all have a critical role to play in building an equitable and sustainable world, and we actively partner with all stakeholders to enable impact through our advisory orchestration services, knowledge and data platforms which we have built as public goods for the ecosystem and collaborative solutions and partnerships.
  
  
Our teams are based in India, Singapore, Denmark and UK, but as a global organization our work has spanned 25 countries and 5 continents. For more information, please visit: www.sattva.co.in
  
  
**The Opportunity**
This is the role that anchors Sattva’s AI transformation. You drive the agenda for how AI changes the way we work, and you carry the organisation along that journey.
  
  
You are accountable for making Responsible AI adoption happen; the business units and enablement teams you work with own the outcomes in their areas.
  
  
You are inheriting live momentum from an outgoing AI Solution Lead: tools in place, a policy about to land, pilots in validation, a knowledge-management effort under way and an engaged network of AI champions.
  
  
Alongside internal transformation, this role involves client engagements under the AI for Nonprofits offering, where the lessons of our own journey become the substance of what we deliver.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
You will focus on four pillars.
  
  

* AI Adoption, Fluency and Responsible AI
* Make AI fluency universal, so that every Sattvan knows which tools suit which tasks and uses them responsibly and well. Build on what exists, including the AI Ninja Program, the AI Open House and the responsible-use assessment results.
* Keep the organisation informed. Run regular updates for leadership and for all of Sattva, so progress, lessons and next steps stay visible.
* Steward the AI Policy. With security, legal and IT, assess privacy, consent, confidentiality, vendor terms, access and data retention, and translate policy into pragmatic controls and plain-language guidance.
* Workflow Solutions with Business and Enablement Units
* Discover and prioritise opportunities with business unit leaders, enablement heads and delivery teams. Understand real workflows, assess feasibility, value, data readiness, cost and risk, define measurable outcomes, and keep a transparent pipeline of use cases.
* Design practical solutions such as assistants, agentic workflows and reusable skills and playbooks, combining AI with the systems and data we already use. Build first versions yourself with AI and low-code tools, make build-versus-buy choices, and bring in external partners for larger builds.
* Grow and equip the AI champion network, so capability spreads well beyond you. Coach champions, give them ready-to-use playbooks, and learn from what they see in the field.
* Move pilots into stable, dependable use, each with an accountable business owner.
* AI for Nonprofits Client Work
* Help take the AI for Nonprofits offering from definition to its first engagements, working alongside the consulting teams that lead it.
* Support delivery directly through discovery workshops, use-case design, prototypes and hands-on training for nonprofit teams.
* Portfolio, Platforms and Vendors
* Evaluate AI products and implementation partners, and oversee the relevant licences, budgets and integrations.
* Keep the portfolio manageable and current, retiring tools and pilots that no longer earn their place.

**Experience**
**Skills Required:**

* Typically 6+ years across product or software delivery, technology consulting, digital transformation or similar work, with demonstrable hands-on experience designing and deploying GenAI workflows that people actually use. Equivalent capability matters more than a rigid tenure threshold.
* Led adoption or change across a largely non-technical workforce, and can show what changed as a result.
* Developed AI PoCs and run AI pilots with accountable business owners. Has taken some of them to productive use and adoption.
* Worked across multiple teams, business units or clients, facilitated workshops, and mentored champions or junior builders.

Capabilities
  
  

* Highly hands-on with today’s frontier models, harnesses and tools. You use them every day and know what each is good for.
* A pragmatic builder who gets a working first version up fast with AI and low-code tools. Deep coding skills are not what we are looking for.
* Strong at workflow discovery, problem framing and prioritisation, and at turning pilots into maintainable services.
* A clear writer and communicator who can explain trade-offs to a busy consultant and a senior leader alike.

Attributes
  
  

* Exceptional at working with people. You earn time and commitment from colleagues who are busy with their own projects, and you lead through influence rather than authority.
* Genuinely enthusiastic and curious about AI, while clear-eyed about its pitfalls.
* Fast and pragmatic: you build a first version quickly, test it against real work, and prefer measured impact to tool novelty.
* A patient teacher who enjoys helping people from any background become confident with new tools.

Helpful, Not Mandatory
  
  

* Familiarity with social-sector consulting, NGO operations, due diligence, monitoring and evaluation, field data collection, research workflows or organisation-wide knowledge management.

**What Success Looks Like**

* In 3 months, you will have completed a structured handover of priority pilots, knowledge systems, governance, tool access and vendor obligations, each with a clear sponsor and next decision. You will have met every business unit head, enablement head and AI champion, published a concise use-case rubric and pipeline, and chosen a small set of high-value opportunities with baselines, milestones, owners and go/no-go criteria. For at least one workflow, you will have shown a repeatable benchmark, a failure taxonomy and a human-review design, and reached a decision to pilot, redesign or stop. You begin engaging with clients on AI strategy and implementation projects.
* In 6 months, the first pilots will be in stable use with accountable owners, the AI Policy will be working as practical controls and guidance, and adoption will be measured at the level of real workflows. You would have delivered a few client engagements via the AI for Nonprofits offering.
* In 12 months, selected use cases will show verified outcomes, with evidence of quality, adoption and a credible estimate of time, cost or service improvement. Every business unit and enablement team will have AI use cases in regular use, and Sattva will have documented solution patterns, review standards, reusable assets, trained champions and a current portfolio. Externally, Sattva would have established itself as a key enabler of AI transformation for Nonprofits.

**What Won’t Work**

* This won’t work if you are a pure technologist who builds elegant tools nobody adopts. Adoption is not an afterthought to the job.
* This won’t work if you are an evangelist who runs inspiring workshops but cannot build, test or evaluate a solution yourself.
* This won’t work if your strength is writing production code and that is how you want to spend your days. We need someone who moves fast with AI tools and gets others moving, not a software engineer.
* This won’t work if you need a large team or formal authority to get things done. You will have a couple of interns, a network of champions and your ability to bring people along.

**What’s Hard About This Job**

* Influence without authority. The people you need are busy delivering their own projects. Leadership is behind this transformation, but that buy-in opens doors; it does not do the work of earning people’s time and commitment. That depends on you.
* A largely non-technical organisation. Fluency for 400 people from diverse backgrounds means meeting each of them where they are, in the language of their own work.
* A team of one. Beyond a couple of interns, your leverage comes from champions, partners and reusable assets you create, so you must choose carefully where to spend your own hands-on time.
* Starting mid-flight. Pilots, policy, knowledge curation and programmes are already moving, and the person who started them is leaving. You will need to learn fast and keep momentum without losing quality.
* Two audiences at once. Internal transformation and client work under AI for Nonprofits pull on the same hours.
* A moving target. AI tools change month to month. You will hold steady standards for evaluation and responsible use while the tools themselves keep shifting.
* Highly visible. You will update leadership and the whole organisation regularly. Progress will be seen, and so will anything that stalls.

**Why This Role Matters**

* Near-term. AI is reshaping consulting, both in how the work is done and in what clients will pay for. The choices Sattva makes over the next two years will decide whether we lead that shift or catch up to it.
* Mid-term. Through AI for Nonprofits, what works inside Sattva becomes a path for nonprofits across the sector. Your work multiplies well beyond our own walls, which is impact at scale in its truest sense.
* Personal. This is a highly visible role with regular access to leadership, and a rare chance to shape how an organisation of 400 people works through the AI era.

**Why Sattva?**
It's not about us really- Because IMPACT is everybody’s business.
  
  

* Create Impact: Make an impact with the work you do and the solutions you design
* Work Environment: Thrive in a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment
* Learn & Grow: Challenge yourself to learn, grow, and deliver the best you can
* Future Ready: Work on critical issues of today that will affect our collective tomorrow

**How to Prepare?**
This is your opportunity to showcase not only your qualifications but also your unique personality and passion for making a meaningful impact. Approach your application with intentionality, ensuring that each word reflects your commitment to excellence and aligns seamlessly with the values of Sattva.
  
  
**FAQs on the Hiring Process**
**Next Steps**
**Together towards a sustainable world with opportunity for all!**
*Sattva is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, caste, creed, gender, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, or any other legally protected and/or marginalized characteristics. Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are essential to our business and we foster an environment of respect and a culture that celebrates diversity and promotes equity and inclusion. We are committed to providing all employees with education, training, and development opportunities to create a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and included.*
**Please note: The organization follows a Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) policy, under which employees are required to use their personal laptops for work purposes, subject to compliance with the company’s information security and IT policies. Necessary tools for operating, like MS office etc, will be provided.**

title: Presales Consultant
description:

**Pre-Sales Consultant**
with strong multi-cloud expertise and hands-on Salesforce knowledge. The ideal candidate will design and propose scalable, secure, and cost-efficient technical solutions across diverse technology ecosystems—including Salesforce, AWS, Azure, and integration/middleware platforms—without vendor bias.

This role bridges sales, delivery, and engineering, bringing deep technical insight, excellent communication skills, and strong solution-design capabilities to the RFx process.

The Senior Pre-Sales Consultant is expected to lead large-scale/complex project(s), executing the following responsibilities:

* Client, Sales & RFx Engagement:

* Recommend best-fit technology stacks—Salesforce or otherwise—based purely on customer needs and evaluation criteria.
* Create high-level and detailed technical architecture diagrams, data flow models, and integration patterns.
* Translate requirements into epics, modules, feature lists, and high-level solution blueprints.
* Apply modern architectural principles: microservices, API-led integration, event-driven frameworks, serverless, containerization, and cloud-native patterns.

The ideal candidate brings broad technical versatility, including:

Salesforce Ecosystem:

* Core technologies: Apex, Visualforce, Lightning (Aura/LWC), SOQL/SOSL, Salesforce APIs.
* Clouds: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CPQ, Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Einstein.
* Integration: MuleSoft (API-led connectivity), Dell Boomi, Informatica, Jitterbit, and other middleware platforms.

* Security & governance: OAuth, SSO, profiles/permissions, event monitoring.

Third Party Integrations:

* Document generation: Conga, DocuSign Gen, Nintex.
* E-signature: DocuSign, Adobe Sign, Zoho Sign.
* Storage/Content: SharePoint, Google Drive, AWS S3, OneDrive, Box.
* SMS/Communication: Twilio, Sinch, Whatsapp APIs, Netcore.
* Monitoring/Logging: Splunk, Datadog, ELK.
* Analytics/BI: Tableau, Power BI, CRM Analytics.

Cloud & Application Stack:

* AWS, Azure, GCP (optional) cloud services.
* Databases: SQL, NoSQL.
* Programming: Java, Python, Node.js (advantage).
* Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes.
* AI/ML model usage & LLM-based solutioning.

* Estimation, Planning & Financial Modelling
* Prepare accurate estimates for functional work, integrations, data migration, and system complexity.
* Develop implementation timelines, resource/staffing plans, and project roadmaps.
* Create margin analysis, cost breakdowns, and pricing models.
* Collaborate with sales and delivery leadership for approvals and validation.

* Technical Proposal & Documentation
* Draft and refine technical sections for RFIs, RFPs, proposals, and solution decks.
* Convert customer requirements into compelling technical narratives and business value propositions.
* Document design assumptions, architectural decisions, and solution trade-offs.
* Ensure solutions meet scalability, security, compliance, and performance standards.

**What you will bring:**

* 6-12 years of experience in Pre-Sales, Solution Design, or Architecture roles.
* Strong multi-cloud and Salesforce experience, including deep hands-on understanding of integrations and ecosystem tools.
* Ability to convert requirements into modular solution components and architectural blueprints.
* Excellent communication skills to simplify complex concepts for business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with technical writing, prompt engineering, and AI-assisted solutioning.
* Proven experience participating in large-scale RFx processes and cross-functional collaboration.

**What we offer:**

Group Medical Insurance (Family Floater Plan - Self + Spouse + 4 Dependent Children)

* Sum Insured: INR 5,00,000/-
* Maternity cover upto two children
* Cashless & Reimbursement facility
* Access to free online doctor consultation

* Accidental Death and Permanent Total Disability is covered up to 100% of Sum Insured
* Permanent Partial Disability is covered as per the scale of benefits decided by the Insurer
* Temporary Total Disability is covered

Optional Food Wallet (up to Rs. 2500 per month)

* Offered as a tax saver component
* Part of the special allowance component in the CTC

Monthly Internet Reimbursement of upto Rs. 1,000

Professional Development opportunities through various MTX-sponsored certifications on multiple technology stacks, including Salesforce, Microsoft, Google Cloud, AWS & other

Academic Success Manager

AVEVA India offices
  
  
**Department:**
Partners

You will be expected to work with leading educational institutions to create lasting partnerships that make AVEVA’s portfolio easily accessible and commercially affordable.

* Demonstrating the ability to improve existing engagements with the academia by driving adoption of existing and new AVEVA solutions
* Gathering and researching information to solve academia inquiries by using internal tools and escalation within teams as necessary
* Focus on growing the region both from a partnership point of view (# of participating institutions), and from an adoption point of view (# of leverage core products, strategic adoption of cloud)
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to drive program progress against goals and objectives by establishing logistics, like marketing materials, participation in, or sponsorship of related events
* Facilitates the flow of information between everyone involved in the advancement of the academic program and create alignment around priorities
* Bring forward ideas and execution plans from an educational onboarding perspective across legal, commercial, pricing and licensing dimensions such that teachers and students alike can get started quickly and learn easily
* Experience defining, developing and leading complex projects in a fast-paced, changing environment
* Time management, facilitation, and organizational skills
* Experience in communicating with cross functional international teams
* Academic background or experience working with the academic community

* You will have 7-9 years of experience in the industrial software world
* You will have significant experience with engineering solutions within the industrial marketplace
* You will be a self-starter, optimising and enhancing the universities education programs/curriculum by familiarizing them with our solutions

* You will have sound commercial and business development skills to define and quantify a suitable delivery strategy

* You will have a deep knowledge of the business processes, information flow and management practices for the marketplace

If you're passionate about driving growth, tackling complex business challenges, and fostering strong customer relationships, you'll find success and fulfilment in our Commercial team.
  
  
You’ll also be joining an award-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our
awards and recognition
.
  
  
Find out more:
https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/

title: Solution Architect - Presales
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for L2 Presales Engineers with strong expertise in Modernization, Data & AI, and Migration to strengthen our presales capabilities in these strategic technology areas.
  
  
The selected candidates will be responsible for handling core L2-level presales activities, including customer discovery, solution design, architecture, technical presentations, solution discussions, and customer-facing technical engagements.
  
  
The role requires a strong combination of technical depth, solutioning capability, and customer-facing presales experience. Migration expertise is mandatory, along with strong knowledge of Modernization and Data & AI.
  
  
The resources will work closely with the presales and sales teams and will also contribute to cross-skilling and knowledge sharing across the broader presales organization.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated Data & Modernization Presales Engineer with hands-on experience in application modernization, database modernization, cloud migration, and AWS modernization services. The candidate will support sales teams in designing modernization solutions, conducting technical assessments, preparing proposals, developing business cases, and assisting customers in their transformation journey from legacy applications and databases to modern cloud-native platforms.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of modernization tools such as AWS Transform (ATX), Kiro, Amazon Q Developer, database migration technologies, application re-platforming, and cloud-native architecture patterns
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Conduct technical discovery sessions with customers to understand business and technology requirements.
* Translate customer requirements into appropriate technical solutions and architectures.
* Design and present solutions focused on application modernization, cloud transformation, migration, data, and AI.
* Develop high-level solution architectures, technical proposals, presentations, and solution documents.
* Participate in customer meetings, workshops, technical discussions, and solution demonstrations.
* Collaborate with sales, delivery, engineering, and architecture teams to develop end-to-end solutions.
* Provide technical inputs for RFPs, RFIs, proposals, and other presales engagements.
* Assess existing customer environments and identify modernization and migration opportunities.
* Support estimation, solution sizing, effort assessment, and technical assumptions.
* Explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends across Modernization, Cloud, Data, and AI.
* Build reusable solution assets, reference architectures, presentations, and technical collateral.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and cross-skilling initiatives within the presales team.
* Support multiple customer opportunities while managing priorities and timelines effectively.
* Conduct application and database modernization discovery workshops with customers.
* Assess legacy applications and recommend Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, or Modernization strategies.
* Analyze existing database platforms and define migration approaches to Aurora PostgreSQL, PostgreSQL, Aurora MySQL, or AWS-native services.
* Execute application and database assessment tools and prepare modernization reports.
* Utilize AWS Transform, Amazon Q Developer, Kiro, AWS SCT, and other modernization tools to identify migration opportunities.
* Design target-state cloud architectures aligned with AWS Well-Architected principles.
* Prepare High-Level Designs (HLDs), solution architectures, migration plans, and modernization roadmaps.
* Create effort estimations, bill of materials (BoM), TCOs, and technical proposals.
* Present solution recommendations, modernization strategies, and business benefits to customer stakeholders.
* Support pre-sales activities including RFP/RFI responses, technical discussions, and solution demonstrations.
* Identify application dependencies, integration challenges, and modernization risks.
* Work closely with AWS teams, OEM partners, sales teams, and delivery teams for solution validation.
* Define migration waves, cutover approaches, testing strategies, and rollback plans.
* Stay current with emerging AWS modernization services, GenAI-assisted development tools, and cloud-native architectures.
* Support PoCs, pilot engagements, and customer workshops focused on application and database modernization initiatives.
* Assess existing data platforms including Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, ETL pipelines, BI platforms, and recommend modernization strategies on AWS-native services.
* Design high-level architectures for Data Lakes, Data Platforms, Analytics Solutions, GenAI applications, RAG-based solutions, and AI-powered modernization initiatives
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI-assisted tools for application modernization, code transformation, database migration, documentation generation, and productivity improvements
* Support presales activities related to Data Engineering, Analytics, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions, including preparation of solution proposals, roadmaps, effort estimates, and business cases.
* Work with customers to define AI use cases, data readiness requirements, governance considerations, and modernization priorities aligned to business outcomes.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in Presales, Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting, or Solution Engineering.
* Strong experience in customer-facing presales engagements.
* Strong understanding of Application Modernization and transformation concepts.
* Strong expertise in Data & AI technologies and solutioning.
* Mandatory experience in Migration, preferably cloud/application/data migration.
* Experience in conducting discovery workshops and requirement-gathering sessions.
* Strong understanding of solution architecture and technical design.
* Experience preparing technical proposals, presentations, RFP/RFI responses, and solution documents.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable and practical technical solutions.
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively with sales, delivery, engineering, and architecture teams.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with major cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of cloud-native architecture and modernization patterns.
* Exposure to data platforms, data engineering, analytics, GenAI, or machine learning solutions.
* Relevant cloud, data, AI, or architecture certifications

title: Consulting Project Management
description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs.

Our organization is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI. We take pride in embodying Microsoft's mission of empowerment, promoting a growth mindset, inspiring excellence, and fostering a culture of inclusivity where everyone is encouraged to share their unique perspectives and be their authentic selves. By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to life-changing innovations that impact billions of people worldwide.

The Solution Architect is responsible for translating the client’s business requirements into specific systems, applications, or process designs for very large complex technology solutions and architectures. You’ll act as an advocate for the client as the ultimate authority on the architecture designed to address client business problems. You’ll provide direction for design activities, often project-based, sometimes working at customer sites.  
  
As a Solution Architect you’ll gather customer/partner insights from a broad range of stakeholders to shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of projects. You’ll define and document the architecture to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Collaborating with the Project Manager you’ll jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use. You’ll work with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders to gather and ratify requirements and constraints and collaborating with the Account Team and/or Bid Team to understand the business solution/problem. This role is flexible in that you can work up to 50% from home.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

Responsibilities -

You will gather customer/partner insights from a broad range of stakeholders as well as the main business sponsor to shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of projects and work with customer/partner stakeholders and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach to determine if changes are needed to the business solution.  

* You will use evidence-based approach to represent the customer/partner as a customer advocate and share insights with Product Engineering teams and the business with a view to improving Microsoft technologies, products, services and offerings such that they can better meet customer/partner needs across a territory.
* You will define and document the Architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach.
* You will work with customers to understand and demonstrate business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realizes and manage and resolve ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved.
* You will generate new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas to drive changes.
* You will identify which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers and drive the re-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre-sales and delivery as well as participate and contribute to internal/external communities.
* You will lead virtual teams around technologies and customer/partner challenges by sharing ideas, insight, and strategic, technical input with technical teams, internal communities across the field and the larger virtual team across Microsoft using knowledge of Microsoft architectures and their context in the competitive landscape.

Technology Areas

Strong understanding of complex business problems to ensure projects are leveraging the appropriate technology and the technical design.  
Enterprise-scale technical experience with cloud and hybrid infrastructures, architecture designs, database migrations, and technology management.  
Experience in moving data from on-premises data platforms to cloud and designing cloud native data warehouse platform.  
Experience working with transactional, temporal, time series, and structured and unstructured data.  
Big Data and Data Warehouses including Azure Synapse Analytics (formerly Azure SQL DW), Snowflake, GCP’s Big Query, AWS Redshift, Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Explorer  
Advanced Analytics including Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Bricks, data visualization tools (i.e. PowerBI, Tableau)  
Data Science and Machine Learning (i.e. Azure ML, ML Server, TensorFlow, or other similar frameworks)  
Experience with cloud infrastructure, storage optimization and query optimizations.  
Experience in delivering/managing lifecycle of software/services using DevOps/MLOps.  
Proficiency in data modeling and design, including SQL development and database administration.  
Experience with cloud platforms, such as Azure, to manage and integrate data systems.  
Knowledge of big data developments and technology architectures.  
Familiarity with data security measures and compliance regulations.  
Ability to design and model database, data warehouse, and data flow infrastructures.  
Understanding of data integration and the tools to manage data flow.

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 8+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain of Data & AI.

o OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 6+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)  
o OR equivalent experience  

* 2+ years managing multiple projects or portfolios
* 1+ year(s) experience leading blended, multidisciplinary teams

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 12+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

o OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 8+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)  
o OR equivalent experience  

* 6+ years technical sales experience
* 6+ years project management experience
* 3+ years people management experience, including managing consultant practice managers, technical sales managers, and/or technical architect managers

o Technical or Professional Certification in Domain (e.g., Security)

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

In MS we are also ambitious, seeking to more than double our success in the future.

  

**The opportunity**

Global Managed services business at EY at its inflexion point and poised for fast faced growth across our portfolio of solutions and offering that we take to the market. As a member of the solution team you will be responsible to leverage your experience and expertise to create be-spoke solutions aligned to client objectives and transformation aspirations. In addition to creating the solution you will also be responsible to participate in business development activities and support our frontline sales team in effectively engaging with target clients from the point of identification of the business opportunity to the point it is set up for consistent and predictable delivery stage.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Leads AI solutioning for AMS pursuits, embedding AI, GenAI, and agentic capabilities into end‑to‑end service models
* Drives identification of high‑impact AI use cases and innovation opportunities across operations and applications.
* Builds quantified AI value cases (productivity, cost, experience, automation impact) to strengthen deal positioning.
* Shapes the AI-led solution narrative, translating technical capabilities into clear business outcomes.
* Owns definition of AI architecture, agent models, and integration with platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, SaaS)
* Leads client engagements and orals, confidently defending AI strategy, solution design, and benefits.
* Collaborates across teams to align AI solution, operating model, and commercials.
* Continuously drives differentiation through emerging AI capabilities, accelerators, and thought leadership
* Lead and/or manage due diligence exercises pre and post contract analysing client’s as-is state, assess risks and commercial impact in best interest of the client and EY. Understand client’s business environment and create compelling value proposition
* You will be required to make complex decisions factoring delivery capabilities, available client data, advancements in technology and competitive positioning of EY solutions
* Provide input towards the design of a specific priority managed services offering over the development lifecycle with particular focus on delivery components necessary to deploy a viable solution for our clients

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Excellent inter-personal skills to be able to rally diverse teams to work collaboratively and effectively
* Positive attitude to unlearn and learn new ways of working
* Ability to understand client goals and connect the dots with respect to EY capabilities- domain expertise, technology, frameworks to solve client challenges.
* Experience in Coaching, Mentoring and Developing people
* Experience across end-to-end Managed Services life cycle
* Flexibility to work with various EY stakeholders across the world and in different time zones.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Degree in Business, Finance, Technology IT or related fields
* 15+ years of relevant industry experience
* Passion for problem-solving and helping our clients with some of their most complex issues
* Experience in developing integrated managed services solutions primarily around
* Tech Ops: SAP, ServiceNow, MS Dynamics, Data & Analytics, App modernization, Gen AI, AI/ML Operations, Guidewire.
* Business Operations: High end Finance operations including but not limited to *Tax, Treasury, Consolidation, Revenue Assurance, Complex Regulatory compliance reporting* etc. Supply Chain operations including but not limited to strategic sourcing, procurement, vendor management etc. Mobility and Payroll operations.
* Risk: Transform and operate risk and controls functions including enterprise risk, enterprise resilience, compliance, internal audit, and controls and protect value across stakeholders in the long term Industry focused experience sectors like FSO (Banking & Capital Markets, Wealth & Asset Management Insurance), Consumer Products & Retail, Technology, Manufacturing, Life Sciences, Oil & Gas, Power& Utilities, Telecom

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* You may have certification in architecture degree such as TOGAF
* Proficiency in Design Thinking and Agile Methodology
* You will have core understanding of the big four and their got-to-market propositions

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the you may aspire to become.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Principal Technical Account Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Serves as the main contact for individual contracts, providing extensive business processes, product/service (e.g., hardware, applications, software) functionality, and/or implementation knowledge. Provides services, adjusting to ensure alignment, and educates customers on ways to leverage Oracle services. Reviews service requests and gathers information to determine next steps, identifies potential crises, leveraging extensive knowledge and other customer experience to develop innovative solutions, and connects and/or escalates issues to appropriate teams to reach solutions, anticipating and reporting pain points. Develops and maintains plans and ensures positive margins, seeks opportunities to review and update documentation, and leverages understanding and collaborates across teams to identify and submit delivery leads for new opportunities and contract renewals. Proactively provides ongoing maintenance, mentors team members to act as a liaison between teams, and seeks opportunities to improve customer ability to adopt product and service changes. Works closely with peers within and sometimes beyond the team to identify and develop innovative ways of delivering services, provides direction, experiments with new approaches, and seeks opportunities to share product/support information, and plays a key role in the development of new services and/or processes, remaining up-to-date with technological business, and industry trends.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Customer Engagement:**

* Serves as the main point of contact for individual-level contracts, providing advanced business process, product/service (e.g., hardware, applications, software) functionality, and/or implementation knowledge in an advisory manner.
* Provides timely services, adjusting to ensure alignment with their practices, procedures, contractual budgets, leveraging contractual agreements and identifying revisions.
* Maintains customer relations, communicating with customers and across related teams regularly to ensure satisfaction. Provides updates on customer status to leadership.
* Educates customers on the most effective and efficient way to leverage Oracle services, products, and tools, experimenting with new approaches and providing feedback on customer organization performance.

**Issue Resolution:**

* Reviews service requests and gathers information from appropriate parties to determine next steps.
* Identifies potential crises or concerns and works to resolve customer issues and incidents in a timely manner, leveraging advanced knowledge of appropriate resources and other customer experience to develop innovative solutions.
* Connects and/or escalates issues to appropriate teams to reach solutions and minimize impact on the business, anticipating and reporting pain points to minimize impact on the business.

**Account Management and Governance:**

* Develops and maintains service delivery and/or project plans throughout their lifecycle and ensures positive margins according to governance and account management expectations and contracted terms.
* Proactively updates and maintains accurate customer account, contract, and service history information, identifying and addressing areas missing information.
* Independently and proactively conducts account planning and account reviews, tracking and communicating status on a wide range of projects including risk identification and mitigation recommendations.
* Seeks opportunities to review and update documentation and collaborates with peers to maintain contract cost, resources and scheduling, and scope, working to meet contract revenue and margin objectives.
* Leverages understanding of business needs and collaborates across teams to identify and submit delivery leads for custom new opportunities and contract renewals.

**Technical Delivery Management:**

* Proactively advises customers on optimal use and health or their Oracle product/service investment, proactively providing ongoing maintenance to optimize and ensure effectiveness and performance of the product and/or service.
* Collaborates with cross-functional teams, driving the execution and development of technical delivery plans.
* Mentors more junior team members to act as a liaison between customers, internal, and external teams.
* Seeks opportunities to increase customer understanding and improve their ability to adopt product and service changes according to policies and best practices.

**Innovation and Continuous Improvement:**

* Works closely with peers within and sometimes beyond the team to identify and develop innovative ways to deliver service and improve overall product and service utilization to achieve ROI goals.
* Contributes to the team by providing guidance, experimenting with new approaches, and seeking opportunities to share knowledge of product, service, and/or support information or issues.
* Identifies and recommends opportunities for enhanced value for services.
* Plays a key role in the development of new services and/or processes, remaining up-to-date with technological, business, and industry trends.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

**Problem Solving:**

* Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.

**Performance and Development:**

* Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Senior Consultant
description:
**Senior Consultant, Consulting India**

**Chennai/Pune/Gurugram/Noida**

**Who is ZoomRx?**

ZoomRx is a rapidly growing life science market research and consulting company founded upon the belief that there is important work to be done at the intersection of data, healthcare, and technology. We help some of the world’s biggest biopharmaceutical companies answer questions no one else can. We support our clients through their entire business lifecycle; providing market intelligence that helps them launch new therapies, optimize promotional efforts, defend against competitive pressure, shape marketing strategies, and much more.

At ZoomRx we also have various impactful products (Ferma.AI, PERxCEPT, & HCP-PT). Ferma.AI provides healthcare intelligence to pharma firms of all sizes, making it easy for teams to stay on top of their market landscape and help them make informed decisions. PERxCEPT is a one-stop shop for omnichannel intelligence in the life sciences industry, providing visibility into every digital campaign in a market from the customer’s point of view. HCP-Pt conversations is a point-of-care market insights platform that gives a real-world view of the prescribing process. Brand Builder provides holistic insights programs for new brand launches and post-launch brand optimization.

At ZoomRx, We Have a Flat Organization Structure Where Everyone Is Encouraged To Take Risks, Learn From Mistakes, And Continuously Grow Towards Realizing Their Career Goals. We Offer a Collaborative, Environment That Optimizes For The :

* pride in doing high-quality work
* joy of tackling creative, intellectually challenging work
* camaraderie of working with smart, grounded peers

**What will you be a part of?**

Consulting India works with drug commercialization teams at top pharma and biotech companies to understand their complex business needs and help them make informed decisions. The team creates strategic narratives for senior management teams of blockbuster drugs by designing and executing custom market research studies, conceiving new data analysis methods, and drawing insights from complex datasets.

**What does your day look like as a Senior Consultant?**

Senior Consultants play the role of the project leads within the Consulting team, and are expected to:

* Collaborate efficiently with the US team/counterparts to gain an in-depth understanding of client needs and problems.
* Develop detailed project plans and own tracking against it.
* Facilitate smooth flow of information and knowledge transfer between the various stakeholders involved in the end-to-end project process.
* Review project data and analytical insights to draft powerful stories.
* Debottleneck and smoothen out project operations by intervening at key inflection points.

On a day-to-day basis, you are involved in the following activities:

* Tracking daily activities against the project plan
* Translate US team/client requirements into actionable plans for their project delivery teams and clarify challenges and expectations when required
* Prepare and review meeting content
* Participate in client discussions by asking clarifying questions as well as answering a few questions directly or leading some sections of the presentation or content
* Building functional capability, improving efficiency and process adherence within their team / Delivery unit
* Removing and reducing bottlenecks to ensure smooth and efficient delivery of projects
* Mentor and coach the team members on elements they need to improve on
* Participate and contribute to internal initiatives that will benefit the BA community and its capability

**Preferred Skills/Expertise**

* Experience in Life Sciences or Healthcare industries

title: Project Head – Plotted Development (Real Estate)
description:
**About Us**  
Revanza Developers is the residential plotted development arm of the Revanza Group, a Chennai-based group in industrial real estate, warehousing, logistics parks and investments. Our first project, Revanza Fortune Greens, is a premium DTCP-approved gated villa-plot community inside Mahindra World City, Chengalpattu. More projects are coming up across Chennai, Chengalpattu and Coimbatore. Our tagline is *“Creating dreams to living.”*

**About the Role**  
We are looking for a **Project Head** to take full charge of our plotted layout projects, from land handover and approvals to development, completion and handover to customers. You will own timelines, budgets, quality and contractor performance across sites, and report directly to the Vice President.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end execution of plotted and gated-community layouts, from site mobilisation to final handover

* Ensure quality standards, site safety and documentation (DPRs, MIS, inspection reports, as-built drawings)
* Work with Sales and CRM teams on site readiness for customer visits, plot handovers and customer site queries
* Support pre-acquisition due diligence on new land parcels: site feasibility, development cost estimates and layout potential
* Build and lead the site team of engineers, supervisors and surveyors

**Requirements**

* **5 to 7 years of experience in plotted or layout development** with a real estate developer (mandatory)
* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering preferred; Diploma holders with strong plotted-project experience may apply
* Proven track record of delivering at least one complete DTCP/CMDA-approved layout project
* Good working knowledge of Tamil Nadu approval processes (DTCP, CMDA, local panchayat) and TNRERA requirements
* Strong grasp of land development costing, BOQ, contractor billing and project scheduling

* Good communication in **Tamil and English**
* Willing to travel to project sites regularly
* Own two-wheeler or four-wheeler preferred

**What We Offer**

* A leadership role in a growing real estate brand backed by an established corporate group
* Direct exposure to senior management and real say in how new projects are planned
* Competitive salary based on experience
* Statutory benefits (PF), travel allowance and mobile reimbursement
* A growth path as our project pipeline grows

**Job Type:** Full-time, Permanent  
**Location:** Mahindra World City, Chennai  
**Reports to:** Vice President

*Interested candidates with relevant plotted-development experience are encouraged to apply with their updated resume.*

* Paid sick time

title: Travel Consultant
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONTravel Consultant

**Company:** iTour by RethinkWays  
**Department:** Operations / Travel Consulting  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Chennai

About iTour by RethinkWays

At iTour by RethinkWays, we believe every journey deserves a story worth remembering. Our goal is to create seamless, memorable and personalised travel experiences by providing thoughtfully planned travel solutions and excellent customer service.

We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented **Travel Consultant** who can understand customer requirements, design suitable travel packages and ensure a smooth experience from enquiry to trip completion.

Job Summary

The Travel Consultant will be responsible for handling customer enquiries, understanding travel preferences, preparing customised itineraries, coordinating with vendors and ensuring timely follow-ups and confirmations.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Client Handling & Communication**

* Handle domestic and international travel enquiries.
* Understand client requirements, preferences and travel expectations.
* Maintain professional communication through calls, WhatsApp and emails.
* Build strong relationships with clients and provide timely updates.

**2. Itinerary Planning & Quotation**

* Prepare customised domestic and international travel itineraries.
* Research destinations, hotels, sightseeing and transportation options.
* Prepare accurate quotations based on client requirements.
* Suggest suitable travel options and value-added services.

**3. Sales & Follow-ups**

* Follow up with clients regarding shared quotations.
* Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings.
* Identify customer concerns and provide suitable solutions.
* Maintain regular follow-ups until booking confirmation.

**4. Booking & Coordination**

* Coordinate with hotels, transport providers, DMCs and other vendors.
* Handle flight, hotel, visa and travel-related booking requirements.
* Ensure all booking details are accurate and properly documented.
* Coordinate with the operations team for smooth trip execution.

**5. Pre-Trip & Post-Trip Support**

* Share essential travel information and client briefings.
* Ensure clients receive necessary travel documents and updates.
* Provide assistance during travel-related concerns.
* Collect client feedback after trip completion.

**6. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate enquiry and booking records.
* Update CRM and daily activity reports.
* Track enquiry status, follow-ups and booking conversions.
* Ensure proper documentation and coordination within the team.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Travel & Tourism, Hospitality, Aviation, Business Administration or a related field.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Good knowledge of domestic and international destinations.
* Strong negotiation and convincing skills.
* Good customer-handling and problem-solving abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Office and Google Workspace.
* Ability to multitask and work within deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and a customer-first approach.

Preferred Qualities

* Passion for travelling and exploring destinations.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Target-oriented and result-driven mindset.
* Professional approach towards clients and colleagues.

Performance Expectations (KPIs)

* Enquiry handling efficiency.
* Quotation preparation and response time.
* Follow-up consistency.
* Enquiry-to-booking conversion rate.
* Revenue and sales contribution.
* Client satisfaction and feedback.
* Accuracy in bookings and documentation.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to grow in the travel and tourism industry.
* Exposure to domestic and international travel operations.
* Supportive and collaborative work environment.
* Learning and career development opportunities.
* Performance-based incentives and recognition.

**Join iTour by RethinkWays and be a part of creating journeys that turn into happy stories.**

*Plan your Happy Stories.*

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Job Description – Talent Acquisition Manager _ Immediate joiner
description:
Job Description – Talent Acquisition & People Development Manager

**Location:** Chennai  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office – Monday to Saturday  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Experience:** 6–10 Years  
**Salary:** Up to ₹50,000 per month  
**Industry Preference:** HealthTech, E-commerce, Pharma, Healthcare, Retail or Startup preferred

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition & People Development Manager to own end-to-end recruitment and key employee experience initiatives across the organisation.

The role will be responsible for hiring across IT, Non-IT, Blue-Collar and Grey-Collar functions, along with pre-onboarding, onboarding, new joinee engagement, performance management coordination, employee pulse surveys, Training Needs Identification (TNI) and Learning & Development (L&D).

The person will work closely with business leaders, department heads and employees to understand business requirements, build talent pipelines, improve the employee experience and strengthen people processes.

This role requires strong ownership, execution, communication and the ability to manage multiple HR processes independently in a fast-paced business environment.

Key Responsibilities1. End-to-End Talent Acquisition

* Manage the complete recruitment cycle, from understanding hiring requirements to offer release and joining.
* Handle hiring across Technology, Product, Sales, Operations, Customer Support, Finance, HR and other business functions.
* Manage IT, Non-IT, Blue-Collar and Grey-Collar hiring.
* Handle volume hiring, niche positions and leadership-level recruitment.
* Ensure timely closure of vacancies without compromising on candidate quality.

2. Workforce Planning & Stakeholder Management

* Work closely with department heads and hiring managers to understand current and future manpower requirements.
* Prepare hiring plans, recruitment priorities and closure timelines.
* Follow up with hiring managers to ensure timely interview feedback and hiring decisions.
* Provide regular updates on hiring progress, challenges and expected joining dates.
* Maintain clear accountability for every open position.

3. Talent Sourcing & Recruitment Strategy

* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, consultants, direct sourcing and other channels.
* Identify suitable talent pools and explore new sourcing strategies.
* Build relationships with colleges, recruitment agencies and industry networks.
* Improve the quality and effectiveness of sourcing channels.
* Strengthen employee referral and employer branding initiatives.

4. Pre-Onboarding, Onboarding & New Joinee Experience

* Own the pre-onboarding process, including candidate communication, document collection, joining confirmation and coordination with internal teams.
* Ensure a smooth and structured onboarding experience for every new employee.
* Coordinate induction programmes, joining formalities, system access, department introductions and policy communication.
* Track and manage the new joinee experience from the first month through the sixth month.
* Conduct regular check-ins at key milestones, such as 30, 60, 90 and 180 days.
* Gather feedback from new joinees and identify concerns relating to role clarity, manager support, work environment and overall experience.
* Coordinate with reporting managers to address onboarding gaps and improve employee integration.
* Monitor early attrition and recommend corrective actions.

5. Performance Management System (PMS)

* Participate in the planning and execution of the Performance Management System.
* Coordinate performance review cycles, self-assessments, manager evaluations and feedback discussions.
* Follow up with managers and employees to ensure timely completion of performance reviews.
* Maintain PMS trackers and review records.
* Support the identification of performance gaps and development requirements.
* Coordinate with HR and business leaders on performance improvement and employee development initiatives.

6. Employee Engagement & Pulse Surveys

* Plan and conduct periodic employee pulse surveys to understand employee satisfaction, engagement and workplace concerns.
* Analyse survey responses and identify common themes and improvement areas.
* Share relevant insights with HR and business leaders.
* Coordinate action plans based on employee feedback.
* Track action closure and follow up to ensure that feedback is translated into meaningful improvements.

7. Training Needs Identification (TNI) & Learning and Development

* Coordinate Training Needs Identification across departments in consultation with managers.
* Identify skill gaps and development requirements at individual and team levels.
* Prepare and maintain the annual or periodic training calendar.
* Coordinate internal and external training programmes.
* Work with managers to identify relevant learning interventions.
* Track training participation, feedback and effectiveness.
* Maintain training records and L&D reports.

8. Recruitment Operations & HR Metrics

* Track recruitment metrics such as time-to-hire, cost-per-hire, offer-to-joining ratio, source effectiveness and position ageing.
* Maintain updated recruitment trackers, onboarding trackers and employee experience dashboards.
* Monitor offer dropouts, candidate withdrawals, joining conversions and early attrition.
* Prepare regular HR reports and provide updates to management.
* Identify process gaps and recommend improvements.

9. Team Management

* Lead and guide the talent acquisition team, wherever applicable.
* Allocate hiring responsibilities and monitor individual recruiter performance.
* Set clear targets, review progress and improve team productivity.
* Build a disciplined, accountable and result-oriented team.

Required Skills & Experience

* 6–10 years of experience in Talent Acquisition and HR, with at least 2–3 years in a team-leading or managerial role.
* Strong experience in end-to-end recruitment across multiple business functions.
* Practical exposure to IT, Non-IT, Blue-Collar and Grey-Collar hiring.
* Experience in onboarding, employee engagement, PMS coordination and L&D activities.
* Good understanding of recruitment tools, job portals, ATS and HRMS.
* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation and coordination skills.
* Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi. Knowledge of Tamil will be an advantage.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and deliver within defined timelines.
* Strong ownership, follow-up, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Startup or high-growth business experience is preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely closure of approved vacancies.
* Quality of hires and hiring manager satisfaction.
* Offer acceptance and joining conversion ratio.
* Reduction in position ageing and time-to-hire.
* Pre-onboarding and onboarding completion.
* New joinee experience and feedback up to six months.
* Early attrition monitoring and improvement.
* Timely completion of PMS activities.
* Employee pulse survey completion and action-plan closure.
* TNI completion and execution of planned training programmes.
* Training participation and effectiveness.
* Accuracy and timely reporting of HR data.

What We Expect

* Strong ownership of recruitment and employee experience processes from start to finish.
* Ability to work independently and manage responsibilities without constant follow-ups.
* Should own the process, not just coordinate activities.
* Speed, quality and discipline in execution.
* Ability to work closely with managers and employees across departments.
* Strong communication and follow-up skills.
* A proactive approach to identifying gaps and implementing improvements.
* Accountability for outcomes, timelines and process effectiveness.

Additional Preferences

* Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period are preferred.
* Candidates from reputed or top-tier colleges are encouraged to apply.

* Team player with strong organization skills and an ability to act with speed in a complex environment

title: Technical Enablement Specialist
description:
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a technically strong and business-oriented
**Technical Enablement Specialist**
with experience in Graph Database technologies, Data Engineering, and technical product enablement.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of graph database concepts, data modeling, query development, database architecture, and technical troubleshooting. Experience with platforms such as
**Neo4j**
,
**TigerGraph**
,
**AWS Neptune**
, or other graph database technologies is highly preferred.
  
  
In this role, you will develop deep expertise in the TigerGraph platform—understanding its architecture, functionalities, product capabilities, and new feature releases—and translate this knowledge into effective technical and business-oriented training programs. You will work closely with Sales, Presales, Product, Engineering, Delivery, Developers, and Clients to enable stakeholders to understand, position, implement, and leverage TigerGraph solutions effectively.
  
  
We seek someone who seamlessly combines hands-on technical expertise with strong communication, presentation skills, stakeholder management, and business acumen.
  
  
**Requirements**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Graph Database & Technical Expertise
  
  

* Graph & Data Engineering: Demonstrate a strong understanding of graph database concepts, architecture, data modeling, graph traversal, and graph analytics using technologies like Neo4j, TigerGraph, or AWS Neptune.
* Query & Performance Optimization: Utilize query languages (e.g., GSQL, Cypher, Gremlin) while demonstrating a strong grasp of database performance, query optimization, data integration, and distributed systems.
* TigerGraph Mastery: Develop hands-on expertise in TigerGraph products, architecture, capabilities, and ecosystems. Analyze new product releases and updates to translate them into practical learning modules.
* Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis: Independently investigate, troubleshoot, and identify root causes for technical issues, performance bottlenecks, query failures, and configuration challenges in graph implementations.
* Product & Engineering Collaboration: Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to understand technical defects, enhancements, and product behaviors.
* Documentation & Knowledge Base: Create technical FAQs, troubleshooting guides, knowledge repositories, and best-practice documentation.

Technical Training & Enablement
  
  

* Program Design & Delivery: Design, develop, and deliver structured technical training programs, workshops, product demonstrations, and hands-on technical bootcamps on TigerGraph products and graph technologies.
* Multi-Stakeholder Enablement: Tailor enablement programs for diverse internal and external groups:

+ Sales & Presales: Product capabilities, business value, competitive positioning, use cases, and solution demos.
+ Product Teams: Product architecture, new features, functionality, enhancements, and technical dependencies.
+ Developers & Engineering: Graph modeling, query development, implementation, debugging, integrations, and best practices.
+ Clients & External Stakeholders: Product onboarding, solution understanding, technical adoption, and implementation guidance.

* Content & Assessment Creation: Develop engaging training presentations, technical documentation, practical assignments, hands-on lab environments, assessments, and product demo materials.
* Gap Analysis: Continuously evaluate training effectiveness and identify capability gaps across teams to refine enablement strategies.
