title: Franchise Development Manager
description:
**Company:**
the EleFant

**Location:**
Ahmedabad

**Department:**
Franchise Development & Business Expansion

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
5–10 years

**Reporting to:**
Chief Revenue Officer / Head of Business Development

**About the EleFant**

At the EleFant, we're on a mission to change the way India interacts with toys.

We are building a technology-led toy and book library that gives children access to a wide range of toys, books and play experiences through convenient memberships, with doorstep delivery and exchanges.

Featured on Shark Tank India, the EleFant is expanding its presence across the country through a unique
**FICO (Franchise Invested, Company Operated)**
model.

Under this model, franchise partners invest in the business infrastructure, while the EleFant manages operations, technology, customer acquisition and service delivery as defined in the franchise agreement.

We are looking for an ambitious Franchise Development Manager who can accelerate our expansion by bringing the right investors and business partners into the EleFant ecosystem.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**high-energy, commercially strong Franchise Development Manager**
who can take ownership of franchise acquisition, investor engagement and deal closures.

This is a revenue-generating role requiring strong relationship-building, consultative selling, negotiation and business development skills.

The ideal candidate understands how to sell a business opportunity, not just a product.

**Your success will be measured by the number, quality and value of franchise partnerships you close.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Franchise Sales & Revenue Ownership**

* Own monthly, quarterly and annual franchise acquisition targets.
* Generate and convert qualified franchise investor leads.
* Independently manage the entire franchise sales cycle from initial enquiry to agreement execution and payment collection.
* Present the EleFant's FICO model, business proposition, financial structure and commercial opportunity to prospective investors.
* Conduct investor meetings, online presentations and detailed commercial discussions.
* Handle objections related to investment structure, business performance, returns, operational responsibility and risk.
* Negotiate commercial terms within approved company guidelines.
* Ensure timely closures and collection of franchise investment commitments.

**2. Investor Lead Generation & Channel Development**

* Identify HNIs, business owners, professionals, family offices and potential franchise investors.
* Build relationships with franchise consultants, wealth advisers, business networks and referral partners.
* Develop investor acquisition channels through LinkedIn, BNI, business associations, networking events and other relevant platforms.
* Build partnerships with brokers and intermediaries who can refer qualified franchise investors.
* Generate opportunities through existing franchise-partner referrals.
* Work closely with Marketing to improve campaign quality, targeting and lead conversion.
* Build a sustainable pipeline rather than relying only on inbound leads.

**3. Franchise Investor Relationship Management**

* Understand each prospective investor's financial capacity, expectations, investment horizon and preferred geography.
* Develop trust through transparent and professional communication.
* Explain franchise investment terms, contractual responsibilities, commercial assumptions and associated risks accurately.
* Conduct structured follow-ups and move prospects through the sales funnel.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective franchise partners.
* Identify opportunities for additional investments and territory expansion among existing partners.
* Coordinate with senior management on strategic or high-value investment opportunities.

**4. Franchise Sales Process & CRM Management**

* Maintain complete and accurate investor information in the CRM.
* Track lead sources, qualification, meetings, proposals, negotiations and closures.
* Ensure disciplined follow-ups with every qualified prospect.
* Maintain visibility over high-intent, documentation-pending and payment-pending opportunities.
* Build reliable weekly and monthly closure forecasts.
* Identify bottlenecks and take proactive steps to improve conversion rates.
* Share actionable market feedback to improve franchise pitches and sales materials.

**5. Coordination & Deal Execution**

* Coordinate with Finance, Legal and Operations for franchise agreement execution.
* Ensure complete investor documentation and adherence to internal approval processes.
* Work with the onboarding team for smooth handover after commercial closure.
* Ensure franchise partners receive accurate information regarding their rights, obligations and investment terms.
* Support compliance with applicable internal policies and legal requirements.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5–10 years of experience in franchise development, business development, investment sales or high-ticket consultative selling.
* Proven track record of independently closing franchise or business investment deals.
* Experience selling franchise opportunities, commercial assets, business partnerships or other high-value propositions.
* Strong network among business owners, HNIs, franchise consultants and professional communities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-management skills.
* Ability to understand and explain commercial structures, business economics and contractual terms.
* Strong follow-up discipline and ability to manage longer sales cycles.
* Comfortable with CRM systems, spreadsheets and pipeline management.
* Willingness to travel for investor meetings, networking events and business expansion.
* Proficiency in English and Hindi; Gujarati or other regional languages would be an advantage.

**Preferred industry experience:**
Franchise consulting, organized retail, consumer services, investment-led franchise businesses, education franchises, hospitality, wealth distribution or high-ticket B2B sales.

**Who Will Be a Great Fit?**

We are looking for someone who:

* Has the confidence to speak with investors committing significant capital.
* Can develop their own network instead of depending entirely on company leads.
* Understands that franchise selling is about trust, business fundamentals and long-term relationships.
* Has strong commercial judgment and the ability to close deals.
* Is persistent without being pushy.
* Takes complete ownership of targets and commitments.
* Can work independently and thrive in a growing startup.
* Knows how to identify serious investors and avoid wasting time on unqualified prospects.
* Believes in transparent selling and building relationships beyond the first transaction.

**Why Join the EleFant?**

* Be part of a growing consumer brand transforming how children access toys and play experiences.
* Help expand a differentiated FICO franchise model across India.
* Work closely with the company's revenue and leadership teams.
* Take ownership of significant commercial opportunities.
* Build a nationwide investor and franchise-partner network.
* Grow into larger franchise expansion and business development leadership roles.
* Work in a performance-driven environment with opportunities for professional growth.

**Compensation**

**Competitive fixed salary + performance-linked incentives**
, aligned to franchise closures and realized investment collections.

Compensation will depend on relevant experience, demonstrated track record and commercial capabilities.

**Apply Now**

If you have experience closing franchise deals, enjoy working with investors and have the hunger to build a strong nationwide franchise network, we'd love to hear from you.

title: SAP SD / SAP PS
description:

title: GDS Microsoft Frontier Innovation Solution Manager-Associate Director
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Title:**
GDS Microsoft Frontier Innovation Solution Manager - Associate Director - India
  
  
Alliance: Microsoft
  
  
**Competency**
: Microsoft Frontier Innovation
  
  
**Function**
: GDS ES Growth & Innovation
  
  
**Skill Level:**
High
  
  
**Sub Function:**
GDS Alliances Partner Ops CoE
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Microsoft Alliance is one of EY’s most strategic ecosystem relationships, focused on helping clients accelerate transformation through cloud, data, AI, automation and emerging technologies. The Frontier Innovation team plays a critical role in bringing together EY’s industry expertise and Microsoft’s technology capabilities to develop scalable, market-leading solutions.
  
  
We are looking for a highly motivated and collaborative Solution Manager to join the Microsoft Alliance Frontier Innovation team. In this role, you will help shape, develop and scale innovative solutions that address real business challenges for clients while creating new growth opportunities for EY and Microsoft. The role combines solution management, program execution, stakeholder engagement, portfolio governance and go-to-market activation.
  
  
You will work with a diverse group of stakeholders across EY Service Lines, Industries, Global Delivery Services, Alliance Leadership, Sales, Marketing and Microsoft teams to transform ideas into impactful solutions that can be adopted globally.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of innovation, technology, alliances and business growth.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Lead Solution Development and Portfolio Management**
You will play a central role in managing solution roadmaps and supporting teams throughout the development and commercialization lifecycle, ensuring alignment with strategic alliance priorities and measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**Key responsibilities include:**

* Manage solution roadmaps and ensure alignment with Microsoft Alliance strategic priorities.
* Support solution teams throughout the development, readiness and commercialization lifecycle.
* Drive governance processes that enable visibility, accountability, prioritization and decision-making.
* Track portfolio performance, progress against milestones, risks, dependencies and business outcomes.
* Help identify opportunities for investment, prioritization, acceleration and solution expansion.
* Success in this area means translating promising ideas into scalable solutions that create measurable value for EY, Microsoft and clients.

**Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration**
The Solution Manager acts as a connector across teams, helping align priorities, manage dependencies and maintain momentum across a complex global stakeholder network.
  
  
You will:
  
  

* Partner with Global Alliance leaders, Service Line leaders, Industry teams and Microsoft stakeholders.
* Facilitate alignment between business, technology, sales, delivery, alliance and marketing teams.
* Coordinate solution review sessions, governance forums, working groups and leadership updates.
* Proactively identify risks, dependencies and opportunities for collaboration.
* Build trusted relationships across a global, matrixed stakeholder environment.

**Support Innovation and Frontier Innovation Programs**
**You will:**

* Help facilitate ideation workshops, solution incubation activities and Frontier Innovation planning sessions.
* Support proof-of-concept initiatives, pilot programs and Client Zero engagements.
* Work with subject matter professionals to evaluate business cases, solution viability and market relevance.
* Help accelerate the transition from concept to market-ready offering.
* Contribute to the continuous evolution of EY’s Frontier Innovation operating model.

This role provides exposure to emerging technologies, including AI, cloud platforms, automation and next-generation business solutions.
  
  
**Enable Go-To-Market Success**
Developing strong solutions is only part of the journey; enabling market activation, adoption and measurable growth is equally important.
  
  
**You will:**

* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Alliance teams and Solution Owners on activation plans.
* Coordinate development of solution collateral, demos, case studies, enablement content and marketplace assets.
* Support readiness and enablement activities for client-facing and business development teams.
* Track adoption, pipeline contribution, commercialization progress and related performance metrics.
* Contribute to co-sell initiatives and strategic growth programs with Microsoft.

**Deliver Insight Through Governance and Reporting**
**Responsibilities include:**

* Prepare executive reporting, leadership updates and portfolio dashboards.
* Monitor key metrics related to solution maturity, activation, adoption, funding and business impact.
* Support business reviews, governance meetings and leadership decision forums.
* Maintain reporting accuracy, governance discipline and compliance with agreed operating standards.
* Provide insights and recommendations that support prioritization, investment decisions and strategic growth.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
We are looking for someone who brings a balance of strategic thinking, execution excellence, and relationship-building capabilities.
  
  

* Thrive in fast-paced, evolving and ambiguous environments.
* Enjoy turning ideas into tangible plans, outputs and measurable outcomes.
* Are comfortable managing multiple priorities, deadlines and stakeholder groups in parallel.
* Can influence outcomes without direct authority.
* Have a passion for innovation, technology, alliances and business transformation.
* Bring strong organizational, communication, governance and program management skills.
* Have a continuous improvement mindset, with a focus on simplifying, automating and scaling ways of working.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 15+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Experience in program management, product management, solution management, consulting, technology transformation, innovation management or alliances.
* Proven experience working across complex, global and matrixed stakeholder environments.
* Strong communication, governance, project management and executive reporting capabilities.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives with clear outcomes, measurable impact and disciplined follow-through.

**What We Look For**

* We are looking for individuals who are curious, collaborative and passionate about innovation. The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys connecting strategy with execution, can navigate ambiguity and is energized by working with diverse teams to create meaningful business outcomes.
* This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to one of EY’s most important alliance ecosystems while helping shape innovative solutions that drive growth, transformation and long-term client value.

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic global delivery network that plays a vital role in advancing EY’s growth strategy. Working across locations including Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK, GDS teams collaborate with EY service lines, geographies and sectors to deliver high-quality work for clients around the world. In GDS, you will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects, collaborate with diverse teams and build capabilities across an expanding ecosystem of people, learning, technology and insights that support long-term career growth.
  
  

* Continuous learning: Develop the mindset, skills and confidence to adapt, grow and navigate what comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: Access the tools, flexibility and support to make a meaningful impact in the way that works best for you.
* Transformative leadership: Gain insights, coaching and experiences that help you grow into the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: Be valued for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:

**Digital Marketing Manager**

Working closely with sales, product and global marketing teams, the Marketing Manager will play a critical role in accelerating business growth and strengthening HID’s market position in the market.
  
  
**Who are we?**
HID powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely. We are a high-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,000 worldwide employees. Check us out: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo
  
  
LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/hidglobal/mycompany/
  
  
**About HID Global, Bangalore**
At HID Global, we are a bunch of passionate Engineers working on a product that helps integrating multiple physical access controls and logical access systems for Identities. Our product provides a common way of provisioning cards and access to identities across the organisation. We work on exciting integration and design problems using latest Microsoft Technologies in an inclusive environment. It is a great place to make a career, learn and have fun.We develop best-in-class access control and authentication solutions that help governments and organizations stay ahead of an ever-changing threat landscape. Most of our products are supported on both on premise and cloud environments. Our products protect more than 85 million user identities and issued more than 50 million credentials to date.
  
  
It is a great place to become security domain expert and work on latest technologies.
  
  
Physical Access Control Solutions (PACS)
  
  
**HID's Physical Access Control Solutions Business Area:**
HID PACS, located in multiple development locations across the world, is recognized as the global leader in the design, manufacture, and supply of access control security technology. HID Global, the provider of trusted identities to the world's people, places and things. A leader in the commercial security industry, this established company designs and manufactures physical access control systems.
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities include the following.**
Other duties may be assigned.
  
  

* Develop and execute the marketing strategy and plan for India, aligning marketing initiatives with business objectives – driving market engagement through a mix of digital marketing, events, channel partner programs, public relations, thought leadership and customer-facing activities.
* Develop and execute digital-first marketing programs that drive awareness, lead generation, pipeline creation and revenue growth.
* Manage and optimize multi-channel campaigns across paid social, digital advertising, content syndication, email marketing and other demand generation channels.
* Analyze campaign performance and customer journey metrics to continuously improve marketing effectiveness, conversion rates and return on investment.
* Support broader regional marketing activities, ensuring consistent messaging, strong brand execution and effective engagement with customers, partners, key industry stakeholders and cross-functional internal audiences

**Education and/or Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communication, Business or a related field.
* 7+ years of B2B marketing experience
* 4+ years’ experience managing digital marketing and demand generation programs
* Demonstrated success driving growth through digital marketing programs
* Strong understanding of lead generation, customer journeys, marketing analytics and funnel performance
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders in a cross-functional environment
* Experience working with agencies and external vendors
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

**Advantageous Qualifications / Experience**

* Experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, Google Analytics, marketing automation platform(s) and CRM (Salesforce) systems.
* Experience in physical security, access control, multi-national enterprise organization, or a global agency
* Experience supporting regional or global marketing programs
* Experience in global channel and partner marketing

**Why apply?**

* Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
* Innovation: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part-time job seekers.
* Integrity: You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted.

This opportunity may be open to flexible working arrangements.
  
  
HID is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – Minority/Female/Disability/Veteran/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation.
  
  
**We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!**
On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.
  
  
When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
## About the Role

Own utilisation of a distributed rental inventory network through performance and retention marketing. Every SKU is a depreciating asset — idle inventory is a cost, not a missed sale. ROAS and CAC are levers, not the goal.

The Weekly Loop: Read → Diagnose → Act → Review

Read the utilisation report every week (by SKU × city)

Diagnose: visibility, budget, catalogue, retention, or genuinely low demand?

Act: pull the right lever across Google, Meta, catalogue, or lifecycle

Review the following week; iterate

## Key Responsibilities

- Read the utilisation report every week (by SKU × city)

- Diagnose visibility, budget, catalogue, retention, or genuinely low demand

- Act by pulling the right lever across Google, Meta, catalogue, or lifecycle

- Review the following week and iterate

## Requirements

- 1–4 years hands-on running Google Ads and Meta Ads

- Comfortable reading data weekly and drawing own conclusions

- Real diagnostic instinct — knows which lever to pull and when

## Preferred Qualifications

- Not a fit if instinct is “spend more, ROAS good” without asking why

- Not a fit if wants brand/creative work more than performance and data

- Not a fit if SKU × city-level granularity sounds like too much detail

## What We Offer

- Free access to entire rental catalogue

- Health insurance

- Flexible working hours

- Direct mentorship from Demand Gen Lead

- Real autonomy from day one

## Location & Work Mode

- Bangalore, onsite

title: B2B Marketing Executive
description:
**About HerKey**

HerKey is India’s largest AI-powered platform to unlock women’s work-life aspirations. We are a mission-driven organization focused on enabling women to build meaningful careers through employment opportunities, learning, and professional communities. We partner with organizations to advance diversity, equity, and inclusion while helping businesses connect with relevant talent and marketing opportunities.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented
**B2B Marketing Executive**

to manage CRM operations, execute B2B email marketing campaigns, drive outbound lead generation, and support demand generation initiatives.

The role will provide hands-on experience in CRM management, email campaign execution, database research, lead segmentation, reporting, and AI-powered marketing, including AI-powered content creation and no-code automation tools.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**
**1. CRM Management – Zoho CRM**

* Manage lead uploads, database maintenance, account creation, and CRM data hygiene in Zoho CRM.
* Handle CRM requests, including account additions, removals, record updates, and lead management.
* Create and maintain CRM workflows to streamline lead management and internal processes.
* Troubleshoot CRM-related issues and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to resolve them.
* Ensure accurate and up-to-date lead and account information for sales and marketing activities.

**2. B2B Email Marketing – Zoho Campaigns**

* Create, schedule, and execute targeted B2B email marketing campaigns using Zoho Campaigns.
* Develop B2B email content and campaign copies using AI-powered tools such as Claude, ChatGPT.
* Manage audience segmentation, database transfers from Zoho CRM, and campaign targeting.
* Plan follow-up campaigns for email openers, clickers, and other relevant audience segments using AI.
* Monitor campaign performance, including delivery rates, open rates, click-through rates, and lead conversions, and recommend improvements.

**3. Landing Pages and Lead Capture**

* Create and manage landing pages for B2B outreach campaigns using no-code tools such as Lovable.
* Develop Google Forms for lead collection, event registrations, and other marketing requirements.
* Coordinate landing page updates, form integrations, and lead capture requirements.
* Ensure landing pages and forms support effective lead generation and accurate data collection.

**4. Outbound Lead Generation and Database Research**

* Research target companies, identify relevant business opportunities, and build prospect databases for the sales team.
* Identify organizations with active hiring requirements and relevant hiring signals to support targeted outreach.
* Build and enrich contact databases using tools such as Lusha and other relevant research platforms.
* Maintain accurate inbound and outbound lead databases and ensure timely lead handover to the sales team.

**5. Lead Assignment and Sales Coordination**

* Assign relevant inbound, outbound, and campaign-generated leads to the appropriate sales team members.
* Ensure timely lead distribution and maintain accurate lead assignment records.
* Coordinate with the sales team to track lead status, follow-ups, and conversions.
* Handle corporate queries received through designated communication channels and route relevant business enquiries to the appropriate sales stakeholders.

**6. Reporting and Performance Tracking**

* Prepare weekly reports for business and management reviews, along with quarterly and annual performance reports.
* Track inbound and outbound lead generation, campaign performance, and lead conversion metrics.
* Consolidate CRM, email marketing, and event performance data into actionable reports.
* Maintain accurate campaign records and share performance updates with relevant stakeholders.
* Identify trends and opportunities to improve lead generation, engagement, and campaign effectiveness.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
* **2-3 years of experience in B2B marketing, demand generation, email marketing, marketing operations, or lead generation.**
* **Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, preferably Zoho CRM, and email marketing tools such as Zoho Campaigns.**
* Experience in B2B database research, lead generation, audience segmentation, and contact enrichment.
* Working knowledge of email campaign metrics, lead tracking, and marketing performance reporting.
* Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for database management, analysis, and reporting.
* Strong written communication skills for B2B email campaigns, outreach, and stakeholder coordination.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns, maintain data accuracy, and meet deadlines.
* **Experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for marketing content creation.**
* Familiarity with Lusha or similar B2B contact enrichment tools.
* Basic understanding of campaign analytics, workflow integrations, and lead lifecycle management.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management.
* Ownership of campaign execution and timelines.
* Process orientation and an automation-first mindset.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating across teams.

title: Social Media Marketing Specialist
description:
**Techademy**
is an edtech company helping working professionals build careers in project management, AI and product roles. Our programs include PMP certification, AI for Project Managers, Agentic AI, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Product Transition and programs with IIT Patna. We reach learners through free masterclasses and paid courses across India, APAC, the Middle East and the US.

**About the role**

We’re looking for a
**Social Media Executive**
to own Techademy’s day-to-day presence on social media. You’ll plan and publish content, grow our community, and turn followers into masterclass registrations and course leads. You’ll work closely with our content writer, graphic designer and paid marketing team.

**Key responsibilities**

* Plan and run a monthly content calendar across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and X, aligned to course launches and masterclass schedules.
* Write captions, post copy, carousel scripts and short video scripts, working with Aditi (content) on long-form ideas and Saikat (design) on creatives.
* Publish and schedule posts, Reels, Shorts and LinkedIn content consistently.
* Promote upcoming masterclasses and webinars on social to drive registrations.
* Manage comments, DMs and community conversations, and route sales enquiries to the sales team quickly.
* Repurpose masterclass recordings, learner testimonials and expert sessions into short-form clips and posts.
* Track trends in AI, project management and careers, and turn them into timely content.
* Coordinate with Bala (paid marketing) so organic and paid campaigns share messaging and creatives.
* Track and report weekly and monthly performance: reach, engagement, follower growth, link clicks and leads from social.
* Support employer branding and learner success stories on LinkedIn.

**What we’re looking for**

* 1 to 3 years of hands-on social media experience, ideally in edtech, B2C or a digital agency.
* Strong written English, with a clear and professional tone suited to working professionals.
* Good understanding of LinkedIn and Instagram algorithms, formats and best practices.
* Basic video editing skills for Reels and Shorts (CapCut, InShot, Canva or similar).
* Comfort with scheduling and analytics tools (Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn analytics, Buffer, Hootsuite or similar).
* Organised, reliable and able to manage several posts and campaigns at once.
* Curiosity about AI, tech and careers.

**Good to have**

* Experience promoting webinars, events or online courses.
* Basic knowledge of Canva or Figma for quick creative edits.
* Experience creating content for international audiences (APAC, Middle East, US).
* Familiarity with UTM tracking and Google Analytics.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Hermix's is a Bangalore-based creative marketing agency specializing in content, branding, and performance marketing for digital-first brands. The agency partners with businesses across fashion, fitness, interiors, retail, wellness, and lifestyle sectors to strengthen online presence and drive measurable growth. By blending creative storytelling with strategic, performance-driven campaigns, Hermix's helps brands reach the right audiences and achieve lasting impact. The team focuses on building memorable, audience-centric brands rather than just increasing visibility, offering a dynamic environment for marketing professionals. Joining Hermix's means contributing to innovative campaigns and working closely with diverse clients in the lifestyle and consumer space.
  
**Role Description**
The Social Media Manager is responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing social media campaigns across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and emerging channels. This full-time, on-site role in Bengaluru involves creating content calendars, coordinating with design and content teams, and ensuring brand consistency across all social touchpoints. Day-to-day tasks include writing and reviewing posts, managing community engagement, responding to comments and messages, and monitoring trends to inform content and strategy. The Social Media Manager will analyze performance metrics, prepare reports, and recommend data-driven improvements to enhance reach, engagement, and conversions. The role also includes collaborating with clients and internal stakeholders, overseeing social media promotions, and staying updated on best practices in social media marketing.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Social Media Marketing and Social Media Optimization (SMO) to plan, execute, and refine campaigns across major platforms.
* Candidates should possess solid Communication and Writing skills to craft clear, engaging, and brand-aligned content and interact effectively with clients and audiences.
* Candidates should possess expertise in Content Strategy to develop effective social media calendars, align content with business goals, and adapt messaging to different audiences.
* Candidates should possess familiarity with analytics tools (e.g., Meta Business Suite, Instagram Insights, Google Analytics) and be comfortable interpreting data to drive decisions.
* Candidates should possess strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment.
* A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Media Studies, or a related field is preferred; previous agency or brand-side social media experience is an advantage.
* Candidates should possess awareness of current social media trends, influencer marketing practices, and platform-specific best practices.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**About the Role:**

Silvermine Group is building an integrated platform of digital services that simplify regulatory compliance and business operations for the U.S. trucking industry.

We're looking for an experienced, hands-on Product Marketing Manager to own product positioning, go-to-market execution, and customer adoption across our growing portfolio of specialized digital services. The ideal candidate has direct experience marketing specialized services or digital products to U.S. consumers and small businesses, particularly in industries where customers must navigate complex processes, regulatory requirements, or recurring service needs.

This role combines strategic product marketing with hands-on campaign execution, customer segmentation, conversion optimization, and cross-functional collaboration.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Product Marketing & Go-to-Market**

* Own product positioning, value propositions, messaging, and go-to-market strategies across multiple products.
* Plan and execute product launches, promotional campaigns, and feature rollouts in collaboration with Marketing, Product, and Engineering.
* Translate complex services, regulatory requirements, and product features into clear, compelling customer benefits.
* Develop segment-specific messaging and campaigns for customer acquisition, retention, cross-selling, and upselling.
* Identify market opportunities, customer needs, competitive advantages, and conversion barrie
* Campaign Execution & Product Adoption
* Own promotional campaigns across Truckopedia's websites, customer dashboards, and other digital touchpoints.
* Develop targeted cross-product campaigns using customer data, purchase history, lifecycle stages, and service requirements.
* Define campaign requirements, audience eligibility, targeting rules, and promotional placements with Product and Engineering.
* Partner with Performance Marketing, Content, and Design to develop and execute effective multichannel campaigns.
* Analyze campaign performance, customer journeys, and conversion funnels to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Establish measurable campaign objectives, reporting, and ongoing optimization processes.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIRED SKILLS:**

* 5–8 years of relevant marketing experience, including significant ownership of product marketing, go-to-market strategy, and digital campaign execution.
* Direct experience marketing products or services to U.S. customers, with a strong understanding of American consumer behavior, business audiences, and digital purchasing journeys.
* Experience with specialized, transaction-based, or recurring services, preferably in one or more of the following:

 Tax preparation, filing, or regulatory compliance services.

 Financial services, insurance, or business services.

 Business registration, licensing, or professional services.

 Specialized B2B/B2C digital platforms/SaaS solutions serving US consumers & SMBs

* Demonstrated success launching and marketing at least two distinct products or services, with measurable acquisition, conversion, revenue, or adoption results.
* Proven experience developing customer segmentation, targeted promotions, cross-sell/upsell campaigns, and conversion optimization strategies.
* Strong analytical skills and experience using campaign performance data, customer insights, and funnel metrics to improve results.
* Ability to translate marketing objectives into clear functional requirements for Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams.
* Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to develop and evaluate customer-facing messaging for U.S. audiences.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.

**Preferred Experience**

* Marketing multiple related products or services to an overlapping customer base.
* Working with U.S.-based service companies, particularly those offering regulated, deadline-driven, or specialized services.
* Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, marketing automation

**PERKS OF JOINING:**

**The Culture: most companies talk about their values, we live them.**

* **Supportive Culture:**
  We value teamwork, mentorship, and professional development, and we show it by providing top-notch employee experience and training programs, and incentivizing team growth.
* **Work-Life Balance:**
  We support a hybrid work model and encourage our employees to create a healthy balance between personal and professional life.
* **A Voice at the Table:**
  Influence major decisions in marketing, product strategy, and user experience.
* **Innovative Work:**
  Contribute to cutting-edge solutions for e-commerce and SaaS businesses.
* **The Work:**
  stability of a market leader with the hunger for innovation and growth of a start-up
* **Impactful & Broad Role:**
  You will have a seat at the table when it comes to key management decisions, drive critical marketing strategy and decisions, and have a voice in key product and user experience decisions.
* **Growth Opportunities:**
  Learn and grow from market veterans, take advantage of a fast-paced, collaborative environment, and enjoy the ability to move up the ladder when you earn it.
* **Competitive Benefits:**
  Access comprehensive insurance for health (incl. parents), life and personal accident.

**ABOUT SILVERMINE GROUP:**

Silvermine Group is the largest & most trusted provider of regulatory compliance services for the heavy trucking and transportation industries. Our compliance automation platform is secure, cloud-based, and certified by the IRS - helping over 100,000 customers every year file federally required documents - such as IRS Form 2290, Form 8849, and MCS-150 - accurately, securely, and on time. Our technology, highly skilled customer support, and relentless focus on product improvement and growth ensures that our customers’ equipment stays on the road and their businesses keep humming.

Website: Silvermine

Group Products: eform2290, emcs150.com, eUCR, eIFTA, Club FR8

title: Field Marketing Manager
description:
**Are you ready to unlock intelligence?**
If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.
  
  
**Build Kong’s India marketing engine from the ground up.**
**About The Role**
Kong is the AI connectivity company. We help engineering teams manage, secure, and scale the APIs and AI traffic that power modern businesses.
  
  
India represents a significant growth opportunity for Kong. We’re looking for a Field Marketing Manager to build our marketing presence in the market from the ground up—turning strategic priorities into programs that create demand, accelerate pipeline, and establish Kong as a leader in API and AI connectivity.
  
  
This is a builder’s role. There’s no established playbook, inherited marketing engine, or existing team to lean on. You’ll have the ownership to define the strategy, make the bets, build the programs, and prove what works.
  
  
You’ll partner closely with Sales, global marketing, and channel partners to bring Kong’s story to India’s enterprise technology leaders. You’ll be expected to think strategically, execute hands-on, and connect every marketing investment to measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**Your mission: build a repeatable, scalable marketing engine that drives growth for Kong in India.**
**What You’ll Do**
Own the India marketing strategy
  
  

* Define the regional marketing strategy, priorities, and investment plan in alignment with India Sales and global marketing.
* Identify the industries, enterprise accounts, and buyer segments with the greatest growth potential.
* Turn market insights into focused programs that generate pipeline and accelerate revenue.
* Make deliberate choices about where to invest—and where not to.

Build and execute account-based marketing
  
  

* Partner with Sales to develop and prioritize target account lists, buying groups, and account-specific growth strategies.
* Design and execute ABM programs that engage decision-makers, build buying-group awareness, and create opportunities within strategic accounts.
* Coordinate campaigns, executive engagement, content, and field activities around account priorities.
* Measure account engagement, opportunity creation, pipeline influence, and progression through the sales cycle.

Create demand that converts
  
  

* Build integrated demand generation programs across digital, content, email, events, and partner channels.
* Translate Kong’s global messaging into locally relevant campaigns that resonate with India’s enterprise technology buyers.
* Work with Sales to define lead qualification, routing, follow-up SLAs, and conversion targets.
* Continuously optimize programs based on pipeline contribution, conversion rates, and cost efficiency.

Build the India events engine
  
  

* Develop an events strategy spanning executive roundtables, technical workshops, webinars, industry conferences, and flagship experiences.
* Create programs that bring together engineering leaders, enterprise decision-makers, developers, and strategic customers.
* Own event planning, audience acquisition, execution, follow-up, and performance measurement.
* Build a repeatable events model that prioritizes meaningful engagement and commercial outcomes over attendance numbers alone.

Turn partnerships into growth
  
  

* Work with channel and technology partners to develop joint demand generation and co-marketing programs.
* Equip partners with localized content, campaigns, event resources, and sales enablement.
* Identify opportunities to extend Kong’s reach through strategic ecosystems and industry relationships.

Establish Kong’s presence in India
  
  

* Adapt global brand campaigns and content for local market needs while maintaining consistency with Kong’s positioning.
* Build relationships with relevant industry communities, technology leaders, and enterprise decision-makers.
* Develop programs that strengthen awareness, credibility, and consideration among Kong’s target audiences.

Own the budget and prove impact
  
  

* Manage the India field marketing budget, allocating investment against clear business priorities.
* Establish dashboards and reporting that connect marketing activity to qualified pipeline, opportunity progression, and revenue outcomes.
* Share performance transparently, including what worked, what didn’t, and what should change.
* Build a continuous improvement culture grounded in data, experimentation, and accountability.

**What You’ll Bring**

* A builder’s mindset. You’ve built a marketing function, regional program, or demand engine from scratch—not just operated an established one.
* B2B technology marketing experience. You understand how to market complex technology solutions to enterprise buyers and translate technical value into business impact.
* Strong ABM and demand generation expertise. You know how to prioritize accounts, engage buying groups, generate demand, and build programs that contribute to pipeline.
* A track record in high-growth environments. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities, limited resources, and the need to move quickly.
* Cross-functional leadership. You can align Sales, global marketing, partners, and regional stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* Events that deliver results. You know how to design experiences that build relationships, create opportunities, and justify the investment.
* Commercial and analytical rigor. You understand pipeline metrics, conversion rates, campaign performance, and marketing efficiency—and know how to act on the data.
* Deep knowledge of India’s enterprise technology landscape. You understand the accounts, industries, buying dynamics, and ecosystems that matter.
* Clear, adaptable communication. You can build credibility with engineers, executives, sales teams, and marketing leaders alike.

**What Will Set You Apart**

* Experience marketing APIs, cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, cybersecurity, or AI technologies.
* Experience building channel marketing or partner-led demand generation programs.
* Established relationships across India’s enterprise technology, financial services, or global capability center (GCC) ecosystem.
* Experience working in a global, matrixed organization while building programs tailored to a regional market.

**About Kong**
Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

title: Influencer Marketing Specialist
description:
**About Us**

: Strategic Brand Solutions, based in Mumbai, is a leading player in the Indian influencer landscape, collaborating with premium brands and influencers to deliver exceptional results. Now a part of
**YKONE**

title: Social Media Manager
description:
**Okay Done**
is a digital marketing agency with a diverse clientele, such as Royal Challengers Bengaluru, OnePlus, VRL, Google, Bengaluru City Police, Heineken, and Health Care Global to name a few. We work across various industries, including sports, consumer, hospitality, luxury, F&B, real estate, and D2C.

**Before you scroll further, a fair warning.**

We get hundreds of applications. Most of them are from people who skimmed this page, pasted a resume, and hoped for the best. They never hear back.

Low-effort applications will never be considered. One-line answers, ChatGPT-sounding responses, and "please refer to my resume" will not be considered.

Read every word of this JD. If you're not 100% sure you want this job, close the tab. No hard feelings.

If you are, this application takes about 5 minutes. Right after you apply, we email you a short assignment, due within 24 hours. That's your first week on the job. Show us how you'd run it.

**The role, in one line**

You run the pages. Every post that goes live, on time, on brand, and better than last month.

**Overview**

A brand's Instagram is its shopfront, and you're the one who keeps it open.

At Okay Done, our Content Strategists crack the ideas and write the copy. Our production team makes the content. You're the one who makes it all actually happen: planning what goes out and when, getting it made on time, publishing it, managing the community, and knowing exactly what's working.

You'll handle a set of brands end to end. When a trend breaks at 6pm, you're the first to spot it and the first to flag it. When a reel flops, you know why before anyone asks. When a client's page goes quiet, it's because you've never let it happen.

This is a full-time, in-office role in Bengaluru.

**What you'll do**

**Run the calendar**

• Build and own monthly content calendars for each brand, in line with the direction the Content Strategists set.

• Keep every deliverable on track, from brief to production to approval to publishing.

• Make sure nothing goes live late, off brand, or with a typo.

**Run the pages**

• Publish across Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and wherever the brand lives.

• Own stories, highlights, pinned posts, bios, and every small detail that makes a page feel alive.

• Manage the community: replies, DMs, comments, and the occasional angry customer.

**Stay on the pulse**

• Live on social. Spot trends, audios, and moments early, and flag them to the strategists while they're still fresh.

• Push for reactive content when a moment is right for a brand, and move fast when it is.

**Read the numbers**

• Track reach, engagement, saves, shares, and follower growth for every brand.

• Build monthly reports that explain why, not just what.

• Bring those learnings back to the strategists so the next month's ideas are sharper.

**Hold it all together**

• Work with Content Strategists, designers, editors, videographers, and Account Managers every day.

• Be the person everyone trusts to know exactly where every piece of content stands.

**Who we're looking for**

• 2+ years managing social media for brands, ideally at an agency. We care far more about how good you are than how long you've been doing it.

• You've run real brand pages, not just your personal account.

• You're organised to the point of being slightly annoying about it.

• You notice when a post is 2 pixels off, a caption has a double space, or a story is missing a link.

• You can look at insights and explain what happened and what to do next.

• You live online and know what's happening on the internet today, not last month.

• You can juggle multiple brands without dropping a single deliverable.

• Kannada is a plus.

We're not hiring someone who can do the job. We're hiring someone who'll make the job look easy.

**Why Okay Done**

• You'll run pages for brands people actually talk about.

• Shoots, sets, launches, and the occasional work trip to some of the finest resorts in the country.

• You work with strategists who bring you ideas worth posting, not generic filler.

• A clear path to Senior Social Media Manager and Group Head.

• A team that lives online, eats well, and roasts each other often. In that order.

title: Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
**Department:**
Marketing / Sales
  
  
**Reports To:**
Director of Marketing
  
  
**Employment Status:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Location**
: Embassy Tech Village Kadubeesanahalli, Bangalore 560103
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Marketing Operations Specialist supports the systems, data, reporting, automation, and processes used by the Marketing and Sales teams. This role helps administer Salesforce, HubSpot, and related platforms; maintains data quality; develops reporting; supports campaign operations; and improves workflows across the revenue process.
  
  
The position works with multiple stakeholders to troubleshoot system issues, document processes, support users, and implement practical technology and automation solutions that improve efficiency, visibility, and execution.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**

* Support the administration and optimization of Salesforce, HubSpot, and related marketing and sales platforms.
* Maintain system fields, workflows, permissions, lists, forms, campaigns, reports, and dashboards.
* Support integrations and data synchronization between approved business platforms.
* Build and maintain marketing, campaign, pipeline, attribution, and activity reporting.
* Monitor and improve data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and duplicate management.
* Translate business needs into system configurations, workflows, reports, and documented requirements.
* Troubleshoot system, reporting, integration, automation, and data-quality issues.
* Support campaign setup, lead routing, segmentation, tracking, and performance measurement.
* Develop practical automations using approved tools, artificial intelligence, APIs, or Python when appropriate.
* Test and document system changes before deployment.

title: Content Marketer (Social Media)
description:
**What's Ditto?**

Ditto’s mission is to help people make well-informed insurance decisions - from expert advisory and policy purchases to dedicated claim support. We pioneered the industry-first “No-spam” policy, and over the past five years, we’ve assisted over 700,000 users with personalized advice on health and term insurance. We carry a
**4.9 rating**
with
**32,000+ reviews on Google.**

Ditto is part of the Finshots family (500K+ subscribers) and is backed by Zerodha, India’s largest stockbroker. We won LinkedIn’s Top Startup award in both 2022 and 2023

**About the Role:**

We’re looking for someone who is unusually good at finding things worth talking about, and then writing about them well. Not someone who needs a content brief for every post.

A lot of the best content at Ditto doesn’t start with a brainstorm. It starts with a conversation with someone from claims, something a customer said, an interesting number buried in a sheet, a strong opinion someone on the team has, or something happening on the internet that makes us think,
*wait, there’s a Ditto angle here.*

Your job is to find those things.

You’ll spend a lot of time talking to people across Ditto, understanding how they think, asking better questions, doing your own research, and turning half-formed thoughts into sharp pieces of content.

A large part of the role will involve written social content, particularly LinkedIn and X. But we’re not looking for someone who just “writes posts”.

We want someone who can understand an idea, figure out what is actually interesting about it, develop a point of view and package it in a way people want to read.

Sometimes you’ll get a clear idea. Sometimes someone will give you three sentences and say, “There’s probably something here.” Sometimes you’ll have to find the story yourself.

That last one matters a lot.

**What you'll do**

* Own pieces of content end-to-end, from finding the idea to research, writing, feedback, publishing and eventually understanding how it performed.
* Speak to people across Ditto and pull interesting stories, opinions and observations out of conversations.
* Write extensively for LinkedIn and X.
* Take someone's rough thought, voice note or conversation and turn it into something that still sounds like them, not like generic internet content.
* Research topics properly before writing about them. We like strong opinions, but they need something underneath them.
* Build content around insurance, startups, business, customers, culture, work and whatever else our audience would genuinely find interesting.
* Repurpose one strong idea intelligently across formats instead of copy-pasting the same post everywhere.
* Work with designers and other members of the content team when an idea needs a visual, carousel or another format.
* Maintain your own content pipeline rather than waiting every morning to be told what to work on.
* Look at performance and gradually understand what works, what doesn't and why.
* Experiment. Some things will work. Some will bomb. Both are useful.

**You might be a good fit if**

* You can really write. This is the biggest one.
* You're naturally curious and ask follow-up questions instead of accepting the first obvious answer.
* You can tell when an idea has something interesting inside it, even if it hasn't been articulated properly yet.
* You can write in different voices without making everyone sound like the same copywriter.
* You read things outside your immediate job. Business, culture, creators, startups, Reddit rabbit holes, news, whatever.
* You have opinions, but you're also willing to change them when the research says otherwise.
* You're comfortable going to someone and saying, “You mentioned something interesting yesterday. Tell me more.”
* You don't think posting consistently is the same thing as doing good content marketing.
* You're comfortable taking ownership without having five approval layers around you.
* You know how to use AI, but you don't depend on it to do the thinking for you.

**What we'd love to see**

We're less interested in whether you've had the exact same job title before.

Show us things you've written or built.

It could be:

* A LinkedIn or X account you've worked on
* Your own writing
* A newsletter
* A brand account
* Threads/posts that performed well
* A side project
* Even a few pieces you're disproportionately proud of

And if you've grown an account before, we'd love to understand how you thought about it, not just the follower number.

The goal is simple:

Find things worth saying. Say them well. And make Ditto one of those brands people follow even when they're not actively looking to buy insurance.

**What’s In It for You?**

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive Health and Term Insurance
* The chance to shape the future of insurance education in India
* At Ditto, you’ll be part of a smart, ambitious, and supportive team. With our flat hierarchy, you’ll have the chance to collaborate closely with people across all levels from Day 1.

**Our Interview Process:**

We would like to help you minimise your time and effort. There are 4 rounds & we will be working towards completing all the rounds within a maximum of 2 weeks time.

**The schedule is as follows:**

1. First Interaction (HR Round)
2. Task or Assignment
3. Second Interaction (Technical Round)
4. Final Interaction

This is an in-office role. Our address is : Fortuna 1, 680, 8th Main Rd, near Delmia Cirlce, 14th Cross, 3rd Phase, J. P. Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560076.

***Please Note: Beware of recruitment scams. Ditto does not charge any fees for the hiring process. We’ve seen fraudulent hiring messages impersonating Ditto. Please read this notice for details and how to verify/report.***

title: Performance Marketing (Content) - Intern
description:
**Role : Intern - Performance Marketing (Content)**
**Location : Bangalore (Onsite)**
**Duration : 6 Months Internship (PPO / Full-time opportunity based on performance)**
**About Lokal :**
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren't really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they'd come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
  
  
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they've always deserved. We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:
  
  

* Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
* Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
* Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* Local Jobs - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
* Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
* Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
* Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
* Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we've built, they don't wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for. This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centere — access changes lives.
  
  
We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.
  
  
We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital
  
  
**About the role :**
We are looking for a hands-on Performance Marketing professional to manage end-to-end digital marketing—from running ads and creating content ideas to tracking and optimizing performance.
  
  
This is a high-ownership role where you will be responsible for results, not just execution. Training and guidance will be provided.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities :**

* For each app you work on, you'll study the audience, the market, and the competition - then write ads that get people to download and make that first purchase
* You decide the angle, the hook, the format, and the script - and you write it yourself
* You'll brief designers and video editors on your concepts and follow through until the output matches your intent
* You'll ship multiple creative variants per campaign (80-100 per week) - fast cycles, not one polished ad a week
* You run your own A/B tests, read the results, and decide what to try next
* You track what's working in each market and make sure the creative feels native to that audience

**Requirements**
**Must-Have**

* Knowledge in performance marketing content or growth marketing
* Hands-on exposure to Meta Ads & Google Ads campaigns
* Strong copywriting skills (English + regional language preferred)
* Understanding of performance metrics like CAC, ROAS, CPI, CTR
* Experience working with creative and video teams
* Data-driven mindset with strong analytical skills

**What We Offer :**

* End-to-end ownership of marketing
* Training and mentorship from leadership
* High learning curve with direct business impact
* Performance-based growth opportunities

**Why This Role Is Exciting :**

* You will directly drive growth through paid marketing and experiments
* You will own end-to-end performance—from ads to insights and optimization
* You will test, learn, and scale what works with real business impact
* High visibility with lead

description:
**About CMR Group**

The CMR Group of Institutions is a unique education conglomerate based in Bangalore, India, that offers a wide range of courses from the Montessori / Kindergarten level to Post Graduate and PhD programs. Founded in 1991 to meet the needs of local students, CMR Group currently comprises different brands of schools & colleges, namely, CMRIT Bangalore, Ekya Schools, CMRNPU Colleges & the CMR University, which was established in 2013.

The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable crafting compelling social media captions, developing SEO optimized blogs, writing thought leadership articles, and creating engaging copy for digital advertising campaigns. The role requires a writer who can adapt their writing style across platforms and audiences while maintaining the University's brand voice, editorial standards, and communication objectives.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Content Writing and Development:**

* Develop high-quality, original content for the University's website, blogs, newsletters, brochures, emailers, and other communication materials.
* Research and write informative, engaging articles on higher education, innovation, research, student life, and emerging industry trends.
* Translate complex academic and technical information into accessible, audience-friendly content.
* Proofread, edit, and refine content to ensure grammatical accuracy, clarity, consistency, and readability.

**Creative Copywriting and Digital Campaigns:**

* Develop compelling taglines, campaign headlines, and creative concepts for institutional branding and admissions campaigns.
* Write engaging social media captions, carousel copy, and video scripts for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
* Create persuasive Meta ad copy, including headlines, primary text, descriptions, and calls to action.
* Adapt messaging for different target audiences, including prospective students, parents, industry professionals, and academic stakeholders.
* Collaborate with graphic designers and video editors to ensure seamless integration of copy and visuals.

**Blogs and Thought Leadership:**

* Research, conceptualize, and write SEO-friendly blogs on academic programmes, career opportunities, industry developments, and relevant educational topics.
* Ghostwrite thought leadership articles, opinion pieces, and executive communications for University leadership and subject matter experts.
* Conduct interviews with faculty members, researchers, and industry experts to develop insightful, authoritative content.
* Repurpose interviews, speeches, and video transcripts into compelling articles and digital content.
* Adapt long-form content for platforms such as LinkedIn, Medium, and Substack.

**LinkedIn and Social Media Content:**

* Develop engaging LinkedIn posts that highlight institutional achievements, research, industry collaborations, and thought leadership.
* Write platform-specific content that balances professional storytelling with audience engagement.
* Identify relevant content opportunities and contribute ideas for social media campaigns.
* Work closely with the social media team to ensure content aligns with campaign objectives and publishing schedules.

**SEO Content Writing and Optimisation:**

* Conduct keyword research and incorporate relevant keywords naturally into website content and blogs.
* Develop SEO-friendly headlines, meta titles, meta descriptions, and page content.
* Apply on-page SEO best practices, including appropriate heading structures, internal linking, and search intent alignment.
* Optimise existing content to improve search visibility, relevance, and readability.
* Work with the digital marketing team to identify content gaps and develop keyword-driven content.
* Use SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, or Google Search Console to support content development and optimization.

**Editorial Standards and Brand Consistency:**

* Adhere strictly to the CMR University style guide, brand voice, and editorial guidelines.
* Ensure consistency in tone, terminology, grammar, punctuation, and formatting across all communication materials.
* Maintain UK English conventions across all written content.

**Collaboration and Content Management:**

* Manage multiple writing assignments while meeting deadlines and maintaining quality.
* Contribute to editorial and social media calendars, content planning, and brainstorming sessions.

**Required Qualifications and Skills:**

* Bachelor's degree in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Media Studies, or a related discipline.
* 2–3 years of professional experience in content writing, copywriting, journalism, digital marketing, or corporate communications.
* Exceptional command of English grammar, vocabulary, punctuation, and syntax, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to write both long-form editorial content and concise, impactful advertising copy.
* Working knowledge of SEO principles, keyword research, and content optimization.
* Strong research, interviewing, proofreading, and editing skills.
* Ability to understand and consistently apply an institutional style guide.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments, incorporate feedback, and meet deadlines.

Telugu and English (native-level writing in Telugu required)

**CTC range**

₹5.5–7 LPA, based on experience and test-task performance

About Emporia

Emporia is a Hyderabad-based marketing and creative agency. We run monthly retainers for clients in government, real estate, healthcare (India and US), food and beverage, fashion retail and ethnic retail, alongside brand identity and website projects. Our content work is shoot-led and short-form first: scripting, shoots, design, editing, posting, reporting and social listening.

The Role

You will own the copy and the monthly content plan across our retainers: calendars, reel and shoot scripts, captions, ad copy, website content and brand collaterals. A significant share of the work is for a government sector client, written in Telugu for public audiences.

Emporia is growing into a real estate performance marketing agency. You will write the ad copy, landing pages and campaign scripts that generate leads and site visits for property developers, working with our performance marketer.

This is not a write-to-brief role. You are expected to understand why content and ads work: who the audience is, what stage of the funnel a piece serves, which angle to test, and what the data says. You decide what to write as well as how to write it. Calendars are approved monthly by the founder; day-to-day content and creative decisions are yours.

Key Responsibilities: Content Strategy

•   
**Content pillars:**
define content pillars, audience segments and tone for each retainer, and revisit them quarterly.

•   
**Platform strategy:**
decide format mix and posting rhythm per platform — reels, carousels, statics, stories, YouTube Shorts — based on what each client's audience responds to.

•   
**Monthly content calendars:**
plan platform-wise calendars for each content retainer and get them approved before the month starts.

•   
**Campaign ideas:**
develop recurring series, seasonal and festive campaigns, and topical content tied to each client's business goals.

•   
**Performance review:**
read monthly post data (reach, watch time, saves, shares, profile actions) and change next month's plan because of it.

•   
**Social listening insights:**
turn the government account's listening data into content direction and write the insight section of its monthly report.

Key Responsibilities: Ad Strategy

•   
**Funnel thinking:**
map ad creatives to funnel stages — awareness, consideration, lead, retargeting — for each real estate and lead-generation campaign.

•   
**Creative angles:**
develop angles per audience (end-users, investors, NRI buyers): location, price, amenities, lifestyle, urgency, trust.

•   
**Testing plans:**
with the performance marketer, plan structured creative tests — hooks, offers, formats, copy length — and write the variants.

•   
**Ad data:**
read cost per lead, CTR, hook rate and lead quality feedback, and use it to decide the next round of creatives.

•   
**Organic to paid:**
identify organic posts that should be turned into ads for existing content clients, and pitch those upsells with the founder.

Key Responsibilities: Writing

•   
**Shoot briefs:**
write shoot briefs and shot lists with the DOP so a shoot day covers a month of content.

•   
**Scripts:**
write reel, shoot and video ad scripts in Telugu and English, with hooks, on-screen text and voiceover lines.

•   
**Social copy:**
captions, static post copy, carousel copy and hashtags for each client's calendar.

•   
**Real estate ad copy:**
headlines, primary text, lead-form copy and variants for Meta and Google lead-generation campaigns; scripts for walkthrough, location and testimonial videos; copy aimed at local and NRI buyers.

•   
**Landing pages:**
conversion-focused landing page copy for property projects — offer, location benefits, amenities, pricing cues and calls to action.

•   
**Compliance:**
ensure property ads carry required details such as the project's RERA registration number; no claims the client cannot substantiate.

•   
**Website content:**
page copy for client websites — home, about, services, product pages — written for clarity and search.

•   
**Collaterals:**
brochures, product descriptions, packaging copy, user manuals and other business collaterals for project clients.

•   
**Government communication:**
write accurate, appropriate Telugu content for public messaging; follow approval guidelines strictly.

•   
**Transcreation:**
adapt English content into natural Telugu and vice versa — not literal translation.

•   
**Revisions:**
turn around client and founder feedback quickly; maintain version control.

•   
**Brand voice:**
maintain voice documents and glossaries for each client, including Telugu terminology.

•   
**Time logging:**
log hours daily per client and task category.

Must-Have Skills

•   
**Telugu:**
native-level writing — grammar, spelling and tone, including formal and conversational registers.

•   
**English:**
clean, persuasive writing for social, ads and web.

•   
**Short-form scripting:**
understands how scripts translate to shots, edits and on-screen text for reels.

•   
**Range:**
can switch voice across sectors — government, healthcare, real estate, food, fashion.

•   
**Content strategy:**
has built content pillars and monthly calendars for multiple clients, and can explain the reasoning behind them.

•   
**Ad strategy:**
understands Meta and Google ad funnels, creative testing and audience-based messaging; has written ads for lead-generation or sales campaigns.

•   
**Data literacy:**
reads Meta Business Suite and Ads Manager data — reach, retention, CTR, cost per lead — and turns it into creative decisions.

•   
**Direct-response writing:**
understands hooks, offers and calls to action that drive leads, not just engagement.

•   
**Speed:**
delivers multiple scripts per day to deadline without dropping quality.

•   
**Typing:**
comfortable typing in Telugu Unicode (Google Input Tools, Lekhini or similar).

Good to Have

•   Real estate or property marketing copy experience.

•   Basic SEO writing knowledge for website content.

•   Experience with ad copy A/B testing.

•   Hindi as an additional language.

•   Interest in film, regional pop culture and social trends.

Selection Process

•   
**Writing samples:**
scripts, captions or web copy you have written, in both Telugu and English.

•   
**Test task, part A (content):**
a one-month calendar for one of our retainers with its content pillars and the reasoning behind them, plus three reel scripts (at least two in Telugu, one for public/government messaging).

•   
**Test task, part B (ads):**
a Meta lead ad plan for a sample residential project — funnel stages, two audience segments (one NRI), three creative angles with copy variants, and how you would judge which one wins.

•   
**Interview with the founders:**
walkthrough of both parts and a data-reading exercise on a real post and ad export.

How to Apply

Send your resume, writing samples and current/expected CTC with notice period to preetham@emporia.agency with the subject line “Senior Copywriter – [Your Name]”. Candidates who can join within 30 days will be prioritised.
