title: Account Lead
description:
Location: Hybrid (Secunderabad-based)

Type: Full-Time

**About the role**

This is an ownership role, not a coordination one. You take a set of our accounts and you own them end to end: from the client relationship and timelines to the quality of everything that goes out. When something needs doing, you get it done, and when there's no one else to do it, you do it yourself.

You'll brief the team, review their work and push back when it isn't ready. If you want a narrow lane and a fixed job description, this isn't it. If you like owning outcomes and doing whatever it takes to protect them, read on.

**What you'll own**

* The client relationship: You're the primary point of contact for your accounts. Calls, recaps, updates, expectations, all yours. You flag blockers early, and you're the steady voice when a timeline slips or a client gets anxious. As far as the client is concerned, you are the studio.

* Delivery and quality: You own what ships and when. You're the first person to forward-plan and the last set of eyes before work reaches the client. Nothing sloppy or half-finished goes out under your accounts.

* Timelines across every account: You're the first to know what's due, what's at risk, and what needs re-sequencing. Deadlines don't surprise you, because staying ahead of them is the job.

* Team coordination: You brief the copywriter, designers and strategist clearly, give feedback that's actionable, and keep everyone's timelines aligned so the work actually moves instead of stalling between people.

* Account documentation: Trackers, content calendars, approval threads, revision logs, and the rest. The systems that keep 5-7 accounts from turning into chaos stay current because you keep them current.

* Account health: You watch for scope creep, churn risk, and the conversations no one wants to have, and you have them early. Protecting the relationship and the renewal is partly yours.

* Performance: You track how the work actually does once it's live. You read what's working and what isn't, turn that into a clear improvement plan, and feed it into the next cycle of content. When you talk to the client, you bring them progress, not just output.

* Filling the gap: When an account needs something and there's no one free to do it, you step in, whatever it is.

**Who you'll work with**

You'll sit between the clients and the people who make the work. You'll brief and coordinate the creative team and the production and coordination support and you'll report into the founder on account health and anything that needs a call above your level. You run the day-to-day so the founder doesn't have to be in every room.

**What this is not**

This is not a primarily creative role. You won't be the one ideating campaigns or writing the bulk of the captions, though you're always welcome to, and you'll be expected to jump in when a gap needs filling. Your core job is to make sure the people doing that work have what they need, when they need it, and that the client always sees a studio that has its act together.

**What we're looking for**

* 3+ years in a client-facing, account, or project-management role with agency experience strongly preferred).
* Able to represent the studio unsupervised. Confident on calls, clear in writing, composed with senior and demanding clients.
* Obsessive about follow-through. If you said you'd send something, it's sent.
* Sound judgment. You know which decisions are yours to make and which to bring to the founder, and you don't escalate every little thing.
* Able to run 5-7 accounts in parallel without mixing them up or dropping a thread.
* Hands-on enough to step into the work when it's needed. A decent writer, a clear briefer, comfortable around a shoot.
* Comfortable with numbers. You can read content performance and turn it into what to do differently next month, not just report what happened.
* High on accountability, ownership, integrity, and commitment.
* Fluent in project-management tools (Notion, Google Workspace, or similar).

**Mandatory**

* A background in content, media, or marketing. You don't need to create it, but understanding how it's made helps.
* Experience managing timelines for video or social media production.

**A note on scope**

We're a small studio still building our core team, which means this role will stretch. Everything above is where you'll start, not a ceiling. As the studio grows and as we learn what you're best at, your remit will shift and expand, and there will be stretches where you're asked to take on work beyond this description simply because the studio needs it. If that flexibility sounds like an opportunity rather than a problem, you'll do well here.

title: Content Scriptwriter
description:

**Employer Brand & Employee Value Proposition (EVP):**

* Own the GCC’s internal communications strategy, calendar and content across newsletters, intranet, email communications, digital signage, town halls and leadership messaging
* Partner with GCC leadership communicate business priorities, key milestones and organizational updates in a clear and consistent manner across internal and external communications
* Design and execute employee engagement initiatives, recognition programs, cultural campaigns and leadership forums in collaboration with HR

**Talent Brand, Campus & Recruitment Marketing:**

* Manage talent-focused social media channels and create content that showcases employee stories, center milestones, culture and capability growth

description:

**About the Role**

Keka, a modern people platform trusted by 12,500+ companies, is looking for an SEO Lead (5–6 yrs) to own technical SEO, content, off-page and
AI search/GEO
visibility across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini.

**What you'll do**

1. Technical SEO

* Own crawling, indexation, site architecture, and technical SEO for a large WordPress website.
* Diagnose and resolve indexing, JavaScript rendering, Core Web Vitals, canonical, hreflang, structured data, and crawlability issues with the development team.
* Manage site migrations, redirects, international SEO, and technical QA.

2. Keyword, Content & On-Page SEO

* Own keyword research, intent-based clustering, keyword-to-URL mapping, and cannibalisation resolution.
* Develop information architecture, internal linking, and scalable SEO page strategies for commercial and informational keywords.
* Create content briefs, optimise on-page elements, and manage content refresh, consolidation, and removal.
* Improve SERP visibility and organic conversions in collaboration with Content, Product Marketing, and Demand Generation teams.

3. Off-Page SEO & Authority Building

* Develop the link-building and authority strategy across priority markets.
* Manage and mentor the Off-Page SEO Executive, including link quality, paid placements, and vendor performance.
* Lead digital PR, linkable asset development, review-platform strategy, and third-party listicle/roundup placements.
* Manage external SEO agencies and evaluate link quality, relevance, and risk.

4. AI Search & GEO

* Own Keka's visibility across Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Copilot.
* Develop and execute strategies to increase Keka's mentions, visibility, and citations across priority commercial and informational queries.
* Build and maintain standardised prompt sets to monitor AI visibility, citations, competitor presence, cited sources, prominence, and share of voice across markets.
* Identify citation gaps and develop strategies across Keka's content, digital PR, backlinks, review platforms, and authoritative third-party sources.
* Analyse AI search performance and implement improvements to content structure, entity signals, structured data, internal linking, and external authority.
* Establish GEO baselines, targets, and reporting for AI visibility, citations, share of voice, and AI referral traffic.
* Maintain accurate and consistent brand and product information across Keka's website and authoritative third-party sources.

5. Analytics & Performance Reporting

* Use Google Search Console and GA4 to analyse organic performance, using APIs and custom reports where required.
* Track rankings, organic traffic, and share of voice by market, separating branded and non-branded performance.
* Build traffic-to-conversion and pipeline forecasts, with documented assumptions.
* Work with Marketing Operations to measure organic contribution to MQLs, SQLs, and pipeline.
* Maintain SEO and GEO dashboards and communicate performance, insights, and priorities to leadership.

**What you'll bring**

* 5–6 years of SEO experience, with ownership of strategy, execution, prioritisation, and results.
* Strong technical SEO skills, including diagnosing crawling, indexing, rendering, and international SEO issues.
* Experience developing content and keyword strategies, managing content teams, and making consolidation decisions.
* Experience evaluating backlinks, managing link-building activities, and assessing link quality and risk.
* Hands-on experience with AI search/GEO, including monitoring LLM visibility, analysing citations, and improving brand mentions and citations.
* Experience building prompt sets or structured frameworks to measure AI visibility and competitor share of voice.
* Proficiency in Semrush or Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, and GA4.
* Experience managing at least one website migration or major restructure.
* A case study demonstrating SEO results, including baseline, timeframe, actions, outcomes, and learnings.
* Experience in HR tech, fintech, or compliance-heavy SaaS.
* Experience with AI search/GEO monitoring platforms.
* SQL, Python, Apps Script, or BigQuery experience for SEO data analysis.
* Experience with server log analysis.
* Experience managing agency budgets, vendors, or direct reports.
* Experience with product-led growth, free tools, self-serve trials, and SEO-driven product activation.

title: Founding Marketing Lead
description:
**About Project Noon:**

Project Noon is building India's first Sun Control brand- reimagining how people protect, comfort, and recover from everyday sun exposure. We believe the future of sun care goes far beyond sunscreen, and we're creating an entirely new category of products designed to help people live better under the sun.

Built at The Foundery, backed by Nikhil Kamath, Kishore Biyani, and Ronnie Screwvala, Project Noon is being built as a next-generation consumer brand with the ambition to define a new category from India for the world. By combining breakthrough product innovation, thoughtful design, and world-class brand building, we're creating a company that's changing the way millions of people experience the sun.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for our Founding Marketing Lead to build and lead Project Noon's marketing and brand function from the ground up. Project Noon is building India's first sun control brand, and this is a founding-team role: you won't inherit a marketing playbook, you'll write it. From brand strategy and content to performance campaigns, influencer programmes and offline activations, you will set the foundations that take the brand from launch to category leadership.

This is
**not**

a planning-only role. You will build the strategy, ship the assets, run the campaigns, read the data and iterate, every week. The role covers brand, content, performance, influencer, community and offline marketing across D2C, E-commerce and Quick Commerce channels.

This role reports directly to the Founder and offers significant opportunities for growth as the company grows.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Marketing Strategy & Planning**

* Build and own Project Noon's end-to-end marketing and content strategy from scratch, across brand, performance, influencer, community, online and offline.
* Translate the brand positioning into a clear go-to-market plan for launch and the first 12 months.
* Define the full-funnel architecture: what the brand says, to whom, on which channel, at each stage of TOFU, MOFU and BOFU.
* Set marketing budgets, channel mix and targets (CAC, ROAS, repeat rate, contribution margin) in partnership with the Founder and Finance.
* Build the marketing calendar around launches, seasons and cultural moments.

**Full-Funnel Execution (TOFU, MOFU, BOFU)**

* Plan, brief, produce and manage assets for every stage of the funnel:
* Top of the funnel (TOFU): awareness
  *(e.g., brand films, hook-led reels, memes, cultural content and influencer awareness pushes that create the sun control category).*
* Middle of the funnel (MOFU): consideration
  *(e.g., education, product demos, routines, reviews, UGC, creator explainers and retargeting content that build consideration and trust).*
* Bottom of the funnel (BOFU): conversion
  *(e.g.,offers, bundles, testimonials, comparison and conversion creatives, PDP and landing page content, cart and checkout nudges.)*
* Be hands-on in execution, not just planning: write briefs, review edits, sign off creatives and launch campaigns.
* Read performance daily and iterate quickly: kill what isn't working, scale what is, and feed learnings back into the creative pipeline.

**Performance Marketing**

* Run, test and optimise Meta Ads campaigns alongside the performance marketing agency: account structure, audiences, creative testing frameworks, bidding and budget allocation.
* Build a systematic creative testing engine (hooks, formats, angles, offers) with clear win/loss criteria along with team members and affiliated agencies.
* Drive efficient CAC and ROAS while protecting contribution margin.

**Brand & Content**

* Own the brand voice, visual identity and content standards across every touchpoint.
* Build and run the content engine across Instagram, YouTube and emerging platforms, with an India-first, culturally grounded point of view.
* Lead shoots, campaigns and launches end-to-end, from concept to delivery.
* Ensure all communication stays within regulatory and claims guidelines (ASCI, CDSCO, BIS).

**Influencer, Community & Affiliate Marketing**

* Build the influencer strategy across mega, macro, micro and nano creators, plus dermatologists and experts.
* Run seeding, paid collaborations, ambassador and affiliate programmes with clear ROI tracking.
* Build an owned community of early adopters and brand advocates.

**Offline & Experiential Marketing**

* Plan and execute offline activations: pop-ups, sampling, events, college and gym partnerships, and on-ground campaigns in launch cities.
* Integrate offline moments with online amplification so every activation produces content.

**Agency & Partner Management**

* Act as the single point of contact for all marketing agencies and partners, including performance marketing, influencer marketing, creative and production agencies.
* Set briefs, KPIs and review cadences; hold agencies accountable to outcomes, not activity.
* Decide what to keep in-house versus outsource as the function scales.

**Analytics & Marketing Operations**

* Build dashboards and KPIs across the funnel: reach, engagement, CTR, CPA, CAC, ROAS, conversion rate, AOV, repeat and LTV.
* Set up attribution, tracking and reporting across D2C, marketplaces and Quick Commerce.
* Run structured experiments and use data to drive every major decision.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Product, Supply Chain, Finance and Growth teams.
* Align launches and campaigns with inventory, pricing and channel plans.
* Feed consumer insight and campaign learnings back into product development.

**Team Building**

* Build and lead Project Noon's marketing and brand team as the company scales, across content, design, performance and influencer roles.
* Hire, mentor and develop a high-performing team, fostering a culture of ownership, speed, creativity and accountability.

**What We're Looking For**

* A minimum of 3 years of experience in Marketing & Brand.
* Experience building marketing for D2C brands in personal care, beauty, skincare, wellness or consumer products.
* Hands-on experience running Meta Ads: campaign setup, creative testing, audience strategy, optimisation and scaling budgets.
* Strong understanding of full-funnel marketing, with a track record of building and managing TOFU, MOFU and BOFU assets.
* Experience across brand, content, influencer and performance marketing, both online and offline.
* Experience managing performance, influencer and creative agencies as the brand-side lead.
* Experience marketing across D2C, Marketplace (Amazon, Nykaa) and Quick Commerce channels.
* Strong analytical and commercial skills: comfortable with CAC, ROAS, LTV, contribution margin and attribution.
* A sharp eye for creative: can tell a winning hook from a weak one and brief accordingly.
* Proven ability to be hands-on with execution while thinking strategically.
* Comfortable building systems and processes in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with a high-ownership mindset.

**Preferred Background**

* Experience in D2C, personal care, skincare, beauty, wellness or consumer brands preferred.
* Experience launching a new brand or category from zero to one is a strong advantage.
* Experience with suncare or seasonal categories is an added advantage.
* A portfolio of campaigns, content or brand work you have personally led.
* Candidates from Tier 1 institutes will be preferred.

**Preferred Traits**

* Entrepreneurial builder mindset.
* Strategic thinker with exceptional execution capability.
* Agile and test-driven: moves fast, reads the data, and changes course without ego.
* Culturally fluent, with a strong point of view on Indian internet and consumer culture.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure.
* Data-driven and creatively sharp in equal measure.
* Collaborative leader with excellent decision-making ability.

﻿

*Project Noon is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diverse perspectives and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.*

title: Director-Marketing
description:
**ABOUT CEDAR**

Cedar is a global strategy consulting, research and analytics firm with a 40-year track record and clients across multiple industry sectors. Since 1985, our teams have assisted clients in strategy, process innovation, strategic human capital and business technology, among others, with a strong focus on the Financial Services sector. As a full-suite management consulting firm, Cedar assists clients across these areas in an integrated fashion — from strategy formulation to execution and implementation.

The firm's heritage includes being part of the former US$1 billion Renaissance Worldwide, whose leadership included the creators of the Balanced Scorecard — the world's leading strategy-deployment and performance-management tool, used by organisations globally. Cedar's specialist Financial Services practice serves as the firm's centre of excellence, offering innovative advisory, research and accelerator capabilities to players across the global Financial Services ecosystem.

Cedar's group unit, UK-headquartered IBS Intelligence (IBSi), is a leading global pure-play FinTech research, news-analysis and advisory firm; for over 30 years it has been the definitive source of independent, in-depth analysis of global financial-technology markets, and its annual Sales League Table is considered the global industry barometer of banking-technology suppliers. The Cedar-IBSi platform also runs Cedar-IBSi FinTech Labs, a BankTech / B2B FinTech accelerator home to 70+ FinTechs since 2017; and Cedar's independent venture capital fund, announced in 2023, backs founders building AI-first enterprise technology for the Financial Services industry.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

The Director, Marketing leads Cedar’s marketing function end-to-end — owning brand, demand generation, thought leadership, and the digital presence that position Cedar as a leading global management consulting firm. The role exists to translate the firm’s strategy and practice expertise into a clear, consistent market voice, to build a pipeline of qualified opportunities for the partners and practice leaders, and to ensure every client-facing touchpoint reflects Cedar’s 40-year heritage and its credibility in Financial Services. Operating across practices and geographies, the role safeguards brand integrity, message discipline, and marketing governance across the firm.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role that combines strategy with execution. On brand and positioning, it owns the Cedar identity, messaging architecture, and the firm’s thought-leadership and research-led content programme. On demand generation, it plans and runs integrated campaigns, account-based marketing for priority sectors, events and webinars, and the digital and social channels that drive awareness and lead flow. On infrastructure, it owns the website, marketing technology stack, CRM alignment with business development, and the analytics that measure marketing’s contribution to pipeline and revenue. The role carries significant partner and practice-leader exposure, manages the marketing team and external agencies, and is accountable for the quality, consistency, and governance of all of Cedar’s outbound communication.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Brand, Positioning & Thought Leadership**

– 
Own and evolve the Cedar brand, visual identity, and messaging architecture across all practices and geographies.

– 
Lead the research-led thought-leadership programme — reports, points of view, bylines, and insights — with a strong focus on Financial Services.

– 
Ensure message consistency and brand governance across every client-facing and public touchpoint.

**Demand Generation & Campaigns**

– 
Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns aligned to practice and sector priorities.

– 
Design and run account-based marketing programmes for priority clients and target sectors.

– 
Generate and nurture a qualified pipeline in partnership with business development and the practice leaders.

**Digital, Content & Social**

– 
Own the website, SEO, email marketing, and the firm’s social and LinkedIn presence.

– 
Direct the content calendar across formats — web, social, video, collateral, and sales enablement material.

– 
Manage the marketing technology and analytics stack and its alignment with the CRM.

**Events, PR & Communications**

– 
Lead events, webinars, conferences, and speaking engagements that raise the firm’s profile.

– 
Manage public relations, media relationships, awards, and rankings submissions.

– 
Support internal communications and partner / practice-leader visibility programmes.

**Team, Budget & Governance**

– 
Lead, mentor, and build the marketing team, and manage external agencies and vendors.

– 
Own the marketing budget, plan, and reporting, and demonstrate return on marketing investment.

– 
Maintain brand, compliance, and data-privacy governance across all marketing activity.

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification (MBA or equivalent) in marketing or management is advantageous.

**Experience:**
A minimum of 12 years in marketing, with a significant portion in B2B, professional services, consulting, technology, or financial services. Proven experience leading a marketing function, building brand and demand-generation programmes, and managing teams, budgets, and agencies. Exposure to global or multi-geography marketing and to Financial Services is strongly preferred.

**SKILLS, DOMAIN & COMPETENCIES**

**Functional & technical skills:**
Brand & positioning; Integrated campaign & demand generation; Content & thought-leadership development; Digital marketing (website, SEO, email, social); Marketing automation & CRM; Analytics & reporting; Budget management; Agency & vendor management.

**Industry & domain knowledge:**
B2B / professional-services marketing; Consulting and advisory go-to-market; Financial Services and FinTech landscape; Account-based marketing; Events and PR.

**Behavioural competencies:**
Strategic thinking, Ownership, Stakeholder management, Communication & storytelling, Creativity with commercial discipline, Collaboration, and Planning & organisation.

**LEADERSHIP EXPECTATIONS**

**Expectations:**
Own the marketing strategy, brand, and function; Build and lead a high-performing marketing team; Partner closely with partners, practice leaders, and business development; Demonstrate marketing’s contribution to pipeline and revenue; and serve as the custodian of Cedar’s brand and market voice.

**CONFIDENTIALITY & GOVERNANCE**

Safeguards client, firm, and market-sensitive information and material non-public information, maintaining brand, compliance, data-privacy, and conflict-of-interest requirements across all marketing and communications activities.

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**

**Internal:**
Partners, Managing Partner, practice and sector leaders, business development, the consulting teams, and the wider Cedar–IBSi platform.

**External:**
Clients and prospects, media and analysts, event partners, marketing and creative agencies, technology vendors, and industry bodies.

**CAREER PROGRESSION & SUCCESS**

**Progression:**
Subject to sustained performance, demonstrated capability, business requirements, and the availability of suitable opportunities, the role may progress towards a senior marketing-leadership or wider go-to-market leadership position.

**Success (first 12–18 months):**
Brand and messaging are refreshed and consistently applied; A repeatable demand-generation engine is in place and contributing to pipeline; The thought-leadership and digital presence are visibly stronger; and the marketing team and its reporting are well-established and trusted by the partners.

etc.

The candidate should have a strong understanding of how search engines and AI platforms discover, understand, and rank content.**

**The role requires someone who can manage SEO strategies, optimise websites for answer-based search, and improve brand visibility across Google Search, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and other generative search platforms.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and execute end-to-end SEO strategies for client websites.
* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis and content gap analysis.
* Optimise meta titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal linking and on-page content.
* Perform technical SEO audits covering crawlability, indexation, canonical tags, schema, redirects, site speed and Core Web Vitals.
* Work with content and development teams to implement SEO recommendations.
* Monitor rankings, traffic, impressions, CTR and conversions using GA4, GSC and SEO tools.
* Prepare monthly SEO reports with insights, observations and recommendations.
* Optimise website content for answer-based search and featured snippets.
* Create FAQ-led, conversational and intent-focused content structures.
* Suggest structured data/schema recommendations such as FAQ, Breadcrumb, Organization, Product, Service and Article schema.
* Identify opportunities to improve visibility for informational and long-tail queries.
* Optimise content for visibility across AI and generative search platforms.
* Improve brand/entity signals through structured content, clear topical authority and schema implementation.
* Recommend content formats that improve chances of being referenced by AI platforms.
* Work on entity-based SEO strategies to strengthen brand authority and topical relevance.

**Required Skills**

* 3–5 years of experience in SEO, preferably with agency or multi-client exposure.
* Strong understanding of on-page SEO, technical SEO and content SEO.
* Knowledge of AEO, GEO, AI search, featured snippets and schema markup.
* Hands-on experience with Google Search Console, GA4, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog and keyword research tools.
* Good understanding of HTML basics, crawl reports, redirects, canonical tags and indexing issues.
* Ability to create SEO recommendations that are practical and implementation-friendly.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills.
* Good communication skills for coordinating with clients, content teams and developers.
* Experience working on programmatic SEO pages.
* Knowledge of Looker Studio dashboards.
* Understanding of AI Overviews, ChatGPT visibility, Perplexity citations and entity optimisation.

**Candidate Profile**

* Should be detail-oriented, proactive and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
* Should be able to manage multiple SEO projects and deadlines.
* Should have a performance-driven mindset with a focus on organic growth.
* Should be willing to work from office in Lower Parel, Mumbai.

description:
**Company overview:**

PEP is a dynamic personal care company that proudly houses two innovative brands –
**mCaffeine & Hyphen**
. With a passion for creating high-performance, conscious, and consumer-loved products, we are redefining the way personal care is experienced. While mCaffeine is India’s first caffeinated personal care brand, loved for its energizing and playful approach, Hyphen is built on the philosophy of simplifying skincare through science-backed formulations. Together, our brands reflect PEP’s mission to deliver quality, creativity, and care to millions of consumers. We believe in Confidence over all skin & body biases.

**Come, join the pack!**

**Job Summary:**
Build and lead a content function that can independently support brands, with clear processes, stronger brand communication and consistent delivery across launches and everyday business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Establish a Structured Content Function Across Brands**

● Content should be planned well in advance rather than handled request by request.

● Oversee content across all brands: launches, BAU, offers, CRM and e-commerce.

● Ensure every launch has a clear messaging direction that carries across all touchpoints.

**2. Develop a Distinct Communication Style for Every Brand**

● Each brand should sound and communicate differently, moving beyond functional copywriting.

● Strengthen product storytelling across PDPs, A+ content, listings, website and campaigns, focused on benefits and reasons to believe.

● Review content for originality, clarity, consistency and accuracy, and work with design on cohesive copy and visuals.

**3. Lead and Develop an Independent Content Team**

● Manage the workload and development of the Content Writers, with clear brand and project ownership.

● Set expectations for quality, turnaround and accountability, and review work before approval.

● Coach writers through regular feedback and performance discussions, and create templates and guidelines.

● Content should get consistent attention, not only around launches and major sales.

● Plan recurring content across BAU, offers, CRM, website and e-commerce.

● Work with BAU, Growth and Performance teams on copy variations for creative testing.

● Balance recurring needs with launch priorities so everyday communication is not neglected.

**5. Improve Content Performance and Delivery Efficiency**

● Use performance data and customer feedback to identify what messaging works, and apply it to future work.

● Monitor timelines, revision cycles and bottlenecks, and fix the causes of delays and rework.

**6. Own Content Timelines and Launch Delivery**

● Own the content timeline from brief to final delivery, with clear milestones and deadlines.

● Track dependencies across design, shoots, product readiness and approvals.

● Plan workload around overlapping launches, flag risks early and keep content from delaying launch readiness.

● 4–8 years of experience in content or copywriting, with at least 2 years leading a team.

● Experience in D2C, beauty, personal care or consumer brands preferred.

● Excellent writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to write in multiple brand voices.

● Experience with e-commerce content (PDPs, A+ content, marketplace listings) and performance or CRM copy.

Clean & Crafted

About Us

Clean & Crafted is India’s new-age clean-label food company crafting fresh, nutrition-focused breads using real and thoughtfully selected ingredients.

With no maida, no palm oil and a strong focus on natural ingredients, meaningful nutrition and great taste, we are building a modern food brand around transparency, trust and everyday wellness.

We are looking for someone who can help give this brand its distinctive voice, personality and visual language.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly creative and hands-on
**Creative Lead – Brand Content & Social**
who will take ownership of how Clean & Crafted communicates with consumers across social media and other marketing touchpoints.

This is not merely a graphic-design or social-posting role.

The Creative Lead will conceive ideas, develop scripts, create content formats, direct shoots, guide visual execution and manage the complete social-content engine of Clean & Crafted.

The person should be equally comfortable writing a 20-second reel, directing a product shoot, developing a carousel concept, briefing a designer and sitting with a video editor to improve the final cut.

The role will work directly with the Founder and closely with Performance Marketing, Sales and Product teams.

Key ResponsibilitiesCreative Strategy & Brand Storytelling

* Develop Clean & Crafted’s creative language, tone and storytelling style.
* Translate brand strategy and product propositions into consumer-friendly communication.
* Generate campaign ideas around products, ingredients, nutrition, occasions and consumer problems.
* Build distinctive recurring content properties for the brand.
* Ensure consistency of tone, visual language and messaging across consumer touchpoints.
* Develop communication that is credible, engaging and differentiated from conventional bread brands.

Social Media Content

* Own the creative direction of Clean & Crafted’s social-media presence.
* Develop monthly and quarterly content calendars.
* Conceptualise:
* Reels
* Short-form videos
* Carousels
* Static posts
* Stories
* Founder-led content
* Product education
* Nutrition-led content
* Consumer testimonials
* Occasion-based campaigns
* Develop hooks, scripts, captions and storyboards.
* Ensure social content is created for engagement rather than simply maintaining posting frequency.

Reels & Video Direction

* Develop concepts and scripts for reels and digital video.
* Direct product, consumer and founder-led shoots.
* Guide framing, performances, locations, props and visual treatment.
* Work closely with the Video Editor on pacing, music, graphics and final output.
* Build efficient formats that allow multiple pieces of content to be created from each shoot.
* Track emerging reel and video formats and intelligently adapt them for the brand.

Graphic & Visual Content

* Brief and guide the Graphic Designer on:
* Social-media posts
* Carousels
* Digital advertisements
* Q-commerce creatives
* Retail communication
* Campaign assets
* Review designs for visual quality, brand consistency and communication effectiveness.
* Ensure creative work is simple, distinctive and immediately understandable.

Team Management

* Manage the day-to-day creative workflow of the Graphic Designer, Video Editor and Social Media Intern/Executive.
* Allocate briefs and timelines.
* Review output and provide clear creative feedback.
* Maintain a content-production calendar.
* Ensure deadlines and content cadence are consistently maintained.
* Build an organised repository of footage, photographs, artwork and master files.

Social Media Ownership

* Guide the Social Media Intern/Executive on publishing, scheduling and community management.
* Review captions, stories and consumer responses.
* Monitor comments, DMs and consumer conversations.
* Identify opportunities for user-generated content.
* Track competitor communication and cultural/social trends.
* Ensure the brand remains responsive and relevant.

Performance Creative

* Work closely with the Performance Marketing Manager to develop advertising creatives.
* Develop multiple creative variations for testing.
* Understand which hooks, claims, products and formats convert best.
* Use advertising performance data to improve future creative.
* Participate in regular creative-performance reviews.

Campaigns & Product Launches

* Develop creative communication for:
* New-product launches
* Q-commerce launches
* Retail activations
* Sampling campaigns
* Seasonal occasions
* Nutrition and education initiatives
* Create integrated campaign ideas rather than isolated pieces of content.
* Coordinate production with photographers, creators or external specialists where required.

Consumer Understanding

* Develop an understanding of C&C’s target consumers and their motivations.
* Regularly review comments, reviews, feedback and social conversations.
* Translate consumer insights into content ideas.
* Ensure creative output communicates benefits in language consumers understand rather than technical jargon.

Must-Have AttributesCreative Capability

* Strong storytelling and conceptual ability.
* Excellent scriptwriting capability, particularly for short-form video.
* Strong understanding of visual storytelling.
* Ability to develop ideas from concept through execution.
* Experience directing video or digital content.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, reels and contemporary social-media formats.
* Ability to guide graphic design and video editing even if not personally executing every asset.

Execution Capability

* Hands-on and comfortable working in a lean team.
* Ability to produce high-quality content with practical budgets.
* Able to simultaneously manage multiple pieces of content and deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable giving clear briefs and feedback to designers and editors.

Consumer & Brand Orientation

* Ability to think like a consumer, not merely a filmmaker or creator.
* Understands the difference between attractive content and effective brand communication.
* Ability to simplify product and nutritional information.
* Curious about consumer behaviour, food, culture and digital trends.

Soft Skills

* Highly creative and curious.
* Strong communicator.
* Open to feedback and experimentation.
* High ownership and accountability.
* Comfortable working directly with the Founder.
* Fast-moving and solution-oriented.
* Collaborative and able to lead a small creative team.

Technology & Tools

* Working understanding of modern video-production and editing workflows.
* Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite / Premiere Pro / Final Cut / Canva or equivalent tools.
* Comfortable using Instagram and Meta platforms.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT for ideation, scripting and research.
* Comfortable using Google Docs, Sheets and project-management tools.

Good-to-Have Attributes

* Experience in FMCG, food, nutrition, wellness or consumer brands.
* Experience working with a startup or founder-led company.
* Experience developing content for a high-growth social-media brand.
* Ability to personally shoot basic mobile-first content.
* Exposure to influencer/creator collaborations.
* Experience directing founder-led content.
* Basic understanding of performance marketing and creative analytics.
* Experience building a social-media presence from an early stage.
* Interest in food, nutrition and consumer health.

Key Performance Indicators

The role will be measured on:

1. Quality and originality of creative ideas
2. Consistency of content output
3. Reel/video performance
4. Organic reach and engagement
5. Shares and saves
6. Content production turnaround time
7. Performance of paid-media creatives
8. Brand consistency
9. Ability to build distinctive content properties
10. Team productivity and creative quality
11. Improvement in consumer engagement and brand recall

What Success Looks Like

Clean & Crafted should develop a social and creative identity where consumers can recognise a piece of C&C content even before seeing the logo.

The Creative Lead should make the brand:

**Interesting enough to watch. Useful enough to save. Distinctive enough to remember. Credible enough to trust.**

**The objective is not to create more content. It is to create content that builds the brand and helps grow the business.**

Remuneration & Growth

* Competitive compensation based on experience and capability.
* Direct access to and interaction with the Founder.
* Opportunity to build the creative identity of a new consumer-food brand from the ground up.

title: Community & Fan Engagement Manager
description:
**Location:**
India

**Employment type:**
Full-time

About Cricket8

Cricket8 is building a new kind of cricket gaming platform — where fans don't just watch the match, they play it.

Our platform brings friends together to compete, climb leaderboards and battle for bragging rights through interactive cricket Leagues. We want to make following cricket even more exciting by giving fans a way to participate, compete and connect around the game they love.

We're looking for a passionate, creative and highly engaged
**Community & Fan Engagement Manager**
to help build Cricket8 into a mainstream gaming platform across India.

The Role

You will be responsible for building and nurturing an active community of cricket fans who regularly play Cricket8, compete in our Leagues and bring their friends into the game.

You'll be at the heart of our community — creating competitions around the cricket calendar, engaging fans across social media, developing creative ways to drive participation and turning Cricket8 into a platform that fans return to match after match.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands Indian cricket culture, loves competition and knows how to turn an audience into an engaged community.

Key ResponsibilitiesLeague Creation & Matchday Engagement

* Create, manage and promote Cricket8 Leagues around all major cricket matches and tournaments relevant to Indian fans.
* Build a dynamic competition calendar covering international cricket, the IPL, domestic tournaments and other major cricket events.
* Develop creative League formats, challenges and competitions that encourage fans to participate, compete and return regularly.
* Drive participation before, during and after matches, creating excitement around every League.
* Monitor League engagement and use player feedback and performance data to improve future competitions.

Community Building & Player Engagement

* Build, grow and nurture a highly engaged community of Cricket8 players and cricket fans across India.
* Develop relationships with users, understand what motivates them and encourage them to play regularly.
* Create opportunities for players to compete with friends, connect with other fans and share their achievements.
* Identify passionate and influential community members who can help grow Cricket8 organically.
* Make Cricket8 feel like a community that fans belong to — not simply another gaming app.

Social Media & Content

* Actively engage with users across relevant social media platforms, including Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, TikTok and emerging channels.
* Develop engaging, timely and culturally relevant content around cricket matches, rivalries, players, Leagues and Cricket8 competitions.
* Create and coordinate matchday content, challenges, memes, polls, community highlights and other shareable content.
* Identify social trends and opportunities to make Cricket8 part of the wider cricket conversation.
* Encourage users to share their League participation, results and experiences with friends.

Growth & Mainstream Brand Development

* Develop creative community-led initiatives that introduce Cricket8 to new audiences across India.
* Identify opportunities to collaborate with cricket creators, fan communities, colleges and other relevant partners.
* Help turn social engagement into new users, active players and repeat participation.
* Work with the marketing team to support campaigns, launches and major cricket-related initiatives.
* Contribute ideas that help Cricket8 become a recognised and mainstream gaming brand in India.

Player Feedback & Product Collaboration

* Act as the voice of the Cricket8 community, sharing player feedback, ideas and issues with the product team.
* Identify opportunities to improve the user experience and increase engagement and retention.
* Monitor community sentiment and respond to questions, feedback and issues in a timely and constructive manner.
* Work closely with the product, marketing and design teams to develop features and experiences that players love.

What We're Looking For

* A genuine passion for cricket and a strong understanding of the Indian cricket fanbase.
* Experience in community management, fan engagement, social media, gaming, sports marketing or a similar role.
* A strong understanding of how Indian fans follow cricket, engage online and connect with other fans.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to engage users in an authentic, relatable way.
* A creative mindset, with the ability to generate ideas that get people talking and participating.
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple competitions and activities around a busy cricket calendar.
* A proactive, entrepreneurial attitude — someone who takes ownership and enjoys building something from the ground up.
* A data-driven approach to understanding engagement and improving performance.
* Flexibility to work during major matches, including evenings and weekends when required.

**Desirable experience:**

* Experience working with a gaming platform, sports brand, cricket team, broadcaster or digital community.
* Experience creating and managing online competitions, tournaments or fan engagement initiatives.
* Familiarity with Indian regional languages and the cultural nuances of different cricket audiences.
* Experience working with creators, influencers or grassroots communities.

How We'll Measure Success

Success in this role will be measured by the growth and activity of the Cricket8 community, including:

* Growth in registered and active players.
* League participation and the number of players competing in each match.
* Repeat participation and player retention across successive matches and tournaments.
* The number of users inviting friends and sharing Cricket8 content.
* Engagement and growth across Cricket8's social channels.
* The effectiveness of community initiatives in driving new users and sustained gameplay.

Why Join Cricket8?

This is an opportunity to help build a new gaming platform at an exciting stage of its development.

You'll have the freedom to shape our community strategy, develop creative ideas, experiment with new ways to engage cricket fans and play a meaningful role in growing Cricket8 into a mainstream gaming brand across India.

If you love cricket, understand its fans and want to build a community that brings people together through competition, we'd love to hear from you.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration - Confident working with brand, sales, finance, and external partners.

title: Senior Performance Marketing Executive
description:
**Location:**
Pune (On-site)

**Experience:**
3-6 Years in Performance Marketing

**Role Summary
:**

We are looking for a data-driven, results-obsessed Sr. Performance Marketing Executive to plan, execute, optimise, and scale paid marketing campaigns across digital platforms. You will own the end-to-end performance of paid media - from strategy and campaign setup to budget management, creative testing, analytics, and reporting. Expert in both
**B2C**
and
**B2B**
market.

This is not a 'boost posts and report reach' role. We want someone who lives in dashboards, thinks in CPL and ROAS, can diagnose what's breaking in a campaign - and who holds themselves accountable to business outcomes, not just platform metrics.

**Key Responsibilities
:**

**1. Paid Campaign Strategy & Execution**

* Plan, set up, and manage performance campaigns across Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube, PMax), and other relevant platforms (LinkedIn, Programmatic, etc.).
* Develop full-funnel campaign strategies - from awareness and consideration to lead generation and conversion.
* Define campaign objectives, audience segmentation, targeting parameters, bidding strategies, and budget allocation.
* Write or brief ad copy, define creative requirements, and collaborate with the design team to produce high-converting ad creatives.
* Launch, monitor, and optimise campaigns daily - adjusting bids, budgets, audiences, and creatives based on performance data.

**2. Budget Management & ROI Optimisation**

* Manage monthly paid media budgets - allocate spend across platforms, campaigns, and ad sets for maximum ROI.
* Track Cost Per Lead (CPL), Cost Per Acquisition (CPA), Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), and other business-critical metrics.
* Identify underperforming campaigns and reallocate budgets proactively to maximise efficiency.
* Prepare budget utilisation reports and forecasts for weekly and monthly reviews with stakeholders.
* Ensure zero budget wastage - monitor for ad fatigue, audience overlap, and frequency issues.

**3. Audience & Targeting Strategy**

* Build and manage custom audiences, lookalike audiences, retargeting pools, and remarketing lists across platforms.
* Segment audiences by funnel stage, behaviour, demographics, and intent signals for personalised ad delivery.
* Use first-party data (CRM lists, website visitors, past buyers) to create high-intent targeting strategies.
* Continuously test new audience hypotheses and document learnings in a structured testing log.

**4. Creative Testing & Conversion Optimisation**

* Run structured A/B and multivariate tests on ad creatives, headlines, CTAs, landing pages, and audience combinations.
* Analyse creative performance data - identify winning formats (static, video, carousel, UGC) and scale what works.
* Collaborate with the design and content teams to brief and iterate creatives based on performance insights.
* Work with the web/tech team to optimise landing pages for conversion - improve load time, form fill rates, and UX.
* Implement and test lead form ads, click-to-WhatsApp campaigns, and other lead capture formats.

**5. Tracking, Analytics & Reporting**

* Set up and maintain conversion tracking via Meta Pixel, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and UTM parameters.
* Build and maintain campaign performance dashboards in Google Looker Studio, Excel, or equivalent tools.
* Deliver weekly and monthly performance reports with insights, observations, and recommended next steps - not just numbers.
* Analyse the full lead journey - from ad click to CRM entry to sales outcome - and optimise for lead quality, not just volume.
* Track attribution across channels and campaigns to understand true contribution to revenue.

**6. SEO & Organic Support (Secondary)**

* Collaborate with the content team on keyword strategy and paid-organic synergy.
* Support basic SEO tasks - meta tags, keyword mapping, and content briefs - where applicable.
* Use Google Search Console and SEMrush/Ahrefs insights to inform paid search strategy.

**7. AI-Powered Marketing (Advantage)**

* Use AI tools like ChatGPT/Claude for ad copy generation, A/B test ideation, and audience research.
* Leverage platform-native AI features - Meta Advantage+, Google Smart Bidding, PMax - with a critical, data-led approach.
* Stay current on AI developments in digital advertising and bring new tools/approaches to the team proactively.

**Key Skills & Competencies
:**

***Technical / Hard Skills***

* Deep expertise in Meta Ads, Google Ads & other paid channels.
* Conversion tracking - Pixel, GTM, GA4 setup
* A/B testing and creative experimentation
* Budget management and ROAS optimisation
* Landing page CRO (Conversion Rate Optimisation)
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets for data analysis
* UTM tagging and attribution modelling

***Soft Skills & Mindset***

* Analytical mindset - comfortable with numbers daily
* Bias for action - tests fast, learns faster
* Strong ownership of targets and outcomes
* Clear communication with design, sales, and leadership
* Curiosity - stays ahead of platform updates and trends
* Collaborative - works well cross-functionally

**Qualifications
:**

* Graduate / Postgraduate in Marketing, Business, Mass Communication, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in performance/digital marketing - agency or in-house.
* Experience in industries like real estate, IT, Telecom. Internet, B2C, or e-commerce is an advantage.

·       Proven experience managing and growing social media channels in a B2B environment.

·       The ability to prioritise and organize workloads independently.

**DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

·       Bachelor’s/master’s in marketing

·       Experience across the full marketing mix.

. Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, ideally high quality video creation.

**ONE GLOBAL TEAM - DISTRIBUTED BY DEFAULT**

We put a lot of weight on the "One Team" philosophy. All our team members in India are a tightly integrated well-knit member of their global teams that they are part of. They regularly participate in (and can influence) many of theproject decisions. Similarly, their S.M.A.R.T. goals and career development plans are well orchestrated to be closely aligned to their global peers and business needs.

It is highly likely that the team you are working with is distributed across the globe, and you have the opportunity or are encouraged to visit them (and vice versa) as part of working-

together philosophy.

**THE WORKPLACE OF THE FUTURE**

One of our core tenets has been Freedom underpinned with Responsibility. We were one of the early companies in Indiawith a formal Work from Home policy more than a decade back. We see it as one of the many ways we can encourage and help our employees achieve work life balance & choose where they would like to work - either from one of ourmodern offices or from a coffee shop. It also allows us to find the best possible talent free from geographical barriers.

We believe that a hybrid working model which allows employees to work from their location of choice combined with“Touchdown” days where they gather to meet their teams in person and gain energy & inspiration through inter-personal interactions is the best in both the worlds. The Workplace of the Future awaits you with us.

**DIVISION PROFILE**

With over 30 years of experience and more than 6000 Customers worldwide, TECHNIA is a leading global supplier of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) solutions for creating and managing product information throughout the entire product lifecycle, from product planning, development and design to production, sales, training, and support.

In partnership with other leading suppliers in the field, TECHNIA also offers solutions within CAD, technical document management, product configuration, and visualization. TECHNIA’s PLM services include business process review, organizational change management, implementation, deployment, training, maintenance, and support.

TECHNIA is a strategic partner to more than 200 companies in the telecom, electronics, consumer products, life sciences, and automotive, industrial equipment, oil & gas, energy, and construction industries.

http://www.technia.com

A digitally sustainable society in which people, companies, authorities, and organizations interact with the technology that surrounds us.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
**ABOUT STAHL**

Stahl is a premium Indian cookware brand built on the belief that great cooking begins with great tools. Headquartered in Pune, we are re-imagining the Indian kitchen not by chasing trends, but by deeply understanding how people cook, what they aspire to, and what would delight them before they knew to ask for it. We are building a brand that people don’t simply buy, but feel something for. Our journey began at the heart of every home: the kitchen. But our ambition extends far beyond it - to create products that make everyday life better, wherever people live, work, move and gather.

**THE ROLE**

Stahl exists to reimagine the kitchen by understanding the people who cook, the lives they lead, and what can make everyday cooking more joyful. As Head of Marketing, you will turn that understanding into a brand people notice, remember and choose. You will lead Brand, Content, Creative, D2C and Customer Engagement - turning customer insight into ideas, stories, experiences and relationships that make Stahl distinctive and desirable. You will work closely with Product, Sales and Engineering teams to bring the whole experience together - what we make, why it matters, how we tell its story, how it reaches people and what we learn from them. As Stahl grows, you will also shape what the brand feels like in the world - its tone, voice, look and character - building a brand that feels unmistakably Stahl wherever people encounter it.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

– Customer & Positioning

Own segmentation, targeting and positioning across our customer groups. Stay close to customers throughout their journey and turn what you learn into sharper propositions, messaging, and experiences.

– Brand & Content

Build a brand that people recognise, remember and actively want in their lives. Set the brand’s point of view and turn customer insight into compelling stories. Build creator partnerships and genuine Stahl advocacy, and shape how our stories travel across platforms and touchpoints.

– D2C & Marketing Effectiveness

Turn our D2C website into a meaningful direct relationship with the customer, not simply another sales channel. Own the expression of the brand and the customer experience across D2C platform. Set the vision for the website’s look, feel and UI/UX, and work closely with Growth Team: Sales and E-commerce to bring customer and commercial insights into a relevant, seamless and high-converting experience.

– Customer Relationship

Build a lasting relationship with customers beyond the first purchase. Bring CRM, customer care and proactive outreach together to understand customers, help them get more from their products, and build loyalty, advocacy and repeat purchase.

– Go-to-Market

Bring Stahl’s products and ideas to life in ways that people want to engage with, from launches and campaigns to partnerships, events and communities. Work closely with Product and Sales to ensure every launch has a clear customer, story and reason to choose Stahl.

– Partnerships, Experiences & Growth

Find new ways for people to experience Stahl and bring the brand into their lives- through partnerships, PR, events, communities and loyalty programmes. Build these deliberately around the customer and the brand, rather than as one-off activities, and create a system where every interaction gives us something to learn and every learning makes the next interaction better.

– Internal Brand & Communications

Build a strong internal brand through thoughtful communication of Stahl’s products, launches, customer insights, aspirations and business milestones. Partner with HR to bring the culture, values and employee experience to life through newsletters, culture decks, internal campaigns, events and other employee touchpoints.

– Agency, Partner and Team Management

Build the team and capabilities Stahl needs for its next stage of growth, knowing what to build in-house and what to bring in from specialists, consultants, vendors and agencies. Building and managing the right agency ecosystem is a crucial part of the role. Set the direction and the “why”, drive the “how”, create the clarity, ownership, standards and strong mechanisms needed for great work, while being equally willing to roll up your sleeves and get into the work when needed.

**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**

– Not an Amazon or marketplace role. Not a performance marketing role.

– Not a product roadmap role. Product Team owns the roadmap; Marketing partners on insight, positioning and go-to-market.

– Not to be restricted to MarCom/ communication/ creative request desk.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

Someone who combines the instincts of a brand builder, the curiosity of a customer researcher, the commercial orientation of a growth leader, and the ambition of an entrepreneur.

– Customer obsession. You start with what the customer is trying to look for, not just stated ones.

– Brand instinct and taste. You know how to make a premium brand distinctive and recognise what feels premium before it needs to be explained. This comes naturally to you.

– Commercial rigour. You read brand health and funnel data with ease, understand metrics such as TROAS, CAC and CPL, and use the numbers to make better decisions. You are hands-on with data, with a sharp eye for spotting what the numbers are really telling you.

– Focus and frugality. You can say no to distracting segments and tactics, and build through consistent, compounding experiments.

– Influence and leadership. You lead working leaders, bring Growth, Sales and Product along with you, and carry a customer-first view across the company.

– AI-forward but pragmatic. You use new tools to move faster, with governance and judgement.

– You challenge yourself and your team to keep raising the bar, without becoming attached to what you have created.

– 10-15 years in Marketing, ideally across premium consumer, D2C or retail environments.

– A track record and experience across brand-building and commercial marketing, and in building and leading a team.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

– Opportunity to contribute towards a brand that transforms kitchens into spaces of joy, not just utility. Here, you will find the environment and trust to push boundaries and create work you can truly be proud of, work that becomes a meaningful part of people’s lives.

– Simple, low-hierarchy culture with open and honest collaboration across levels, where ownership comes with responsibility and grows with you.

– We ensure a way of working that respects life beyond work.

– Along with competitive compensation, other benefits and exclusive staff discounts on our products.

If this resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you. Apply through the LinkedIn job link or share your profile with us directly on
**hr@stahlkitchens.com**

We are an equal opportunity employer that values diverse perspectives and the strength they bring to our teams. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, ancestry, national origin, caste, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, marital status, or any other protected characteristic.

www.stahlkitchens.com

title: Growth Associate
description:
**Role:**
Growth Associate

**Location:**
Aundh, Pune (Full-time, in-office)

**Shift timings:**
11:30am to 8:30pm IST

**Years of experience:**
0 - 2 years

**Why this role:**

InCommon is the talent workforce layer for enterprise adoption of AI. We have three service lines:

1. Global Capability Centres (GCCs), which build and run dedicated India-based teams for US companies
2. Forward-deployed engineers (FDEs), the deployment layer for AI; and
3. Building Reinforcement Learning (RL) environments.

We've done our 0 to 1, and now we want to go from 1 to 10.A big part of getting there is founder-led content. Our founders have a lot to say about how enterprises are adopting AI, and we want the right people to hear it. That's where you come in. This is a growth role: you'll experiment with founder-led content to figure out what works, get it in front of the right audience, and turn that attention into business for InCommon.

We'll be honest: there's no fixed playbook here yet. You'll be testing formats, hooks and ideas, keeping what works and dropping what doesn't. The team will be right there with you, and you'll learn a lot along the way.

**What you'll do:**

You'll own founder-led content across all three service lines, and content strategy will be a big part of the job. Honestly, you'll be closer to the engagement numbers than anyone else, so we expect you to shape the strategy, not just execute it.

* Set and evolve our content strategy based on what the data tells you: which topics, formats and channels are working.
* Write posts for our founders on LinkedIn and X, largely by hand rather than with AI.
* Create video content, such as short founder clips, cut-downs from our leadership interviews and conversations, and simple explainers.
* Repurpose long-form content from our AEO (answer engine optimisation) agency into the right shape for each platform, and keep an eye on how we show up in AI search.
* Experiment constantly with formats, hooks and topics, and track what actually lands.
* Work on distribution: figure out how to capture attention and get our content in front of the people who matter.
* Think about how to turn that attention into business, whether that's inbound leads, conversations or partnerships.
* Build our founders' authority as credible voices in their space.
* Map content pillars to each stage of the funnel (awareness, consideration, decision) and run the content calendar.

Branding matters a lot to us. Every post shapes how the market sees InCommon, so you'll play a real part in building our brand.

**Who we're looking for:**

Above all, we're looking for a good writer with good taste.

* You can tell good writing from bad, and you can spot when something was written by AI rather than a person.
* You read and watch a lot, and you can tell us what content you consume.
* You've made something of your own, like a blog, newsletter, LinkedIn or X presence, or videos, or worked on content before. This isn't a hard requirement, but it certainly helps.
* You're comfortable with video, or keen to learn.
* You like working from data and aren't afraid to change course when the numbers say so.
* Excellent written and spoken English, since our audience is largely in the US.
* You're comfortable with ambiguity and like experimenting.

**Tools and logistics:**

You'll work mostly in LinkedIn, X and Claude, alongside video editing and analytics tools. We'll train you on anything new.

description:
**ABOUT STAHL COOKWARE**

Stahl is a premium Indian cookware brand built on the belief that great cooking begins with great tools. We are a design-forward manufacturing company headquartered in Pune. Our ambition is to re-imagine the Indian kitchen, not by chasing trends, but by deeply understanding how people cook, what they aspire to, and what would delight them before they even knew to ask for it. We make products that earn a place in kitchens for a lifetime. This role is central to that promise.

**THE ROLE**

We’re looking for a versatile and detail-driven Content and Copy professional who can strategise, craft,

and deploy compelling, well-researched and brand-aligned content across multiple formats and channels. You own the voice and storytelling for Stahl across brand campaigns, social media, trade marketing, performance marketing and e-commerce. You’ll manage content strategy and copy development, working closely with designers, production teams, influencers and partner agencies to create compelling, on-brand communication that drives engagement and conversions. This role blends creative vision with technical precision, covering everything from tone-of-voice development and SEO-driven copy to campaign ideation and content optimisation.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

• Content Strategy Development with brand aligned writing: Create and implement comprehensive content strategies that align with brand objectives, focusing on brand building, trade marketing, performance marketing, and e-commerce. Produce clear, engaging, and technically accurate copy tailored to the Stahl brand’s tone of voice.

• Content Creation: Develop high-quality, engaging content (blog posts, social media posts, product descriptions) that resonates with the target audience and positions Stahl Kitchens as a premium brand with a clear, transformational role to play in Indian kitchens.

• Multiple media touch-points: From print and packaging to social media, e-commerce platforms, advertising, events, and video content—you’ll create and adapt work across multiple touch-points. This includes everything from brochures, digital ads, and marketplace listings to brand films, event branding, and internal communications, ensuring Stahl’s presence is strong and consistent everywhere our audience interacts with us.

• Collaboration: Work closely with designers, marketers, and the creative team on projects of varying scale. Liaise with content creators, influencers, and external agencies to develop cohesive and effective marketing campaigns. Work closely with digital marketing agencies to optimize content for SEO, ensuring high visibility and engagement across digital platforms.

• Research, Strategy, and Content sourcing: Conduct high-quality research to strengthen messaging and ensure factual accuracy. Identify and source supporting imagery or media for content pieces.

• Content Versatility: Write for a range of formats - web, print, campaigns, brochures, product catalogues, display ads, and social media.

• Editing & Proofing: Review and refine copy to maintain clarity, consistency, and grammatical precision.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

• Minimum 5 years of professional copywriting experience preferably in D2C / B2C marketing for an FMCG / FMCD brand.

• Strong body of work demonstrating versatility across mediums and industries.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration with cross-functional teams.

• Familiarity with SEO principles and digital marketing tools.

• Ability to analyze data and make informed decisions to optimize content strategies.

• Precision in grammar, tone, and structure, across tight deadlines.

• Strong understanding of brand building, trade marketing, performance marketing, and e-commerce strategies.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Opportunity to be part of a brand that transforms kitchens into spaces of joy, not just utility. Here, you will find the environment and trust to push boundaries and create work you can truly be proud of, work that becomes a meaningful part of people’s lives.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
## About the Role

We seek a Performance Marketing Specialist with 3–4 years in Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads. The role involves driving website traffic, generating B2B leads, and enhancing campaign performance. Candidates must manage campaigns independently, analyze data, optimize budgets and audiences, and prepare performance reports. Experience in B2B lead generation and tech/electronics is beneficial.

Manage keyword targeting, match types, negative keywords, bidding, budgets, and ad copies. Optimize campaigns for CTR, CPC, CPL, conversion rate, and lead quality. Identify underperforming elements and implement corrective actions. Monitor and optimize campaigns based on performance and business objectives.

Build audiences based on job titles, industries, company size, seniority, location, and other parameters. Create and test different ad formats, creatives, messaging, and Lead Gen Forms. Monitor CPL, CTR, conversion rate, lead quality, and qualified-lead performance. Continuously optimize campaigns based on audience and lead-quality data.

Monitor metrics including impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, conversions, CPL, conversion rate, and qualified leads. Analyze campaign performance against targets and identify opportunities for improvement. Work with sales/business teams to evaluate lead quality and conversion from lead to opportunity. Maintain accurate campaign and performance dashboards.

- \*\*Lead Generation & Conversion Optimization\*\*: Develop and execute strategies for B2B lead generation and website traffic growth. Work with content/design teams to develop high-performing ad creatives and messaging. Coordinate with website teams to improve landing pages and conversion rates. Implement A/B testing for ads, audiences, landing pages, and offers. Focus on generating qualified leads rather than simply maximizing lead volume.

## Requirements

- 2–4 years in Performance Marketing / Digital Advertising.

- Independent campaign management.

- Strong experience with Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads.

- Understanding of CPC, CTR, CPM, CPL, CPA, conversion rate, and ROAS.

- Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Search Console.

- Understanding of conversion tracking, pixels/tags, and campaign attribution.

- Strong analytical and reporting skills.

- Good understanding of audience targeting and remarketing.

- Experience with Excel/Google Sheets for campaign analysis and reporting.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Experience with Google Tag Manager.

- Experience with CRM-based lead tracking and offline conversion data.

- Basic understanding of SEO and landing-page optimization.

- Experience with Looker Studio or similar reporting/dashboard tools.

- Google Ads and/or LinkedIn certifications are a plus.

## Preferred

- Experience in B2B performance marketing.

- Experience marketing technology, electronics, SaaS, industrial, or professional services businesses.

description:
We're hiring a Head of Growth at DREAMS 🎬

DREAMS is building India's home for AI-made films, series and micro-dramas, in Hindi, Hinglish and regional languages. Our studio puts out new stories every week. What we need now is the person who makes all of India find them.

The brief is simple and huge:

→ Take our socials from 12K to 500K followers across Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, X and LinkedIn, with YouTube alone at 100K+

→ Make watchdreamsapp.in a site that converts, not just one people visit

• Our content calendar and release strategy for every film and series drop

• App store presence, onboarding and retention experiments, working directly with product

• A content machine behind you. Most growth leads beg for content. You'll have an AI studio making trailers, reels, episodes and characters every day, and you decide what gets made for growth.

• Real ownership from day one. No layers, no committees. You report directly to the founder, and your ideas ship the same week.

• Milestone bonuses, paid out as we hit follower, install and revenue targets together.

• A budget to test with, and the freedom to kill what doesn't work.

• You build the team. As we scale, you hire the growth and social team under you.

• A career-defining story. Taking a new entertainment brand from thousands to millions is the line on your CV that opens every door after this.

• Work at the edge. AI filmmaking is new, and you'll be marketing something no one in India has marketed before.

You're probably the one if

• You've grown a page, channel, app or brand fast, and can show the before and after

• You live on Reels, Shorts and X, and can tell why something went viral in the first 3 seconds

• You understand the Indian audience beyond the metros: regional, Tier 2 and 3, Hinglish internet

**What you bring :-**
**Must have :-**

* 4 to 8 years of experience in client servicing, account management or client solutions within digital advertising, a media agency, an ad platform or a performance marketing team

* Confident communicator who can hold a client conversation, handle objections and manage demanding agency stakeholders

**Good to have :-**

* Experience on X Ads or other social and video platforms
* Exposure to sectors such as auto, BFSI, gaming, tech or e-commerce
* Existing relationships with agencies or advertisers in North India

**Where You Will Work :-**
Our office is in Gurgaon, and this role requires 3 days a week in the office. Candidates based in Delhi, Noida or nearby are welcome to apply, provided they are comfortable commuting to Gurgaon.
  
  
**Why Aleph :-**
You will work with leading advertisers and agencies on one of the world's most influential media platforms, as part of a team that values ownership, clear thinking and straight talk. You will have room to grow with the India business as it scales.
  
  
**Why Join Us?**
Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.
  
  
We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.
