title: P&L Head- Digital Content Business
description:
Otavo.ai is the hiring agency and is hiring on behalf of their client

**Title**
: P&L Head – Digital Content Business

**Location**
: Aerocity, Delhi

**Reports to:**
Leadership

**Compensation:**
₹80–90 LPA

**Experience Required:**
12+ years

**About the Hiring Company**

(Name will be revealed to shortlisted candidates only after evaluating fit)

A corporate-backed media and entertainment company — one of India's leading FM networks — operating across broadcast radio, digital podcasting and content production, and expanding its digital entertainment business.

**The Role**

We are looking for a P&L Head to take full ownership of revenue, costs and profitability for the digital content business. You will lead growth and financial strategy, working across Content, Product, Growth and Finance and reporting to leadership and investors.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Take full ownership of revenue, costs and profitability.
* Drive content investment ROI, pricing strategy, partnerships and forecasting.
* Manage growth while controlling burn and improving unit economics.
* Lead cross-functional teams including Content, Product, Growth and Finance.
* Prepare and own reporting and the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) for leadership and investors.

**What We're Looking For**

* A P&L owner or business unit head role, accountable for revenue, costs and profitability.
* Ownership of pricing strategy for a product or business.
* Led a business through growth while reducing burn or improving unit economics.
* Owned the AOP and business reporting to leadership or investors.

**Must Haves:**

Managed content investments or content budgets and tracked their ROI.

Led revenue partnerships or strategic partnerships.

Worked in a digital entertainment, media or content business.

**Why This Opportunity?**

This is an opportunity to own the full P&L of a growing digital entertainment businessbacked by an established media brand, with direct visibility to leadership and investors.

**About the Hiring Agency**

Otavo.ai is a global AI-driven platform focused on senior recruitment for roles ranging from 40L to 2 Cr in compensation. Founded by serial entrepreneur Mahak Garg, a Stanford MBA and Forbes Under 30 honoree, the company builds on her prior experience scaling Udayy with leading global investors. Otavo.ai currently partners with 30+ fast-growing companies worldwide to address their senior talent hiring needs. The platform maintains a curated network of 10,000+ high-performing candidates with 5–20 years of experience, including alumni from top global schools and leaders across marketing, product, and strategy in major firms and startups. For each open role, Otavo.ai provides a small set of pre-vetted, well-matched candidates rather than long lists of low-fit profiles, enhancing hiring efficiency and quality.

title: RevOps & Automation Specialist
description:
BeFiSc is a financial data intelligence and risk technology company helping businesses

make safer, faster, and smarter decisions. We work with organizations across Fintech,

BFSI, Insurance, Digital Lending, and Financial Services.

Our core focus is Fraud Prevention, Risk Analysis, and Financial Data Intelligence.

Using technology, APIs, data analytics, and large-scale data processing, we help businesses

detect suspicious patterns, assess customer and transaction risks, verify identities and

businesses, and turn complex financial data into actionable insights.

Our solutions support critical use cases including customer onboarding, underwriting,

fraud detection, identity and employment verification, financial analysis, due

diligence, and risk monitoring.

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced and technically strong RevOps & Automation Specialist

to lead advanced data management, reporting, automation, and CRM analytics activities.

The ideal candidate should have expert-level knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets

formulas, report and summary preparation, Google Apps Script, and code-based web

scraping. The candidate should also have hands-on experience with Zoho CRM

administration, report creation, dashboards, workflows, and CRM data management.

The role requires a combination of analytical thinking, technical expertise, problem-solving

ability, and ownership to improve data quality, reporting efficiency, business visibility, and

operational productivity.

Key Responsibilities

1. Advanced Reporting & Data Analysis

● Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, monthly, and customized MIS reports,

management summaries, and business performance reports.

● Analyze large datasets and convert raw data into meaningful business insights and

actionable summaries.

● Develop automated reporting systems, KPI trackers, performance reports, and

management dashboards.

● Identify trends, anomalies, data gaps, and performance improvement opportunities.

● Present complex data in a structured, accurate, and easy-to-understand format for

management and internal stakeholders.

2. Advanced Excel & Google Sheets

● Demonstrate expert-level knowledge of Excel and Google Sheets formulas and

advanced data handling.

● Work extensively with complex formulas, including ARRAYFORMULA, QUERY,

FILTER, INDEX-MATCH, XLOOKUP, VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, LET,

dynamic arrays, and other relevant functions.

● Build advanced Pivot Tables, data models, automated summaries, reconciliation

reports, and reporting templates.

● Optimize formulas and spreadsheets for performance when handling large datasets.

● Develop reusable reporting frameworks, validation rules, conditional formatting, and

data quality checks.

3. Automation & Google Apps Script

● Develop, maintain, and optimize Google Apps Script solutions for reporting, data

processing, validation, and operational automation.

● Automate repetitive manual tasks, reporting workflows, data updates, notifications,

and tracking systems.

● Create custom functions, triggers, scheduled jobs, and integrations using APIs where

required.

● Troubleshoot script failures, improve execution efficiency, and maintain reliable

automation.

● Document scripts, workflows, dependencies, and troubleshooting procedures.

4. Code-Based Web Scraping & Data Extraction

● Code-Based Web Scraping & Data Extraction

● Develop and maintain code-based web scraping solutions using Python and relevant

libraries/frameworks.

● Extract company, business, and Point of Contact (POC) information from permitted

and appropriate online sources.

● Automate data collection, enrichment, cleaning, validation, and structuring.

● Handle pagination, dynamic web pages, structured data, and extraction challenges

using suitable technical approaches.

● Implement error handling, logging, deduplication, and data validation mechanisms.

● Follow applicable privacy, data protection, website terms, and access restrictions; do

not bypass CAPTCHAs, authentication, or anti-bot controls.

5. Zoho CRM Administration & Analytics

● Manage and maintain Zoho CRM configurations, modules, fields, layouts, users,

roles, profiles, permissions, and related settings.

● Create and maintain customized CRM reports, dashboards, KPI trackers, and

management summaries.

● Configure workflows, field mappings, validation rules, assignment rules, and

automation as required.

● Manage CRM data quality, duplicate records, account/contact ownership, and data

consistency.

● Support CRM data imports, exports, bulk updates, migration, and reconciliation.

● Analyze sales pipeline, lead performance, account activities, conversion metrics, and

team productivity.

● Troubleshoot CRM issues, support users, and coordinate with internal teams or Zoho

Support for advanced requirements.

● Maintain CRM documentation and follow data access and governance standards.

6. Data Mining & Database Management

● Plan and execute company and POC data research, mining, enrichment, and

validation activities.

● Maintain structured, accurate, and relevant company and contact databases.

● Identify and eliminate duplicate, outdated, invalid, and mismatched records.

● Prepare segmented datasets for sales prospecting, business development, and

marketing campaigns.

● Ensure adherence to defined data quality standards and internal DND requirements.

7. Team Coordination & Process Improvement

● Coordinate with Sales, Business Development, Marketing, Product, IT, and

Management teams.

● Understand business reporting requirements and translate them into technical

solutions.

● Identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements in reporting, automation, and

CRM processes.

● Guide junior team members on formulas, reporting standards, data quality, and

process execution.

● Take ownership of assigned projects, timelines, deliverables, and issue resolution.

Required Skills

● Expert-level MS Excel and Google Sheets knowledge, including advanced formulas

and reporting techniques.

● Strong expertise in MIS reporting, business summaries, data analysis, and

dashboard development.

● Practical experience in Google Apps Script automation.

● Strong coding knowledge in Python for web scraping and data processing.

● Hands-on Zoho CRM administration experience.

● Proven ability to build custom reports and dashboards in Zoho CRM.

● Understanding of CRM workflows, modules, fields, permissions, data management,

and automation.

● Strong database management, data cleaning, validation, and reconciliation skills.

● Analytical thinking, problem-solving, attention to detail, and ownership.

● Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Required Qualifications & Experience

● Bachelor’s degree is mandatory.

● 1–4 years of relevant experience in data mining, lead generation, online research,

database management, or a similar role.

● Demonstrated hands-on experience in advanced Excel/Google Sheets reporting and

automation.

● Practical experience developing Google Apps Script solutions.

● Experience in Python-based web scraping and data extraction.

● Hands-on Zoho CRM administration, reporting, and dashboard development

experience.

● Ability to manage large datasets and multiple business requirements independently.

● Proven track record of process automation, reporting improvements, or CRM

optimization.

Preferred / Good to Have

● Experience in FinTech, NBFC, BFSI, lending, or financial services.

● Experience with Zoho CRM APIs, Deluge, webhooks, and third-party integrations.

● Knowledge of SQL, REST APIs, JSON, and data integration.

● Familiarity with Salesforce CRM or other CRM platforms.

● Experience in building management dashboards and automated MIS reporting

frameworks.

● Experience mentoring junior team members and managing cross-functional projects.

Key Performance Areas

● Accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of management reports and summaries.

● Reliability and efficiency of reporting automation.

● Reduction in manual reporting effort and repetitive operational tasks.

● Quality and performance of Excel/Google Sheets reporting solutions.

● Effectiveness and reliability of web scraping and data extraction solutions.

● Accuracy, consistency, and usability of Zoho CRM reports and dashboards.

● CRM data quality, process compliance, and resolution of data issues.

● Timely delivery of assigned projects and stakeholder requirements.

● Contribution towards productivity improvement and team development.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is technically strong, analytical, proactive, and detail-oriented, with the

ability to independently handle complex reporting, automation, data extraction, and CRM

administration requirements.

The candidate should be comfortable converting business requirements into practical

technical solutions, managing multiple priorities, troubleshooting problems, and taking

end-to-end ownership of deliverables.

Why Join BeFiSc?

● Build and work on high-impact, data-driven products used by financial

institutions.

● Solve complex problems in fraud detection, risk assessment, and financial

intelligence.

● Work with large-scale data, APIs, analytics, and modern technologies.

● Take ownership and responsibility from an early stage.

● Work in a fast-paced environment where ideas can quickly turn into real

products.

● Learn directly from real-world financial use cases and continuously grow with

the company.

title: OOH & DOOH Consultant
description:
**Role Description:**

The OOH & DOOH Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in New Delhi, responsible for planning, executing, and monitoring out-of-home (OOH) and digital out-of-home (DOOH) campaigns that promote the practice’s legal services and brand visibility. This role involves coordinating with vendors and media owners to identify suitable outdoor and digital signage locations, negotiating placements, and ensuring timely installation and maintenance of all media assets. The executive will manage campaign calendars, track performance metrics, and prepare regular reports on reach, engagement, and effectiveness. Day-to-day tasks include content briefing for creative assets, collaborating with internal stakeholders to align campaigns with legal service offerings, and maintaining compliance with local advertising regulations and guidelines. The role also requires on-ground checks, documentation of campaign execution, and continuous optimization of OOH and DOOH strategies to support business growth.

**Qualifications**

* Strong understanding of OOH and DOOH media planning and buying, including site selection, vendor coordination, and campaign execution.
* Skills in marketing and brand communication, with the ability to translate legal service offerings into clear, impactful outdoor and digital messaging.
* Experience in campaign tracking, performance analysis, and reporting, using basic analytics tools and structured documentation practices.
* Excellent organizational and time-management abilities, with attention to detail and capability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with internal teams, media partners, and external stakeholders.
* Comfort with on-site field work, including regular site visits and verification of installations and displays.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Media, Business, or a related field; experience in legal or professional services marketing is an advantage.
* Proficiency in office productivity tools (such as spreadsheets and presentation software) and basic familiarity with digital signage technologies.

title: Account Manager
description:
**Designation - Account Manager | Branding & Digital Marketing**

Brandeur Global Pvt. Ltd. | Inderpuri, New Delhi | Full-time, work from office

Experience: 5+ years of relevant agency experience

**Immediate joining**

**About Brandeur**

Brandeur is a branding, design and digital agency with over 13 years of experience across B2B and B2C sectors. Our work spans brand strategy, identity, packaging, websites and digital communication. We work closely with clients as strategic partners and brand custodians.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for an experienced Account Manager who can independently manage client relationships and drive projects from brief to delivery. The role requires an understanding of brand communication, strong project management skills and the ability to coordinate content, design, development and digital teams.

You should be comfortable managing multiple accounts, reviewing work thoughtfully and taking ownership of timelines, quality and follow-through.

**Key Responsibilities**

* *Client and account management*

·      Understand each client’s business, audience, objectives and agreed scope.

·      Lead routine client meetings, document decisions and communicate clear next steps.

·      Translate requests and feedback into actionable briefs; manage expectations around inputs, revisions and timelines.

·      Identify concerns early, recommend solutions and involve senior team members when needed.

* *Project planning and delivery*

·      Manage branding, packaging, website and digital projects from onboarding through completion.

·      Break projects into tasks, milestones and approval stages, coordinating resources with the relevant team leads.

·      Work closely with designers, content specialists, developers, video teams and external partners.

·      Track progress, follow up on dependencies and flag delays with a practical recovery plan.

·      Review deliverables against the brief before sharing them with clients.

* *Brand strategy and creative collaboration*

·      Conduct focused business, audience and competitor research to support briefs and recommendations.

·      Work with the brand consultant to translate strategy into messaging, content and creative direction.

·      Coordinate identity, packaging, presentations and marketing collateral, maintaining consistency across touchpoints.

·      For packaging, coordinate approved copy, dielines, dimensions and production requirements with the relevant specialists.

·      Present creative work and its rationale clearly to clients.

* *Website project management*

·      Coordinate website objectives, sitemap, content, design, development and launch milestones.

·      Collect client inputs, consolidate feedback and maintain clear revision and approval records.

·      Work with developers and content teams to check content accuracy, mobile responsiveness, links, forms and agreed functionality.

·      Coordinate final delivery, access information and maintenance requirements.

* *Social media and digital communication*

·      Coordinate content calendars, campaigns and approvals with the social media team.

·      Review content and creatives for brand alignment, factual accuracy and adherence to the brief.

·      Support shoot planning through clear objectives, content requirements and team coordination.

·      Coordinate email and WhatsApp communication where included in the account’s scope.

·      Review campaign reports with the team and follow through on agreed improvements.

* *Platforms and campaigns management*

·      Use Meta Business Suite and relevant Google tools for account and campaign coordination.

·      Manage or coordinate basic boosting and approved campaigns, checking objectives, audiences, budgets and schedules.

·      Coordinate permissions and troubleshoot routine access or campaign issues with the appropriate support.

·      Liaise with external marketing partners and learn established workflows on tools such as Mailchimp, Klaviyo and Interakt.

* *Brandeur marketing and documentation*

·      Support selected internal initiatives, including newsletters, hiring campaigns, portfolio updates and lead-generation coordination.

·      Maintain organised project trackers, briefs, approvals, account information and working/final files.

·      Document recurring processes and share knowledge so colleagues can provide cover when needed.

·      Participate in planning and review meetings, providing clear updates and raising issues proactively.

**What we're looking for**

·      At least five years of relevant experience in a branding, advertising, design or digital agency.

·      Proven ability to manage multiple clients and projects independently, with practical exposure to branding and website delivery.

·      Strong written and spoken English, including clear briefing, presentation and client communication skills.

·      Sound organisation, prioritisation, attention to detail and problem-solving ability.

·      Working knowledge of Meta and Google tools, spreadsheets, shared drives and project trackers.

·      A collaborative approach, willingness to learn and dependable ownership of work.

Experience across B2B and B2C accounts, WordPress/Shopify projects, packaging production or email/WhatsApp marketing would be valuable.

To apply

Send your CV and a brief summary of relevant accounts and projects to
**info@brandeur.in**
, including your current location, notice period and earliest joining date.

title: Architectural Communications Manager
description:
at Rethinking The Future, New Delhi
  
  
**Position:**
Architectural Communications Manager
  
  
**Location:**
Nirman Vihar, New Delhi
  
  
**Salary:**
25,000 INR to 40,000 INR per month
  
  
**Job Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Rethinking The Future (RTF)**
is the fastest growing platform for architecture & design online. Our mission is to empower design professionals to build better buildings, better products, better cities, and a better world.
  
  
At
**Rethinking The Future (RTF)**
, we are passionate about creating a meaningful impact in the architectural community. We are looking for a dynamic, detail-oriented
**Architectural Communication Manager**
to join our team and help us expand our national and international presence.
  
  
In this role, you will shape our communication strategy, manage media relations, and create content that resonates with the architectural world. We’re looking for someone passionate about architectural events, with a strong network to connect us to global conferences and meetups. You will also collaborate with leading architectural brands, fostering partnerships to enhance our platform and industry presence.
  
  
**Your Role**

* Public Relations: Develop and implement PR plans, build relationships with media professionals, architects and craft compelling press releases, speeches, and press materials.
* Social Media Management: Create and manage engaging content for platforms like Instagram and LinkedIn, enhancing our studio’s online presence.
* Brand Collaboration: Build relationships with architectural product and material brands, inviting them to collaborate on meaningful projects and features on our platform.
* Strategic Growth: Leverage your national and international network to provide access to architectural conferences and events, fostering stronger connections within the community.
* Monitoring & Feedback: Track the performance of PR campaigns and social media efforts, analyzing their effectiveness and adapting strategies to achieve the best outcomes.

**Who You Are**

* A strong communicator with excellent written and spoken English.
* Organized, detail-oriented, and skilled in time management.
* Passionate about architecture, design, and cultural initiatives.
* Proactive, collaborative, and eager to explore diverse aspects of work.
* Experienced in the architectural communication industry (1–3 years preferred).

**What We Offer**

* A collaborative and creative work environment where your ideas and contributions matter.
* Hands-on learning opportunities in management and communication.
* A workplace that values a healthy environment, fostering personal and professional growth.
* Competitive compensation of ₹25,000–₹40,000/month based on your skills and experience.

**Skills And Qualifications**
We are looking for a candidate with a positive and adaptable attitude who can both work independently and contribute to collaborative cross-functional teams. The ideal candidate will have
  
  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Design , Communications, Journalism, Public Relations or a related field.
* Proven experience in communications or related roles.
* Proficiency in content creation for social media platforms.
* Excellent marketing skills and experience in client dealing.
* Attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

**About RTF**

* We’re a media company with deep roots in architecture and design. Rethinking The Future lives online and offline, we regularly collaborate with innovative cultural organizations around.
* We approach our work with equal parts analysis and creativity. We’re a multi-disciplinary team working together to unlock the value of the built environment.
* Rethinking The Future is a wonderful place to work. If you’re passionate about the built environment, this is an opportunity to work with a team of committed and resourceful people who share your passion!

**Architectural**
**Communications Manager**
is a
**full-time**
,
**paid position**
, and
**based in Nirman Vihar, New Delhi**
.
  
  
**How To Apply**
If this resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you! Please send the following to
**hello@re-thinkingthefuture.org**
with subject ‘Application for Architectural Communications Manager’:
  
  

* Cover letter
* CV
* Portfolio or a link to your online portfolio
* Possible date of joining if selected

Join us at
**RTF**
and be part of a team dedicated to pushing boundaries in architectural communication and creating something extraordinary for the design world. We can’t wait to welcome you!

title: Video Editor and Graphic Designer
description:
**Company Description**

**Niyat Studios, Films & Productions, based in C.R. Park, New Delhi, is a professional hub for photography, videography, filmmaking, and customizable studio setups. The company handles diverse projects, including fashion photography, influencer shoots, event coverage, social media campaigns, portfolio shoots, and product photography. Backed by a team of skilled photographers, videographers, and choreographers, Niyat Studios has built a distinguished client portfolio featuring brands like Taj Palace (New Delhi), IHCL, Vivanta, and Zoya. The studio is known for delivering high-quality visuals tailored to clients’ creative needs.**

**Role Description**

**We are seeking a full-time Video Editor & Graphic Designer**
to join our dynamic team on-site at our South Delhi studio. This hybrid creative role involves both post-production video editing and graphic design for digital and print platforms.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for editing high-quality videos for social media campaigns, brand films, influencer content, advertisements, and event coverage. In addition, the role includes designing visual assets such as logos, branding materials, thumbnails, promotional creatives, social media posts, and marketing collateral.

Daily responsibilities include:

* Editing and assembling raw footage into polished, engaging video content
* Adding motion graphics, transitions, sound design, subtitles, and color grading
* Designing graphics aligned with brand guidelines and campaign objectives
* Collaborating closely with photographers, videographers, and the creative team
* Ensuring all deliverables meet quality standards and deadlines

This role requires strong creative thinking, storytelling ability, technical proficiency, and attention to detail to produce visually compelling content across formats.

**Qualifications**

* Proficiency in video editing and graphic design principles
* Strong expertise in the Adobe Creative Suite, including:
* Adobe Premiere Pro
* Adobe After Effects
* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe InDesign
* Adobe Lightroom
* Solid understanding of typography, layout, and branding
* Knowledge of color correction, audio syncing, and motion graphics
* Strong visual storytelling skills
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines
* Experience working in photography or videography environments is a plus
* Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, Film, Media, or a related field preferred
* If you are passionate about storytelling through both motion and design and thrive in a fast-paced studio environment, we’d love to hear from you.

Please share your best portfolio / work with us.

title: Social Media Marketer & Performance Marketer
description:
Job Description: Social Media Manager (1+ Year Experience)

**Company:** Events Chakra  
**Location:** South Delhi  
**Experience Required:** 1+ Year  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About Events Chakra

Events Chakra is a dynamic event management and experiential marketing company specializing in creating memorable events, brand activations, corporate gatherings, and social experiences. We are looking for a creative and enthusiastic Social Media Manager to strengthen our digital presence and engage our audience across multiple platforms.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage and grow social media accounts across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
* Create, schedule, and publish engaging content including posts, reels, stories, and videos.
* Develop monthly content calendars aligned with marketing campaigns and business objectives.
* Write compelling captions, hashtags, and social media copy.
* Coordinate with graphic designers, photographers, and event teams to generate high-quality content.
* Cover live events and create real-time social media updates.
* Monitor social media trends, competitor activities, and audience engagement.
* Respond to comments, messages, and inquiries in a timely manner.
* Track and analyze social media performance metrics and prepare monthly reports.
* Assist in planning and executing influencer collaborations and digital campaigns.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field.
* Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience in social media management.

**Reporting:**

**About the Role**

We're looking for someone who can write, shoot, edit, design, think, curate, and move fluidly between storytelling formats and platforms. Someone who understands that communication for a design university isn't just about captions or calendars — it's about cultural literacy, visual fluency, and the ability to craft seamless narratives that reflect what's happening in the world and on campus.

You'll wear multiple hats here: writer, photographer, video editor, designer, event coordinator, creative collaborator, trend spotter. If you're deeply curious, perpetually online in the best way, can hold a conversation about everything from Satyajit Ray to street style to semiotics — and know how to frame a shot and cut a story together — keep reading.

**What you will do**

● Write and edit across all platforms: social media, website copy, press releases, campaign scripts. Your writing should adapt to the medium and audience — Instagram captions aren't blog intros aren't press releases.

● Shoot and edit content: You'll be on the ground capturing moments — events, campus life, student work, faculty interviews. Then you'll edit those into Instagram Stories, Reels, YouTube videos, or whatever format the story demands. You should know composition, lighting basics, and how to make a phone or DSLR work for you.

● Design when needed: Create social media posts, story graphics, email headers, or quick visual assets using Canva, Photoshop, or Illustrator. You don't need to be a senior designer, but you should have an eye for layout, typography, and brand consistency.

● Curate video and visual narratives: Work with internal and external design and video partners to develop concepts, write briefs, and ensure the final output has both aesthetic integrity and narrative clarity. You should know what a good edit looks like and be able to articulate why.

● Manage events with a storytelling lens: From Convocation to campus visits to the Graduate Show — you'll help plan, coordinate, document, and amplify. You're not just logistics support. You're thinking: What's the story here? How do we capture and tell it before, during, and after?

● Stay contextually aware: You should know what's trending, what's being talked about, what movements are shaping culture — and how (or whether) IIAD should respond. Pop culture, design discourse, social issues, global and local — all of it informs how we communicate.

● Generate ideas, not just execute them: We need someone who can pitch concepts for campaigns, suggest content series, and spot opportunities to insert IIAD into larger cultural conversations. You're not waiting for a brief — you're co-creating it.

● Collaborate across departments: Regular touchpoints with faculty, students, admissions, program heads, and external agencies. You're gathering stories, aligning messaging, and ensuring that what we say actually reflects what we do.

● Track, analyse, refine: Monitor engagement, performance, and sentiment across platforms. Use insights to evolve our approach — what's resonating, what's not, and why.

**Who You Are**

You're a cultural omnivore.

You read books. You watch films (and not just the ones everyone talks about). You notice design in everyday spaces. You have opinions about typography, about casting choices, about how cities are planned. You're curious about history, geography, mythology, subcultures. You connect things that don't obviously connect.

You're a natural storyteller across mediums.

You can craft a narrative arc across platforms — an Instagram Reel isn't just a video, it's part of a larger conversation. You understand pacing, tone, visual rhythm, and context. You know when to be formal and when to be conversational. You know how a story changes when it's written vs. filmed vs. designed.

You're contextually switched on.

You know what's happening — culturally, socially, politically. You can spot a meme reference, understand a design movement, explain why something went viral. You're online, but critically so.

You're exhaustingly multi-skilled.

Writing? Yes. Photography and video? Absolutely. Basic graphic design? Of course. Event coordination? Sure. Video ideation, shooting, and editing? That too. Giving feedback to external designers? Yes. Spotting a typo in a 40-slide deck at 6pm? Unfortunately, also yes.

You're a self-directed learner.

You don't wait to be taught. You pick up tools, platforms, and skills as needed. If tomorrow we need to figure out a new platform, a new tool, or a new format — you're the person who dives in first.

**Technical skills you MUST have:**

● Fluent writing and editing in English

● Photography skills (phone + DSLR/mirrorless)

● Video shooting and editing (Instagram Stories, Reels, YouTube — basic to intermediate level)

● Graphic design software: Canva (essential), Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator (strong plus)

● Social media platforms and native analytics (Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube)

● MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

**Technical skills that are a BIG plus:**

● Advanced video editing (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, CapCut)

● Motion graphics (After Effects basics)

● Figma or other design collaboration tools

● Email marketing platforms (Mailchimp, etc.)

● Understanding of SEO, content strategy, and digital storytelling

25-35k (Negotiable and commensurate with skills and qualifications.)

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
**About Exotel:**

Exotel is one of Asia's largest customer communication platforms. We are on a mission to move enterprise customer communication to the cloud. In 2020, we powered over 4 billion calls and connected over 320 million people. We work with some of the most innovative companies such as Ola, Swiggy, Zerodha, Whitehat Jr, Practo, Flipkart, GoJek, etc. We also power customer communication for some of the top banks in the country. Join us on this journey to improve how companies approach customer communication.

**About the Role:**

As a Senior Manager - Digital Marketing, you will own Exotel's digital demand engine end to end: organic, paid and marketing automation, measured on pipeline and revenue, not just traffic.

This is a hands-on role. You will set the strategy, build and coach the team, manage budgets and agencies, and still get into the data and campaigns yourself. You will work closely with Product Marketing, Sales, SDRs and RevOps to turn website visitors into qualified pipeline across our markets.

**What will you do:**

1. Organic growth (SEO, content, AI search)

* Own the SEO strategy across technical SEO, on-page, content and link building for exotel.com and product pages.
* Build a high-intent content engine: comparison pages, use-case pages, pricing and integration pages, and thought leadership.
* Grow visibility in AI search (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity) through structured content, original data and authority building.
* Run organic social and community programs, especially on LinkedIn, together with leadership and PMM.

2. Paid media (performance marketing)

* Plan, run and optimize campaigns on Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta and programmatic/ABM platforms.
* Own the paid budget, with clear targets for CPL, cost per SQL, CAC and ROAS by market and product.
* Run continuous experiments on audiences, creatives, landing pages and bidding.
* Build ABM and retargeting programs for enterprise and mid-market target accounts with Sales.

3. Marketing automation and CRO

* Own the marketing automation stack (HubSpot, Marketo or similar) and its integration with the CRM.
* Design lead capture, scoring, routing and nurture journeys across email and WhatsApp.
* Improve website and landing-page conversion through A/B testing and CRO.
* Keep data clean: UTMs, lifecycle stages, consent and compliance.

4. Analytics and attribution

* Set up full-funnel reporting from visit to lead, MQL, SQL, opportunity and revenue.
* Own attribution and report channel ROI and pipeline contribution to leadership every month.
* Use data to shift budget and effort to what works.

5. Leadership and collaboration

* Align with Sales, SDRs, PMM, Product and RevOps on targets, ICP and messaging.
* Build quarterly plans and budgets, and present results to leadership.

**What are we looking for:**

* 7–10 years in digital marketing, with at least 4 years in B2B SaaS, CPaaS, telecom or enterprise tech.
* A proven record of growing organic traffic and leads, with numbers to show for it.
* Hands-on experience managing paid budgets across Google and LinkedIn, with ownership of CPL, CAC and ROAS.
* Deep hands-on experience with a marketing automation platform (HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot or similar) and CRM integration (Salesforce, Zoho or HubSpot CRM).
* Strong analytics skills: GA4, Search Console, Looker Studio or similar; comfortable with funnel and attribution analysis.
* 2+ years managing people or agencies.
* Clear communicator who can present results and plans to senior leadership.

**Good to have:**

* Experience marketing an API, developer or contact-center product.
* Experience running campaigns across several markets (India, SEA, Middle East).
* Hands-on with AI search optimization (GEO/AEO) and AI tools for content and campaign work.
* ABM platforms such as 6sense, Demandbase or LinkedIn ABM.
* SEO tools such as Ahrefs or Semrush; CRO tools such as VWO, Hotjar or Optimizely.
* Basic SQL, or comfort working with BI teams on data.

ABOUT INDOBANYAN

Indobanyan Brands Pvt Ltd is a Noida-based house of Indian consumer brands: Kothi Decor (handcrafted brass and home decor), Happy Banyan (curated gift boxes), Divine Banyan (pooja essentials) and IVEI (desk and craft products). The Social Media Manager builds and runs our social media presence for home decor and gifting brands, starting with one brand. The role owns strategy, the content calendar, creator briefs, community management, collaborations and reporting, with the aim of growing an engaged audience that converts to sales on the website and marketplaces. The focus is organic growth; paid promotion is planned jointly with the performance marketing team.

Team: in-house content creators, graphics and video editor (shared)

Location: C-159, Sector 44, Noida 201301

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Define the social media strategy per brand: audience, content pillars, platforms (Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Pinterest, LinkedIn brand pages), posting cadence and tone

- Plan and run the weekly content calendar; brief in-house content creators and the video editor every week; review and approve content before posting

- Write hooks, captions, scripts and calls to action in English and Hinglish; maintain brand voice

- Manage community: respond to comments and DMs within the day, route purchase enquiries to sales, collect and repost customer content

- Run creator and influencer collaborations (barter and paid): identify, negotiate, brief, track deliverables and results; target 15 to 20 collaborations a month

- Coordinate with the performance marketing lead on which organic content goes paid, and with the B2B team on LinkedIn content for corporate buyers

- Support founder-led content on LinkedIn: ideas, drafts, clips

- Maintain the content library, scheduling tool, hashtag and trend research

REQUIREMENTS

- Graduate; 3 to 5 years managing social media for a consumer brand, in-house or at an agency, with results you can show

- Has grown at least one account substantially through organic content and can explain what worked and why

- Strong writing in English and Hinglish; short-form video sense

- Reads Instagram and YouTube analytics without help and acts on them

- Has briefed and managed creators, designers or editors

- Comfortable with Canva or Adobe basics, a scheduling tool and simple video edits

PREFERRED

- Home, decor, gifting, lifestyle or festive category experience

- Influencer seeding programmes at scale

- Basic Meta Ads understanding, enough to read results

- Pinterest and YouTube long-form experience

HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED

- Follower and reach growth against an agreed monthly target

- Save and share rate on posts; DM-to-order conversions

- Collaborations completed per month and their reach

- Calendar delivered on time every week

TERMS

Full-time, on payroll. Probation 3 months. 18 paid leaves a year after probation. Notice period 15 days during probation, 30 days after.

HIRING PROCESS

A 10-minute phone screen, then one 45-minute round at the office: 5 reel ideas with hooks for one of our brands prepared the night before, 15 minutes to present, one live hook rewrite, then 15 minutes on past results with numbers. Decision within 48 hours. title: Senior Growth Manager
description:
**About Moloco:**
Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet. Founded in 2013 by machine learning engineers who had built AI advertising systems inside the world's largest technology companies, Moloco began from a shared mission: to build that same engine for the open internet.
  
  
Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system.
**Moloco Ads**
is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet.
**Moloco Commerce Media**
is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by
**CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture)**
, the AI system behind every Moloco product.
  
  
At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer.
**Come build what's next.**
**The Impact You'll Be Contributing to Moloco:**
Join Moloco as a Senior Growth Manager and help advertisers grow their mobile businesses. Moloco Ads is an AI-native performance advertising platform that helps app marketers acquire and re-engage high-value users across the open internet, optimising campaigns towards measurable business outcomes.
  
  
You’ll build a deep understanding of each client’s business, shape their growth strategy, and work with colleagues across Sales, Marketing, Data Science, and Product to turn insights into better performance and lasting partnerships.
  
  
This role is based in Gurgaon, with a hybrid working model.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**

* Develop a deep understanding of clients’ businesses and marketing objectives, and show how Moloco Ads can help achieve them.
* Build a clear, data-driven strategy for each client, taking ownership of account performance and long-term growth.
* Partner with Sales, other Growth Managers, Data Science and cross-functional teams to improve campaign performance and grow client accounts.
* Lead client relationships, meetings and business reviews, building trust through clear communication and actionable recommendations.
* Analyse campaign data, translate complex findings into clear insights, and use them to guide client decisions.
* Identify and recommend opportunities to expand client investment in line with growth objectives.
* Work with GTM, Product, and Data Science to improve products and client solutions, bringing client needs and feedback into the process.
* Look beyond individual campaigns to identify recurring challenges, address root causes and develop approaches the wider team can use.
* Stay informed about developments in the mobile advertising ecosystem and translate relevant trends into practical advice for clients.

**How Do I Know if the Role is Right For Me?**

* 6+ years of experience in mobile advertising account management, with experience in programmatic marketing.
* A track record of managing and growing major advertiser accounts.
* Hands-on experience in day-to-day campaign management and optimisation.
* Familiarity with mobile measurement partners (MMPs), the mobile app ecosystem and advertising technology, alongside confidence working with large datasets.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into compelling stories, clear recommendations and effective client presentations.
* Sound commercial judgment: you use data and client context to recommend next steps, explain trade-offs and adapt as new information emerges.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills: you bring clients and cross-functional partners into the work early, communicate recommendations clearly and build alignment across different perspectives.
* A strong sense of ownership and a curious, proactive approach to solving problems.
* Attention to detail and a data-driven approach to decision-making.
* Adaptability, initiative and a willingness to learn in a fast-moving environment.
* Fluency in English.
* Flexibility to travel according to business needs.

**Supporting Your Best Work and Your Best Life:**
Our benefits are designed to support our people in doing their best work and living well, at work and beyond. Benefits vary by country, employment type, and eligibility. Connect with a recruiter to learn more about benefits in your region.
  
  
**Moloco Values:**

* Lead with Humility: Everyone’s voice is respected, valued, and heard. We win, lose, and learn together. Accountability and feedback are essential to our success.
* Uncapped Growth Mindset: We see all situations as opportunities to learn, grow, and improve as individuals and as an organization. We seek diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and promote experimentation to push the boundaries of what’s possible.
* Create Real Value: We pursue the most impactful opportunities with intensity and rigor. We take intelligent risks and make disciplined trade-offs to maintain deep focus. We help our customers win by delivering durable value.
* Go Further Together: We’re one team working towards one vision. We collaborate proactively and inclusively, involving the right people at the right time and in the right way. We strive to create a more equitable workplace. We won’t let each other fail.

**Additional Resources:**

* Moloco Company Blog
* Moloco Leadership
* Moloco Newsroom

Please review our AI Use in Interviews Policy before your interview to understand what to expect. Failure to comply with this policy may impact your candidacy.

title: Content Manager
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
We are looking for a highly driven
**Digital Content & Influencer Marketing Manager**
who can build brands through compelling content, creator partnerships, and social-first storytelling. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience managing influencer campaigns at scale, creating high-performing digital content, driving social media engagement, and collaborating with media teams to amplify content performance.
  
  
This role requires a blend of creativity, cultural awareness, analytical thinking, and strong execution skills to deliver measurable business impact across the marketing funnel.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Influencer Marketing**

* Lead end-to-end influencer marketing programs across Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms.
* Build and manage a diverse network of creators, influencers, celebrities, and domain experts.
* Identify, evaluate, and shortlist influencers based on audience fit, engagement, relevance, and campaign objectives.
* Execute large-scale influencer campaigns involving macro, micro, nano, and regional creators.
* Negotiate partnerships and manage agency relationships.
* Develop influencer briefs, content guidelines, and approval workflows.
* Measure campaign effectiveness through reach, engagement, video views, sentiment, search lift, traffic, and conversions.

**Content Strategy & Creation**

* Develop platform-first content strategies tailored to consumer behavior and business objectives.
* Create and manage content calendars across social and digital channels.
* Drive production of reels, short-form videos, static creatives, creator collaborations, and branded content.
* Translate consumer insights, trends, and cultural moments into engaging content ideas.
* Ensure content aligns with brand voice, category regulations, and marketing priorities.

**Social Media Management**

* Manage brand presence across social platforms.
* Monitor trends, conversations, and emerging content formats.
* Work closely with community management teams to drive engagement and advocacy.
* Track social performance and continuously optimize content strategies.

**Media & Content Amplification**

* Partner with media teams to drive content distribution and performance.
* Understand paid media fundamentals across Meta, YouTube, Google, and programmatic platforms.
* Recommend content amplification strategies including creator whitelisting, partnership ads, and paid social.
* Leverage media insights to improve content effectiveness and audience targeting.

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Establish clear KPIs for influencer and content campaigns.
* Analyze campaign performance and generate actionable insights.
* Monitor competitor activities, creator landscape, and industry trends.
* Present performance reports and recommendations to key stakeholders.

Why you?
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:
  
  

* 4-5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Content Marketing, Social Media, or Influencer Marketing.
* Proven track record of executing influencer campaigns at scale.
* Strong understanding of the Indian creator ecosystem.
* Excellent knowledge of Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and emerging social platforms.
* Understanding of social media algorithms, content formats, and platform best practices.
* Familiarity with paid media and content amplification strategies.
* Experience with social listening and influencer discovery tools.
* Strong storytelling, copywriting, and communication skills.
* Proficiency in analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite, YouTube Analytics, etc.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, agencies, and projects simultaneously.

**Preferred Qualifications**
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:
  
  

* Experience in FMCG, Consumer Healthcare, Consumer Tech, Beauty, or Lifestyle categories.
* Experience working with influencer marketing platforms and measurement tools.
* Familiarity with AI-powered content creation tools.
* Exposure to performance marketing and commerce-led content.
* Brand /Agency side experience

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
A social-first marketer who understands that great content, the right creators, and smart media amplification work together to drive brand growth. Equally comfortable discussing a reel concept, influencer shortlist, KPI framework, or media optimization plan.
  
  
**Job Posting End Date**
2026-11-12
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
  
  
**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
  
  
**Note to candidates**
The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

description:
**Your Next** **Opportunity** **Starts Here**
---------------------------------------------

Join a team that's shaping the future of Advertising & Beyond. At Xapads, you'll work alongside people who challenge convention, embrace innovation, and build AI-powered technologies that help brands connect with audiences across the globe. Whether you're an engineer, marketer, strategist, or storyteller, your ideas have the opportunity to make a real impact. We believe great work is driven by curious minds, collaborative teams, and the freedom to build what's next.

We never ask for payments or fees as part of our hiring process. If you receive any suspicious communication or would like to verify a job opportunity, please contact us at career@xapads.com.

  

**Job Information**
-------------------

* Date Opened 11/03/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry Digital Marketing & Social Media
* City Noida
* State/Province Uttar Pradesh
* Country India
* Zip/Postal Code 201301

**Job Description**
-------------------

### **ABOUT XAPADS MEDIA**

  

Xapads Media is a leading global AdTech company delivering innovative digital advertising solutions to brands, agencies, and app developers worldwide. With a global presence of 200+ employees across multiple international offices, Xapads combines technology, data insights, and market expertise to drive high-impact advertising outcomes.

Recognized as a Great Place to Work for five consecutive years and ranked among the Top 100 Companies for Women, Xapads is committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture that values professional growth, operational excellence, and workplace diversity.

### **ABOUT THE SEGMENT**

The Social Media and Brand Communications team builds global awareness, authority, and engagement across all Xapads product lines and international markets. The team simplifies complex programmatic, advertising technology, and publisher monetizing concepts into sharp, compelling narratives across social media, digital campaigns, executive thought leadership, and corporate communications.

### **THE ROLE**

The Copywriter will strengthen Xapads’ brand and social communication capabilities by creating clear, engaging, and persuasive content across global digital channels. Operating as a core creative storyteller, this person will translate complex AdTech products, business objectives, and campaign briefs into impactful copy that highlights Xapads’ value proposition. The role independently owns content from brief interpretation and research through drafting, executive ghostwriting, editing, and final publishing handoff while maintaining strong brand consistency across all platforms.

### **WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* **End-to-End Content Ownership:** Own assigned content deliverables from brief interpretation and independent research through drafting, editing, fact-checking, and final handoff.
* **Social & Campaign Messaging:** Own social media copy, campaign narratives, ad copy, and pitch messaging across global brand initiatives.
* **Executive & Brand Voice:** Own executive ghostwriting and thought-leadership communications, capturing leadership perspectives in a credible, authentic tone.
* **Brand Consistency:** Ensure consistent brand voice, terminology, narrative quality, and clarity across all digital channels and client-facing presentations.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Campaign & Social Copywriting:** Create compelling copy for social media platforms, brand campaigns, advertising materials, PR initiatives, award submissions, and client pitches.
* **AdTech Simplification:** Translate technical AdTech, programmatic, mobile performance, and digital advertising concepts into clear, accessible, and creative communications.
* **Long-Form & Thought Leadership:** Develop long-form articles, case studies, blogs, and executive ghostwritten pieces for leadership LinkedIn profiles and industry publications.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with design, social media, marketing, product, SEO, sales, and executive leadership to brainstorm creative concepts, messaging strategies, and campaign plans.
* **Editing & Quality Assurance:** Edit and refine content to preserve accuracy, logical flow, proper grammar, brand voice, and clear calls-to-action.
* **SEO & Workflow Optimization:** Apply foundational SEO principles to web and long-form content while utilizing AI-assisted tools responsibly to support research and workflow efficiency.

### **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* **Relevant Experience:** 1–3 years of professional copywriting or content writing experience in an agency (creative/digital) or in-house marketing setting. A strong portfolio showcasing creative storytelling and campaign execution is essential.
* **Core Writing & Grammar Skills:** Exceptional command of American English grammar, vocabulary, structural editing, and proofreading.
* **Executive Ghostwriting Capability:** Demonstrated ability to interview leaders or subject-matter experts and translate raw inputs into credible, well-structured thought-leadership posts.
* **Research & Fact-Checking:** Strong ability to research unfamiliar B2B or technical topics, verify claims independently, and explain complex subjects simply.
* **Adaptable Tone:** Ability to tailor voice, messaging depth, and calls-to-action based on target audiences, digital platforms, and business goals.

### **GOOD TO HAVE**

* **Industry Background:** Prior copywriting experience in B2B technology, SaaS, digital advertising, ad-tech, or programmatic media ecosystems.
* **Agency Background:** Hands-on experience working in creative or digital marketing agencies.
* **SEO & AI Familiarity:** Basic knowledge of search intent, keyword integration, and experience leveraging AI tools for content research and workflow support.

  

**Life at Xapads Media:**

At Xapads Media, we place a strong emphasis on employee growth and continuous development. Individuals are encouraged to build expertise, take ownership of their work, and explore areas that align with their interests over time.

Our culture supports collaboration, knowledge sharing, and open communication. Teams engage in ongoing discussions, exchange ideas, and contribute to broader conversations across the business.

We also value moments that bring teams together-recognising achievements, sharing progress, and building a sense of collective momentum.

To learn more about our culture and ways of working, visit: https://www.xapads.com/life-at-xapads

  

**HOW TO APPLY**

To apply for this position, send an email to our careers mailbox (career@xapads.com). In the email make sure to include your resume and any additional information you would feel relevant for this role.

title: CRM & Lifecycle Executive

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a CRM Executive, Growth & Marketing to support customer engagement and lifecycle execution.

You will be responsible for executing CRM campaigns across key customer journeys, helping drive user activation, engagement, repeat usage, and reactivation through targeted, data-informed communications.

This is a hands-on role focused on campaign execution, segmentation support, and multi-channel communication, working closely with the Growth, Creative, and Product teams to ensure a consistent and effective customer experience across all touchpoints.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, execution-driven, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where testing, data, and continuous improvement guide daily work.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Execute onboarding campaigns to help new users complete their first ride.
* Support retention and engagement campaigns to increase ride frequency and repeat usage.
* Run reactivation campaigns targeting inactive or low-usage users based on defined segments.
* Support lifecycle communications for premium subscribers, including engagement and renewal messaging.
* Execute CRM campaigns across push notifications, in-app messages, WhatsApp, SMS, and email.
* Set up and schedule campaigns using CRM and engagement platforms.
* Build and maintain customer segments based on behavioral and usage data.
* Support A/B testing of campaign messaging, timing, and creatives.
* Support referral and loyalty campaign execution.
* Monitor campaign performance and prepare basic reports with key insights.
* Work closely with creative and content teams to ensure timely and accurate campaign execution.
* Ensure CRM data accuracy, campaign QA, and proper execution across all platforms.
* Assist in maintaining campaign calendars and execution timelines.
* Support improvements to automated journeys under the guidance of the Growth & Marketing Manager.

**Qualifications**

* 4 to 6 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle, or marketing execution, ideally in a B2C or app-based business.
* Experience executing multi-channel campaigns across push, in-app, WhatsApp, SMS, and email.
* Hands-on experience with a CRM or customer engagement platform.
* Comfortable building segments and working with behavioral and usage data.
* Strong attention to detail, with solid campaign QA and execution discipline.
* Ability to interpret campaign performance and turn it into simple, useful reporting.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work well with creative, content, and product teams.

**Bonus Points For**

* Experience in ride-hailing, mobility, or app-based businesses.
* Hands-on experience with Braze.
* Familiarity with HubSpot.
* Experience in mobility, on-demand, or marketplace apps.
* Exposure to lifecycle automation and journey building.
* Familiarity with subscription or membership engagement.

* Hands-on experience with Odoo.

**What we offer**

* Direct exposure to the Australian e-commerce market.
* Real ownership of the numbers in a growing online business.

Send your CV and answer the following:

6. Confirmation that you can work the advertised schedule.

title: Founder's Office Intern - Strategy & Growth
description:
**About Dosbros & Divine Brands**

Divine Brands Pvt. Ltd. is the company behind DosBros Fresh Mexican Grill India, bringing the bold flavours of a US-origin Mexican QSR brand to the Indian market.

DosBros has
**60+ locations globally across the USA, India and Canada**
, with an expanding presence in India.

We are on an ambitious journey to build DosBros into one of India's leading Mexican QSR brands, with a strong focus on expansion, brand building, innovation, strategic partnerships and business growth.

As we scale across cities and explore new business opportunities, we are looking for an ambitious and entrepreneurial individual to work directly with the Founder and senior management.

**About the Role**

This is a high-ownership, generalist internship for someone who wants to understand how businesses are built, scaled and funded.

You will act as
**Entrepreneur in Residence**
and will work across business strategy, growth initiatives, brand management, marketing, fundraising and business development. You will be involved in evaluating new opportunities, coordinating strategic projects, strengthening brand presence, supporting investor outreach and helping convert business plans into execution.

This is not a conventional desk internship. We are looking for someone who can think independently, work with data, communicate effectively, manage multiple priorities and take ownership of outcomes.

**Think like an entrepreneur. Operate like a business owner. Execute with ownership.**

**Key Responsibilities1. Strategy & Business Growth**

* Work directly with the Founder and senior management on strategic initiatives, business planning and growth strategies.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis and feasibility assessments to evaluate new business opportunities.
* Identify new revenue streams, business models and expansion possibilities.
* Assist in preparing business plans, financial models, management reports and presentations.
* Track business performance, analyse data and convert findings into actionable recommendations.

**2. Brand Management & Marketing**

* Contribute to strengthening DosBros' brand positioning, brand value, market presence and overall awareness across India.
* Work with external marketing consultants and the internal team to strategize, coordinate and follow up on marketing campaigns, promotional activities and brand-building initiatives, tracking timely execution and deliverables.
* Support new product launches, menu innovations, existing product promotions and seasonal campaigns, coordinating with restaurant teams for effective on-ground implementation and customer engagement.

**3. Fundraising & Investor Relations**

* Research and identify suitable investors, including angel investors, HNIs, family offices, strategic investors and funds interested in consumer, food and beverage, retail or brick-and-mortar businesses.
* Build and maintain a structured investor database and outreach pipeline, and support initial investor communication and follow-ups.
* Assist in preparing and refining investor presentations, fundraising proposals, financial models, unit economics and business expansion plans.
* Coordinate investor meetings, maintain communication records and support the fundraising process, including information sharing and due-diligence coordination.

**4. Business Development & Strategic Partnerships**

* Support franchise development, franchise partner coordination and expansion initiatives across India.
* Explore corporate partnerships, catering opportunities, packaged meals and institutional business opportunities.
* Coordinate with food delivery aggregators such as Zomato and Swiggy, POS providers, technology partners, franchise partners and other external stakeholders.
* Identify and evaluate strategic partnerships, new business models and opportunities to generate additional revenue.
* Manage business discussions, follow-ups and execution coordination with external partners.

**5. Project Management & Execution**

* Take ownership of assigned business projects and drive them from planning through execution.
* Coordinate cross-functional initiatives involving marketing, finance, supply chain, technology and business development teams.
* Track project timelines, identify execution bottlenecks and follow up with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure timely implementation of management decisions and strategic priorities.
* Prepare progress updates, reports and presentations for the Founder and senior management.

**Who Should Apply?**

We are looking for someone who:

* Has an entrepreneurial mindset and a genuine interest in startups, business strategy and company building.
* Is comfortable working in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.
* Takes ownership and follows through without requiring constant supervision.
* Has strong analytical, research, problem-solving and communication skills.
* Can manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Is comfortable with business research, Excel-based analysis, presentations and external stakeholder coordination.
* Is proactive, resourceful, detail-oriented and execution-focused.

Previous exposure to a Founder's Office, CEO's Office, business strategy, business operations, fundraising, investor relations, marketing or management consulting will be an advantage, but is not mandatory.

Freshers and candidates with 0–2 years of experience are welcome to apply if they demonstrate strong initiative, ownership and entrepreneurial thinking.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Management, Engineering or a related field.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint and Google Workspace.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok.
* Strong research, documentation, presentation and analytical abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to prepare business reports, investor presentations, research documents and analytical summaries.
* Interest in business strategy, fundraising, consumer brands and the food and beverage industry.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Direct Founder Exposure:**
  Work closely with the Founder on strategic business priorities and growth decisions.
* **Business-Building Experience:**
  Understand how a multi-outlet consumer business operates, expands and raises capital.
* **Fundraising Exposure:**
  Participate in investor research, outreach, fundraising preparation and investor coordination.
* **Cross-Functional Learning:**
  Work across strategy, marketing, brand management, business development and finance.
* **High Ownership:**
  Take responsibility for meaningful projects and see your work translate into business outcomes.
* **Career Growth:**
  Opportunity to be considered for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) or full-time role based on performance.

**Internship Structure & Compensation**

* **Duration:**
  6 months.
* **Probation:**
  First 15 days of the internship.
* **Stipend:**
  ₹14,000 per month + performance based bonus upto ₹10,000.
* **Working Hours:**
  11:00 AM – 8:00 PM, Full time, work from office
* **Joining:**
  Immediate joiners only.

A PPO or full-time employment opportunity will be offered to high-performing interns, subject to their contribution, performance.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should email their updated CV along with a short cover letter or introduction explaining:

1. Why they are interested in working in a Founder's Office.
2. Their interest in strategy, business growth, marketing or fundraising.
3. Any relevant projects, internships or experiences demonstrating ownership and execution ability.
4. Why they believe they would be a good fit for this role at Dosbros India.

**Email:**
admin@dosbros.in

**CC:**
pratham.dsbs@gmail.com

**Subject:**
Application – Founder's Office Intern Strategy & Growth – Ahmedabad

**Important:**
Only candidates who are available to join immediately or within a few days should apply.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager
  

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Work Location:**
Mannarkkad, Palakkad, Kerala

Experience: 4–6 Years

**Reporting To:**
CEO

1. About Obraz

Obraz is a technology-driven organisation focused on delivering innovative software and AI-powered solutions that help businesses improve efficiency, streamline operations and achieve better business outcomes.

We are looking for a strategic and result-oriented
**Marketing Manager**
with experience in SaaS, AI and Computer Vision (CV) domains to lead our marketing initiatives, strengthen brand positioning, generate qualified business leads and drive business growth.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of technology-based products, B2B marketing, digital marketing, demand generation and market positioning, along with the ability to translate complex technical solutions into compelling business value propositions.

2. Role Overview

The Marketing Manager will be responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies to increase brand visibility, drive customer acquisition, generate qualified leads and support revenue growth.

The role requires a combination of strategic planning and hands-on execution, along with close collaboration with the Sales, Product and Leadership teams.

3. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Marketing Strategy & Planning

* Develop and implement comprehensive marketing strategies aligned with organisational goals.
* Build and manage quarterly and annual marketing plans, budgets and campaign calendars.
* Identify target markets, customer segments, buyer personas and business opportunities.
* Strengthen Obraz's brand positioning and market presence within the SaaS and AI ecosystem.

B. Digital Marketing & Demand Generation

* Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta and other relevant platforms.
* Drive inbound and outbound marketing initiatives to generate qualified business leads.
* Develop and optimise landing pages, website campaigns and conversion funnels.
* Implement SEO, SEM and performance marketing strategies to improve online visibility.
* Manage email marketing, lead nurturing and marketing automation campaigns.

C. Content & Brand Management

* Develop and execute content marketing strategies across relevant digital channels.
* Oversee blogs, website content, case studies, whitepapers, newsletters and social media content.
* Create compelling marketing communication highlighting product value propositions and customer benefits.
* Ensure consistent brand messaging across all marketing touchpoints.
* Manage social media presence, particularly LinkedIn, to build brand credibility and engagement.

D. SaaS Product Marketing & Go-to-Market

* Understand the company's SaaS products, features, benefits and competitive advantages.
* Develop effective product positioning and messaging for target customer segments.
* Plan and execute go-to-market strategies for new products, features and product enhancements.
* Collaborate with the Product team to translate technical capabilities into customer-focused messaging.
* Identify opportunities to expand product reach and market adoption.

E. Competitive Analysis & Market Intelligence

* Conduct regular competitor research to understand market positioning, pricing strategies, product offerings and marketing approaches.
* Identify key competitors, industry trends and emerging market opportunities within the SaaS, AI and Computer Vision ecosystem.
* Analyse competitor websites, campaigns, content strategies and customer engagement activities.
* Identify Obraz's competitive advantages and develop strategies to strengthen its market positioning.
* Monitor competitor activities and provide actionable insights to support business and marketing decisions.

F. Lead Generation & Sales Collaboration

* Work closely with the Sales team to develop lead generation and customer acquisition strategies.
* Define and monitor the lead funnel from Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) to Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs).
* Develop targeted campaigns to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
* Support sales enablement through presentations, brochures, product collateral and case studies.
* Track marketing contribution to the sales pipeline and business growth.

G. Analytics & Performance Management

* Monitor and analyse campaign performance using relevant analytics tools.
* Track key metrics such as:
* Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs)
* Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs)
* Cost Per Lead (CPL)
* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
* Conversion Rates
* Website Traffic and Engagement
* Marketing ROI
* Marketing-Sourced Pipeline
* Prepare monthly marketing performance reports and recommend improvement strategies.
* Continuously optimise campaigns based on data, insights and business outcomes.

H. Team Building & Management

* Build, manage and scale the marketing team in line with organisational growth requirements.
* Lead, guide and mentor marketing professionals to achieve business objectives.
* Delegate responsibilities, monitor team performance and ensure timely execution of marketing activities.
* Coordinate with external agencies, freelancers and marketing partners.
* Establish effective marketing processes and improve overall team productivity.

4. Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications or a related discipline.
* MBA in Marketing or a relevant postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.
* 4–6 years of relevant marketing experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, AI, Computer Vision or technology-based organisations.
* Prior experience in marketing AI-based products, Computer Vision solutions or other technology-driven products.
* Proven experience in digital marketing, demand generation and lead acquisition.
* Demonstrated ability to plan and execute marketing campaigns with measurable outcomes.
* Experience in marketing strategy, competitor analysis and product positioning.
* Experience in building or managing teams will be preferred.
