title: Digital Marketing Intern
description:
About InstantDM

InstantDM helps creators and businesses grow on Instagram by automating DMs. It sends replies to comments, story replies and messages on its own, so brands can turn engagement into leads and sales without typing every reply.

About the role

You will join a small team and work across all of our marketing, not a single channel. In week one you will be writing. By month two you will own blog posts, SEO tasks and small ad campaigns from start to finish, and you will see the numbers each one brings in.

What you'll do

**Blog and content writing**

* Write blog posts a week on Instagram growth, DM automation, lead generation and creator marketing
* Research keywords and plan each post around what people actually search for
* Write landing page copy, comparison pages, how-to guides and use-case pages
* Update older posts so they stay accurate and keep ranking

**On-page SEO**

* Write title tags, meta descriptions, headings and image alt text
* Add internal links between blog posts, feature pages and pricing
* Find and fix broken links, thin pages and slow pages with tools like Google Search Console and PageSpeed Insights
* Add schema markup (FAQ, How-to, Article) with the dev team

**Off-page SEO**

* Build backlinks through guest posts, outreach, resource pages and partner sites
* List InstantDM on SaaS directories, review sites and tool roundups
* Answer questions on Reddit, Quora and creator communities where it genuinely helps
* Track backlinks and referring domains every month

**Paid ads**

* Set up and run Meta (Instagram and Facebook) and Google Ads campaigns with a senior marketer
* Write ad copy, brief creatives and set up A/B tests
* Watch spend, cost per signup and ROAS every day, and pause what isn't working
* Set up retargeting audiences and conversion tracking

**And more**

* Plan and post on Instagram, LinkedIn and X, including Reels scripts and carousels
* Write email newsletters and onboarding emails
* Help with product launches, Product Hunt and affiliate outreach
* Send a weekly report on traffic, rankings, signups and ad results from Google Analytics 4 and Search Console

What we're looking for

**Must have**

* Strong written English: clear, simple and free of errors
* A basic understanding of SEO: keywords, on-page vs off-page, and how backlinks work
* Comfort using ChatGPT, Claude or similar AI tools to draft and research, plus the judgment to edit the output
* Available full-time, in office, for 6 months
* Final-year student or recent graduate in marketing, mass communication, English, business or a related field (a degree is not required if your work shows the skill)

**Nice to have**

* A blog, Medium page, newsletter or Instagram account you've grown yourself
* Hands-on time with Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Semrush or Ubersuggest
* Any experience running Meta or Google ads, even with a small budget
* Basic Canva or WordPress skills
* Interest in creators, Instagram and SaaS products

What you'll get

* A monthly stipend and a full-time offer for strong performers at the end of the internship
* Real ownership: your posts go live, your campaigns spend real budget, and you see the results
* Daily mentoring from the founders and the marketing team
* Hands-on experience with SEO, paid ads and content at a growing SaaS company
* An internship certificate and a letter of recommendation

title: General Manager, India
description:
Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!
  
  
At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.
  
  
Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.
  
  
Read our blog to learn more.
  
  
**About The Role...**
India is one of Duolingo's most important growth markets. We've operated there for a while, but believe it has much more potential than we've realized so far. We're looking for a seasoned leader to own Duolingo's trajectory in India and build our business in the market. In addition to being a strategic, resourceful, high-influence generalist, we want someone with excellent product sense, built through leading or partnering closely with product teams at global consumer tech companies. You'll set the strategy, build and rally our team on the ground, and serve as India's bridge to our global teams and leaders.
  
  
Your success will be measured on Duolingo's core metrics: user growth and monetization. Like most leaders at Duolingo, you'll work in a matrix. Team members report into their functions, and you'll lead them as one cross-functional team focused on India. Instead of managing a market P&L, you'll spend your time on things that move these core metrics.
  
  
This role is based in our Bangalore office and reports to the Asia Business Lead. We welcome candidates already in India as well as those willing to relocate.
  
  
**🧠 You will...**

* Be responsible for India's strategy and priorities, and accountable for results
* Build and lead an India-based cross-functional team, as well as the culture and operating cadence that hold it together
* Be the voice of India: bridge what's actually true in market and what our global leadership and teams understand about it, and translate company priorities into work that makes sense locally
* Work closely with product teams to shape India-specific product and course improvements
* Influence and align global, cross-functional teams to support the needs of India

**✅ You have...**

* 15+ years of experience in product, growth, or market leadership roles at global, high-growth technology companies
* A track record across both the US and India, credible with leadership abroad and effective on the ground
* Excellent product sense, particularly for how global products get adapted for markets like India
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence without authority, and an understanding of how different stakeholders think
* Experience working effectively with colleagues across different time zones and locations
* A bias toward acting on what you see rather than waiting for someone else to prioritize it
* Analytical and strategic, but also scrappy and willing to roll up your sleeves
* Passion for language education, for building Duolingo's business in India, and appetite for a multi-year bet

**⭐ Exceptional candidates will have…**

* Built a country team from near zero, including its culture and its credibility inside the company
* Adapted an international product for users in developing markets, especially India
* Fluency in one or more Indian languages beyond English

*The offered salary is dependent upon several factors, including work experience, skills, and internal peer comparisons. The posted range is subject to change in the future. For this role, base salary is supplemented by equity compensation. We encourage you to talk with your recruiter for more information related to compensation for this role!*

₹11,969,600—₹17,954,400 INR
  
  
**Benefits:**
Take a peek at how we care for our employees' holistic well-being with our benefits here.

Sign up for job alerts here.

Duolingo is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Head of Product, PhonePe Wealth
description:
**About PhonePe**
At PhonePe our vision is to provide financial inclusion to a billion Indians. Today we have made significant progress on this vision by making digital payments far simpler and ubiquitous than it has ever been. However we wish to make it so easy, safe, and universally accepted that people never feel the need to carry cash or cards again. And not just in Urban India. At PhonePe, our aim is to transform the entire Indian landscape so that every Indian, in every corner of the country, makes significant economic progress. Onwards and upwards! That is our goal.
  
  
**About PhonePe Invest**
PhonePe Invest is rebuilding trading and investing for India. It's a full-stack broking platform — stocks, F&O, ETFs, mutual funds, IPOs, and Wealth Baskets — with a research and intelligence layer (factor analysis on every stock, expert-curated baskets) sitting on top. It's a separate app from the main PhonePe one, and it's backed by PhonePe's reach, trust, and distribution.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Opportunity:**
As a Director of Product at PhonePe Invest, you will own and drive the roadmap for our PhonePe Invest products catering to for first time investors to seasoned traders. This is a hard but interesting product and design problem. You're working with regulated financial products, real money, and a spectrum of users that runs from a first-time investor buying their first stock to an active trader running F&O strategies. The job is to make something genuinely powerful feel calm and trustworthy — not to bolt more features onto a busy screen.
  
  
You will work with other pod members and a diverse set of stakeholders towards a collective set of objectives. We work on complex technology, scale while iterating quickly and have a bias for impact in everything we do. Leading our PhonePe Invest product portfolio, you will be working with leaders in PhonePe ecosystem to determine the portfolio product strategy. You will be responsible for evangelizing and aligning all the cross-functional stakeholders on the strategy and plans and work on the execution and delivery to realize the identified opportunity and impact.
  
  
You'll own all aspects of Product and Design for PhonePe Invest end to end. Today that means you, the craft, and a close partnership with Business, Engineering and regulated ecosystem.This is a hands-on leadership role, not a manage-from-a-distance one. As the product grows, you'll build and lead the team around it.
  
  
You'll set the Product and Design direction, ship the work yourself when it matters, and be the person accountable for the quality of the experience for all the users. You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work alongside the broader PhonePe org.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**As a Director of Product, you will:**

* Define a portfolio product strategy from first principles that becomes the org’s reference point; drives multi-pod execution and measurable portfolio outcomes
* Identify and deliver multiple Annual Operating Plan-shaping bets; consistently make correct profitability vs growth calls across portfolio, shift business trajectory with durable levers (pricing, distribution, unit economics, cost-to-serve)
* Design pod-level org structure and capability plan that materially increases throughput and quality; shape cross-functional Hiring AOP with high accuracy; prevent bottlenecks before they form.
* Build a strong leadership bench; direct reports consistently progress levels. Establish pod-wide talent mechanisms with counterparts that raise performance across functions.
* Design and evolve the pod operating system (planning, decision forums, execution reviews, launch readiness, learning loops) with measurable improvements in reliability and speed.
* Demonstrate thought leadership and be the go to person for product decisions for internal and external stakeholders.
* Engage with external customers and stakeholders, communicate objectives and progress.
* Own the experience. Set the bar for what best looks like on PhonePe Invest, and hold it. Strategy, flows, visual craft, microcopy — you're accountable for all of it.
* Ship, don't just direct. Get into the file. Design the experience for our users e2e to give them maximum efficiency and wow during their financial, investment and trading journeys. Prototype to find the answer rather than arguing about it in a doc.
* Make complex things simple. Turn dense financial data and regulated flows into something a first-time investor trusts and a serious trader respects. This is the core craft of the job.
* Partner closely. Work shoulder to shoulder with Business and engineering as an equal. Bring the user's point of view to roadmap and tradeoff conversations early, not at the end.

**What we look for:**

* Excellent communication skills.
* At least 15+ years of experience in Product / Platform building and development.
* Strong business acumen and ability to partner with cross-functional teams.
* Contributes to business decisions regularly and proactively.
* Can build credibility via knowledge and judgment to persuade others.
* Conducts interviews for PM/SPM roles and for specific competencies.

**Additional Information**
**Culture:**
At PhonePe, we take extra care to make sure you give your best at work, Everyday! And creating the right environment for you is just one of the things we do. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. Being enthusiastic about tech is a big part of being at PhonePe. If you like building technology that impacts millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

title: Business Head - Imaging
description:
**About the Company**

BPL Medical Technologies is a leading Indian medical technology company committed to advancing healthcare through innovative, reliable, and accessible solutions. With a strong legacy and nationwide presence, BPL serves hospitals, clinics, and healthcare providers across India and select international markets.

The company offers a diverse portfolio across patient monitoring, imaging, and critical care, supported by robust manufacturing, service, and distribution capabilities. With a growing installed base and a focus on quality and customer trust, BPL continues to strengthen its position as a trusted partner in healthcare delivery.

Driven by innovation and operational excellence, BPL is focused on building future-ready capabilities and delivering long-term value to customers, partners, and stakeholders.

Get to know about us -
**https://www.bplmedicaltechnologies.com/**

**Role Summary**

A senior business leader to own and grow BPL's imaging modality portfolio, this is a P&L role that also demands genuine technical depth: you'll set commercial strategy and run the business, while staying hands-on enough to engage credibly with clinicians, KOLs, and technical teams on product application, clinical use, and complex deals. You'll bring 10+ years of experience spanning both sales/business leadership and technical or application exposure in the medical device space, along with the seniority to operate as a key member of the leadership team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Ownership & P&L Management**

* Own the P&L for all imaging modality businesses — revenue, margin, and market share targets.
* Define and execute business strategy for each imaging modality segment, in line with overall company goals.
* Drive annual business planning, budgeting, and forecasting across the portfolio.

**Technical & Application Leadership**

* Maintain strong working knowledge of the clinical applications, technology, and competitive positioning of every product in the imaging portfolio.
* Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex deals, large tenders, and key accounts — engaging directly with clinicians, biomedical teams, and KOLs where deep product/application knowledge is needed to close business.
* Guide the Product Specialist and Application teams on technical strategy, ensuring field teams are equipped with accurate, current clinical and technical knowledge.
* Partner with R&D and product management to translate clinical/field feedback into product improvements and new development priorities.

**Portfolio & Market Strategy**

* Shape go-to-market strategy for new and existing imaging modality products, grounded in both commercial and clinical/technical insight.
* Track market trends, the competitive landscape, and customer needs to guide portfolio decisions.
* Represent BPL at key clinical and industry forums, building the company's technical credibility in the market.

**Sales & Channel Leadership**

* Provide leadership and direction to sales, marketing, product, and application teams across the imaging portfolio.
* Build and strengthen channel partnerships, distributor relationships, and key accounts.
* Drive institutional and government business, including tenders, across the imaging modality range — supporting technical bid requirements as needed.

**Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with manufacturing, supply chain, quality, regulatory, and R&D teams to ensure smooth execution.
* Represent the imaging modality business to senior leadership, the board, and external stakeholders.

**Team Leadership & Talent Development**

* Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team across sales, product, application, and marketing functions.
* Foster a culture of accountability, technical rigour, and customer-centricity.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in the medical device / MedTech industry, with significant exposure to imaging modality businesses.
* A track record spanning both business/sales leadership and hands-on technical or clinical application work — someone equally comfortable in a boardroom and at a hospital bedside.
* Proven track record of P&L ownership and driving business growth in a senior leadership role.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams across sales, product, application, and marketing.
* Biomedical engineering, electronics, or related technical degree preferred; an MBA or equivalent business qualification is a strong plus.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong business acumen combined with genuine technical/clinical understanding of the imaging portfolio.
* Excellent leadership and people management skills.
* Deep understanding of the medical device market, regulatory environment, and healthcare ecosystem in India.
* Ability to engage credibly with clinicians, KOLs, and technical stakeholders, not just commercial decision-makers.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Why This Role Matters**

You'll be one of the senior-most business leaders at BPL, with direct accountability for a major share of the company's revenue and growth, gaining:

* Full P&L ownership across the imaging modality portfolio — rare scope at this level.
* A role that blends commercial leadership with real technical depth, rather than one at the expense of the other.
* A direct line to the CEO/MD and a genuine seat at the leadership table.
* The opportunity to build and scale multiple product lines, each with distinct customers, technology, and go-to-market needs.
* The chance to work in a company with real purpose — where stronger business performance translates directly into wider access to quality healthcare.

**Location - Bangalore**

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About Reach**

Reach is the Shopify of telecom. We're a cloud-native, modular, API-first platform that lets any brand, ISP, fintech, or retailer launch a mobile, broadband, or IoT service — without becoming a telco, without legacy complexity, and without the years-long timelines big telco still treats as normal. We cut launches from years to weeks.

We're professional troublemakers. We built what we couldn't buy, and now we run it for the brands we wish had existed when we were on the other side of the table. Everything big telco wasn't: simple, transparent, and human.

Website: https://www.reachplatform.com

**Position Overview**

Location: Bangalore, India • Experience: 4–6 years • Function: Account Management

Our clients aren't buying software — they're betting their connectivity business on us. The Key Account Manager owns that bet.

You'll run a portfolio of our strategic accounts end-to-end: you're the face of Reach for client leadership, the person who knows their business cold, the one who carries the revenue number, and the operator who keeps every account in your book green. The job is relationship-led and operations-tight — deep trust with senior client stakeholders, and the discipline underneath it so nothing in the day-to-day quietly slips. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with product, engineering, ops, and BD.

**What You'll Actually Do**

**Account Management — of course!**

* Own a portfolio of accounts end-to-end — the face of Reach for client leadership and the person their team calls first.
* Build real partnerships with stakeholders across the client's business, product, and ops teams — the kind they invite into the room when it matters, not the kind they cc.
* Run QBRs and strategic planning sessions that the client actually shows up for — you set the agenda for the relationship, you don't just react to theirs.
* Build account plans with sharp objectives, real metrics, honest stakeholder maps, and a 12-month roadmap per client.
* Present updates, reviews, and recommendations to client leadership in language they'd use themselves — not in account-management speak.
* Be the voice of the client inside Reach — surface what they actually need to product, engineering, and leadership, not a polished translation of it.

**Revenue Ownership**

* Carry the revenue number for your book of accounts. This is the KPI — everything else supports it.
* Grow each account — more modules, more integrations, more services — where it makes the client's business better, not just our quarter.
* Own renewals end-to-end — legal, finance, product, and client stakeholders all moving on your timeline, not theirs.
* Work with the BD team to find, qualify, and close new opportunities inside accounts you already own.

**Account Operations**

* Run a weekly account health rhythm — usage, SLAs, open issues, billing, NPS, exec sentiment — and act on what it tells you before the client has to raise it.
* Maintain a live account status (green / amber / red) for your portfolio and drive amber/red accounts back to green with a clear plan, owner, and timeline.
* Orchestrate internal pods across support, ops, finance, and product to close out client issues — you're the single throat to choke on the client side, and you make sure there's a single throat to choke on ours.
* Keep account hygiene tight — contracts, SOWs, contact maps, renewal dates, commercial terms, escalation paths — so nothing falls through a gap that shouldn't exist in the first place.
* Run structured escalations when they happen — fast acknowledgement, clear comms, honest timelines, and a post-mortem that actually changes how we operate next time.

**Product Consulting**

* Advise clients on how to configure and get real value out of the platform. Trusted advisor isn't a title — it's how they describe you to their CEO.
* Turn client business problems into clear product requirements; partner with PMs to shape what gets built.
* Help push the roadmap forward with synthesised client feedback, usage data, and market signal — specific recommendations, not just observations.
* Lead growth conversations — pulling on platform capabilities, integration patterns, and what's working across the rest of the book.

**Program Management**

* Own delivery of client programs — kick-off, go-live, and what happens after.
* Build the implementation plan; manage scope, risks, and dependencies on both sides of the table.

**What You Need to Walk In With**

**Education & Experience**

* Full-time MBA from a Tier-1 B-school (IIM A/B/C/L/K/I, ISB, FMS, XLRI, MDI or an equivalent program).
* Strong academic record — evidence you can think structurally, hold business acumen, and stand up an argument.
* 4–6 years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Strategy Consulting, SaaS/Platform businesses, Product/Program Management, or other relevant client-facing roles.
* A track record of owning client relationships, expansion targets, or multi-stakeholder programs end-to-end.
* Mobile, connectivity, or related platform/SaaS background helps you ramp faster. Not having it doesn't disqualify you — we'd rather hire a great account leader from an adjacent domain than a mediocre one from telecom.

**Cheat Book — What Sets Great Candidates Apart**

* **Account Leadership & Client Management:**
  Builds senior stakeholder relationships, runs QBRs people actually want to attend, creates multi-year account strategies, maps stakeholders effectively, sets expectations early, and handles escalations or conflict with maturity and composure.
* **Strategic & Commercial Thinking:**
  Able to zoom out to understand a client's broader business model while also diving deep into specific account challenges. Comfortable owning revenue across a portfolio through renewals, pricing, expansion, and growth initiatives, backed by strong commercial instinct and execution.
* **Product & Platform Consulting:**
  Advises clients on platform adoption and operational strategy, translates business needs into structured product requirements, and partners closely with product, engineering, operations, and external partners to drive outcomes.
* **Communication & Executive Presence:**
  Clear, concise communicator with strong presentation skills and credibility in executive conversations, including with C-suite stakeholders and senior leadership teams.
* **Cross-Functional Influence:**
  Drives alignment and execution across teams without relying on formal authority — able to move initiatives forward collaboratively and effectively.
* **Ownership, Bias to Action & Comfort with Ambiguity:**
  Thrives in fast-moving environments where structures and playbooks are still evolving. Brings clarity to ambiguity, proactively closes gaps, and takes accountability beyond defined responsibilities.
* **Data-Informed Decision Making:**
  Comfortable analysing data, building simple models, deriving insights, and presenting recommendations to senior audiences in a practical and business-oriented manner.
* **Soft Skills & Judgment:**

  Uses AI tools effectively for research, analysis, drafting, and productivity enhancement, and can thoughtfully incorporate AI-driven thinking into client and operational conversations in a practical, non-gimmicky way.

title: Lead - Distributor Markets
description:
**Company Description**
**About AbbVie**
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
  
  
**Job Description**
Position Summary
  
  
Leads commercial sales for AbbVie products across distributor markets in Bangladesh, Nepal and Sri Lanka, and for a key customer in India. The role is accountable for delivering business objectives through effective distributor partnership, market planning, sales execution, forecasting and compliant customer engagement.
  
  
Working closely with commercial leadership, regional teams, distributors and cross-functional partners, the role translates brand priorities into market-relevant plans, strengthens route-to-market effectiveness and drives high-quality execution. It provides performance governance and actionable market insight while ensuring activities align with AbbVie standards, local regulations and distributor operating requirements.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  
Market Strategy, Business Planning and Distributor Governance
  
  

* Develop and execute commercial plans for Bangladesh, Nepal, Sri Lanka and the assigned key customer in India, aligned with brand priorities, affiliate strategy and regional direction.
* Partner with distributors to translate annual brand and sales objectives into country plans with clear targets, investment priorities, milestones and performance measures.
* Establish and lead distributor governance routines, including business reviews, scorecards, action tracking and escalation processes.
* Identify market opportunities, access challenges, competitive dynamics and execution gaps; translate insights into practical initiatives to improve performance and customer reach.
* Monitor distributor capability, field reach, inventory health, channel coverage and execution quality to support business continuity and sustainable growth.
* Ensure distributor activities comply with AbbVie standards, local regulations, contractual requirements and ethical business practices.
* Maintain a strong understanding of pharmaceutical market dynamics and evolving access, channel and route-to-market models in assigned markets.

Sales Delivery, Forecasting and Performance Management
  
  

* Own sales delivery across assigned distributor markets, track performance against monthly, quarterly and annual objectives, and drive timely corrective action.
* Lead demand-planning and forecasting inputs with Supply Chain, Finance and distributors, ensuring assumptions are evidence-based and reflect market conditions.
* Review sales, inventory and execution measures regularly, identifying risks and opportunities and aligning stakeholders on appropriate actions.

Distributor Operations, Channel Execution and Access
  
  

* Drive effective distributor operations, including order planning, product availability, secondary-sales visibility, claims processes and resolution of operational issues.
* Strengthen channel coverage and route-to-market execution by identifying priority accounts, institutions, hospitals, wholesalers and customer segments with distributors.
* Partner with Medical, Regulatory, Market Access, Supply Chain, Finance and Compliance to enable market initiatives with appropriate governance and documentation.
* Ensure commercial activities, field-force support, promotional materials and distributor-led execution are consistent with approved plans, brand strategies and compliance requirements.
* Build distributor capability through structured performance reviews, execution coaching and reinforcement of AbbVie ways of working.
* Represent market performance, risks and opportunities in affiliate and regional forums, providing leadership with timely visibility and recommendations.

Customer Engagement, Field Execution and Capability Building
  
  

* Enable distributor field teams to execute approved brand priorities through high-quality customer engagement, clear call objectives and disciplined follow-through.
* Coordinate training and capability-building activities to strengthen distributor teams’ understanding of AbbVie products, relevant therapeutic areas, compliance expectations and customer engagement standards.
* Work with Commercial and Medical colleagues to prioritise key-account engagement, congress activities, scientific initiatives and local programmes within approved frameworks.
* Use field activity, customer feedback and market intelligence to improve execution, close capability gaps and focus resources on high-value opportunities.

Market and Sales Planning and Analysis
  
  

* Provide quantitative and qualitative market insights to support financial planning, S&OP, forecasting, brand planning and long-range planning for assigned markets.
* Recommend commercial strategies involving route-to-market improvements, channel priorities, access opportunities, pricing inputs, promotional investment, distributor capability and targeted customer engagement.
* Analyse sales trends, secondary-sales data, inventory movement, account performance and competitive intelligence to evaluate initiatives and inform course corrections.

Leadership and Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with distributors, commercial teams and cross-functional stakeholders to develop and execute plans across complex distributor-led markets.
* Use sales, inventory, forecast and execution metrics to assess performance and course-correct activity.
* Influence distributors, regional colleagues and affiliate stakeholders without direct authority.
* Drive accountability, collaboration and results across multiple markets and operating models.

Main Contacts
  
  

* Commercial Director, Business Unit Director, General Manager, Brand Teams and Sales and Marketing Leads
* Distributors and distributor field leadership in Bangladesh, Nepal and Sri Lanka
* Finance, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Medical, Compliance and Market Access teams
* Regional Commercial teams

**Essential Skills And Competencies**

* Commercial leadership and a hands-on approach to shaping market strategy and driving disciplined execution through distributors.
* Strong understanding of ethical sales and marketing practices, compliance requirements and customer-focused engagement in healthcare.
* Strategic planning, budgeting, forecasting and business acumen, with the ability to connect market insight, customer needs, access priorities and operational execution.
* Knowledge of distributor management, route-to-market models, sales execution, inventory monitoring, forecasting and performance management.
* Strong leadership, interpersonal, negotiation and influencing skills, with the ability to build trust and align internal and external stakeholders.
* Analytical, numerical, creative and conceptual thinking, including the ability to translate data and market intelligence into clear commercial choices and measurable actions.
* Strong personal effectiveness, including prioritization, responsiveness, flexibility and resilience; able to work with limited supervision and exercise sound judgment about when to consult, escalate or inform.
* A track record of driving growth, strengthening partner accountability, fostering innovation and delivering customer and business impact in distributor markets.

AbbVie Behaviours and Values
  
  

* Seizes market opportunities through insight-led decisions, identifying customer, channel and distributor priorities to deliver sustainable impact.
* Collaborates across local, regional and distributor teams, prioritizing resources to achieve commercial objectives.
* Builds trusting relationships, understands customer needs and embeds customer-focused practices in distributor operations and field execution.
* Develops strategic networks and partnerships, communicates with energy and clarity, and builds commitment to shared success.
* Adapts to uncertainty and change, works effectively with ambiguity and anticipates evolving market, access and channel needs.
* Acts with integrity and authenticity, promotes trust, remains receptive to others’ ideas and demonstrates self-motivation, creativity, accountability and innovation.

**Qualifications**
Education and Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Medical, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences, Business Administration or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification in business, management or marketing is an advantage.
* 12–15 years of progressive experience in the healthcare or pharmaceutical industry, preferably in a multinational organization, with significant experience in sales, distributor management, commercial operations, market planning or channel execution.
* Experience managing distributor-led or emerging markets; South Asia experience, including Bangladesh, Nepal and Sri Lanka, is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, manage external partners, coach distributor teams and build execution discipline across matrix and third-party environments.
* Experience in sales planning, forecasting, budget management, distributor governance, key-account engagement, access coordination and compliant commercial execution.
* Fluency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders and external partners in a multicultural environment.

Additional Information
  
  
AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives and serving our community.  Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.
  
  
US & Puerto Rico only - to learn more, visit https://www.abbvie.com/join-us/equal-employment-opportunity-employer.html
  
  
US & Puerto Rico applicants seeking a reasonable accommodation, click here to learn more:
  
  
https://www.abbvie.com/join-us/reasonable-accommodations.html

title: Innovation Head
description:
**Role: Innovation Lead**

**About Pakka Limited**

At Pakka Ltd, we are committed to sustainable innovation, creating eco-friendly packaging solutions that align with the needs of modern businesses. With over 40 years of manufacturing excellence and a strong R&D foundation, we have been revolutionizing three major segments: Wrap & Carry, Food Services and Flexible Packaging. Join us to shape the future of packaging and make a meaningful impact.

**Mission of the Role**

Lead Pakka’s Innovation and Business Centre to replace plastic at scale while building profitable revenue. Own the centre’s business performance, funding, innovation portfolio and strategic partnerships; connect scientific innovation with customer adoption, commercial scale-up and measurable environmental impact. Advance Pakka’s mission to revolutionise food packaging solutions for a cleaner planet.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Own the centre’s P&L, funding strategy, financial planning and commercial performance, ensuring that tonnes of plastic replaced grow alongside revenue and profitability.

2. Set the innovation and business roadmap across rigid food-service packaging, flexible packaging and waste valorisation, selecting projects that meet Pakka’s mission filter: home-compostable or paper-stream-recyclable solutions.

3. Allocate budgets, people and resources across the Customer, Science, Commercialization, Proof, Ecosystem and establish clear decision rights, project gates, priorities and performance reviews.

4. Build and convert anchor customer relationships and global partnerships with brands, QSRs, converters, manufacturers and technology providers; translate customer needs into viable innovation and licensing opportunities.

5. Lead commercialisation and licensing strategy, including final licence terms, supply partnerships, tiered royalties and cost-down pathways that improve competitiveness with conventional plastics.

6. Provide strategic technical direction through strong understanding of cellulose chemistry, material science, formulations, manufacturing processes and application requirements, enabling cross-disciplinary problem-solving.

7. Drive disciplined innovation lifecycle management from concept and minimum viable product through testing, customer trials, pilot validation and scale-up; ensure timely delivery, cost control and corrective action.

8. Use emerging technologies, simulation, data analytics and AI-enabled approaches to evaluate options, improve formulations, strengthen process performance and reduce ecological impact.

9. Build partnerships with research institutes, universities, certification bodies, startups and suppliers; protect an open research and startup budget of 10–15% of centre income in line with the proposed operating guardrails.

10. Establish systems for intellectual property creation and protection covering formulations, designs and processes; oversee external validation, certification and relevant regulatory and sustainability requirements.

11. Build a high-performing, multidisciplinary team and a culture of ownership, independent decisions, experimentation, competency-based development and accountability for outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* Materials Science / Fiber Science / Polymer Science
* Chemical Engineering / Pulp & Paper Technology
* Sustainable Packaging / Industrial Biotechnology / Green Chemistry
* Related disciplines with strong R&D focus
* A postgraduate qualification in a relevant technical or business discipline is advantageous.

**Experience**

·
**Business Leadership:**
15–20 years of experience in specialty chemicals, paper, packaging or related industries, including 5+ years in business leadership with P&L responsibility, financial management and commercialization.

·
**Technical & Innovation Expertise:**
Strong knowledge of cellulose chemistry, biomaterials, manufacturing processes, product development, technology scale-up, IP management and innovation strategy.

·
**Global Exposure & Partnerships:**
Proven experience working with international customers, technology partners and research institutions, including participation in global conferences, exhibitions and industry events to drive collaborations and business opportunities.

·
**Strategic Thinking:**
Expertise in technology scouting, digital tools, AI applications, data-driven decision-making and developing commercially viable sustainable solutions.

·
**Leadership & Collaboration:**
Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, manage budgets, develop strategic partnerships and drive cross-functional innovation programs.

**Success Measures**

Tonnes of plastic replaced; profitable revenue and centre profitability; number of customers converted; delivery of commercial innovations; and progress in cost competitiveness and impact.

**Long-Term Outcomes (2030 Ambitions in Role Profile)**

· Create rigid ready-to-eat meal packaging solutions supporting sales of over 200,000 tonnes per year.

· Build effective flexible packaging solutions for snacks and confectionery supporting sales of over 300,000 tonnes per yr

· Achieve process excellence with valorisation of all solid waste and zero liquid discharge.

**What We Offer**

This role offers the opportunity to shape Pakka’s sustainable packaging innovation agenda, build a multidisciplinary business and science ecosystem, and translate new materials and technologies into measurable environmental and commercial impact. The position offers leadership scope, collaboration with global partners and opportunities for professional growth. Compensation and benefits will be discussed during the hiring process.

**To Apply:**

If you are passionate about leading innovation that replaces plastic at scale while building a sustainable, profitable business, send your CV and cover letter to Lakshmi.vikram@pakka.com.

Join us to shape the future of sustainable packaging!

The role involves working with product managers, business managers and engineering leaders to convert the business idea/vision into a development roadmap

The successful individual ensures that the platform transformations meet the evolving needs of risk management through continual innovation, global/flexible design for new use cases to fuel growth, reduce time to market and manage losses. Requires strong organizational, technical and creative problem-solving skills. Requires strong stakeholder management and ability to influence across multiple levels of leadership. Must work well in a dynamic, complex environment and under deadline pressures. Propagates architectural flows and governance to a set of scrum teams and/or SAFE trains to deploy the new business features across markets and products for risk management.

**Responsibilities**
**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Create architectural blueprints for business initiatives to ensure consistency across markets and products, track progress to move from legacy to future state platform
* Defining the architecture roadmap and deployment plan, working to ensure that risk processes and platforms are moving in right direction

title: Market Deployment & Adoption Manager
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Market Deployment & Adoption Manager to join the Delivery, Deployment & Adoption capability within Haleon's Commercial Digital Services organisation. Based in India, this role is responsible for leading the successful deployment, adoption, and value realization of digital products and capabilities across global markets.
  
  
Operating at the intersection of product delivery teams, market leadership, commercial stakeholders, and change management specialists, the Manager plays a pivotal role in ensuring digital solutions are effectively embedded into business processes and ways of working. The role is accountable for developing adoption strategies, managing deployment readiness, mitigating adoption risks, and ensuring markets realise measurable business outcomes from digital investments.
  
  
The successful candidate will provide leadership across multiple deployment initiatives, partnering with market teams, product squads, Value Assurance teams, and senior stakeholders to drive adoption at scale. This role requires a blend of strategic thinking, operational execution, change leadership, data-driven decision making, and stakeholder influence.
  
  
This position is critical to accelerating Haleon's digital transformation by ensuring markets not only deploy new capabilities successfully but also achieve sustained behavioural change and business value.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deployment & Adoption Leadership
* Lead the deployment and adoption strategy for digital products and capabilities across multiple markets and business functions.
* Partner with market stakeholders, Product Managers, Deployment Leads, and Value Assurance teams to develop and execute market-specific adoption plans.
* Establish deployment governance, success measures, and escalation processes to proactively manage adoption risks and dependencies.
* Ensure market readiness activities are completed successfully and aligned to deployment timelines, business priorities, and operational constraints.
* Drive consistency in deployment and adoption practices across markets while allowing for local market requirements and nuances.
* Adoption Performance & Insights
* Own the measurement and reporting of adoption, utilisation, engagement, and behavioural change outcomes for deployed solutions.
* Develop and oversee dashboards, performance scorecards, and executive reporting that provide visibility to adoption performance and business impact.
* Analyse adoption trends and usage patterns to identify opportunities, risks, and areas requiring intervention.
* Establish leading indicators and success metrics that enable early identification of at-risk markets and deployment challenges.
* Provide actionable recommendations to senior stakeholders based on quantitative data and qualitative feedback.
* Change Management & Market Enablement
* Lead change, communication, and adoption activities that support successful market transitions and behavioural change.
* Ensure deployment plans include effective stakeholder engagement, communications, learning, and enablement strategies.
* Coordinate adoption activities across concurrent initiatives to minimise change saturation and conflicting demands on markets.
* Partner with change specialists and market teams to develop targeted interventions that increase user engagement and capability uptake.
* Champion user-centric approaches that improve the effectiveness and sustainability of digital adoption efforts.
* Stakeholder & Market Relationship Management
* Build strong relationships with market leadership teams and key business stakeholders to understand priorities, challenges, and adoption barriers.
* Act as a trusted advisor to markets on deployment readiness, adoption performance, and value realization opportunities.
* Facilitate governance forums, deployment reviews, and stakeholder discussions to ensure alignment and effective decision making.
* Influence senior stakeholders to drive accountability for adoption outcomes and ensure business ownership of change initiatives.
* Escalate and resolve deployment and adoption challenges that may impact business outcomes or programme objectives.
* Value Realisation & Continuous Improvement
* Ensure adoption strategies are aligned with business value targets and expected benefits from digital investments.
* Monitor adoption performance against value KPIs and identify areas of value leakage or underperformance.
* Partner with Value Assurance teams to define corrective actions and intervention plans where benefits are not being realised.
* Lead continuous improvement efforts by capturing lessons learned and embedding best practices across deployments.
* Drive feedback loops between markets, deployment teams, and product squads to improve future releases and deployment approaches.
* Team Leadership & Capability Development
* Provide leadership, coaching, and direction to analysts, deployment specialists, or project resources supporting deployment and adoption activities.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, customer focus, and data-driven decision making.
* Contribute to the development of deployment, adoption, and change management capabilities across the organisation.
* Support the evolution of standards, methodologies, tools, and frameworks that strengthen Haleon's deployment and adoption maturity.

**Qualifications & Experience**
**Basic Qualifications :**

* Significant experience leading deployment, adoption, change management, or business transformation initiatives within digital or technology-enabled programmes.
* Proven experience managing complex stakeholder relationships across global markets and cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights and strategic recommendations.
* Demonstrated experience leading adoption and behavioural change initiatives that drive measurable business outcomes.
* Experience influencing and communicating effectively with senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Strong programme coordination, governance, and risk management capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**
:
  
  

* Experience leading large-scale global digital transformation or deployment programmes.
* Experience within consumer healthcare, healthcare, FMCG, or related industries.
* Knowledge of behavioural science, organisational change management, and user adoption methodologies.
* Experience with adoption analytics and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery models, product operating models, and value realization frameworks.
* Experience leading or mentoring team members within a deployment, adoption, or transformation environment.

**Job Posting End Date**
2026-11-23
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
  
  
**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
  
  
**Note to candidates**
The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

description:

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Proven experience in product life cycle management and new product launches.
* Strong ability to build and execute marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
* Experience in market research, insight generation, and commercial analysis.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, with the ability to create compelling presentations and robust analyses.
* Working understanding of digital marketing and social media campaign planning and execution.
* Strong business acumen with experience supporting planning, forecasting, and business case development.

Additional Information

* Customer-centric mindset

* Execution excellence and accountability

* Stakeholder management and relationship building
* Adaptability and agility in a fast-paced environment
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Innovation and continuous improvement mindset

* Demonstrate ownership, initiative, and sound judgment in managing the portfolio.

**Additional Requirements**

title: Director of Sales And Business Development
description:
Axiro Semiconductor

Axiro Semiconductor is a fabless semiconductor design company headquartered in Bengaluru, driving innovation in RF, wireless infrastructure, satellite communication (Satcom), and high-speed connectivity solutions. Backed by CG Power & Industrial Solutions Ltd. part of the 120-year-old Murugappa Group. Axiro represents India’s leap into the global semiconductor arena. With millions of chips already powering global networks, a world-class team across India, the US, and Europe, and cutting-edge expertise spanning RF, mmWave, GaN, and next-generation communication technologies, Axiro is engineering the future of how the world connects, computes, and communicates.

Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced
**Director of Sales**
to lead and scale our global sales organization, driving revenue growth and strategic customer engagement across the semiconductor market. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing sales strategies, managing key customer relationships, and building a high-performing sales team focused on achieving aggressive growth objectives.

You will work closely with executive leadership, product management, marketing, applications engineering, and operations teams to identify market opportunities, secure strategic design wins, and accelerate adoption of our semiconductor portfolio. This role requires a strong blend of leadership, business acumen, and technical understanding of semiconductor solutions and target applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

  Proven ability to build, lead, and motivate high-performance sales organizations across multiple regions.
* **Business Acumen:**
  Demonstrated success managing revenue growth, strategic planning, pricing strategies, and key customer relationships.

  Extensive experience leading commercial negotiations, strategic agreements, and long-term customer partnerships.
* **Customer-Facing Skills:**
  Strong executive presence with the ability to engage effectively at all levels, from engineering teams to C-suite executives.

* **Problem-Solving:**
  Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate market insights into business opportunities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  .

  .

title: Senior Sales Manager (Solution Sales)
description:

Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here's why we stand out:
  
  

* We are trusted by over 500 million active users every month across 190+ countries
* We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
* We are powered by a team of 400+ employees from 45+ nationalities

**The role:**
As a
**Senior Sales Manager (Solution Sales)**
, you will spearhead strategic alliance growth. In this role, you will own the full commercial lifecycle for a dedicated portfolio of core partners, driving joint revenue via sell-to, sell-with, and sell-through models.
  
  
**What you'll do:**

* **Multi-Partner Portfolio Management**

  - Guide alliance partners throughout their development cycle, transforming foundational capabilities into mature, scalable operations designed to deploy tailored vertical offerings.

+ Collaborate directly with executive leadership to establish strategic visions, align go-to-market initiatives by sector, and construct organizational frameworks alongside solution suites.

* **Industry and Segment Solution Development**
  - Work closely alongside key allies to design robust, enterprise-grade capabilities leveraging Truecaller Number Intelligence that directly resolve specialized domain requirements and market demands.

+ Partner with vertical practice teams to uncover strategic applications, jointly engineer baseline frameworks and deployment toolkits, and ensure each alliance builds a distinctive offerings portfolio highlighting Truecaller's advanced platform functionality.
+ Spearhead the rollout of targeted industry models covering domains like automated content processing, client experience modernization, and regulatory adherence.

* **Revenue Generation and Market Leadership**
  - Spearhead high-impact commercial engagements alongside assigned alliance networks and account executives, embedding Truecaller Number Intelligence as the benchmark tier for alternate Early Warning Signals.

+ Cultivate strategic ties with senior executives, guiding key digital shifts and embedding Truecaller into primary corporate strategies.
+ Drive account growth speed across all alliances by establishing definitive benchmarks and operational rigor across your account base.

* **Customer Success and Lifetime Value**
  - Ensure every strategic transaction executed across your ecosystem is structured to maximize sustainable impact and long-term retention. Define core performance metrics for shared clients, oversee seamless integration and onboarding initiatives, and maintain iterative review mechanisms to continuously elevate solution efficacy.

**What you bring in:**

* Proven experience of successfully nurturing partners from early stages to scaled, mature, revenue-generating organizations.
* Proficient in building partner business plans, establishing practice architectures, developing large-scale enablement programs, and measuring partner maturity and progression.
* Experienced in helping partners develop industry-specific and use-case-driven solutions to build repeatable revenue streams.
* Proven track record of carrying revenue targets, managing forecasting, and understanding the financial mechanics of channel partnerships.
* Adept at achieving ambitious portfolio growth targets and developing bottom-up models that connect activities directly to revenue outcomes.
* Skilled in balancing short-term revenue generation with long-term partner investment and growth.

**It would be great if you also have:**

* Experience with any AI tools - Gem, Co-pilot, Claude etc.
* Data Interpretation tools including data drift visualisation,

**What we offer:**
We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:
  
  

* **A comprehensive compensation package:**
  Learning and development allowance, voluntary provident fund (VPF) and/or national pension scheme (NPS) tax saving option provided, creche allowance
* **Modern tools to do your best work:**
  Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
* **A people-focused office culture:**
  We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
* **Truecaller's "Lab Days"**
  offer a space for imagination: 5 days each quarter, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they've always wanted to. It's a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.

**Come as you are:**
Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.
  
  
**Sounds like a great opportunity?**
We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.
  
  
We only accept applications in English.

title: Assistant Vice President – Sales
description:
**About SmartQ:**

SmartQ is redefining how the world experiences food. As a next-generation food-tech innovator, we solve real operational challenges through empathy-led insights and powerful technology. Our mission is clear: to elevate everyday dining into a seamless and meaningful experience.

In the last decade, we’ve transformed cafeteria and food operations across industries with scalable, cutting-edge solutions. Operating in 14 countries and backed by Compass Group- a $60B global foodservice leader SmartQ continues to push the boundaries of what modern food-tech can achieve.

Since our inception in 2015, we’ve become a trusted partner for corporates, hospitals, universities, and food courts worldwide. With a bold vision to become the world’s largest B2B food-tech company, we connect people through exceptional food experiences powered by advanced technology. Today, we proudly serve 400+ global clients, including leaders like Google, HSBC, Amazon, and Wells Fargo.

At the heart of SmartQ is a culture shaped by four core pillars:

These values inspire collaboration, innovation, humility, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

To dive deeper into what drives us, explore our cultural pillars on the SmartQ LinkedIn ‘Life’ page. It offers an authentic glimpse into the journey you could be part of:

https://www.linkedin.com/company/smartq-bottlelabs/life/cdc290f8-ff81-4e7f-9c96-37d842f936c4/?viewAsMember=true

* Define and drive the sales vision, strategy, and annual operating plan, setting the direction for high-impact growth.

* Stay ahead of the market by tracking trends, analyzing competitors, and shaping pricing strategies to ensure strong market dominance.

* Champion cross-functional collaboration to deliver seamless solutions and exceptional customer experiences.
* Lead digital transformation initiatives to automate, accelerate, and modernize the sales function.
* Manage budgets, P&L impact, and resource allocation, ensuring optimal efficiency and profitability.
* Implement structured sales processes, robust pipelines, and insightful dashboards to enable fast, data-driven decisions.
* Represent the organization at major industry forums, events, and CXO-level interactions, strengthening brand presence and influence.
* Ensure full compliance with legal, commercial, and contractual standards throughout enterprise engagements.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of proven success in B2B Sales or Business Development, driving measurable impact and revenue growth.
* At least 8 years of experience in SaaS, technology, enterprise sales, or F&B enterprise solutions, with a strong understanding of complex solution selling.

Food is an everyday necessity, but the experience around it can influence how we feel, connect, and go about our day. title: Valuation Controller Vice President (Equities)
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Join the Valuation Control Group in a role focused on equity products, where you will lead a team and deliver individual production outcomes. You will help ensure fair value through robust valuation controls, disciplined analysis, and clear communication with key partners. This role offers exposure to complex products, strong control responsibilities, and meaningful engagement with business, risk, and finance stakeholders.

As a Valuation Control Group Manager, Equity Products within the Corporate & Investment Bank, you will lead a team while delivering individual production responsibilities across valuation control processes. You will perform independent price verification, price testing, and reserve calculations, and communicate results to the trading desk. You will execute fair value adjustment and prudential valuation processes and contribute to management reporting and regulatory deliverables. You will strengthen and enhance the control framework through process reviews and the implementation of tools that improve efficiency and consistency.

Job responsibilities

* Perform daily and monthly price testing and reserve calculations, and communicate results to the trading desk
* Execute the independent price verification process, including calculation of fair value adjustments and prudential valuations
* Support established valuation control practices and control initiatives, including work related to management reporting, regulatory mandates, and consistency within the broader framework
* Oversee the work of direct reports and support them in completing business-as-usual deliverables
* Manage internal and external audit queries
* Maintain a strong control mindset and ensure valuation controls are performed consistently
* Partner with functional groups on valuation-related issues and develop and implement appropriate measures to support fair value outcomes
* Enhance the existing control framework by reviewing independent pricing processes, assessing potential coverage developments, and implementing tools to improve control efficiency
* Contribute to value-added projects aligned to business, risk, and finance initiatives

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Seven or more years of related experience
* Ability to understand complex products and analyze transaction and process flows
* Understanding of valuation concepts for financial products and derivatives, with basic accounting knowledge
* Strong analytical and quantitative aptitude
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks efficiently
* Demonstrated ability to deliver individual production outcomes while supporting team deliverables

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Undergraduate degree with a finance and economics major
* Graduate degree in finance, economics, or mathematics (including a Master of Business Administration)

* Quantitative background

* Clear written and verbal communication of plans, commitments, and changes to team members and management
* Technical competency ranging from moderate to subject matter expert

title: Technical Product Manager – Lilly USA Data Analytics & AI
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
Job Description
  
Technical Product Manager – Lilly USA Data Analytics & AI (DA&AI)
  
At Lilly, we believe in the talent of our workforce. One of the best ways to utilize and develop that talent is to use our existing workforce to fill new and/or open positions. If you are looking for a new position within Lilly, you can view and apply to open roles posted in the internal job posting system. You must meet the minimum qualifications outlined in the job description and have or obtain work authorization in the country where the position is to be considered. When applying internally, your current supervisor will receive notification that you have applied. We encourage employees to discuss the opportunity with their supervisor before applying.
  
  
Path/Level
  
P3
  
Job Title
  
Technical Product Manager, Lilly USA Tech@Lilly – DA&AI
  
Job Function
  
Information Technology
  
Location
  
India – Bangalore
  
Reports to
  
Director, CTI Commercial India, Tech@Lilly
  
  
**Note:** Roles are posted at the lowest level of a band. Employees hired into banded positions transfer at their current level, despite the level indicated in the posting.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Technical Product Manager (TPM) owns the product vision, roadmap, prioritization and value realization for Lilly USA Commercial Sales data and analytics products. The role translates the needs of Sales Operations, field leadership and commercial teams into trusted, reusable data products and analytical capabilities that improve field effectiveness, customer engagement and business decision-making.
  
This individual-contributor role combines strong Commercial Sales stakeholder partnership with formal product management accountability. It moves beyond demand intake and status coordination to owning product outcomes, roadmap decisions, prioritization, adoption and measurable business value.
  
The TPM owns the Sales vertical product direction and business outcomes while partnering with platform Product Owners, Data Architects, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, engineering, quality and compliance teams that retain accountability for their respective platform, architecture and delivery responsibilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Product vision, strategy and roadmap
  
  

* Define and communicate a multi-quarter data-product vision and roadmap for Commercial Sales, aligned with Commercial Unit priorities and the broader Data & AI strategy.
* Translate business problems such as field effectiveness, targeting and customer engagement into validated product opportunities, data requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Prioritize the roadmap and backlog using business value, urgency, strategic alignment, effort, risk, compliance, capacity and dependency trade-offs; make and defend scope decisions with leadership.
* Maintain a transparent roadmap, release outlook and product lifecycle plan, clearly communicating changes in priorities, capacity, funding or dependencies.
* Align the Sales roadmap with reusable enterprise capabilities, platform roadmaps and relevant AI innovation initiatives before approving vertical-specific development.

Product discovery and data-product definition
  
  

* Lead structured discovery with field users, Sales Operations, reporting teams to understand decisions, workflows, unmet needs and pain points before defining solutions.
* Validate problems and proposed product concepts through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, data analysis, usability testing and field feedback.
* Define the business contract for each Sales data product, including intended consumers, decision use cases, product grain, key identifiers, business definitions, source systems, refresh expectations, quality thresholds, access requirements and service expectations, in partnership with the Business Analyst and Data Architect.
* Maintain a clear product catalogue covering product purpose, business owner, product owner, consumers, lifecycle status, dependencies, service expectations and adoption measures.

End-to-end product delivery and acceptance
  
  

* Own product outcomes from validated opportunity through production adoption, including scope, prioritization, release decisions, enablement and post-launch value tracking.
* Own product priorities, backlog ordering and timely scope decisions; partner with the Business Analyst to translate outcomes into epics, features, user stories, data requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with the Scrum Master so planning refinement, reviews and delivery ceremonies support product priorities and timely decisions.
* Work with data engineers, analysts, ML engineers, quality teams and architects to resolve product questions and make informed value, usability, risk and sequencing trade-offs.
* Establish business acceptance criteria, coordinate UAT with authorized Sales stakeholders and secure business sign-off before release.
* Ensure critical Sales measures are reconciled across source systems, data products and consuming reports before production adoption.
* Coordinate product acceptance and operational handover to downstream analytics and reporting teams, including documentation, access, support ownership and known limitations.
* Track delivery and product health, proactively surfacing risks, dependencies, quality concerns, cost considerations and mitigation decisions.

Stakeholder, portfolio and operating-model leadership
  
  

* Act as the single point of accountability and voice of the product for Commercial business partners, Sales Operations, field leadership and technology stakeholders.
* Lead regular Sales product reviews covering roadmap, value realized, adoption, product health, dependencies, risks and decisions required.
* Lead quarterly demand, capacity and sequencing discussions for the Sales data-product portfolio, balancing business value, urgency, strategic alignment, risk, technical dependencies and available delivery capacity.
* Assess existing enterprise data products, approved patterns and reusable platform capabilities before starting new development.
* Contribute to maintaining the Sales DA&AI operating model, decision rights and RACI, recommending updates when product, platform or delivery accountabilities change.
* Provide concise executive updates and evidence-based investment recommendations, including the consequences of funding, capacity and sequencing decisions.

Data, AI and regulated-environment stewardship
  
  

* Champion and apply architecture, data-governance, privacy, security, quality and compliance standards established by the accountable enterprise teams.
* Promote trusted business definitions, data quality, lineage, appropriate access and a consistent source of truth for Sales and Commercial measures.
* Identify and validate Sales problems that may benefit from analytics, machine learning, generative AI or agentic capabilities.
* Partner with Business Analysts and engineering teams to assess feasibility, data readiness, responsible-AI considerations and measurable business value.
* Support the transition of successful proofs of concept into governed, supportable and adoptable Sales products.

Value realization, adoption and lifecycle management
  
  

* Define success measures before investment and track outcomes after release, using appropriate business, product, data-quality, adoption and delivery measures.
* Drive change management, training, communications and field enablement so intended users adopt and benefit from the products.
* Continuously improve products through evidence-based releases, address low adoption or quality concerns and retire low-value or duplicative capabilities.

Role Accountability and Decision Rights
  
  
The TPM is accountable for why the product is needed, whom it serves, what outcomes it must deliver, what is prioritized and whether value is realized. The TPM partners with the Business Analyst on detailed requirements, the Scrum Master on delivery ceremonies, the Data Architect on architecture and governance standards, engineering and quality teams on implementation and validation, and platform Product Owners on reusable capabilities and technical roadmaps.
  
  
Qualifications and Skills
  
  
Required
  
  

* Relevant experience in technology, data, analytics or digital product delivery, including substantial experience owning data, analytics or AI products in complex enterprise environments.
* Proven record of owning product discovery, vision, roadmap, prioritization, delivery, adoption and lifecycle management in an Agile environment such as Scrum or SAFe.
* Experience working with Commercial Sales, Sales Operations, CRM, field-force or customer-engagement data and platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva or similar.
* Strong data literacy, including the ability to interpret data models, SQL outputs, dashboards, business measures, quality indicators and analytical results.
* Working knowledge of modern cloud data and analytics platforms, such as Databricks and AWS, including Lakehouse concepts, data pipelines, data modelling, semantic layers, business intelligence and ML/AI product lifecycles. The role is not expected to be a hands-on data engineer but must engage credibly with technical teams and make informed product trade-offs.
* Experience with product discovery, outcome-based roadmaps, business acceptance, UAT, product adoption and measurable product KPIs.
* Experience managing priorities, dependencies, capacity and sequencing across multiple business and delivery teams.
* Working knowledge of Jira or Azure DevOps for product backlog and roadmap management.
* Demonstrated understanding of data governance, privacy, security, quality, compliance and responsible AI in a regulated environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, negotiation and consulting skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and global cross-time-zone teams without formal authority.

Preferred
