* Experience with AI/ML or generative-AI product use cases such as next-best action, forecasting, recommendation or copilots for Sales users.

title: General Manager/ Business Head
description:
**Job Description :**

**Company**
: KeminCBR Pvt.Ltd. (A fully owned subsidiary of Kemin South Asia Pvt Ltd)

**Role :**
General Manager /Business Head

**Location**
:Chennai

* Lead and transform our Ruminant Retail business (B2C) by driving 2X profitable growth, expanding customer and distribution reach, executing winning sales and marketing strategies, and building high-performing teams.
* Expected to be jointly responsible for providing business leadership, strategic directions and be accountable for the overall business KPIs of the company. Work closely as a team member, manage and lead the company towards achievement of the overall company’s shared goals
* Partner closely with Manufacturing, C&F, Finance, and Sales to unlock market opportunities, optimize business performance, and leverage technology, data, and AI to create sustainable growth.
* Work Environment: The position will be based at the head office in Chennai and will require traveling both regionally and internationally depends upon the needs of the regional and global requirements

Necessitates 16-18 days of business travel in a month

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Business Strategy and Leadership

* Develop and execute the annual operating plan and medium-term growth strategy for the ruminant retail business.
* Define business priorities, target markets, customer segments, geographic expansion plans, and channel strategy.
* Convert business objectives into clear functional plans, budgets, performance targets, and accountability for the team.
* Lead periodic business reviews and present performance, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions to senior leadership.
* Balance revenue expansion, profitability, customer value, and organizational capability when allocating resources.

2. Full P&L Ownership and Financial Performance

* Own the business P&L, including net sales, cost of goods sold, gross margin, operating expenditure, and operating profit against approved targets.
* Prepare and manage annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and financial performance reviews in partnership with Finance.
* Analyze product, customer, channel, and territory profitability and implement actions to improve the quality of earnings.
* Govern pricing, discounts, trade schemes, and promotional investments within delegated authority; obtain approvals for exceptions.
* Identify and address adverse variances in revenue, sales mix, margins, trade spending, and operating costs.
* Assess the commercial viability and financial return of new products, market expansion, headcount, and other business investments.
* Own business-level working capital outcomes in partnership with Finance and Supply Chain, including receivables, inventory, and cash conversion.

3. Sales and Retail Channel Development

* Lead delivery of sales targets through the sales team and distributor, dealer, and retail network.
* Develop territory coverage, distributor and retailer development plans, and channel productivity standards.
* Review primary and secondary sales, channel inventory, market reach, product availability, and repeat purchase trends.
* Lead strategic customer and channel partner relationships and support major negotiations and issue resolution.
* Ensure trade terms, incentives, and channel programs support profitable growth and comply with company policy.
* Conduct regular field reviews to assess execution quality, farmer demand, competitive activity, and channel effectiveness.

4. Product Portfolio and Marketing Direction

* Provide strategic direction to the Product Manager on portfolio priorities, positioning, pricing, launch plans, and marketing investments.
* Approve product and brand plans within delegated authority and ensure alignment with business growth and profitability objectives.
* Prioritize new product opportunities using customer needs, scientific differentiation, commercial potential, and financial feasibility.
* Review product lifecycle performance and decide on expansion, repositioning, rationalization, or discontinuation through the appropriate approval process.
* Oversee integrated marketing, farmer engagement, veterinary outreach, and channel activation programs.
* Ensure product claims, marketing communication, and promotional practices follow applicable requirements and internal review processes.

5. Forecasting, Supply Alignment, and Working Capital

* Own the commercial demand forecast and align Sales, Product Management, Finance, and Supply Chain on assumptions and priorities.
* Participate in demand and supply planning reviews to balance service levels, inventory investment, and business risk.
* Monitor stock availability, channel inventory, inventory aging, returns, and expiry exposure; drive timely corrective action.
* Ensure sales execution respects approved credit limits and terms, and drive collection accountability with Finance and Sales.
* Coordinate responses to supply constraints, product quality concerns, and customer service issues with the responsible functions.

6. Customer, Veterinary, and Farmer Engagement

* Build strategic relationships with distributors, retailers, veterinary professionals, dairy and livestock stakeholders, and key customers.
* Ensure farmer and customer insights inform business strategy, portfolio development, and field execution.
* Oversee technical and educational programs that support responsible product use and strengthen customer confidence.
* Establish clear processes for customer feedback, complaint escalation, technical support, and service recovery.
* Represent the business at relevant customer meetings, industry events, and strategic partnership discussions.

7. People Leadership and Organizational Capability

* Lead, coach, and develop the business team, including the Product Manager and sales leadership or sales team, as defined by the approved structure.
* Set measurable goals, review performance, and establish clear decision rights and cross-functional working practices.
* Build capability in commercial management, channel development, scientific selling, financial discipline, and customer engagement.
* Identify capability gaps and support recruitment, succession planning, talent development, and retention with HR.
* Create a culture of accountability, ethical conduct, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

8. Governance, Risk, and Continuous Improvement

* Ensure adherence to financial controls, approval limits, company policies, and applicable commercial and regulatory requirements.
* Identify and manage business risks, including customer concentration, credit exposure, channel conflict, supply disruption, and margin erosion.
* Work with Quality, Technical Services, and other responsible functions on product issues and business continuity responses.
* Improve reporting, business review processes, forecasting accuracy, and decision-making through reliable data.
* Maintain timely escalation of material risks, deviations, and investment requirements to senior leadership.

**Educational Qualification & Years of Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in
  **agriculture, Veterinary Science, Dairy Technology, Agribusiness**
  , or a related field (MBA is a strong plus) with
  **15–20 years of progressive experience in Sales,**
  Marketing, Business Development, or Commercial leadership and relevant experience in animal health, animal nutrition, livestock products, agricultural inputs, or a comparable retail-led business.
* At least
  **3–5 years in business leadership,**
  sales and marketing leadership, or a comparable role with demonstrable P&L responsibility.
* Demonstrated experience in distributor and retail channel management, team leadership, budgeting, pricing, and profitable business growth.
* Experience in the ruminant, dairy, or livestock sector is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional execution across product management, sales, marketing, technical services, and supply operations.

**Competencies - Skills required:**

Business and Financial

* P&L management, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
* Pricing, margin management, investment evaluation, and working capital discipline.
* Business strategy, market development, and resource allocation.

Commercial and Operational

* Sales leadership, distributor management, and retail channel development.
* Product portfolio strategy, marketing effectiveness, and customer relationship management.
* Demand planning, negotiation, execution management, and business risk assessment.

Leadership and Behavioral

* Strategic thinking, commercial judgment, and decisive problem-solving.
* People leadership, coaching, talent development, and accountability.
* Cross-functional influence, executive communication, ethical conduct, and change leadership.

Travel Requisite:

* Up to 50% of travel, domestically and internationally, as and when warranted

**Other Key Consideration:**

* The above noted job description document is not intended to describe in exhaustive detail, the multitude of tasks that may be entailed with this position, but rather to give a general sense of the responsibilities and expectations. As the nature of business demands change, so too do the essential functions of this position.

description:
**About Keka**

Keka is a modern people platform for growing enterprises. HR, payroll and talent live in one core system, so teams spend less time on admin and more time on their people. More than 12,500 companies trust Keka, from fast-growing small businesses to large enterprises and global companies with teams across borders.

We build software the way HR actually works. It feels human, sets up in days instead of months, and has AI built into every part of HR. With customers across India, the US and the Middle East.

The PAM owns a named book of Keka partners end-to-end — program rules, pipeline, co-sell, operations, GTM, cross-functional alignment and the partner relationship. You are responsible for maximizing your partners’ revenue impact while delivering an exceptional experience with Keka.

* HR-tech, fintech, or payroll-adjacent industry exposure.
* Experience scaling a partner book from a handful to 50+ active partners.

title: Territory Sales Manager
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION / RESPONSIBILITIES**

This position will be responsible for driving sales and business development activities in the assigned region. The role entails developing regional business, managing key accounts, and achieving sales and collection targets through direct customer engagement, project pursuit, and channel development. The incumbent will also play a key role in implementing the company’s business strategy and ensuring market growth.

**1. Sales Planning & Business Development**

* Execute the regional sales and business development plan in alignment with national targets and objectives.
* Identify and develop business opportunities across infrastructure, industrial, institutional, commercial, and residential segments.
* Generate and manage project pipelines, ensuring timely follow-ups and order conversions.
* Develop business through Consultants, PMCs, Contractors, Developers, Ready-mix concrete producers, and government departments.

**2. Key Account & Channel Management**

* Build and nurture strong relationships with key developers/ clients, consultants, and ready-mix concrete producers in the assigned territory.
* Ensure product specifications and vendor registrations with major clients and govt. departments.
* Initiate admixture trials and product sampling/ mock-ups with key clients and coordinate with the technical service team to execute the same.
* Manage and expand distribution networks, ensure channel partner performance and alignment with company policies.
* Support and coordinate with applicators and channel partners for project execution.
* Achieve sales and collection targets as per approved budgets.

**3. Market Intelligence & Customer Support**

* Track competition activities to identify emerging trends and new business opportunities.
* Ensure prompt resolution of customer complaints in coordination with the technical and QA teams.
* Provide feedback on product performance, pricing, and customer requirements to the National Manager.
* Ensure product demonstrations, site trials, and technical presentations for key customers.

**4. Sales Process, Reporting & Collections**

* Sales Targets: Plan and execute monthly and quarterly sales activities to achieve assigned sales and product mix targets.
* Maintain and update CRM records — leads, opportunities, quotations, and order closures.
* Credit Control - Monitor outstanding payments, follow up for collections, and maintain DSO within target limits.
* Prepare and submit periodic MIS reports on sales, forecasts, and customer activity.

**5. Teamwork & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Technical Services, SCM, and Accounts teams for order execution and customer satisfaction.
* Coordinate with the Technical teams for product establishment, trials, approvals and specification initiatives.
* Support marketing campaigns, exhibitions, and promotional events within the assigned region.

**6. Compliance & Ethical Conduct**

* Ensure adherence to company policies, pricing structures, and credit guidelines.
* Maintain ethical conduct, transparency, and integrity in all business dealings.
* Follow EHS (Environment, Health, and Safety) standards during site visits and field operations.

**DESIRED CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Educational Qualifications:**

* Diploma / B.Tech in Civil or Chemical Engineering (preferred) or B.Sc. (Physics / Chemistry / Maths).
* MBA in Marketing or Business Management will be an added advantage.

**Work Experience:**

* 4-7 years of experience in Project Sales / Business Development in Construction Chemicals, Concrete Admixtures, or related Building Materials industry.
* Proven experience in dealing with consultants, PMCs, contractors, applicators, and government/institutional clients.

**Nature of Experience:**

* Should have worked in project-based sales and technical sales roles.
* Experience in both direct and channel-based business preferred.
* Capable of managing regional business independently and achieving defined KPIs.

**Specific Skills / Personal Attributes:**

* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Self-motivated, result-oriented, and capable of handling multiple priorities.
* Good analytical and interpersonal abilities.
* Customer-centric approach with strong follow-up and execution discipline.
* Proficiency in CRM, MS Office, and report preparation.

**CAREERS AT ECMAS ECMAS**

provides a dynamic work environment with opportunities for professional growth, learning, and recognition. With over 300 high-energy professionals, we encourage knowledge sharing, innovation, and collaboration across functions.

We recognise and reward performance that contributes to customer satisfaction and business growth.

**Come, grow with ECMAS and be part of our journey to redefine Construction and Concrete Chemistry in India!**

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹1,400,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

* Job Details

**Job Title:**
Category Head – Cotton
  
  
**Job Location:**
Hyderabad

WFO

Business Head
  
  

* Candidate Expectations
* Total Experience: 12–18 years
* Relevant Experience: 8 years
* Candidate Location: Hyderabad
* Skills – Mandatory: Category Management, P&L Management, Pricing, Forecasting, Portfolio Management, Market Intelligence, Go-to-Market, Leadership.
* Candidate Industry: Agri-inputs, preferably seed businesses with cotton portfolio exposure.
* Education and Certification

**Qualification – Mandatory**

* Bachelor's degree in Agriculture.

**Good To Have**

* MBA in Agri-Business, Marketing, or Strategy.
* Detailed Job Description

**Job Summary**
The Category Head – Cotton will be responsible for the end-to-end strategy, performance, and profitability of the Cotton portfolio within the Bioseed business. The role involves driving category growth, competitive positioning, pricing governance, product lifecycle management, and cross-functional alignment to achieve sustainable market leadership and strong financial performance in the cotton segment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Category Strategy and Portfolio Leadership
* Define and execute the long-term Cotton category strategy in alignment with business growth objectives.
* Build and manage a differentiated and competitive cotton portfolio across regions and maturity segments.
* Drive product lifecycle management, including launches, scaling, performance monitoring, and portfolio rationalization.
* P&L Ownership and Financial Performance
* Own the Annual Business Plan (ABP) for Cotton, including revenue, volume, and gross margin targets.
* Monitor category profitability by hybrid and region and implement corrective actions where required.
* Develop and govern pricing strategies aligned with competitive positioning and margin objectives.
* Demand Planning and Supply Alignment
* Drive accurate demand forecasting in collaboration with Sales and Supply Chain.
* Align demand plans with production schedules to minimize stock-outs and excess inventory.
* Monitor inventory health and optimize working capital within the category.
* Go-to-Market and Commercial Strategy
* Define product positioning, value propositions, and commercial strategies for cotton hybrids.
* Partner with Sales and Marketing to design and execute product launches, campaigns, and farmer engagement initiatives.
* Monitor and drive the execution of demand-generation activities.
* Track market share trends, pricing realization, and channel performance.
* Market Intelligence and Competitive Strategy
* Monitor competitor portfolios, pricing dynamics, trait positioning, and regional market trends.
* Identify growth opportunities, market gaps, and potential risks in the cotton segment.
* Recommend portfolio, pricing, and promotional interventions based on analytics and field insights.
* Cross-Functional Leadership and Team Development
* Collaborate with R&D, Product Evaluation and Agronomy, Production, Processing, Quality Assurance, and Supply Chain teams to ensure pipeline-to-market alignment.
* Provide category inputs for product advancement and commercialization decisions.
* Lead and develop the Cotton category team, driving performance excellence and accountability.
* Key Skills

**Mandatory Key Skills:**
Category Management, P&L, Pricing, Forecasting, Portfolio Management, Commercialization, Analytics, Leadership.
  
  
**Good to Have Skills:**
Agronomy, Product Development, Market Research, Strategy.
  
  

* Other Specific Remarks
* Industry Preference: Agri-inputs, preferably the seed industry.
* Business Exposure: Experience managing complete crop portfolios and driving P&L accountability is essential.
* Functional Exposure: Strong understanding of category strategy, commercial planning, pricing, product management, demand forecasting, and market development.

Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Join us to put AI to work for people.

**Drive Now on Now GTM execution and field activation**
, expanding how ServiceNow’s Customer Zero story is embedded across Executive Briefing Centers (EBCs), strategic customer engagements, workshops, industry events, webinars, and other high-impact GTM motions.
  
  
**Design and execute scalable GTM motions**
that increase customer engagement with Now on Now, building strong partnerships across Sales, Solution Consulting, Global Solutions, Marketing, Customer Success, and other GTM organizations.
  
  
**Create demand for Now on Now engagements**
by proactively identifying opportunities where ServiceNow’s internal transformation, innovation, and business outcomes can help advance strategic customer conversations.
  
  
**Build and activate a strong practitioner and executive community**
, enabling ServiceNow leaders and subject-matter experts to effectively share how ServiceNow uses its own platform, AI capabilities, and workflows to transform the business.
  
  
**Translate ServiceNow’s Customer Zero experience into compelling customer stories**
, connecting our internal use of ServiceNow products and AI to customer priorities, business challenges, measurable outcomes, and strategic transformation opportunities.
  
  
**Partner with Digital Technology and solution teams**
to maintain a strong understanding of the ServiceNow product portfolio and identify new Customer Zero stories as capabilities are deployed internally.
  
  
**Orchestrate high-impact customer engagements**
, bringing together the right executives, practitioners, content, demonstrations, and proof points based on the customer's priorities and stage in the sales cycle.
  
  
**Develop reusable GTM assets and enablement**
that allow Sales, Solution Consulting, and other field teams to more easily incorporate Now on Now into customer conversations.
  
  
**Use engagement and customer-demand data to identify trends and opportunities**
, including emerging solution areas, customer priorities, practitioner demand, and opportunities to scale successful engagement patterns.
  
  
**Track and communicate the business impact of Now on Now**
, developing dashboards and executive insights around engagement volume, customer demand, practitioner activation, strategic account penetration, and influenced business outcomes.
  
  
**Continuously improve the Now on Now engagement model**

**1. Job Purpose**

To lead the national sales strategy and drive sustainable business growth for the Critical Care Division by achieving revenue and profitability objectives, expanding hospital and institutional business, and developing a high-performing sales organization across India.

**A. Sales Strategy & Business Growth**

* Achieve national sales and growth objectives in alignment with the division’s business plan.

* Leadership, coaching, and team development

* Negotiation and commercial acumen

* Effective communication and stakeholder management
* Integrity, accountability, and regulatory compliance

**Role Summary**
The Sales Effectiveness Lead will be responsible for enhancing sales force productivity, improving channel efficiency and establishing data-driven decision-making across the sales organisation. The role involves translating business strategy into effective sales execution through tools, processes and performance monitoring. The candidate will act as a key link between Marketing, Product Management, R&D and Sales teams to drive business initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Sales Force Productivity & Territory Optimisation
* Design and optimise territory structures at district and tehsil levels based on crop-wise potential, agro-climatic zones, market share and competition.
* Define optimal span of control and workload distribution for field sales teams.
* Drive effective sales team deployment across Kharif and Rabi seasons.
* Establish coverage norms for channel and farmer engagement.
* Monitor field sales productivity and territory performance.
* Drive bottom-up sales planning in coordination with regional teams.
* Sales Planning & Demand Generation Effectiveness
* Drive demand estimation based on acreage trends, crop-switching behaviour and historical secondary sales data.
* Establish productivity metrics for farmer meetings, demonstration plots and field days.
* Monitor sales plans against actual performance through structured reviews.
* Distribution Strategy & Channel Effectiveness
* Drive distribution strategy and channel-led market coverage.
* Define and monitor distribution width and depth.
* Develop channel segmentation frameworks, including distributor and dealer tiering.
* Improve secondary sales and channel throughput.
* Monitor inventory ageing, stock rotation and credit discipline.
* Identify gaps in last-mile distribution and retailer coverage.
* Sales Incentives & Motivation Programs
* Design incentive schemes aligned with sales growth, product mix and strategic business priorities.
* Develop incentives to promote hybrid and high-margin crop products and new product launches.
* Ensure transparency and timely incentive payouts.
* Evaluate incentive program ROI and implement improvements.
* Sales Capability Building
* Identify capability gaps across frontline sales teams.
* Develop training programs covering product knowledge, agronomy advisory and selling skills.
* Support structured onboarding programs for new sales employees.
* Sales Systems & Analytics
* Drive adoption of CRM and Sales Force Automation (SFA) tools.
* Ensure data integrity and disciplined usage of sales systems.
* Analyse farmer adoption patterns, product performance and regional opportunities.
* Coordinate with IT and Data teams to improve reporting tools and dashboards.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work with Marketing on campaign planning and product positioning.
* Coordinate with Supply Chain for demand forecasting and inventory alignment.
* Collaborate with R&D and Agronomy teams to translate product performance insights into sales actions.
* Act as a bridge between business strategy and field-level execution.
* Key Skills

**Mandatory Key Skills:**
Sales Effectiveness, Sales Excellence, Sales Force Productivity, Territory Planning
  
  
**Good to Have Skills:**
Territory Optimisation, Sales Strategy, Sales Planning, Demand Forecasting, Channel Management, Distribution Strategy, Distributor Management, Dealer Management, Secondary Sales, Sales Analytics, Sales Operations, Performance Management, CRM, Sales Force Automation (SFA), Incentive Management, MIS, Market Development, Stakeholder Management.
  
  

* Other Specific Remarks
* Preferred industry experience in Seeds, Crop Protection or Fertilizers.
* Should have exposure to territory design, channel management, sales analytics and field sales enablement.
* Should possess strong strategic thinking, execution and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience in handling sales performance reviews and data-driven decision-making is important.
* The role involves close coordination with regional and zonal sales teams and multiple internal departments.

title: Director, Commercial Sales- South Asia
description:
**Position Overview**
The
**Director – Sales,**
Crop Protection is part of Country Leadership team and responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership to the sales organization and delivering sustainable revenue, profitability, market share, and business growth objectives. The role will lead the development and execution of short- and long-term sales strategies, market development models, distribution and channel roadmaps, and commercial plans aligned with evolving customer and market needs. The Director will ensure clear accountability for execution while building a high-performing, future-ready Sales organization with the capabilities, structure, and talent required to support the company's growth ambitions. As a key commercial leader, the incumbent will work closely with Marketing, Commercial Excellence, Finance, Supply Chain, Product Management, R&D and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate business strategy into effective market execution and deliver value for customers, channel partners and the organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Sales Strategy & Business Growth**

* Develop and execute short- and long-range sales strategies aligned with the overall Crop Protection business strategy and growth objectives.
* Establish annual sales operating plans, priorities, objectives and performance measures across markets, geographies and product portfolios.
* Deliver revenue, profitability, volume and market-share objectives through disciplined commercial planning and execution.
* Develop market development models and identify new opportunities for sustainable growth across products, crops, customers, channels and geographies.
* Translate strategic priorities into clear sales plans and ensure consistent execution across the field organization.
* Lead monthly and annual sales forecasting and drive greater forecast accuracy through strong market intelligence and sales discipline.
* Monitor business performance and proactively initiate corrective actions where performance is below plan.

**Distribution & Channel Strategy**

* Strengthen and expand the distribution network to improve market reach, customer access and commercial effectiveness.
* Build strong, sustainable relationships with distributors, channel partners and other key stakeholders.
* Regularly assess the effectiveness, productivity and relevance of the distribution model and implement appropriate corrective measures.
* Ensure consistent implementation of commercial policies across the distribution network.
* Identify opportunities to evolve channel and go-to-market models in response to changing buying behaviors, technology and market dynamics.
* Drive disciplined channel management with appropriate focus on inventory, demand generation, market coverage and quality of sales.

**Commercial & Market Leadership**

* Partner closely with Marketing on customer segmentation, product positioning, pricing strategies, portfolio priorities and go-to-market plans.
* Provide timely market intelligence on competitor activity, pricing, customer dynamics, market trends and in-season developments to support commercial decision-making.
* Develop appropriate competitive responses and commercial interventions in partnership with Marketing and other relevant functions.
* Contribute actively to product management teams, including new product introduction, product development strategies, launch planning, promotion, business planning and product lifecycle management.
* Ensure strong alignment between sales execution, demand generation activities and broader commercial priorities.
* Identify emerging customer and market needs and translate these insights into actionable commercial opportunities.

**Sales Organization & People Leadership**

* Lead the organizational design of the sales organization, ensuring that structure, roles, capabilities and staffing are aligned with current and future business needs.
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities, objectives and performance standards across the sales organization.
* Communicate expectations clearly and create strong accountability for execution and business results.
* Regularly assess sales force productivity and effectiveness, including half-yearly and annual performance reviews.
* Build a strong leadership and talent pipeline through coaching, capability development, succession planning and targeted development interventions.
* Foster a high-performance culture characterized by customer focus, collaboration, ownership, inclusion and continuous improvement.
* Anticipate future capability requirements and ensure the sales organization continues to evolve in line with changing markets and commercial models.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Collaborate with Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Commercial Excellence, R&D and other functions to ensure integrated business planning and execution.
* Partner with Supply Chain and commercial teams to align demand forecasts, portfolio priorities and market requirements.
* Provide senior leadership with regular visibility into sales performance, market developments, business opportunities and potential risks.
* Influence enterprise decision-making by bringing a strong customer, channel and market perspective to strategic discussions.
* Champion effective execution of strategic commercial initiatives across the sales organization.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in agriculture, Agricultural Sciences, Agribusiness, Business Management or a related discipline. A Master's degree/MBA would be advantageous.
* 15–20 years of progressive commercial/sales leadership experience, preferably in the agro-input/agriculture industry; strong leadership experience from adjacent sectors such as FMCG, Pharmaceuticals, Consumer Healthcare, or other distribution-led industries will also be considered.
* Demonstrated experience leading sizeable and geographically dispersed sales organizations.
* Strong understanding of complex distribution and channel models, customer segmentation, go-to-market strategies and market development. Experience in agriculture/Crop Protection is preferred, with relevant experience from FMCG, Pharmaceuticals, Consumer Healthcare or other distribution-led industries also valued.
* Proven experience developing and executing sales strategies and delivering revenue and profitability objectives.
* Experience in organizational design, sales-force effectiveness, capability development and leadership of senior commercial teams.

**Leadership & Functional Capabilities**
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
  
  

* Strategic Commercial Leadership: Ability to connect long-term business strategy with practical market and sales execution.
* Market Shaping: A forward-looking mindset and the ability to anticipate shifts in customer, channel and agricultural market dynamics.
* Business & Financial Acumen: Strong understanding of revenue, profitability, pricing, investment choices and commercial trade-offs.
* Customer & Channel Orientation: Deep understanding of customer needs and an ability to develop sustainable relationships across the distribution ecosystem.
* Execution Excellence: Ability to translate strategy into clear priorities, establish accountability and consistently deliver business outcomes.
* People Leadership: Proven ability to build, motivate and develop high-performing sales teams and future leaders.
* Collaboration & Influence: Ability to work effectively across functions and influence senior stakeholders in a complex, matrixed organization.
* Innovation & Agility: Willingness to challenge established approaches and introduce new commercial models, tools and ways of working as the market evolves.
* Data-led Decision Making: Ability to use sales, customer and market insights to strengthen forecasting, resource allocation and commercial decisions.
* Change Leadership: Ability to lead teams through changing business models, market dynamics and organizational priorities while sustaining execution.

This role will build the revenue operations backbone for ADP’s next phase of growth. You will own the systems, data and operating processes that support the customer-to-revenue lifecycle, helping ADP scale new products, commercial models and markets with greater consistency and control.
  
You will own the development roadmap for Dynamics 365, HubSpot and any other key commercial operations systems for ADP. Our Dynamics platform extends beyond conventional CRM to support product and pricing data, quoting, order and licence delivery records, invoice preparation, royalty reporting and customer support. You will lead the developers and delivery partners who maintain and improve this environment.
  
Working across Sales, Marketing, Product, Software Engineering, Customer Support and Success, Customer Operations, Finance and Digital Technology, you will translate agreed pricing, product, licensing and go-to-market decisions into scalable systems, data, workflows and controls.
  
The role sits within ADP’s Operations Function. Reporting to ADP’s Global Commercial Manager, you will work cross-functionally across the global business and manage the India-based CRM development team, specialist technology suppliers and relevant Arup Digital Technology stakeholders.
  
You will use AI, automation and workflow technology to simplify work, improve data quality and reduce cost,.
  
You will shape a business-led revenue systems roadmap, strengthening ownership of commercial data and determining how Dynamics, HubSpot, licensing tools and wider Arup platforms should work together. This will include representing ADP’s requirements in any future integration between Dynamics and Arup’s wider commercial systems.
  
Your principal responsibilities will include:
  

* Own the development roadmap and governance for Dynamics 365, HubSpot, licensing tools and connected revenue systems, aligning investment and delivery priorities with ADP’s product pipeline and growth plans.
* Lead ADP’s in-house D365 CRM developers, HubSpot consultants and technology partners, setting priorities, requirements, delivery standards, testing, documentation, releases and user support arrangements.
* Own HubSpot as ADP’s top-of-funnel platform, governing lead capture, quality, lifecycle stages and hand-off to Dynamics.
* Oversee integrations across CRM, marketing, licensing and finance systems, defining process boundaries, data flows, controls and ADP’s requirements for future platform changes.
* Lead revenue operations improvements with an aim to increase robustness to handle multiple product portfolios across multiple regions. Improvement aspects in both processes and revenue data quality & definitions.
* Enable functional leads to establish clear data ownership, governance and quality standards across the commercial lifecycle.
* Partner with functional leaders to translate agreed pricing, product configurations, licensing models and go-to-market decisions into scalable operating systems and processes.
* Establish the system controls, data and reporting processes required to support reliable commercial and financial reporting, including sales commission calculations, working closely with Finance and other functional owners and supporting relevant audit coordination.
* Enable Finance and Sales to operate effective forecasting processes through appropriate systems, data, controls and governance.
* Drive system adoption through appropriate technology training, onboarding, SOPs, in-system guidance and maintained knowledge content.
* Implement AI and automation where appropriate and remove inefficient processes and controls.

As ADP expands its portfolio, markets and revenue, you will build a global Revenue Operations capability that combines software-business agility with Arup’s expertise. This is a unique opportunity to create the operating infrastructure through which ADP takes products to market, processes revenue and supports customers.
  
Success in the role will be demonstrated through outcomes including:
  

* clear ownership and an effective development roadmap for ADP’s revenue and commercial systems;
* strong adoption of Dynamics, HubSpot and other business systems, supported by effective leadership of developers, consultants and suppliers;
* agreed product, pricing, licensing and go-to-market decisions translated effectively into scalable operating systems and processes;
* well-governed commercial data, effective system controls and reliable reporting that support operational and financial decision-making;
* more consistent and scalable customer-to-revenue processes across products, markets and functional teams;
* measurable improvements in efficiency, data quality and user experience across business systems and processes;
* targeted use of AI and automation delivering evidenced productivity, quality or cost benefits;
* overall, a revenue systems capability that can support new products, regions and commercial models without avoidable complexity.

At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.

**3. Is this role right for you?**
  
This role is part of Arup Digital Products. We are seeking a senior Revenue Operations manager who can set direction, remain close to delivery and build scalable operating capability in a growing, multi-product software business. You should bring:
  

* Around 10 years or more relevant experience, including several years leading Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations or Business Systems within a rapidly growing B2B software, SaaS or technology business.
* Ownership of Dynamics 365 or a comparable enterprise CRM, together with HubSpot or similar marketing-automation technology, including platform roadmaps, governance and adoption.
* A track record of leading revenue systems transformation.
* Experience translating pricing, product, licensing and go-to-market decisions into scalable systems, data, workflows and controls across the customer-to-revenue lifecycle.
* Experience leading CRM developers, consultants or technical teams, ideally distributed globally, including setting development priorities and overseeing requirements, testing, releases, support and integration delivery.
* Practical experience improving commercial data, pipeline management, forecasting, reporting and governance in close partnership with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product and Operations.
* Evidence of delivering automation, workflow or AI initiatives with measurable operational benefits.
* Experience building scalable operating processes in an agile, fast-moving environment.

You will be comfortable working across functions, geographies and time zones, with sufficient overlap with colleagues in Japan and the United Kingdom and close collaboration with India-based teams. You will combine strategic perspective with a hands-on approach to systems, data, processes and users.
  
You should distinguish technology issues from underlying process, ownership, data and capability gaps; challenge unclear requirements constructively; and deliver practical solutions suited to ADP’s scale and maturity.
  
Experience of software licensing, subscription or usage-based commercial models, product and pricing data, finance system integration, customer support platforms, engineering software or distributor channels would be advantageous but is not essential.

**4. What we offer you**
  
At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.
  
Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.
  
We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.
  
India-specific details of rewards and benefits will be provided as part of the recruitment process.

  

**5. Different people, shared values**
  
Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age within legal limits, gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.
  
Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup.
  
We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact the relevant recruiter to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

**6. Our Application Process**
  
Applications will be reviewed against the essential experience and capabilities set out above. Shortlisted candidates should expect an initial interview focused on relevant Revenue Operations and transformation experience, followed by a practical assessment or case discussion considering systems ownership, data, process improvement and stakeholder management.
  
Final-stage candidates may meet cross-functional senior stakeholders from Business Operations, Customer Operations and other relevant ADP functions.
  
Stay safe online – Arup will never ask for your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

title: Territory Sales Manager
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION / RESPONSIBILITIES**

This position will be responsible for driving sales and business development activities in the assigned region. The role entails developing regional business, managing key accounts, and achieving sales and collection targets through direct customer engagement, project pursuit, and channel development. The incumbent will also play a key role in implementing the company’s business strategy and ensuring market growth.

**1. Sales Planning & Business Development**

* Execute the regional sales and business development plan in alignment with national targets and objectives.
* Identify and develop business opportunities across infrastructure, industrial, institutional, commercial, and residential segments.
* Generate and manage project pipelines, ensuring timely follow-ups and order conversions.
* Develop business through Consultants, PMCs, Contractors, Developers, Ready-mix concrete producers, and government departments.

**2. Key Account & Channel Management**

* Build and nurture strong relationships with key developers/ clients, consultants, and ready-mix concrete producers in the assigned territory.
* Ensure product specifications and vendor registrations with major clients and govt. departments.
* Initiate admixture trials and product sampling/ mock-ups with key clients and coordinate with the technical service team to execute the same.
* Manage and expand distribution networks, ensure channel partner performance and alignment with company policies.
* Support and coordinate with applicators and channel partners for project execution.
* Achieve sales and collection targets as per approved budgets.

**3. Market Intelligence & Customer Support**

* Track competition activities to identify emerging trends and new business opportunities.
* Ensure prompt resolution of customer complaints in coordination with the technical and QA teams.
* Provide feedback on product performance, pricing, and customer requirements to the National Manager.
* Ensure product demonstrations, site trials, and technical presentations for key customers.

**4. Sales Process, Reporting & Collections**

* Sales Targets: Plan and execute monthly and quarterly sales activities to achieve assigned sales and product mix targets.
* Maintain and update CRM records — leads, opportunities, quotations, and order closures.
* Credit Control - Monitor outstanding payments, follow up for collections, and maintain DSO within target limits.
* Prepare and submit periodic MIS reports on sales, forecasts, and customer activity.

**5. Teamwork & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Technical Services, SCM, and Accounts teams for order execution and customer satisfaction.
* Coordinate with the Technical teams for product establishment, trials, approvals and specification initiatives.
* Support marketing campaigns, exhibitions, and promotional events within the assigned region.

**6. Compliance & Ethical Conduct**

* Ensure adherence to company policies, pricing structures, and credit guidelines.
* Maintain ethical conduct, transparency, and integrity in all business dealings.
* Follow EHS (Environment, Health, and Safety) standards during site visits and field operations.

**DESIRED CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Educational Qualifications:**

* Diploma / B.Tech in Civil or Chemical Engineering (preferred) or B.Sc. (Physics / Chemistry / Maths).
* MBA in Marketing or Business Management will be an added advantage.

**Work Experience:**

* 4-7 years of experience in Project Sales / Business Development in Construction Chemicals, Concrete Admixtures, or related Building Materials industry.
* Proven experience in dealing with consultants, PMCs, contractors, applicators, and government/institutional clients.

**Nature of Experience:**

* Should have worked in project-based sales and technical sales roles.
* Experience in both direct and channel-based business preferred.
* Capable of managing regional business independently and achieving defined KPIs.

**Specific Skills / Personal Attributes:**

* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Self-motivated, result-oriented, and capable of handling multiple priorities.
* Good analytical and interpersonal abilities.
* Customer-centric approach with strong follow-up and execution discipline.
* Proficiency in CRM, MS Office, and report preparation.

**CAREERS AT ECMAS ECMAS**

provides a dynamic work environment with opportunities for professional growth, learning, and recognition. With over 300 high-energy professionals, we encourage knowledge sharing, innovation, and collaboration across functions.

We recognise and reward performance that contributes to customer satisfaction and business growth.

**Come, grow with ECMAS and be part of our journey to redefine Construction and Concrete Chemistry in India!**

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹1,400,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Provident Fund

title: Now on Now Go To Market Sr. Manager
description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

Key Responsibilities

**Drive Now on Now GTM execution and field activation**, expanding how ServiceNow’s Customer Zero story is embedded across Executive Briefing Centers (EBCs), strategic customer engagements, workshops, industry events, webinars, and other high-impact GTM motions.

**Design and execute scalable GTM motions** that increase customer engagement with Now on Now, building strong partnerships across Sales, Solution Consulting, Global Solutions, Marketing, Customer Success, and other GTM organizations.

**Create demand for Now on Now engagements** by proactively identifying opportunities where ServiceNow’s internal transformation, innovation, and business outcomes can help advance strategic customer conversations.

**Build and activate a strong practitioner and executive community**, enabling ServiceNow leaders and subject-matter experts to effectively share how ServiceNow uses its own platform, AI capabilities, and workflows to transform the business.

**Translate ServiceNow’s Customer Zero experience into compelling customer stories**, connecting our internal use of ServiceNow products and AI to customer priorities, business challenges, measurable outcomes, and strategic transformation opportunities.

**Partner with Digital Technology and solution teams** to maintain a strong understanding of the ServiceNow product portfolio and identify new Customer Zero stories as capabilities are deployed internally.

**Orchestrate high-impact customer engagements**, bringing together the right executives, practitioners, content, demonstrations, and proof points based on the customer's priorities and stage in the sales cycle.

**Develop reusable GTM assets and enablement** that allow Sales, Solution Consulting, and other field teams to more easily incorporate Now on Now into customer conversations.

**Use engagement and customer-demand data to identify trends and opportunities**, including emerging solution areas, customer priorities, practitioner demand, and opportunities to scale successful engagement patterns.

**Track and communicate the business impact of Now on Now**, developing dashboards and executive insights around engagement volume, customer demand, practitioner activation, strategic account penetration, and influenced business outcomes.

**Continuously improve the Now on Now engagement model**, removing friction, simplifying how field teams access Customer Zero expertise, and developing scalable approaches that increase the program's reach and impact.

 **Qualifications**

**Experience:** 10+ years of relevant experience, including 7+ years in go-to-market strategy, solution consulting, product marketing, sales strategy, customer engagement, or a related function within enterprise technology.

**GTM Expertise:** Demonstrated experience developing and executing programs that connect product capabilities, customer needs, and field sales motions.

**ServiceNow Knowledge:** Strong understanding of the ServiceNow platform, product portfolio, and value proposition, with the ability to connect technology capabilities to business outcomes.

**Executive & Customer Engagement:** Experience working with senior executives, customers, sales leaders, and technical practitioners, with the confidence to facilitate strategic conversations and influence across organizational boundaries.

**Storytelling:** Strong ability to translate complex technology and transformation initiatives into clear, compelling business narratives appropriate for executive and customer audiences.

**Cross-functional Leadership:** Proven ability to lead through influence and successfully orchestrate initiatives across Sales, Solution Consulting, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and other matrixed organizations.

**AI & Enterprise Technology:** Strong understanding of enterprise AI, automation, workflow transformation, and emerging technology trends, with the ability to articulate their relevance to customer transformation.

**Analytical Skills:** Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with experience using engagement, customer, and business data to identify trends, prioritize opportunities, and measure program impact.

**Communication:** Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with audiences ranging from practitioners to senior executives.

**Adaptability:** Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities, technology, and customer needs evolve quickly.

**Education:** Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. MBA or advanced degree preferred.

 **Additional Information**

**Work Personas**

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

description:
**Job Description – Strategic Alliances & Product Management**
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**Designation:**
Manager / Senior Manager / AVP
  
  
**Department:**
Wealth Management / Asset Management
  
  
**Experience:**
6–12 Years
  
  
**Industry:**
Asset Management / Wealth Management / Banking / Financial Services
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an experienced professional to drive strategic distribution partnerships and product management initiatives for AIML's investment offerings. The role will focus on establishing relationships with banks, wealth management firms, and financial intermediaries to expand product distribution, while ensuring effective product positioning, sales enablement, and coordination with internal stakeholders.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Strategic Alliances & Distribution Partnerships
* Identify, develop, and manage strategic partnerships with banks, wealth management companies, and financial intermediaries for distribution of AIML's investment products.
* Drive distributor onboarding, commercial discussions, and relationship management to expand the distribution network.
* Present and position investment offerings, including Mauritius-based USD-denominated funds, Portfolio Management Services (PMS), and Market Linked Debentures (MLDs).
* Work closely with distribution partners to drive product visibility, engagement, and business opportunities.
* Product Management & Sales Enablement
* Manage and regularly update product-related materials, including factsheets, product presentations, investment collaterals, and commission structures.
* Coordinate with investment, research, compliance, and marketing teams to ensure product information is accurate, current, and compliant.
* Support product positioning, launches, and communication of product updates to distribution partners and internal sales teams.
* Act as the central point of contact (SPOC) for channel sales managers across locations, addressing product-related queries and providing necessary sales support.
* Stakeholder Management & Business Coordination
* Collaborate with internal sales teams, product specialists, investment teams, and external distribution partners to ensure smooth business execution.
* Conduct product knowledge sessions and support sales teams with product presentations and distributor engagement.
* Track partnership development, distributor activation, and business opportunities to support distribution growth.

Desired Candidate Profile
  
  

* 6–12 years of experience in strategic alliances, institutional distribution, product management, or channel sales within asset management or wealth management.
* Strong understanding of alternative investment products, PMS, structured products, MLDs, and offshore investment funds.
* Established relationships with banks, wealth management firms, private wealth teams, or financial intermediaries.
* Experience in distributor empanelment, relationship management, and investment product positioning.
* Ability to develop and manage product collaterals, factsheets, presentations, and distribution-related documentation.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to independently drive partnerships while coordinating with geographically distributed sales teams.

**Educational Qualifications**

* MBA / PGDM in Finance, Marketing, or a related discipline.
* CFA, CA, or relevant capital markets certifications would be an added advantage.

**Preferred Candidate Background**

title: Business Manager Drive Systems
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
  
  
We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
**Business Manager - Drive Systems**
As Business Manager - Drive Systems, you will develop and execute strategies that expand Rockwell Automation's Drive Systems business across targeted industries, shape customer specifications, lead strategic pursuits, and build strong relationships with customers and partners. You will collaborate with sales teams, regional stakeholders, and Asia Pacific and Global Business Units to accelerate profitable growth and strengthen market position.
  
  
You will report to the Intelligent Devices Business Leader, India and will be based in Mumbai
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute industry-specific growth strategies for Drive Systems across targeted markets, applications, and strategic accounts.
* Identify emerging opportunities, customer needs, investment trends, and specification opportunities, and convert market insights into account and pursuit plans.
* Lead strategic customer and partner engagement with consultants, EPCs, OEMs, end users, distributors, and system integrators, including executive meetings, workshops, technical presentations, and joint go-to-market activities.
* Collaborate with sales and cross-functional teams to qualify opportunities, establish competitive differentiation, shape commercial and pricing strategies, and improve opportunity conversion, revenue growth, profitability, market penetration, and market share.
* Represent India market requirements with Asia Pacific and Global Business Units, provide competitive and business intelligence to leadership, and coach sales teams on drive applications, value positioning, and win strategies.

**The Essentials - You Will Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent professional experience.
* A proven record in business development, strategic sales, market expansion, and revenue growth.
* Strong knowledge of variable frequency drives, low-voltage and medium-voltage drives, motor control applications, and the Indian industrial automation market.
* Experience engaging senior decision-makers, negotiating contracts, developing strategic partnerships, and working across consultants, EPCs, OEMs, distributors, system integrators, and end users.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and operating effectively in a matrix organization, supported by strong commercial and analytical capability.

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have**

* 15+ years of experience in industrial automation, including 10+ years in drives, motion control, motor control, or drive systems.

**What We Offer**

* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program.
* On-demand digital course library for professional development and continuous learning.
* Opportunities to work with leading technologies and global industry experts.
* Career growth opportunities within a diverse, innovative, and inclusive global organization.

*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*

title: Growth & Revenue Lead
description:
**About Project Noon**

Project Noon is building India's first Sun Control brand- reimagining how people protect, comfort, and recover from everyday sun exposure. We believe the future of sun care goes far beyond sunscreen, and we're creating an entirely new category of products designed to help people live better under the sun.

Built at The Foundery, backed by Nikhil Kamath, Kishore Biyani, and Ronnie Screwvala, Project Noon is being built as a next-generation consumer brand with the ambition to define a new category from India for the world. By combining breakthrough product innovation, thoughtful design, and world-class brand building, we're creating a company that's changing the way millions of people experience the sun.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Revenue Lead to own and drive Project Noon's revenue performance across every sales channel. This is a high-ownership, commercially focused role for someone who can connect the dots between channel strategy, sales execution, marketing investment, customer behaviour and business profitability.

You will be responsible for translating the company's growth ambitions into clear channel-wise targets and actionable plans across D2C, e-commerce marketplaces, quick commerce and general/traditional trade. You will build the revenue planning and reporting discipline that helps the business understand where growth is coming from, what is holding it back, and where to place its next bets.

This role works closely with the Founder and is a central partner to Performance Marketing, Brand, Finance, Supply Chain and external channel partners. It offers the opportunity to shape the commercial engine of an ambitious, early-stage consumer brand as it scales.

**Experience:**

Minimum 5 years of relevant experience across fast growing FMCG brands

**Work arrangement:**

Full-time, on-site | Worli, Mumbai

**Key Responsibilities:*****Revenue Strategy & Channel Ownership***

* Own the overall revenue plan and delivery against monthly, quarterly and annual business targets.
* Develop channel-wise growth strategies and targets across D2C, e-commerce marketplaces, quick commerce and GT/MT.
* Track revenue, orders, average order value, repeat behaviour, channel mix and growth trends; identify gaps and build clear action plans.
* Identify opportunities to improve channel productivity, expand distribution, increase product visibility and accelerate sell-through.
* Build a strong understanding of the economics, operating models and growth levers of each channel.

***Commercial Planning & Performance***

* Build and maintain revenue forecasts, budgets, monthly business plans and channel-wise performance dashboards.
* Monitor net sales, gross-to-net movements, discounts, promotions, commissions, trade spends and contribution margins.
* Strategize on & Evaluate the commercial impact of offers, bundles, pricing, assortment, launches and channel-specific promotions.
* Partner with Finance to track revenue realisation, channel costs, profitability, reconciliations and business performance.
* Use data to distinguish between topline growth and profitable, sustainable growth.

***Channel Partner & Account Management***

* Build and manage working relationships with marketplace, quick-commerce and other channel partners.
* Coordinate with channel teams on onboarding, assortment, catalogue readiness, visibility plans, promotional calendars and business reviews.
* Track channel-specific requirements, commercial terms, campaign opportunities and execution timelines.
* Work with partners to address sales or operational bottlenecks and improve availability, discoverability and conversion.

***Growth & Cross-Functional Collaboration***

* Work closely with the Performance Marketing Associate to connect paid media performance with overall revenue outcomes, channel priorities and business targets.
* Collaborate with Brand and Creative teams to translate consumer, category and channel insights into campaigns, launches, offers and growth initiatives.
* Partner with Supply Chain & Operations on demand forecasts, inventory availability, replenishment priorities and launch planning to minimise stock-outs and excess inventory.
* Work with Finance to ensure that revenue reporting, budgets, channel costs and profitability metrics are accurate and timely.
* Bring together insights from D2C, marketplaces and quick commerce to identify what is working, what is not, and where the business should focus.

***Reporting & Business Reviews***

* Own the weekly and monthly revenue review cadence, including channel-wise performance against targets.
* Create clear, decision-oriented reports that explain performance drivers, risks, opportunities and recommended actions.
* Establish consistent metrics, reporting definitions and processes so that leadership has a reliable view of business performance.
* Translate analysis into decisions and follow through to ensure agreed actions are implemented.

**What We're Looking For**

* A minimum of 5 years of experience in revenue, sales, business growth, category management, e-commerce or commercial roles.
* Previous experience in fast-paced FMCG or consumer brands is ideal; experience in D2C, beauty, skincare, personal care, wellness or lifestyle is highly relevant.
* Strong understanding of multi-channel consumer businesses, ideally spanning D2C, e-commerce marketplaces and quick commerce.
* Demonstrated ability to own revenue targets, build forecasts and translate business goals into channel-level plans.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including familiarity with net revenue, gross margins, contribution margins, discounts, trade spends and channel economics.
* Comfortable working with data, building and interpreting dashboards, and using Excel/Google Sheets to drive decisions.
* Strong stakeholder and partner-management skills, with the ability to work across internal teams and external platforms.
* A hands-on, ownership-oriented approach and the ability to operate in a fast-paced startup environment.

**Key Stakeholders & Liaison**

* Founder: revenue priorities, business reviews, growth plans and key commercial decisions.
* Performance Marketing Associate: paid marketing performance, acquisition efficiency, channel contribution and budget priorities.
* Finance: budgets, revenue reporting, reconciliations, channel costs and profitability.
* Brand & Creative: product launches, campaigns, promotions, consumer insights and channel-specific marketing plans.
* Supply Chain & Operations: demand planning, inventory availability, replenishment and fulfilment readiness.
* External channel partners: marketplace, quick-commerce and other sales-platform teams.

﻿

**Preferred Traits**

* Commercially sharp, analytical and comfortable taking ownership of business outcomes.
* A builder mindset: able to create structure, reporting rhythms and processes where they do not yet exist.
* Able to move between strategic thinking and hands-on execution.
* Curious about consumer behaviour, category trends and the evolving Indian beauty and personal-care landscape.
* Clear communicator who can influence stakeholders and turn insights into action.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, pace and the demands of building a new consumer category.
* Candidates from Tier-1 institutions will be preferred.

*Project Noon is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diverse perspectives and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.*

title: Head of International Business
description:
**Company Description**
Oswal Industries Limited (OIL) is a leading India-based manufacturer of gate, globe, check, ball, cryogenic, and pressure seal valves, serving both domestic and global markets. The company operates India’s largest single-location integrated valve manufacturing facility, supported by a captive steel foundry focused exclusively on valve castings in advanced metallurgy grades including stainless, duplex, super duplex, and exotic alloys. OIL holds multiple international approvals and certifications, reinforcing its credibility with customers across oil and gas, petrochemicals, refineries, power, steel, chemicals, fertilizers, water treatment, offshore, and nuclear sectors. * Demonstrated track record of growing international revenue, developing new territories, and managing long-term customer relationships.
* Willingness to travel internationally as required and work on-site in Mumbai.

title: Manager - Program/Project Management
description:
We are looking for a high-energy Program / Project Manager to help build and scale our Consumer Engagement/ Loyalty business. This is a highly execution-oriented role for someone who can think strategically, get into the details, rally teams, and make things happen. The ideal candidate is someone who combines the structured problem-solving of a top-tier consultant with the mindset of a digital operator - comfortable working across product, technology, marketing, analytics and business teams, navigating ambiguity, and driving initiatives from “what should we do?” to “it’s live.”
  
  
This is not a pure strategy or PMO role. We are looking for someone with execution excellence, strong digital understanding, a high ownership mindset, and the hustle to push through roadblocks and deliver outcomes.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  

* Drive end-to-end programs across the Consumer Engagement/ Loyalty business - from defining the problem and building the roadmap to execution, launch, and performance tracking.
* Work closely with Product, Technology, Digital, Marketing, Analytics, Partnerships and Operations teams to get initiatives delivered.
* Translate business objectives into clear product requirements, execution plans, milestones, owners and KPIs.

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 3–5 years of experience, preferably in a top-tier management consulting firm such as McKinsey, BCG or Bain.
* Strong understanding of digital businesses and digital product execution - you should be comfortable discussing customer journeys, apps/web, funnels, APIs, technology dependencies, data and product roadmaps.
* Demonstrated ability to take ownership and drive execution, rather than simply provide recommendations.
* Excellent project/program management skills with experience coordinating multiple stakeholders and workstreams.

Nice to Have

title: Growth Director - CleverAI

CleverAI is central to CleverTap's next phase of growth. This role is the single owner of making it succeed in the market: taking customers from adoption to measurable business impact, turning those wins into proof points, and converting that proof into revenue. You will work across Customer Success, Sales, Marketing and Product, with no ownership of any one of them but accountability for the combined outcome.

* Own the end-to-end CleverAI growth journey, from customer adoption, implementation, use-case discovery, measurement, and scaling.
* Define success metrics, adoption frameworks, and best practices to help customers achieve measurable business outcomes.

* Create repeatable onboarding frameworks, playbooks, and enablement programs for CSMs and AEs.
* Drive monetisation by partnering with Sales and CS teams on expansion opportunities, account strategies, and upsell motions.
* Enable Sales teams with AI use cases, customer insights, proof points, and positioning to support pipeline generation.
* Partner with Marketing to build the CleverAI narrative, customer stories, campaigns, and market-facing content.
* Act as the voice of the customer by gathering insights, influencing product improvements, and driving customer-centric innovation.
* Build a strong library of customer success stories, testimonials, and case studies that demonstrate business impact.
* Evangelise CleverAI internally by developing training programs, certifications, and resources to keep teams aligned as the product evolves.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 8+ years of experience in growth, product marketing, customer success, GTM or related functions, with prior experience in a growth team.
* Experience taking a product or feature from early adoption to scaled usage and revenue.
* Hands-on understanding of customer implementations and onboarding, and comfort working alongside CS teams on technical and data-dependent rollouts.
* Comfort with data: you define metrics, build dashboards or work with analysts, and use the numbers to tell a story.
* Strong cross-functional influence. You can align Sales, CS, Marketing and Product without direct authority.
* Credibility in customer and prospect conversations, including with senior stakeholders.
* Excellent storytelling, written and verbal, and the ability to turn complex AI capabilities into clear business outcomes.
* Background in martech, CRM, SaaS or data/AI products is a strong plus.

**Measures Of Success**

* Consistently drive high-quality CleverAI implementations, with faster time to go-live and time to first value
* Rising CleverAI adoption and depth of usage across customers
* A growing library of measurable customer success stories and testimonials
* Expansion and upsell revenue attributable to CleverAI
* CSMs and AEs confidently positioning and delivering CleverAI
* Visible product improvements driven by customer feedback

**Why join us**

* Contribute to a product backed by 11 technology patents, showcasing industry-leading innovation. You are passionate about technology and its impact on the high-growth mobile technology space
* Power personalized engagement at scale, processing over 30 billion events daily and reaching 3+ billion devices worldwide.
* Flourish in an Environment that Nurtures Growth and Curiosity

**Learn More**
Get to know us better before you apply!
  
  
Check out our product documentation, engineering blog, and customer stories to see how we work and what we value.
  
  

* Our Culture Video
* CleverAI
* CleverTap Developer Documentation
* Blogs
* TesseractDB™
* CleverTap Product Demo

**About CleverTap**
CleverTap is the world’s leading AI-first, all-in-one customer engagement and retention platform, redefining how brands build lasting customer relationships in the Agentic era. Powered by its proprietary CleverAI™ Decisioning Engine and the Agentic Universe, CleverTap enables autonomous, real-time decision-making that helps organizations deliver 1:1 individualized experiences at scale while maximizing ROI.
  
  
Its unified platform brings together an AI-native Personalization Engine, automated Journey Orchestration, its proprietary Customer Data Platform – TesseractDB™, and deep customer and product analytics to power truly intelligent, self-optimizing engagement across channels including mobile, web, email, SMS, WhatsApp, and more. By seamlessly connecting data, insights, and activation, CleverTap ensures every interaction is contextual, coordinated, and conversion-driven.
  
  
Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Personalization Engines and a Strong Performer in The Forrester Wave™, CleverTap is at the forefront of the shift from campaign-led marketing to agent-led growth. Trusted by more than 2,000 global brands including IKEA, Tesco, Burger King, Levi’s, Decathlon, Domino’s, 7-Eleven, Jio, Grab, Carousell, and Emirates NBD, CleverTap helps businesses drive measurable growth through meaningful, autonomous customer engagement.
  
  
Backed by Accel, Peak XV Partners, Tiger Global, CDPQ, and 360 One, CleverTap has 550+ employees across offices in the US, the Middle East, Asia, and LATAM.
  
  
For more information, visit https://clevertap.com/ or follow us on Linkedin and X.

**Corporate Senior Leader Job Description**
**Position Title:**
**Senior Director Sales & Distribution, West India & SAMHI**

**September 2026**
