Strategic Program Management  

* Define and drive the AI, agentic systems, machine learning, data, and automation transformation strategy for L&D, aligning initiatives with business priorities and evolving customer needs.
* Lead programs from discovery and architecture through implementation, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
* Manage dependencies, risks, success measures, and cross-functional delivery.

Advanced Analytics & Machine Learning  

* Implement descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytics—including machine learning, and agentic AI to uncover skill gaps, forecast learning needs, and measure program impact.
* Build Microsoft Fabric data pipelines, lakehouses or warehouses, and Power BI reporting to support actionable insights and data-driven decisions.
* Establish data-quality controls and measurement frameworks to evaluate learning effectiveness and organizational capability.

Agentic AI & Personalized Learning  

* Design and deploy agentic AI solutions, including autonomous agents, adaptive learning systems, and intelligent tutoring experiences, with appropriate human oversight and operational safeguards.
* Integrate Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Copilot, and Azure Machine Learning to deliver personalized, scalable learning and knowledge experiences.
* Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), grounding, evaluation, and feedback mechanisms to improve AI response quality and relevance.

Document & Speech Intelligence  

* Use Azure AI Document Intelligence to extract, classify, and validate information from structured and unstructured documents.
* Integrate Azure AI Speech capabilities, including speech-to-text and text-to-speech, into conversational, learning, and accessibility solutions.
* Develop workflows that convert documents and spoken interactions into searchable knowledge and actionable insights.

Cloud Architecture & Application Development  

* Architect secure, scalable Azure solutions using Azure App Service/Web Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Cosmos DB, and supporting cloud services.
* Develop applications, APIs, AI integrations, and data-processing components using Python and C#/.NET.
* Design data models, partitioning strategies, and secure access patterns for Azure Cosmos DB.
* Apply managed identities, role-based access control, secrets management, and monitoring across application environments.

CI/CD & Automation  

* Establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, incorporating automated testing, security checks, and controlled deployments.
* Implement repeatable infrastructure and environment provisioning using infrastructure as code.
* Automate business and technical workflows using Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and scripting.
* Improve delivery efficiency and operational reliability through reusable components and automated processes.

Continuous Improvement  

* Use real-time feedback, telemetry, and analytics to iterate on program and solution design.
* Monitor solution performance, reliability, adoption, and cost, ensuring sustained value in a fast-changing environment.

Stakeholder Engagement  

* Translate technical insights into clear recommendations for non-technical audiences.
* Collaborate with business leaders, subject-matter experts, engineering teams, and learning professionals.
* Foster a culture of data-driven decision-making and shared accountability for outcomes.

Responsible AI & Change Management  

* Champion fairness, transparency, privacy, security, and accessibility in AI-enabled learning and knowledge systems.
* Establish appropriate evaluation, human oversight, and governance for agentic AI solutions.

 **Qualifications**

Required/Minimum Qualifications:

Master's Degree or equivalent 10+ year(s) experience in learning and development, relevant technical roles, business development, quota management, human resources (HR), customer success, collection management, research/restoration evaluation, industry, program/project management, or corporate education OR Bachelor's degree or equivalent AND 12+ years experience in learning and development, relevant technical roles, business development, field or sales, HR, customer success, collection management, research/restoration evaluation, industry, or program/project management, corporate education OR equivalent experience.

Additional Required Qualifications:  

* Demonstrated experience in technical program/project management, learning and development, knowledge management, customer success, or a related technical role.
* Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and translating business requirements into technical solutions and measurable outcomes.

Technical expertise  

* Microsoft Azure: Hands-on experience designing and delivering secure, scalable cloud solutions, including identity, access management, monitoring, and application integration.
* Azure AI: Experience building AI-powered applications using Azure AI services, including Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Foundry, with an understanding of agentic workflows, RAG, evaluation, and responsible AI.
* Azure AI Document Intelligence: Experience implementing document extraction, classification, and validation workflows.
* Azure AI Speech: Experience integrating speech-to-text and text-to-speech into applications or automated workflows.
* Azure App Service/Web Apps: Experience developing, deploying, securing, and monitoring web applications and APIs.
* Azure Cosmos DB: Experience with NoSQL data modeling, partitioning, querying, and secure application persistence.
* Microsoft Fabric: Experience with data integration, engineering, and analytics using pipelines, lakehouses, and Power BI.
* Python and C#/.NET: Proficiency in developing APIs, AI integrations, data-processing components, and automation.
* CI/CD: Experience implementing build, test, and deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps.
* Automation: Experience automating workflows using Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and scripting.
* Working knowledge of source control, automated testing, API integration, cloud security, and operational troubleshooting.

Leadership and communication  

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder-management, and communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decisions across organizational boundaries.
* Ability to balance strategic program leadership with hands-on technical execution.

Additional Preferred Qualifications:  

* Bachelor or Master’s degree or equivalent advanced experience in a relevant discipline.
* Significant experience delivering enterprise-scale AI, learning, knowledge-management, or digital-transformation programs.
* Experience with Azure Machine Learning, model deployment, and MLOps practices.
* Experience implementing AI evaluation, prompt/version management, monitoring, and governance practices.
* Experience provisioning cloud infrastructure using Bicep, Terraform, or Azure Resource Manager templates.

* Familiarity with enterprise data governance, privacy, accessibility, and security requirements.
* Relevant Microsoft certifications in Azure, AI, data, Fabric, or DevOps.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: VP -Product
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**POSITION DESCRIPTION**

apexanalytix is the world's leading provider of supplier onboarding, risk management and recovery solutions. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Greensboro, NC, apexanalytix is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management Solutions, recognized for both Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute. More than 320 of the world's largest companies use our AI-native, Quantum Era-ready platform to protect over $9.5 trillion in annual spend.

apexanalytix is seeking an experienced Head of Product to own product strategy and execution across apexanalytix's full platform.

The portfolio spans three connected pillars — supplier onboarding, supplier risk management, and audit and recovery — delivered through a configurable enterprise platform, a self-service data validation and risk API business, and a supplier-facing community platform, with a substantial AI and automation capability underpinning all of them. apexanalytix has also been named Risk Management Company of the Year by SupplyTech Breakthrough and rated the top Supplier Relationship Management and Risk solution by Spend Matters.

This role sits at the center of the business — translating customer and market needs into a coherent, prioritized roadmap across that portfolio, and holding product managers and cross-functional partners in Engineering, Design and Go-to-Market accountable to it. This is a player-coach role: you'll set direction across the full portfolio while staying close enough to individual product areas to make sharp calls when it matters.

This role will lead a team of product managers covering apexanalytix's core product lines, working in close collaboration with Engineering, Sales, Customer Success and Marketing to ensure the roadmap reflects both customer value and business priority.

**The Portfolio:**

Supplier management and risk platform. Multi-tenant enterprise SaaS covering supplier registration and onboarding, self-registration and invite flows, document collection and e-signature, validation gates, approval and status workflow, risk scoring and scorecards, segmentation, revalidation, ERP integration, tax and withholding validation, and consent management. This platform is delivered largely through configuration rather than code — dozens of distinct tenant-scoped configurable surfaces mean a significant share of what a client experiences as "the product" is a configuration decision, not a release.

QubitOn. A product-led, self-service data validation and risk API business with a published price list from a free tier through pay-as-you-go, Pro and Enterprise. Over 70 capabilities spanning data validation, banking and financial verification in 180+ countries, global tax ID and regulatory validation, business intelligence and golden-record matching, compliance and watchlist screening, risk scoring, monitoring and questionnaires — backed by 280M+ verified golden records from 1,000+ sources across 250+ countries. Packaged offerings include BankPro and Registration Essentials, and the platform is also delivered through a self-service developer portal.

Conductor. The supplier-side platform, serving our clients' suppliers and customers rather than the clients themselves: signup, identity and passkey authentication, invite and onboarding flows, invoice visibility and risk information. This is the second side of a two-sided market, with its own adoption dynamics.

Cyberrisk. Third-party and supplier cyber risk monitoring, adjacent to the supplier risk and TPRM capability in the core platform.

Audit, recovery and payment integrity. The accounts payable and contract compliance recovery audit practices — apexanalytix is the largest commercial AP recovery audit firm in the world — and firststrike® Fraud Detect, the duplicate payment prevention product that grew out of our audit algorithms and has run in daily client operations since 2006. A services-plus-software business with a contingency commercial model.

apexanalytix Learn. Subscription-based training and enablement.

AI-enabled capability. A significant AI and automation capability — document intelligence, conversational assistants, supplier intelligence, ESG scoring and AI-assisted audit — built and delivered by a separate AI & Automation organization. This role owns what is packaged, positioned and priced from it for clients, and the prioritized demand signal into that organization.

**Trusted Advisor**

* Leverages deep subject-matter expertise across apexanalytix's product portfolio to advise executive leadership on product strategy and investment trade-offs.
* Acts as the voice of the customer and internal advocate, ensuring insights from enterprise clients (many on the Global 2000) shape the roadmap rather than getting lost between teams.
* Partners with Engineering, Design and Go-to-Market leaders to translate business priorities into a shared, prioritized product roadmap.
* Roles and Requirements
* Owns end-to-end product strategy and roadmap across apexanalytix's core product lines, ensuring alignment with overall company strategy and value-creation priorities.
* Leads, mentors and develops a team of product managers, setting a consistent bar for discovery, prioritization and go-to-market execution across product areas.
* Partners with Engineering leadership to translate roadmap priorities into delivery plans, balancing new feature development against platform investment.
* Owns the commitment-to-delivery discipline: every commitment made to a client, prospect or analyst has a named owner, an entry in the delivery system of record, and a date Engineering has agreed to.
* Owns the configuration-versus-code boundary for the supplier management platform — deciding what becomes a configurable capability, what remains a per-tenant configuration, and what becomes a product feature — and is accountable for the long-run support and upgrade cost of that choice.
* Drives customer discovery and market research to validate product bets, working directly with enterprise customers, Sales and Customer Success.
* Owns the supplier-side product experience as a first-class concern with its own adoption metrics, not as a downstream consequence of client-side decisions.
* Defines and tracks product success metrics — adoption, retention, revenue impact, API consumption and supplier activation — and reports progress to executive leadership.
* Leads pricing and packaging decisions in partnership with Finance and Sales leadership across materially different commercial models: enterprise SaaS subscription, usage-metered self-service API with a published free tier, contingency-based recovery audit services, and subscription-based offerings such as apexanalytix Learn.
* Represents Product in executive reviews and with industry analysts, providing clear, data-driven narratives on roadmap progress and business impact.
* Champions a consistent product management practice — discovery frameworks, roadmap cadence, prioritization criteria — across the team.

**Required Skills**

* 10+ years of product management experience, including 4+ years leading and developing a team of product managers.
* Experience owning product strategy for a B2B enterprise SaaS platform, ideally serving large, complex enterprise customers.
* Direct experience with at least two distinct commercial models — enterprise subscription, usage-metered/API, marketplace or network, or services-attached.
* Experience with a self-service or product-led growth motion, including free-tier design, conversion funnel, usage-based pricing and developer experience.
* Experience with a highly configurable enterprise product, and a clear point of view on where configurability creates leverage and where it creates unmanageable divergence.
* Strong technical fluency — comfortable partnering directly with engineering leadership on architecture and platform trade-offs, even without a hands-on engineering background.
* Proven track record turning customer and market insight into a prioritized, well-communicated roadmap.
* Experience with pricing/packaging strategy and business-case development for new products or product lines.
* Strong executive presence — able to represent Product credibly in front of executive leadership, industry analysts and, as needed, the Board.
* Experience working with a distributed engineering organization across US and India time zones.
* Strong communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience in supply chain, procurement, accounts payable, fintech, audit, third-party risk or data/analytics domains.
* Experience with a two-sided or network product where adoption on the non-paying side determines the value of the paying side.
* Experience packaging and pricing AI capability as a product, including the guardrail, assurance and liability considerations that accompany it.
* Experience in regulated or attested environments (SOC 2, FedRAMP) where compliance shapes the roadmap.
* Education Levels/Credentials (Degree types and Emphasis) - Undergraduate degree required; MBA or other graduate business degree a strong plus but not required.

**Location**

* apexanalytix Headquarters (HQ) at Greensboro, NC, USA (hybrid).

**Travel required — occasional, including periodic travel to the Noida, India GCC and to enterprise clients.**

**Scope Boundaries:**

**This role owns what gets built and why, for whom, and at what price. Engineering delivery and release execution sit with the VP, Head of Software Development; technical architecture with the Architect; platform strategy and infrastructure investment with the SVP, Global Head of Engineering & Infrastructure; security policy and compliance attestation with the CISO; and AI and automation delivery with a separate AI & Automation organization.**

Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/

Benefits

At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence. With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

title: Senior Manager – International Business (Medical Devices)
description:
**International Business & Overseas Brand Development**

**Company:** Sterimed Group

**Location:** Bahadurgarh, Haryana & Rohini, Delhi

**Experience:** 10+ years in medical device exports

**Reporting to:** Managing Director

**Role level:** Senior Manager / Lead

**About Sterimed Group**

Founded in 1955, Sterimed Group is a growing Indian manufacturer with a presence in medical and surgical devices, industrial and medical adhesive tapes. The company offers a range of over 100 products and serves healthcare providers across domestic and international markets, covering more than 50 countries.

Sterimed Group is focused on expanding into newer products and geographies while building on more than 70 years of trust, quality, and customer goodwill.

**About the Role**

Sterimed Group is looking for an experienced international business leader to build and grow its own medical device brand across overseas markets.

This is a leadership role with strategic and operational ownership of assigned international markets. The selected candidate will be responsible for shaping market-entry strategy, developing distributor networks, strengthening brand positioning, and driving revenue growth.

This role is not limited to international sales. It requires a professional who can build the brand in overseas markets, understand local customer needs, develop the right distribution partnerships, and ensure that products are positioned competitively.

**What You Will Own**

* Overseas growth strategy for Sterimed Group’s own medical device brand.
* Market prioritisation, entry sequence, pricing, positioning, and partner model.
* Distributor, dealer, and strategic-partner development across target markets.
* Brand visibility, product positioning, and competitive presence in international markets.
* Lead generation and conversion through exhibitions, digital outreach, B2B platforms, and networking.
* Team building and consistent lead conversion.
* OEM and private-label business development as an additional growth avenue.

**Key Responsibilities**

**International Strategy & Market Expansion**

* Drive the overseas growth of the company’s own medical device brand, owning the strategy, markets, and results.
* Shape the overseas expansion strategy, including decisions on which markets to enter, the order of entry, pricing, positioning, and partner model.
* Work directly with the promoters and senior management.

**Distributor & Partner Development**

* Identify, evaluate, and onboard distributors, dealers, and strategic partners.
* Negotiate commercial terms, agreements, and exclusivity arrangements.
* Build strong distributor networks to support market expansion.

**Brand, Marketing & Lead Generation**

* Build the brand in overseas markets and ensure products are positioned competitively.
* Understand local customer needs and translate them into effective market and product positioning.
* Plan the exhibition and lead-generation strategy, combining trade shows, digital outreach, B2B platforms, and networking.
* Build a team that converts leads consistently.

**Regulatory & Market Readiness**

* Drive product registrations with the regulatory team to ensure the brand is market-ready ahead of expansion plans.

**Travel & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Travel overseas to meet distributors, hospitals, and key opinion leaders, and represent the brand.

**Business Growth**

* Develop OEM and private-label business as an additional growth avenue.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 10+ years of experience in medical device exports and international business.
* Proven ability to open new markets and appoint distributors.
* Experience in or exposure to brand building, beyond trading.
* Working knowledge of international regulatory frameworks and export documentation.
* Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
* An entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to build independently in the absence of an established structure.
* Willingness to travel extensively.

**Why Join Sterimed Group**

* Own international market strategy, distributor development, and business performance.
* Work directly with the Managing Director, promoters, and senior leadership.
* Shape international expansion through market entry, pricing, positioning, and partnership decisions.
* Build a team and create long-term impact across global markets.
* Competitive remuneration as per industry standards.

**Compensation:** Competitive and flexible remuneration, with exceptional compensation potential for candidates demonstrating outstanding international business leadership, proven market expansion capabilities, and a strong track record of building global brands.

**Mandatory Application Requirement:** Candidates must attempt and submit responses to all screening questions while applying. Applications with unanswered screening questions may not be considered for further evaluation.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates may apply through Indeed or email their updated CV and cover letter to **hrssipl@sterimedgroup.com**.

Pay: ₹1,800,000.00 - ₹3,600,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience building and developing an organisation's own medical device brand in overseas markets, beyond OEM or trading business?
* Have you been responsible for international market revenue targets, business development strategy and distributor performance?
* Do you have experience developing OEM or private-label business in international markets?
* Are you willing to travel internationally for distributor meetings, exhibitions, hosp and business development?
* Are you comfortable working from Bahadurgarh, Haryana or Rohini, Delhi?
* Have you managed or built an international sales/business development team?
* Do you have experience in international business or export sales within the medical device industry? If so, how many years of experience do you have?

title: Senior Growth Manager
description:
**About Moloco:**

Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet. Founded in 2013 by machine learning engineers who had built AI advertising systems inside the world's largest technology companies, Moloco began from a shared mission: to build that same engine for the open internet.

Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system. **Moloco Ads** is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet. **Moloco Commerce Media** is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by **CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture)**, the AI system behind every Moloco product.

At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer. **Come build what's next.**

**The Impact You'll Be Contributing to Moloco:**

Join Moloco as a Senior Growth Manager and help advertisers grow their mobile businesses. Moloco Ads is an AI-native performance advertising platform that helps app marketers acquire and re-engage high-value users across the open internet, optimising campaigns towards measurable business outcomes.

You'll build a deep understanding of each client's business, shape their growth strategy, and work with colleagues across Sales, Marketing, Data Science, and Product to turn insights into better performance and lasting partnerships.

This role is based in Gurgaon, with a hybrid working model.

**The Opportunity:**

* Develop a deep understanding of clients' businesses and marketing objectives, and show how Moloco Ads can help achieve them.
* Build a clear, data-driven strategy for each client, taking ownership of account performance and long-term growth.
* Partner with Sales, other Growth Managers, Data Science and cross-functional teams to improve campaign performance and grow client accounts.
* Lead client relationships, meetings and business reviews, building trust through clear communication and actionable recommendations.
* Analyse campaign data, translate complex findings into clear insights, and use them to guide client decisions.
* Identify and recommend opportunities to expand client investment in line with growth objectives.
* Work with GTM, Product, and Data Science to improve products and client solutions, bringing client needs and feedback into the process.
* Look beyond individual campaigns to identify recurring challenges, address root causes and develop approaches the wider team can use.
* Stay informed about developments in the mobile advertising ecosystem and translate relevant trends into practical advice for clients.

**How Do I Know if the Role is Right For Me?**

* 6+ years of experience in mobile advertising account management, with experience in programmatic marketing.
* A track record of managing and growing major advertiser accounts.
* Hands-on experience in day-to-day campaign management and optimisation.
* Familiarity with mobile measurement partners (MMPs), the mobile app ecosystem and advertising technology, alongside confidence working with large datasets.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into compelling stories, clear recommendations and effective client presentations.
* Sound commercial judgment: you use data and client context to recommend next steps, explain trade-offs and adapt as new information emerges.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills: you bring clients and cross-functional partners into the work early, communicate recommendations clearly and build alignment across different perspectives.
* A strong sense of ownership and a curious, proactive approach to solving problems.
* Attention to detail and a data-driven approach to decision-making.
* Adaptability, initiative and a willingness to learn in a fast-moving environment.
* Fluency in English.
* Flexibility to travel according to business needs.

**Supporting Your Best Work and Your Best Life:**

Our benefits are designed to support our people in doing their best work and living well, at work and beyond. Benefits vary by country, employment type, and eligibility. Connect with a recruiter to learn more about benefits in your region.

**Moloco Values:**

* **Lead with Humility:** Everyone's voice is respected, valued, and heard. We win, lose, and learn together. Accountability and feedback are essential to our success.
* **Uncapped Growth Mindset:** We see all situations as opportunities to learn, grow, and improve as individuals and as an organization. We seek diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and promote experimentation to push the boundaries of what's possible.
* **Create Real Value:** We pursue the most impactful opportunities with intensity and rigor. We take intelligent risks and make disciplined trade-offs to maintain deep focus. We help our customers win by delivering durable value.
* **Go Further Together:** We're one team working towards one vision. We collaborate proactively and inclusively, involving the right people at the right time and in the right way. We strive to create a more equitable workplace. We won't let each other fail.

**Additional Resources:**

* Moloco Company Blog
* Moloco Leadership
* Moloco Newsroom

**AI Use in Interviews**

Our interview process is designed to get to know the real you. Unless a round specifically includes AI as part of what's being assessed, we ask that candidates engage without AI assistance. Please review our AI Use in Interviews Policy before your interview to understand what to expect. Failure to comply with this policy may impact your candidacy.

**Candidate Privacy Notice:**

Your privacy matters to us. By applying, you acknowledge that you've reviewed our Candidate Privacy Notice.

title: Director - Product Management and MarTech
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
About Lilly
  
At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients.
  
We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world.
  
Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve.
  
We bring our best to this work because people depend on it.
  
If you’re driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
  
  
About Lilly’s India Affiliate
  
Few careers offer the opportunity to work directly for the people your work is ultimately meant to serve.
  
Lilly’s India affiliate is one of them.
  
Whether you are building brand strategies, developing sales capabilities, creating market access, or enabling the teams that do — the work you do here ensures that Lilly’s medicines reach the people who need them.
  
  
Purpose of the Job
  
The Director – Product Management and MarTech leads the digital and marketing technology agenda for the CMO organisation. The role drives digitization initiatives across Strategic Capabilities and the enterprise-wide technology transformation agenda.
  
  
Additionally, the role will also help in shaping the user personalization strategy for AFL so that it is aligned with broader brand and commercial objectives. The role impacts across multiple functions.
  
  
The incumbent also acts as strategic digital partner to the team leads across CMO organisation capabilities: designing the product vision, translating it into user experience and interface design, running digital products that attract and retain users, and building a strong digital environment that the whole organisation can use. The role combines Digital Product Management, media, ad tech, digital and retention marketing expertise with the ability to lead technology-enabled change within strict medical, ethical and regulatory guardrails.
  
  
Regular interaction with CMO organisation leaders, Medical, Business Technology, E&C, Legal, Data Privacy, and IBU / global digital counterparts, and with external agencies and technology partners.
  
  
Recognised as an expert in the area, with strong ability to influence senior leaders, internal customers and external partners on key decisions.
  
  
Anticipates, identifies and solves complex technical and business problems affecting the functional area.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
Digital Vision & Product Strategy
  
  

* Design the product vision and roadmap for MedMarTech, aligned with the CMO organisation’s brand, commercial and capability priorities.
* Translate the vision into clear product requirements, user journeys and design specifications that engineering, design and agency teams, from build and launch through adoption, so that products are delivered on time, within budget and to quality standards.
* Anticipate long- and short-term digital, customer and competitive trends and shape the strategy accordingly.

Digitization & Technology Transformation
  
  

* Lead digitization initiatives across Strategic Capabilities, driving the enterprise-wide technology transformation agenda for the CMO organisation.
* Partner with Business Technology, IBU and global digital teams to align local initiatives with global platforms, standards and roadmaps.
* Identify and prioritise opportunities to improve processes, products and services through technology, and lead their delivery from concept to scale.

Digital Media Strategy & Ad Tech
  
  

* Shape the digital media strategy jointly with CMO Functions and Tech leadership for AFL, ensuring alignment with broader brand and commercial objectives.
* Define and govern the ad tech and media technology approach (e.g., programmatic buying, audience data, tracking and measurement), and guide agencies on channel mix, targeting and optimisation.
* Ensure media effectiveness through measurement frameworks, attribution and continuous optimisation based on performance data.

Digital Product Management, UX & UI
  
  

* Own digital products end to end as a digital product manager, with a focus on attracting and retaining users: discovery, design, launch, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Set UX and UI standards and drive user research, journey mapping and usability testing so digital experiences are simple, engaging and consistent.
* Use product analytics and user feedback to prioritise the backlog and improve engagement and retention.

Digital & Retention Marketing
  
  

* Lead digital and retention marketing capabilities, including lifecycle journeys, personalisation and always-on engagement that bring users back and deepen their engagement.
* Enable brand teams with reusable journeys, content frameworks and campaign playbooks; track retention, engagement and conversion outcomes.
* Build capability in test-and-learn approaches to continuously improve channel and content performance.

MedMarTech Platforms & Digital Environment
  
  

* Build and maintain a strong, integrated digital environment: marketing technology stack, content and experience platforms, data and analytics tools that work together.
* Ensure platform architecture, data flows, integrations, security and scalability meet business needs, working with Business Technology and vendors.
* Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies (including AI-enabled tools) through structured pilots and scale-up decisions.

Strategic Digital Partner to CMO Organisation
  
  

* Partner with team leads across CMO organisation capabilities as their trusted digital and technology partner: understand their priorities, co-create solutions and prioritise requests against organisational objectives.
* Define a clear MedMarTech offering (what is provided, how teams engage, how requests are prioritised and expected turnaround) so team leads know what to expect and can plan with confidence.
* Deliver digital solutions, tools and support that make each team more effective; track and report the value delivered and use feedback to improve the offering continuously.

Vendor & Partner Ecosystem
  
  

* Scout, select and manage agencies, technology vendors and ad tech partners; negotiate terms within budget and policy guidelines and hold partners accountable for performance.
* Build a scalable partner ecosystem and governance model that improves speed, quality and cost efficiency.

Compliance, Data Privacy & Governance
  
  

* Ensure digital products, media and marketing activities comply with Lilly policies, applicable regulations and industry codes, partnering with Medical, E&C, Legal and Data Privacy.
* Embed governance for approved content and medical-legal-regulatory review, consent and data privacy, and digital security into product and campaign workflows.
* Ensure adverse event and product complaint reporting requirements are built into digital channels and partner operations.

Analytics, Performance & Insights
  
  

* Define KPIs and dashboards for digital media, product and retention performance; take ownership of reporting on adoption, engagement, retention and return on investment.
* Turn data into insights and recommendations for CMO organisation leaders and use them to shape strategy and investment decisions.

Program & Budget Management
  
  

* Lead large-scale programs with significant risk, resource and complexity to achieve critical business objectives, including the enterprise technology transformation agenda.
* Manage resources and budgets for programs and operations, including forecasting, prioritisation and vendor spend.

Required Qualifications
  
  

* MBA with Bachelor’s degree in Engineering.
* 13–15 years of extensive experience in digital marketing, digital product management or marketing technology, with a track record of leading large digital transformation programs.
* Specialised depth and breadth across digital media and ad tech, UX / UI and product design, and digital and retention marketing.
* Experience partnering with business leaders as an internal service provider or digital solutions partner.
* Experience managing agencies, technology vendors and budgets for large programs.

Additional Preferences
  
  

* Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry, including working within promotional compliance, medical-legal-regulatory review and data privacy requirements.
* Working knowledge of the marketing technology landscape: content and experience platforms, marketing automation, data and analytics tools.
* Ability to translate a product vision into clear requirements, designs and delivery plans.
* Ability to make complex technical and business decisions within functional, company and industry guidelines.
* Awareness of emerging technologies, including AI, and how they can improve customer engagement and productivity.
* Strong communication, storytelling and stakeholder management skills; sensitivity towards confidential data.
* Strong people leadership: coaching and developing team members.

Additional Information
  
  

* Expected to be based in the office 4 days a week.
* May require domestic and international travel.
* Must be legally allowed to work in India.
* Incumbent must be based in Gurugram (Delhi NCR).

title: Category Manager (Signage )
description:
**Job title:** Category Manager, New Signage Categories

**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana (on-site)  
**Job type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 5 to 8 years  
**Pay:** Up to ₹10,00,000 per year

**About the company**  
CrazyNeon is a fast-growing e-commerce brand specializing in custom LED neon signs and other custom signage, selling to customers across the US and other international markets. Owned and operated by Propound Internet Pvt. Ltd., we’re building the next generation of the custom signage buying experience, combining e-commerce, technology, design, automation and AI.

**About the role**  
You will identify, launch and scale new signage categories on crazyneon.com, taking each from idea to a profitable, scalable part of our range. You’ll decide which categories we add, how they are priced, listed, marketed, sourced and delivered, and own the P&L for the categories you launch. This role blends e-commerce product thinking, conversion optimization, data and applied AI.

**What you’ll do**

* Build and own the new-category roadmap, revenue targets and annual plan
* Research demand, search trends and competitors (Amazon, Etsy, VistaPrint, Signs.com, BuildASign) to find new category opportunities, and build a business case for each launch
* Define the range for each category: materials, sizes, finishes, mounting options and add-ons, for both D2C and business buyers
* Run launches end to end: sourcing and sampling, costing, listing, pricing, marketing and go-live, then decide whether to scale, refine or exit
* Set pricing, bundles and volume tiers, and own revenue, gross margin, AOV, discounts and return/remake costs
* Plan seasonal promotions (Halloween, Christmas, Valentine’s Day, wedding season, Black Friday)
* Own category and product pages on crazyneon.com (Shopify), including structure, filters, content, images and mockups
* Work with the tech team to extend the custom design/upload tool and size/price configurator
* Drive SEO with the marketing team, and run A/B tests to improve conversion
* Use AI and automation tools for research, listing content, mockups and reporting
* Onboard vendors and production partners, set quality and packaging standards, and track delivery times, damage and remake rates
* Brief marketing on Google Shopping, Meta ads, email and social campaigns, and grow B2B and bulk orders with the sales team
* Report weekly and monthly on sales, margin, traffic, conversion and customer feedback, and guide category executives, designers and listing specialists

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, engineering or similar (MBA is a plus)
* 5 to 8 years of experience, with at least 3 years in category management, product management or merchandising for an e-commerce or D2C brand
* Proven record of launching and scaling new categories with clear revenue and margin results
* Strong grasp of pricing, unit economics and P&L
* Comfortable with Shopify (or similar), Google Analytics, Excel/Google Sheets and SEO basics
* Experience selling to international customers, ideally in the US, UK or Europe
* Clear written and spoken English; able to work with US/UK teams across time zones
* Data-driven, organized, and able to work across design, production, marketing and tech

**Good to have**

* Experience with signage or custom-made products (printing, packaging, personalized gifts, home décor)
* Knowledge of signage materials, manufacturing and finishing processes
* B2B, bulk or wholesale sales experience
* Familiarity with product configurators and design-upload tools
* Working-level Google Shopping and Meta ads experience

title: Assistant Manager, Growth
description:
**Company Description**

Launched in 2007 by Aloke Bajpai & Rajnish Kumar, ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited) is a technology company focused on empowering Indian travellers to plan, book and manage their trips across rail, air, buses and hotels. ixigo assists travellers in making smarter travel decisions by leveraging artificial intelligence. The ixigo, ConfirmTkt and AbhiBus apps allow travellers to book train tickets, flight tickets, bus tickets, hotels, and cabs, and provide travel utility tools and services developed using in-house proprietary algorithms and crowd-sourced information. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in Fiscal 2025, ixigo is the leading OTA for Next Billion Users in India. For more information, please visit http://www.ixigo.com

 **Job Description**

About the role

You will own the daily execution engine of the Growth team: performance marketing campaigns, CRM/lifecycle communications, and the content calendar behind them. The strategy and budget are set by the Growth lead; you make sure every campaign ships on time, to the right segment, with the right creative, and that the numbers are read the next morning.

This is a hands-on role. You will spend most of your week inside CleverTap/MoEngage/WebEngage, Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager, and n8n. You will use AI tools (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) every day for drafting copy, building segments, analysing campaign data and automating repetitive work.

The role is a fit for someone who has run campaigns from a blank slate, not only maintained existing ones, and who is comfortable with the technical side of martech: webhooks, APIs, JSON payloads and event schemas.

Key responsibilities

1. Performance marketing execution (approx. 30% of time)

* Run day-to-day operations on Google Ads (Search, App campaigns, PMax) and Meta Ads: campaign setup, audience and creative rotation, budget pacing, bid changes within approved guardrails.
* Maintain daily spend, CAC and ROAS trackers; flag anomalies (pacing, CPI/CPA spikes, disapprovals, tracking breaks) the same day.
* Coordinate with design and content for creative refreshes; maintain the creative testing log (hypothesis, variant, result).
* Work with the analytics/MMP owner (AppsFlyer/Adjust/Branch or equivalent) to keep attribution and events clean.

2. CRM and lifecycle campaigns (approx. 40% of time)

* Build, QA and schedule campaigns and journeys on CleverTap / MoEngage / WebEngage across push, in-app, WhatsApp, SMS, email and RCS.
* Own segmentation logic: event- and property-based cohorts, RFM, control groups, frequency capping and suppression lists.
* Design and launch campaigns from scratch: brief, segment, creative, copy, deep links, test send, go-live, read-out.
* Run A/B and holdout tests on copy, timing, channel and offer; document uplift against control, not only open/click rates.
* Keep deliverability healthy: template approvals (WhatsApp/DLT), opt-out hygiene, rendering checks across devices.

3. Content calendar and communication planning (approx. 15% of time)

* Own the monthly and weekly communication calendar across all CRM channels, aligned to travel seasonality, long weekends, festivals, route/product launches and offers.
* Enforce frequency rules so segments are not over-messaged; resolve clashes between business units asking for the same slot.
* Keep a single source of truth (sheet/board) of what went out, to whom, and with what result.

4. Automation and AI-assisted workflows (approx. 15% of time)

* Build and maintain basic n8n workflows: trigger on webhook or schedule, call an API, transform JSON, write to a sheet/database or push to the CRM tool.
* Use Claude / Gemini / ChatGPT for copy variants, segment ideation, campaign post-mortems and reporting summaries; keep prompt templates reusable for the team.
* Reduce manual reporting: automate daily campaign pulls and alerts where possible.

5. Reporting and coordination

* Publish the daily growth dashboard and a weekly read-out with wins, misses and next actions.
* Coordinate with product, tech, design, content and business teams to unblock campaign dependencies (events, deep links, landing pages, offers).

6. Responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

 **Qualifications**

Requirements:

* 3–5 years in growth, performance or CRM marketing at a B2C internet company; travel, mobility or hyperlocal preferred.
* Hands-on, current execution experience on at least one of CleverTap, MoEngage or WebEngage: can build a segment, a multi-step journey and an A/B test without supervision.
* Has launched at least one campaign or journey from scratch (brief to read-out) and can walk through the segment logic, creative choices and results.
* Working knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager: campaign setup, budget pacing, basic optimisation and reading CAC/ROAS.
* Understands webhooks, REST APIs and JSON well enough to read an API doc, test an endpoint (Postman or equivalent) and map a JSON payload to CRM user properties or events.
* Has built at least a basic n8n (or Zapier/Make) workflow with a trigger, an API call and a data transform; can explain what an agentic workflow is and where it differs from a fixed automation.
* Uses Claude, Gemini or ChatGPT in daily work and can show examples: copy variants, data analysis, campaign ideation.
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets at a pivot and lookup level; can read a dashboard and explain a trend.
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.

 **Additional Information**

Good-to-have:

* Experience in an OTA, bus/rail/air booking app, hotel platform or mobility/hyperlocal business with high-frequency, price-sensitive users.
* Exposure to MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch) and event instrumentation for app campaigns.
* WhatsApp Business API experience (Gupshup, Interakt, Karix or similar): template categories, utility vs marketing classification, DLR analysis.
* Basic SQL (SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY) for pulling cohorts without waiting on analytics.
* Experience with App Store / Play Store campaigns, ASO or Apple Search Ads.
* Built an LLM-powered workflow end to end (e.g., n8n + OpenAI/Claude node for auto-generating or classifying campaign content).
* Familiarity with incrementality or holdout-based measurement rather than last-click attribution alone.

title: Sr.Regional Business Manager (South) - Indian Region
description:
**Give hope. Give health. Make your mark in the fight against cancer.**

At Accuray, we make a direct and powerful impact on the lives of cancer patients every day — helping them live longer, better lives. But our commitment to innovation offers a truly unique opportunity: the chance to change the fight against cancer — helping to develop, introduce and support new treatment delivery systems and software that will give new hope and new health to cancer patients and cancer survivors around the world.

Accuray develops, manufactures and sells radiotherapy systems for alternative cancer treatments. Our radiation therapy for cancer makes treatment shorter, safer, personalized and more effective, ultimately enabling patients to live longer, better lives.

**Job Description**

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Responsible for managing commercial and sales targets for the region mainly but not limited to new orders, revenue, margins, upgrades sales & market share aspects of the business. Contribute to timely renewal of service contracts in the assigned territory.
* The individual has to carry out business by accurately positioning Accuray’s products and portfolios in Private market, Strategic Accounts & Govt. accounts while maintaining high visibility in assigned geography to ultimately gain the market share.
* Assess individual markets and develop together with the Marketing, Service teams and Senior Regional Business Director, sales and marketing plans and strategies to achieve business goals with prospects and existing customers for new system sales.
* Develop relationships and build Accuray advocacy within the respective territory.
* Coordinate all regional sales activities to achieve the quarterly and yearly goals. Ability to forecast the business imperatives and maintain linearity of business on Quarter-to-Quarter basis.
* Develop reference centers for the region.
* Assist the sales channels in the preparation of high-level proposals and product/clinical features, advantages, and benefits (FAB) to medical physicists, oncologists, and key administrators.
* Participate in customer training programs, industry symposia and trade shows.
* Build and keep the funnel in SalesForce.com (Customer Relationship Management System) up to date in order to deliver a reliable forecast to the management.
* Ensure safety and quality considerations and requirements are proactively addressed and implemented in marketing & customer requirements.
* Follow the timeline for internal QA-related tasks, like Accuray University.
* Address and report in a timely fashion safety and quality issues raised by customers or staff.
* Supports Accuray’s Quality System and Safety & Health Program by following procedures and mentoring others
* Inform the Regional Business Director about the competitive landscape and advice for pricing strategies for the respective territory.
* Managing accolated quarterly budget for Travel, lodging & business expenses and accurately reporting of same.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor/Master’s degree in biomedical engineering or related field is required.
* 8 years or more professional sales experience of medical equipment with specific knowledge of the assigned territory is highly desired. Other related experience may also be considered.
* Familiarity and experience with oncology, radiotherapy, IMRT, Radiosurgery, Medical Physics, and other hospital/healthcare practices.
* Excellent level of English (read, written, spoken). Local language, Tamil, Telegu and Kannada will be an added advantage.
* Experience demonstrating strong written and verbal skills including an ability to present.
* Excellent customer relation skills, problem solving and stakeholder management in a matrixed organization.
* Experience with the use of standard office software programs including spreadsheet, word-processing, email applications and Power Point.
* Ability to be self-motivated and to work independently.
* Capability to work home based while keeping a high standard of motivation, professionalism, and ethic.
* Team worker and loyal team member
* Dynamic, proactive, and driven to high levels of accomplishment.
* Willingness to travel at least 60% of the time.

We offer five-day work with attractive benefits package to the right candidates. Please send your resume with current and expected salary details and a cover letter quoting the job reference to **jobs-asia@accuray.com**

All information received will be kept strictly confidential and used for recruitment purposes only.

**To qualify for this position, candidates must be able to furnish proof that they are authorized to work in the country they are applying on a permanent basis without sponsorship.**

**Job Description**
Job Description – Key Account Manager (Q-Commerce – Ambient & Frozen)
  
  
Company: Sarya Holdings Pvt. Ltd.
  
  
Location: Kolkata
  
  
Department: Sales – Quick Commerce
  
  
Position: Key Account Manager (KAM) – Q-Commerce
  
  
Experience: 4–8 Years
  
  
**About The Company**
Sarya Holdings is an FMCG distribution group operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and India. In India, the company focuses on building and scaling Korean food brands, including Good Seoul, Samyang, OKF, and other partner brands.
  
  
The company operates across Quick Commerce, Modern Trade, and General Trade, with a strong presence on platforms such as Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket, Flipkart Minutes, and Amazon Fresh.
  
  
**Job Overview**
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Key Account Manager – Q-Commerce to manage and drive the overall business for both Ambient and Frozen product categories.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing national/platform-level sales, developing strong relationships with Quick Commerce platforms, driving business growth, improving product availability, managing listings, promotions, pricing, inventory, and ensuring operational excellence.
  
  
The role will involve managing both regular ambient products and temperature-sensitive frozen products, ensuring proper cold chain management, inventory control, and business expansion across platforms.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Key Account & Business Management

Manage and grow business across Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket, Flipkart Minutes, and Amazon Fresh.
  
  
Act as the primary point of contact for Quick Commerce platform central teams.
  
  
Build and maintain strong relationships with platform category managers and key stakeholders.
  
  
Drive sales targets, revenue growth, account profitability, and business expansion.
  
  
Lead commercial negotiations, visibility packages, pricing discussions, and Joint Business Planning (JBP).
  
  

* Sales & Category Management – Ambient and Frozen

Drive sales growth across both Ambient and Frozen product categories.
  
  
Develop category-wise sales strategies and expansion plans.
  
  
Monitor primary and secondary sales performance across platforms.
  
  
Ensure product assortment, pricing, and availability across relevant platforms.
  
  
Identify opportunities for new product launches and category expansion.
  
  

* Availability & Inventory Management

Monitor daily product availability and stock levels across platforms.
  
  
Identify and resolve Out-of-Stock (OOS) issues.
  
  
Coordinate with supply chain and warehouse teams to ensure timely stock replenishment.
  
  
Maintain healthy inventory levels and minimize stock-outs and product expiry.
  
  
Prepare rolling forecasts and monitor forecast accuracy.
  
  

* Frozen Category & Cold Chain Management

Ensure proper cold chain compliance throughout transportation and storage.
  
  
Coordinate reefer dispatches, temperature monitoring, and cold chain documentation.
  
  
Manage freezer capacity at distribution centres (DCs) and dark stores.
  
  
Coordinate freezer allocation and infrastructure requirements with platform teams.
  
  
Handle temperature-related rejections and resolve operational issues.
  
  
Monitor FEFO (First Expiry, First Out), shelf life, ageing inventory, and expiry risks.
  
  

* Promotions, Listings & New Product Launches

Plan and execute promotional campaigns across Quick Commerce platforms.
  
  
Manage product listings, catalogue accuracy, pricing, and visibility.
  
  
Coordinate new product launches (NPD) and ensure timely platform onboarding.
  
  
Monitor promotional performance and analyse ROI.
  
  
Ensure promotional activities are aligned with stock availability and inventory requirements.
  
  

* Reporting & Analytics

Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales and business performance reports.
  
  
Monitor platform-wise sales, availability, inventory, and category performance.
  
  
Track key business KPIs and identify improvement opportunities.
  
  
Conduct regular business reviews with management and platform partners.
  
  
Maintain dashboards and provide actionable business insights.
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
4–8 years of experience in FMCG, Food & Beverage, or food distribution sales.
  
  
Minimum 2+ years of direct experience managing Quick Commerce or E-commerce key accounts.
  
  
Hands-on experience with platforms such as Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket, Amazon, or Flipkart.
  
  
Experience managing both Ambient and Frozen/Food categories will be highly preferred.
  
  
Strong understanding of sales growth, account management, commercial negotiations, and category management.
  
  
Knowledge of inventory management, forecasting, product availability, and supply chain operations.
  
  
Understanding of cold chain logistics, temperature-controlled storage, and frozen product handling.
  
  
Strong analytical skills with advanced Excel and familiarity with Power BI, GobbleCube, or platform dashboards.
  
  
Ability to manage platform relationships and independently drive business targets.
  
  
Graduate degree required; MBA or Supply Chain qualification preferred.
  
  
**Preferred Industry Background**
Candidates from the following industries will be preferred:
  
  
FMCG and Food & Beverage
  
  
Frozen Foods and Frozen Snacks
  
  
Dairy and Ice Cream
  
  
Ready-to-Eat and Packaged Foods
  
  
Food Distribution and Supply Chain
  
  
Quick Commerce and E-commerce
  
  
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
Overall sales growth and revenue achievement.
  
  
Product availability across Quick Commerce platforms.
  
  
Fill rate and inventory management.
  
  
Dark store coverage and distribution expansion.
  
  
Promotion execution and sales performance.
  
  
Forecast accuracy and stock planning.
  
  
Listing accuracy and new product launches.
  
  
Cold chain compliance and frozen product availability.
  
  
Reduction in stock-outs, rejections, and expiry-related losses.
  
  
Platform relationship management and business development.

competitive advantage.

**Job Summary:**

As an Associate Manager, Data Operations, you will own the day-to-day performance of a team of Data

Associates across our classification, attribution, and product-catalog workflows. You will sit where human

judgment meets machine learning—turning targets into daily execution, coaching your associates from

task-executors into data-driven critical thinkers, and acting as the first line of defense for quality,

throughput, and SLAs. You will operate within the operating plan set by your Manager, run it relentlessly

on the floor, and surface the insights and improvement ideas that make the plan better.

Operations.

* Supervise, coach, and develop a team of 15-20 Data Associates responsible for classification,

attribution, and product catalog management.

* Monitor and manage team performance against KPIs, including throughput, accuracy, and quality

benchmarks.

* Serve as the first point of escalation for workflow or process-related issues.
* Conduct regular quality reviews and provide actionable feedback to ensure data accuracy and

consistency.

* Identify workflow inefficiencies and partner with managers, automation teams, and governance

specialists to improve processes.

* Coordinate team scheduling, task assignment, and workload balancing to meet daily and weekly

targets.

* Ensure compliance with governance standards, documentation, and reporting requirements.
* Train new hires and ensure associates are up to date on classification guidelines, tools, and

processes.

* Report team status, coverage, productivity, and quality metrics to management.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Proactively identify and address problems before they escalate, while recognizing opportunities

for efficiency, automation, and quality improvements.

**Role Mandate - How you will move the needle**

You start your day in your team’s real-time utilization dashboards and queue metrics. You read the data to

anticipate bottlenecks before they form, check the health of in-flight work, and make rapid, high-judgment

calls on how to reallocate associates across queues to protect SLAs.

Through the morning, you are on the floor with your associates. You run quality reviews, give specific,

example-based feedback (what, why, and the rule behind it), and coach your team to do root-cause

analysis on their own defect and throughput data so the same error doesn’t come back twice.

In the afternoon, you connect outward: you partner with Quality, Training, Governance, and your peer

Associate Managers to close process gaps, pilot improvements within your workflows, and feed clear,

evidence-backed recommendations up to your Manager for anything that needs a roadmap-level decision.

You keep the “voice of the client” in view, validating that your team’s output holds up in the real world. You

end the day by reviewing throughput and quality, recognizing your best performers, and making sure your

cross-trained, fungible team is positioned to clear tomorrow’s volume.

**Success Measures:**

* Accuracy: Team maintains 98%+ accuracy in ad classification, attribution, and catalog updates.
* Productivity: Team consistently processes assigned workloads against defined productivity

targets and SLA requirements.

* Quality Assurance: Less than 2% of team output requires rework due to errors.
* Team Development: Regular coaching and training lead to measurable improvement in associate

performance.

* Process Improvement: Implements at least two documented workflow or tool improvements per

quarter.

* Collaboration: Builds strong working relationships with peers in automation, governance, and

data quality functions.

Short-Term Deliverables (First 90 Days):

* Baseline your team’s skill sets and identify single points of failure and coverage gaps across the

media types you support.

* Stand up a rigorous, data-driven feedback loop with your associates using specific defect

examples and root-cause analysis ahead of weekly syncs.

* Deeply understand your production queues and utilization metrics to optimize the balance

between Core Production (value-add) and Administrative Shrinkage within your team.

Long-Term Deliverables (6 months - 1 year and beyond):

* Establish a seamless, highly efficient operational flow across time zones that eliminates

geographical friction.

* Successfully manage the operational integration of new datasets, media channels, or M&A

expansions without linearly increasing headcount.

* Successfully groom your top Team Leads to be ready for Manager-level responsibilities.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, operations, information systems, or a related field.
* 4+ years of professional experience in data operations, data quality, content processing, or

shared-services roles.

* 2+ years directly leading or managing a team, with a proven ability to coach, develop, and hold

people accountable.

* Demonstrated experience managing high-volume, detail-oriented workflows to tight quality and SLA

standards.

* Data Fluency: You can use raw data (advanced Excel, PowerBI, Looker) to track performance, spot

bloat, and drive behavioral change in your team.

* You anticipate challenges, resolve issues fast, and balance daily tactical delivery with a steady

drumbeat of continuous improvement.

* You actively mentor and elevate associates, guide them through ambiguous operational change,

build actionable growth plans, and cultivate critical thinkers rather than task executors.

* You treat accuracy as the baseline, not the goal. You uphold and strengthen QA frameworks—even

with legacy tools—so that high-fidelity classification and first-time-right execution are

non-negotiable.

* (Good to have) Industry Context: Experience in media intelligence, ad-tech, data tagging, taxonomy

management, or content moderation is a strong plus.

title: Digital Marketing Trainee
description:
About the role

We're looking for a motivated fresher to run the day-to-day digital marketing for Raayan Technologies. You'll handle the official marketing for two very different businesses: NaachiChat, a verified communications platform sold to schools and institutions, and our real estate business, which markets to local home and property buyers.

This is a hands-on, learn-on-the-job role. You won't be expected to arrive knowing everything — we'll train you from the ground up. What matters is that you're curious, organised, and willing to learn fast. You'll work directly with the founder, which means you'll see how a business actually runs and build skills across every part of marketing.

What you'll do

You'll be trained across all the areas below. Over time you'll own them; at the start you'll focus on the ones that need the least budget and the most learning.

**Social media & content**

* Plan and post content for both businesses across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube
* Write captions, shoot and edit simple reels and graphics (we'll teach you the tools)
* Keep a content calendar so posting is consistent, not random
* Help our websites and listings rank for the right local and institutional searches
* Write and optimise blog posts, landing pages and property listings
* Track keywords and improve what's underperforming
* Set up and read Google Analytics (GA4), ad dashboards and website data
* Send the founder a simple weekly report: what's working, what isn't, what you'd change
* Turn numbers into decisions, not just charts
* Build and send email campaigns and follow-ups to leads and institutional contacts
* Keep lead and contact lists clean and organised

Who we're looking for

We care more about attitude and aptitude than a polished CV. You're a good fit if you:

* Are a recent graduate (any field — marketing, commerce, arts, engineering, all welcome)
* Are based in Coimbatore, or ready to relocate here, and can work on-site
* Communicate well in **Tamil and English**, both writing and speaking
* Are comfortable on a smartphone and computer, and quick to pick up new apps
* Are organised, reliable, and able to manage your own time without being chased
* Are genuinely curious about how marketing and businesses work
* Have a basic eye for design and good writing (or the will to build it)

What we offer

* **₹20,000 per month** to start, plus an **annual salary hike** and a formal review at 12 months
* **Conversion bonus** — an extra payout for every lead or deal you convert, on top of your salary, so strong results directly raise your earnings
* **Full training** across every area of digital marketing — no prior experience needed
* **Direct mentorship from the founder** and a front-row view of how real businesses run
* **A real growth path:** Assistant Manager and your own team within about two years for strong performers
* **Varied work** across two industries — technology and real estate — so you learn far more than a single-product role

Pay: ₹20,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance

Work Location: In person

description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONBusiness Development Manager – Ventilation Products

**Position:** Business Development Manager (BDM)  
**Department:** Sales & Marketing  
**Industry:** HVAC / Ventilation Products  
**Territory:** Tamil Nadu & Kerala, Expect Chennai  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director / Management

1. Job Purpose

To develop and expand the ventilation products business across Tamil Nadu and Kerala by building strong dealer networks, developing new business opportunities, managing key customers and achieving the company's sales and revenue targets.

The candidate will be responsible for promoting and marketing ventilation products to HVAC contractors, consultants, builders, architects, dealers and other potential customers.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Business Development & Sales**

* Develop new business opportunities across Tamil Nadu and Kerala.
* Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
* Identify and approach potential customers, dealers and distributors.
* Promote ventilation products and generate enquiries.
* Develop new markets and increase the company's market share.
* Convert enquiries into confirmed orders.

**B. Dealer & Distributor Network Development**

* Identify and appoint new dealers and channel partners.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing dealers.
* Conduct regular dealer visits and business review meetings.
* Support dealers with product information, pricing and technical assistance.
* Develop an effective distribution network across assigned territories.

**C. Customer & Project Development**

* Develop business relationships with:
* HVAC contractors
* MEP consultants
* Architects and interior designers
* Builders and construction companies
* Industrial and commercial customers
* Electrical and mechanical contractors
* Generate project enquiries and follow up until order confirmation.
* Coordinate with the technical team for product selection and application support.

**D. Marketing & Product Promotion**

* Conduct product presentations and technical demonstrations.
* Arrange dealer meets, customer meets and product awareness programmes.
* Promote company products through direct marketing and customer visits.
* Monitor competitor activities, market pricing and new product opportunities.

**E. Sales Coordination & Reporting**

* Prepare and maintain a monthly sales and business development plan.
* Submit daily visit reports and customer follow-up reports.
* Maintain customer and dealer databases in the CRM.
* Prepare monthly sales forecasts and pipeline reports.
* Coordinate with accounts, stores and operations teams for order execution and payment follow-up.

3. Product Responsibilities

Responsible for developing sales of ventilation products, including:

* Exhaust Fans
* Inline Fans
* Axial Flow Fans
* Centrifugal Fans
* Fresh Air Ventilation Systems
* Energy Recovery Ventilators (ERV)
* Air Handling and Ventilation Accessories
* Other HVAC and ventilation-related products

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Achievement of monthly and annual sales targets.
* Number of new dealers and channel partners appointed.
* New customer acquisition.
* Number of project enquiries generated.
* Enquiry-to-order conversion ratio.
* Collection follow-up and outstanding payment management.
* Territory-wise sales growth.
* Customer and dealer relationship management.
* Regularity of CRM updates and sales reporting.

5. Qualification & Experience

* Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Business Administration.
* 3–5 years of experience in HVAC, ventilation products or building materials sales.

Developing strong solutions is only part of the journey; enabling market activation, adoption and measurable growth is equally important.
  
  
**You will:**

* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Alliance teams and Solution Owners on activation plans.
* Coordinate development of solution collateral, demos, case studies, enablement content and marketplace assets.
* Support readiness and enablement activities for client-facing and business development teams.
* Track adoption, pipeline contribution, commercialization progress and related performance metrics.

* Monitor key metrics related to solution maturity, activation, adoption, funding and business impact.
* Support business reviews, governance meetings and leadership decision forums.
* Maintain reporting accuracy, governance discipline and compliance with agreed operating standards.
* Provide insights and recommendations that support prioritization, investment decisions and strategic growth.

* Thrive in fast-paced, evolving and ambiguous environments.
