title: Product Manager
description:
* Define the product vision, strategy, roadmap and long-term direction, and keep the roadmap stable enough to plan against and open enough to change when the evidence changes.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and customer discovery to identify and validate product opportunities, and bring the findings into roadmap decisions rather than filing them as reports.
* Translate customer problems and business needs into clear product requirements: the outcome and the user problem, specified well enough for Engineering to build against without dictating the solution.
* Own feature prioritisation and release decisions with Engineering and UI/UX, and be able to state the cost and the benefit of each choice. A roadmap that only says yes is a backlog.
* Identify and evaluate AI, Generative AI and automation opportunities, and assess each on feasibility, scalability, cost and business value before it reaches the roadmap.
* Define product success metrics before the work starts, instrument the product to measure them, and read the results honestly afterwards.
* Contribute to product positioning, pricing, go-to-market strategy and commercial viability, working with Sales and Marketing.
* Build shared context across the organisation so that teams can make decisions without routing every question through you.
* Work closely with the Founder, Engineering, UI/UX, Sales and other stakeholders to align on product direction and drive execution.

**What You Will Not Own**

* Product Manager and Project Manager are used interchangeably across the market. At 2Base, they are different roles, so the boundary is stated rather than assumed.
* Client project delivery. Project Managers own client engagements, schedules, and escalations.
* Engineering architecture and implementation. You own what and why; Engineering owns how. Where the two conflict, you negotiate rather than instruct.
* UI/UX design execution. The design function designs. You own the user outcome and brief, review and decide against it.
* Final product investment and budget approval. The Founder decides what the product is funded to do and over what horizon. You own the case that decision is taken on.
* Client-specific commercial negotiations. Pricing and packaging of the product itself is yours; client contracts are not.

Requirements

**Experience**

* 6–12 years in the technology industry, with at least 4 years in Product Management or direct product ownership.
* At least one product you took from concept or early development to actual customer usage, with a clear view of what happened after release. A product you inherited fully formed and maintained is a weaker signal than a smaller one you shaped.
* A decision not to build something, and what it cost you to hold that line.
* Direct work with engineering teams through a build, not across a handover, with enough understanding of software development, technical feasibility, APIs, integrations and cloud applications to judge what a decision will cost.
* AI and Emerging Technology
* Practical exposure to AI-powered products, Generative AI, machine learning or automation-driven solutions.
* The ability to tell a capability apart from a product, and to assess an AI use case on feasibility, scalability, cost and business value rather than on novelty.

**Product Judgement**

* You can describe how you decided what to build: the evidence you had, the evidence you wanted and did not have, and what you did about the gap.
* You can reason about a product commercially. Who pays, what for, and what has to be true for the numbers to work.
* You can hold a position with a founder, an engineering lead or a client, and change it when the argument against you is the better one. Knowing which situation you are in is the skill.
* You write and present clearly. Most of a product manager's influence here travels as writing, and a requirement that is ambiguous on Monday becomes an argument three weeks later.
* Ways of Working
* You start by asking rather than deciding. The first months are spent understanding users, the business model, what has already been attempted, and how decisions are actually made here.
* You work independently and establish your own processes. There is no research function and no analyst to brief.
* You influence without formal authority. Nobody in this structure reports to you, and the roadmap holds because people agree with it.
* You can make a decision that leaves someone unhappy, explain the reasoning, and keep working with them. Trade-offs are the job, and somebody loses every time one is made.

**Education**

A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

**What We Are Not Looking For**

* Stated now rather than at the end of a multi-stage process.
* Project or delivery managers looking to change title. The skills overlap less than the market suggests, and this is not a promotion path from delivery.
* Business analysts who have written specifications against requirements someone else set. Valuable work; different work.
* Candidates whose account of a product is the features it shipped, with no view on whether it should have shipped them.
* Anyone who needs an established research function, design system and process in place before they can start.

Benefits

A growth-driven environment with opportunities to lead, innovate, and upskill continuously.

•Cloud Engineering (AWS, Azure, GCP)

•Software Engineering

•Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning

•Enterprise Applications

Talent Pipeline & Market Intelligence

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
TargetHR has been around for three decades, but honestly, that’s not what defines us today.

What matters is what we do
**now**
.

We work closely with some of India’s sharpest startups and product companies. We sit across the table with founders and VCs and help them build teams that actually move the business forward. No bulk hiring. No resume pushing. Real hiring conversations.

**What this role is really about**

* **This is a full-time role for someone with 1–5 years of experience in recruitment — or someone making a thoughtful career switch into recruitment — and is serious about growing fast.**
* You won’t be stuck doing just sourcing or coordination. You’ll work like a
  **talent consultant**
  — understanding the company, the founder’s mindset, the role, and then going out to find the right people.
* You’ll get to work with multiple companies, see how different founders think, and understand how hiring decisions are actually made behind closed doors.

**It’s the best of both worlds:**

* Depth of in-house hiring
* Exposure and learning of consulting

**What you’ll do day-to-day**

* Work on real, active roles across startups and product companies.
* Speak to founders and hiring managers to understand what they
  *really*
  want.
* Source, screen, and engage candidates — thoughtfully, not blindly.
* Sell early-stage and upcoming brands with conviction, not just big names.
* Manage interview pipelines, follow-ups, and closures end-to-end.
* Use data, structure, and AI tools to get better at hiring every month.
* Build long-term relationships with candidates and clients.

**This role is for you if…**

* You want exposure to multiple companies, not just one office and one problem.
* You’re excited by building teams for upcoming brands, not only selling established logos.
* You want to sharpen your recruitment skills using data and AI, not just instinct.
* You’re curious about how founders think and want to see the business side of hiring.
* You like ownership and responsibility and don’t need constant follow-ups.

**What we expect (no surprises)**

* You’re comfortable talking to people — founders, candidates, stakeholders.
* You’re organised. Trackers and follow-ups don’t scare you.
* You take ownership. If something’s stuck, you push it forward.
* You’re hungry to learn and grow, not just “do a job”.

title: Human Capital - Total Rewards Benefits Operate- Manager
description:
**Human Capital**

  

Our Human Capital practice is at the forefront of transforming the nature of work. As converging forces reshape industries, our team uniquely addresses the complexities of work, workforce, and workplace dynamics. We leverage sector-specific insights and cross-domain perspectives to help organizations tackle their most challenging workforce issues and align talent strategies with their strategic visions. Our practice is renowned for making work better for humans and humans better at work. Be part of this exciting era of change and join us on this transformative journey.

**Work you’ll do**

As a **Total Rewards Benefits Operate Manager**, you will lead work at the intersection of **benefits strategy, administration operations, and enabling technology**. You’ll help clients and internal teams translate benefits requirements into scalable platform capabilities—understanding what leading **benefits administration providers** can deliver, how **HCM platforms** connect to those ecosystems, and what it takes to drive successful implementation and ongoing operations. This will be achieved either through use of Deloitte’s proprietary BenefitIQ technology and/or other market solutions as appropriate.

You’ll be accountable for delivering high-quality outcomes, managing teams and stakeholders, and shaping product-enabled solutions that improve member experience, administrative efficiency, and compliance-aligned execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage the global benefits operations for different clients, administering health and welfare, pension, leave, and other rewards programs across the full-service lifecycle, from discovery and solution, design through implementation, operational readiness, ongoing delivery, and customer support.
* Own benefits administration engagements end-to-end, holding full accountability for service delivery, financial performance, and client satisfaction across benefits administration scopes. Accountable for end-to-end SLA/XLA delivery, quality, and compliance across all in-scope benefits operations towers.
* Serve as the primary operational relationship owner for the client.
* Lead client governance, manage escalations, and own the relationship with client HR / Total Rewards / Benefits leadership and benefits vendors
* Communicate effectively with client stakeholders (HR, Total Rewards, HRIT, Payroll, vendors) and internal leadership.
* Partner with cross-functional internal teams to provide cohesive and seamless client experience as one Deloitte.
* Drive growth within the account — identifying expansion opportunities, upsell, and new service lines
* Guide decisions on vendor/platform fit based on client context, administrative complexity, and operating model needs.
* Support operational design including SOPs, roles/responsibilities, case management, escalations, controls, and service metrics.
* Contribute to proposals, estimates, delivery plans, status reporting, and risk/issue management.
* Drive continuous improvement and process optimization

**The Team**  
Our Insights, Innovation & Operate Offering is designed to enhance key aspects of our clients' businesses by leveraging cutting-edge technology, data, and a blend of deep technical and human expertise. We innovate and deliver creative, industry-specific solutions that streamline operations and accelerate speed-to-value.

**Required Qualification:**

* Bachelor's degree

* A total of 10+ years of progressive experience in global benefits administration, spanning implementation, day-to-day operations, process optimization, customer care, and/or working in vendor or service provider environments

* 3+ years of people-management experience leading teams responsible for benefits administration, including system configuration and ongoing operational delivery

* 3+ years of experience leading benefits administration for multinational clients, with accountability for service quality, compliance, and client satisfaction across multiple countries

* Hands-on experience with Human Capital Management (HCM) platform data management and payroll integrations supporting rewards or benefits programs, including eligibility rules, life and qualifying events, payroll deductions, and file-based data exchanges

  
  
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* HR or benefits-related professional certification (e.g., CEBS, GBA, or SHRM-CP/SCP, HRCI, or equivalent)

* Experience working with multiple benefits administration providers across both implementation and ongoing service delivery

* In-depth understanding of the benefits technology landscape, including the capabilities, strengths, and limitations of Workday and other leading HCM and benefits administration platforms.

* Good knowledge of global benefits practices, regulatory considerations, and market trends

* Proven track record of building and managing strong, collaborative relationships with benefits carriers, vendors, and service providers

* Solid understanding of core HCM concepts and integration patterns, such as worker and benefit event data, payroll deductions, file-based vs. API integrations, and inbound/outbound data feeds.

  
  

**Possible Locations**: Gurugram, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Mumbai, Chennai, Pune, Kolkata

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Head – Talent Acquisition
description:
**Location:**
Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Organisation:**
A Leading GCC-Type Organisation

**Reporting To:**
CHRO / Head HR / Business Leadership

**About the Opportunity**

We are representing a leading organisation operating in a GCC-type business environment, with offices across India and its corporate headquarters in Mumbai.

The organisation is looking to appoint an experienced Head – Talent Acquisition who will be responsible for building, strengthening and managing the overall talent acquisition framework.

This role requires a professional who has experience not only in managing recruitment delivery but also in setting up talent acquisition processes, developing recruitment partner networks, onboarding and managing Talent Partners, and ensuring effective execution of the complete hiring lifecycle.

The ideal candidate should be a process-oriented recruitment leader with strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build a scalable and efficient talent acquisition ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Talent Acquisition Strategy & Process Development**

* Develop and implement the overall talent acquisition strategy in alignment with business growth and manpower requirements.
* Establish structured recruitment processes, policies, workflows and standard operating procedures.
* Build scalable recruitment frameworks to support hiring across multiple business functions and locations.
* Define recruitment metrics, dashboards, turnaround times and performance standards.

**2. Talent Partner Onboarding & Management**

* Identify, evaluate and onboard external Talent Acquisition Partners, recruitment agencies and specialist search firms.
* Develop a structured onboarding framework for new Talent Partners, including process orientation, role briefing, documentation and service expectations.
* Ensure Talent Partners understand the organisation's hiring requirements, recruitment processes, candidate submission protocols and quality standards.
* Drive continuous engagement with Talent Partners to ensure effective delivery.
* Establish partner performance evaluation mechanisms based on quality, turnaround time, conversion ratios and hiring outcomes.
* Build and maintain a strong network of recruitment partners across relevant industries and talent segments.

**3. End-to-End Recruitment Management**

* Oversee the complete recruitment lifecycle, from manpower requisition and job briefing to sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer management and joining.
* Ensure timely follow-ups at every stage of the recruitment process.
* Monitor candidate pipelines, interview feedback, offer releases, acceptance ratios and joining conversions.
* Establish mechanisms to minimise candidate dropouts and improve offer-to-joining ratios.
* Ensure effective coordination between internal stakeholders, hiring managers and external Talent Partners.

**4. Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with business heads, functional leaders and HR teams to understand current and future manpower requirements.
* Conduct structured discussions with hiring managers to understand role specifications and talent expectations.
* Ensure regular communication and follow-ups with stakeholders on open positions.
* Resolve recruitment bottlenecks and ensure timely closure of critical positions.

**5. Recruitment Analytics & Governance**

* Develop and monitor recruitment dashboards and MIS reports.
* Track metrics such as time-to-hire, cost-per-hire, source effectiveness, interview-to-offer ratios and offer-to-joining ratios.
* Establish recruitment SLAs and accountability mechanisms.
* Ensure adherence to recruitment policies, documentation and process governance.

**6. Team Leadership & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead and mentor the internal talent acquisition team.
* Establish clear responsibilities, performance measures and delivery expectations.
* Identify opportunities for automation, technology adoption and process improvement.
* Continuously evaluate the effectiveness of the recruitment ecosystem.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 12–18 years of overall experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment.
* Significant experience in leading the Talent Acquisition function of a mid-sized or large organisation.
* Experience in a GCC, GCC-like, IT/ITES, technology, professional services or other structured corporate environment would be preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in setting up or transforming talent acquisition processes.
* Hands-on experience in identifying, evaluating, onboarding and managing external recruitment partners / Talent Partners.
* Experience in developing recruitment partner networks across multiple locations and functional specialisations.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end recruitment operations and hiring lifecycle management.
* Experience in managing multiple recruitment partners simultaneously and ensuring regular follow-ups and delivery.
* Strong understanding of recruitment metrics, SLAs, MIS and performance dashboards.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to build structured recruitment processes while ensuring delivery efficiency.

**Location & Mobility**
-
**Mumbai is the mandatory base location for this position.**

Candidates must be willing to relocate to Mumbai if they are currently based elsewhere in India. This is a non-negotiable requirement.

* The identity of the organisation will not be disclosed at the initial stage of interaction.

title: Account Manager
description:
**When you join Accurate Background, you’re an integral part of making every hire the start of a success story. Your contributions will help us fulfill our mission of advancing the background screening experience through visibility and insights, empowering our clients to make smarter, unbiased decisions.**
**Job Description**
The Account Manager is a consultative client leader responsible for strengthening strategic partnerships, retaining and expanding assigned accounts, and growing revenue. Through regular engagement with stakeholders at all levels, the Account Manager becomes a trusted advisor on background screening services and related solutions, identifies opportunities and risks, and delivers recommendations supported by business insights and ROI. * Commercial management: Negotiate pricing and implementation requirements, prepare proposals and ROI-based recommendations, and advance opportunities through Accurate’s defined sales cycle.
* Client and industry expertise: Maintain a strong understanding of each client’s business, market, and industry trends to deliver proactive, strategic recommendations.
* Risk and retention management: Monitor account activity and usage, identify emerging issues or churn risks, and present clear mitigation plans to key stakeholders.
* Cross-functional execution: Coordinate internal teams, ATS providers, and other external partners to implement new services, integrations, and client solutions successfully.
* Special projects: Lead client-driven initiatives and other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: At least three years of background screening and client-facing experience required; OR three or more years of account management experience in an HR-related/Ed-tech/HR Tech/SaAs industry preferred.
* Business and technical proficiency: Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, with the ability to interpret client data and translate insights into actions.
* Judgment and problem-solving: Demonstrated ability to exercise sound decision-making, navigate complex situations, formulate practical solutions, and offer well-considered alternatives.
* Organization and execution: Strong ability to prioritize work, manage multiple responsibilities, and use time efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively across client and internal stakeholder levels.
* Drive: Self-motivated, proactive, and accountable for delivering client and business outcomes.

**This is an Onsite role with US shift timings - 6pm to 3:30 AM (Transportation will be provided both ways)**
**The Accurate Way**
We offer a fun, fast-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. To do this, we follow four guiding principles – Take Ownership, Be Open, Stay Curious, Work as One – core values that dictate what we stand for, and how we behave.
  
  
**Take ownership.**
Be accountable for your actions, your team, and the company. Accept responsibility willingly, especially when it’s what’s best for our customers. Give others every reason to trust you, believe in you, and count on you. Rise to every occasion with your personal best.
  
  
**Be open.**
Be open to new ideas. Be inclusive of people and ways of doing things. Make yourself accessible and approachable, and communicate with genuineness, transparency, honesty, and respect. Embrace differences.
  
  
**Stay curious.**
Stay curious even as you move forward. Tirelessly ask questions and challenge the status quo in your pursuit of new ideas, ways to solve problems, and to continually grow and improve.
  
  
**Work as one.**
Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.
  
  
**Equal opportunities**
Accurate is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Accurate will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.
  
  
You must have a right to work in Australia indefinitely that does not involve sponsorship by the Company.
  
  
**Special Notice**
Accurate is aware of schemes involving fraudulent job postings/offers and/or individuals or entities claiming to be employees of Accurate. Those involved are offering fabricated employment opportunities to applicants, often asking for sensitive personal and financial information. If you believe you have been contacted by anyone misrepresenting themselves as an employee of Accurate, please contact humanresources@accurate.com.
  
  

* Please be advised that all legitimate correspondence from an Accurate employee will come from "@accurate.com" email accounts.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**About Huru**

Huru is a UAE-based fintech company regulated by the Central Bank of the UAE, focused on making financial services accessible, seamless, and inclusive. We're building innovative financial solutions that empower individuals and businesses, and we're looking for passionate professionals to join us on this journey.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a passionate and results-driven Talent Acquisition Specialist to help us attract and hire exceptional talent as we scale our teams across India and the UAE.

This is a hands-on recruitment role where you will own the end-to-end hiring process, partner closely with hiring managers, and build strong talent pipelines across technical and non-technical functions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from requirement gathering and sourcing to offer negotiation and joining.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, define role requirements, and develop effective recruitment strategies.
* Drive hiring across Engineering, Product, Data, Risk, Compliance, Operations, and Business functions.
* Source and engage candidates through LinkedIn, referrals, Boolean searches, and other creative sourcing channels.
* Build and maintain strong pipelines of active and passive candidates.
* Conduct initial candidate screening, assess suitability, and coordinate interview processes.
* Manage offer discussions, compensation negotiations, and candidate engagement through joining.
* Conduct market mapping, talent research, and compensation benchmarking.
* Maintain accurate recruitment trackers, hiring dashboards, and candidate records.
* Monitor recruitment metrics such as time-to-fill, offer acceptance rates, and pipeline conversion.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience and maintain strong relationships with hiring managers.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–6 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, preferably within fintech, technology, product companies, or high-growth startups.
* Strong hands-on experience hiring across technical and business functions, including Engineering, Product, Sales, Business Development, Operations, Risk, and Compliance, with the ability to manage diverse hiring requirements independently.
* Proven ability to identify and engage passive candidates through direct sourcing.
* Strong stakeholder management, candidate assessment, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset.

**Good to Have**

* Experience hiring across India and the UAE.
* Exposure to fintech, payments, or financial services hiring.
* Experience with ATS platforms, recruitment analytics, and structured interviewing.
* Experience working closely with engineering and product leadership teams.

**Why Join Huru?**

* Play a key role in building high-performing teams for a growing fintech.
* Own hiring initiatives from strategy through execution.
* Gain exposure to diverse functions and regional hiring across India and the UAE.
* Work in a collaborative environment where your contributions directly impact business growth.

If you're a recruiter who enjoys sourcing, solving challenging hiring problems, and connecting great talent with exciting opportunities, we'd love to hear from you.

**Apply now and help us build the future of Huru!**

title: Senior Executive Talent Acquisition
description:
**About Medhavi Skills University**

Medhavi Skills University (MSU) is a government-notified private State Skills University established under a State Act in Sikkim in 2021, dedicated to advancing quality skill-integrated higher education and entrepreneurship. Recognised by the UGC and aligned with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, MSU is a pioneer in converging the skilling ecosystem with formal higher education through its “Industry as Campus” model. The University collaborates extensively with industries and Skill Development Institutes to deliver work-integrated degree programs embedding structured on-the-job training within the curriculum. MSU is a recognised Awarding Body under NCVET, empanelled with DGT, and serves as an anchor university partner with NSDC and the PMU of NSDC International-collectively reinforcing its demand-driven, industry-co-led academic framework. Ranked 4th among India’s Top Skill Universities in the Outlook ICARE Rankings 2025 and supported by over 11 defence partnerships along with multiple national recognitions, MSU stands among India’s leading skill-integrated higher education institutions.

For more information, visit https://www.msu.edu.in/

**About Medhavi Group:**

Established in 2013, Medhavi Group is a unified ecosystem comprising MSU and various skill-promoting organisations, dedicated to advancing skill development, vocational training, and industry-integrated higher education. With a strong outcome-driven approach, the Group has trained over 6 lakh learners, achieving more than 70% employability outcomes, and currently supports 20,000+ active students across its diverse programs. Medhavi Group continues to bridge the gap between education and employment by building scalable, industry-aligned talent pathways across India. Work Integrated Skill based Higher Education (WISE) is Medhavi’s flagship industry-integrated initiative built on the principle of “Industry as Campus.” It combines academic learning with structured on-the-job training, ensuring students graduate with real work experience and industry-ready skills. Through deep, outcome-driven partnerships with over 300+ leading industry and skill partners across 26+ sectors including Hyundai, Mahindra, IHG Group, Nephroplus, Barbeque Nation, Nexus Select Malls, ClassPlus, Tata Electronics, Marriott, ITC, and others- WISE enables learners to acquire role- specific competencies directly within live business environments. WISE creates a demand-driven talent pipeline for industries that enhances employability, improves workforce productivity, and bridges the industry skill gap.

For more information, visit https://msu.edu.in/wise/

**Role Overview:**

The Sr. Executive / Assistant Manager – Talent Acquisition will be responsible for managing end-to-end recruitment for the WISE (Work Integrated Skills Education) segment of Medhavi Skills University. The role involves hiring across academic, operations, sales, partnerships, and corporate functions while ensuring speed, quality, and cultural alignment. The incumbent will work closely with hiring managers and leadership to support rapid growth and workforce planning initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. End-to-End Recruitment**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from manpower requisition to onboarding.
* Coordinate with department heads to understand workforce requirements and hiring priorities.
* Draft and refine job descriptions aligned with functional needs.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, consultants, and internal databases.
* Conduct preliminary screenings and coordinate interview processes.
* Ensure defined Turnaround Time (TAT) for position closures.

**2. Salary Negotiation & Offer Management**

* Conduct compensation benchmarking and align salary proposals with internal budgets.
* Lead salary negotiations with selected candidates to ensure cost-effectiveness and acceptance ratio optimization.
* Draft Offer Letters (OL) as per organizational policy.
* Coordinate pre-joining engagement to minimize offer dropouts.

**3. Documentation & Verification**

* Verify candidate documentation including educational qualifications, experience letters, salary proofs, ID proofs, and other statutory documents.
* Ensure compliance with university hiring policies and documentation standards.
* Coordinate background verification (if applicable) and onboarding formalities.

**4. HRMS Onboarding & Employee Record Creation**

* Create and update employee profiles in the HRMS system.
* Ensure accuracy of personal, compensation, and reporting details.
* Coordinate with Payroll and HR Operations for seamless salary processing.
* Support smooth onboarding experience including joining formalities and induction coordination.

**5. Strategic Hiring for WISE Segment**

* Support hiring for roles across WISE
* Develop talent pipelines for volume hiring and critical positions.
* Conduct competitor and industry mapping for lateral talent acquisition.

**6. Process Management**

* Provide regular recruitment dashboards and status updates to your manager.
* Manage hiring manager expectations and drive structured interview evaluations.
* Support audit and compliance requirements related to recruitment.

**Qualifications & Experience Required:**

* 3–6 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, preferably in Education, EdTech, Staffing, or Skill Development sectors.
* Experience in both bulk hiring and mid-level lateral hiring.
* Exposure to academic and field sales hiring preferred.
* MBA/PGDM in HR or relevant qualification preferred.

**Preferred Skills & Competencies:**

**Recruitment & Negotiation Skills**

* Strong sourcing capability across multiple platforms.
* Hands-on experience in salary negotiation and offer management.
* Understanding of compensation structures and benchmarking.
* Ability to assess role fit and cultural alignment.

**HR Operations Knowledge**

* Experience in drafting Offer Letters and employment documentation.
* Strong documentation verification skills.
* Hands-on experience with HRMS systems and onboarding processes.
* Basic understanding of payroll coordination.

**Execution & Coordination**

* Strong TAT management and ability to handle multiple roles simultaneously.
* Attention to detail and process discipline.
* Strong follow-up and stakeholder management skills.

**Personal Attributes**

* High ownership and accountability.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced growth environment.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making capability.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to architect and scale a future-focused, industry-integrated higher education ecosystem.
* Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
* Leadership role in a rapidly growing national skills and university platform.
* A collaborative, mission-driven environment.
* The opportunity to create a measurable impact on employability and workforce transformation at scale.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter detailing their qualifications and experience at careers@msu.edu.in at earliest possible.

Medhavi Skills University is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Placement Manager - Law
description:
Role purpose

The Placement Manager – Law owns internship and placement outcomes for law students. The role builds and manages relationships with law firms, corporate legal departments, legal-tech companies, LPOs and legal consultancies, and converts them into internships, pre-placement offers and final placements.

The incumbent sources recruiters independently and runs drives end to end with support from the CDC Operations team, with peak activity in the placement season (1 May – 31 August).

Key responsibilities

**Employer outreach and relationship management**

* Identify and approach recruiters: Tier-1/2/3 law firms, corporate legal teams, Big 4 and consulting firms, banks and NBFCs, LPOs, legal-tech start-ups, compliance and IP firms, and litigation chambers.
* Build a pipeline of new recruiters every month through LinkedIn, bar networks, alumni and industry events.
* Maintain long-term relationships with HR heads, hiring partners and General Counsels; plan recruiter visits and campus engagements.
* Negotiate roles, compensation and selection processes; secure PPO-linked internships.

**Internships and placements**

* Plan and run the mandatory internship cycle for all law batches (NGOs, courts, advocates, firms, corporates) in line with BCI requirements.
* Run placement drives end to end with the Operations team: JD circulation, registrations, shortlisting, tests, interviews, offers and onboarding.
* Track offers, PPOs, joining status and recruiter feedback; prepare placement records for audits.

**Student readiness**

* Map student profiles, practice-area interests and readiness; maintain an up-to-date student database.
* Organise CV and cover-letter clinics, mock interviews, legal drafting and research tests, and group discussions.
* Arrange guest lectures, workshops and mentoring by practising lawyers, in-house counsel and judges.
* Counsel students on career paths: litigation, corporate law, judiciary, LPO, policy, academia and higher studies.

**Industry engagement and branding**

OneStepGreener is a tech-first climate action organization focused on recycling, afforestation, and climate awareness to address air pollution and waste management challenges in India. * Track and analyze operational metrics related to recruitment lifecycle activities.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

description:
**Position:** IT Recruiter (US Staffing)

**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat (On-Site)

**Shift Timings:** 07:30 PM to 04:30 AM

**Summary**

We are seeking an experienced US IT Recruiter with a strong background in supporting US government agencies & state clients. As part of Dash Technologies -a company based in Dublin, Ohio, you will play a critical role in driving our continued growth in the US public sector staffing space.

Dash Technologies is a rapidly expanding IT services and staffing organization known for delivering high-quality talent solutions across enterprise and government clients. With increasing demand from our US-based partners, we are actively looking to strengthen our recruitment team with

professionals who understand the nuances of compliance-driven hiring, VMS/MSP environments, and government-specific requirements.

**Responsibilities:**

* + Source candidates through multiple channels including job portals (Dice, Monster), ATS, internal databases, LinkedIn Recruiter, social media, networking, and referrals.
  + Evaluate and screen candidates based on technical skills, domain expertise, experience, qualifications, and compliance requirements (especially for government roles).
  + Conduct initial technical and behavioral screening interviews to assess communication skills, motivation, and cultural fit.
  + Handle different types of hiring: Contract, Contract-to-Hire (CTH), and Full-Time (Permanent Placements) with a focus on government and public sector clients.
  + Strong understanding of US tax terms like C2C, 1099, and W2, and various visa types including H1B, GC, TN, EAD, and US Citizens with emphasis on eligibility criteria for government projects (e.g., US Citizens, GC, clearance-ready candidates).
  + Experience working with US government requirements such as federal/state contracts, MSP/VMS portals (e.g., Fieldglass, Vector VMS, People Fluent) or for any commercial clients.
  + Coordinate interviews, conduct reference checks, and manage compensation negotiations (salary/rates) in line with market and client budgets.
  + Ensure seamless candidate onboarding and maintain regular communication to build long-term relationships while ensuring compliance with client onboarding processes.
  + Maintain a pipeline of qualified and interested candidates through proactive networking and targeted sourcing for niche government roles.

  + Familiarity with compliance requirements such as background checks, clearance processes, and documentation standards.

* + ATS - CEIPAL
  + Boolean search techniques
  + LinkedIn experience is a must
  + Interviewing
  + Pipeline management
  + Recruitment metrics analysis
  + *VMS/MSP tools (Fieldglass, VectorVMS, PeopleFluent, etc.)*
  + *Government hiring compliance & documentation*

title: Location: Coimbatore
description:
**8 - 12 YOE of Experience**
----------------------------

### **Location: Coimbatore**

  
  

**Talent Acquisition Manager**
==============================

**Experience:** **8–12 Years**
==============================

**Location:** **Coimbatore**
============================

**Department:** **Human Resources**
===================================

**Employment Type:** **Full-time**
==================================

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for an experienced and strategically driven Senior Manager – Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning to lead our recruitment function and align talent acquisition activities with the organisation's business goals and growth plans.

This role requires a professional who can effectively bridge the gap between the leadership team and the recruitment execution team, translating business requirements into structured hiring strategies, workforce plans, recruitment projections and measurable execution targets.

The individual will own end-to-end recruitment delivery, workforce planning, recruitment analytics, team management, stakeholder management and continuous improvement of recruitment processes.

The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable participating in leadership discussions, presenting recruitment strategies and projections, managing recruitment teams, and personally driving sourcing and closure of critical positions whenever required.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Strategic Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning**

* Develop and implement organisation-wide recruitment strategies aligned with business expansion and workforce requirements.
* Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual hiring projections based on business plans, resource requirements and anticipated growth.
* Translate leadership-level manpower requirements into actionable recruitment plans with defined timelines, priorities and ownership.
* Assess existing workforce capacity, anticipated vacancies, attrition and future hiring requirements.
* Plan recruiter capacity and resource allocation based on projected hiring volumes and recruitment complexity.
* Identify potential hiring bottlenecks and proactively recommend solutions to ensure business continuity.
* Develop scalable workforce plans to support the organisation's growth and expansion across business functions and locations.

### **2. Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary recruitment point of contact between the leadership team, department heads and recruitment execution team.
* Participate in leadership meetings and strategic brainstorming sessions to provide inputs on hiring feasibility, talent availability, market trends and workforce requirements.
* Present recruitment progress, hiring projections, challenges, risks and recommendations to leadership through structured reports and dashboards.
* Consult with department heads to understand current and future resource requirements and establish realistic hiring priorities.
* Challenge unrealistic hiring expectations with market data, availability insights and achievable timelines.
* Ensure effective communication between leadership and recruiters, translating business expectations into clear recruitment deliverables.
* Provide leadership with data-backed recommendations to support manpower and recruitment-related decisions.

### **3. Recruitment Operations & Delivery**

* Own end-to-end recruitment delivery across technical and non-technical positions, including niche, critical and leadership hiring.
* Establish recruitment timelines, hiring priorities, sourcing strategies and closure targets for every requirement.
* Monitor recruitment pipelines and ensure positions are closed within agreed turnaround times.
* Drive sourcing strategies across job portals, referrals, professional networks, consultants and other relevant channels.
* Personally step into sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, negotiations and closures for critical or challenging requirements whenever necessary.
* Ensure quality of hire through effective screening, evaluation and coordination with hiring managers.
* Monitor offer acceptance, candidate dropouts, joining ratios and onboarding success.
* Ensure recruitment execution remains aligned with business priorities and committed hiring timelines.

### **4. Recruitment Analytics, Dashboards & Forecasting**

* Develop and maintain recruitment dashboards and MIS reports to provide visibility into hiring performance.
* Track key recruitment metrics, including:
  + Time to Fill and Time to Hire.
  + Position-wise hiring progress and ageing.
  + Source effectiveness and conversion ratios.
  + Recruiter-wise productivity and performance.
  + Interview-to-selection and offer-to-join ratios.
  + Cost per hire and recruitment expenditure.
  + Planned versus actual hiring.
  + Forecasted versus completed closures.
  + Recruiter capacity and requirement allocation.
* Use recruitment data to identify trends, evaluate performance and recommend improvements.
* Provide periodic recruitment forecasts and management reports to leadership.
* Establish data-driven recruitment practices and ensure accuracy of recruitment records.

### **5. Recruitment Team Leadership & Performance Management**

* Lead, mentor and manage the recruitment team to achieve organisational hiring targets.
* Allocate recruitment requirements based on recruiter capabilities, workload and hiring priorities.
* Establish individual and team-level KPIs, productivity benchmarks and performance expectations.
* Conduct periodic reviews of recruiter performance, pipeline health and closure progress.
* Identify skill gaps and implement training and development initiatives for the recruitment team.
* Build accountability, ownership and collaboration within the recruitment function.
* Ensure recruiters follow standardised recruitment processes, documentation practices and communication protocols.
* Optimise team structure and recruiter allocation based on changing workforce requirements.
  

  

### **6. Recruitment Tools, Systems & Process Management**

* Own and optimise recruitment tools and platforms, including ATS, job portals and recruitment management systems.
* Ensure effective utilisation of recruitment platforms, databases, reporting tools and automation capabilities.
* Manage job portal performance, subscription utilisation, sourcing effectiveness and recruitment-related expenditure.
* Establish standard operating procedures for sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer management and onboarding handover.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive recruitment activities and improve operational efficiency.
* Ensure recruitment data integrity, reporting accuracy and process compliance.
* Evaluate and recommend tools and technologies that can improve recruitment productivity and scalability.

### **7. Continuous Improvement & Talent Market Intelligence**

* Track industry hiring trends, salary benchmarks, talent availability and competitor hiring practices.
* Evaluate emerging sourcing channels and recruitment methodologies.
* Identify opportunities to improve hiring quality, turnaround time and candidate experience.
* Develop scalable recruitment practices to support the organisation's future workforce growth.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
------------------------------------

* 8–12 years of overall recruitment and talent acquisition experience, preferably within IT Services, IT Consulting, SaaS or technology-driven organisations.
* Demonstrated experience in managing recruitment teams and delivering hiring targets.
* Strong experience in workforce planning, manpower budgeting, hiring projections and recruitment strategy development.
* Proven ability to work with senior leadership and department heads on talent acquisition decisions.
* Hands-on experience in technical and non-technical recruitment, including niche and lateral hiring.
* Strong understanding of recruitment metrics, dashboards, MIS reporting and data-driven decision-making.
* Experience working with ATS platforms, job portals such as Naukri Resdex and recruitment automation tools.
* Strong understanding of recruiter capacity planning and resource allocation.
* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation and leadership skills.
* Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on recruitment execution.

**What We Expect From This Role**
---------------------------------

**The successful candidate should be able to:**

* Understand the organisation's business plans and translate them into realistic workforce and hiring projections.
* Present recruitment strategies, progress and challenges confidently to the leadership team.
* Convert leadership expectations into clear execution plans for the recruitment team.
* Monitor and drive the team towards achieving hiring targets without losing sight of recruitment quality.
* Independently handle critical hiring requirements and step into sourcing and closures when needed.
* Build a recruitment function that is measurable, accountable, scalable and aligned with business growth.

**The ultimate ownership of this role is to ensure that the organisation has the right people, in the right roles, at the right time, while building a recruitment function capable of supporting sustained business growth.**

* Consult with department heads to understand current and future resource requirements and establish realistic hiring priorities.
* Challenge unrealistic hiring expectations with market data, availability insights and achievable timelines.
* Ensure effective communication between leadership and recruiters, translating business expectations into clear recruitment deliverables.
* Provide leadership with data-backed recommendations to support manpower and recruitment-related decisions.

### **3. Recruitment Operations & Delivery**

* Own end-to-end recruitment delivery across technical and non-technical positions, including niche, critical and leadership hiring.
* Establish recruitment timelines, hiring priorities, sourcing strategies and closure targets for every requirement.
* Monitor recruitment pipelines and ensure positions are closed within agreed turnaround times.
* Drive sourcing strategies across job portals, referrals, professional networks, consultants and other relevant channels.
* Personally step into sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, negotiations and closures for critical or challenging requirements whenever necessary.
* Ensure quality of hire through effective screening, evaluation and coordination with hiring managers.
* Monitor offer acceptance, candidate dropouts, joining ratios and onboarding success.
* Ensure recruitment execution remains aligned with business priorities and committed hiring timelines.

### **4. Recruitment Analytics, Dashboards & Forecasting**

* Develop and maintain recruitment dashboards and MIS reports to provide visibility into hiring performance.
* Track key recruitment metrics, including:
  + Time to Fill and Time to Hire.
  + Position-wise hiring progress and ageing.
  + Source effectiveness and conversion ratios.
  + Recruiter-wise productivity and performance.
  + Interview-to-selection and offer-to-join ratios.
  + Cost per hire and recruitment expenditure.
  + Planned versus actual hiring.
  + Forecasted versus completed closures.
  + Recruiter capacity and requirement allocation.
* Use recruitment data to identify trends, evaluate performance and recommend improvements.
* Provide periodic recruitment forecasts and management reports to leadership.
* Establish data-driven recruitment practices and ensure accuracy of recruitment records.

### **5. Recruitment Team Leadership & Performance Management**

* Lead, mentor and manage the recruitment team to achieve organisational hiring targets.
* Allocate recruitment requirements based on recruiter capabilities, workload and hiring priorities.
* Establish individual and team-level KPIs, productivity benchmarks and performance expectations.
* Conduct periodic reviews of recruiter performance, pipeline health and closure progress.
* Identify skill gaps and implement training and development initiatives for the recruitment team.
* Build accountability, ownership and collaboration within the recruitment function.
* Ensure recruiters follow standardised recruitment processes, documentation practices and communication protocols.
* Optimise team structure and recruiter allocation based on changing workforce requirements.
  

  

### **6. Recruitment Tools, Systems & Process Management**

* Own and optimise recruitment tools and platforms, including ATS, job portals and recruitment management systems.
* Ensure effective utilisation of recruitment platforms, databases, reporting tools and automation capabilities.
* Manage job portal performance, subscription utilisation, sourcing effectiveness and recruitment-related expenditure.
* Establish standard operating procedures for sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer management and onboarding handover.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive recruitment activities and improve operational efficiency.
* Ensure recruitment data integrity, reporting accuracy and process compliance.
* Evaluate and recommend tools and technologies that can improve recruitment productivity and scalability.

### **7. Continuous Improvement & Talent Market Intelligence**

* Track industry hiring trends, salary benchmarks, talent availability and competitor hiring practices.
* Evaluate emerging sourcing channels and recruitment methodologies.
* Identify opportunities to improve hiring quality, turnaround time and candidate experience.
* Develop scalable recruitment practices to support the organisation's future workforce growth.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
------------------------------------

* 8–12 years of overall recruitment and talent acquisition experience, preferably within IT Services, IT Consulting, SaaS or technology-driven organisations.
* Demonstrated experience in managing recruitment teams and delivering hiring targets.
* Strong experience in workforce planning, manpower budgeting, hiring projections and recruitment strategy development.
* Proven ability to work with senior leadership and department heads on talent acquisition decisions.
* Hands-on experience in technical and non-technical recruitment, including niche and lateral hiring.
* Strong understanding of recruitment metrics, dashboards, MIS reporting and data-driven decision-making.
* Experience working with ATS platforms, job portals such as Naukri Resdex and recruitment automation tools.
* Strong understanding of recruiter capacity planning and resource allocation.
* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation and leadership skills.
* Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on recruitment execution.

**What We Expect From This Role**
---------------------------------

**The successful candidate should be able to:**

* Understand the organisation's business plans and translate them into realistic workforce and hiring projections.
* Present recruitment strategies, progress and challenges confidently to the leadership team.
* Convert leadership expectations into clear execution plans for the recruitment team.
* Monitor and drive the team towards achieving hiring targets without losing sight of recruitment quality.
* Independently handle critical hiring requirements and step into sourcing and closures when needed.
* Build a recruitment function that is measurable, accountable, scalable and aligned with business growth.

**The ultimate ownership of this role is to ensure that the organisation has the right people, in the right roles, at the right time, while building a recruitment function capable of supporting sustained business growth.**

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**About the Company**

Infinity Learn is a fast-growing EdTech company focused on competitive exam preparation (JEE, NEET, and Foundation). As the organization scales its consumer sales, lead generation, and academic delivery teams, the HR function plays a critical role in keeping the workforce engaged, stable, and aligned with business growth plans.

**About the Role**

The HR Business Partner (HRBP) will act as the primary HR touchpoint for assigned business functions, with a core mandate to control attrition, drive employee engagement, and act as a strategic bridge between business leaders and the Talent Acquisition team. The role requires close partnership with function heads to anticipate hiring needs, translate business plans into workforce requirements, and use data-driven insights — including Root Cause (RCA) and Retention Analysis of attrition trends — to strengthen people outcomes.

**Responsibilities**

* Attrition Control & Retention
* Own attrition metrics for assigned functions (Consumer Sales, Lead Generation, Freelance Teachers) and drive month-on-month improvement against targets.
* Conduct structured exit interviews and stay interviews; identify patterns and early attrition risk signals.
* Run Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on attrition data — by tenure, manager, location, and function— and convert findings into actionable retention plans.
* Partner with function leaders on manager-effectiveness and team-health interventions where attrition risk is manager-driven.
* Track and report attrition dashboards (voluntary vs involuntary, early attrition, regretted exits)to leadership on a monthly cadence.
* Employee Engagement
* Design and execute a monthly/quarterly engagement calendar (recognition programs, team connects, skip-level sessions, R&R initiatives).
* Drive employee pulse surveys / eNPS, analyse results, and own follow-through action plans with respective leaders.
* Strengthen onboarding and early-tenure engagement (first 90 days) to reduce early attrition.
* Champion culture-building initiatives that reinforce Infinity Learn's values across floor and remote teams.

**Business Partnering& Workforce Planning**

* Maintain a regular connect cadence with function leaders(Sales, Lead Gen, Academics) to stay ahead of business plans and upcoming headcount needs.
* Translate business growth plans and attrition-driven backfills into clear, timely hiring requisitions.
* Share consolidated hiring requirement inputs (volume, role mix, location, urgency) with the TA Team to support sourcing and pipeline planning.
* Act as the single point of coordination between business leaders and TA on requisition prioritization, offer approvals, and hiring timelines.
* Provide TA with context on role-specific attrition trends to help refine sourcing and screening criteria.

* HR Operations& Reporting
* Maintain accurate headcount, attrition, and engagement MIS/dashboards for leadership review (MRM/business reviews).
* Ensure timely resolution of employee grievances and escalations in partnership with the HR/ER team.
* Support performance review cycles, warning/PIP processes, and policy implementation within assigned functions.

**Qualifications**

* MBA/PGDM in HR or equivalent, with 4–8 years of experience as an HRBP, preferably in high-volume sales/BPO/EdTech environments.

**Required Skills**

* Proven track record of managing attrition and engagement in a high-growth, high-volume hiring setup.
* Strong stakeholder management skills; comfortable working directly with sales/business leaders and TA teams.
* Data-oriented — comfortable building and reading attrition/engagement dashboards in Excel/Power BI.

description:
We’re seeking someone to join our team as a
**Director - HR Employee Services**
leader who will be responsible for complex HR advisory, Reasonable Accommodation, Reduction in Force, case management, and employee services activities across the HCMES Service Delivery portfolio.
  
  
In the Human Capital Management division, we provide advice and insight to attract, retain, reward and develop a talented global workforce, giving employees the support and tools, they need to succeed. This is a Director level position within the HCM Employee Services team which provides commercially oriented HR guidance, employee support, operational execution, risk management, governance, and service delivery across global HR processes.
  
  
Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.
  
  
**What You'll Do In The Role**

* Lead complex Reasonable Accommodation case management from intake through resolution, including review of supporting documentation, policy interpretation, operational feasibility assessment, stakeholder consultation, and risk-balanced recommendations.
* Act as the senior subject matter expert for sensitive accommodation, leave, ergonomic, employee relations, and workforce matters requiring independent judgment, confidentiality, and escalation discipline.
* Provide end-to-end support and governance for Reduction in Force activities, including coordination with HR Business Partners, Legal, Employee Relations, business leaders, and delivery teams to support confidential workforce actions.
* Interpret Firm policies, regulatory expectations, historical case precedents, and operational guidelines to drive consistent, fair, and defensible outcomes across complex employee situations.
* Influence and advise senior stakeholders, HR Business Partners, managers, employees, Legal, and regional HR partners on sensitive workforce matters, balancing employee experience, business requirements, operational constraints, and compliance risk.
* Own complex escalations and decision support for high-risk cases where precedents are unclear, multiple stakeholders are involved, or outcomes may create legal, compliance, reputational, or employee relations impact.
* Lead operational governance for assigned HCMES processes, including case tracking, documentation quality, audit readiness, service standards, controls, and timely closure of matters in Firm systems.
* Analyze case trends, process gaps, recurring risk themes, and stakeholder feedback to recommend improvements that reduce risk, strengthen controls, and improve the employee and manager experience.
* Drive process simplification, standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across HR Employee Services, ensuring SOPs, templates, playbooks, and knowledge materials remain current and fit for purpose.
* Partner with global and regional HR teams to deliver people initiatives, planned and ad hoc HR projects, cyclical activities, and service delivery priorities with strong execution discipline.
* Provide leadership, coaching, training, and knowledge guidance to junior team members and peers, including capability building, work allocation support, quality review, and input into resourcing or performance-related discussions where applicable.
* Develop executive-ready summaries, metrics, risk insights, and recommendations for senior HR leadership, including clear articulation of issues, options, dependencies, and proposed actions.
* Maintain high standards of confidentiality, judgment, responsiveness, and stakeholder trust while operating in a high-volume, fast-paced, global environment.
* Stay current on relevant employment laws, HR policies, accommodation frameworks, governance expectations, and service delivery requirements to ensure compliant and consistent outcome.

**What You'll Bring To The Role**

* Strong HR advisory capability with proven ability to handle complex, sensitive, and confidential employee matters.
* Experienced understanding of HR Employee Services, Reasonable Accommodation, Employee Relations, RIF support, case management, and HR operations within a global environment.
* Strong knowledge of U.S. employment regulations and accommodation frameworks, including FMLA, ADA, and related policy or compliance expectations.
* Ability to exercise independent judgment, assess risk, analyze complex facts, and recommend balanced outcomes where precedents may not be clearly defined.
* Strong stakeholder management and influence skills, with ability to engage employees, managers, HRBPs, Legal, ER, Compliance, and senior leaders professionally and effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, escalations, and workstreams while maintaining accuracy, documentation quality, and timely follow-through.
* Strong process governance mindset, including SOP ownership, audit readiness, controls discipline, and continuous improvement orientation.
* Proficiency in Workday, AskHR, HRCM, ServiceNow, or similar HR/case management platforms, along with strong Microsoft Office capability across Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* High level of ownership, accountability, integrity, discretion, and professionalism when handling employee data and confidential workforce matters.
* Ability to work effectively across global teams, navigate ambiguity, adapt communication style, and operate in a dynamic service delivery environment.
* Experience supporting complex employee matters in a regulated environment, preferably Banking and Financial Services.
* Experience partnering with Legal, Employee Relations, Compliance, HR Business Partners, business leaders, and regional HR teams on sensitive or high-risk matters.
* At least 10 years' relevant experience would generally be expected to find the skills required for this role with strong exposure to HR Operations, Employee Services, Employee Relations, Reasonable Accommodation, RIF support, or complex case management.

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.
  
  
Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
  
  
Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

In this role, you will serve as a subject matter expert, collaborating closely with HR Business Partners, Finance teams, and senior leadership to design competitive pay structures and incentive programs. - Manage the end-to-end administration of compensation and rewards programs, ensuring seamless execution and compliance with global and local regulatory standards.

- Provide analytical support to senior management by preparing detailed reports and modeling scenarios to inform critical decision-making regarding salary budgets and variable pay structures.

- Demonstrate advanced proficiency in compensation and benefits modeling, with a proven ability to translate complex data into clear, strategic recommendations for leadership.

- Exhibit strong interpersonal skills to effectively navigate stakeholder expectations and communicate sensitive compensation information with clarity and professional discretion.

- Possess a deep understanding of market benchmarking methodologies and the ability to apply these insights to maintain a competitive edge in talent acquisition.

- Maintain a high degree of adaptability in a hybrid work environment, demonstrating the ability to manage multiple high-priority projects simultaneously with minimal oversight.

title: Lead Total Rewards Partner
description:
Egis is a global organisation with over 23,500 employees worldwide. With our head office based in Paris, we offer global career opportunities, as well as offer rewarding careers for our people locally.

Egis is an organisation with a capacity to make meaningful industry and community change in the space of place-making, sustainability and creating connected cities. Different to other engineering firms, Egis offers true end-to-end capability across the entire design-to-operation lifecycle, offering advisory, architecture, engineering, design, asset management and operations services.

We are committed to creating great teams doing innovative work and would love
**you**
to join us to
**Impact the Future.**

**Job Description**

Role Purpose

Act as the analytical engine and trusted deputy to the Regional Head of Total Rewards, driving the design, delivery and governance of competitive, cost-effective and compliant Compensation & Benefits programmes across MESA. The role combines strong technical reward expertise with strong hands-on analytics and partnering with HR, Finance, Group Reward and business leaders as necessary.

Key Responsibilities – Compensation

* **Job Architecture:**
  Maintain job families, levelling and grade/title mapping; support job evaluation and consistent role governance across countries.
* **Pay Bands & Structures:**
  Build and refresh salary ranges (min/mid/max, spreads, midpoint progression); monitor compa-ratios and range penetration.
* **Market Benchmarking:**
  Manage salary survey participation (e.g., Mercer, Aon, Korn ferry) and job matching; deliver market positioning analysis by country, sector and level.
* **Harmonization:**
  Lead pay and grade harmonization for M&A, restructuring and legacy entities, including gap analysis, cost modelling and transition plans.
* **Annual Salary Review & Incentives:**
  Run ASR/merit cycles, budget modelling and merit matrices; support STI/bonus design, payouts.
* **Pay Equity, Offers & Allowances:**
  Conduct internal equity reviews; advise on offers, promotions and salary corrections; govern allowance and expat/mobility packages.

Key Responsibilities – Benefits & Insurance

* **Insurance Programmes:**
  Manage group medical, life and personal accident policies; lead annual renewals with brokers and insurers (RFPs, negotiations, plan design options).
* **Claims & Cost Analytics:**
  Analyse claims experience, loss ratios and utilisation trends; project renewal costs and recommend cost-containment levers.
* **Statutory & Retirement Benefits:**
  Ensure compliance with country requirements (e.g., End-of-service benefits, GOSI/pension schemes, mandatory health cover etc).
* **Benchmarking, Wellbeing & Vendors:**
  Benchmark benefits against market practice; support wellbeing and flexible benefits; manage broker/TPA SLAs, employee communications.

Key Responsibilities – Governance, Analytics & Partnering

* **Policy & Governance:**
  Draft and maintain reward policies, approval matrices and audit-ready documentation; ensure alignment with Regional & Group Reward frameworks.
* **Reward Analytics:**
  Build dashboards, cost models and scenario analyses; ensure HCM/HRIS reward data accuracy and integrity.
* **Operations & Shared Services Partnership:**
  As policy owner, partner with Operations and Shared Services teams who execute reward transactions; define clear process guidelines, controls and checks to ensure accurate, compliant and consistent delivery and data integrity.
* **Partnering & Deputising:**
  Prepare leadership-ready decks and approval notes; act as first point of contact for HRBPs and Finance, and deputise for the Regional Head when required.

**Qualifications**

Candidate Profile

* 12+ years in Compensation & Benefits/Total Rewards, ideally with multi-country exposure across India and the Middle East.
* Hands-on experience with job evaluation methodologies (e.g., Mercer IPE, Korn Ferry Hay, WTW GGS) and salary surveys.
* Advanced Excel and data modelling skills; working knowledge of Power BI and HCM systems (e.g., SuccessFactors, Workday, Oracle).
* Strong analytical rigour and discretion; confident communicator who turns data into executive-ready insights and thrives in a lean regional team.

title: HR Operations Specialist
description:
**About Role**
We are looking for a detail-oriented and tech-savvy HR Operations Specialist to manage day-to-day HR operations, with a strong focus on payroll management, HRMS administration.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience independently managing the complete payroll cycle and be comfortable working with automated payroll systems. In this role, you will be responsible for validating payroll inputs and outputs, identifying discrepancies, ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing, and managing the company's HRMS platform end-to-end.
  
  
You will also oversee core HR operational processes, ensure statutory compliance, and continuously improve HR processes through effective use of HR technology.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Payroll Management & Administration
* Must have prior hands-on experience managing the complete monthly payroll cycle independently, from collecting payroll inputs to final payroll processing.
* Review and validate automated payroll calculations, ensuring accuracy of salaries, attendance, leaves, overtime, incentives, reimbursements, and deductions.
* Ensure accurate computation of statutory components such as PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS, and other applicable statutory deductions.
* Coordinate with Finance for payroll reconciliation, statutory filings, and tax-related documentation.
* Handle employee queries related to salary payouts, pay slips, tax declarations, deductions, and payroll discrepancies with confidentiality and empathy.
* Maintain accurate payroll records and documentation for audit and compliance purposes.
* HRMS Management & Administration
* Program management implementation of the company's HRMS platform (e.g., Keka, Darwinbox, Workday, or equivalent), ensuring data accuracy, system hygiene, and effective utilization.
* Monitor attendance, leave balances, and payroll inputs within the HRMS to ensure accuracy and consistency.
* HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Management
* Manage day-to-day HR operational activities, ensuring smooth execution of employee lifecycle processes.
* Handle employee documentation, personnel records, employee data updates, and HR-related documentation.
* Manage attendance, leave management, employee queries, and other HR operational requirements.
* Support the implementation and communication of HR policies, procedures, and guidelines.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and employees to resolve HR operational queries efficiently.
* Maintain accurate and confidential employee records in compliance with company policies and statutory requirements.

**Qualifications**

* 2–5 years of hands-on experience in HR Operations, with mandatory prior experience independently handling end-to-end payroll processing.
* Previous experience managing payroll through an HRMS or payroll management platform.
* Experience administering and managing an HRMS platform such as Keka, Darwinbox or equivalent Payroll.

**Technical Skills & Requirements**

* Strong understanding of the complete payroll cycle, payroll components, salary structures, statutory deductions, and applicable labor laws.
* Hands-on experience in validating and processing payroll using automated payroll systems.
* Proficiency in HRMS administration, employee database management, and workflow configuration.
* Advanced MS Excel skills, including VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and conditional formulas for data validation and reconciliation.
* Good understanding of PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS, and other applicable statutory compliances.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data management skills..
* High attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to handle confidential employee information.
