At our core, Cloud Raptor is built on long-term partnerships, continuous learning, and outcome-driven delivery. We don’t just implement technology—we help shape what’s next.

Let’s calibrate your future with technology.

Technical Recruitment Manager

Location: India - Bangalore Employment Type: Full-Time Reporting To: Director of Talent and Engagement

Job Summary

Cloud Raptor is seeking an experienced, commercially minded, and highly strategic Technical Recruitment Manager to lead our India Recruitment function and support our continued growth across global markets.

This is a leadership role responsible for managing a high-performing team of technical recruiters while driving end-to-end recruitment delivery across Cloud Raptor's consulting, managed services, and project delivery businesses.

The successful candidate will bring extensive experience recruiting technology professionals within a consulting or professional services environment, supporting Tier 1 enterprise clients and large-scale transformation programs. You will be responsible for developing recruitment strategies, building scalable talent pipelines, managing stakeholder relationships at executive level, and ensuring successful hiring outcomes across India and international markets.

This role requires a proactive leader who can balance operational excellence, people management, workforce planning, and strategic staff augmentation in a fast-paced technology consultancy environment.

Key Responsibilities

Recruitment Leadership & Team Management

•Lead, mentor, develop, and manage a team of Technical Recruitment Specialists.

•Establish recruitment objectives, KPIs, hiring targets, and performance standards across the recruitment function.

•Foster a high-performance culture focused on delivery excellence, accountability, candidate experience, and continuous improvement.

•Conduct regular coaching, performance reviews, training, and career development discussions with team members.

•Build workforce planning capabilities to support rapid organisational growth and project mobilisation.

•Develop scalable recruitment frameworks, processes, and best practices across the business.

Strategic Recruitment

•Own and oversee end-to-end recruitment delivery for permanent, contract, consulting, and project-based hiring.

•Design and execute recruitment strategies aligned to business growth objectives and client delivery requirements.

•Develop proactive recruitment plans across key technology practices including:

•Cloud Engineering (AWS, Azure, GCP)

•DevOps & Platform Engineering

•Software Engineering

•Data Engineering & Analytics

•Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning

•Cyber Security

•Enterprise Applications

•Solution Architecture

•Digital Transformation Consulting

•Drive talent mapping, succession planning, and pipeline development activities.

•Ensure consistent achievement of recruitment SLAs, time-to-fill targets, and quality-of-hire metrics.

Client & Stakeholder Management

•Partner with senior business leaders, Practice Directors, Delivery Executives, and Client Partners to understand workforce requirements and future demand.

•Act as a trusted talent advisor to leadership teams across multiple business units.

•Support resource planning for large-scale consulting engagements, managed services accounts, and project delivery teams.

•Collaborate closely with sales and delivery leadership to support new business opportunities and project ramp-ups.

•Present market insights, talent intelligence, salary benchmarking, and hiring recommendations to executive stakeholders.

•Build strong relationships with Tier 1 enterprise clients and contribute to workforce solution discussions where required.

Talent Pipeline & Market Intelligence

•Establish and maintain high-quality talent communities across specialist technology domains.

•Drive direct sourcing strategies through LinkedIn Recruiter, networking, referrals, industry groups, and talent communities.

•Develop long-term engagement strategies for passive candidates and niche technical talent.

•Monitor technology market trends, competitor activity, talent availability, and evolving skills demands.

•Provide leadership with ongoing analysis of hiring trends, workforce challenges, and talent risks.

Employer Branding & Talent Attraction

•Support the development and execution of employer branding initiatives across India and international markets.

•Promote Cloud Raptor as an employer of choice within the technology and consulting sector.

•Partner with marketing teams on recruitment campaigns, social media strategies, and talent attraction programs.

•Represent Cloud Raptor at industry events, career fairs, technology communities, and networking functions.

Recruitment Operations & Governance

•Ensure compliance with recruitment policies, governance standards, and employment legislation.

•Own ATS management, recruitment reporting, hiring analytics, and workforce dashboards.

•Continuously improve recruitment processes, workflows, and candidate experience initiatives.

•Manage vendor relationships including recruitment agencies, job boards, and assessment providers where required.

•Deliver regular reporting on recruitment performance, forecasting, and hiring effectiveness.

Required Skills & Experience

Essential

•Minimum 10+ years of recruitment and staff augmentation, with significant exposure to technology and digital transformation

•Proven experience managing a team in a Tech consultancy environment dealing with Tier One clients.

title: Assistant Manager Learning & Development
description:
**Company Description**
**The Hoxton, Bengaluru City**
We are seeking an innovative and goal-oriented
**Assistant Manager Learning and Development**
to join our dynamic team for The Hoxton Bengaluru City.
  
  
As a key member of our People & Culture team, you’ll shape and deliver learning initiatives that help our people grow, perform at their best and build meaningful careers with The Hoxton. Working closely with hotel leaders and department heads, you’ll make sure our learning offer is practical, engaging and connected to what our teams and business really need.
  
  
The Hoxton is opening its very first neighbourhood hotel in Asia, coming to India’s Bengaluru city centre in 2026. This is a major milestone for the brand as it ventures into a new continent entirely and we are now looking for a brilliant leadership team to help bring this lifestyle brand to the market.
  
  
Located in the heart of the city centre, The Hoxton, Bengaluru City will bring its undeniable brand DNA and guest experience to India’s “Silicon Valley”, a high-tech city filled with parks and gardens and known for its vibrant cafe and pub culture - very apt for a brand that was founded in London!
  
  
The hotel will feature 149 bedrooms in a variety of The Hoxton’s well-loved room categories and the lobby will have a vibrant all-day dining restaurant & bar. Topping off the hotel we will have a rooftop pool and bar, large scale function rooms and The Apartment - The Hoxton’s unique meeting & events concept
  
  
**More About Us…**
The Hoxton is a series of open-house hotels, each in a neighbourhood that we love. Ever since we opened our first hotel in Shoreditch, we’ve never just been about offering a bed for the night. We want to be more than that: proving style doesn’t need to be sacrificed for good value and providing a place where guests can hang out alongside the locals and submerse themselves in the neighbourhood with vibrant, welcoming public spaces.
  
  
**What's In It For You...**

* The opportunity to work with an exciting new hospitality concept in Bangalore and have a real impact on its success.
* Join an innovative, fast-growing, international group that’s committed to not just building new hotels but building a global brand.
* The chance to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.
* Become part of a team that’s very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences.
* Great discounts across the entire Ennismore family (which you get to keep even if you decide to leave us!).
* A competitive package and plenty of opportunity for development.

Job Description
  
  
**What You’ll Do…**

* Be a true partner to the business for anything that relates to looking after their teams, providing advice & guidance.
* Implement and manage our policies, processes, and procedures, ensuring we are compliant with local employment law in all areas.
* Position our brand as an employer of choice through effective recruitment strategies that attract talent and build a talent pool for effective succession planning within the business.
* Work with heads of department on putting in place development opportunities & paths for the team.
* Keep the culture of the hotel alive by embedding The Hoxton values, promoting a fair, safe and inclusive environment and leading initiatives that engage and empower the team.
* Drive our talent review process from coffee chats, annual reviews through to talent and career management.
* Lead activities under “Do More”, our global initiative to work with local charities & community projects in the cities we call home.
* Support managers on employee relations and performance management cases.
* Work with the central team on European/Global projects and rollouts. We want to hear your ideas and get your input on how to design effective initiatives and deliver innovative solutions.

Qualifications
  
  
**What We’re Looking For…**

* Individuals. You’re looking for a place where you can be you; no clones in suits here.
* Passion for hospitality – whether that’s a drink, a meal, an event or a bed for the night.
* You’re all about having a positive impact on the people you interact with, leaving them with a memorable experience.
* You’re not precious. We leave our egos at the door and help get things done.
* You’re up for doing things differently and trying (almost) everything once.
* If we got stuck in a lift together, we’d have a good time and share a few laughs.
* You want to be part of a team that works hard, supports each other, and has fun along the way.
* You'll come with 2+ years’ experience across all aspects of human resources within the hospitality industry.
* If you’ve previously opened a hotel that’s a big plus; you’ll need to be comfortable recruiting high volume.
* You’re passionate about bringing out the best in other people and are full of ideas you want to try in achieving that goal.
* Experience dealing with legal and performance issues.

title: Benefits and Payroll Manager
description:
Rodeo FX is an award-winning creative company offering services in visual effects, animation, advertising and experiential. We partner with some of the world's leading storytellers and entertainment companies, including Netflix, HBO, Disney, Marvel, Amazon Studios, Warner Bros. and Sony.
  
  
In 2026, Rodeo FX opened its newest studio in
**Bengaluru**
, expanding our global network across Canada, the United States, Europe and India. Located in
**International Tech Park Bengaluru**
, the new 40,000-square-foot studio is designed to accommodate up to 400 artists and supports both Rodeo FX and Mikros Animation.
  
  
Our Bengaluru team is fully integrated into Rodeo FX's global pipeline, collaborating with artists, supervisors and production teams across our international studios on incredible projects.
  
  
We're now building the senior creative and technical leadership for this studio. Joining us at this stage means having the opportunity not only to contribute to world-class projects, but also to help shape the team, workflows and culture of a growing global hub.
  
  
**Work Arrangements**
As an artist-founded and artist-led company, creativity is at the heart of everything we do. Our mission is to give our talent the freedom, resources, and environment they need to produce high-quality work and thrive in a stimulating, collaborative, and supportive setting.
  
  
To support close collaboration, strong team connections, and the creative energy of our studio,
**all Bengaluru roles are expected to work from the studio five days per week**
. This on-site presence helps foster effective communication, faster decision-making, knowledge sharing, and a consistent studio culture across teams.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Benefits & Payroll Manager plays a pivotal role in overseeing the payroll operations for Rodeo’s India Studio. The Benefits and Payroll Manager will manage the day-to-day administration of employee benefits and payroll. The role ensures accurate employee information across the HRIS and the payroll system, timely payroll inputs and a smooth employee experience.
  
  
Working closely with HR and Finance, this person serves as a point of contact for questions related to benefits, leave and payroll. The role requires accuracy, discretion and the ability to meet strict deadlines while coordinating with local and international teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Benefits & Leave Administration**

* Administer employee benefit programs offered in India, including group insurance and wellness benefits, coordinating enrolments, changes, dependent information and coverage termination.
* Liaise with insurance providers, brokers and other benefit partners to maintain accurate records and resolve administrative issues.
* Maintain leave and absence records, including maternity leave, sick leave and other approved absences, in accordance with company policies and applicable requirements.
* Respond to employee and manager questions about benefits, eligibility, coverage and leave, escalating complex cases as needed.
* Maintain benefit documentation and coordinate employee information sessions with providers when required.

**Payroll Preparation & Coordination**

* Oversee, manage and prepare the entire payroll processing cycle within established deadlines, including new hires, departures, salary changes, attendance, unpaid leave adjustments.
* Verify approved compensation information, including cost-to-company (CTC) components, effective dates and employee status changes, before payroll processing.
* Prepare or validate prorated pay, arrears, retroactive adjustments, leave-related adjustments and corrections
* Ensure compliance with all relevant laws and regulations related to payroll, taxes, and employee benefits;
* Oversee the preparation and submission of tax filings and other statutory reports;
* Review payroll registers and supporting reports, investigate discrepancies and coordinate corrections before submission for approval.
* Coordinate full and final settlement inputs for departing employees, including outstanding salary, leave encashment and other applicable dues.
* Support Finance with payroll reconciliations, supporting documentation and payment preparation.

**HRIS Data Integrity & Employee Coordination**

* Support onboarding by verifying payroll information, coordinating benefit enrolment and explaining payroll and benefits processes to new employees.
* Coordinate offboarding updates across HR, payroll and benefit providers.
* Document procedures, maintain tracking tools and contribute to consistent practices between the India studio and global HR teams.
* Handle employee information securely and maintain strict confidentiality.

**Reporting & Process Improvement**

* Prepare and maintain HR, payroll and benefits reports, including headcount changes, leave balances, payroll adjustments and benefit enrolment.
* Identify recurring discrepancies and recommend improvements to data quality, controls and employee support.
* Participate in HR projects, system implementations and process improvements.
* Coordinate with local and international stakeholders to resolve operational issues and meet reporting deadlines.

**Qualifications**

* At least 5 years of relevant experience combining benefits administration with hands-on payroll preparation in India.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Human Resources, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Practical knowledge of Indian payroll processes, including monthly inputs, payroll validation, CTC structures, arrears and full and final settlements.
* Working knowledge of statutory payroll requirements, including EPF, ESI, professional tax and salary TDS, as applicable, and relevant Karnataka employment and leave requirements.
* Experience administering group insurance and employee benefits.
* Experience using an HR information system and payroll software.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including intermediate Excel skills for formulas, data validation and reconciliation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to support employees and collaborate with international teams.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, judgment and discretion.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and meet payroll deadlines.

Assets
  
  

* Experience with HRIS
* Experience with payroll implementation
* Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables.
* Experience supporting multiple entities or locations.
* Experience in VFX, animation, gaming, technology or another project-based environment.
* Relevant training or certification in Indian payroll or statutory compliance.

**Additional Information**
**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**
At Rodeo FX, diversity is a core value. We’re committed to creating an inclusive, equitable workplace where different perspectives are embraced. Every team member brings unique insight that strengthens our creativity, challenges our thinking, and helps us deliver better work.
  
  
**Use of Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment**
Rodeo FX may use AI-based tools to support certain steps of the recruitment process, such as interview transcription or preliminary application analysis. These tools may be operated by third-party providers, and data may be processed outside Quebec. These tools never replace human decision-making: all final hiring decisions are made by our recruitment team and hiring managers. To learn more about how we protect your personal information and your rights, please consult our Privacy Policy.
  
  
**Apply with LinkedIn**
If you would like to use the “Apply with LinkedIn” feature to simplify your application, please make sure you accept cookies on the SmartRecruiters application page. This allows the feature to display and function properly.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role title**
**Job Description**
Assistant Director – Process Consultant(Talent)\_Service Excellence
  
  
**Job Summary**
Support the Service Excellence Leader in shaping, driving, and governing the Service Excellence agenda across GDS by enabling strategy execution, driving insights, and ensuring structured governance, reporting, and compliance.
  
  
Acts as a central orchestration layer between strategy, execution teams, and leadership—ensuring initiatives translate into measurable outcomes.
  
  
Talent Services act as operational business partners to regional talent teams and global functions, offering dedicated support to candidates and employees. Team provides expert advise and facilitate scalable, high-quality services at an economical cost model. We are a crucial part of the EY global talent operating model, supporting its ‘All In’ strategy.
  
  
The process consultant would assist the teams in continuous improvement.
  
  
Key Role and Responsibilities
  
  
As a consultant, the Assistant Director will provide strategic insights and solutions to drive service excellence. They will support team members and business teams , fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional growth. By leveraging their expertise, the Assistant Director will guide the implementation of best practices and innovative methodologies within the organization.
  
  

* Strategy & Thought Leadership Enablement

+ Support the Service Excellence Leader in defining and articulating the Service Excellence strategy and roadmap
+ Conduct research, benchmarking, and internal analysis to inform strategic decisions
+ Develop executive-level presentations, viewpoints, and communication artefacts
+ Translate leadership vision into structured initiatives, frameworks, and action plans
+ Support in shaping new service excellence initiatives (AI, automation, quality, governance)

* Initiative Governance & Transformation Tracking

+ Establish and manage a central initiatives tracker across Service Excellence programs
+ Monitor execution of transformation initiatives (CI, digital, process excellence)
+ Track benefits realization, KPIs, and ROI across initiatives
+ Flag risks, delays, and dependencies with structured escalation mechanisms
+ Drive governance cadence (reviews, dashboards, leadership updates)

* Insights, Reporting & Analytics

+ Design and manage Service Excellence dashboards (KPIs, maturity, adoption, impact)
+ Convert raw data into actionable insights for leadership decision-making
+ Support periodic leadership reviews, business updates, and executive reporting
+ Integrate data across functions to provide a single view of performance and effectiveness

* Governance, Compliance & Standards

+ Support implementation of Service Excellence governance frameworks
+ Ensure adherence to process standards, quality frameworks, and maturity models
+ Assist in process audits, compliance reviews, and documentation governance
+ Maintain repository of methods, frameworks, and best practices

* Stakeholder Orchestration & Communication

+ Act as connective interface across Service Excellence teams, business functions, and leadership
+ Ensure alignment between strategy, execution teams, and global stakeholders
+ Support leadership in stakeholder engagement and influencing discussions
+ Drive structured communication plans for initiatives and programs

* Continuous Improvement & Capability Support

+ Support rollout of CI, agile, quality, and AI-led capability programs
+ Assist in organizing workshops, training initiatives, and awareness programs
+ Enable identification of improvement opportunities and value creation initiatives

Core Skills
  
  

* Proven leadership experience in a similar role with a focus on service excellence, delivery excellence, or business excellence.
* Functional experience of minimum 5 years in Talent or Human Resources.
* Strong understanding of project and program management methodologies and quality management systems.
* Practical experience in implementing quality systems such as ISO, Agile Practice, and Delivery Excellence Practices in medium to larger business units.
* Strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* Good understanding of tools and technology and their application, such as RPA, AI, Copilot, and Power App.
* Usage of AI tools for enhanced productivity and be the advocate of AI tool usage.
* Effective communication and influencing skills to drive results and build relationships with business leaders.
* Proficient in metrics reporting, management, and governance.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably with an engineering or management background.
* Certified Six Sigma Black Belt or Lean Certified Practitioner or Champion.
* Familiar on working and driving project through agile methodology.
* Over 14 years of experience in professional services or a related industry.
* Certification not mandatory, but any maturity model, process, and methods would be a bonus.
* Experience working with various stakeholders and cultural intelligence to work with a wide range of people from different backgrounds, geographies, and countries.
* Ability to lead teams with 10+ Black Belts and influence teams that may not be directly reporting to the person.

We invite you to take on this crucial role to facilitate transformative change and enhance excellence within our service delivery operations. Your leadership and expertise will be essential in achieving our objectives and upholding EY’s standard of excellence.
  
  
Skills and attributes for success
  
  

* Stakeholder Management
* Global Mindset
* Influencing and Negotiation skills
* Change Management, Adaptability and Agility
* Process Engineering skill sets.
* Innovative mindset and ability to relevant models suiting to the context

**What We Look For**
A person who has the energy and enthusiasm to initiate change with appropriate intentions. Demonstrates a commitment to positively impacting the overall situation. Focuses on finding solutions and is willing to ask questions to develop creative resolutions. Genuine, approachable, and capable of uniting a team to work collaboratively towards a shared vision.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: AVP - Payroll & Statutory Compliance
description:

**Location: Bengaluru**
We are looking for an experienced HR Operations professional to lead end-to-end payroll operations, statutory compliance and benefits administration for a leading global banking and financial services organisation.
  
  
This is a leadership opportunity for a seasoned professional with strong expertise in Indian payroll practices, statutory regulations, payroll governance, benefits administration and stakeholder management.

* Strong working knowledge of Indian payroll processes and employment-related statutory compliance.
* Hands-on experience managing end-to-end payroll operations and payroll governance.
* Experience in employee benefits administration, including insurance and retirement-related benefits.
* Proven experience in audit management, vendor governance, stakeholder management and process improvement.
* Exposure to Workday or other comparable HRMS/payroll platforms.
* Experience in a Global Capability Centre (GCC), banking captive or large, complex organisation will be preferred.
* Strong people leadership, analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.

title: Employee Experience & Continuous Improvement Lead
description:
Business Unit: ESI HQ & Other
  
  
Division: IT - Business
  
  
**Challenge Yourself and Impact the Future!**
Element Solutions Inc (NYSE:ESI) is a leading specialty chemicals company whose operating businesses formulate a broad range of solutions that enhance the performance of products people use every day. Developed in multi-step technological processes, our innovative solutions enable our customer manufacturing processes in several key segments, including electronic circuitry, communication infrastructure, automotive systems, industrial surface finishing, and offshore energy.
  
  
Customers of our businesses use our innovation as a competitive advantage, relying on us to help them navigate in fast-paced, high-growth markets. For example, in-care technology, from infotainment to driver assistance, is accelerating the paste of new product development and automotive markets, and with a deep market expertise in electronics, we sit at the intersection of the fast-growing market, changing the competitive playing field for automotive manufacturers, with a long-standing presence.
  
  
We strive to embody the five 'Elements of our Culture'- our '5C's'; Challenge, Commit, Collaborate, Choose, and Care. These core values are the foundation of our organization which our employees embrace in their interactions with customers, colleagues and other stakeholders, to drive financial performance and create a rewarding work environment.
  
  
**Who are we looking for?**
The Employee Experience & Continuous Improvement Lead improves how employees experience IT services and internal processes. The role turns employee feedback, service performance data and operational pain points into practical, measurable improvements. Working across IT and business functions, the position leads service-quality reviews, root-cause analysis and cross-functional improvement initiatives, with a strong focus on sustainable adoption and business outcomes.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**
**Employee Experience And Service Quality**
Own the review of negative satisfaction surveys and other employee feedback relating to IT services.
  
  
Coordinate fact-based reviews with service owners, identify root causes and agree on corrective or service-recovery actions.
  
  
Analyze recurring themes across employee feedback, service interactions and key employee journeys, including onboarding, offboarding, access, and support.
  
  
Advocate for clear, consistent and user-friendly service experiences, communications and processes.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement**
Lead cross-functional improvement initiatives from problem definition through implementation and benefits review.
  
  
Facilitate process mapping, root-cause analysis, and solution-design workshops.
  
  
Apply Lean, Six Sigma, ITIL or comparable methods to simplify processes, reduce waste, and improve quality.
  
  
Partner with service and process owners to prioritize actions, manage dependencies, and sustain improvements.
  
  
**Insights, Measurement and Change**
Define and monitor employee experience, service quality, and improvement of KPIs.
  
  
Prepare concise trend reports and recommendations for leadership and service owners.
  
  
Track improvement commitments, benefits, and post-implementation outcomes.
  
  
Support communications, readiness, training, and stakeholder engagement for process changes.
  
  
**Role Boundaries**
The role focuses on employee experience, service quality, and continuous improvement, not system delivery.
  
  
Technology platforms are used as information or workflow sources when relevant.
  
  
**Who are You?**

* 3-5 years of experience in continuous improvement, employee or customer experience, service quality, operational excellence, process management, or business transformation.
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional improvement initiatives and influencing without direct authority.
* Experience analyzing qualitative feedback and operational data, conducting root-cause analysis, and translating findings into action.
* Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken.
* Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma or ITIL; certification is preferred.
* Experience with survey analysis, KPI reporting, or tools such as Power BI, servicenow is an advantage.

**What competencies will you need?**

* Ability to perform data analysis and use statistical tools.
* Ability to communicate complex problems in plain language.
* Strong facilitation, stakeholder management, written communication, and presentation skills.
* Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken.

**We are Offering...**
**Teamwork**
- At Element Solutions Inc, you will be part of a highly collaborative culture that promotes continuous improvement through cross-functional partnerships to achieve our mission. We do this through a strong and unified culture and transparent management which has empowered us to create high performing global teams that achieve superior solutions for our customers.
  
  
**Innovative**
- At ESI, we are committed to solving the complex and evolving needs of our customers through innovation and high-quality standards. We are focused on bringing cutting-edge and environmentally sustainable solutions to the market. Our people are the critical resources required to make that happen. We support your success by creating a strong, inclusive culture, competitive total rewards, and an appropriate work-life balance.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category applicable under federal, state and local laws.

description:

We are looking for a passionate HR Administration Advisor who thrives on precision, collaboration, and continuous improvement. * Ensure scalability and accuracy of HR administrative processes using SAP HR and SuccessFactors.
* Collaborate with HR Business Partners and Shared Services to streamline workflows and improve service delivery.
* Maintain reliability in employee data management, ensuring compliance with global and local regulations.

* Timely and accurate delivery of HR administrative services aligned with business goals.
* Effective collaboration with HR teams and internal stakeholders to enhance service quality.
* Reduction in process errors and continuous improvement in operational efficiency.

* Empowered by advanced HR technologies and a global digital transformation vision.

Provide guidance to the business and develop creative solutions on a variety of total compensation issues including the setting of appropriate fixed pay, variable pay levels.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* You will support the assigned lead in the entire life cycle of compensation activities ranging from Compensation benchmarking, budgeting, increase and bonus cycles.
* You will be accountable to build and tap existing networks for sources of Market intelligence
* You will build strong network and be able to assess the pulse of Recruitment and Talent retention data points and be able to support with Root cause analysis, findings and recommendations for a program.
* Perform ad hoc analysis for costing, program effectiveness and trend purposes
* Identify, select and participate in compensation and benefits surveys to analyse the company’s competitive market position for each in-country location
* Look for opportunities to do Technology transformation in process areas and steps.
* Ensure deep dive analysis, ROI of all compensation interventions.
* Help in the change management process and communicate the same to the larger employees.
* Partnering with Procurement and Risk management as and when necessary when new service providers are signed up for.
* Has to be fiscally responsible for the program budgets.
* Will be accountable for the judicious use of budgets towards program
* Evaluate and compare existing benefit programs to identify key differences and possible areas of alignment
* Transforming existing benefit programs by recommending design changes that would work from Global, local cultural perspective and cutting through a diverse workforce.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* A self-starter and initative taker
* Should be able to tap into local networks to identify Total Rewards program opportunities
* Must possess strong verbal, written and interpersonal skills for internal presentations.
* Ability to seek out information, clearly communicate information and requests and provide quality advice
* Ability to effectively manage communication and relationships in a highly matrix organization structure
* Demonstrate the ability to highly network and also look for opportunities to attend external forums.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Graduate or a post graduate qualification
* 8 -10 years of proven compensation and benefits experience
* Experience in managing and mentoring teams
* Good understanding of the principles and practices of compensation and benefits systems and legislation in India
* Knows basic taxation laws applying to compensation in India
* Strong analytical, problem solving skills and quantitative skills and a track record for planning, doing and auditing work;

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple projects and priorities at once
* Ability to create tools and models to interpret and analyse data
* Should be able to understand the nuances of diverse businesses and able to develop solutions that may look customized yet is scalable and can be made consistent
* Extensive understanding of industry wide Total Rewards programs and how it would work
* Able to systematically break down problems or processes into their parts and develop several alternative solutions

  

**What we look for**

* Be an enabler of high-performance Talent team.
* Highly detail driven with emphasis on accuracy, coupled with the ability to see the broader/big picture
* Keen interest to invest time for self-learning, seeking opportunities to work on cross-functional HR projects
* Working collaboratively in a team environment
* Comfortable working in a highly matrixed environment

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning:**You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you****:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership****:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:**You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Lead Total Rewards Partner
description:
**Company Description**

Egis is a global organisation with over 23,500 employees worldwide. With our head office based in Paris, we offer global career opportunities, as well as offer rewarding careers for our people locally.

Egis is an organisation with a capacity to make meaningful industry and community change in the space of place-making, sustainability and creating connected cities. Different to other engineering firms, Egis offers true end-to-end capability across the entire design-to-operation lifecycle, offering advisory, architecture, engineering, design, asset management and operations services.

We are committed to creating great teams doing innovative work and would love **you** to join us to **Impact the Future.**

 **Job Description**

Role Purpose

Act as the analytical engine and trusted deputy to the Regional Head of Total Rewards, driving the design, delivery and governance of competitive, cost-effective and compliant Compensation & Benefits programmes across MESA. The role combines strong technical reward expertise with strong hands-on analytics and partnering with HR, Finance, Group Reward and business leaders as necessary.

Key Responsibilities – Compensation

* **Job Architecture:** Maintain job families, levelling and grade/title mapping; support job evaluation and consistent role governance across countries.
* **Pay Bands & Structures:** Build and refresh salary ranges (min/mid/max, spreads, midpoint progression); monitor compa-ratios and range penetration.
* **Market Benchmarking:** Manage salary survey participation (e.g., Mercer, Aon, Korn ferry) and job matching; deliver market positioning analysis by country, sector and level.
* **Harmonization:** Lead pay and grade harmonization for M&A, restructuring and legacy entities, including gap analysis, cost modelling and transition plans.
* **Annual Salary Review & Incentives:** Run ASR/merit cycles, budget modelling and merit matrices; support STI/bonus design, payouts.
* **Pay Equity, Offers & Allowances:** Conduct internal equity reviews; advise on offers, promotions and salary corrections; govern allowance and expat/mobility packages.

Key Responsibilities – Benefits & Insurance

* **Insurance Programmes:** Manage group medical, life and personal accident policies; lead annual renewals with brokers and insurers (RFPs, negotiations, plan design options).
* **Claims & Cost Analytics:** Analyse claims experience, loss ratios and utilisation trends; project renewal costs and recommend cost-containment levers.
* **Statutory & Retirement Benefits:** Ensure compliance with country requirements (e.g., End-of-service benefits, GOSI/pension schemes, mandatory health cover etc).
* **Benchmarking, Wellbeing & Vendors:** Benchmark benefits against market practice; support wellbeing and flexible benefits; manage broker/TPA SLAs, employee communications.

Key Responsibilities – Governance, Analytics & Partnering

* **Policy & Governance:** Draft and maintain reward policies, approval matrices and audit-ready documentation; ensure alignment with Regional & Group Reward frameworks.
* **Reward Analytics:** Build dashboards, cost models and scenario analyses; ensure HCM/HRIS reward data accuracy and integrity.
* **Operations & Shared Services Partnership:** As policy owner, partner with Operations and Shared Services teams who execute reward transactions; define clear process guidelines, controls and checks to ensure accurate, compliant and consistent delivery and data integrity.
* **Partnering & Deputising:** Prepare leadership-ready decks and approval notes; act as first point of contact for HRBPs and Finance, and deputise for the Regional Head when required.

  
**Qualifications**

Candidate Profile

* 12+ years in Compensation & Benefits/Total Rewards, ideally with multi-country exposure across India and the Middle East.
* Hands-on experience with job evaluation methodologies (e.g., Mercer IPE, Korn Ferry Hay, WTW GGS) and salary surveys.
* Advanced Excel and data modelling skills; working knowledge of Power BI and HCM systems (e.g., SuccessFactors, Workday, Oracle).
* Strong analytical rigour and discretion; confident communicator who turns data into executive-ready insights and thrives in a lean regional team.

title: Senior Principal - Portfolio Manager
description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organization. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigor and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose:**

GSK’s Global Supply Chain D&T team is the front facing business tech group supporting GSK’s critical business of Global Manufacturing across all product portfolios. The team comprises of multiple business tech disciplines from site specific D&T partnering through to above site and global services like Data & Analytics and Global Demand & Supply Planning processes.

The Team consists of a set of portfolio and business operations manager aligned to GSC D&T Towers and VPs. The team is responsible for defining as well as ensuring portfolio delivery processes, standards, reporting and governance,are adhered to and understood by product owners and VPs across GSC D&T. The team is also responsible for PMO delivery toolset and its maintenance.

In addition the team is accountable for business operations for each of the towers, in ensuring all Finance, HC and Contracts are clearly understood and driven with the respective GSC D&T LT members, VPs.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead the Portfolio Management service for an assigned GSC D&T Tower, partnering with Tower LT and Product Directors to optimise value delivery across projects and epics.
* Define, maintain and embed portfolio delivery framework, standards, reporting and governance in line with GSCD&T product/portfolio model and PMO guidance.
* Ensure portfolio data quality (scope, status, RAG, milestones, risks, dependencies) and financial information are accurate and ready for governance forums and Portfolio Reviews.
* Prepare and lead Tower portfolio review sessions, highlighting key red/amber items, tracking actions to “back to amber/green” and feeding into GSCD&T Portfolio Review.
* Support prioritization and discretionary budget allocation decisions across the Tower using data-driven insights on Capex/Opex, benefits, risks and impacts. Ensure every initiative has a baseline, a named benefit owner and a measurement schedule, track benefits beyond closure, and feed actuals back into prioritization.
* Work closely with Finance and the Senior Business Operations Manager to ensure finance, headcount and contract/vendor information is clearly understood, controlled and reflected in portfolio reporting.
* Champion GSCD&T portfolio standards and tools (Aha! workspaces, ADO/Jira integration, Power BI dashboards) and support teams to adopt. Coach Product Owners and Tower teams on portfolio discipline so that transparency improves at source.
* Provide support to projects on managing risks, cross-stream dependencies and impediments, escalating through Tower LT and GSCD&T governance where needed. Hold the integrated Tower plan (sequencing, dependencies, capacity and RAID), challenge delivery on pace and evidence, and escalate before impact through Tower LT and GSCD&T governance.
* Partner during planning sessions/BRPs to assess value, dependencies and capacity across the portfolio and ensure alignment with integrated roadmaps and key programmes (e.g. ERP, Smart Manufacturing, D&AI work).
* Continuously improve portfolio management maturity, standards and insight generation, including leveraging AI/automation use cases.
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Master’s degree or PhD in Business, Supply Chain/Operations, Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in supply chain, manufacturing, quality, digital/technology, or a related business environment.
* Experience leading technology-enabled portfolios and/or programmes.
* Experience delivering digital or technology transformation initiatives.
* Experience managing multiple technical projects, products, programmes, or initiatives as part of a portfolio.
* Experience establishing or managing portfolio governance, status reporting, milestones, risks, dependencies, prioritization, and delivery tracking.
* Experience managing operational and/or change budgets valued in the millions of pounds or equivalent currency, including financial tracking and reporting.
* Experience working with senior leadership stakeholders on portfolio priorities, investment decisions, risks, dependencies, and delivery status.
* Experience managing delivery against defined scope, budget, timelines, and quality requirements.
* Experience working with Finance and business/technology teams on portfolio planning, budgeting, or investment management.
* Experience managing risks, cross-programme dependencies, issues, and escalation through governance forums.
* Experience preparing and presenting portfolio performance, financial information, risks, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Experience working across multiple business, technology, finance, and/or geographically distributed teams.
* Availability for business travel as required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Recognized Portfolio Management certification
* Agile / SAFe certification, such as Leading SAFe or SAFe POPM
* Project Management certification, such as PMP or PRINCE2

**Skills**

Change Management, Compliance Risk Management, Dependency Analysis, Executive Reports, Financial Acumen, Portfolio Performance Management, Portfolio Prioritization, Problem Solving, Project Management Governance, Shareholder Communications, Stakeholder Management

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: People Analytics & Reporting Analyst
description:
**Job Title**

People Analytics & Reporting Analyst

**Job Description Summary**

**Job Description**

**Role Summary**  
This position will support the People Analytics & Reporting team with a focus on Workday reporting delivery, stakeholder support, data quality, and operational continuity. The role will partner with a centralized global team of people analytics and reporting to develop, maintain, and enhance reporting solutions that support People business priorities, workforce insights, and data governance.  
  
**Responsibilities**  

* Report into the People Analytics & Reporting function and collaborate with a global team of Workday reporting analysts to deliver accurate, timely, and scalable reporting solutions.
* Own day-to-day Workday reporting responsibilities, including report maintenance, enhancement requests, troubleshooting, and stakeholder follow-up.
* Design, build, test, and deploy Workday reports, including custom reports, advanced reports, matrix reports, and calculated fields.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to understand business requirements, clarify reporting needs, and translate requests into effective reporting solutions.
* Support workforce management, data quality, compliance, and operational reporting needs across geographies and functional areas.

title: Human Capital - Total Rewards Benefits Operate- Manager
description:
**Human Capital**

  

Our Human Capital practice is at the forefront of transforming the nature of work. As converging forces reshape industries, our team uniquely addresses the complexities of work, workforce, and workplace dynamics. We leverage sector-specific insights and cross-domain perspectives to help organizations tackle their most challenging workforce issues and align talent strategies with their strategic visions. Our practice is renowned for making work better for humans and humans better at work. Be part of this exciting era of change and join us on this transformative journey.

**Work you’ll do**

As a **Total Rewards Benefits Operate Manager**, you will lead work at the intersection of **benefits strategy, administration operations, and enabling technology**. You’ll help clients and internal teams translate benefits requirements into scalable platform capabilities—understanding what leading **benefits administration providers** can deliver, how **HCM platforms** connect to those ecosystems, and what it takes to drive successful implementation and ongoing operations. This will be achieved either through use of Deloitte’s proprietary BenefitIQ technology and/or other market solutions as appropriate.

You’ll be accountable for delivering high-quality outcomes, managing teams and stakeholders, and shaping product-enabled solutions that improve member experience, administrative efficiency, and compliance-aligned execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage the global benefits operations for different clients, administering health and welfare, pension, leave, and other rewards programs across the full-service lifecycle, from discovery and solution, design through implementation, operational readiness, ongoing delivery, and customer support.
* Own benefits administration engagements end-to-end, holding full accountability for service delivery, financial performance, and client satisfaction across benefits administration scopes. Accountable for end-to-end SLA/XLA delivery, quality, and compliance across all in-scope benefits operations towers.
* Serve as the primary operational relationship owner for the client.
* Lead client governance, manage escalations, and own the relationship with client HR / Total Rewards / Benefits leadership and benefits vendors
* Communicate effectively with client stakeholders (HR, Total Rewards, HRIT, Payroll, vendors) and internal leadership.
* Partner with cross-functional internal teams to provide cohesive and seamless client experience as one Deloitte.
* Drive growth within the account — identifying expansion opportunities, upsell, and new service lines
* Guide decisions on vendor/platform fit based on client context, administrative complexity, and operating model needs.
* Support operational design including SOPs, roles/responsibilities, case management, escalations, controls, and service metrics.
* Contribute to proposals, estimates, delivery plans, status reporting, and risk/issue management.
* Drive continuous improvement and process optimization

**The Team**  
Our Insights, Innovation & Operate Offering is designed to enhance key aspects of our clients' businesses by leveraging cutting-edge technology, data, and a blend of deep technical and human expertise. We innovate and deliver creative, industry-specific solutions that streamline operations and accelerate speed-to-value.

**Required Qualification:**

* Bachelor's degree

* A total of 10+ years of progressive experience in global benefits administration, spanning implementation, day-to-day operations, process optimization, customer care, and/or working in vendor or service provider environments

* 3+ years of people-management experience leading teams responsible for benefits administration, including system configuration and ongoing operational delivery

* 3+ years of experience leading benefits administration for multinational clients, with accountability for service quality, compliance, and client satisfaction across multiple countries

* Hands-on experience with Human Capital Management (HCM) platform data management and payroll integrations supporting rewards or benefits programs, including eligibility rules, life and qualifying events, payroll deductions, and file-based data exchanges

  
  
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* HR or benefits-related professional certification (e.g., CEBS, GBA, or SHRM-CP/SCP, HRCI, or equivalent)

* Experience working with multiple benefits administration providers across both implementation and ongoing service delivery

* In-depth understanding of the benefits technology landscape, including the capabilities, strengths, and limitations of Workday and other leading HCM and benefits administration platforms.

* Good knowledge of global benefits practices, regulatory considerations, and market trends

* Proven track record of building and managing strong, collaborative relationships with benefits carriers, vendors, and service providers

* Solid understanding of core HCM concepts and integration patterns, such as worker and benefit event data, payroll deductions, file-based vs. API integrations, and inbound/outbound data feeds.

  
  

**Possible Locations**: Gurugram, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Mumbai, Chennai, Pune, Kolkata

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: AI Solution Architect – Agentic AI & Engineering Transformation
description:
**Life at Ness**

At Ness, people come first. Here, you'll be part of a vibrant team that values curiosity, innovation, and growth. We work with industry-leading clients on projects that truly make an impact while supporting every team member in carving out their unique career path. With resources for learning, certifications, and hands-on experiences, Ness offers you more than just a job—it’s a place where your ideas, ambition, and well-being matter.

**The Role**

**AI Solution Architect – Agentic AI & Engineering Transformation**

**Position Summary:**

Seeking a highly experienced AI Architect to lead the design, adoption, and scaling of AI-driven Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices and Agentic AI solutions across the organization.

**Why this Role is important**

This is not a traditional architecture role. You will be at the forefront of transforming a large-scale engineering organization into an AI-First Delivery Enterprise, defining how software is designed, built, tested, and operated in the age of Generative AI and Agentic AI.

You will have the opportunity to:

* Shape the organization's enterprise AI strategy and engineering future state.
* Build and scale Agentic AI capabilities from the ground up.
* Define next-generation AI-driven SDLC practices.
* Work on real-world AI transformation initiatives rather than isolated proofs of concept.
* Partner with senior architects, engineering leaders, business executives, and technology vendors.

**Location**: Offshore – India  
**Experience**: 12+ years overall; strong recent GenAI / Agentic AI architecture experience  
Domain: Banking & Financial Services – Cards, Payments, Customer Service, Collections, Identity, Loyalty, Digital Servicing

**Role Purpose**

Drive the CTFS AI transformation across the managed-services / vendor-consolidation portfolio, focusing on AI-enabled SDLC, Agentic AI, application modernization, engineering productivity, operational automation and measurable savings.

**CTFS Context**

Work across:

* DSS: Java-based digital servicing platform with ~55 microservices
* Pega: Customer service, servicing and disputes
* Collections: Delinquency/default servicing and recovery workflows
* Cards & Payments: TSYS, payment gateway and transaction integrations
* Digital Channels: Mobile/web servicing
* Identity & Fraud: CIAM, authentication and fraud integrations
* Batch & Integration: APIs, MQ/middleware, batch and partner systems
* Legacy Modernization: Java/WebSphere and cloud migration
* Data platform Modernization: Migration from traditional warehouse to cloud(preferably Databricks)

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define AI target architecture and adoption roadmap
* Drive AI across requirements, design, coding, testing, documentation, release and support
* Design Agentic AI solutions using agents, MCP/API integrations and human-in-the-loop controls
* Establish reusable patterns for LLMs, RAG, agents, security, evaluation and observability
* Identify and prioritize AI use cases across DSS, Pega, Collections, Batch and Digital
* Apply AI to legacy analysis, modernization, testing and migration acceleration
* Enable AI-assisted incident triage, RCA, knowledge retrieval and operational automation
* Drive PoC Pilot Production with security and governance controls
* Measure productivity improvement and translate it into validated capacity / cost savings
* Mentor engineering teams and create reusable accelerators
* Establish AI adoption frameworks, governance models, and implementation standards.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and platforms.
* Provide technical guidance to engineering teams, architects, and product owners.

**Core Skills**

**Technical skills:**

* **AI & Generative AI : Strong experience in:**

* Large Language Models (LLMs)
* GPT-based architectures
* OpenAI ecosystem
* Azure OpenAI
* Anthropic Claude
* Gemini
* Prompt Engineering
* RAG architectures
* Vector databases
* Embedding models
* Fine-tuning concepts
* AI evaluation frameworks

2. **Agentic AI: Hands-on experience with:**

* Multi-agent architectures
* Autonomous workflow agents
* AI orchestration frameworks
* Agent lifecycle management
* Planning and reasoning systems
* Tool integration frameworks
* Human-in-the-loop patterns
* MCP Server

3. **Preferred exposure to below AI platforms/framework:**

* LangGraph
* AutoGen
* LangChain
* CrewAI
* Microsoft Copilot Studio
* Azure AI Foundry

4. **Software Engineering: Strong understanding of:**

* Agile delivery
* Microservices
* Event-driven architecture
* SDLC methodologies

5. **Cloud & Platforms: Experience with:**

* Microsoft Azure
* AWS
* Google Cloud
* AI services and cloud-native architecture
* Devops pipeline for both Brownfield and GreendField applications

**Leadership Skills**

* Ability to influence senior leadership and engineering organizations
* Executive stakeholder management
* Team mentoring and coaching
* Strong communication and presentation skills

**Preferred Experience**

Financial services, cards/payments, customer servicing, collections, fraud/identity, enterprise modernization, Pega, Java/Spring, NodeJS, MQ, Azure, batch processing and regulated environments.

**Expected Outcome**

AI Roadmap Prioritized Use Cases Production AI Solutions SDLC/Productivity Improvement Measurable Savings

**Success Metrics: The AI Architect will be measured on:**

* AI adoption across engineering teams
* SDLC productivity improvement
* Reduction in development and testing effort
* Number of AI-enabled delivery programs
* Agentic AI implementation success rate
* Reusable AI accelerators created
* Architecture compliance and governance adherence
* Engineering team AI maturity growth

**What to Expect Next**

We believe great experiences start with transparency—and that includes our hiring process. Here’s what you can typically expect after you hit "Apply":

1. HR Interview – A conversation to get to know you better and align on expectations.

2. Technical Interview – A chance to showcase your skills and experience.

3. Client Interview – Ensuring mutual fit between you and the client team.

4. Offer Stage – If everything aligns, we’ll be happy to make it official.

While many of our roles involve just 2–3 steps, some client processes may include additional conversations. Regardless of the path, we aim to keep every step transparent and respectful of your time.

**Ready to Start Your Journey?**

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
