title: People Consulting-Payroll Implementation and Consulting-Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line - Position Title: EY - GDS - Consulting - People Consulting (PC),**
**Payroll Advisory - Staff / Consultant**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for experienced Staff / Consultants with expertise in Payroll to join the People Consulting team. This is an opportunity to support global payroll advisory and transformation engagements, work with distributed teams across geographies, and build strong functional knowledge across payroll processes, operating models and technology.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support delivery of global payroll advisory, transformation and implementation engagements in collaboration with GDS teams and EY member firms.
* Participate in payroll current-state assessments, discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews and documentation of findings, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Support payroll process design, operating model analysis, vendor assessment, requirements gathering and preparation of business and functional documentation.
* Develop process maps, standard operating procedures, work instructions, project trackers, status reports and client-ready presentations.
* Support data collection and analysis across payroll inputs, gross-to-net processing, payroll remittances, controls, interfaces, reporting and workforce management processes.
* Assist with payroll implementation activities, including requirements traceability, test scenario preparation, data validation, defect tracking, user acceptance testing and deployment readiness.
* Work as part of a global distributed team and ensure quality, accuracy and timeliness of assigned deliverables.
* Maintain effective communication with project team members and client stakeholders, proactively highlighting risks, dependencies and issues.
* Contribute to payroll methodologies, templates, accelerators, proposals and thought leadership materials that strengthen the Payroll Advisory offering.
* Demonstrate continuous learning and develop subject-matter expertise in one or more payroll service areas or technology platforms.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* High integrity and commitment to working in a new and challenging environment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and documentation skills, with attention to detail.
* Ability to manage ambiguity, organize work independently and be proactive.
* Strong verbal and written communication and presentation skills.
* Cross-cultural awareness and sensitivity when working with global teams.
* High energy levels, agility, adaptability and willingness to learn.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet agreed timelines.
* Open to travel nationally and internationally for approved client projects, in line with EY and country-specific travel advisory guidelines.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 2-5 years of relevant experience in payroll operations, payroll consulting, payroll implementation, HR transformation or workforce management.
* Practical exposure to payroll advisory, payroll transformation, payroll implementation or payroll technology projects.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in commerce, Finance, Human Resources, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* Understanding of the end-to-end payroll lifecycle and key controls, including payroll inputs, gross-to-net processing, remittances, reconciliations and reporting.
* Experience in process documentation, requirements gathering, data analysis, testing or project coordination.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
* Experience of working in consulting, shared services, payroll provider or global delivery environment.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Exposure to one or more payroll platforms such as ADP, Dayforce, Workday, SAP, Oracle or PeopleSoft.
* Experience in payroll assessments, process improvement, vendor selection, payroll outsourcing or operating model initiatives.
* Experience in preparing process maps using Visio or similar tools and creating SOPs, work instructions or business requirements documents.
* Exposure to multi-country payroll programs and global payroll vendors.
* Awareness of payroll compliance, governance, risk and control considerations.
* Relevant payroll, project management or technology certification.

**What We Look For**

* Professionals who are independent, self-motivated, proactive and results-oriented, with a commitment to high-quality client service.
* Individuals with relevant payroll experience and the enthusiasm to adapt and learn in a fast-moving consulting environment.
* Team players who are willing to take on new responsibilities, work across geographies and contribute to the continued growth of the Payroll Advisory practice.
* People with a genuine interest in Payroll, Workforce Management and HR Transformation.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment and support your growth through a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodation you may need.
  
  
**Our commitment**
We endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose and champion inclusiveness. Our aim is to cultivate an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, and individuals can authentically be themselves and contribute their best.
  
  
**Professional development**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and culture**
Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**How To Apply**
If you are passionate about joining us and aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing the required application information and providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates may advance to a competency-based interview as part of the recruitment process.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: HRIS Manager
description:
**HRIS Manager**

**Location :** Chennai, India  
**Required Language** : English  
**Employment Type** : Full Time  
**Seniority Level** : Manager Level
  
**Travel** : <10%  
  
Buckman is a privately held, global specialty chemical company with headquarters in Memphis, TN, USA, committed to safeguarding the environment, maintaining safety in the workplace, and promoting sustainable development. Buckman delivers exceptional service and innovative solutions to our customers globally in the pulp and paper, leather, and water treatment sectors to help boost productivity, reduce risk, improve product quality, and provide a measurable return on investment. Buckman is in the middle of a digital transformation of its businesses and focused on building the capabilities and tools in support of this.  
  
**Position Summary**  
The HRIS Manager owns the global HR systems landscape and is accountable for the management, maintenance, governance, integration, security, and continuous improvement of all Human Resources systems and workforce data. The role ensures SAP HCM, SAP SuccessFactors, and every other HR application, interface, reporting solution, and supporting technology are reliable, secure, compliant, connected, and fit for business needs. The HRIS Manager proactively searches for, evaluates, recommends, and helps implement AI-enabled solutions that improve the effectiveness, efficiency, accuracy, scalability, and user experience of HR processes and services. The role establishes clear data ownership and controls, protects employee-data integrity, enables consistent global HR processes, and partners with HR, IT, Payroll, Finance, and business leaders to deliver trusted workforce information and measurable value from HR technology.

**Job responsibilities**

* Own the complete global HR systems portfolio, including SAP HCM, SAP SuccessFactors, and all other HR applications, tools, interfaces, reporting solutions, and supporting technologies.
* Maintain a complete HR systems inventory with clear purpose, ownership, lifecycle status, dependencies, controls, service expectations, and vendor accountability.

SAP HCM, SuccessFactors, and the Full HR Technology Portfolio Are Optimized

* A global HR data-governance framework defines data owners, stewards, standards, definitions, quality rules, access, retention, and issue-resolution accountabilities.
* Data quality is monitored through controls, reconciliations, exception reporting, and corrective action, with recurring issues addressed at source.

Integrations, Access, and Compliance Risks Are Controlled

* Interfaces among HR systems, payroll, identity management, finance, time, recruiting, learning, and other connected platforms are monitored and supported end to end.

AI and Emerging Technology Improve HR Effectiveness

* Continuously scan the market and internal technology landscape for AI-enabled solutions that can improve HR service delivery, decision support, employee and manager experience, data quality, and productivity.
* Identify high-value HR use cases, define the business problem and expected benefit, and evaluate solutions for effectiveness, feasibility, integration, cost, risk, privacy, security, and responsible use.

**Competencies Needed for Success**

Demonstrated hands-on functional and administrative expertise in SAP HCM and SAP SuccessFactors is required.  
Experience owning a global or multi-country portfolio of HR systems, including product lifecycle, configuration, releases, testing, support, integrations, vendor delivery, rationalization, and roadmap management.  
Working knowledge of AI-enabled HR solutions and the ability to identify use cases, scan and evaluate vendors or products, assess value and risk, support pilots, and measure business outcomes.  
Strong knowledge of HR master data, organization structures, workflows, role-based permissions, interfaces, reporting, and data-quality controls.

Deep expertise in Excel – Pivots, Power queries, Advanced formulas

Strong knowledge of APUs Query Manager 4, Qlik, Power BI and SQL reporting

Working knowledge of HR data governance, privacy, security, responsible AI, access controls, segregation of duties, retention, audit, and compliance requirements.

Ability to translate HR and business requirements into scalable technology solutions while balancing standardization, user experience, effectiveness, risk, and cost.

Experience with project delivery, process redesign, change management, stakeholder communication, and user adoption in a complex global organization.

People leadership and capability-building experience preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Bachelor's Degree with One of the following or similar: Human Resources Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related field  
Advanced degree and relevant SAP certifications preferred

**Personality Traits**

* Strong problem-solving, debugging and solutions design and implementation experience.
* Ability to work on multiple projects at the same time by managing priorities and project timelines.
* Exceptional self-direction and project management skills
* Be a self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, startup environment.

title: Manager - Operations
description:
**About Medhavi Skills University**

Medhavi Skills University (MSU) is a government-notified private skills university established under a State Act in Sikkim, dedicated to promoting quality skill education and entrepreneurship integrated with higher education. As a pioneering institution in the convergence of the skilling ecosystem with higher education, MSU aligns with the National Education Policy, 2020 (NEP 2020). Recognized by the UGC and established in 2021, MSU collaborates with industries and Skill Development Institutes to offer work-integrated courses, embedding on-the-job internships and training within the curriculum. MSU is a recognized Awarding Body under the National Council for Vocational Education & Training (NCVET) and is empanelled with the Directorate General of Training (DGT). As an anchor university partner with the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) and the Project Management Unit (PMU) of NSDC International, MSU is committed to preparing youth for the future workspace by co- working

with industry partners to design and implement demand-driven programs.

**About MAPL**

Medhavi Aspire Private Limited (MAPL) serves as the industry outreach arm of Medhavi Skills University, providing comprehensive human capital solutions across India. As a one-stop partner for talent workforce management, MAPL empowers businesses with innovative tools and strategies to

attract, develop, and retain top talent. MAPL’s diverse portfolio includes training and development,manpower outsourcing, payroll and compliance management, and apprenticeship management services under the NAPS/NATS schemes. It also champions the ‘Learn & Earn’ initiatives through the WISE programs of Medhavi Skills University, offering individuals an opportunity to gain practical skills while earning a livelihood. In addition to its core services, MAPL is committed to fostering impactful Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives. These efforts focus on skill development, education, and environmental conservation, furthering its mission to drive sustainable growth and social progress.

**Role Overview:**

The Operations Manager is responsible for end-to-end management of manpower operations including workforce deployment, client servicing, statutory compliance, payroll coordination, productivity tracking,and stakeholder management to ensure seamless service delivery and contractual adherence.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Manpower Operations & Deployment

* Manage end-to-end manpower operations across assigned client locations.
* Ensure timely mobilization, deployment, and replacement of manpower as per client requirements.
* Monitor attendance, shift scheduling (including night shifts), and productivity.
* Address workforce issues such as absenteeism, attrition, discipline, and grievances.

**2. Client Relationship Management**

* Act as the single point of contact for client operational matters.
* Conduct regular client meetings to review service levels, compliance, and performance.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs, commercial terms, and contract conditions.
* Handle escalations related to manpower, billing, or compliance professionally.

3. Compliance & Statutory Adherence

* Knowledge of compliance – Apprenticeship Program(NAPS/NATS)
* Coordinate monthly compliance check with Compliance Dept.
* Maintain accurate documentation and records for compliance and audits.

**4. Payroll & Commercial Coordination**

* Coordinate with payroll teams for accurate wage processing and timely disbursement.
* Validate attendance, overtime, incentives, allowances, and deductions.
* Ensure correct billing to clients as per approved commercials.
* Support finance teams in reconciliation and collections follow-ups.

**5. Team Management**

* Lead and manage site supervisors, coordinators, and field executives.
* Conduct regular reviews, training, and performance monitoring of the team.
* Ensure daily reporting, MIS, and operational dashboards are maintained.

**6. Reporting & MIS**

* Prepare and share daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports headcount
* Attrition
* Attendance
* P & L
* Analyze operational data to improve efficiency and reduce costs.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* Graduate / Postgraduate (HR, Operations, or related field preferred)
* 6–12 years of experience in manpower / staffing / contract labor operations
* Prior experience handling large headcount and multiple client locations
* Strong knowledge of manpower/staffing operations
* In-depth understanding of compliance
* Excellent client handling and communication skills
* Leadership and people management capability
* Problem-solving and escalation management
* Proficiency in MIS, Excel, and HRMS/CRM systems

**Reporting – National Operations Head**

**Why Join MAPL?**

* Be a part of a mission-driven organization committed to transforming the workforce ecosystem.
* Opportunity to lead and innovate in a growing industry.
* Contribute to impactful skill development initiatives that shape the future of the workforce.

Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter detailing their qualifications and experience at careers@msu.edu.in

title: Sr Executive Assistant
description:
**The Company**

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. description:

--------------------

Driven by the belief that health is a human right and the vision, ‘Health for a better world’, Providence and its 121,000 caregivers strive to provide everyone access to affordable quality care and services.

The India center will have focused efforts around healthcare technology and innovation, and play a vital role in driving digital transformation of health systems for improved patient outcomes and experiences, caregiver efficiency, and running the business of Providence at scale.

  

**Why Us?**
-----------

* Best In-class Benefits
* Inclusive Leadership
* Reimagining Healthcare
* Competitive Pay
* Supportive Reporting Relation

**Position Summary**
====================

The Privacy and AI Governance Manager will strengthen the assessment, implementation and continuous improvement of PGC’s privacy and AI governance programs. The individual will closely partner with business, Technology, Cybersecurity, Legal, Procurement, HR, and product teams to embed privacy and AI governance requirements throughout the data and AI lifecycles - from ideation and collection through design, development, deployment, monitoring, retention, and decommissioning. The individual will also identify and help operationalize privacy and HIPAA obligations arising from customer contracts and Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) throughout the customer contractual lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Privacy Governance**
----------------------

* Manage the data privacy governance framework, with particular focus on the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and other applicable privacy requirements.
* Identify HIPAA and data privacy obligations arising from external customer contracts and Business Associate Agreements (BAAs), ensure appropriate safeguards are implemented through the contractual lifecycle, including handling of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and Protected Health Information (PHI). Coordinate implementation and ongoing compliance with applicable safeguards.
* Conduct privacy risk assessments, gap assessments, Data Protection Impact Assessments, and remediation tracking for business processes and applications.
* Maintain governance for privacy notices, consent and withdrawal, data-principal rights, records of processing activities, purpose limitation, data minimization, retention, disposal, data flows, and cross-functional accountability.
* Develop and deliver role-based privacy awareness, communications, and training for employees, leaders, process owners and other relevant groups.
* Act as the single point of contact for data privacy matters, providing practical advisory support that ensures compliance requirements are met.
  

**AI Governance**
-----------------

* Operationalize AI governance framework covering entity-level and use-case-level risks and controls across the full AI lifecycle.
* Maintain a standardized AI risk taxonomy, risk and control library, assessment methodology, evidence requirements, maturity criteria, and reporting approach.
* Assess AI control design and operating effectiveness; collaborate with respective control owners to elevate governance maturity and follow through to closure.
* Review AI use cases and provide subject matter expertise on privacy exposures and necessary safeguards.
* Support strengthening policies and procedures on AI governance across variety of use cases (generative AI, large and small language models, agentic AI, enterprise AI, native AI, and third-party AI solutions).
* Align the program, as appropriate, with recognized frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, healthcare AI guidance, and Providence AI principles.

* Monitor regulatory and industry developments and recommend timely updates to policies, controls, training, and governance practices.

**Qualifications and Experience**
=================================

* Bachelor’s degree in law, information technology, cybersecurity. Postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* 8–12 years of experience in privacy, data protection, technology risk, compliance, information governance, AI governance, or related areas, including experience leading cross-functional programs.
* Working knowledge of the DPDP Act, privacy principles, consent and rights management, records of processing, impact assessments, incident management, retention, and third-party risk.
* Strong understanding of AI governance and risk concepts across design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, change, and retirement.
* Experience developing risk and control matrices, testing controls, evaluating evidence, assessing maturity, and managing remediation.
* Ability to interpret regulatory and framework requirements and convert them into practical business and technology controls.
* Experience engaging senior leaders and collaborating across cross functional teams.
* Experience in healthcare or another highly regulated environment is preferred.

**Preferred Credentials**
=========================

* Privacy certification such as Certified in Healthcare Privacy Compliance (CHPC), Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP), Certified Information Privacy Manager (CIPM), or an equivalent credential.
* Risk, audit, security, or governance certification such as Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), or an equivalent credential.
* Training or certification relating to responsible AI, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, AI assurance, or model risk management.

This makes us committed towards equal employment opportunities, regardless of race, religion or belief, color, ancestry, disability, marital status, gender, sexual orientation, age, nationality, ethnic origin, pregnancy, or related needs, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, or any other category protected by applicable law. In furtherance to our mission in building a more inclusive and equitable environment, we shall, from time to time, undertake programs to assist, uplift and empower underrepresented groups including but not limited to Women, PWD (Persons with Disabilities), LGTBQ+ (Lesbian, Gay, Transgender, Bisexual or Queer), Veterans and others. title: Compensation and Benifit Manager
description:
About the Role

As the Compensation, Variable Pay & Benefits Lead, you will own the compensation strategy, variable pay programs and employee benefits framework. You will make sure pay practices are competitive, compliant and data-driven. You will work with HR and business leaders to enable fair pay decisions, employee engagement and cost-effective rewards.

Key Responsibilities

**Compensation Management**

* Lead annual compensation planning, including merit, market adjustments and promotions.
* Benchmark roles and run pay analysis to ensure internal equity and market competitiveness.
* Manage salary structures, pay ranges and job evaluations.
* Recommend pay for hiring, transfers and retention cases.
* Analyze compensation trends and share insights with leadership.

**Variable Pay & Incentive Programs**

* Own the design, administration and governance of variable pay, bonus and incentive plans.
* Manage annual and quarterly incentive calculations, payouts and audits.
* Work with Finance, HRBPs and business units on performance metrics and eligibility.
* Keep incentive programs transparent and aligned with organizational goals.

**Benefits Administration**

* Manage benefits programs such as insurance, leaves, wellness and retirement benefits.
* Evaluate benefit offerings for competitiveness and cost-effectiveness.
* Drive vendor management, renewals, negotiations and SLA adherence.
* Resolve employee queries and communicate benefit policies clearly.

**Governance, Policies & Compliance**

* Maintain C&B policies aligned with statutory requirements (PF, gratuity, ESIC and others).
* Ensure strong governance, documentation and audit readiness for all pay and benefits processes.
* Drive process improvements and standardization.

**Reporting, Analysis & Insights**

* Build dashboards and reports on compensation trends, cost impact, payout summaries and headcount metrics.
* Provide modeling and scenario analysis for leadership decisions.
* Support budgeting and cost projections for compensation, variable pay and benefits.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance and leadership on compensation decisions.
* Lead communication for reward cycles, benefits changes and policy updates.
* Act as the subject matter expert on compensation and benefits.

title: HR Benefits Senior Analyst
description:
We are looking for a
**Senior Analyst**
to join our
**HR Benefits Operations**
team. In this role, you will manage retirement benefits, trust accounting, compliance audits, and regional APAC transitions.
  
  
**Key Operating Context (Downstream Payroll Interface):**
Most benefit operations are downstream processes that depend directly on monthly payroll output. Individual will work closely every day with the
**Global Payroll Services**
team to match deduction files, meet strict cut-off schedules, and ensure accurate benefit remittances and settlements.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Regional APAC Projects & Process Transitions
* Work with regional leaders and local country teams in China, Japan, South Korea, Indonesia, and Taiwan to map retirement, pension funding, payment processes and
* Lead the transition (migration) of corporate and statutory benefit tasks from local payroll teams into the centralized Benefits Operations team.
* Write and update clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Operating Procedure Manuals (OPMs) to ensure audit readiness across all APAC markets.
* Review monthly accounting entries, cost accruals, and expense reclassifications.
* Review invoices for benefit vendors and service partners on time.
* Complete monthly and quarterly General Ledger (GL) and FullKey balance sheet sign-offs/attestations with full audit trails.

**India Key Processes**
**Downstream Payroll Interface & Reconciliations**

* Work closely with the Payroll team each month to receive, match, and validate employee deduction files.
* Perform two-way reconciliations between payroll reports and benefit records before any money is paid out.
* Review and correct data differences caused by salary revisions, arrears, new joiners, exits, and unpaid leaves.

**Provident Fund (In House Trust and EPFO Trust)**

* Maintain the master database for PF for Citibank in House PF Trust
* Review and approve monthly PF settlement claims, transfer requests, and death claims.
* Reconcile annual PF accounts and ensure yearly member account slips are generated and sent to employees.
* Ensure all new joiners complete Form 11 declarations and KYC verification.
* Checking of monthly Electronic Challan cum Return (ECR) files and complete statutory PF payments on the EPFO portal within government deadlines.

**Gratuity**

* Track the solvency and balance of the Gratuity fund to make sure liabilities are fully funded.
* Coordinate required policy funding and premium payments with fund managers (such as LIC) with complete payment records.
* Review and approve monthly employee gratuity settlement calculations and disbursements upon exit or retirement.
* Work to automate and update internal gratuity calculation sheets and liability models.

**Superannuation & Management Pension**

* Maintain the Superannuation member master file, tracking active members, voluntary contributions, deferrals, and exit payouts.
* Manage monthly calculations for retired staff pension, annual indexation/pension increases, and arrears.
* Track and verify annual Life Certificates submitted by pensioners to ensure continuous and valid pension disbursements.
* Ensure accurate generation and distribution of annual Superannuation account statements to employees.

**Actuarial Valuation Headcount Preparation**

* Partner with external actuaries, Corporate Finance, and Risk teams for annual and interim valuation exercises.
* Collect, clean, and provide audited demographic and employee data for Gratuity, Leave Encashment, and Pension valuation reports.
* Maintain and improve internal tracking templates and valuation models.

**Tax Compliance (TDS / e-TDS)**

* Calculate tax (TDS) deductions on all retirement, pension, and trust claim payouts.
* Support the timely filing of quarterly e-TDS returns (Form 24Q / Form 26Q).
* Generate and issue Form 16 / Form 16A tax certificates to beneficiaries and retirees.

**Retirement Trusts Governance**

* Support administrative and secretarial tasks for Employee Benefit Trusts (Deck for Board of Trustees meetings)
* Maintain official trust accounting books and ensure all investments follow approved trust guidelines and banking regulations.
* Lead end-to-end preparations for annual statutory audits of retirement trusts to ensure zero audit findings.

**Partner Governance & Query Resolution**

* Supervise third-party administrators (such as HGS) and insurance partners (such as LIC) through regular performance reviews and SLA scorecards.
* Act as the senior point of contact to resolve complex queries or escalations from ex-employees, alumni, and retirees.
* Guide and support junior team members to maintain high operational accuracy and meet daily turnaround times.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business, or HR.
* Experience: 5 to 8 years of relevant experience in Benefits Operations, Retirement Trusts, Payroll, or HR Compliance.
* Product Knowledge: Strong understanding of statutory retirement rules (PF/EPFO, Gratuity, Superannuation, Pension, Trust Governance, and TDS).
* Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, basic formulas) and HR/Payroll platforms (such as Workday, SAP, or PeopleSoft).
* Communication: Clear verbal and written English communication skills for collaborating with regional teams, finance, and external partners.

title: Strategy Head
description:
Job Title: Head – Corporate Strategy & Business Growth

Company: Konark Infrastructure Ltd.

Department: Corporate Strategy & Business Development

Location: Corporate Office, Maharashtra

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 10–18 Years

Qualification: MBA (Strategy / Finance / Operations) from a reputed institution preferred. B.E. / B.Tech with relevant business leadership experience will also be considered.

1. Job Overview

Konark Infrastructure Ltd. is looking for a highly strategic, commercially driven and result-oriented Head – Corporate Strategy & Business Growth to lead the company’s long-term growth, business expansion and strategic initiatives.

The candidate will work directly with the CEO and senior management to develop and execute corporate strategies, identify new business opportunities, evaluate market potential, expand into new geographies and improve organisational and financial performance.

The company operates in infrastructure, Solid Waste Management (SWM), water supply and municipal infrastructure projects. The candidate will be expected to understand government contracting, infrastructure economics, project financing, competitive positioning and large-scale project execution.

This is a leadership position requiring a combination of strategic thinking, financial understanding, business intelligence, commercial acumen and execution capabilities.

The selected candidate will be responsible for translating the CEO’s vision into measurable business objectives and ensuring that strategic initiatives are implemented across the organisation.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Corporate Strategy & Business Planning

* Develop short-term, medium-term and long-term corporate growth strategies.
* Prepare annual business plans, strategic roadmaps and growth targets.
* Identify opportunities to increase turnover, profitability, market share and operational efficiency.
* Evaluate existing business verticals and recommend expansion or restructuring.
* Develop strategies for strengthening the company’s competitive positioning.
* Identify business risks, market challenges and opportunities.
* Work directly with the CEO on strategic decision-making and organisational priorities.
* Convert management decisions into actionable plans with defined timelines and accountability.

B. Business Expansion & New Geographies

* Identify new business opportunities across India in SWM, water supply and infrastructure.
* Evaluate opportunities in Municipal Corporations, Municipal Councils, State Government departments and Central Government projects.
* Conduct geographical market mapping and identify high-potential cities and states.
* Develop strategies for entering new markets and establishing regional operations.
* Identify potential government projects, upcoming tenders and infrastructure investment opportunities.
* Develop relationships and coordinate with industry stakeholders, consultants and strategic partners.
* Prepare market entry strategies for new business verticals.

C. New Business Verticals & Diversification

Identify, evaluate and develop opportunities in emerging infrastructure and environmental businesses, including:

* Bio-CNG and Compressed Biogas (CBG).
* Dry waste recycling and material recovery facilities (MRF).
* Construction and Demolition (C&D) waste processing.
* E-waste and battery waste management.
* Organic waste processing and composting.
* Waste-to-energy and resource recovery.
* Water supply infrastructure and distribution networks.
* Advanced waste management technologies and automation.

Responsibilities include:

* Conduct feasibility studies and market assessments.
* Evaluate investment requirements and potential returns.
* Prepare business plans and project financial models.
* Identify technology partners, investors and joint venture opportunities.
* Present investment proposals to the CEO and management.
* Monitor implementation of approved diversification projects.

D. Tender & Business Pipeline Strategy

* Develop a centralised business opportunity and tender pipeline.
* Identify strategically attractive tenders based on project size, profitability, eligibility and competitive intensity.
* Evaluate tender opportunities before the company commits resources.
* Work with the Tender Head to develop bidding strategies for high-value projects.
* Conduct competitor intelligence and analyse competitors’ financial capacity, project experience and geographical presence.
* Evaluate consortium, joint venture and strategic partnership opportunities.
* Analyse bid success rates and recommend improvements.
* Develop a long-term order book growth strategy.
* Monitor the conversion of business opportunities into awarded projects.

Note: The Strategy Head will determine which opportunities the company should pursue, while the Tender Head will remain responsible for actual bid preparation and submission.

E. Financial Strategy & Investment Analysis

* Evaluate project-level and business-level profitability.
* Develop financial models for new projects and business opportunities.
* Conduct feasibility analysis, ROI, IRR, NPV and payback period calculations.
* Assess working capital requirements and project cash flow.
* Evaluate capital expenditure and investment proposals.
* Identify opportunities to improve EBITDA and PAT margins.
* Assess financial risks associated with large government contracts.
* Work with Finance and Accounts to develop financial performance dashboards.
* Evaluate acquisitions, strategic investments and joint ventures.
* Recommend capital allocation based on risk-adjusted returns.

F. Mergers, Acquisitions & Strategic Partnerships

* Identify potential acquisition opportunities in infrastructure and environmental services.
* Evaluate companies, technologies and business assets for strategic acquisition.
* Conduct preliminary commercial and financial due diligence.
* Identify suitable strategic partners and technology providers.
* Develop consortium and joint venture strategies.
* Evaluate opportunities for inorganic growth and geographical expansion.
* Prepare investment memorandums and proposals for management approval.

G. Business Intelligence & Competitive Analysis

* Track government infrastructure expenditure and upcoming project announcements.
* Monitor Central and State Government schemes, including AMRUT and urban infrastructure programmes.
* Analyse competitors’ turnover, order books, project execution and financial strength.
* Maintain a database of upcoming tenders and market opportunities.
* Study industry developments, technology trends and regulatory changes.
* Prepare competitor benchmarking and market intelligence reports.
* Identify emerging risks and opportunities before they impact the business.

H. Organisational Strategy & Performance Management

* Work with department heads to establish measurable annual targets.
* Develop departmental KPIs and performance monitoring systems.
* Establish a structured management review mechanism.
* Monitor strategic initiatives and ensure timely execution.
* Identify organisational bottlenecks and recommend corrective measures.
* Improve coordination between Tendering, Finance, HR, Operations, Legal and Projects.
* Develop systems for management reporting and decision-making.
* Drive a performance-oriented organisational culture.

I. CEO’s Strategic Office

* Act as a strategic advisor to the CEO on business growth and corporate decisions.
* Prepare management presentations, business reviews and investment proposals.
* Analyse critical business decisions and present data-backed recommendations.
* Track execution of key management decisions.
* Coordinate cross-functional strategic projects.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly business performance reports.
* Ensure that major strategic initiatives have clear ownership and measurable outcomes.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

* 10–18 years of overall professional experience.
* MBA in Strategy, Finance, General Management or Operations preferred.
* B.E. / B.Tech with significant business strategy experience will also be considered.
* Experience in infrastructure, EPC, environmental services, SWM, water supply or government contracting.
* Experience in corporate strategy, business development, management consulting or business leadership.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, project economics and investment analysis.
* Experience evaluating large government infrastructure contracts.
* Exposure to business expansion, strategic partnerships and diversification.
* Excellent presentation, analytical and communication skills.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint.

4. Preferred Candidate Background

Candidates from the following backgrounds will be preferred:

* Infrastructure and EPC companies.
* Solid Waste Management companies.
* Water supply and urban infrastructure companies.
* Big Four consulting firms.
* Management consulting firms.
* Corporate strategy teams of large infrastructure groups.
* Investment and business development teams.

Candidates who have worked with companies managing large government contracts and multi-location operations will have an advantage.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Strategy Head will be evaluated on measurable business outcomes.

KPI

Measurement

Revenue growth

Achievement against annual business plan

Order book growth

New orders secured

New market expansion

Successful entry into targeted geographies

Business diversification

Viable new verticals developed

Profitability

Improvement in EBITDA and PAT margins

Tender pipeline

Quality and value of qualified opportunities

Bid conversion

Improvement in successful bid conversion

Investment returns

ROI on approved strategic investments

Strategic execution

Completion of approved initiatives

Competitive intelligence

Quality and accuracy of market analysis

6. Required Skills & Personal Attributes

* Strategic and entrepreneurial mindset.
* Strong commercial and financial understanding.
* Ability to think beyond day-to-day operations.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong business judgement and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to work directly with promoters and senior leadership.
* High ownership and execution orientation.
* Excellent presentation and communication skills.
* Ability to handle confidential business information.
* Strong leadership and cross-functional coordination skills.

7. What We Expect From the Candidate

The selected candidate should be capable of independently answering the following questions:

* Which new cities and states should the company enter over the next three years?
* Which government contracts should the company pursue and which should it avoid?
* How can the company improve its profitability and cash flow?
* Which new business verticals offer the best investment opportunities?
* How can the company build a stronger and more sustainable order book?
* Which competitors pose the greatest strategic threat?
* How can the organisation become more systematic, scalable and professionally managed?
* What strategic initiatives will create long-term shareholder value?

The ideal candidate will be a business strategist who combines consulting-level analytical capabilities with practical infrastructure industry experience and the ability to execute decisions on the ground.

Pay: ₹751,000.00 - ₹2,070,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

* Support management in negotiations, settlements, and dispute resolution.

* End-to-end management of contract labor including onboarding, attendance, deployment, and exit.

**Statutory & Legal Compliance**

* Prepare and file statutory returns, registers, and records within timelines.
* Handle inspections, audits, and queries from labor authorities.
* Coordinate with legal advisors on labor-related cases and compliance matters.

**Government Liaison & Licensing**

* Liaise with various government authorities (Labor Department, Factory Inspectorate, PF/ESI offices, etc.).
* Manage preparation, renewal, and maintenance of statutory licenses and registrations.
* Handle submission of statutory returns and responses to notices.

**Employee Engagement & People Management**

* Plan and execute employee engagement activities to improve morale and workplace culture.
* Support initiatives related to employee communication, welfare, and retention.
* Act as a bridge between management and employees to foster trust and transparency.

**Data Analysis & Reporting**

* Maintain and analyze ER/IR data, manpower data, attrition, absenteeism, and compliance dashboards.
* Prepare MIS reports and presentations for management review.
* Use data insights to support decision-making and continuous improvement.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of labor laws, ER & IR practices
* Hands-on experience in contract labor and payroll handling
* Excellent grievance handling and negotiation skills
* Strong people management and stakeholder coordination abilities
* Proficiency in MS Excel (advanced level) and PowerPoint for data analysis and presentations
* Good communication, documentation, and reporting skills
* Ability to work independently and handle pressure situations

**Educational Qualification**

* MBA / MSW / PG Diploma in HR or Labor Laws (preferred)
* Certification in Labor Laws or IR (added advantage)

title: Learning & Development Specialist
description:
**About Conversive**
Conversive is entering its next phase of growth. As the organization scales, the ability to build capability consistently across teams will become a competitive advantage.
  
  
Today, learning is largely informal and decentralized. Knowledge resides with individuals, onboarding experiences vary across teams, role-specific learning paths are limited, and organizational knowledge is not systematically captured or shared.
  
  
Rather than building a traditional Learning & Development function focused primarily on training coordination, Conversive aims to establish the foundations of a learning organization—one where employees have access to the right knowledge, managers actively develop their teams, and learning becomes an integral part of everyday work.
  
  
This role will build those foundations.
  
  
We are looking for someone who believes learning is more than training. This role is responsible for building the organizational capability that enables Conversive to scale. You will design learning journeys, capability frameworks, manager development programmes, leadership initiatives and knowledge ecosystems that help employees continuously develop the skills required to succeed.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Build and establish the organization's learning capability by creating structured learning experiences, organizing institutional knowledge, enabling managers to develop their teams, and laying the foundation for a scalable learning ecosystem.
  
  
The role is expected to evolve alongside the organization—from establishing core learning processes and repositories in the initial stages to designing role-based capability frameworks, leadership development programmes and organizational learning systems as Conversive grows.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and continuously improve the organization's learning ecosystem by establishing learning governance, learning processes, annual learning calendars and role-based development initiatives aligned with business priorities.
* Design, develop and maintain structured onboarding programmes, role-specific learning journeys and capability development pathways that enable employees to become productive faster and grow within the organization.
* Partner with business leaders and managers to identify capability gaps, recommend learning interventions and support the development of high-performing teams through structured learning initiatives.
* Develop and coordinate manager capability programmes, including first-time manager development, management toolkits, learning resources and continuous capability-building initiatives.
* Curate, coordinate and continuously improve internal and external learning opportunities by collaborating with subject matter experts, external learning partners and digital learning platforms.
* Establish learning measurement frameworks and dashboards to evaluate programme effectiveness, knowledge application, employee participation and business impact, using insights to continuously improve organizational capability.
* Promote a culture of continuous learning by encouraging knowledge sharing, self-directed learning, internal communities of practice and manager-led capability development across the organization.
* Evaluate emerging learning technologies, AI-enabled learning tools and digital knowledge platforms that improve learning accessibility, personalization and organizational effectiveness.
* Support broader organizational development initiatives including competency frameworks, career pathways, succession readiness and leadership development as the organization's learning capability matures.

**What We're Looking For**
**The Ideal Candidate Should Demonstrate**

* A builder's mindset with the ability to create systems and processes from scratch.
* Strong ownership and bias for action.
* High learning agility and intellectual curiosity.
* Ability to simplify complex information into practical and engaging learning experiences.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger organizational objective.
* Collaborative and influential, with the ability to work across multiple functions and levels of the organization.
* Passion for continuous improvement and organizational excellence.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, Business Administration, Education, Learning & Development or a related discipline.
* A postgraduate qualification in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Learning & Development or Business Management will be an advantage but is not mandatory.

**Professional Experience**

* 3–6 years of relevant experience in Learning & Development, Organizational Development, Talent Development or Capability Building.
* Experience in designing and implementing learning programmes, onboarding initiatives or capability development projects.
* Exposure to fast-paced technology, SaaS, consulting or high-growth organizations is preferred.

**Preferred Knowledge**

* Understanding of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies.
* Familiarity with learning technologies, digital learning platforms or Learning Management Systems.
* Working knowledge of competency frameworks, capability mapping and learning journey design.
* Awareness of emerging learning technologies, including AI-assisted learning tools, is desirable.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong presentation, facilitation and written communication skills.
* Excellent project planning and stakeholder management abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word) or Google Workspace.
* Comfortable using AI productivity tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot or similar platforms to enhance learning design and content development.

**What This Role Is Not**
This role is not primarily responsible for:
  
  

* Coordinating training logistics.
* Scheduling classrooms or managing attendance.
* Delivering generic training programmes.
* Acting as an administrative coordinator for learning activities.

Instead, the role is expected to build the foundations of organizational capability by creating learning systems, enabling managers, improving onboarding and establishing scalable approaches to employee development.

title: Global Director of People and Culture
description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.
  
  
Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.
  
  
Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**
Cin7 is an inventory management company with a globally distributed team and customers around the world. People are at the heart of what we do. As we keep growing, we need a hands-on HR leader who can partner closely with our Engineering and Product teams to build a high-performing, engaged culture.
  
  
You’ll be a trusted advisor to technology leaders, bringing HR expertise and a business perspective to how we hire, develop, reward, and retain talent. You’ll work across time zones with the Global People and Culture team to share ideas, practices, and projects that support our people and our goals. You will also lead a small team, providing day-to-day guidance, development, and performance support to your direct reports.
  
  
This is a director-level role with ownership of the people agenda for your teams. This role will have one direct report at launch: the HR Business Partner (New Zealand). You will also work with the Assistant Manager, HR & Administration (Sri Lanka) through a matrix reporting relationship. You’ll be based in Pune or Ahmedabad and will travel approximately quarterly to visit our teams in Ahmedabad/Pune, Colombo, and Dubai.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own and drive HR outcomes and deliverables that support the overall People and Culture vision and strategy.
* Serve as a trusted counsel to Engineering and Product leaders on people matters, including complex employee relations and performance issues.
* Lead global planning cycles such as compensation planning, goal setting, and performance reviews, coordinating closely with leaders to execute them.
* Lead HR projects such as restructuring, reorganizations, and merit cycles, guiding leaders on approach and timelines and supporting them through completion.
* Build strong relationships with business leaders and stakeholders to align HR initiatives with business strategy.
* Anticipate future capability needs and proactively address emerging people challenges.
* Champion Cin7’s values, culture, and employee engagement across your teams.
* Provide clear, accurate people data and analysis to inform decisions and communicate updates to leaders.
* Partner with the Assistant Manager, HR & Administration (Sri Lanka) and the HR Business Partner (New Zealand) to set priorities, share best practices, and support their work across the matrix.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s preferred.
* 10+ years of experience as an HR Business Partner or HR leader across multiple areas of HR ownership.
* Prior experience managing people leaders or HR team members, including across more than one country.
* Demonstrated expertise across HR functions, with experience practicing HR in a global or multi-region capacity.
* Experience leading through influence and working with virtual and global teams.
* Strong understanding of employment relations, performance management, and engagement practices.
* Financial acumen and strong business presentation skills.
* Ability to create frameworks for processes and best practices.
* Team mindset: you roll up your sleeves and help others.

**Tools & Technology**

* Hands-on experience with HRIS platforms such as BambooHR, including deep-dive employee data analysis and benchmarking.
* Experience with performance management systems.
* Confident, everyday use of AI tools to improve HR workflows, analysis, and communication.

**In Return, We Offer**

* Growth opportunities, a team and a support network.
* Flexible working
* Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
* Social events and many opportunities to build your local, regional and global community
* Customer Volunteer Days
* Recruitment referral bonus
* A diverse and global team, where everyone helps solve problems.
* A culture that is owned by all of us

**Why CIN7?**
CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.
  
  
At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.
  
  
***We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team.***
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Engineer, cloud security and Infrastructure Security
description:
**Job Description**

**Senior Engineer, Pune/Chennai**

NIQ is seeking a highly skilled **Senior Engineer, Cybersecurity** to join our growing cybersecurity team. In this role, you will be responsible for evaluating, deploying, and managing tools, processes, and procedures to secure cloud applications across multiple platforms, including **Microsoft Azure, AWS, and GCP**. The successful candidate will be proficient in **Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM)**, **Cloud Workload Protection Platforms (CWPP), and Cloud Native Application Protection Platforms (CNAPP)** technologies. Additionally, you will be responsible for collaborating with teams across geographies and playing a key role in securing cloud infrastructure within a multi-national environment.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Deploy, manage, and optimize** cloud security technologies, including CWPP, CNAPP, and CSPM solutions, to secure cloud platforms and applications.
* Partner with the cloud platform and app security teams to implement security controls aligned with business operations.
* **Provide security recommendations for cloud IaaS/PaaS/SaaS architecture roadmaps**, including baseline security controls and hardening requirements.
* Define and enforce **security guardrails** that protect workloads while maintaining deployment agility.
* Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and security teams to identify vulnerabilities, implement security controls, and ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
* Automate security monitoring, and **infrastructure-as-code (IaC)** validation using tools such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Terraform, and Kubernetes.
* Collaborate with the **Security Operations Center** to define monitoring requirements for cloud-based systems and applications.
* Drive cloud security best practices across Azure/AWS environments, including identity management, secrets management, workload protection, and secure configuration baselines.
* Partner with architecture teams on **Web Application Firewall (WAF)** and API security protection patterns.
* Contribute to the **security champions program** by providing expertise and training on cloud infrastructure security.
* Assist in **design and architecture discussions**, ensuring that security is embedded in the design of cloud infrastructure.
* Apply **hands-on experience with container technologies**, such as **Docker** and **Kubernetes**, to address security concerns related to containerized environments.

  
**Qualifications**  

* **Bachelor's degree in computer science**, Information Systems, or a related technical field; equivalent work experience will be considered.
* **6-8 years** of experience in cybersecurity with a focus on cloud security and infrastructure.
* Proficiency in deploying and managing **CWPP, CNAPP, and CSPM** technologies.
* Expertise **cloud technologies**, including **container technologies**, virtualization, and orchestration within multi-cloud environments.
* Experience with **CI/CD pipelines** and tools such as Bitbucket, Gitlab, Jenkins, and Terraform.
* Experience in **infrastructure-as-code (IaC)** validation using tools such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Terraform, and Kubernetes
* Strong experience in managing **cloud security tools** such as **Wiz, Orca Security, or Palo Alto Prisma**.
* Strong knowledge of CASB and SSPM tools
* Familiarity with **cloud security best practices** and industry frameworks (Zero Trust, passwordless authentication, secrets management, etc.).
* Certifications such as **AZ-500: Microsoft Azure Security**, **AWS Certified Security – Specialty**, or **GCP certifications** are a plus.
* **Strong problem-solving and analytical skills**, capable of addressing complex security challenges with innovative solutions.
* **Self-starter** with a passion for technology, cybersecurity, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated engagement in **security conferences, training, and continuous learning** is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work in a global, matrixed environment.

**Our Benefits**

title: Executive – Global Partnerships & Programs
description:
**Role Objective**

The International Partnership Executive will be responsible for developing and managing strategic partnerships with foreign universities, higher education institutions, international organisations, industry bodies and corporate partners across South Asia, the Middle East and other global markets.

The primary responsibility will be to identify international collaboration opportunities, establish institutional relationships, negotiate partnerships and execute EduSkills International programmes, including Student Immersion Programs, Global Internship Programs, Global Leadership Programs and HR Global Programs.

The role requires an individual with strong international communication, partnership development, business development and programme coordination skills who can build a sustainable global education and talent ecosystem.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

A. International Strategic Partnerships

* Identify and establish partnerships with foreign universities, colleges, educational institutions and international organisations.
* Develop institutional relationships across South Asia, the Middle East, Southeast Asia and other emerging international markets.
* Identify potential universities and strategic partners for academic, cultural, research and industry collaborations.
* Initiate communication with international university leadership, international relations offices, professors and institutional representatives.
* Arrange virtual and physical meetings, institutional visits and partnership discussions.
* Negotiate collaboration terms, MoUs, partnership agreements and programme execution frameworks.
* Build and maintain long-term relationships with international stakeholders.

B. International Programme Development & Execution

Drive partnerships and coordinate the execution of EduSkills International programmes, including:

1. Student Immersion Programs

* Develop short-term international immersion opportunities for Indian students.
* Coordinate with foreign universities for academic sessions, campus visits, industry exposure and cultural experiences.
* Develop programme itineraries, schedules, institutional engagements and participation plans.
* Coordinate student nominations, registrations and programme execution.

2. Global Internship Programs

* Establish partnerships with international companies, universities and organisations to facilitate global internship opportunities.
* Identify internship domains and opportunities for students.
* Coordinate with international partners for internship placements, mentorship and project-based learning.
* Monitor programme delivery and student participation.

3. Global Leadership Programs

* Develop international leadership and executive learning programmes for students, faculty and institutional leaders.
* Collaborate with foreign universities and industry experts to organise leadership programmes, international conferences and executive interactions.
* Coordinate international exposure visits, leadership sessions and cross-border knowledge-sharing initiatives.

4. HR Global Programs

* Develop international engagement opportunities for HR professionals, CHROs and Talent Acquisition leaders.
* Establish partnerships with international HR associations, universities and corporate organisations.
* Coordinate global HR summits, leadership roundtables, HR exchange programmes and international networking sessions.
* Facilitate cross-border HR knowledge exchange and corporate collaborations.

C. Business Development & Partnership Acquisition

* Identify new international markets and opportunities for EduSkills International.
* Develop strategic proposals and partnership presentations for foreign universities and organisations.
* Convert institutional leads into active partnerships and programme engagements.
* Explore revenue-generating international programmes and institutional collaboration opportunities.
* Develop partnership models, programme pricing and commercial proposals in coordination with management.
* Drive international programme participation through EduSkills' network of 1,000+ Member Higher Education Institutions in India.

D. International Stakeholder & Relationship Management

* Serve as the primary point of contact for international university and institutional partners.
* Coordinate with Indian universities and institutions to facilitate international programme participation.
* Maintain regular communication with international stakeholders across different time zones.
* Coordinate institutional delegations, international visits, meetings and signing ceremonies.
* Ensure effective post-partnership engagement and long-term relationship management.

E. Programme Operations & Coordination

* Coordinate end-to-end execution of international programmes.
* Work with internal academic, operations, marketing and finance teams.
* Coordinate programme documentation, student nominations, travel schedules, accommodation and other logistical requirements.
* Track programme timelines, deliverables, participation and partner commitments.
* Prepare partnership progress reports and programme performance reports.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate/Postgraduate in International Business, Business Administration, Management, International Relations or related disciplines.
* 2–5 years of experience in international partnerships, institutional relations, business development or education consulting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong presentation, negotiation and relationship-building abilities.
* Experience in communicating with international universities, foreign institutions and corporate stakeholders.
* Understanding of international education, student mobility, academic collaborations and global internship programmes.
* Ability to develop partnership proposals, presentations, MoUs and commercial agreements.
* Strong coordination, planning and programme management skills.
* Willingness to travel internationally and domestically as required.
* Proficiency in MS Office, PowerPoint, Excel, LinkedIn and CRM tools.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person
