title: Senior Executive Human Resources
description:
About the Company

Outhouse is one of India's leading bridge-to-luxury jewellery and accessories brands,

celebrated for its bold design language, exceptional craftsmanship, and global vision.

Founded by sisters Kaabia and Sasha Grewal, Outhouse has established a strong presence

across retail, e-commerce, and international markets.

As we continue to scale globally, we're looking for an exceptional People Leader to help

shape the next chapter of our growth. This is an opportunity to build a high-performing

organization, strengthen our culture, and partner directly with the founders in creating an

environment where exceptional people thrive.

Position: Senior Executive – HR ( Operations, Recruitment & People Support)

Reporting To :Senior HR Manager / HR Business Partner

Location: Gurgaon

Experience : 2–4 years of relevant HR experience, preferably within retail, luxury, fashion,

lifestyle, D2C, e-commerce or consumer-facing organizations.

About the Role:

At Outhouse, you'll have the opportunity to build something meaningful.

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive & execution-driven HR professional who

can support the day-to-day people function while taking strong ownership of Talent

Acquisition and HR Operations.

The role requires someone who understands the pace and talent requirements of a growing

D2C and luxury business and is comfortable managing recruitment across corporate, e-

commerce, marketing, creative, retail and support functions.

The role will work closely with the Senior HR Manager / HRBP and will be responsible for

ensuring seamless execution across recruitment, onboarding, employee lifecycle

management, HR operations, performance management coordination, employee

engagement, HR reporting and people processes

The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable coordinating multiple recruitments,

managing employee documentation, following up with managers, maintaining accurate HR

data and ensuring that HR processes are closed on time.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Talent Acquisition – Key Priority

Talent Acquisition will be one of the most important responsibilities of this role.

The candidate will:

* Manage end-to-end recruitment support across corporate, retail and D2C functions.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, recruitment consultants, references and other relevant platforms.
* Build candidate pipelines for recurring and critical positions.
* Understand hiring requirements across: E-commerce, Digital Marketing, Performance Marketing, Brand Marketing, CRM, Merchandising, Retail, Creative / Content / Graphic designers , Operations, Finance and Support Functions
* Screen profiles and conduct first-level candidate assessments.
* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and leadership.
* Ensure quick and disciplined follow-up with candidates.
* Maintain accurate recruitment trackers and hiring dashboards.
* Track offer-to-join ratio, interview conversion, source effectiveness and time-to-hire.
* Coordinate references and pre-employment checks.
* Support offer discussions, documentation and joining closure.
* Maintain an active talent pool for future positions.
* Support employer branding and recruitment communication where required. The candidate should understand that hiring for a D2C / luxury business requires strong judgment around both capability and brand fit.

2. Recruitment MIS & Tracker Management

The candidate must be highly disciplined with data and trackers.

They will be responsible for maintaining:

* Open Positions Tracker
* Recruitment Pipeline Tracker
* Candidate Interview Tracker
* Offer Tracker
* Offer-to-Join Tracker
* Recruitment TAT Tracker
* Source-wise Hiring Tracker
* Hiring Manager Feedback Tracker
* Consultant / Agency Tracker
* Upcoming Manpower Requirement Tracker

All trackers must be updated consistently and shared through structured weekly reporting.

3. HR MIS & People Analytics / Weekly HR MIS , Dashboard & Monthly HR Reporting

Maintain accurate and updated HR MIS across the organization, including:

* Employee Master
* Current Headcount Tracker
* Department-wise Manpower Tracker
* Joining Tracker
* Open positions / Recruitment TAT
* Exit Tracker
* Attrition Tracker
* Attendance Tracker
* Leave Tracker
* Probation / Confirmation Tracker
* Contract Renewal Tracker
* Appraisal / PMS Tracker
* Training Tracker
* Employee Engagement Calendar
* HR Action Tracker
* Maintain HR trackers and Calendar / PJP planners.
* Weekly HR Dashboard
* Monthly HR MIS
* Highlight delays, risks and pending actions proactively rather than waiting for follow-ups. The person should be comfortable converting HR data into simple, clear reports for management review.

4.Onboarding & Employee Lifecycle

* Manage complete Pre -Joining & joining documentation.
* Prepare & issue offer letters, appointment letters and other employee documentation.
* Coordinate employee background verification wherever required.
* Maintain accurate personnel files and HRMS records..
* Ensure all system access, ID cards, uniforms, email IDs and relevant tools are ready

before joining. Coordinate structured induction programs and first-week plans with department heads.

* Ensure new employees understand company policies, culture, reporting structures and expectations.
* Track onboarding completion and collect new-joiner feedback.
* Support transfers, promotions, increments and employee movements.
* Manage resignation documentation and exit formalities.
* Coordinate exit interviews and maintain exit data.

5. Employee Lifecycle Management

Own and coordinate employee documentation across the complete employee lifecycle,

including:

* Joining
* Confirmation
* Probation extensions
* Promotions
* Transfers
* Salary revisions
* Increment letters
* Performance Improvement Plans
* Warning / disciplinary letters
* Resignations
* Exit documentation
* Full & Final coordination
* Experience and relieving letters
* Ensure documentation is accurate, confidential and completed within defined timelines.

6. Performance Management Support

* Support the Senior HR Manager / HRBP in running the Performance Management System.
* Maintain KRA / KPI records and PMS trackers employee performance documentation.
* Coordinate quarterly, mid-year and annual performance review calendars.
* Follow up with managers to ensure performance reviews are completed within timelines.
* Maintain appraisal trackers and performance documentation.
* Support Performance Improvement Plans and employee development plans.
* Assist in maintaining succession planning, high-potential employee and career progression data.
* Prepare relevant PMS reports and dashboards.

7. HR Operations & HRMS

* Maintain the employee master database and ensure accuracy of employee records.
* Regularly update HRMS systems.
* Manage employee personal files and documentation.
* Track attendance, leave, roster and shift data across corporate offices and stores.
* Maintain probation, confirmation and contract renewal trackers.
* Coordinate employee transfers and changes in reporting structure.
* Ensure HR processes and documentation comply with company policies.

8. Payroll & Compensation Support

* Prepare and validate monthly payroll inputs.
* Coordinate attendance, leave, incentives, deductions, new joiners and exits with Finance / payroll partners.
* Ensure payroll inputs are accurate and submitted within defined timelines.
* Maintain salary revision and increment documentation.
* Support compensation benchmarking exercises wherever required.

9. Employee Engagement & Culture

* Support the annual employee engagement calendar.
* Coordinate employee recognition and reward programs.
* Conduct pulse surveys and collate employee feedback.
* Handle first-level employee queries and escalate sensitive matters appropriately.
* Support initiatives that strengthen communication, collaboration and employee experience
* Assist in driving company values and culture across corporate and retail teams.

10. Employee Relations & Policy Implementation

* Act as the first point of contact for routine employee queries.
* Ensure HR policies are communicated and implemented consistently.
* Support grievance documentation and resolution.
* Assist with disciplinary processes and maintain appropriate records.
* Maintain confidentiality while handling sensitive employee information. Support policy rollouts and employee communication

Skills & Competencies

We are looking for someone who is:

* Highly organized and process-driven
* Strong at follow-up and closure
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities simultaneously
* Excellent with Excel / Google Sheets and MIS
* Strong in recruitment coordination and candidate management
* Familiar with D2C and retail talent profiles
* Clear and professional in written and verbal communication
* Confident interacting with hiring managers and candidates
* High on ownership and accountability
* Detail-oriented and accurate
* Discreet and trustworthy with confidential information
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, founder-led environment
* Proactive rather than dependent on constant supervision

Preferred Background

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources preferred.
* 2–4 years of HR experience.
* Prior experience in D2C, luxury, fashion, jewellery, beauty, retail, lifestyle or premium consumer brands strongly preferred.
* Exposure to recruitment across e-commerce, marketing, creative, retail and corporate functions will be a strong advantage.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets.
* Experience with HRMS platforms.
* Strong communication skills in English and Hindi.

!

The Senior Manager partners with leaders worldwide to establish learning and sustainment tools that strengthen leadership capability, leverages AI-enabled coaching and training tools to optimize coaching effectiveness, and applies root cause analysis and program performance gap analysis to continuously improve program outcomes. title: HR Operations & Admin Senior Specialist
description:
**Req ID:**
395368
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a HR Operations & Admin Senior Specialist to join our team in NCR/Gurugram, Haryāna (IN-HR), India (IN).
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced HR Operations & Admin Senior Specialist with 9-12 years of relevant experience to support and enhance global Hire-to-Retire (H2R) processes within a Global HR Shared Services environment.
  
  
The ideal candidate will:
  
  

* Play a key role in driving operational governance, service excellence, and continuous improvement across Global HR Shared Services operations.
* Serve as a trusted advisor and functional expert for Hire-to-Retire (H2R) processes, promoting standardization, automation, compliance, and a consistent employee experience across multiple geographies.
* Partner with HR leadership, COEs, HR Business Partners, Payroll, Finance, IT, Legal, and external vendors to enable efficient HR service delivery, operational scalability, process improvement, and effective governance.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Act as a senior subject matter expert (SME) and escalation point for complex global HR operations and employee lifecycle matters.
* Drive operational excellence, service quality, process consistency, and adherence to agreed service standards across shared services.
* Partner with HR leadership and key stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical service delivery improvements.
* Ensure accurate and timely execution of employee lifecycle transactions across supported countries, in line with defined SLAs and controls.
* Ensure compliance with global and local HR policies, procedures, data privacy requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Establish, monitor, and analyze HR Shared Services KPIs, SLAs, quality measures, and operational performance trends.
* Lead governance reviews, operational audits, and service improvement initiatives, and follow through on agreed actions.
* Identify operational risks, recurring issues, and control gaps, and implement appropriate mitigation and corrective actions.
* Drive service quality improvements through process reviews, root-cause analysis, and preventive actions.
* Lead or support HR system enhancements, user acceptance testing (UAT), change readiness, and technology adoption initiatives.
* Drive automation, workflow optimization, and self-service opportunities to improve efficiency and employee experience.
* Maintain and improve process documentation, SOPs, knowledge articles, and operational controls to support consistent service delivery.
* Develop and analyze HR operational dashboards and management reporting to provide actionable insights.
* Promote and embed best practices across shared services operations.
* Support a culture of continuous learning, accountability, and customer-centric service delivery.
* Facilitate training, coaching, and knowledge-transfer activities for global teams.

**Skills And Experience**
We are seeking candidates with 9-12 years of relevant experience and strong hands-on expertise in Global HR Shared Services. The ideal candidate should possess:
  
  

* Strong functional expertise in Hire-to-Retire (H2R) processes.
* Advanced knowledge of HR operations, employee lifecycle management, and HR administration.
* Experience working with enterprise HR platforms, HR case management systems, workflow tools, and employee self-service environments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively across multiple levels of a global organization.
* Strong reporting and data analytics capabilities, with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with Power BI or similar reporting tools.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment, with a process-oriented mindset and strong attention to detail.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to lead process improvement and change initiatives.
* Proven ability to work cross-functionally and influence outcomes across geographies and functions.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed global environment.

**Preferred Qualifications And Experience**

* Graduate or postgraduate qualification in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline from a recognized university.
* Candidates with prior hands-on experience in both SAP SuccessFactors and ServiceNow will be given preference.
* Prior experience in a Global HR Operations or Shared Services role.
* Prior Global HR Operations experience supporting the MENA and EMEA regions will be given preference.
* Prior experience in HR master data maintenance or employee lifecycle administration using SuccessFactors, SAP, or comparable HR platforms.
* Relevant certification(s) in HR, HR operations, project management, change management, or related disciplines would be an advantage.

Working Hours
  
  

* This is an office-based position requiring attendance Monday through Friday.
* Working hours may be aligned to IST, CET, or EST/CST business hours based on operational requirements.
* The selected candidate must be flexible and willing to work night shifts, where required, to support global stakeholders and ensure continuity of service delivery.

title: Director, Talent Supply Chain Operations
description:
The Company

We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
At the heart of every successful organization is the ability to attract, move, and onboard great talent seamlessly. As our Director, Talent Supply Chain Operations, you will lead the engine that powers that journey.
  
  
This role is responsible for the operational excellence of our talent supply chain—from approved requisition through candidate selection, and from offer acceptance through successful onboarding. You will ensure that every step of the process is efficient, scalable, complaint, and delivers outstanding experience for candidates, hiring managers, and new employees.
  
  
Working closely with Talent Acquisition, People & Culture partners, and business leaders, you will transform how talent moves into the organization by leveraging data, process excellence, technology, and a relentless focus on service delivery.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Lead End-to-End Talent Supply Chain Delivery
  
  

* Own the operational delivery of the talent acquisition and onboarding lifecycle.
* Ensure smooth, timely, and high-quality execution from requisition approval through onboarding readiness.
* Create a scalable operating model that enables the organization to meet its workforce demands efficiently and consistently.

Drive Operational Excellence
  
  

* Lead recruitment operations teams responsible for:
* Requisition management
* Interview coordination and scheduling
* Candidate administration
* Assessment logistics
* Offer management
* Background verification and pre-employment processes
* New hire onboarding readiness
* Simplify, standardize, and continuously improve processes to increase efficiency and quality.

Deliver Exceptional Experiences
  
  

* Create a seamless journey for candidates, hiring managers, and new hires.
* Partner across the People & Culture ecosystem to remove friction points and improve service delivery.
* Champion service excellence through clear accountability, responsiveness, and stakeholder engagement.

Leverage Data and Insights
  
  

* Establish and monitor key operational metrics and service levels.
* Use insights and analytics to identify trends, improve performance, and influence business decisions.
* Drive transparency through meaningful reporting and workforce delivery dashboards.

Enable Transformation and Innovation
  
  

* Lead automation, digitization, and process transformation initiatives.
* Maximize the value of recruiting and HR technologies to create a more connected and efficient talent ecosystem.
* Build operational capability to support future business growth and changing workforce needs.

Lead and Develop High-Performing Teams
  
  

* Inspire, coach, and develop a high-performing team focused on excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Foster a culture where collaboration, innovation, and customer-centricity thrive.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Talent demand is fulfilled with speed, quality, and consistency.
* Hiring managers and candidates experience a seamless and highly effective recruitment journey.
* New hires arrive ready, engaged, and set up for success from day one.
* Operational performance is measured, transparent, and continuously improving.
* Processes are scalable, compliant, and enabled by smart technology solutions.
* Teams are empowered to deliver exceptional outcomes while continuously raising the bar.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Significant leadership experience in Talent Acquisition Operations, Talent Delivery, HR Shared Services, Recruitment Operations, or Workforce Delivery.
* Proven ability to lead large-scale operational teams and complex service delivery environments.
* Strong expertise in process optimization, operational governance, and performance management.
* A data-driven mindset with the ability to translate insights into action.
* Experience leading transformation, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Exceptional stakeholder management, influencing, and leadership capabilities.
* Passion for creating outstanding employees and candidate experiences.

Why Join Us?
  
  
This is an opportunity to shape the future of talent delivery on a scale. You'll lead a critical function that directly impacts business growth, workforce capability, and employee experience while building a best-in-class talent supply chain that helps our organization thrive.

* Ensure adherence to employment regulations, internal policies, data privacy requirements, and control standards.
* Maintain strong operational governance and audit readiness.

Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Develop strong partnerships with:
* HR Business Partners
* Centers of Excellence
* Talent Supply Chain teams
* Payroll Operations
* Technology teams
* Legal and Compliance functions

People Leadership
  
  

* Lead and develop a team of operations leaders and HR professionals.

* Drive talent development, succession planning, and organizational effectiveness across the operations function.

Scope

* Candidate Management
* Pre-Employment Processes
* Onboarding

Manages multiple projects collaboratively. Works with HR in recruitment and performance appraisal process. Mentor the team members and layout their growth path.

Leads the execution and operationalization of enterprise AI initiatives, ensuring AI strategy is translated into scalable, business-impacting solutions. Partners across business and technology teams to drive delivery, adoption, and measurable outcomes, while maintaining strong alignment to enterprise priorities and governance. Acts as a senior program leader with end-to-end accountability for execution, value realization, and executive alignment across priority AI initiatives

**Key Responsibilities**

**1) Enterprise AI Execution & Operationalization:** Translate enterprise AI strategy into actionable roadmaps, delivery plans, and implementation milestones**.** Drive end-to-end execution of priority AI initiatives across multiple business areas. Ensure AI solutions move from concept to pilot to scaled deployment, and ultimately to sustained adoption. Own delivery outcomes across initiatives, including scope, timelines, and measurable business impact.

**2) Program & Portfolio Delivery:** Lead a portfolio of AI use cases and programs across the enterprise. Establish and manage delivery discipline (prioritization, dependencies, timelines, risk mitigation). Ensure outcomes are tied to clear business value (e.g., productivity, growth, cost, risk). Drive integrated program plans, track KPIs and milestones, and proactively manage risks, dependencies, and execution challenges, escalating as needed.

Partner with HR / change / comms teams to support workflow integration and behavior change. Ensure value realization is clearly defined, tracked, and communicated, with a focus on measurable outcomes.

Support approval processes and risk assessments for AI deployments. Ensure alignment to the enterprise AI operating model, embedding best practices across data, technology, risk, talent, and change management.

**Job description**

Requisition ID: 1756717

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Assistant Director - Total Rewards Rank**

If you are looking for a challenging and rewarding career experience as a Total Rewards professional in a high-growth organization, we have a role here. In EY GDS we value wellbeing, curiosity and agility as an individual. We create teams of inspiring, teaming and belonging. We care for our business, society and client. Our purpose is building a better working world. Does that resonate with you? We look forward to working with you.

  

**The opportunity**

The Assistant Director – Recognition will be responsible for the end-to-end management, governance and continuous evolution of recognition programs across GDS locations. The role will combine strategic program ownership with strong operational governance to ensure recognition programs are effectively designed, delivered, governed and continuously improved.

The role will partner closely with Total Rewards, Talent, business leadership, Finance, Payroll, Technology, Procurement, Risk and other stakeholders across GDS locations to deliver a consistent, compliant and positive employee experience, while accommodating applicable local requirements and practices.

The incumbent will also play a key role in advancing the recognition agenda through **technology transformation, automation, analytics, employee engagement and change management**, while ensuring fiscal discipline and effective utilization of program budgets.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* **Recognition Operations:** Own end-to-end administration and seamless delivery of recognition programs, ensuring timely and effective execution across applicable GDS locations.
* **Tool & Technology Management:** Manage recognition platforms, including enhancements, testing, issue resolution and adoption, while identifying opportunities for automation and improved user experience.
* **Campaigns & Engagement:** Design and execute recognition campaigns to increase awareness, participation and engagement, helping strengthen a culture of timely and meaningful appreciation.
* **Policy & Governance:** Manage recognition policies, program guidelines, process controls and periodic updates, ensuring appropriate governance and consistency across programs.
* **Budget Governance:** Oversee recognition budgets, utilization and forecasting, monitor adherence to approved allocations, and provide relevant updates and insights to stakeholders.
* **Payroll Coordination:** Partner with Payroll and relevant teams to enable accurate and timely processing of monetary awards, including required validations and reconciliations.
* **Dashboards & Analytics:** Manage recognition dashboards and develop actionable insights on program coverage, participation, trends, budget utilization and overall program effectiveness.
* **Benefits Support:** Support benefits-related programs and initiatives, working with relevant stakeholders on program administration, employee communications, issue resolution and process enhancements.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Partner closely with business leaders, Talent, Finance, Payroll, Technology and GDS location teams to ensure effective execution and resolution of program-related requirements.
* **Cross-location Program Support:** Support recognition programs and related initiatives across other GDS locations, facilitating consistency and alignment while accommodating applicable local requirements and practices.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify and drive opportunities for process simplification, standardization, automation and improved employee experience across recognition and benefits processes.
* **Leadership Reporting & Insights:** Provide periodic program updates, insights, risks and recommendations to senior stakeholders to support informed decision-making and future program enhancements.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* A self-starter and initiative taker
* Should be able to tap into local networks to identify Total Rewards program opportunities.
* An individual who is eager to learn and research on topics.
* Team player.
* Work independently. Must be hands-on with high level of energy and professional skills to function effectively and independently in a fast growing environment with diverse stakeholders.
* Must possess strong verbal, written and interpersonal skills for internal presentations.
* Ability to seek out information, clearly communicate information and requests and provide quality advice
* Ability to effectively manage communication and relationships in a highly matrix organization structure
* Demonstrate the ability to highly network and also look for opportunities to attend external forums.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree
* 12+ years of experience preferably in a similar field of Total Rewards and someone who is preferably at a Manager level in the industry.

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong experience in **Total Rewards, Recognition, Benefits or related HR programs**.
* Demonstrated experience in managing programs and processes involving multiple stakeholders and locations.
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing and relationship-building capabilities.
* Experience managing HR/recognition platforms, process improvements and technology enhancements.
* Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting dashboards, budgets and program metrics.
* Good understanding of governance, controls, payroll coordination and program administration.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive initiatives independently in a complex, cross-functional environment.

  

**What we look for**

* Be an enabler of high-performance Talent team.
* Highly detail driven with emphasis on accuracy, coupled with the ability to see the broader/big picture
* Keen interest to invest time for self-learning, seeking opportunities to work on cross-functional HR projects
* Working collaboratively in a team environment
* Comfortable working in a highly matrixed environment

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across eight locations – Argentina, India, Philippines, Spain, Mexico, Poland, Sri Lanka and Hungary– and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manager/Sr. Manager – People Strategy & Organisation Transformation
description:
**Role Purpose**

The incumbent will support the VP – People Strategy & Organisation Transformation in building a scalable, productive and future-ready organisation aligned with the Group’s business strategy and growth objectives. The role will work with business leaders and functional teams to drive organisation design, strategic workforce planning, manpower productivity, people cost optimization, people analytics and organisation transformation initiatives.The role requires a combination of strategic thinking, analytical capability, business understanding and strong project execution skills. The individual must translate business requirements into actionable insights, recommendations and

measurable implementation plans.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Organisation Design & Effectiveness**

* Support organisation design initiatives across business verticals, functions and group entities.
* Analyse organisational structures, reporting relationships, spans of control, layers and role overlaps.
* Identify opportunities to improve organisational effectiveness, accountability, decision-making and operating efficiency.
* Develop organisation charts, role-mapping documents, responsibility matrices and governance frameworks.
* Support role clarity, job architecture and organisation restructuring initiatives.

**B. Strategic Workforce Planning & Manpower Productivity**

* Partner with business leaders to assess current and future workforce requirements against business plans and growth projections.
* Assess resource utilisation, capacity, productivity and capability gaps.
* Compare existing and proposed manpower requirements and identify opportunities for redeployment, role consolidation and improved utilisation.
* Develop workforce plans, headcount projections and manpower scenarios aligned with business priorities.
* Evaluate workforce requirements against relevant productivity measures, such as operational output, service levels,revenue or enrolments.
* Support a structured manpower budgeting and approval framework.

**C. People Cost & Workforce Economics**

* Analyse employee costs across business units, functions, levels and locations.
* Build manpower cost models covering headcount, compensation, vacancies, new hiring and projected workforce expenditure.
* Identify cost drivers, cost variances and opportunities to improve workforce efficiency without compromising critical capabilities.
* Prepare financial scenarios and business cases for organisational changes, hiring plans and workforce investments.
* Track approved manpower budgets against actual expenditure and forecasts.
* Partner with Finance to validate assumptions, quantify financial impact and monitor realised benefits.

**D. Strategic Business Partnering**

* Work with business leaders to understand business priorities, organisational challenges and future capability requirements.
* Translate business challenges into organisation, workforce and capability interventions.
* Prepare decision-support notes and recommendations for leadership discussions.
* Highlight workforce risks, capability gaps, productivity concerns and organisation effectiveness issues during business reviews.
* Establish ownership, timelines and expected outcomes with stakeholders.

**E. Organisation Transformation & Project Management**

* Drive strategic people and organisation transformation projects from diagnosis through implementation.
* Develop project charters, implementation roadmaps, milestone trackers, risk registers and governance mechanisms.
* Coordinate cross-functional initiatives involving business, Finance, People & Culture, operations and other relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor implementation progress, manage dependencies and escalate delays or risks.
* Support change impact assessments, stakeholder communication plans and adoption tracking.
* Measure the business impact and sustainability of implemented changes.

**F. People Analytics & Management Reporting**

* Develop dashboards and reports covering headcount, manpower cost, productivity, workforce mix, vacancies and organisational effectiveness.
* Analyse workforce trends and translate data into actionable business insights.
* Establish consistent definitions, reporting standards and data-validation mechanisms for strategic workforce metrics.
* Prepare periodic leadership reviews highlighting trends, risks, opportunities and recommended interventions.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of workforce investments and organisational changes using data.

**G. Leadership & Capability Strategy**

* Support the identification of critical roles, leadership capability gaps and succession risks.
* Assist in developing frameworks for critical-role identification, leadership pipeline assessment and succession readiness.
* Analyse future skill requirements and capability gaps arising from business expansion, technology adoption and operating-model changes.
* Partner with the HR execution team to translate capability priorities into development plans.
* Support strategic talent reviews and leadership workforce planning.

**H. Governance & Strategic Execution**

* Track strategic people initiatives, leadership decisions and agreed organisational actions.
* Maintain a consolidated view of transformation priorities, progress, dependencies, risks and outcomes.
* Prepare leadership presentations, decision papers, business cases and executive summaries.
* Ensure recommendations are supported by validated data, financial implications, risk assessments and measurable outcomes.
* Maintain confidentiality and sound governance when handling workforce information and organisational decisions.

**Key Deliverables**

* Organisation Effectiveness Review: assessment of structures, reporting relationships, layers, spans and role overlaps.
* Strategic Workforce Plan: current workforce assessment, projected requirements, capability gaps and future manpower scenarios.
* Manpower Cost & Productivity Dashboard: consolidated view of headcount, workforce expenditure, productivity indicators and budget variances.
* Workforce Business Cases: data-backed recommendations for resource deployment, hiring priorities, restructuring and productivity improvement.
* Organisation Transformation Tracker: milestones, accountable owners, dependencies, risks and realised outcomes.
* Leadership Workforce Review: insights on critical roles, leadership gaps, succession risks and future capability requirements.
* Strategic Decision Papers: concise recommendations supported by analysis and implementation plans.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Timely completion of organisation and workforce assessments for identified business units.
* Accuracy and reliability of manpower, compensation cost and productivity analysis.
* Quality and action-ability of workforce planning recommendations.
* Timely preparation of workforce budgets, forecasts and management dashboards.
* Progress against approved organisation transformation milestones.
* Quantified financial benefits and productivity improvements from implemented initiatives.
* Adoption and effectiveness of agreed organisation design and workforce interventions.
* Stakeholder satisfaction with the quality of analysis, recommendations and project delivery.

Performance targets will be agreed with the reporting manager based on business priorities and the availability of reliable baseline data.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, Finance or a relateddiscipline.
* 6–10 years of relevant experience in organisation development, workforce planning, people strategy, HR transformation, management consulting, business analysis or a related field.
* Experience in organisation design, manpower planning, productivity analysis, workforce budgeting or transformation project management.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders and translating business requirements into structured recommendations.
* Experience in a multi-business, multi-location or rapidly scaling organisation is an advantage.
* Exposure to consulting, business transformation or financial modelling is preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strategic thinking: connects workforce decisions with business objectives.
* Analytical capability: strong proficiency in Excel, data analysis, scenario modelling and dashboard development.
* Business acumen: understands operating models, manpower economics, productivity and financial implications.
* Problem-solving: diagnoses underlying issues and develops practical, evidence-based recommendations.
* Project management: strong planning, execution, stakeholder coordination and follow-through.
* Communication: presents complex analysis in a concise, leadership-friendly manner.
* Stakeholder management: confident working with senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
* Attention to detail: strong data validation, documentation and analytical discipline.
* Ownership: works independently, manages ambiguity and drives initiatives to completion.

**Role Boundaries**

The position sits within People Strategy & Organisation Transformation and is distinct from day-to-day HR operations.

**Primary focus**

* Strategic workforce planning and organisation effectiveness.
* Manpower economics and productivity analysis.
* Organisation design and transformation projects.
* Strategic people analytics and decision support.
* Leadership workforce planning and capability strategy.

Activities owned by designated HR execution teams

* Recruitment operations and hiring administration.
* Employee lifecycle transactions and routine HR operations.
* PMS administration and appraisal-cycle execution.
* Routine employee engagement and HR service delivery.
* Day-to-day HRIS administration and operational reporting.

The incumbent will partner with HR execution teams wherever strategic analysis or transformation support is required.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a structured thinker who can work with imperfect data, ask the right business questions and turn

analysis into practical decisions. The individual should be comfortable engaging with business leaders, challenging

assumptions constructively, building financial and workforce models, and ensuring that agreed initiatives are implemented.

The candidate must combine strategic orientation with hands-on execution capability and independently manage

work streams while keeping the VP informed of key decisions, risks and outcomes.

**How to apply**

Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter detailing their qualifications and experience at

careers@medhavione.com at earliest possible.

**building HR systems and processes from the ground up**
, while ensuring operational excellence across the complete employee lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

HR Strategy & Leadership

* Lead and manage the complete HR function across the organization.
* Develop and execute HR strategies aligned with business growth and organizational objectives.
* Partner with senior management and business leaders on people-related decisions.
* Establish scalable HR frameworks, policies, processes, and governance systems.
* Build an HR function capable of supporting rapid workforce expansion.

Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning

* Oversee end-to-end recruitment and talent acquisition activities.
* Develop workforce planning and manpower forecasting mechanisms.
* Work with business leaders to understand current and future hiring requirements.
* Establish recruitment processes, hiring SLAs, and workforce productivity metrics.
* Build talent pipelines to support business growth and new client requirements.
* Monitor hiring effectiveness, time-to-hire, quality of hire, and recruitment costs.

Employee Lifecycle & HR Operations

* Oversee the complete employee lifecycle from
  **joining to separation**
  .
* Develop standardized HR processes and SOPs across employee-related activities.
* Ensure effective onboarding, documentation, employee records, transfers, promotions, and exits.
* Establish strong HR service delivery standards and operational controls.
* Ensure HR systems and processes remain scalable as the organization grows.

Employee Engagement, Culture & Retention

* Develop and implement employee engagement and retention strategies.
* Build a positive, performance-oriented, and inclusive workplace culture.
* Conduct engagement initiatives, employee feedback programs, surveys, and recognition activities.
* Identify key drivers of employee satisfaction and attrition.
* Develop targeted interventions to improve retention and employee experience.
* Strengthen communication between employees, HR, and leadership.

Performance Management & Organizational Development

* Design and manage performance appraisal and review systems.
* Establish effective
  **KPI, KRA, goal-setting, and performance management frameworks**
  .
* Partner with business leaders to improve employee productivity and performance.
* Identify high-potential employees and develop career progression frameworks.
* Support organizational development, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives.

Compensation, Incentives & Recognition

* Develop and manage compensation structures aligned with market benchmarks.
* Design and administer incentive and variable-pay frameworks.
* Develop employee recognition and reward programs.
* Conduct compensation reviews and support salary benchmarking.
* Ensure compensation practices are consistent, transparent, and aligned with business objectives.

Employee Relations & Grievance Management

* Manage employee relations and workplace concerns effectively.
* Establish structured grievance-handling and resolution processes.
* Handle disciplinary matters in accordance with company policies and applicable employment requirements.
* Support managers in addressing employee performance and behavioral issues.
* Maintain a fair, professional, and transparent employee relations environment.

HR Compliance & Governance

* Develop and maintain HR policies, SOPs, manuals, and governance frameworks.
* Ensure compliance with applicable employment laws and statutory requirements.
* Establish appropriate HR controls, documentation, and audit processes.
* Maintain accurate and confidential employee records.
* Monitor changes in employment regulations and ensure necessary policy updates.

HR Analytics & Reporting

* Establish and monitor key HR metrics and dashboards.
* Track
  **attrition, hiring, absenteeism, productivity, employee engagement, retention, and workforce costs**
  .
* Provide actionable HR insights and reports to senior management.
* Analyse workforce trends and recommend appropriate interventions.
* Use data and analytics to support people-related business decisions.

Business Partnering & Organizational Growth

* Act as a strategic HR partner to business leaders and functional heads.
* Support organizational restructuring, expansion, and new business initiatives.
* Provide HR guidance during new client onboarding and workforce ramp-ups.
* Develop people strategies aligned with business growth plans.
* Support leadership in building a high-performance and scalable organization.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **10+ years of progressive HR experience**
  , with significant leadership responsibility.
* Proven experience managing HR for
  **500+ employees**
  .
* Strong experience in
  **KPO, BPO, ITES, GCC, shared services, or other process-driven organizations**

* Experience supporting international operations or clients, particularly in the
  **USA, UK, Canada, or Australia**
  .
* Strong understanding of HR operations, employee engagement, retention, performance management, and workforce planning.
* Experience designing and implementing HR policies, SOPs, systems, and processes.
* Strong understanding of HR analytics, workforce metrics, and reporting.
* Excellent leadership, communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

title: Regional Retail Trainer
description:
**Regional Trainer - Job description**

The Regional Retail Trainer - is responsible for implementing and driving the retail training strategy. This role will focus on enhancing the capabilities of our retail staff, promoting brand standards, ensuring consistency in product knowledge, and improving sales performance. The Regional Retail Trainer will work closely with store managers, staff, and leadership teams to deliver effective training programs that elevate the overall customer experience and achieve business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Training Development & Delivery:**

* Conduct on-site and virtual training sessions for retail teams across region, focusing on product knowledge, customer service, sales techniques, and brand values.
* Conduct Residential NHT (6 days) program for at-least 3 weeks in a month

* Organize and lead regional training workshops, webinars, and one-on-one coaching sessions.

title: Global Director of People and Culture
description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.
  
  
Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.
  
  
Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**
Cin7 is an inventory management company with a globally distributed team and customers around the world. People are at the heart of what we do. As we keep growing, we need a hands-on HR leader who can partner closely with our Engineering and Product teams to build a high-performing, engaged culture.
  
  
You’ll be a trusted advisor to technology leaders, bringing HR expertise and a business perspective to how we hire, develop, reward, and retain talent. You’ll work across time zones with the Global People and Culture team to share ideas, practices, and projects that support our people and our goals. You will also lead a small team, providing day-to-day guidance, development, and performance support to your direct reports.
  
  
This is a director-level role with ownership of the people agenda for your teams. This role will have one direct report at launch: the HR Business Partner (New Zealand). You will also work with the Assistant Manager, HR & Administration (Sri Lanka) through a matrix reporting relationship. You’ll be based in Pune or Ahmedabad and will travel approximately quarterly to visit our teams in Ahmedabad/Pune, Colombo, and Dubai.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own and drive HR outcomes and deliverables that support the overall People and Culture vision and strategy.
* Serve as a trusted counsel to Engineering and Product leaders on people matters, including complex employee relations and performance issues.
* Lead global planning cycles such as compensation planning, goal setting, and performance reviews, coordinating closely with leaders to execute them.
* Lead HR projects such as restructuring, reorganizations, and merit cycles, guiding leaders on approach and timelines and supporting them through completion.
* Build strong relationships with business leaders and stakeholders to align HR initiatives with business strategy.
* Anticipate future capability needs and proactively address emerging people challenges.
* Champion Cin7’s values, culture, and employee engagement across your teams.
* Provide clear, accurate people data and analysis to inform decisions and communicate updates to leaders.
* Partner with the Assistant Manager, HR & Administration (Sri Lanka) and the HR Business Partner (New Zealand) to set priorities, share best practices, and support their work across the matrix.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s preferred.
* 10+ years of experience as an HR Business Partner or HR leader across multiple areas of HR ownership.
* Prior experience managing people leaders or HR team members, including across more than one country.
* Demonstrated expertise across HR functions, with experience practicing HR in a global or multi-region capacity.
* Experience leading through influence and working with virtual and global teams.
* Strong understanding of employment relations, performance management, and engagement practices.
* Financial acumen and strong business presentation skills.
* Ability to create frameworks for processes and best practices.
* Team mindset: you roll up your sleeves and help others.

**Tools & Technology**

* Hands-on experience with HRIS platforms such as BambooHR, including deep-dive employee data analysis and benchmarking.
* Experience with performance management systems.
* Confident, everyday use of AI tools to improve HR workflows, analysis, and communication.

**In Return, We Offer**

* Growth opportunities, a team and a support network.
* Flexible working
* Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
* Social events and many opportunities to build your local, regional and global community
* Customer Volunteer Days
* Recruitment referral bonus
* A diverse and global team, where everyone helps solve problems.
* A culture that is owned by all of us

**Why CIN7?**
CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.
  
  
At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.
  
  
***We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team.***
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Compliance Consultant
description:
**Job Role:**

We are seeking a highly organised, detail-driven
**Senior Compliance Consultant**
to oversee and enhance all compliance processes related to candidate onboarding, contract management, and client due diligence. This role is critical in ensuring that we maintain the highest standards of legal, contractual, and operational compliance while delivering a seamless experience to candidates and clients.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in recruitment compliance, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple workflows in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Candidate Onboarding & Compliance Checks**

* Conduct end-to-end compliance checks before candidate placement.
* Verify ID, Right-to-Work, residency, and professional certifications.
* Complete background checks, references, and employment verification.
* Maintain GDPR-compliant compliance records.
* Follow up with candidates for missing documents.

**2. Contract Review & Risk Management**

* Review client and candidate contracts for accuracy and compliance.
* Identify liability, indemnity, and contractual risks.
* Coordinate with internal teams and legal advisors for amendments.
* Manage contract extensions, amendments, and renewals.

**3. Proposal & Documentation Support**

* Prepare RFPs, supplier questionnaires, and compliance documents.
* Provide accurate compliance and operational information.
* Coordinate with Sales and Delivery teams for documentation.

**4. Contract Extensions & Paperwork Management**

* Manage contract extension paperwork and signatures.
* Update internal systems and maintain audit trails.
* Ensure timely communication to avoid contract lapses.

**5. Client Credit Checks & Financial Compliance**

* Conduct client credit checks and maintain assessment records.
* Support credit control and overdue payment follow-ups.
* Assist with invoices and billing compliance.

**6. Internal Compliance & Process Improvement**

* Review and improve compliance processes.
* Provide compliance guidance and training to internal teams.
* Monitor UK & EU recruitment legislation and regulatory requirements.

**Key Competencies / Experience**

* Recruitment or staffing compliance experience.
* Strong knowledge of UK/EU Right-to-Work and GDPR.
* Good contract review and risk assessment skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and organisation.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Credit checks, invoicing, or credit control experience is an advantage.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.

**Why Join us?**

* Work with clients across the UK and Europe.
* Opportunity to shape and improve compliance processes.
* Collaborative culture with strong support from leadership and delivery teams.
* Competitive salary and opportunities for professional development.

Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership.
  
  
At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.
  
  
**About The Role**
Edwards / Kidde Commercial, business brands of Kidde Global Solutions, Strategic Accounts organization is currently searching for a dynamic Strategic Accounts Manager (SAM) to manage and increase sales of fire alarm, air sampling smoke detection, & emergency call / mass notification solutions to clients in the Data Center / Semiconductor, Hospitality, and Modular Construction verticals. This is a remote field position, and all locations will be considered.
  
  
The primary responsibility of the SAM is to drive incremental solution sales, which are delivered by the Edwards and Kidde Commercial channel partner networks, achieving an annual Sales target by developing, implementing, and executing a Strategic Account plan that achieves or exceeds the vertical segment plan. Experience developing and managing strong owner/executive relationships with C-suite and corporate headquarters personnel, consulting engineers, and general contractors / developers. The SAM must be capable of flexibly pivoting across these verticals, adapting account strategies and stakeholder messaging to address the distinct buying processes, technical requirements, and project delivery structures unique to each segment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Account Management: Build and manage relationships with key stakeholders across design, construction, ownership, and operations to position Edwards and Kidde Commercial solutions in new and replacement projects. Key stakeholders include:
* Data Center / Mission Critical: Engineering firms, hyperscale and colocation owners/operators, and senior design, construction, project, and operations leaders.
* Hospitality: Brand and ownership executives, design and construction leaders, facilities teams, property managers, and design consultants.
* Modular Construction: Modular manufacturers, general contractors, developers, and owners.

title: Partnerships Manager
description:

Zing offers a library of curated strategies, real-time market signals, and one-click execution with targets and stop-losses built in and sent directly to your broker. Whether you're placing your first or thousandth F&O trade, Zing is designed to help traders make more informed decisions.

We are looking for a
**Partnerships Manager**
to build and manage Zing's partnerships with
**creators, influencers, trading coaches, and other partners**

This is a relationship-driven role that combines
**partnership management, business development, relationship management, and customer success**

title: Account Director - FTL LineHaul
description:
**ABOUT LETSTRANSPORT :**

LetsTransport, a new-age, technology-enabled logistics marketplace that aggregates all types of trucks to provide flexible, reliable, and cost-effective transportation solutions across India.

Operational since 2015, we specialize in Intra/Local and Upcountry/Linehaul movements. With India’s largest urban network of connected trucks, we ensure seamless logistics support tailored to your specific needs.

We are proud to be the trusted logistics partner for some of India’s leading enterprises, including:

• FMCG: Pidilite, Dabur, Coca-Cola,Bunge,Nestle + Others

• E-commerce & QSR: Amazon, Zomato, Swiggy, + Others

• Conglomerates & Industrials: Reliance, Aditya Birla Group, JSW, Adani, Exide, Greenply, Godrej etc.

Our tech-driven platform ensures real-time visibility, intelligent routing, and end-to-end fulfillment across every shipment, helping our partners scale efficiently and reliably.

**ROLE OVERVIEW – Why this Role ?**

LetsTransport is building a tech driven aggregation logistics business in India with a vision to

scale to a INR 2500+ Cr by 2030. The demand is there & supply is there but access is driven by

relationships, market knowledge, and execution speed, creating a clear advantage for the

right operator.

This is a pivotal hire !

The SALES NAM – FTL Linehaul will play a pivotal role in this.

He/She will will own end to end, Account Management of given Enterprise Accounts assigned to

him/her. You will leverage your skills, network & client plus market understanding to profitably

scale our FTL Enterprise Clients - turning relationships into revenue & establishing Letstransport

as a trusted player in the client ecosystem.

**Location: Bangalore HO**

**About the role**

You will own a portfolio of our National Enterprise Accounts end to end — revenue, expansion,

service, and commercial health. This is not an order-taking role. You are the single face of the

company to the client, and the single voice of the client inside the company. You will be

measured on how much the clients grows, how many new client locations you open, and how

few problems reach the client's leadership.

**What you'll own**

Grow the existing book

• Increase wallet share at locations we already serve — new lanes, new vehicle types,

new business units within the same client.

• Build and defend annual revenue targets per account, tracked month on month.

• Run structured QBRs with client stakeholders: performance against SLA, cost saved,

volume trends, and a forward plan.

**Open new locations**

• Map the client's full network and identify every city, plant, DC, or dark store where we

aren't present.

• Build the internal business case (volume, pricing, vehicle supply, breakeven) and drive it

through operations, supply, and finance to a live go.

• Own the launch: SLA agreement, first-90-day stabilisation.

**Be the single point of contact**

• One number the client calls, whatever the issue — ops, billing, compliance, new

requirements.

• Own escalations from intake to root cause to closure, with a written RCA back to the

client on anything material.

• Set the internal escalation matrix so the client never has to chase two people for one

problem.

**Commercial hygiene**

• Resolve invoicing disputes — POD gaps, rate mismatches, detention and waiting

charges, unbilled trips.

• Work with finance and the client's payables team to keep DSO and outstanding within

agreed limits; drive collections on ageing buckets.

• Own rate revisions, annual contract renewals, and any diesel or toll-linked escalation

clauses.

**Work the data**

• Build and maintain account dashboards: revenue, contribution margin, trips, fill rate, ontime

performance, placement adherence, cost per trip.

• Bring analysis, not anecdotes, to both client reviews and internal reviews — spot

leakage, declining lanes, and margin erosion before someone else does.

• Knowledge of Excel is non-negotiable

**Work across functions**

• Partner with operations, supply, technology, finance, and legal to deliver what you've

committed to the client.

• Influence teams you don't manage — you'll need to get a vehicle-supply plan or a tech

integration prioritised without formal authority.

**What we're looking for**

• 8–10+ years in key account management, B2B sales, or client servicing — logistics, 3PL,

supply chain, or a related B2B services industry preferred.

• A track record of growing a named account book, with numbers you can talk to.

• Comfortable with senior client stakeholders (Supply Chain Head, CPO, plant and

category leadership) and equally comfortable on a warehouse floor at 6 am.

• Strong commercial instincts — you understand contribution margin, not just top line, and

you know when to hold a rate.

• Willing to travel 10–15 days a month across client locations.

• Bachelor's degree required; MBA preferred but not essential.

• Fluent in English and Hindi; a regional language is a plus.

**How success is measured**

• Revenue growth on the existing portfolio (YoY and QoQ)

• Number of new client locations opened and revenue ramped within 90 days

• Contribution margin held at or above target

• DSO and overdue outstanding within agreed thresholds

• Escalation closure TAT and repeat-escalation rate

• Client retention and contract renewal rate

**What we offer**

- High-growth environment :. A dynamic, collaborative, and entrepreneurial workplace

- Strategic ownership : Shape the core strategy of a fast-growing startup

- Fast-paced, autonomous culture : Operate without heavy layers, with the freedom to move

fast and close deals.

title: Implementation Lead

  **Azure or AWS**
  cloud environments.

Exercise general responsibilities to facilitate the efficient organization of the contract, aligning with contractual terms and conditions. Additionally, focus on enhancing the overall customer experience through effective management and service delivery.

Do you possess all these skills and wish to make an impact in the world of food and technology? Join us now!

Role

* Conduct food wastage analysis and implement cost-optimization initiatives.

* The ability to handle pressure and meet deadlines.
* Flexible and willing to take on any tasks to support team efforts.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills.
* Sound knowledge and experience of working with food, technology and people management
* Result-oriented and accountability
* Proven experience in managing successful teams in a similar environment
* Excellent financial and application acumen
* Self-motivated, agile and ability to adapt to a changing environment.

**Message from CEO:**

Food is an everyday necessity, but the experience around it can influence how we feel, connect, and go about our day. At SmartQ, we see an opportunity to make these everyday moments better, one meal at a time. Our aggregation model, powered by technology and operational excellence, brings together food partners, processes, and people to transform dining experience. By combining these capabilities, we continuously seek better ways to solve problems, improve efficiency, and create experiences that are simpler, smarter, and more human. As we continue to redefine this space, we believe the next breakthrough can come from anyone who questions convention, sees possibilities where others see routine, and brings a fresh perspective to a familiar challenge.

We look forward to welcoming minds who will challenge our thinking and help shape what SmartQ becomes next. We invite you to be that person. Together, let’s make everyday experiences extraordinary.

title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About The Team**
The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  
  
You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.
  
  
You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.
  
  
This role can be based in Delhi, Mumbai, or Bangalore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.
* Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.
* Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.
* Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
* Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.
* Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.
* Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.
* Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.
* Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.
* Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.
* Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.
* Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.
* Have guided enterprise organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact.

ROLE PURPOSE
  
  
The Customer Service Lead is responsible for leading day-to-day customer service operations, supporting and guiding the customer service team, ensuring high-quality customer interactions, resolving escalated customer issues, and driving continuous improvement in customer experience.

+ Resolution Time
+ Complaint/Escalation Rate
+ Productivity
+ Quality Scores
