title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
  
  
Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
  
  
From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
  
  
Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
  
  
Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
  
  
Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
  
  
We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
  
  
But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
  
  
**The Role**
As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will play a pivotal role as the dedicated primary point of contact for all technical and product-related activities post Go-live for our Super Enterprise Merchants. Your responsibility will extend to building and nurturing strong relationships with customer technical contacts, addressing challenges, and transforming them into advocates for our products.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Customer Engagement: Establish and maintain robust relationships with Super Enterprise Merchants, serving as the go-to person for all technical and product-level discussions after Go-live. Proactively engage with customers to understand their queries, conduct hands-on troubleshooting, and ensure timely resolution of technical challenges.
* Technical Expertise: Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of the Razorpay product stack. Report and escalate issues or bugs to the Product/Software engineering teams using tools like Jira, actively collaborating towards swift resolutions.
* Advocacy and Business Alignment: Advocate and drive desired Merchant behavior, identifying opportunities where Razorpay products and technologies can optimally align with the merchant's monetary transaction needs. Act as a subject matter expert, driving best practices with the merchant, documenting technical information, gathering feedback, and contributing to product enhancements.
* Collaboration: Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams on a day-to-day basis, ensuring seamless communication and alignment of goals.

**Skills And Requirements**

* Professional Experience: Previous experience in customer success and/or account management, with a focus on the technical aspects, in a SaaS environment. (Experience in Fintech is a Plus)
* Communication and Presentation Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, coupled with effective presentation abilities.
* Project Management:Strong multitasking and project management skills, showcasing initiative, self-motivation, and teamwork.
* Technical Proficiency:Experience with tools such as Jira, Zendesk, or similar, and a basic understanding of programming (a plus).
* Customer Focus:Ability to discern evolving customer requirements and map them to platform features.
* Organizational Skills:Exceptional project management and organizational skills, especially in coordinating meetings and follow-ups with global stakeholders across multiple time zones and disciplines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience in technical product and SaaS disciplines in a customer-facing role.
* B.Tech/M.Tech degree in Computer Science/Information Science. Technical certifications are a plus.

Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.
  
  
Follow us on LinkedIn & Twitter

title: Salesforce Revenue Cloud- Senior Manager
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Salesforce Revenue Cloud Senior Manager you will lead client-facing work focused on Salesforce Revenue Cloud strategy, implementation, and support across the quote-to-cash lifecycle, helping clients improve operational efficiency and adapt their business applications to changing needs. As a Senior Manager you will lead large projects, advise client teams through complex issues, use sound judgment to decide when to act or escalate, and develop collaborative, inclusive teams that deliver consistent results. In this role at PwC, you will bring together consulting skills, Salesforce experience, and business understanding to guide solution design, support adoption, and translate client needs into practical delivery plans within our Advisory practice, specifically within our Salesforce Consulting Generalist work.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Leading Salesforce Revenue Cloud implementation workstreams across pricing, quoting, billing, and revenue processes
* Advising clients on product-to-cash lifecycle design, recurring revenue models, and consumption-based business operating needs
* Translating business requirements into scalable solution designs using Salesforce Advanced Revenue Management and connected platform capabilities
* Guiding configuration activities, data flow design, and integration planning across sales and revenue operations
* Managing project scope, milestones, risks, and issue resolution across complex client delivery efforts
* Directing teams through ambiguous situations while applying sound judgment to choose when to act or escalate
* Coaching team members through solution design, implementation support, and client delivery tasks
* Validating solution outcomes with client stakeholders and refining approaches based on feedback and business priorities
* Developing clear presentations and storylines that explain process changes, delivery progress, and business impact
* Applying systems thinking to uncover process gaps, improve operating models, and streamline quote to cash execution
* Modeling professional and technical standards while guiding responsible use of Salesforce tools and delivery practices

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 15 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Computer and Information Science,Management Information Systems
* At least one of the following: Salesforce Certified Administrator; additional Salesforce certifications such as Business Analyst, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, or other role-relevant Salesforce Cloud certifications
* Developing Salesforce Revenue Cloud solutions for quote-to-cash processes
* Applying systems thinking to pricing, billing, and revenue workflows
* Crafting client-ready messages across complex implementation efforts
* Coaching teams through ambiguity and changing priorities
* Translating business needs into Salesforce configuration decisions

title: Client Relationship Support Manager
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Job Introduction**
The BCO function will complete tasks currently owned by multiple actors including Credit Analysis Unit, Credit Analysts, and RMs in the management of the first line credit risk responsibilities including structuring, credit analysis and rating recommendation, client credit monitoring tasks, credit terms and docs negotiation with WCMR and clients acting as a single handoff from a RM to the BCO for all C&L tasks, creating a single control point. The function will be client facing and customer service orientated.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the delivery of BCO tasks in line with agreed OKRs, SLAs and KPIs
* Own the end-to-end Credit & Lending servicing journey, ensuring a seamless and efficient process for customers and internal stakeholders
* Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk
* Continuously drive improvement in their productivity whilst enhancing client experience.
* Adopt technology and customer experience improvement initiatives, including alignment to a globally consistent C&L operating model and active participation in training initiatives
* Participate in deal discussions and meetings with clients or credit risk as required
* Strong execution and implementation ability.
* Ability to build and maintain strong relationships across the teams, including credibility with both Business and Risk leaders.
* Protect the Bank by acting as First Line of Defence and adhering to all controls
* Maintain HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit recomentations, along with addressing any issues raised by external regulators
* Demonstrates ability to engage in constructive and consistent dialogue with risk partners, in a manner that effectively balances commercial outcomes and risk management
* Work with the BCO Team Lead to ensure adequate credit risk management controls are built into the operational process and robust MI is in place to track and measure risk against agreed thresholds

**Role Requirements / Education Qualifications / Certifications / Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, or a related field
* Corporate lending experience with strong analytical skills and sound credit knowledge
* Strong understanding of various financing instruments and banking products for Wholesale Banking
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex situations and drive alignment among senior leaders
* Clear understanding of the Group credit risk principles, policies and statutory compliances
* Strong commercial mindset
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization

**Pro-tip :**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Market Deployment & Adoption Manager
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Market Deployment & Adoption Manager to join the Delivery, Deployment & Adoption capability within Haleon's Commercial Digital Services organisation. Based in India, this role is responsible for leading the successful deployment, adoption, and value realization of digital products and capabilities across global markets.
  
  
Operating at the intersection of product delivery teams, market leadership, commercial stakeholders, and change management specialists, the Manager plays a pivotal role in ensuring digital solutions are effectively embedded into business processes and ways of working. The role is accountable for developing adoption strategies, managing deployment readiness, mitigating adoption risks, and ensuring markets realise measurable business outcomes from digital investments.
  
  
The successful candidate will provide leadership across multiple deployment initiatives, partnering with market teams, product squads, Value Assurance teams, and senior stakeholders to drive adoption at scale. This role requires a blend of strategic thinking, operational execution, change leadership, data-driven decision making, and stakeholder influence.
  
  
This position is critical to accelerating Haleon's digital transformation by ensuring markets not only deploy new capabilities successfully but also achieve sustained behavioural change and business value.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deployment & Adoption Leadership
* Lead the deployment and adoption strategy for digital products and capabilities across multiple markets and business functions.
* Partner with market stakeholders, Product Managers, Deployment Leads, and Value Assurance teams to develop and execute market-specific adoption plans.
* Establish deployment governance, success measures, and escalation processes to proactively manage adoption risks and dependencies.
* Ensure market readiness activities are completed successfully and aligned to deployment timelines, business priorities, and operational constraints.
* Drive consistency in deployment and adoption practices across markets while allowing for local market requirements and nuances.
* Adoption Performance & Insights
* Own the measurement and reporting of adoption, utilisation, engagement, and behavioural change outcomes for deployed solutions.
* Develop and oversee dashboards, performance scorecards, and executive reporting that provide visibility to adoption performance and business impact.
* Analyse adoption trends and usage patterns to identify opportunities, risks, and areas requiring intervention.
* Establish leading indicators and success metrics that enable early identification of at-risk markets and deployment challenges.
* Provide actionable recommendations to senior stakeholders based on quantitative data and qualitative feedback.
* Change Management & Market Enablement
* Lead change, communication, and adoption activities that support successful market transitions and behavioural change.
* Ensure deployment plans include effective stakeholder engagement, communications, learning, and enablement strategies.
* Coordinate adoption activities across concurrent initiatives to minimise change saturation and conflicting demands on markets.
* Partner with change specialists and market teams to develop targeted interventions that increase user engagement and capability uptake.
* Champion user-centric approaches that improve the effectiveness and sustainability of digital adoption efforts.
* Stakeholder & Market Relationship Management
* Build strong relationships with market leadership teams and key business stakeholders to understand priorities, challenges, and adoption barriers.
* Act as a trusted advisor to markets on deployment readiness, adoption performance, and value realization opportunities.
* Facilitate governance forums, deployment reviews, and stakeholder discussions to ensure alignment and effective decision making.
* Influence senior stakeholders to drive accountability for adoption outcomes and ensure business ownership of change initiatives.
* Escalate and resolve deployment and adoption challenges that may impact business outcomes or programme objectives.
* Value Realisation & Continuous Improvement
* Ensure adoption strategies are aligned with business value targets and expected benefits from digital investments.
* Monitor adoption performance against value KPIs and identify areas of value leakage or underperformance.
* Partner with Value Assurance teams to define corrective actions and intervention plans where benefits are not being realised.
* Lead continuous improvement efforts by capturing lessons learned and embedding best practices across deployments.
* Drive feedback loops between markets, deployment teams, and product squads to improve future releases and deployment approaches.
* Team Leadership & Capability Development
* Provide leadership, coaching, and direction to analysts, deployment specialists, or project resources supporting deployment and adoption activities.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, customer focus, and data-driven decision making.
* Contribute to the development of deployment, adoption, and change management capabilities across the organisation.
* Support the evolution of standards, methodologies, tools, and frameworks that strengthen Haleon's deployment and adoption maturity.

**Qualifications & Experience**
**Basic Qualifications :**

* Significant experience leading deployment, adoption, change management, or business transformation initiatives within digital or technology-enabled programmes.
* Proven experience managing complex stakeholder relationships across global markets and cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights and strategic recommendations.
* Demonstrated experience leading adoption and behavioural change initiatives that drive measurable business outcomes.
* Experience influencing and communicating effectively with senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Strong programme coordination, governance, and risk management capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**
:
  
  

* Experience leading large-scale global digital transformation or deployment programmes.
* Experience within consumer healthcare, healthcare, FMCG, or related industries.
* Knowledge of behavioural science, organisational change management, and user adoption methodologies.
* Experience with adoption analytics and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery models, product operating models, and value realization frameworks.
* Experience leading or mentoring team members within a deployment, adoption, or transformation environment.

**Job Posting End Date**
2026-11-23
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
  
  
**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
  
  
**Note to candidates**
The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Manager, Agency Sales
description:
**About the Role**

Razorpay Ads is building a commerce media and audience intelligence business powered by Razorpay’s transaction ecosystem. We are looking for a
**Manager – Agency Sales**
to build and scale our relationships with leading media agencies, digital agencies, agency trading teams, and their advertiser portfolios.

This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of
**advertising, data, commerce and fintech**
. You will be responsible for making Razorpay Ads a strategic partner for agencies — helping them leverage Razorpay’s audience intelligence and media capabilities to solve advertiser objectives across performance, customer acquisition, brand building, audience targeting and measurement.

The role goes beyond selling individual campaigns. You will own agency relationships, develop advertiser pipelines within agency portfolios, unlock briefs and budgets, and build a repeatable agency-led revenue engine for Razorpay Ads.

**What You’ll Own**

**Agency Relationship & Business Development**

* Build and own strategic relationships across leading agency networks, independent agencies and digital/performance agencies.
* Develop strong relationships with senior stakeholders across
  **agency leadership, investment, planning, strategy, digital, performance and account management teams**
  .
* Establish Razorpay Ads as a preferred partner for data-led, commerce-media and performance advertising solutions.
* Create agency-level account plans covering priority agencies, key stakeholders, advertiser portfolios, opportunities and revenue potential.
* Drive regular agency engagements, capability sessions, workshops and joint client conversations.

**Advertiser & Revenue Development**

* Identify high-potential advertisers within agency portfolios and build a structured pipeline of briefs and opportunities.
* Work with agency teams to understand advertiser objectives, media plans, campaign challenges and investment priorities.
* Convert agency relationships into
  **active advertisers, repeat advertisers and scalable revenue opportunities**
  .
* Own the sales cycle from prospecting and solutioning through proposal, commercial negotiation, campaign closure and renewal.
* Drive penetration across priority categories including
  **BFSI, fintech, D2C, e-commerce, travel, consumer internet, auto and other digitally intensive categories**
  .
* Build quarterly and annual agency revenue plans and maintain strong visibility on pipeline, closures and forecasts.

**Consultative & Solution Selling**

* Translate advertiser and agency briefs into solutions using Razorpay Ads’ media, audience and data capabilities.
* Position Razorpay’s transaction-led audience intelligence as a differentiated alternative or complement to conventional digital targeting signals.
* Develop solutions spanning
  **audience intelligence, transaction-led targeting, onsite/offsite media, performance campaigns, brand campaigns and measurement**
  .
* Build compelling narratives and proposals that connect Razorpay’s capabilities to measurable advertiser outcomes.
* Partner with agencies to create customized solutions rather than relying on standardized inventory-led selling.

**Agency GTM**

* Build a structured GTM strategy for priority agency groups and their advertiser portfolios.
* Map agency stakeholders, key accounts, upcoming pitches, annual planning cycles and seasonal/festive opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for agency-level partnerships, preferred partner programs, joint pitches and advertiser workshops.
* Develop repeatable playbooks for converting agency relationships into briefs, campaigns and recurring advertiser investments.
* Represent Razorpay Ads at relevant agency forums, industry conversations and advertiser engagements.

**Campaign Success & Account Growth**

* Partner closely with Campaign Management, Product and Operations teams to ensure campaigns deliver against advertiser objectives.
* Stay engaged beyond campaign closure to ensure strong advertiser and agency experience.
* Use campaign results and insights to drive renewals, upsells and larger annual commitments.
* Identify opportunities to expand successful campaigns across brands, categories and agency teams.
* Build case studies and proof points that can accelerate adoption across the wider agency ecosystem.

**Market Intelligence & Product Feedback**

* Maintain a strong understanding of the Indian digital advertising ecosystem, agency structures, advertiser budgets and emerging media trends.
* Track competitive offerings across ad networks, commerce media, retail media, audience platforms and large digital publishers.
* Bring structured agency and advertiser feedback to Product, Strategy and Campaign teams.
* Help shape Razorpay Ads’ positioning, packaging, pricing and product roadmap based on market demand.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role will be measured primarily through:

**Agency penetration:**
Depth and quality of relationships across priority agencies and senior agency stakeholders.

**Active advertisers:**
Number of advertisers activated through the agency ecosystem.

**Quality advertisers:**
Ability to acquire strategic advertisers with meaningful and scalable budget potential.

**Advertiser retention:**
Repeat campaigns and continued investment from activated advertisers.

**Pipeline creation:**
Strength and quality of advertiser briefs and qualified opportunities generated through agencies.

**Revenue:**
Achievement of quarterly and annual revenue objectives.

**Strategic relationships:**
Ability to convert transactional agency relationships into long-term partnerships.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **5–8 years of experience**
  in agency sales, digital advertising, media sales, adtech, commerce media, publisher sales or related businesses.
* Strong existing relationships across
  **media agencies, digital agencies and/or performance agencies**
  in India.
* Demonstrated experience selling digital advertising solutions through agencies and influencing advertiser budgets.
* Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem including
  **Meta, Google, programmatic, publisher media, performance marketing and brand advertising**
  .
* Ability to engage comfortably with stakeholders ranging from agency planners and account leads to Business Heads, Managing Partners and CXOs.
* Strong consultative selling and solutioning capabilities — able to start with a client problem rather than an inventory proposition.
* Strong commercial orientation with experience owning pipelines, negotiations and revenue targets.
* Good understanding of advertising metrics including CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL, CPA, ROAS, reach, frequency and brand/measurement metrics.
* Ability to interpret campaign performance and convert results into a compelling growth narrative.
* Strong presentation, communication and negotiation skills.
* High ownership, bias for action and comfort operating in an early-stage business where GTM playbooks are still being built.

**Strong Plus**

* Experience working at an
  **ad network, large digital publisher, commerce/retail media network, DSP, adtech platform or agency partnership function**
  .
* Existing relationships across leading agency networks and independent digital agencies.
* Experience selling to BFSI, fintech, D2C, e-commerce or consumer internet advertisers.
* Experience selling both
  **performance and branding solutions**
  .
* Exposure to first-party data, audience intelligence, CDPs, clean rooms, retail/commerce media or transaction-led advertising.
* Experience building a new agency channel or GTM motion from an early stage.

**The Person We’d Like to Hire**

We are looking for someone who is
**well-networked but not dependent on their network; commercially aggressive but consultative in approach; comfortable selling what exists today while helping shape what needs to be built tomorrow**
.

The ideal candidate understands how agencies operate, knows how budgets and briefs move through the ecosystem, can open senior-level conversations, and has the persistence and strategic thinking required to turn those relationships into a sustainable revenue engine for Razorpay Ads.

description:

NoBrokerHood is a technologically advanced visitor, community, and finance & asset management platform designed to make life more secure and convenient for gated societies across India. title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer-Trader Voice(Unigy-Cloud9)
description:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to join the IM/Voice/Video Engineering team within Workplace Technology. This role is responsible for the design, engineering, stability, and modernization of mission‑critical trader voice and communications platforms supporting global trading environments. This role provides technical leadership for platforms such as IPC Unigy, Cloud9, and Speakerbus, ensuring high availability, regulatory compliance, security, and seamless integration with trading and collaboration ecosystems. Workplace Technology (WT), part of Enterprise Functions Technology (EFT), delivers critical enterprise capabilities across Endpoint & Mobility, Enterprise Messaging and Collaboration, Voice and Telephony, Security, and Specialized Desktop Services. Within WT, the Voice Engineering team plays a vital role in enabling secure, reliable, and compliant electronic communications at enterprise scale.  
  
**In this role, you will:**

  

* Lead or participate in high level technical concepts spanning technology and business
* Develop specifications for complex infrastructure systems, design and test solutions
* Contribute to the testing of business, application and technical infrastructure requirements
* Drive solutions to reduce recovery
* Review and analyze solutions for cloud security, secrets management and key rotations
* Design, code, test, debug and document programs using Agile development practices
* Design complex system upgrades
* Resolve troublesome trends as they develop
* Develop a long-range plan designed to resolve problems and prevent them from recurring
* Direct the daily risk and control flow of operations, focusing on policies, procedures and work standards to ensure success
* Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues and managers to resolve issues and achieve goals

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* 4+ years of Technology Infrastructure Engineering and Solutions experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.
* Strong hands-on experience with IPC Unigy, Cloud9 Voice, and/or Speakerbus platforms.
* Extensive experience designing, implementing, and supporting Trader Voice solutions, including Ring‑Down circuits such as ARD, MRD, Hoot, and SIP‑based voice services.
* Solid understanding of VoIP, SIP, multicast, low-latency networking, and voice recording systems.

**Desired Qualifications:**

  

* Exposure to voice recording solutions (NICE, Verba, Theta Lake etc.).
* Knowledge of cloud and hybrid voice architectures (private cloud, Azure/AWS integrations).
* Familiarity with ITIL, SRE concepts, and automation frameworks.
* Experience supporting mission-critical, front-office environments in financial services.
* Proven ability to lead complex incident response and large-scale infrastructure changes.
* Experience leading infrastructure modernization or trading floor transformation programs.
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills with ability to communicate effectively with Trading, Compliance, and Senior Leadership.
* Proven experience with platform lifecycle management (patching, upgrades, capacity planning, decommissioning)

* Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for automation and operational efficiency
* Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis (RCA) skills
* Excellent communication skills for technical and leadership audiences
* Ability to collaborate across infrastructure, security, compliance, and application teams
* Experience working in large, regulated enterprise environments

**Job Expectations:**

  

* As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer for the Trader Voice Engineering team, you will own the engineering, stability, and evolution of next‑generation Trader Voice platforms, including Cloud9 and IPC Unigy. The role drives capacity planning, platform upgrades, patching, and vulnerability remediation, working in close partnership with Information Security and enterprise stakeholders.You will provide Level 4 production support, lead controlled platform upgrades through established change and testing frameworks, and oversee technical initiatives to improve resiliency, performance, and scalability.

* Lead the design, build, and support of Trader Voice infrastructure including IPC Unigy, Cloud9, and Speakerbus platforms.
* Ensure 24x7 availability, low latency, and high resilience of trading floor voice services across global locations.
* Own platform lifecycle management: upgrades, patches, capacity planning, and decommissioning of legacy systems.
* Drive adoption of modern architectures, including virtualized, cloud-enabled, and hybrid voice services where applicable.
* Lead problem management activities to eliminate recurring issues and improve platform stability.
* Implement proactive monitoring, alerting, and automation to reduce operational risk and MTTR.
* Ensure trader voice platforms meet regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., voice recording, surveillance, retention, resiliency).

* Embed security best practices including access controls, encryption, and vendor risk management.
* Serve as the technical lead for strategic vendors including IPC Systems, Cloud9, and Speakerbus.

* Provide technical mentorship and guidance to engineers supporting trader voice platforms.

* Drive automation and operational efficiency using PowerShell and scripting.

title: Principal Engineer - Digital Forensics
description:
**About this role:**

At Wells Fargo, a Principal Engineer defines long-term engineering solutions for highly complex business and technical needs across multiple groups or the enterprise. You will translate strategic technology opportunities into technical direction, guide resolution of unique challenges, and provide leadership with insight on significant solutions and emerging technologies.

**In this role, you will:**

* Advise leadership on applications, networks, information security, databases, operating systems, or web technologies for highly complex business and technical needs across multiple groups
* Lead strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise
* Translate advanced technology experience, business objectives, enterprise technology environments, organizational structures, and strategic opportunities into technical engineering solutions
* Provide vision, direction, and expertise to leadership on innovative and significant business solutions
* Maintain knowledge of industry practices and emerging technologies and recommend innovations that enhance operations or competitive position
* Strategically engage with professionals and managers across the enterprise and serve as a technical advisor to leadership

**Required Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of focused professional experience in DFIR, threat hunting, and digital forensics within highly regulated industries (financial services preferred) or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.
* Proven experience leading complex, multi‑team, enterprise‑wide programs in highly regulated organizations.
* Strong knowledge of digital forensics and incident response principles, tooling, and frameworks (e.g., case management systems, SOAR, log pipelines, forensics investigations, event triage).
* Familiarity with SOC and IR functions, threat intelligence, detection engineering, and crisis management.
* Experience with SIEM tools like Splunk , Crowdstrike etc.
* Proficiency with program and project management tools and frameworks (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Smartsheet, MS Project, SAFe, Agile, Waterfall/Hybrid).
* Demonstrated proficiency in Python, PowerShell or equivalent scripting languages with practical experience automating forensic evidence collection, processing and investigative workflows.
* Exceptional communication skills, including executive‑level reporting, stakeholder engagement, and risk management.
* Ability to operate effectively across highly technical and non‑technical domains, balancing operational needs with engineering constraints and business priorities.
* Proven ability to analyze malware and malicious artifacts, including dynamic and static analysis, memory forensics, and identification of persistence mechanisms (formal reverse‑engineering experience is a plus).
* Demonstrated expertise in cloud incident response (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including log analysis, IAM investigations, container workload forensics, and cloud-native security tooling.

**Job Expectations:**

* Perform Tier 3 investigation on critical cyber cases in 24\*7 environment.
* Conduct forensic analysis of cyber incidents including hacking, malware attacks, data breaches and insider threats.
* Identify, preserve, extract and analyze digital evidence from computers, mobile devices, servers, cloud systems, and other digital storage media.
* Use industry-standard forensic tools and techniques (e.g., FTK, EnCase, X-Ways, Autopsy, Volatility, Cellebrite) to uncover evidence and trace cyber attackers
* Lead and execute advanced digital forensic investigations involving endpoint, cloud, network, mobile, email, and SaaS platforms to determine root cause, impact, data exposure, and attacker methodology.
* Design, develop and maintain scalable forensic acquisition and analysis workflows, including custom scripts, artifact parsers, and automation to improve investigation efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Serve as Incident Commander during major security events, coordinating cross‑functional technical teams, legal, compliance, risk, and executive leadership to drive timely containment and eradication actions.
* Conduct threat hunting activities leveraging SIEM, EDR, network telemetry, and intelligence sources to proactively identify indicators of compromise (IOCs), anomalous behaviors, and emerging threats targeting the financial sector.
* Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and standard operating procedures, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements, industry frameworks, and evolving threat landscapes.
* Build and maintain forensic readiness capabilities, including logging strategy, chain‑of‑custody processes, evidence retention standards, forensic imaging workflows, and tooling optimization.
* Collaborate with Fraud, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and internal Audit teams to support investigations involving insider threats, data misuse, fraud activity, and regulatory reporting.
* Perform malware triage and reverse‑engineering (as appropriate) to evaluate malicious payloads, persistence mechanisms, pivot paths, and risk to the institution, providing actionable intelligence to detection engineering teams.
* Drive continuous improvement of detection and response capabilities by identifying monitoring gaps, recommending new security technologies, tuning alerts, and contributing to security architecture reviews.
* Prepare high‑quality written reports and executive‑level briefs summarizing findings, incident timelines, business impact, and recommendations for remediation and long‑term risk reduction.
* Mentor and provide technical leadership to junior analysts, delivering training in forensic methodologies, investigative techniques, threat analysis, tool usage, and incident response best practices.

Experience with Ansible automation

That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. title: Senior Manager, Test Engineering- Networking background is a must
description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

For more information, visit www.sonicwall.com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for an experienced and technically strong Senior QA Manager to own end-to-end quality for cloud applications, cloud security products, and associated services.

This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for defining the quality strategy, driving automation and test infrastructure investments, and partnering closely with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Security, Release Engineering, and Support teams to ensure high standards of reliability, scalability, security, and customer trust.

The role requires a strong understanding of cloud applications and distributed systems, along with good networking and security fundamentals. You will help shape how quality is built into the product lifecycle, from requirements and architecture reviews through continuous testing, release readiness, production validation, and post-release improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Quality Strategy & Release Ownership**

* Define and continuously improve QA and Quality Engineering strategy for cloud applications and cloud security products.
* Establish quality gates, entry/exit criteria, and release readiness standards.
* Drive risk-based testing and shift-left quality practices.
* Define test strategies for new features, platform changes, integrations, maintenance releases, and hotfixes.
* Own QA release readiness and provide quality recommendations for go/no-go decisions.
* Partner with Engineering and Product leadership to identify and mitigate quality risks.

### **Cloud, Security & Networking Technical Leadership**

* Provide technical leadership across cloud applications, distributed services, and cloud security solutions.
* Define comprehensive testing strategies covering:
  + Functional and end-to-end customer workflows
  + REST APIs and microservices
  + Service-to-service communication
  + Authentication and authorization
  + Cloud networking and connectivity
  + DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS/SSL, proxies, and load balancing
  + Security policies and controls
  + Multi-tenant environments
  + High availability, resiliency, and disaster recovery
  + Upgrades, migrations, and backward compatibility
* Review PRDs, technical specifications, and architecture proposals from quality, security, scalability, reliability, and networking perspectives.
* Drive security and negative testing to validate abuse cases, misconfigurations, authorization boundaries, and threat scenarios.

### **Automation, CI/CD & Test Infrastructure**

* Define the automation vision across UI, API, integration, security, and end-to-end testing.
* Establish measurable automation coverage and effectiveness goals.
* Build scalable and maintainable automation frameworks in partnership with engineering and automation teams.
* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Drive improvements in automation stability and reduce flaky tests.
* Promote continuous testing and automated quality gates.
* Define the strategy for cloud-based test environments and test infrastructure.
* Partner with DevOps and Cloud Infrastructure teams on environment availability, scalability, and reliability.
* Explore AI and intelligent automation to improve test effectiveness and engineering productivity.

### **Performance, Scalability & Reliability**

* Define strategies for performance, scalability, resiliency, and long-duration testing.
* Drive testing for high transaction volumes, concurrent users, API scalability, service interactions, resource utilization, failover, recovery, and scaling.
* Establish performance and reliability benchmarks for major releases.
* Partner with Engineering and Cloud Infrastructure teams to identify performance and scalability risks.

### **Execution Excellence & Metrics**

* Own and track key quality metrics including:
  + Defect leakage and escape rate
  + Regression effectiveness
  + Automation coverage and ROI
  + Automation flakiness
  + Release quality and predictability
  + Production incident trends
  + Customer-impacting defects
* Lead release readiness and quality reviews with senior stakeholders.
* Drive root cause analysis for production escapes and systemic quality gaps.
* Convert production and customer learnings into preventive quality improvements.

### **People Leadership & Stakeholder Influence**

* Build, mentor, and retain a strong QA organization comprising leads and senior engineers.
* Lead and scale geographically distributed QA/Quality Engineering teams.
* Set clear expectations, career paths, technical growth plans, and performance goals.
* Develop technical and leadership capabilities within the QA organization.
* Influence Engineering, Product Management, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, and Security leadership to prioritize quality and customer impact.
* Represent QA in leadership forums, customer escalations, incident reviews, and cross-functional initiatives.
* Foster a culture of ownership, engineering excellence, automation, and continuous improvement.

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

* 10–12+ years of experience in software QA/Quality Engineering, with 4+ years in QA leadership or people management.
* Strong experience testing cloud applications, SaaS products, distributed systems, or cloud security products.
* Good understanding of cloud, networking, and security fundamentals.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS/SSL, routing, load balancing, proxies, VPNs, and network security concepts.
* Understanding of cloud networking concepts such as VPC/VNet, subnets, security groups, firewalls, and private/public connectivity.
* Strong understanding of APIs, microservices, distributed systems, authentication, and authorization.
* Experience owning quality for complex software releases.
* Proven experience managing and developing QA teams.
* Strong automation and CI/CD experience.
* Experience with performance, scalability, resiliency, and reliability testing.
* Good understanding of security testing and secure software development practices.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with SaaS and multi-tenant applications.
* Experience testing cloud security or cybersecurity products.
* Experience with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native architectures.
* Exposure to security testing and vulnerability assessment.
* Exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FIPS, or similar compliance programs.
* Experience with observability, monitoring, logging, and production diagnostics.
* Experience handling customer escalations and production incident RCA.
* Experience using AI/ML for test automation, test generation, defect analysis, or quality engineering.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Predictable, high-quality cloud application and cloud security releases.
* Reduced critical customer issues and production escapes.
* Measurable improvement in automation coverage and test effectiveness.
* Faster feedback cycles through shift-left testing and CI/CD integration.
* Improved application scalability, resilience, and production reliability.
* Strong security and quality practices embedded throughout the SDLC.
* Strong QA leadership and technical talent development.
* Improved engineering productivity through automation and modern Quality Engineering practices.
* Increased customer trust through reliable, secure, and high-quality cloud products.

It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com

© 2024 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.

**Job Purpose**
---------------

The Technology Integration Team develops and productizes reusable Color Technology Components that power AkzoNobel’s internal applications and external customer-facing tools, with focus areas in Colorimetric Engines/Building Blocks, Color Visualization, and AI/ML-enabled color services. The AI/ML Researcher owns the delivery of applied Machine Learning and statistical solutions for prioritized color and coatings use cases (e.g., formulation optimisation, pigment/raw material screening, quality prediction, and image-based inspection). The role translates business and R&D questions into well-structured datasets, validated ML models, and clear insights, and partners with engineering and product stakeholders to ensure solutions are deployment-ready, monitored, documented and usable in products and processes. Unlike generalist Researcher roles, this position brings dedicated applied ML/data science capability to the team, owning the end-to-end ML lifecycle from problem framing through deployment-ready model delivery.

**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------

* **Use case shaping & stakeholder partnering**

o Engage with R&D, lab teams, manufacturing and product/application stakeholders to translate needs into well-defined ML problems, required inputs/outputs, constraints, and measurable success criteria.

o Lead or co-lead end-to-end delivery for assigned use cases from discovery and scoping through experimentation, validation, and implementation readiness.

o Communicate trade-offs (accuracy vs. explainability, latency, cost, robustness) and guide stakeholders toward fit-for-purpose solutions.

* **Data preparation, analysis & modelling**

o Acquire, clean, integrate, and analyze data from R&D/lab systems, manufacturing sources, and internal datasets; assess data quality, bias, leakage risk, and suitability for modelling.

o Develop, benchmark, and validate ML models (supervised/unsupervised) including baseline creation, feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter tuning, and robustness checks.

* **Domain application (color/coatings)**

o Collaborate with color formulators, researchers, and lab teams to ensure modelling aligns with domain realities (measurement variability, protocols, material constraints).

o Define and drive dataset design/generation activities (e.g., DoE support, sampling strategy, labeling guidance, protocol awareness) to improve training data quality and coverage.

o Apply practical understanding of relevant color data types (spectral/Lab\*/ΔE and variability) when designing targets, features, and evaluation strategies (as applicable).

* **Computer vision (where relevant)**

o Deliver image-based modelling tasks (e.g., defect detection, surface uniformity, pigment recognition) using classical CV and deep learning methods; define evaluation metrics and acceptance criteria aligned to operational deployment.

o Ensure peer review and alignment with Senior Researchers/architects for high impact use cases and model choices that may affect product/process behavior.

* **Industrialization & production readiness**

o Drive implementation readiness of assigned models: reproducible training/inference code, model artifacts, data dependencies, parameterization, testing approach, and clear runbooks.

o Contribute to MLOps practices as defined by the team: version control, experiment tracking, model registry inputs, monitoring requirements, alert thresholds, and retraining triggers.

o Partner with application/software teams to integrate model outputs into components/services (APIs, batch pipelines, or embedded usage) and support post-deployment stabilization.

**Experience**
--------------

**Educational qualifications**

o Master’s degree (preferred) or Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Operational Research, Engineering or related quantitative field.

**Relevant experience**

o Typically 5-7 years of experience applied machine learning / data science delivering solutions in industrial, manufacturing, R&D, engineering, or equivalent complex environments (or equivalent project portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership).

o Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders (research, engineering, product) and delivering work in an agile/team setting.

**Required skills**

o Strong Python skills for data analysis and ML (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn; TensorFlow/ PyTorch beneficial).

o Solid understanding of ML fundamentals (regression, classification, clustering, model validation, overfitting control) and statistical reasoning.

o Working knowledge of SQL and working with structured datasets; o Familiarity with data pipelines or cloud platforms (Azure/Databricks) is a plus.

o Computer vision knowledge (OpenCV, CNNs/segmentation) is a plus depending on scope.

o Familiarity with Git and reproducible workflows; exposure to MLflow/ experiment tracking is desirable.

o Strong communication skills: ability to present findings clearly and document assumptions/limitations.

o Domain familiarity with color science (CIE color spaces, spectral data, ΔE) is advantageous but not mandatory.

**Mott MacDonald** is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.

We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.

Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be **brilliant**.

**Job Description:**

  

The IT Manager – Change Management reports to the IT Service Delivery Manager and serves as the IT Process Owner for the Change Management process. In this role, you will own the end‑to‑end lifecycle of change management across the IT environment. You will ensure every change is implemented under robust controls, follows a structured and standardised process, and safeguards IT environment stability while minimising risk and reducing service impact.

You will play a strategic role in strengthening governance, managing risk, and driving process maturity. Alongside this core responsibility, the role also engages proactively with business functions, project teams, and operational leaders to help them understand and use the change process confidently and correctly, providing the guidance and support needed to navigate it effectively.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the full lifecycle of the Change Management process, ensuring alignment with ITIL best practices, strong governance, and compliance with audit standards.

* Work collaboratively across the wider organisation, in and outside IT, to help teams understand when and how to engage the change process, ensuring they are supported, guided, and equipped to follow it effectively.

* Prepare, lead, and drive CAB meetings, ensuring structured governance, thorough risk evaluation, and strategic decision‑making.

* Drive accountability across IT and business stakeholders, ensuring ownership of change records, approvals, and risk assessments.

* Assess proposed changes for technical, business, security, and compliance impacts, recommending mitigation strategies to protect IT environment stability.

* Maintain and communicate the Forward Schedule of Change for visibility and alignment across stakeholders.

* Collaborate with the IT Asset and Configuration specialists to ensure accurate CI records in the CMDB for dependency mapping and impact analysis.

* Advance the organisation’s change governance by proactively auditing current practices, identifying improvement opportunities, and evolving the end‑to‑end process to support greater transparency, operational resilience, and readiness for future automation.

* Align Change Management with Release and Deployment practices, ensuring changes integrate seamlessly into DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.

* Lead change communications, ensuring clear, customer‑focused messaging aligned with organisational standards.

* Define and manage actionable KPIs within ServiceNow Platform Analytics to identify bottlenecks, uncover improvement opportunities, and drive automation initiatives.

* Maintain clear documentation including processes, guidelines, and work instructions to support consistent delivery.

* Develop and deliver structured training plans to drive adoption of the Change Management process.

* Research and evaluate emerging ServiceNow capabilities, including automation and GenAI, preparing requirements for future enhancements.

**Personal Attributes**

* Demonstrates ownership while fostering a solution‑oriented, delivery‑focused culture that drives accountability and improvement.

* Organised and proactive, prioritising effectively with urgency to deliver results.

* Self‑manages effectively, quickly grasping complex topics and developing actionable strategies.

* Analytical and process‑minded, applying ITSM frameworks and data insights to deliver outcomes and long‑term service maturity

* Collaborates extensively across the organisation to ensure the Change process is an enabler of the organisations business objectives

* Customer‑centric, committed to enhancing the customer experience and delivering measurable improvements.

* Produces clear, high‑quality documentation that communicates complex information professionally.

* Adaptable and resilient, embracing change while focused on achieving results.

* Communicates confidently, engaging stakeholders with influence and negotiation skills.

* Passionate about technology, continuous learning, and professional growth.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Percentage of changes implemented using approved standard change templates versus ad‑hoc requests.

* Mean time to complete approved changes within their planned implementation window.

* Percentage of changes implemented without causing incidents, rollbacks, or service disruptions.

* Percentage of changes executed via automated workflows versus manual intervention.

* Stakeholder feedback on CAB effectiveness and communication clarity.

**Candidate Specification**

**Essential:**

* Experience managing changes across multiple regions, time zones, and complex organisational structures.

* Strong track record in managing ITSM processes (Change, Incident, Problem) aligned with ITIL best practices.

* Governance and risk assessment expertise, including leading CAB meetings, documenting decisions, and ensuring rollback planning.

* Broad technical knowledge of IT systems and infrastructure (servers, networks, cloud, hybrid) with practical experience in dependency mapping and CMDB impact analysis.

* Ability to influence and communicate effectively with technical teams, executives, and non‑technical stakeholders.

* Proven capability in delivering structured training and producing clear, user‑friendly documentation

* Demonstrated success in evolving the Change Management process, embedding automation, and driving ITIL maturity.

* Experience supporting internal and external audits, ensuring compliance with organisational and regulatory standards.

**Desirable:**

* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher certification.

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) or higher.

* Familiarity with the Service Desk Institute (SDI) framework.

* Experience with ServiceNow Platform Analytics reporting capabilities.

**Flexible working**
  
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.

  

**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working

* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing

title: Technical Account Representative (TAM)
description:
**Oracle Database Consultant**

We are seeking Oracle Database professionals to provide 24x7 operational and advanced support for mission-critical customer environments. The role includes database administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, performance tuning, high availability, backup/recovery, patching, and incident resolution across Oracle Database platforms.

* Administer, monitor, maintain, patch, upgrade, and troubleshoot Oracle Database environments.
* Perform SQL, database, memory, and performance tuning; analyze AWR/ASH and resolve complex performance issues.
* Manage Oracle RAC, ASM, RMAN, Data Guard, Fast-Start Failover, backup/recovery, and disaster-recovery operations.
* Support Oracle GoldenGate, Exadata, multitenant databases (CDB/PDB), Enterprise Manager, and OCI-hosted databases where applicable.
* Conduct database health checks, capacity reviews, proactive risk identification, and operational reporting.
* Resolve incidents within SLA, lead technical escalations, document root causes, and maintain support runbooks.
* Work closely with customer IT teams, Oracle Support, Development, and internal SMEs to drive issues to closure.
* Support database security capabilities including TDE, Oracle Key Vault, Database Vault, wallets, and AVDF where required.
* Provide clear customer communication, technical status updates, and action plans during critical incidents.

**Desired profile:**

* **L3 DBA / SME:** 10+ years of experience with advanced expertise in Oracle Database, Exadata, RAC, ASM, Data Guard, GoldenGate, performance tuning, backup/recovery, and high-severity escalations.
* Experience with Oracle Database 11g, 12c, 18c, and 19c; OCI and Oracle Enterprise Manager experience is preferred.
* BE/BTech/MCA/MS or equivalent experience; Oracle OCA/OCP, OCI, or Autonomous Database certifications are desirable.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, customer-management, and escalation-management skills.
* Willingness to work in a 24x7 support model and travel to customer locations when required.

**Qualifications:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field. Oracle certifications (e.g., OCI , OCA, OCP) are preferred.
* Experience: 8-12 years of hands-on experience with Oracle cloud administration and support.
* Shift : 24\*7 Shift working from Client Site Chennai / Bangalore . No remote or WFH allowed.

**Personal Skills**

* Strong experience in service delivery and/or project management is required.
* Oracle products and services knowledge will be highly appreciated as well as experience in Oracle HW platforms and OS.
* Experience on Enterprise Customers is required
* Excellent communication / relationship building skills
* Customer focused and results oriented
* Ability to work under pressure in highly escalated situations
* Organized with strong attention to detail
* Decision making / problem solving skills
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent activities (customer engagements)
* Highly professional: Ability to deal with senior and exec stakeholders with confidence
* Strong analytic skills and ability to identify potential risks and issues

  

**Technical Skills for an L3 / Senior Database Administrator**

* Advanced Oracle Database administration, architecture, upgrades, and patching.
* Expert performance tuning using AWR, ASH, ADDM, execution plans, and SQL optimization.
* Administration and troubleshooting of Oracle RAC, ASM, and Data Guard.
* Oracle GoldenGate (GG) configuration, replication monitoring, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Advanced RMAN backup and recovery, including point-in-time recovery and recovery validation.
* Database security, including Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), Oracle Database Vault, access controls, privilege management, and security hardening.
* Oracle Audit Vault and Database Firewall (AVDF) deployment, configuration, audit collection, monitoring, and policy management.
* Ownership of complex production incidents, root cause analysis, and preventive actions.
* Planning and execution of database migrations and upgrades with minimal downtime.
* Capacity planning, storage optimization, and automation using SQL, PL/SQL, and Linux/Unix shell scripting.
* Disaster recovery planning, failover testing, and business continuity support.
Technical leadership, mentoring of L1/L2 teams, and review of database changes and operational procedures.  

* **AI & ML Skillset ( Good to have )**
* Python: The core programming language for AI and Machine Learning.
* Essential Libraries:
  + NumPy for numerical computation and array handling.
  + Pandas for data manipulation and analysis.
  + Matplotlib/Seaborn for data visualization.
* ML/DL Frameworks: Hands-on experience with:
  + Scikit-learn for traditional ML models.
  + TensorFlow/Keras or PyTorch for Deep Learning implementations.
* SQL: Proficiency in querying and retrieving data from databases.
* Git: Competence in version control for collaborative development.
* Familiarity with various neural network architectures (CNNs, RNNs, Transformers).
* Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI principles.
* Big Data Tools: Exposure to platforms like Spark or cloud services for handling large datasets.

  **Responsibilities**
* Develop and Manage the Oracle Customer Relationships by forming long term customer relationships with key customer contacts. Work is non-routine and complex, involving the application of advanced technical/business skills in area of specialization. Provides direction and mentoring to more junior team members. Understand customer’s industry drivers, organization structure and key stakeholders, key projects and goals, and critical success factors as well as technical infrastructure and roadmap.
* Work collaboratively with sales, the delivery teams and customers to identify appropriate solutions.
* Coordinate delivery of Oracle Services, operating as the primary delivery contact to the customer, aiding and facilitating customer communications and activities across other Oracle lines of business.
* Responsible for delivering to the contracted terms, effective and efficient use of Oracle delivery resources, achieving the contract margin and revenue objectives.
* Identify and submit delivery leads for new opportunities and contract renewals.
* Act as a point of contact for any major incidents, responsible for managing communication and customer expectations through resolution.
* Establish and maintain a delivery governance model with the customer at the management and executive levels.
* Perform scope and risk management.
* Contribute to initiatives for Oracle delivery organizational process improvement and tool development.
* Conduct periodic Service Account Planning and Account Reviews.
* Be the single point of contact within Oracle for the customer, acting as their advocate for the service you are responsible for delivering.
* The CSS TAM is a customer advocate and must demonstrate customer obsession by placing the client needs first.
* Provide technical guidance and be part of the customer calls/meeting on adoption of database technology
* Should possess strong technical skills on Database and DB products to advocate to customer the use cases and guide the customer and team of Oracle CSS Engineers through the lifecycle of Oracle Technology product adoption
* Manage the contract or delivery engagement as defined by ACS line management, including creating and maintaining accurate documentation
* Maintain the Oracle business systems to ensure systems are up to date with the correct/current information (resource assignment, timecards, rates, completion estimates, invoice details etc.) to ensure that services are delivered efficiently, invoices are generated in a timely manner and revenues are recognised promptly.
* Plan and deploy resources to ensure effective delivery within agreed budgetary constraints.
* Where appropriate create and maintain the ACS service delivery or project plan.
* Actively manage project forecast, identify risks and issues and opportunity for revenue collection (upside)

  **Accountabilities** :
* Proactively manage the contract delivery to completion / customer acceptance
* Proactively report on any potential risks / issues that may impact service delivery or customer satisfaction
* Manage any customer escalation that may arise
* Ensure all contract-related systems and documentation either required contractually or as part of a program, are up to date and accurate
* Monitor and report revenue forecast and margin estimates, revenue and margin achievements for each contract
* Work in line with customer working practices and procedures, if contractually agreed
* Operate in line with Oracle CSS business processes and procedures
* Operate in line with Oracle Global and local HR policies and procedures
