title: Customer Operations Manager
description:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

We're looking for a Customer Success Operations Associate to own the systems, data, and processes that keep our Customer Success organization running efficiently. You'll work closely with the Sr. Customer Success Operations Manager and cross-functionally with CSMs, Renewals, and Onboarding teams to ensure reporting is accurate, tools are configured correctly, and workflows move smoothly. You'll combine solid technical comfort with CS platforms, genuine curiosity about how data connects to customer outcomes, and fluency with AI-assisted tools to enhance data accuracy and reporting efficiency. Independently managing recurring workstreams and identifying improvements as you go, you'll be the backbone keeping our CS operations aligned and data-driven.

**Outcomes & KPIs**
-------------------

**Key Outcome(s) Owned:**

* Accuracy and timeliness of CS reporting and dashboards used by leadership and CSMs
* Reliability of CS platform data and configurations (Salesforce, Gainsight, Zendesk/Intercom)

**Success Metrics / KPIs:**

* Reporting accuracy and on-time delivery of recurring dashboards and QBR data pulls
* Data hygiene metrics across CS platforms (duplicate rate, field completeness, stale records resolved)
* Turnaround time on ticketed requests for tooling changes, access, or configuration support
* Renewal and onboarding milestone tracking accuracy
* Feedback from CSMs and the Sr. CS Operations Manager on responsiveness and reliability

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Build and maintain recurring reports and dashboards (health scores, churn/renewal metrics, CSM productivity, NPS/CSAT) that leadership and CSMs rely on for decision-making.
* Pull and clean data from CS platforms to support leadership reporting and QBRs, using AI-assisted tools to accelerate data cleanup and duplicate detection while flagging quality issues before they reach stakeholders.
* Own day-to-day administration of CS platforms (e.g., Gainsight, Salesforce, Zendesk/Intercom), including field updates, access requests, and configuration changes, escalating ambiguous or higher-risk cases to the Sr. CS Operations Manager.
* Document and refine workflows, playbooks, and automations that the broader CS team uses, proactively identifying and proposing improvements where friction exists.
* Own renewal tracking and reporting, independently surfacing upcoming renewals and at-risk accounts to the CS Operations Manager and CSMs.
* Coordinate onboarding operations tasks — checklists, handoff tracking, and milestone reporting — to keep new customers moving smoothly through their first months.
* Partner with CSMs, Renewals, and Onboarding teams on ad hoc projects that support the broader CS Operations roadmap, and help onboard new CS Ops hires to platform basics and team workflows.

**Functional Competencies**
---------------------------

**Required:**

* 4+ years of experience in a data, operations, or customer-facing support role.
* Proficient working in spreadsheets/Excel.
* Working proficiency with at least one CRM/CS platform (Salesforce, Gainsight, HubSpot, Zendesk, or similar), with the ability to quickly ramp on others.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; comfortable managing multiple recurring tasks and deadlines.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to flag issues or ask clarifying questions proactively.
* Genuine curiosity about how Customer Success operations and SaaS businesses work.

**Preferred / Nice to Have:**

* Exposure to SQL or BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker).
* Prior exposure to a Customer Success, Support, or RevOps function.
* Basic understanding of SQL, Excel formulas/pivot tables, or data visualization tools.
* Experience with CRM/CS Platforms including Gainsight and Salesforce.
* Fluency with AI-assisted tools for reporting, data cleanup, and data analysis.
* Experience in a SaaS or high-growth technology company.

Follow us on LinkedIn!

**Why Menlo?**

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: **Proactive Leadership**, **Straight Talk**, **United Impact**, **Elevated Talent**, and **Customer-Compelled**. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability**.

Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Menlo Security. In the event a candidate submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment will be paid.***

description:
**Job Description**
Serves as the main contact for individual contracts, providing extensive business processes, product/service (e.g., hardware, applications, software) functionality, and/or implementation knowledge. Provides services, adjusting to ensure alignment, and educates customers on ways to leverage Oracle services. Reviews service requests and gathers information to determine next steps, identifies potential crises, leveraging extensive knowledge and other customer experience to develop innovative solutions, and connects and/or escalates issues to appropriate teams to reach solutions, anticipating and reporting pain points. Develops and maintains plans and ensures positive margins, seeks opportunities to review and update documentation, and leverages understanding and collaborates across teams to identify and submit delivery leads for new opportunities and contract renewals. Proactively provides ongoing maintenance, mentors team members to act as a liaison between teams, and seeks opportunities to improve customer ability to adopt product and service changes. Works closely with peers within and sometimes beyond the team to identify and develop innovative ways of delivering services, provides direction, experiments with new approaches, and seeks opportunities to share product/support information, and plays a key role in the development of new services and/or processes, remaining up-to-date with technological business, and industry trends.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Customer Engagement:**

* Serves as the main point of contact for individual-level contracts, providing advanced business process, product/service (e.g., hardware, applications, software) functionality, and/or implementation knowledge in an advisory manner.
* Provides timely services, adjusting to ensure alignment with their practices, procedures, contractual budgets, leveraging contractual agreements and identifying revisions.
* Maintains customer relations, communicating with customers and across related teams regularly to ensure satisfaction. Provides updates on customer status to leadership.
* Educates customers on the most effective and efficient way to leverage Oracle services, products, and tools, experimenting with new approaches and providing feedback on customer organization performance.

**Issue Resolution:**

* Reviews service requests and gathers information from appropriate parties to determine next steps.
* Identifies potential crises or concerns and works to resolve customer issues and incidents in a timely manner, leveraging advanced knowledge of appropriate resources and other customer experience to develop innovative solutions.
* Connects and/or escalates issues to appropriate teams to reach solutions and minimize impact on the business, anticipating and reporting pain points to minimize impact on the business.

**Account Management and Governance:**

* Develops and maintains service delivery and/or project plans throughout their lifecycle and ensures positive margins according to governance and account management expectations and contracted terms.
* Proactively updates and maintains accurate customer account, contract, and service history information, identifying and addressing areas missing information.
* Independently and proactively conducts account planning and account reviews, tracking and communicating status on a wide range of projects including risk identification and mitigation recommendations.
* Seeks opportunities to review and update documentation and collaborates with peers to maintain contract cost, resources and scheduling, and scope, working to meet contract revenue and margin objectives.
* Leverages understanding of business needs and collaborates across teams to identify and submit delivery leads for custom new opportunities and contract renewals.

**Technical Delivery Management:**

* Proactively advises customers on optimal use and health or their Oracle product/service investment, proactively providing ongoing maintenance to optimize and ensure effectiveness and performance of the product and/or service.
* Collaborates with cross-functional teams, driving the execution and development of technical delivery plans.
* Mentors more junior team members to act as a liaison between customers, internal, and external teams.
* Seeks opportunities to increase customer understanding and improve their ability to adopt product and service changes according to policies and best practices.

**Innovation and Continuous Improvement:**

* Works closely with peers within and sometimes beyond the team to identify and develop innovative ways to deliver service and improve overall product and service utilization to achieve ROI goals.
* Contributes to the team by providing guidance, experimenting with new approaches, and seeking opportunities to share knowledge of product, service, and/or support information or issues.
* Identifies and recommends opportunities for enhanced value for services.
* Plays a key role in the development of new services and/or processes, remaining up-to-date with technological, business, and industry trends.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

**Problem Solving:**

* Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.

**Performance and Development:**

* Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Partnership Manager-Chennai
description:
**About Keka**

Keka is a modern people platform for growing enterprises. HR, payroll and talent live in one core system, so teams spend less time on admin and more time on their people. More than 12,500 companies trust Keka, from fast-growing small businesses to large enterprises and global companies with teams across borders.

We build software the way HR actually works. It feels human, sets up in days instead of months, and has AI built into every part of HR. With customers across India, the US and the Middle East.

**About Role**

The PAM owns a named book of Keka partners end-to-end — program rules, pipeline, co-sell, operations, GTM, cross-functional alignment and the partner relationship. You are responsible for maximizing your partners’ revenue impact while delivering an exceptional experience with Keka.

**What you'll do**

Program & Partner Mechanics

* Own program rules — tier criteria, certifications, MDF usage, branding, incentives, rebates and commissions.
* Maintain clean partner data in CRM/PRM ( certifications, contacts, opportunities);
* Oversee deal registration, contract renewals, SLA and MDF claim validation.

Pipeline, Co-Sell & GTM

* Drive pipeline creation, co-sell support, negotiation, margin discussion and conflict resolution with each partner.
* Build partner sales plans, joint customer-success plans, reference-customer development and upsell/cross-sell motions.
* Run joint GTM — campaigns, key plays, enablement milestones, co-marketing strategy and execution.

Operations, Reviews & Cross-Functional

* QBR / MBR / weekly reviews, forecasting accuracy, pipeline hygiene and partner scorecard management.
* Coordinate Sales, Marketing, Ops, Finance, Legal, CS, Presales and Channel Leadership on partner needs.
* Resolve commercial, operational and support escalations; manage budgets and deal-desk for partner investments.

Strategic Relationship & Lifecycle

* Executive alignment with VP/C-level at top partners; annual business reviews and multi-year growth roadmaps.
* Partner health-score monitoring, journey mapping, NPS, advisory-board participation.
* Voice-of-partner programs, partner community building, and clean exit/offboarding when required.

**What you'll bring**

* 6–10 years in channel / alliances / partner-account management at a B2B SaaS or enterprise-tech company; carried a partner-sourced number.
* Strong commercial instincts — margin, incentives, deal economics and conflict resolution.
* CRM/PRM hygiene discipline and structured QBR / forecasting cadence.
* Senior stakeholder presence — comfortable with VP / C-level conversations at partners.
* HR-tech, fintech, or payroll-adjacent industry exposure.
* Experience scaling a partner book from a handful to 50+ active partners.

title: Human Capital - Total Rewards Benefits Operate- Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Human Capital**
Our Human Capital practice is at the forefront of transforming the nature of work. As converging forces reshape industries, our team uniquely addresses the complexities of work, workforce, and workplace dynamics. We leverage sector-specific insights and cross-domain perspectives to help organizations tackle their most challenging workforce issues and align talent strategies with their strategic visions. Our practice is renowned for making work better for humans and humans better at work. Be part of this exciting era of change and join us on this transformative journey.

As a
**Total Rewards Benefits Operate Manager**
, you will lead work at the intersection of
**benefits strategy, administration operations, and enabling technology**
. You’ll help clients and internal teams translate benefits requirements into scalable platform capabilities—understanding what leading
**benefits administration providers**
can deliver, how
**HCM platforms**
connect to those ecosystems, and what it takes to drive successful implementation and ongoing operations. This will be achieved either through use of Deloitte’s proprietary BenefitIQ technology and/or other market solutions as appropriate.
  
  
You’ll be accountable for delivering high-quality outcomes, managing teams and stakeholders, and shaping product-enabled solutions that improve member experience, administrative efficiency, and compliance-aligned execution.

Accountable for end-to-end SLA/XLA delivery, quality, and compliance across all in-scope benefits operations towers.

* 3+ years of experience leading benefits administration for multinational clients, with accountability for service quality, compliance, and client satisfaction across multiple countries
* Hands-on experience with Human Capital Management (HCM) platform data management and payroll integrations supporting rewards or benefits programs, including eligibility rules, life and qualifying events, payroll deductions, and file-based data exchanges

* Experience working with multiple benefits administration providers across both implementation and ongoing service delivery
* In-depth understanding of the benefits technology landscape, including the capabilities, strengths, and limitations of Workday and other leading HCM and benefits administration platforms.
* Good knowledge of global benefits practices, regulatory considerations, and market trends
* Proven track record of building and managing strong, collaborative relationships with benefits carriers, vendors, and service providers
* Solid understanding of core HCM concepts and integration patterns, such as worker and benefit event data, payroll deductions, file-based vs. API integrations, and inbound/outbound data feeds.

: Gurugram, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Mumbai, Chennai, Pune, Kolkata

description:
**Job Title: Zonal Head – Field Service Delivery**

**Location:**
Chennai

**Experience:**
10–15+ Years

Role Purpose

The Zonal Head will be responsible for driving end-to-end operational excellence, uptime, service delivery, customer satisfaction, compliance, and business growth across the assigned zone for both Plutus (Digital Payments) and Petroleum Automation businesses.

The role requires strong leadership in managing field operations, customer escalations, vendor coordination, resource planning, and service governance to ensure achievement of contractual SLAs and business objectives.

**Operations Management**

* Drive operational performance across the zone for Plutus and Petroleum businesses.
* Ensure achievement of uptime, SLA, and service delivery targets.
* Monitor and improve First Time Fix Rate (FTFR) and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR).
* Review territory-wise operational KPIs and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure timely closure of incidents, service requests, and customer escalations.

**Team Leadership & People Management**

* Lead Territory Leads, Cluster Heads, and Field Service Representatives (FSRs).
* Drive productivity, discipline, and performance management across teams.
* Conduct regular reviews, coaching sessions, and field audits.
* Identify training needs and develop technical capabilities within the team.

title: AI/ML Manager
description:
**Job Description: AI/ML Manager – Enterprise AI Implementation**

**Location:** Malaysia  
**Candidate Sourcing:** India  
**Experience:** 8–15+ years overall experience, including significant experience leading AI/ML initiatives  
**Role Level:** Senior Manager / AI Transformation Manager / Head of AI Implementation (designation based on experience)

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced **AI/ML Manager with proven experience in enterprise-level Artificial Intelligence implementation** to lead the strategy, planning, development, deployment, and scaling of AI-driven solutions across business functions.

The ideal candidate will have a strong combination of AI/ML technical knowledge, enterprise technology leadership, stakeholder management, and program delivery experience. This role requires a professional who has successfully taken AI initiatives beyond proof of concept (PoC) and pilots into production environments, delivering measurable business value, operational efficiency, and scalable enterprise capabilities.

The candidate will work closely with executive leadership, business stakeholders, IT teams, data engineering teams, and external technology partners to identify AI opportunities, establish implementation roadmaps, and drive enterprise-wide adoption of AI solutions.

Candidates must have demonstrable experience managing large-scale AI implementations in complex business or enterprise environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise AI Strategy & Roadmap**

* Develop and execute enterprise AI strategies aligned with organizational business objectives.
* Identify high-impact opportunities for AI/ML adoption across business functions, operations, products, and customer-facing applications.
* Define AI implementation roadmaps, investment priorities, business cases, and delivery milestones.
* Evaluate AI use cases based on business value, technical feasibility, scalability, risk, and expected return on investment.
* Lead the transition from AI experimentation and proof of concept to production-grade enterprise implementations.
* Establish standards, frameworks, and best practices for enterprise AI adoption.

**2. Enterprise AI Implementation & Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end implementation of AI/ML solutions across multiple business units or enterprise functions.
* Oversee AI programs from requirements gathering and solution architecture through development, integration, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Manage large-scale AI implementation projects involving multiple teams, technology platforms, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Ensure AI solutions integrate effectively with existing enterprise applications, data platforms, APIs, and business workflows.
* Drive the deployment of scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable AI systems.
* Track implementation progress, resolve delivery challenges, manage dependencies, and ensure successful project outcomes.
* Establish clear success metrics and measure the business impact of deployed AI solutions.

**3. Generative AI & Enterprise LLM Adoption**

* Lead the evaluation and implementation of Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) solutions for enterprise use cases.
* Drive the adoption of enterprise AI applications such as intelligent assistants, knowledge management systems, document intelligence, conversational AI, workflow automation, and decision-support systems.
* Oversee initiatives involving Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), enterprise search, AI agents, model orchestration, and integration with internal knowledge repositories, where relevant.
* Evaluate commercial AI platforms, foundation models, and open-source technologies based on business needs, security, cost, performance, and scalability.
* Define approaches for responsible LLM deployment, model evaluation, output quality, and risk management.
* Establish appropriate controls for sensitive enterprise data, access permissions, hallucination risks, and human oversight.

**4. AI/ML Program & Team Management**

* Lead and manage cross-functional teams comprising AI/ML engineers, data scientists, data engineers, software developers, architects, and business analysts.
* Define project scope, resource plans, budgets, timelines, deliverables, and governance structures.
* Build and mentor high-performing AI teams and develop internal capabilities for sustainable AI adoption.
* Manage external implementation partners, consultants, and technology vendors where applicable.
* Establish delivery standards, review mechanisms, performance indicators, and escalation processes.
* Communicate program progress, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to senior management and executive stakeholders.

**5. Enterprise Architecture & Technology Governance**

* Work with enterprise architects, IT leaders, and data leaders to define scalable AI solution architectures.
* Guide decisions regarding cloud-based AI platforms, data infrastructure, model deployment, enterprise integration, and technology selection.
* Ensure AI solutions align with enterprise architecture, application security, infrastructure, and data management standards.
* Promote appropriate MLOps, LLMOps, model lifecycle management, monitoring, and continuous improvement practices.
* Establish governance processes for model validation, performance monitoring, versioning, and production support.

**6. AI Governance, Security & Responsible AI**

* Establish governance frameworks for enterprise AI implementation and adoption.
* Ensure AI solutions adhere to applicable data privacy, information security, regulatory, and organizational policies.
* Address risks related to data leakage, model bias, explainability, reliability, intellectual property, and unauthorized AI usage.
* Work with security, compliance, legal, and risk teams to define appropriate controls and approval processes.
* Promote responsible, transparent, and auditable AI practices across the organization.

**7. Business Value & Transformation**

* Partner with business leaders to redesign processes and identify opportunities for AI-led transformation.
* Quantify business benefits, including productivity improvements, cost optimization, faster decision-making, and enhanced customer experience.
* Develop business cases and establish KPIs to measure AI adoption, operational impact, and return on investment.
* Drive change management, user adoption, training, and organizational readiness for AI-enabled workflows.
* Present implementation outcomes, strategic recommendations, and progress reports to executive leadership.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Approximately **8–15+ years of overall technology, data, digital transformation, or AI-related experience**, with the level adjusted to the complexity of prior enterprise implementations.
* Significant experience managing or leading enterprise AI/ML implementation programs.
* Demonstrated success taking AI initiatives from business requirements and PoCs into production deployment and scaled adoption.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary technical teams and complex technology delivery programs.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts, enterprise data platforms, cloud technologies, and modern AI architectures.
* Experience engaging with senior business stakeholders, IT leadership, and executive management.
* Proven ability to connect technology investments with measurable business outcomes.

**Mandatory Skills & Competencies**

* Enterprise AI implementation and transformation.
* AI/ML program and project management.
* AI strategy, use-case prioritization, and roadmap development.
* Production deployment and scaling of AI solutions.
* Stakeholder and executive management.
* Enterprise solution architecture and systems integration.
* Team leadership, resource planning, and delivery governance.
* Business case development, KPI tracking, and ROI measurement.
* AI risk management, governance, privacy, and security awareness.

**Preferred Technical Exposure**

Candidates should have practical implementation or leadership exposure to several of the following:

* Enterprise Generative AI and LLM platforms.
* RAG-based applications, enterprise search, and AI assistants.
* Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and predictive analytics.
* Microsoft Azure AI, AWS AI services, or Google Cloud AI.
* Enterprise data platforms, data lakes, data warehouses, and data engineering.
* MLOps, LLMOps, model monitoring, and deployment automation.
* AI application integration with ERP, CRM, enterprise knowledge systems, and business applications.
* AI agents, workflow automation, and intelligent process automation.
* Commercial AI platforms and open-source AI ecosystems.

**Key Success Criteria**

The successful candidate will demonstrate a track record of:

* Delivering at least one or more significant AI implementations in a complex enterprise environment.
* Moving AI solutions from experimentation to production and sustained business use.
* Managing multiple stakeholders, teams, and technology dependencies.
* Establishing effective AI governance, security, and operational controls.
* Demonstrating measurable business value from AI investments.
* Driving adoption of AI solutions across teams, departments, or business units.

**Location & Relocation**

**Work Location:** Malaysia  
**Target Candidate Pool:** Experienced professionals currently based in India and willing to relocate to Malaysia.

Candidates must be open to international relocation and working with multicultural, geographically distributed teams. Relocation arrangements and work authorization will be discussed during the recruitment process.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a strategic yet execution-oriented technology leader who understands both the business and technical dimensions of enterprise AI.

The ideal candidate is not limited to AI research, model development, or proof-of-concept experimentation. They should have direct ownership or substantial leadership responsibility for **implementing, integrating, deploying, governing, and scaling AI solutions in a real enterprise environment**.

Experience in enterprise digital transformation, consulting-led AI implementations, large technology programs, or AI platform adoption will be highly valued.

**Application Requirements**

* Experience with production deployment, enterprise integration, and AI governance.

title: Cloud Services Manager (Container)
description:
Req ID: 142267
  
Remote Position: Hybrid
  
Region: Asia
  
Country: India
  
State/Province: Chennai
  
City: Guindy, Chennai

**Summary**
-----------

Seeking an execution-focused, technically proficient **Manager of Cloud Services** to lead the day-to-day engineering and operations of our multi-cloud ecosystem across **AWS, Azure, and GCP**. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Cloud Architecture & Engineering, you will lead a dedicated squad of cloud, DevOps, and platform engineers tasked with translating high-level architecture designs into robust, production-grade deployments.

You will manage the implementation, maintenance, and reliability of our enterprise container platforms (GKE, AKS, OpenShift, and native Kubernetes), operationalize infrastructure for AI models and agentic workflows, and drive hands-on GitOps and IaC practices. This is an active, technical leadership role requiring direct participation in code reviews, pipeline automation, disaster recovery execution, and operational support.

**Detailed Description**
------------------------

Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following:

* **Blueprint Execution:** Translate multi-cloud architectural frameworks into production-ready infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* **Container Environment Provisioning:** Implement and standardize cluster topologies across Red Hat OpenShift, GKE, AKS, and upstream Kubernetes per architectural guidelines.
* **AI Runtime Infrastructure:** Deploy and support execution infrastructure for machine learning and agentic AI systems (e.g., configuring GPU/TPU nodes, model serving runtimes like vLLM/Triton, vector database clusters, and secure runtime sandboxes for agent execution).
* **IaC Authoring & Review:** Write, review, and maintain production Terraform modules, Helm charts, and raw Kubernetes/Kustomize manifests.
* **GitOps Delivery:** Manage and optimize automated GitOps pipelines using ArgoCD or Flux to ensure version-controlled, continuous deployments across staging and production clusters.
* **Internal Platform Enablement:** Maintain CI/CD pipelines, container registries, and self-service templates enabling software engineering and data science teams to deploy microservices smoothly.
* **Cluster Lifecycle Execution:** Coordinate and execute rolling cluster version upgrades, worker node pool patching, and OS maintenance across multi-cloud Kubernetes fleets with zero service disruption.
* **Capacity & FinOps Tracking:** Monitor resource consumption, configure cluster autoscalers (KEDA, Karpenter), implement pod resource quotas, and track daily compute costs across cloud providers.
* **Vulnerability & Compliance Remediation:** Enforce container base image hardening, automate CVE scanning (Trivy, Grype), and ensure runtime admission controllers (OPA/Gatekeeper/Kyverno) adhere to enterprise standards.
* **Backup Automation:** Implement, test, and manage automated backup routines for Kubernetes cluster states and persistent storage using tools such as Velero or Kasten.
* **Model & Artifact Protection:** Ensure secure, regular backups and snapshot validation for persistent AI datasets, model weights, and state stores.
* **Incident Management & Escalations:** Serve as an operational escalation point for L2/L3 production incidents, directing troubleshooting for container, network, and cloud outages.
* **Telemetry Operations:** Manage centralized logging, metrics, and tracing stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog), configuring actionable alerting rules and dashboards.
* **Root Cause Analysis (RCA):** Lead post-incident retrospectives, track action items to resolution, and implement self-healing automations to avoid recurrence.

**Knowledge/Skills/Competencies**
---------------------------------

* **Multi-Cloud Administration:** Hands-on operational experience with AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (VPC/VNet configuration, IAM roles, cloud storage, security groups).
* **AI & Agentic Workload Enablement:** Practical experience deploying and managing infrastructure supporting AI/LLM workloads, containerized inference runtimes, or AI agent toolsets.
* **Infrastructure as Code & Templating:** Advanced proficiency writing and maintaining Terraform code, Helm charts, and native Kubernetes manifests.
* **GitOps & Automation:** Practical experience configuring and debugging GitOps tools (ArgoCD, Flux) and CI platforms (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
* **Observability:** Strong working knowledge of Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry collectors, and centralized log aggregation tools.
* Leadership**:** Proven track record of managing technical teams and delivering enterprise cloud infrastructure services.

**Physical Demands**
--------------------

* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
* Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

**Typical Experience**
----------------------

* 7 to 10 years of relevant IT experience that shows consistent progression, and at least 5 years hands-on technology and team leadership experience.

**Typical Education**
---------------------

* Bachelor's Degree or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Educational requirements may vary by geography.
* Preferred Qualifications & Certifications

  + **Certifications:**

    - Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
    - Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration
    - Associate or Professional Cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect/SysOps, Azure Administrator, GCP Cloud Engineer)

**Notes**
---------

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.

title: Account Lead
description:
Location: Hybrid (Secunderabad-based)

Type: Full-Time

**About the role**

This is an ownership role, not a coordination one. You take a set of our accounts and you own them end to end: from the client relationship and timelines to the quality of everything that goes out. When something needs doing, you get it done, and when there's no one else to do it, you do it yourself.

You'll brief the team, review their work and push back when it isn't ready. If you want a narrow lane and a fixed job description, this isn't it. If you like owning outcomes and doing whatever it takes to protect them, read on.

**What you'll own**

* The client relationship: You're the primary point of contact for your accounts. Calls, recaps, updates, expectations, all yours. You flag blockers early, and you're the steady voice when a timeline slips or a client gets anxious. As far as the client is concerned, you are the studio.

* Delivery and quality: You own what ships and when. You're the first person to forward-plan and the last set of eyes before work reaches the client. Nothing sloppy or half-finished goes out under your accounts.

* Timelines across every account: You're the first to know what's due, what's at risk, and what needs re-sequencing. Deadlines don't surprise you, because staying ahead of them is the job.

* Team coordination: You brief the copywriter, designers and strategist clearly, give feedback that's actionable, and keep everyone's timelines aligned so the work actually moves instead of stalling between people.

* Account documentation: Trackers, content calendars, approval threads, revision logs, and the rest. The systems that keep 5-7 accounts from turning into chaos stay current because you keep them current.

* Account health: You watch for scope creep, churn risk, and the conversations no one wants to have, and you have them early. Protecting the relationship and the renewal is partly yours.

* Performance: You track how the work actually does once it's live. You read what's working and what isn't, turn that into a clear improvement plan, and feed it into the next cycle of content. When you talk to the client, you bring them progress, not just output.

* Filling the gap: When an account needs something and there's no one free to do it, you step in, whatever it is.

**Who you'll work with**

You'll sit between the clients and the people who make the work. You'll brief and coordinate the creative team and the production and coordination support and you'll report into the founder on account health and anything that needs a call above your level. You run the day-to-day so the founder doesn't have to be in every room.

**What this is not**

This is not a primarily creative role. You won't be the one ideating campaigns or writing the bulk of the captions, though you're always welcome to, and you'll be expected to jump in when a gap needs filling. Your core job is to make sure the people doing that work have what they need, when they need it, and that the client always sees a studio that has its act together.

**What we're looking for**

* 3+ years in a client-facing, account, or project-management role with agency experience strongly preferred).
* Able to represent the studio unsupervised. Confident on calls, clear in writing, composed with senior and demanding clients.
* Obsessive about follow-through. If you said you'd send something, it's sent.
* Sound judgment. You know which decisions are yours to make and which to bring to the founder, and you don't escalate every little thing.
* Able to run 5-7 accounts in parallel without mixing them up or dropping a thread.
* Hands-on enough to step into the work when it's needed. A decent writer, a clear briefer, comfortable around a shoot.
* Comfortable with numbers. You can read content performance and turn it into what to do differently next month, not just report what happened.
* High on accountability, ownership, integrity, and commitment.
* Fluent in project-management tools (Notion, Google Workspace, or similar).

**Mandatory**

* A background in content, media, or marketing. You don't need to create it, but understanding how it's made helps.
* Experience managing timelines for video or social media production.

**A note on scope**

We're a small studio still building our core team, which means this role will stretch. Everything above is where you'll start, not a ceiling. As the studio grows and as we learn what you're best at, your remit will shift and expand, and there will be stretches where you're asked to take on work beyond this description simply because the studio needs it. If that flexibility sounds like an opportunity rather than a problem, you'll do well here.

title: Deputy Manager - Operations (Field & Delivery)
description:
**Introduction**
**Come move the world with us!**
Wake up each day to be part of a
**global movement**
. A movement to make an impact. A movement to go for it! A movement to provide best-in class solutions. A movement to be empowered. A movement to do the right thing.

**Overview**
**The Deputy Manager - Operations (Field & Delivery)**
is responsible for leading field delivery operations, customer site execution, transportation coordination, warehouse interface and service-quality governance on behalf of AIT. The role manages supervisors and field resources deployed at customer sites, airports, warehouses, distribution centers and project locations, ensuring safe, timely, compliant, and high-quality delivery execution.
  
  
The incumbent acts as the operational escalation point between customers, transport vendors, warehouse partners, customs brokers, airlines and internal operations teams. The role requires strong ownership of delivery KPIs, team supervision, exception management, vendor performance, customer communication, and continuous improvement in field operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Field Delivery Operations Leadership - Plan, supervise, and monitor pickup, delivery, loading, unloading, and customer-site operations across assigned locations to ensure efficient and compliant service execution.
* AIT Site Representation - Act as the primary AIT representative at customer sites, ensuring adherence to customer instructions, site protocols, and agreed service standards.
* Team Supervision - Lead field supervisors and operational teams, ensuring effective resource deployment, productivity, professional conduct, and service delivery excellence.
* Transportation & Vendor Coordination - Coordinate with transport vendors, warehouses, drivers, customs brokers, airports, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth operational execution and service continuity.
* White Glove & Project Delivery Management - Oversee high-value and specialized deliveries, ensuring safe handling, unpacking, positioning, installation support, and successful customer handover.
* Shipment Visibility & Exception Control - Maintain shipment visibility, milestone accuracy, and proactive communication while managing operational exceptions, delays, damages, and recovery actions.
* POD & Documentation Governance - Ensure timely collection, validation, and submission of PODs, delivery records, customer acknowledgements, and other operational documentation.
* Operational KPI & Service Quality - Drive performance against key metrics including on-time delivery, POD closure, service failures, damage prevention, and customer satisfaction.
* Customer Service & Escalation Management - Manage customer escalations, provide timely updates, and coordinate corrective actions to ensure high service levels and business continuity.
* Safety, Security & Compliance - Ensure compliance with safety standards, security protocols, customer requirements, regulatory guidelines, and AIT operating procedures.
* Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement - Lead root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and process improvement initiatives to enhance service quality, productivity, and cost efficiency.
* Vendor Development & Quality Assurance - Monitor vendor performance, support training initiatives, participate in audits, and drive continuous improvement to strengthen operational reliability and compliance.

**Qualifications**

* A team player who works well with others – being respectful to our teammates is a Core Value
* A strong work ethic with an appreciation for ownership, independence, accountability, and autonomy in your role
* Growth mindset – being passionate about your craft, always looking for ways to improve yourself and the company, being open to change and doing things differently
* Customer service focus – we serve a wide variety of customers, both internal and external, and building relationships is a part of our culture
* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent degree in any field
* 5-6 years in freight forwarding, transportation, delivery operations, field supervision, warehousing, or logistics operations.
* Minimum 2-3 years supervising field executives, delivery teams, transport vendors or customer-site operations.
* Inductry exposure - Freight forwarding, airfreight operations, last-mile delivery, white glove delivery, warehousing, project logistics, data-center / high-value cargo operations

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Field delivery and transportation operations management
* Customer-site coordination and delivery supervision
* White glove / high-value cargo handling awareness
* Shipment tracking, milestone reporting, and POD governance
* Team supervision, shift planning, and field resource deployment
* Vendor, driver, warehouse, and handling-agent coordination
* Issue resolution, escalation handling, and root-cause analysis
* Safety, compliance, security, and customer-site protocol awareness
* Documentation control and operational reporting
* Working knowledge of Excel, Outlook, CargoWise or similar logistics systems preferred

**Preferred Certifications**

* CargoWise user training or equivalent logistics system training
* Logistics / Supply Chain / Transportation certification
* Safety and security awareness training
* Dangerous Goods awareness training where applicable
* Customer-site induction or white glove handling training where applicable

**About AIT Worldwide**
**About AIT Worldwide Logistics:**
AIT Worldwide Logistics is a global freight forwarder that helps its customers grow by expanding access to markets all over the world where they can sell and/or procure raw materials, components, and finished goods. For more than 45 years, the America’s-based supply chain solutions leader has relied on a consultative approach to build a global network and trusted partnerships in nearly every industry, including aerospace, automotive, consumer retail, food, government, healthcare, high-tech, industrial and life sciences. Backed by scalable, user-friendly technology, AIT’s flexible business model customizes door-to-door deliveries via sea, air, ground, and rail—on time and on budget. With expert teammates staffing more than 100 worldwide locations in Asia, Europe, India, Middle East and North America, AIT’s full-service options also include customs clearance, warehouse management and white glove services. Learn more about AIT Worldwide Logistics, our culture and core values in action here .
  
  
AIT Worldwide Logistics is an Equal Opportunity Employer – M/F/Veterans/Disabled. If you are unable to apply online due to a disability, contact Human Resources at 630-766-8300 ext 5218.
  
  
**What AIT Can Offer You**
In addition to base compensation, AIT offers a growing suite of competitive benefits to help our teammates realize their full financial, well-being, personal and professional potential.
  
  
**AIT Worldwide Logistics Benefits Available Across All Global Markets**

* Vacation/holiday time
* Global employee support program
* Mindfulness tools
* Professional development
* Company events and gatherings
* Five paid volunteer hours through our AIT Cares program

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering (Observability, Kafka, Monitoring)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**The Experience**  
  
You will be a Senior Manager of Software Engineering leading a team of 8 to 10 engineers. Your team builds the “Anomaly Alerting” platform. This is a smart system that watches for strange changes in data and sends out warnings. Your job is to guide the people, own the system, and help make our warning alerts smarter and more automatic.
  
  
**What You’ll Actually Be Doing**

* Day-to-day work: You will make sure our alerting system is fast, strong, and does not break as it grows. You will lead projects that make the system do the hard work so other teams don’t have to set up alerts by hand.
* Leading the way: You will manage 1 to 2 teams (8 to 10 engineers). You will build a happy, helpful culture where people work well together.
* Working together: You will partner with other tech teams and groups across Salesforce (like Slack and Sales Cloud) so they can find and fix problems much faster. You will also speak for your team in meetings and work closely with our teams in the US.
Early goals & impact: In your first 60 to 90 days, you will learn the ropes, start leading in meetings, team up with the US groups, and make a real difference on our biggest goals.  

**You’re Our Person If...**

* You have experience being a manager and leading 8 to 10 software engineers.
* You know how to handle huge amounts of data and build data pipelines (ETL).
* You have experience running systems on big clouds like AWS or Google Cloud (GCP).
* You have worked with tools that monitor system health (Observability).
* You have some experience with Machine Learning and know how to spot strange patterns in data (Anomaly Detection).
You are able to work in the office as the company requires (no travel is required for this role).  

**Even Better If...**

* You have deep, hands-on experience building Machine Learning tools that send out alerts.
You already know how to work with Salesforce products like Agentforce, Commerce Cloud, or Slack.  

**Tech Stack:**

* Cloud & Compute: AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) for stateless, scalable multi-cloud orchestration.
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform for resilient, automated platform provisioning across environments.
* Edge Ingestion: OpenTelemetry (OTel) for standardized instrumentation, and Vector/Fluent Bit for high-throughput log routing.
* Message Buffering: Apache Kafka to ingest billions of telemetry events, ensuring durable, decoupled data pipelines.
* Stream Processing: Apache Flink for real-time log parsing, rolling aggregations, and anomaly detection before storage.
* Backend Languages: Java for building heavy stream-processing applications, supplemented by Go and Python for operators and tooling.
* Ad-Hoc OLAP Analytics: Apache Druid to power sub-second, interactive dashboard queries over massive historical datasets.
* Log & Trace Storage: ClickHouse for fast columnar event storage, natively tiered to AWS S3 / GCP Cloud Storage for cost-effective cold storage.
* Time-Series Metrics: VictoriaMetrics, M3DB, or Prometheus to ingest and compress millions of high-cardinality metric rollups.
* Visualization & Alerting: Grafana and Apache Superset for single-pane-of-glass UI, paired with Prometheus Alertmanager for incident routing.
* A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering — using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty.
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in development workflows.
* Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Enterprise Software Test Engineer II
description:

  **Nice to Have:**

title: Senior Principal - Privacy and AI Governance
description:
**About Providence**
--------------------

Providence, one of the US’s largest not-for-profit healthcare systems, is committed to high quality, compassionate healthcare for all. Driven by the belief that health is a human right and the vision, ‘Health for a better world’, Providence and its 121,000 caregivers strive to provide everyone access to affordable quality care and services.

Providence has a network of 51 hospitals, 1,000+ care clinics, senior services, supportive housing, and other health and educational services in the US.

Providence India is bringing to fruition the transformational shift of the healthcare ecosystem to Health 2.0. The India center will have focused efforts around healthcare technology and innovation, and play a vital role in driving digital transformation of health systems for improved patient outcomes and experiences, caregiver efficiency, and running the business of Providence at scale.

  

**Why Us?**
-----------

* Best In-class Benefits
* Inclusive Leadership
* Reimagining Healthcare
* Competitive Pay
* Supportive Reporting Relation

**Position Summary**
====================

The Privacy and AI Governance Manager will strengthen the assessment, implementation and continuous improvement of PGC’s privacy and AI governance programs. The individual will closely partner with business, Technology, Cybersecurity, Legal, Procurement, HR, and product teams to embed privacy and AI governance requirements throughout the data and AI lifecycles - from ideation and collection through design, development, deployment, monitoring, retention, and decommissioning. The individual will also identify and help operationalize privacy and HIPAA obligations arising from customer contracts and Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) throughout the customer contractual lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Privacy Governance**
----------------------

* Manage the data privacy governance framework, with particular focus on the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and other applicable privacy requirements.
* Identify HIPAA and data privacy obligations arising from external customer contracts and Business Associate Agreements (BAAs), ensure appropriate safeguards are implemented through the contractual lifecycle, including handling of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and Protected Health Information (PHI). Coordinate implementation and ongoing compliance with applicable safeguards.
* Conduct privacy risk assessments, gap assessments, Data Protection Impact Assessments, and remediation tracking for business processes and applications.
* Maintain governance for privacy notices, consent and withdrawal, data-principal rights, records of processing activities, purpose limitation, data minimization, retention, disposal, data flows, and cross-functional accountability.
* Develop and deliver role-based privacy awareness, communications, and training for employees, leaders, process owners and other relevant groups.
* Act as the single point of contact for data privacy matters, providing practical advisory support that ensures compliance requirements are met.
  

**AI Governance**
-----------------

* Operationalize AI governance framework covering entity-level and use-case-level risks and controls across the full AI lifecycle.
* Maintain a standardized AI risk taxonomy, risk and control library, assessment methodology, evidence requirements, maturity criteria, and reporting approach.
* Assess AI control design and operating effectiveness; collaborate with respective control owners to elevate governance maturity and follow through to closure.
* Review AI use cases and provide subject matter expertise on privacy exposures and necessary safeguards.
* Support strengthening policies and procedures on AI governance across variety of use cases (generative AI, large and small language models, agentic AI, enterprise AI, native AI, and third-party AI solutions).
* Align the program, as appropriate, with recognized frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, healthcare AI guidance, and Providence AI principles.

* Monitor regulatory and industry developments and recommend timely updates to policies, controls, training, and governance practices.

**Qualifications and Experience**
=================================

* Bachelor’s degree in law, information technology, cybersecurity. Postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* 8–12 years of experience in privacy, data protection, technology risk, compliance, information governance, AI governance, or related areas, including experience leading cross-functional programs.
* Working knowledge of the DPDP Act, privacy principles, consent and rights management, records of processing, impact assessments, incident management, retention, and third-party risk.
* Strong understanding of AI governance and risk concepts across design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, change, and retirement.
* Experience developing risk and control matrices, testing controls, evaluating evidence, assessing maturity, and managing remediation.
* Ability to interpret regulatory and framework requirements and convert them into practical business and technology controls.
* Experience engaging senior leaders and collaborating across cross functional teams.
* Experience in healthcare or another highly regulated environment is preferred.

**Preferred Credentials**
=========================

* Privacy certification such as Certified in Healthcare Privacy Compliance (CHPC), Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP), Certified Information Privacy Manager (CIPM), or an equivalent credential.
* Risk, audit, security, or governance certification such as Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), or an equivalent credential.
* Training or certification relating to responsible AI, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, AI assurance, or model risk management.

Providence’s vision to create ‘Health for a Better World’ aids us to provide a fair and equitable workplace for all in our employment, whether temporary, part-time or full time, and to promote individuality and diversity of thought and background, and acknowledge its role in the organization’s success. This makes us committed towards equal employment opportunities, regardless of race, religion or belief, color, ancestry, disability, marital status, gender, sexual orientation, age, nationality, ethnic origin, pregnancy, or related needs, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, or any other category protected by applicable law. In furtherance to our mission in building a more inclusive and equitable environment, we shall, from time to time, undertake programs to assist, uplift and empower underrepresented groups including but not limited to Women, PWD (Persons with Disabilities), LGTBQ+ (Lesbian, Gay, Transgender, Bisexual or Queer), Veterans and others. We strive to address all forms of discrimination or harassment and provide a safe and confidential process to report any misconduct.

Contact our Integrity hotline also, read our Code of Conduct.

title: Digital Technology Delivery and Performance Lead
description:
About the job

*At Opella, we have one shared mission – we work passionately, every day, to ‘serve healthier, fuller lives’ now and for the generations to come.*

  

*In order to do so, we strive to act as a force for good by integrating sustainability along our business and employees’ mission and operate responsibly from both a social and environmental point of view.*

*Everything we do is centered around people’s interests – our consumers, our customers, healthcare professionals, and our employees – across the world.*

*We are building loved brands that serve 1bn consumers worldwide, through our key platforms: Allergy, Physical & Mental Wellness, Pain, Digestive Wellness and Cough, Cold & Flu.*

*We aspire to become the best Fast Moving Consumer Health (FMCH) company In & For the world and we aim to build a work environment where people can thrive, grow, enjoy and be at their best.*

  

**Our team** designs, delivers, and governs Digital Technology services and capabilities for Opella worldwide.

We deliver our solutions in a highly competitive market answering FMCH needs and sometimes supporting regulated environments (GxP, SoX and other regional or local regulations).

Our team operates in an international context, serving all markets in most of the countries around the world.

  
  

Digital Technology & Architecture organization encompasses following capabilities: Integration, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud engineering, Platform Engineering (e.g. DevOps & related framework), FinOps, Platforms (ServiceNow, Observability, Chatbots, SAP, Salesforce, RPA, …), Digital Workplace and Cloud Infrastructure.

  
  

**Delivery & Performance** provides the management system that connects strategy, portfolio execution, financial performance, governance, and operational improvement across Technology & Architecture. The team works across domains to create transparency, strengthen accountability, and enable faster, better-informed decisions.

  
  

Are you passionate about turning strategy into brilliant execution, improving financial visibility, and simplifying how technology is governed and delivered? Join us as Delivery & Performance Lead within the Technology & Architecture organization and help strengthen portfolio execution, operational performance, and leadership decision-making across Opella.

**Delivery & Performance Lead**
===============================

Job Summary

The Delivery & Performance Lead drives disciplined execution, financial performance, governance, and operational excellence across Opella’s Technology & Architecture organization. The role provides an integrated view of delivery progress, portfolio health, budgets, risks, dependencies, and outcomes, enabling leaders to make timely, evidence-based decisions.

Working across technology domains and in close partnership with Finance, Procurement, project managers, and business stakeholders, the role strengthens ways of working, improves transparency and accountability, and supports simplification of the technology portfolio and landscape.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

### **Technology Delivery & Performance**

* Drive execution discipline and delivery performance across the Technology & Architecture portfolio.
* Maintain clear visibility of progress, milestones, outcomes, risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
* Challenge delivery plans constructively, facilitate issue resolution, and support recovery actions where performance is off track.
* Promote outcome-based planning and consistent portfolio delivery practices.
  

  

### **Financial & Budget Management**

* Oversee budget tracking, forecasting, purchase order management, and financial performance across Business as Usual and Separation Costs.
* Reconcile actuals, commitments, forecasts, and variances in partnership with Finance, Procurement, and budget owners.
* Improve financial transparency, cost control, and decision-making through reliable data and timely insight.
* Identify financial risks and opportunities and coordinate corrective actions with accountable owners.
  

  

### **Governance & Ways of Working**
