title: Senior Revenue Operations Systems Manager
description:
#### **Hyderabad, -, India**

Digital Product Development, Sales and Marketing

UKIMEA Region

  

HYD00003G Requisition #

**Senior Revenue Operations Manager**
  
Location: India, Hyderabad
  
Region: Arup Digital Products
  
Group: Business Management & Operations
  
Grade: 5
  
Employment type: Permanent, full time
  
**1. Joining Arup**
  
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.
  
Arup Digital Products (ADP) develops and commercialises specialist engineering software globally. Our ambition is to become a commercially robust software business that turns Arup’s trusted expertise into scalable products that provides strategic value for the firm. As ADP diversifies across products, markets and regions, we need connected customer and revenue journeys, trusted data and systems that combine global consistency with appropriate local flexibility.
  
We are seeking an experienced Senior Revenue Operations Manager to build and lead a scalable revenue-operations capability for our growing multi-product, international software business.

  

**2. The Opportunity**
  
This role will build the revenue operations backbone for ADP’s next phase of growth. You will own the systems, data and operating processes that support the customer-to-revenue lifecycle, helping ADP scale new products, commercial models and markets with greater consistency and control.
  
You will own the development roadmap for Dynamics 365, HubSpot and any other key commercial operations systems for ADP. Our Dynamics platform extends beyond conventional CRM to support product and pricing data, quoting, order and licence delivery records, invoice preparation, royalty reporting and customer support. You will lead the developers and delivery partners who maintain and improve this environment.
  
Working across Sales, Marketing, Product, Software Engineering, Customer Support and Success, Customer Operations, Finance and Digital Technology, you will translate agreed pricing, product, licensing and go-to-market decisions into scalable systems, data, workflows and controls.
  
The role sits within ADP’s Operations Function. Reporting to ADP’s Global Commercial Manager, you will work cross-functionally across the global business and manage the India-based CRM development team, specialist technology suppliers and relevant Arup Digital Technology stakeholders.
  
You will use AI, automation and workflow technology to simplify work, improve data quality and reduce cost,.
  
You will shape a business-led revenue systems roadmap, strengthening ownership of commercial data and determining how Dynamics, HubSpot, licensing tools and wider Arup platforms should work together. This will include representing ADP’s requirements in any future integration between Dynamics and Arup’s wider commercial systems.
  
Your principal responsibilities will include:
  

* Own the development roadmap and governance for Dynamics 365, HubSpot, licensing tools and connected revenue systems, aligning investment and delivery priorities with ADP’s product pipeline and growth plans.
* Lead ADP’s in-house D365 CRM developers, HubSpot consultants and technology partners, setting priorities, requirements, delivery standards, testing, documentation, releases and user support arrangements.
* Own HubSpot as ADP’s top-of-funnel platform, governing lead capture, quality, lifecycle stages and hand-off to Dynamics.
* Oversee integrations across CRM, marketing, licensing and finance systems, defining process boundaries, data flows, controls and ADP’s requirements for future platform changes.
* Lead revenue operations improvements with an aim to increase robustness to handle multiple product portfolios across multiple regions. Improvement aspects in both processes and revenue data quality & definitions.
* Enable functional leads to establish clear data ownership, governance and quality standards across the commercial lifecycle.
* Partner with functional leaders to translate agreed pricing, product configurations, licensing models and go-to-market decisions into scalable operating systems and processes.
* Establish the system controls, data and reporting processes required to support reliable commercial and financial reporting, including sales commission calculations, working closely with Finance and other functional owners and supporting relevant audit coordination.
* Enable Finance and Sales to operate effective forecasting processes through appropriate systems, data, controls and governance.
* Drive system adoption through appropriate technology training, onboarding, SOPs, in-system guidance and maintained knowledge content.
* Implement AI and automation where appropriate and remove inefficient processes and controls.

As ADP expands its portfolio, markets and revenue, you will build a global Revenue Operations capability that combines software-business agility with Arup’s expertise. This is a unique opportunity to create the operating infrastructure through which ADP takes products to market, processes revenue and supports customers.
  
Success in the role will be demonstrated through outcomes including:
  

* clear ownership and an effective development roadmap for ADP’s revenue and commercial systems;
* strong adoption of Dynamics, HubSpot and other business systems, supported by effective leadership of developers, consultants and suppliers;
* agreed product, pricing, licensing and go-to-market decisions translated effectively into scalable operating systems and processes;
* well-governed commercial data, effective system controls and reliable reporting that support operational and financial decision-making;
* more consistent and scalable customer-to-revenue processes across products, markets and functional teams;
* measurable improvements in efficiency, data quality and user experience across business systems and processes;
* targeted use of AI and automation delivering evidenced productivity, quality or cost benefits;
* overall, a revenue systems capability that can support new products, regions and commercial models without avoidable complexity.

At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.

**3. Is this role right for you?**
  
This role is part of Arup Digital Products. We are seeking a senior Revenue Operations manager who can set direction, remain close to delivery and build scalable operating capability in a growing, multi-product software business. You should bring:
  

* Around 10 years or more relevant experience, including several years leading Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations or Business Systems within a rapidly growing B2B software, SaaS or technology business.
* Ownership of Dynamics 365 or a comparable enterprise CRM, together with HubSpot or similar marketing-automation technology, including platform roadmaps, governance and adoption.
* A track record of leading revenue systems transformation.
* Experience translating pricing, product, licensing and go-to-market decisions into scalable systems, data, workflows and controls across the customer-to-revenue lifecycle.
* Experience leading CRM developers, consultants or technical teams, ideally distributed globally, including setting development priorities and overseeing requirements, testing, releases, support and integration delivery.
* Practical experience improving commercial data, pipeline management, forecasting, reporting and governance in close partnership with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product and Operations.
* Evidence of delivering automation, workflow or AI initiatives with measurable operational benefits.
* Experience building scalable operating processes in an agile, fast-moving environment.

You will be comfortable working across functions, geographies and time zones, with sufficient overlap with colleagues in Japan and the United Kingdom and close collaboration with India-based teams. You will combine strategic perspective with a hands-on approach to systems, data, processes and users.
  
You should distinguish technology issues from underlying process, ownership, data and capability gaps; challenge unclear requirements constructively; and deliver practical solutions suited to ADP’s scale and maturity.
  
Experience of software licensing, subscription or usage-based commercial models, product and pricing data, finance system integration, customer support platforms, engineering software or distributor channels would be advantageous but is not essential.

**4. What we offer you**
  
At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.
  
Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.
  
We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.
  
India-specific details of rewards and benefits will be provided as part of the recruitment process.

  

**5. Different people, shared values**
  
Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age within legal limits, gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.
  
Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup.
  
We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact the relevant recruiter to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.

**6. Our Application Process**
  
Applications will be reviewed against the essential experience and capabilities set out above. Shortlisted candidates should expect an initial interview focused on relevant Revenue Operations and transformation experience, followed by a practical assessment or case discussion considering systems ownership, data, process improvement and stakeholder management.
  
Final-stage candidates may meet cross-functional senior stakeholders from Business Operations, Customer Operations and other relevant ADP functions.
  
Stay safe online – Arup will never ask for your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

description:
**Description**
**Brand Partnerships & Portfolio Ownership**

* Own the account management of gift card brand partnerships —performance management and renewal.
* Build and deepen direct relationships with anchor brands (Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and equivalent large-format retail, fashion, QSR, fuel, travel, electronics and lifestyle brands) and expand coverage across under-penetrated categories.
* Manage relationships with domestic gift card aggregators and content providers (Pine Labs / Qwikcilver, Vouchagram and others) to ensure catalogue depth, competitive rates, inventory availability and fulfilment reliability — while progressively moving high-volume brands to direct tie-ups where it improves margin.
* Maintain a live brand map and category coverage plan; identify and close gaps against competing distributors and marketplaces.
* Support launch of new global brands entering India, and expand existing brands into new use cases (consumer rewards, employee benefits, channel incentives, corporate gifting).

**Commercials, Margin & Offers**

* Negotiate and continuously improve brand commercials — base discounts, slab-based and volume-linked margins, incentive and rebate structures, marketing support and payment/credit terms.
* Secure differentiated and, where possible, exclusive consumer offers, cashback and promotional constructs that channel partners can merchandise to drive conversion.
* Own brand-wise margin performance; track realised versus contracted margin and drive corrective action with brands and internal teams.
* Build and present brand-wise revenue, volume and margin projections based on inputs from brands, channel partners and the channel sales team; track actuals against plan and explain variances.
* Benchmark competitor commercials and offer constructs in the domestic gift card market and use these insights in negotiations.

**Digital Distribution & Scale (with Channel Partnership Team)**

* Work hand-in-hand with the channel partnership and channel sales teams to enable the domestic gift card catalogue across digital distribution partners — banks, fintech apps, e-commerce and retail platforms, loyalty and rewards programmes, and corporate gifting channels.
* Drive catalogue placement, merchandising, visibility and campaign calendars on partner interfaces, working with the product and marketing teams.
* Translate brand-level commercials into channel-level pricing and incentive constructs that make the business attractive and profitable for distribution partners.
* Run joint business reviews with key channel partners; identify growth levers for under-performing brands and channels and execute against them.
* Partner with the internal marketing team to build promotions, festive and seasonal campaigns and co-branded activity with brands.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Act as the single point of connect between brand partners and internal teams — Product, Technology, Operations, Reconciliation, Finance, Legal, Compliance and Channel Sales.
* Work with Operations and Customer Support to set processes for order fulfilment, voucher delivery, inventory availability, refunds and escalations, ensuring a strong end-customer experience at channel partners.
* Work with the Reconciliation and Finance teams on settlement cycles, invoicing, credit and float management, dispute resolution and timely closure of brand and channel reconciliation.
* Coordinate with Technology and Product for API integrations, catalogue management, order-management improvements and new feature rollouts required by brands or channels.
* Manage contract negotiations with brands in collaboration with Legal, Finance, Product and Operations to secure internal approvals and execute opportunities.
* Evaluate the financial and strategic benefit of partnerships and present business cases and portfolio reviews to Euronet management.

**Business Ownership & Governance**

* Carry and deliver the annual revenue, GMV/TPV and margin targets for the domestic gift card portfolio.
* Own all KPIs including the P&L for domestic gift card sales, covering end-to-end management of the sales cycle.
* Maintain governance rhythm — monthly brand reviews, quarterly business reviews with top brands and aggregators, and periodic management reporting on portfolio health.
* Ensure partner contracts, commercial approvals and operating processes remain audit-ready and compliant with internal policy and applicable regulation.

**Requirements**

* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate the value of epay’s products and distribution reach to brands.
* Result-oriented, self-driven and effective in a fast-paced environment.
* Strategic thinker with strong analytical skills, commercial acumen and process orientation.
* High customer centricity with focus on partner success and long-term relationships.
* Dynamic professional with a hands-on approach and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders

title: Account Manager
description:

Your contributions will help us fulfill our mission of advancing the background screening experience through visibility and insights, empowering our clients to make smarter, unbiased decisions.**
**Job Description**
The Account Manager is a consultative client leader responsible for strengthening strategic partnerships, retaining and expanding assigned accounts, and growing revenue. Through regular engagement with stakeholders at all levels, the Account Manager becomes a trusted advisor on background screening services and related solutions, identifies opportunities and risks, and delivers recommendations supported by business insights and ROI. The role maintains continuity from the final stages of the sales cycle through onboarding and ongoing account management, coordinating internal and external resources to meet client requirements and maximize long-term value.

* Client relationship leadership: Build and cultivate relationships with corporate contacts and stakeholders at all levels to strengthen Accurate’s position and create opportunities for incremental business.
* Strategic account planning: Develop and maintain comprehensive account plans with short-, mid-, and long-term priorities designed to grow each client partnership.
* Business reviews and insights: Prepare annual performance reviews, multi-year account plans, usage analyses, and reporting for recurring client meetings.
* Revenue growth: Identify white-space opportunities, penetrate new business units and divisions, position relevant solutions, and consistently achieve or exceed assigned sales targets.
* Commercial management: Negotiate pricing and implementation requirements, prepare proposals and ROI-based recommendations, and advance opportunities through Accurate’s defined sales cycle.
* Client and industry expertise: Maintain a strong understanding of each client’s business, market, and industry trends to deliver proactive, strategic recommendations.
* Risk and retention management: Monitor account activity and usage, identify emerging issues or churn risks, and present clear mitigation plans to key stakeholders.
* Cross-functional execution: Coordinate internal teams, ATS providers, and other external partners to implement new services, integrations, and client solutions successfully.
* Special projects: Lead client-driven initiatives and other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: At least three years of background screening and client-facing experience required; OR three or more years of account management experience in an HR-related/Ed-tech/HR Tech/SaAs industry preferred.
* Business and technical proficiency: Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, with the ability to interpret client data and translate insights into actions.
* Judgment and problem-solving: Demonstrated ability to exercise sound decision-making, navigate complex situations, formulate practical solutions, and offer well-considered alternatives.
* Organization and execution: Strong ability to prioritize work, manage multiple responsibilities, and use time efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively across client and internal stakeholder levels.
* Drive: Self-motivated, proactive, and accountable for delivering client and business outcomes.

**This is an Onsite role with US shift timings - 6pm to 3:30 AM (Transportation will be provided both ways)**
**The Accurate Way**
We offer a fun, fast-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. To do this, we follow four guiding principles – Take Ownership, Be Open, Stay Curious, Work as One – core values that dictate what we stand for, and how we behave.
  
  
**Take ownership.**
Be accountable for your actions, your team, and the company. Accept responsibility willingly, especially when it’s what’s best for our customers. Give others every reason to trust you, believe in you, and count on you. Rise to every occasion with your personal best.
  
  
**Be open.**
Be open to new ideas. Be inclusive of people and ways of doing things. Make yourself accessible and approachable, and communicate with genuineness, transparency, honesty, and respect. Embrace differences.
  
  
**Stay curious.**
Stay curious even as you move forward. Tirelessly ask questions and challenge the status quo in your pursuit of new ideas, ways to solve problems, and to continually grow and improve.
  
  
**Work as one.**
Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.
  
  
**Equal opportunities**
Accurate is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Accurate will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.
  
  
You must have a right to work in Australia indefinitely that does not involve sponsorship by the Company.
  
  
**Special Notice**
Accurate is aware of schemes involving fraudulent job postings/offers and/or individuals or entities claiming to be employees of Accurate. Those involved are offering fabricated employment opportunities to applicants, often asking for sensitive personal and financial information. If you believe you have been contacted by anyone misrepresenting themselves as an employee of Accurate, please contact humanresources@accurate.com.

**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
Wealth and Personal Banking serves more than 50 million customers worldwide with a complete range of banking and wealth management services to enable them to manage their finances and protect and build their financial futures. It is a global business that brings together management responsibility for Retail Banking, Wealth Management, Insurance and Asset Management with a focus on customer-centric propositions and innovative and efficient distribution channels.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the Wealth and Personal Banking-Overseas Indian team.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the
**Premier Banking**
team.
  
  
**Job Introduction**
As a Premier Relationship Manager or Senior Premier Relationship Manager or Corporate Executive Relationship Manager at HSBC, you will be at the forefront of our flagship "Premier Banking" offering, serving as a vital link to our high-net-worth individual (HNI) clients. Your primary responsibility is to cultivate and expand HSBC Premier relationships, aligning with business targets and strategic plans.
  
  
You will act as a single point of contact for Premier customers, anticipating their needs and delivering comprehensive banking and financial advisory services. Your role involves ensuring exceptional customer service in accordance with Global Premier Service Standards, identifying opportunities for wealth reviews, and providing tailored wealth solutions.
  
  
Success in this role requires maintaining the highest standards of integrity, adhering to regulatory requirements, and fostering trust with both the bank and our clients.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**
**Business Impact:**

* Maximize profit and growth of Premier client portfolios by developing new and existing relationships.
* Achieve financial targets through effective client engagement and service delivery.
* Conduct regular client reviews to understand needs and recommend suitable products and services. Cross sell products

**Client Management**

* Build and maintain strong client relationships to ensure retention and satisfaction. Need based selling
* Utilize client relationship management tools to keep client information accurate and up to date.
* Develop strategies to increase wallet share and manage a prospect pipeline effectively.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work as part of an integrated branch management team to meet standards and deliver operating models.
* Collaborate with colleagues across the business to support client needs and achieve performance measures.

**Operational Excellence**

* Ensure compliance with HSBC's policies, including KYC, AML, and sanctions guidelines.
* Manage operational risk and adhere to sales quality requirements.
* Attend mandatory training and report any unusual activities promptly.

**Leadership & Development**

* Support team members and contribute to a positive work environment.
* Establish a network of internal relationships and gather feedback from colleagues and clients.

**Knowledge & Experience**
**Education Qualifications / Certifications and Requirements:**

* Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* Industry Experience:

+ GCB 6: 3 to 5 years of relevant experience.

* Sales Achievements: Demonstrated success & experience in Wealth products.
* Client Relationship Management: Proven experience managing relationships with high-net-worth clients.
* Wealth Management Expertise: Strong technical skills in wealth management.
* Communication & Influence: Excellent communication skills with a focus on client engagement and influence.
* Sales & Networking Skills: Strong orientation towards sales, networking, and portfolio management.
* Product Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of financial services products, services, and client relationship management systems.
* Business Banking Insight: Familiarity with business banking client segments and related products and services.
* Regulatory Compliance: Possession of valid licences and accreditations in wealth management as required by local regulations.
* Risk Management: Ability to collaborate effectively with Compliance, Credit & Risk, and Internal Control teams to maintain a balanced risk environment.
* Language Proficiency: Proficient in English and local languages.

**Accreditations**

* Professional Qualifications: Obtain necessary professional and regulatory certifications such as AMFI, IRDA, NISM XXI A (PMS Certification), and NISM XIII (SIF Certification) as per market requirements.

**Pro-tip :**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  

* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: India Customer Success Leader
description:
NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. In 2023, NIQ combined with GfK, bringing together two industry leaders with unparalleled global reach. With a holistic retail read and the most comprehensive consumer insights—delivered through advanced analytics and state-of-the-art platforms—NIQ delivers the Full View™.

NIQ operates in 100+ markets, covering more than 90% of the world’s population. For more information, visit
https://www.niq.com
.

**Job Description**

**India Customer Success Leader**

**Location: Gurgaon/ Mumbai**

**The Role**

We are seeking a transformational Customer Success & Consulting Leader to drive strategic growth, customer value realization, and executive engagement across NielsenIQ’s FMCG and Technology & Durables businesses in India. This leader will define and execute the customer success strategy, build deep C-suite relationships, and position NIQ as a trusted strategic partner for some of India's leading organizations.

The successful candidate will combine strong commercial acumen, consulting expertise, customer leadership, and people management capabilities to accelerate growth, strengthen client partnerships, and deliver measurable business outcomes. They will serve as the voice of the customer internally while influencing strategic decisions across Commercial, Product, Analytics, Data Science, and Operations teams.

This highly visible leadership role offers the opportunity to shape a future-ready Customer Success organization, foster a culture of collaboration and excellence, and influence the future direction of NielsenIQ's customer engagement model

**Key Leadership Accountabilities**

**Strategic Customer Leadership**

* Build and manage strategic relationships with C-suite executives across key customer accounts, positioning NIQ as a trusted advisor and growth partner for both the verticals
* Act as the voice of customers within NielsenIQ, ensuring customer priorities are reflected in product innovation, business planning, and service delivery strategies
* Lead customer transformation conversations, connecting market intelligence, analytics, and insights to measurable business outcomes. Drive customer adoption, value realization, retention, and long-term partnership growth
* Serve as the executive escalation point for critical customer opportunities and challenges

**Drive Commercial Growth**

* Drive a disciplined account growth strategy by identifying whitespace opportunities, expanding strategic partnerships, and accelerating cross-sell and upsell initiatives
* Partner closely with Commercial, Product, Pricing, and Operations teams to unlock sustainable growth and maximize customer lifetime value
* Influence revenue growth by aligning customer priorities with NIQ capabilities and innovation roadmap
* Create a scalable framework for value-based customer engagement that strengthens loyalty and accelerates growth

**Lead a High-Performing Organization**

* Inspire, align, and empower a high-performing Customer Success and Consulting organization to achieve ambitious growth and customer impact objectives
* Develop future-ready capabilities and a strong leadership pipeline through coaching, talent development, mentoring, and succession planning
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, customer centricity, and excellence
* Drive organizational effectiveness through clear governance, workforce planning, resource allocation, and fit-for-purpose operating models
* Champion employee engagement, inclusion, and continuous learning to build a best-in-class Customer Success function

**Shape Cross-Functional Strategy**

* Influence strategic priorities and decisions across Commercial, Product, Data Science, Engineering, Operations, and Analytics teams to deliver integrated customer outcomes
* Translate customer needs and market opportunities into clear priorities for business planning, solution development, and service innovation
* Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve customer experience, operational excellence, solution adoption, and overall business performance
* Establish strong alignment and accountability across functions to ensure consistent execution against strategic customer commitments
* Contribute customer and market perspectives to NielsenIQ’s broader India business strategy and innovation agenda

**E**
**stablish Customer Success Excellence**

* Define and institutionalize Customer Success methodologies, performance standards, governance mechanisms, and operating rhythms across the organization
* Build differentiated and scalable customer engagement models based on customer needs, strategic value, and growth potential
* Establish a disciplined approach to measuring customer health, adoption, value realization, satisfaction, retention, and growth
* Leverage customer insights, market intelligence, and performance data to proactively identify risks, resolve barriers, and unlock growth opportunities
* Drive continuous improvement across customer experience, service quality, consulting effectiveness, and operational efficiency
* Embed best practices and capability-building programs that strengthen Customer Success maturity and deliver consistent customer outcomes

**What Success Looks Like**

The successful leader will:

* Elevate NielsenIQ's strategic position with key customers
* Increase customer retention, advocacy, and lifetime value
* Accelerate revenue growth across existing customer portfolios
* Strengthen executive-level customer relationships
* Improve Net Promoter Scores (NPS) and customer satisfaction metrics
* Build a highly engaged and high-performing team
* Drive greater adoption of NielsenIQ's analytics, measurement, and consulting solutions
* Create a scalable and future-ready Customer Success organization

**Why This Role?**

This is not a traditional Customer Success leadership position.

It is an opportunity to lead a strategically important function at the intersection of customer growth, consulting, analytics, and commercial strategy. You will shape how some of the world's leading brands leverage data and insights to make critical business decisions while building a high-performing team and influencing the future direction of NielsenIQ's customer engagement model.

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years of progressive leadership experience across Customer Success, Consulting, Consumer Intelligence, FMCG, Retail, Analytics, Professional Services, or related industries
* Proven track record of leading large customer-facing teams, driving customer outcomes, and delivering sustainable business growth
* Demonstrated success building strategic client partnerships and influencing C-suite stakeholders
* Strong commercial mindset with experience identifying and converting growth opportunities through expansion, cross-sell, and value-based engagement
* Strong understanding of how data, analytics, insights, and measurement solutions drive business performance and customer outcomes
* Experience working with FMCG clients and a strong understanding of the consumer goods landscape will be a distinct advantage
* Experience in market research, consumer intelligence, data-driven consulting, or value-based solution selling is preferred

**Additional Information**

**Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

NIQ may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools at various stages of the recruitment process, including résumé screening, candidate assessments, interview scheduling, job matching, communication support, and certain administrative tasks that help streamline workflows. These tools are intended to improve efficiency and support fair and consistent evaluation based on job-related criteria. All use of AI is governed by NIQ’s principles of fairness, transparency, human oversight, and inclusion. Final hiring decisions are made exclusively by humans. NIQ regularly reviews its AI tools to help mitigate bias and ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations. If you have questions, require accommodations, or wish to request human review were permitted by law, please contact your local HR representative. For more information, please visit NIQ’s AI Safety Policies and Guiding Principles: https://nielseniq.com/global/en/info/niqs-ai-safety-policies/

  

**About NIQ**

NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. In 2023, NIQ combined with GfK, bringing together the two industry leaders with unparalleled global reach. With a holistic retail read and the most comprehensive consumer insights—delivered with advanced analytics through state-of-the-art platforms—NIQ delivers the Full View™. NIQ is an Advent International portfolio company with operations in 100+ markets, covering more than 90% of the world’s population.

For more information, visit NIQ.com

Want to keep up with our latest updates?

Follow us on: LinkedIn | Instagram | Twitter | Facebook

  

**Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**

At NIQ, we are steadfast in our commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace that mirrors the rich diversity of the communities and markets we serve. We believe that embracing a wide range of perspectives drives innovation and excellence. All employment decisions at NIQ are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We invite individuals who share our dedication to inclusivity and equity to join us in making a meaningful impact. To learn more about our ongoing efforts in diversity and inclusion, please visit the https://nielseniq.com/global/en/news-center/diversity-inclusion

title: Sale Manager- Battery Materials
description:
We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future.
  
  
We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress.
  
  
Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background. At BASF, careers develop from opportunities .
  
  
**About The Role**
The position is responsible for driving the growth of BASF Battery Materials across South Asia & ASEAN by developing customers, advancing product qualifications and commercializing cathode active materials. The individual will coordinate effectively across internal functions and external stakeholders to drive lengthy customer qualification and commercialization cycles.
  
  

* Execute the regional business strategy by identifying priority customers and translating market needs into targeted commercial actions.
* Work closely with Regional and Global teams for effective cross-collaboration (e.g. R&D).
* Develop market potential through lead generation, opportunity qualification, forecasting, product recommendations and support qualification.
* Strengthen existing customer relationships while building new strategic accounts and partnerships across hierarchical levels at customers’ organization.
* Build BASF’s position and network as a trusted industry partner through active participation in conferences, exhibitions, roadshows and automotive forums..

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Regional business development: Build and execute the regional growth plan for South Asia and ASEAN, prioritize target markets and customers, and develop a qualified opportunity pipeline.
* Customer acquisition and account development: Engage cell manufacturers, battery producers, OEMs and ecosystem partners; build strategic relationships and convert qualified opportunities into sustainable business.
* Qualification and commercialization: Lead customer programs from technical alignment and sampling through qualification, commercial framework finalization, contract negotiation and first regular supply.
* Market and competitor intelligence: Monitor customer investments, technology choices, localization trends, policy developments and competitor activity, and translate insights into commercial priorities and actions.
* Cross-functional coordination: Collaborate with regional product management, R&D, technical service and supply chain, as well as local finance and legal teams, to assess commercial risks and liabilities and support well-informed customer negotiations.
* Sales forecasting and reporting: Monitor sales performance, pipeline status and market trends; maintain accurate forecasts and provide timely, actionable updates to senior management.
* Compliance and regulatory affairs: Remain current on relevant policy frameworks, regulatory requirements and industry standards, and ensure commercial activities comply with applicable internal and external requirements.
* CRM management: Maintain accurate and timely customer, opportunity, qualification and activity data in Salesforce or an equivalent CRM; use the system to manage the pipeline, track follow-ups and support forecasting and management reporting.

* Delegation of Authority & License to Operate:

+ Ensure all work is in accordance with compliant business practices (BASF Standard Operating Procedures, EHS, Compliance, Stewardship). Be responsible for ensuring compliance with respect to BASF’s license to operate in your area of responsibility(ies).
+ Compliance in accordance with BASF Code of Conduct means adherence to:

- Applicable laws and regulations,
- Internal guidelines and policies, and
- Ethical business practices

+ Keep the Managing Director informed of any and all matters concerning or impacting Compliance from time to time.

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree - Chemical Sciences or Chemical Engineering; Executive management program or MBA preferred.
* 5-10 years in Sales of similar business line or Technical sales in chemical industry.
* Proven track record of success in sales roles within the sector or related technologies.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to effectively engage with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders at all levels.
* Strategic thinker with a results-oriented mindset and a proactive approach to identifying and pursuing business opportunities.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and CRM software; experience with Salesforce or similar platforms is a plus.
* Willingness to travel as needed to meet with clients, attend industry conferences, and participate in networking events.

title: MDS AMEA Customer Experience Regional Lead
description:
**Job Description**
**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.**
You are part of a team that experiments with cutting-edge technologies, delivering solutions revealed as a result of the testing and learnings, and developing strong partnerships to enable growth through innovation and agile methodologies.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
You will implement pilot projects to drive disruptive ideas across the organization, using the learnings from these projects to inform decisions on whether to incorporate them as a portfolio project or to introduce them as a new proof of concept. You will also get to experiment with cutting-edge technologies while at the same time building strong partnerships within the business to build a strong pipeline of ideas to pursue. In addition, you will get to bring the outside in by building relationships with start-ups and building your knowledge of actual proof-of-concept cases, and scope, align, adopt and leverage technology for respective learnings and pilots.
  
  
**What You Will Bring**
A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
  
  

* Project management including knowledge of Agile
* Technical expertise and a passion for innovation, understanding a variety of disruptive technology products and services
* Technical and business acumen to evaluate opportunities with internal and external partners
* Machine learning/artificial intelligence programming languages
* The start-up landscape
* Familiarity with the fast-moving consumer goods or related sector
* Leading internal and external teams through complex challenges and developing creative solutions/options
* Driving for results and Analytical Skills

**More About This Role**
**What you need to know about this position:**
This is a hands-on leadership role with a
**Product mindset**
— not a coordination or engagement function. The OTC Regional Success Manager is the
**regional integrator**
across all four OTC product areas, responsible for connecting strategy to execution and ensuring value delivery at scale.
  
  
The role holder acts as the single point of accountability at the regional level for:
  
  

* Synergizing business requirements across Business Units
* Maintaining real-time visibility on project portfolio and operations performance
* Driving digital adoption of OTC tools
* Holding Product Managers and Operations leaders accountable for outcomes

This role spans all four OTC product areas:
  
  

* Order Capture - End-to-end order intake, validation, EDI/portal management
* Order Fulfillment - Order processing, availability, delivery execution & monitoring
* Bill to Cash - Invoicing, collections, cash application, dispute resolution
* Customer Care - Customer query handling, issue resolution, service performance

**What extra ingredients you will bring:**
**Regional OTC Community of Practice & Governance**

* Establish and sustain a Regional OTC Community of Practice spanning all four product areas.
* Drive a monthly governance cadence with structured inputs/outputs that feed all downstream accountabilities.
* Ensure the Community of Practice serves as the activation engine for change adoption, best practice sharing, and regional alignment.
* Curate and escalate regional themes, pain points, and opportunities into global product and operations forums.

**Business Requirements Synergization & Gatekeeper Role**

* Synergize and rationalize OTC business requirements (BRDs) at regional level in partnership with OTC Product Business Analysts.
* Act as the gatekeeper to prevent BU-level fragmentation — blocking unauthorized customizations in the form of MEs, siloed projects, shadow IT, or ungoverned local builds.
* Ensure all regional requirements are aligned with the enterprise product roadmap and S4/HANA migration timelines.
* Provide a consolidated regional demand view to Global Product Managers for backlog prioritization.

**Project Portfolio Visibility & Accountability**

* Own the OTC Project Portfolio view — maintaining real-time visibility across MEs, ND Projects, and Celonis-linked value delivery initiatives.
* Connect the dots between Funding, Cost, and Value Realization — ensuring every investment has a measurable outcome.
* Hold Product Managers accountable for delivery gaps, timeline slippages, and value leakage.
* Provide executive-ready portfolio reporting (weekly/monthly) to the Global OTC Lead and regional stakeholders.

**BPO Operations Performance & Accountability**

* Own the BPO Operations performance lens — tracking Celonis KPIs across the regional operations footprint.
* Hold Operations Leaders and OTC Product Managers accountable for performance gaps against contracted SLAs and KPIs.
* Drive corrective action plans when performance deviates from targets — not just flagging, but fixing.
* Partner with BPO governance leads to ensure operational insights inform technology roadmap priorities.

**Digital Adoption & Value Realization**

* Drive digital adoption of OTC tools (Celonis, SAP, Non-SAP) by setting adoption targets and measuring usage.
* Leverage the Community of Practice as the primary channel for driving tool awareness, training, and behavioral change.
* Track adoption metrics at country level to identify laggards and deploy targeted interventions.
* Ensure adoption translates to measurable business value (not just login counts, but process improvement outcomes).

**Experience**

* 12+ years of progressive experience in OTC/shared services operations, product management, or transformation leadership.
* 3+ years in a senior role (Senior Manager or Director) with cross-functional accountability.
* Proven track record of driving adoption and value realization across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Experience in OTC / Order Management / Finance shared services in a large CPG/FMCG or similar enterprise.
* Demonstrated ability to act as a gatekeeper — saying “no” to fragmentation while maintaining stakeholder relationships.
* Experience with process mining tools (Celonis preferred) and linking process insights to business outcomes.
* Familiarity with Agile product management frameworks and portfolio governance.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of OTC end-to-end processes: Order Capture, Fulfillment, Billing, Collections, Cash Application, Dispute Management, and Customer Care.
* Working knowledge of SAP ECC / S4HANA OTC modules (SD, FI-AR).
* Proficiency in Celonis — ability to interpret process mining data and translate into action.
* Familiarity with project portfolio management tools and dashboards.
* Data literacy — ability to connect cost, adoption, and value metrics into a coherent narrative.
* Financial acumen — understanding of funding models, cost allocation, and value realization tracking.

**Leadership & Soft Skills**

* Assertive accountability — ability to hold peers and senior stakeholders accountable without direct authority.
* Integrator mindset — connecting dots across products, projects, operations, and adoption.
* Executive communication — ability to synthesize complex information into clear, actionable insights.
* Influence without authority — driving outcomes through governance, data, and relationships.
* Strong stakeholder management across Supply Chain, Finance, IT, and Commercial functions.
* Data-driven decision making — leveraging analytics for prioritization and accountability.
* Cultural sensitivity and ability to operate effectively across diverse regional contexts

Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy
  
  
**Business Unit Summary**
At Mondelēz International, our purpose is to empower people to snack right by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. That means delivering a broad range of delicious, high-quality snacks that nourish life's moments, made with sustainable ingredients and packaging that consumers can feel good about.
  
  
We have a rich portfolio of strong brands globally and locally including many household names such as
*Oreo*
,
*belVita*
and
*LU*
biscuits;
*Cadbury Dairy Milk*
,
*Milka*
and
*Toblerone*
chocolate;
*Sour Patch Kids*
candy and
*Trident*
gum. We are proud to hold the top position globally in biscuits, chocolate and candy and the second top position in gum.
  
  
Our 80,000 makers and bakers are located in more than 80 countries and we sell our products in over 150 countries around the world. Our people are energized for growth and critical to us living our purpose and values. We are a diverse community that can make things happen—and happen fast.
  
  
Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
**Job Type**
Regular

title: Human Capital - Total Rewards Benefits Operate- Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Human Capital**
Our Human Capital practice is at the forefront of transforming the nature of work. As converging forces reshape industries, our team uniquely addresses the complexities of work, workforce, and workplace dynamics. We leverage sector-specific insights and cross-domain perspectives to help organizations tackle their most challenging workforce issues and align talent strategies with their strategic visions. Our practice is renowned for making work better for humans and humans better at work. Be part of this exciting era of change and join us on this transformative journey.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a
**Total Rewards Benefits Operate Manager**
, you will lead work at the intersection of
**benefits strategy, administration operations, and enabling technology**
. You’ll help clients and internal teams translate benefits requirements into scalable platform capabilities—understanding what leading
**benefits administration providers**
can deliver, how
**HCM platforms**
connect to those ecosystems, and what it takes to drive successful implementation and ongoing operations. This will be achieved either through use of Deloitte’s proprietary BenefitIQ technology and/or other market solutions as appropriate.
  
  
You’ll be accountable for delivering high-quality outcomes, managing teams and stakeholders, and shaping product-enabled solutions that improve member experience, administrative efficiency, and compliance-aligned execution.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage the global benefits operations for different clients, administering health and welfare, pension, leave, and other rewards programs across the full-service lifecycle, from discovery and solution, design through implementation, operational readiness, ongoing delivery, and customer support.
* Own benefits administration engagements end-to-end, holding full accountability for service delivery, financial performance, and client satisfaction across benefits administration scopes. Accountable for end-to-end SLA/XLA delivery, quality, and compliance across all in-scope benefits operations towers.
* Serve as the primary operational relationship owner for the client.
* Lead client governance, manage escalations, and own the relationship with client HR / Total Rewards / Benefits leadership and benefits vendors
* Communicate effectively with client stakeholders (HR, Total Rewards, HRIT, Payroll, vendors) and internal leadership.
* Partner with cross-functional internal teams to provide cohesive and seamless client experience as one Deloitte.
* Drive growth within the account — identifying expansion opportunities, upsell, and new service lines
* Guide decisions on vendor/platform fit based on client context, administrative complexity, and operating model needs.
* Support operational design including SOPs, roles/responsibilities, case management, escalations, controls, and service metrics.
* Contribute to proposals, estimates, delivery plans, status reporting, and risk/issue management.
* Drive continuous improvement and process optimization

**The Team**
Our Insights, Innovation & Operate Offering is designed to enhance key aspects of our clients' businesses by leveraging cutting-edge technology, data, and a blend of deep technical and human expertise. We innovate and deliver creative, industry-specific solutions that streamline operations and accelerate speed-to-value.
  
  
**Required Qualification:**

* Bachelor's degree
* A total of 10+ years of progressive experience in global benefits administration, spanning implementation, day-to-day operations, process optimization, customer care, and/or working in vendor or service provider environments
* 3+ years of people-management experience leading teams responsible for benefits administration, including system configuration and ongoing operational delivery
* 3+ years of experience leading benefits administration for multinational clients, with accountability for service quality, compliance, and client satisfaction across multiple countries
* Hands-on experience with Human Capital Management (HCM) platform data management and payroll integrations supporting rewards or benefits programs, including eligibility rules, life and qualifying events, payroll deductions, and file-based data exchanges

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* HR or benefits-related professional certification (e.g., CEBS, GBA, or SHRM-CP/SCP, HRCI, or equivalent)
* Experience working with multiple benefits administration providers across both implementation and ongoing service delivery
* In-depth understanding of the benefits technology landscape, including the capabilities, strengths, and limitations of Workday and other leading HCM and benefits administration platforms.
* Good knowledge of global benefits practices, regulatory considerations, and market trends
* Proven track record of building and managing strong, collaborative relationships with benefits carriers, vendors, and service providers
* Solid understanding of core HCM concepts and integration patterns, such as worker and benefit event data, payroll deductions, file-based vs. API integrations, and inbound/outbound data feeds.

**Possible Locations**
: Gurugram, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Mumbai, Chennai, Pune, Kolkata
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: AVP - Strategic Alliances & Product Management
description:
**Job Description – Strategic Alliances & Product Management**
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**Designation:**
Manager / Senior Manager / AVP
  
  
**Department:**
Wealth Management / Asset Management
  
  
**Experience:**
6–12 Years
  
  
**Industry:**
Asset Management / Wealth Management / Banking / Financial Services
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an experienced professional to drive strategic distribution partnerships and product management initiatives for AIML's investment offerings. The role will focus on establishing relationships with banks, wealth management firms, and financial intermediaries to expand product distribution, while ensuring effective product positioning, sales enablement, and coordination with internal stakeholders.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Strategic Alliances & Distribution Partnerships
* Identify, develop, and manage strategic partnerships with banks, wealth management companies, and financial intermediaries for distribution of AIML's investment products.
* Drive distributor onboarding, commercial discussions, and relationship management to expand the distribution network.
* Present and position investment offerings, including Mauritius-based USD-denominated funds, Portfolio Management Services (PMS), and Market Linked Debentures (MLDs).

title: Growth & Revenue Lead
description:
**About Project Noon**

Project Noon is building India's first Sun Control brand- reimagining how people protect, comfort, and recover from everyday sun exposure. We believe the future of sun care goes far beyond sunscreen, and we're creating an entirely new category of products designed to help people live better under the sun.

Built at The Foundery, backed by Nikhil Kamath, Kishore Biyani, and Ronnie Screwvala, Project Noon is being built as a next-generation consumer brand with the ambition to define a new category from India for the world. By combining breakthrough product innovation, thoughtful design, and world-class brand building, we're creating a company that's changing the way millions of people experience the sun.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Revenue Lead to own and drive Project Noon's revenue performance across every sales channel. This is a high-ownership, commercially focused role for someone who can connect the dots between channel strategy, sales execution, marketing investment, customer behaviour and business profitability.

You will be responsible for translating the company's growth ambitions into clear channel-wise targets and actionable plans across D2C, e-commerce marketplaces, quick commerce and general/traditional trade. You will build the revenue planning and reporting discipline that helps the business understand where growth is coming from, what is holding it back, and where to place its next bets.

This role works closely with the Founder and is a central partner to Performance Marketing, Brand, Finance, Supply Chain and external channel partners. It offers the opportunity to shape the commercial engine of an ambitious, early-stage consumer brand as it scales.

**Experience:**

Minimum 5 years of relevant experience across fast growing FMCG brands

**Work arrangement:**

Full-time, on-site | Worli, Mumbai

**Key Responsibilities:*****Revenue Strategy & Channel Ownership***

* Own the overall revenue plan and delivery against monthly, quarterly and annual business targets.
* Develop channel-wise growth strategies and targets across D2C, e-commerce marketplaces, quick commerce and GT/MT.
* Track revenue, orders, average order value, repeat behaviour, channel mix and growth trends; identify gaps and build clear action plans.
* Identify opportunities to improve channel productivity, expand distribution, increase product visibility and accelerate sell-through.
* Build a strong understanding of the economics, operating models and growth levers of each channel.

***Commercial Planning & Performance***

* Build and maintain revenue forecasts, budgets, monthly business plans and channel-wise performance dashboards.
* Monitor net sales, gross-to-net movements, discounts, promotions, commissions, trade spends and contribution margins.
* Strategize on & Evaluate the commercial impact of offers, bundles, pricing, assortment, launches and channel-specific promotions.
* Partner with Finance to track revenue realisation, channel costs, profitability, reconciliations and business performance.
* Use data to distinguish between topline growth and profitable, sustainable growth.

***Channel Partner & Account Management***

* Build and manage working relationships with marketplace, quick-commerce and other channel partners.
* Coordinate with channel teams on onboarding, assortment, catalogue readiness, visibility plans, promotional calendars and business reviews.
* Track channel-specific requirements, commercial terms, campaign opportunities and execution timelines.
* Work with partners to address sales or operational bottlenecks and improve availability, discoverability and conversion.

***Growth & Cross-Functional Collaboration***

* Work closely with the Performance Marketing Associate to connect paid media performance with overall revenue outcomes, channel priorities and business targets.
* Collaborate with Brand and Creative teams to translate consumer, category and channel insights into campaigns, launches, offers and growth initiatives.
* Partner with Supply Chain & Operations on demand forecasts, inventory availability, replenishment priorities and launch planning to minimise stock-outs and excess inventory.
* Work with Finance to ensure that revenue reporting, budgets, channel costs and profitability metrics are accurate and timely.
* Bring together insights from D2C, marketplaces and quick commerce to identify what is working, what is not, and where the business should focus.

***Reporting & Business Reviews***

* Own the weekly and monthly revenue review cadence, including channel-wise performance against targets.
* Create clear, decision-oriented reports that explain performance drivers, risks, opportunities and recommended actions.
* Establish consistent metrics, reporting definitions and processes so that leadership has a reliable view of business performance.
* Translate analysis into decisions and follow through to ensure agreed actions are implemented.

**What We're Looking For**

* A minimum of 5 years of experience in revenue, sales, business growth, category management, e-commerce or commercial roles.
* Previous experience in fast-paced FMCG or consumer brands is ideal; experience in D2C, beauty, skincare, personal care, wellness or lifestyle is highly relevant.
* Strong understanding of multi-channel consumer businesses, ideally spanning D2C, e-commerce marketplaces and quick commerce.
* Demonstrated ability to own revenue targets, build forecasts and translate business goals into channel-level plans.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including familiarity with net revenue, gross margins, contribution margins, discounts, trade spends and channel economics.
* Comfortable working with data, building and interpreting dashboards, and using Excel/Google Sheets to drive decisions.
* Strong stakeholder and partner-management skills, with the ability to work across internal teams and external platforms.
* A hands-on, ownership-oriented approach and the ability to operate in a fast-paced startup environment.

**Key Stakeholders & Liaison**

* Founder: revenue priorities, business reviews, growth plans and key commercial decisions.
* Performance Marketing Associate: paid marketing performance, acquisition efficiency, channel contribution and budget priorities.
* Finance: budgets, revenue reporting, reconciliations, channel costs and profitability.
* Brand & Creative: product launches, campaigns, promotions, consumer insights and channel-specific marketing plans.
* Supply Chain & Operations: demand planning, inventory availability, replenishment and fulfilment readiness.
* External channel partners: marketplace, quick-commerce and other sales-platform teams.

﻿

**Preferred Traits**

* Commercially sharp, analytical and comfortable taking ownership of business outcomes.
* A builder mindset: able to create structure, reporting rhythms and processes where they do not yet exist.
* Able to move between strategic thinking and hands-on execution.
* Curious about consumer behaviour, category trends and the evolving Indian beauty and personal-care landscape.
* Clear communicator who can influence stakeholders and turn insights into action.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, pace and the demands of building a new consumer category.
* Candidates from Tier-1 institutions will be preferred.

*Project Noon is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diverse perspectives and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.*

title: Practice Development Manager - Medical Devices
description:
**Practice Development Manager (Medical Devices / Digital Dentistry)**

Mumbai | Field sales, full time

I'm hiring a Practice Development Manager in Mumbai for a global MedTech leader in digital dentistry. You'll own a territory of dental and orthodontic practices, grow existing accounts, bring new doctors on board and help them move to digital workflows such as intraoral scanning, digital treatment planning and clear aligner therapy.

This is a sales role with clear numbers attached. What changes is the conversation. You'll sit with doctors and their teams as a business partner, look at how the practice runs and where it can grow, and sell on value rather than price. Parts of the territory are underpenetrated, so we need someone who enjoys building demand from a low base.

**What you'll do**

• Build and run a territory plan using account data and opportunity analysis

• Grow revenue with existing doctors and activate new practices

• Run consultative, value-led conversations with clinicians and handle competitive objections

• Drive adoption of digital workflows and help practices fit them into daily operations

• Work with clinical, marketing and training teams on doctor education and events

**What you need**

• 6 to 9 years of sales experience, with at least 4 years in medical devices

• Direct selling to doctors (surgeons, specialists, dentists). This is mandatory. Distributor-only or trade sales profiles won't fit

• Experience with an MNC medical device company or a global MNC pharma company

• A record of beating targets that you can back with numbers: rankings, awards, growth %

• Stable career history, around 2.5 to 3 years or more in each organisation

• Experience growing a low-revenue or new territory

• Degree in science, pharmacy, biomedical, engineering or similar. MBA is a plus

Dental or orthodontic experience helps but isn't required. Backgrounds that tend to do well: orthopaedics, cardiology, ophthalmology and surgical devices, diagnostics, capital equipment, and specialty pharma with strong doctor relationships.

**Package**

Fixed CTC up to ₹20 LPA, plus retirals, incentives of up to 65%, and medical insurance.

Many device sales people see dentistry as niche. In practice, this role builds clinician influence, digital adoption skills, territory ownership and practice consulting experience, all of which carry across healthcare technology. The company is also expanding its presence in India.

To apply, send your CV to megha@peopleedgehr.com or WhatsApp +91 93563 96466. Please mention your current CTC, notice period and target achievement for the last two years.

title: Customer Success Manager II
description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
  
  
**Role**
**Job Description**
As the primary point of contact for assigned customers and partners, this role involves relationship management with technical know-how. The position requires proactive communication, troubleshooting, and quality management, while also focusing on upsell opportunities and customer health. Key responsibilities include handling escalations, developing action plans, managing reports and dashboards, coordinating product updates and integrations, and maintaining customer-specific playbooks. This role demands a blend of customer service, industry expertise, and strategic thinking to ensure customer satisfaction and to drive business growth.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for top tier global Gracenote customers and partners
* Follow a cadence with clients, including dashboard and report reviews
* Create and deliver Quarterly Business Review (QBR) presentations, documenting highlights and action items.
* Monitor and ensure adherence to contractual commitments, including SLAs and NPS
* Drive internal engagement around upcoming renewals
* Gather valuable feedback on customer/partner strategic goals and recommend solutions for customer use cases with a focus on upsell opportunities
* Provide visibility to management on overall customer and partner health
* Strict adherence to adopt tools defined to track customer adoption, usage, health and other relevant metrics
* Drive internal improvements to enhance the customer/partner experience
* Handle quality escalations and issues unresolved through standard Customer Care processes, collaborating with internal departments to ensure timely resolution and preventive measures.
* Initiate and monitor action plans for identified quality trends and provide regular progress updates to customers/partners
* Coordinate data and information in response to and drafting of RFP/RFIs/SOWs and other new customer opportunity inquiries and proposals.
* Manage copyright infringement escalations
* Identify customers to receive standard Customer Dashboards, Quality Reports, and Product Usage Reports
* Coordinate setup of non-standard customer reports and dashboards as needed
* Work with management to design and implement key performance indicators (KPIs) for assigned segment
* Review key performance indicators (KPIs) regularly with customers/partners
* Communicate essential details to customers/partners about product retirements and replacement solutions
* Ensure customer readiness for new product features integration
* Coordinate completion of and deliver Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) for all Severity Level 1 Discrepancies and Quality Trends (as needed)
* Coordinate setup and delivery of new metadata for customers (new license deals) or partnership deals
* Manage customer/partner deliveries and communication for limited release products
* Create Product Inquiry tickets and coordinate customer responses
* Create and maintain customer and partner-specific playbooks

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience working in a global technical account management role demonstrating successful customer satisfaction and relationship management outcomes
* 3+ years of experience working with global accounts in the Media & Entertainment space; specifically with Platforms, Consumer Electronics, Pay TV or Publishers
* 4+ years of technical implementation experience with top global customers and partners
* 4+ years of hands on experience driving solutions and identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities
* Ability to work daytime hours for the regions of assigned global customers
* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities for interacting with customers, partners, and internal teams.
* Ability to identify, analyze, and resolve complex issues and find mutually beneficial solutions
* Project management experience, including skills to coordinate multiple tasks, deadlines, and stakeholders
* Expert-level presentation skills
* Support the Customer & Partnerships Success team with internal Crisis Management, as needed
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities efficiently and independently
* Flexibility to handle various customer needs and changing product landscapes
* Proficiency in creating and maintaining documentation
* Experience guiding customers and partners through complex changes
* Data analysis experience, including the ability to design, interpret and present data
* Ability to travel as needed to customer locations/trade shows

**Additional Information**
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Manager, Advisory Services, South Asia
description:

:

*either*
:

* 10+ years or more experience in banking, financial services, consulting, or other relevant role

* Must be willing to travel extensively within India and be on-site for extended durations

* Direct experience in the credit product lifecycle (e.g., underwriting, portfolio management, collections, operations)

* Demonstrated ability to execute and successfully manage multiple projects in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
