title: Growth Director - CleverAI
description:
**About The Role**
CleverAI is central to CleverTap's next phase of growth. This role is the single owner of making it succeed in the market: taking customers from adoption to measurable business impact, turning those wins into proof points, and converting that proof into revenue. You will work across Customer Success, Sales, Marketing and Product, with no ownership of any one of them but accountability for the combined outcome.
  
  
**What you will do?**

* Own the end-to-end CleverAI growth journey, from customer adoption, implementation, use-case discovery, measurement, and scaling.
* Define success metrics, adoption frameworks, and best practices to help customers achieve measurable business outcomes.
* Partner with Customer Success teams to drive seamless implementations, improve time-to-value, and resolve adoption challenges.
* Create repeatable onboarding frameworks, playbooks, and enablement programs for CSMs and AEs.
* Drive monetisation by partnering with Sales and CS teams on expansion opportunities, account strategies, and upsell motions.
* Enable Sales teams with AI use cases, customer insights, proof points, and positioning to support pipeline generation.
* Partner with Marketing to build the CleverAI narrative, customer stories, campaigns, and market-facing content.
* Act as the voice of the customer by gathering insights, influencing product improvements, and driving customer-centric innovation.
* Build a strong library of customer success stories, testimonials, and case studies that demonstrate business impact.
* Evangelise CleverAI internally by developing training programs, certifications, and resources to keep teams aligned as the product evolves.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 8+ years of experience in growth, product marketing, customer success, GTM or related functions, with prior experience in a growth team.
* Experience taking a product or feature from early adoption to scaled usage and revenue.
* Hands-on understanding of customer implementations and onboarding, and comfort working alongside CS teams on technical and data-dependent rollouts.
* Comfort with data: you define metrics, build dashboards or work with analysts, and use the numbers to tell a story.
* Strong cross-functional influence. You can align Sales, CS, Marketing and Product without direct authority.
* Credibility in customer and prospect conversations, including with senior stakeholders.
* Excellent storytelling, written and verbal, and the ability to turn complex AI capabilities into clear business outcomes.
* Background in martech, CRM, SaaS or data/AI products is a strong plus.

**Measures Of Success**

* Consistently drive high-quality CleverAI implementations, with faster time to go-live and time to first value
* Rising CleverAI adoption and depth of usage across customers
* A growing library of measurable customer success stories and testimonials
* Expansion and upsell revenue attributable to CleverAI
* CSMs and AEs confidently positioning and delivering CleverAI
* Visible product improvements driven by customer feedback

**Why join us**

* Contribute to a product backed by 11 technology patents, showcasing industry-leading innovation. You are passionate about technology and its impact on the high-growth mobile technology space
* Power personalized engagement at scale, processing over 30 billion events daily and reaching 3+ billion devices worldwide.
* Flourish in an Environment that Nurtures Growth and Curiosity

**Learn More**
Get to know us better before you apply!
  
  
Check out our product documentation, engineering blog, and customer stories to see how we work and what we value.
  
  

* Our Culture Video
* CleverAI
* CleverTap Developer Documentation
* Blogs
* TesseractDB™
* CleverTap Product Demo

**About CleverTap**
CleverTap is the world’s leading AI-first, all-in-one customer engagement and retention platform, redefining how brands build lasting customer relationships in the Agentic era. Powered by its proprietary CleverAI™ Decisioning Engine and the Agentic Universe, CleverTap enables autonomous, real-time decision-making that helps organizations deliver 1:1 individualized experiences at scale while maximizing ROI.
  
  
Its unified platform brings together an AI-native Personalization Engine, automated Journey Orchestration, its proprietary Customer Data Platform – TesseractDB™, and deep customer and product analytics to power truly intelligent, self-optimizing engagement across channels including mobile, web, email, SMS, WhatsApp, and more. By seamlessly connecting data, insights, and activation, CleverTap ensures every interaction is contextual, coordinated, and conversion-driven.
  
  
Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Personalization Engines and a Strong Performer in The Forrester Wave™, CleverTap is at the forefront of the shift from campaign-led marketing to agent-led growth. Trusted by more than 2,000 global brands including IKEA, Tesco, Burger King, Levi’s, Decathlon, Domino’s, 7-Eleven, Jio, Grab, Carousell, and Emirates NBD, CleverTap helps businesses drive measurable growth through meaningful, autonomous customer engagement.
  
  
Backed by Accel, Peak XV Partners, Tiger Global, CDPQ, and 360 One, CleverTap has 550+ employees across offices in the US, the Middle East, Asia, and LATAM.

title: Associate City Head - Mumbai ( Advertising Sales )
description:
About NoBroker Technologies Private Limited

NoBrokerHood, a part of NoBroker Technologies Pvt. Ltd., is a technology-driven visitor and community management platform designed to make life convenient, hassle-free, and secure for residents of gated communities.

Launched in late 2018, NoBrokerHood currently serves 20,000+ residential societies across India. The platform offers solutions such as visitor and gate management, complaint management, maintenance bill payments, digital notice boards, Marketplace, home services, and more.

NoBrokerHood goes beyond visitor and gate management by delivering an end-to-end community experience that empowers residents and management committees with digital convenience, revenue growth, and future-ready innovation.

Website: https://www.nobrokerhood.com/

About the Role

The Associate City Head – Ad Sales will play a key role in driving city-level advertising revenue, acquiring new brand partnerships, and expanding NoBrokerHood's monetization business. The role involves identifying and onboarding regional and hyperlocal advertisers, managing key client relationships, driving end-to-end ad sales, and supporting the City Head in executing the city's overall monetization strategy.

The candidate will be responsible for developing strong advertiser relationships and leveraging NoBrokerHood's digital and on-ground advertising inventory to deliver impactful brand campaigns across premium gated communities.

Job Description

**1. Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Drive advertising sales and revenue generation across the assigned city.
* Identify, prospect, and acquire new advertisers across categories such as F&B, FMCG, Retail, Healthcare, Fitness, Education, Beauty, Real Estate, and D2C.
* Develop and execute strategies to onboard regional and hyperlocal brands.
* Manage the complete sales cycle, including lead generation, pitching, negotiations, and deal closures.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly revenue targets.

**2. Brand Partnerships & Client Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with local brands, regional advertisers, media agencies, and key decision-makers.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business, upselling, cross-selling, and long-term brand partnerships.
* Understand advertiser objectives and propose customized advertising solutions.
* Develop a strong pipeline of prospective advertisers to ensure consistent business growth.

**3. Advertising Solutions & Campaign Execution**

* Promote and monetize NoBrokerHood's digital advertising inventory, including in-app banners, push notifications, approval screens, and community platforms.
* Drive sales for on-ground advertising formats such as lift branding, kiosks, product sampling, resident engagement activities, and OOH/DOOH campaigns.
* Coordinate with internal creative, operations, and campaign execution teams to ensure successful campaign delivery.
* Ensure campaigns meet client expectations in terms of visibility, engagement, lead generation, and ROI.

**4. Market Expansion & Strategy**

* Identify new monetization opportunities within the assigned city.
* Map potential advertisers and high-value brands targeting premium residential communities.
* Analyze competitor activities, market trends, and local advertising opportunities.
* Work closely with the City Head to implement city-level sales strategies and expand market presence.

**5. Team Collaboration & Leadership**

* Support the City Head in driving team performance, revenue targets, and business expansion.
* Guide and mentor team members to improve sales productivity and conversion rates.
* Monitor sales pipelines, business performance, and revenue achievement.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of campaigns and client requirements.

Mandatory Requirements

* 5–7 years of experience in Advertising Sales, Media Sales, Brand Partnerships, or B2B Sales.
* Strong experience in acquiring regional and hyperlocal advertisers and closing advertising sales deals.
* Experience selling digital, BTL, OOH/DOOH, or on-ground advertising solutions.
* Prior experience in managing key accounts and developing strategic brand partnerships.
* Exposure to team handling, mentoring, or sales leadership responsibilities is preferred.
* Strong network of local brands, advertisers, media agencies, and marketing decision-makers.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Strong understanding of revenue targets, sales pipelines, and business development strategies.
* High ownership, entrepreneurial mindset, and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Industry Background

* Advertising & Media
* Digital Advertising
* BTL / OOH / DOOH
* Brand Partnerships
* Media Agencies
* FMCG / Retail / F&B Advertising
* Hyperlocal Advertising & Marketing

What We Have to Offer!

* Opportunity to work closely with high-performing Sales and Operations teams.
* Exposure to end-to-end brand partnerships and advertising monetization.
* Opportunity to drive city-level business growth and revenue.
* Fast-paced and collaborative work environment with growth opportunities.

Benefits

* Corporate Health Insurance
* Travel Allowance
* Monthly R&R Awards

title: Account Manager
description:
**When you join Accurate Background, you’re an integral part of making every hire the start of a success story. Your contributions will help us fulfill our mission of advancing the background screening experience through visibility and insights, empowering our clients to make smarter, unbiased decisions.**

Job Description:

The Account Manager is a consultative client leader responsible for strengthening strategic partnerships, retaining and expanding assigned accounts, and growing revenue. Through regular engagement with stakeholders at all levels, the Account Manager becomes a trusted advisor on background screening services and related solutions, identifies opportunities and risks, and delivers recommendations supported by business insights and ROI. The role maintains continuity from the final stages of the sales cycle through onboarding and ongoing account management, coordinating internal and external resources to meet client requirements and maximize long-term value.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* **Client relationship leadership:** Build and cultivate relationships with corporate contacts and stakeholders at all levels to strengthen Accurate’s position and create opportunities for incremental business.
* **Strategic account planning:** Develop and maintain comprehensive account plans with short-, mid-, and long-term priorities designed to grow each client partnership.
* **Business reviews and insights:** Prepare annual performance reviews, multi-year account plans, usage analyses, and reporting for recurring client meetings.
* **Revenue growth:** Identify white-space opportunities, penetrate new business units and divisions, position relevant solutions, and consistently achieve or exceed assigned sales targets.
* **Commercial management:** Negotiate pricing and implementation requirements, prepare proposals and ROI-based recommendations, and advance opportunities through Accurate’s defined sales cycle.
* **Client and industry expertise:** Maintain a strong understanding of each client’s business, market, and industry trends to deliver proactive, strategic recommendations.
* **Risk and retention management:** Monitor account activity and usage, identify emerging issues or churn risks, and present clear mitigation plans to key stakeholders.
* **Cross-functional execution:** Coordinate internal teams, ATS providers, and other external partners to implement new services, integrations, and client solutions successfully.
* **Special projects:** Lead client-driven initiatives and other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
==================

* **Experience:** At least three years of background screening and client-facing experience required; OR three or more years of account management experience in an HR-related/Ed-tech/HR Tech/SaAs industry preferred.
* **Business and technical proficiency:** Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, with the ability to interpret client data and translate insights into actions.
* **Judgment and problem-solving:** Demonstrated ability to exercise sound decision-making, navigate complex situations, formulate practical solutions, and offer well-considered alternatives.
* **Organization and execution:** Strong ability to prioritize work, manage multiple responsibilities, and use time efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
* **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively across client and internal stakeholder levels.
* **Drive:** Self-motivated, proactive, and accountable for delivering client and business outcomes.

**This is an Onsite role with US shift timings - 6pm to 3:30 AM (Transportation will be provided both ways)**

**The Accurate Way:**
=====================

We offer a fun, fast-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. To do this, we follow four guiding principles – Take Ownership, Be Open, Stay Curious, Work as One – core values that dictate what we stand for, and how we behave.

**Take ownership.**
===================

Be accountable for your actions, your team, and the company. Accept responsibility willingly, especially when it’s what’s best for our customers. Give others every reason to trust you, believe in you, and count on you. Rise to every occasion with your personal best.

**Be open.**
============

Be open to new ideas. Be inclusive of people and ways of doing things. Make yourself accessible and approachable, and communicate with genuineness, transparency, honesty, and respect. Embrace differences.

**Stay curious.**
=================

Stay curious even as you move forward. Tirelessly ask questions and challenge the status quo in your pursuit of new ideas, ways to solve problems, and to continually grow and improve.

**Work as one.**
================

Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.

**Equal opportunities**
=======================

Accurate is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Accurate will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.

You must have a right to work in Australia indefinitely that does not involve sponsorship by the Company.

**Special Notice:**
===================

Accurate is aware of schemes involving fraudulent job postings/offers and/or individuals or entities claiming to be employees of Accurate. Those involved are offering fabricated employment opportunities to applicants, often asking for sensitive personal and financial information. If you believe you have been contacted by anyone misrepresenting themselves as an employee of Accurate, please contact humanresources@accurate.com.

* Accurate will not interview candidates via text or email. Our interviews are conducted by recruiters and leaders via the phone, Zoom/Teams or in an in-person format.

title: Brand Partnerships & Alliances Manager (Domestic Gift Cards)
description:
**Brand Partnerships & Portfolio Ownership**

* Own the account management of gift card brand partnerships —performance management and renewal.
* Build and deepen direct relationships with anchor brands (Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and equivalent large-format retail, fashion, QSR, fuel, travel, electronics and lifestyle brands) and expand coverage across under-penetrated categories.
* Manage relationships with domestic gift card aggregators and content providers (Pine Labs / Qwikcilver, Vouchagram and others) to ensure catalogue depth, competitive rates, inventory availability and fulfilment reliability — while progressively moving high-volume brands to direct tie-ups where it improves margin.
* Maintain a live brand map and category coverage plan; identify and close gaps against competing distributors and marketplaces.
* Support launch of new global brands entering India, and expand existing brands into new use cases (consumer rewards, employee benefits, channel incentives, corporate gifting).

**Commercials, Margin & Offers**

* Negotiate and continuously improve brand commercials — base discounts, slab-based and volume-linked margins, incentive and rebate structures, marketing support and payment/credit terms.
* Secure differentiated and, where possible, exclusive consumer offers, cashback and promotional constructs that channel partners can merchandise to drive conversion.
* Own brand-wise margin performance; track realised versus contracted margin and drive corrective action with brands and internal teams.
* Build and present brand-wise revenue, volume and margin projections based on inputs from brands, channel partners and the channel sales team; track actuals against plan and explain variances.
* Benchmark competitor commercials and offer constructs in the domestic gift card market and use these insights in negotiations.

**Digital Distribution & Scale (with Channel Partnership Team)**

* Work hand-in-hand with the channel partnership and channel sales teams to enable the domestic gift card catalogue across digital distribution partners — banks, fintech apps, e-commerce and retail platforms, loyalty and rewards programmes, and corporate gifting channels.
* Drive catalogue placement, merchandising, visibility and campaign calendars on partner interfaces, working with the product and marketing teams.
* Translate brand-level commercials into channel-level pricing and incentive constructs that make the business attractive and profitable for distribution partners.
* Run joint business reviews with key channel partners; identify growth levers for under-performing brands and channels and execute against them.
* Partner with the internal marketing team to build promotions, festive and seasonal campaigns and co-branded activity with brands.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Act as the single point of connect between brand partners and internal teams — Product, Technology, Operations, Reconciliation, Finance, Legal, Compliance and Channel Sales.
* Work with Operations and Customer Support to set processes for order fulfilment, voucher delivery, inventory availability, refunds and escalations, ensuring a strong end-customer experience at channel partners.
* Work with the Reconciliation and Finance teams on settlement cycles, invoicing, credit and float management, dispute resolution and timely closure of brand and channel reconciliation.
* Coordinate with Technology and Product for API integrations, catalogue management, order-management improvements and new feature rollouts required by brands or channels.
* Manage contract negotiations with brands in collaboration with Legal, Finance, Product and Operations to secure internal approvals and execute opportunities.
* Evaluate the financial and strategic benefit of partnerships and present business cases and portfolio reviews to Euronet management.

**Business Ownership & Governance**

* Carry and deliver the annual revenue, GMV/TPV and margin targets for the domestic gift card portfolio.
* Own all KPIs including the P&L for domestic gift card sales, covering end-to-end management of the sales cycle.
* Maintain governance rhythm — monthly brand reviews, quarterly business reviews with top brands and aggregators, and periodic management reporting on portfolio health.
* Ensure partner contracts, commercial approvals and operating processes remain audit-ready and compliant with internal policy and applicable regulation.

  
**Requirements**  

* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate the value of epay’s products and distribution reach to brands.
* Result-oriented, self-driven and effective in a fast-paced environment.
* Strategic thinker with strong analytical skills, commercial acumen and process orientation.
* High customer centricity with focus on partner success and long-term relationships.
* Dynamic professional with a hands-on approach and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders

title: Business Analysis Manager, Vice President - Workforce Planning Global Leader
description:

title: Control Manager - Program - Controls Room - Program Management & Governance Vice President
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

The Controls Room Team within Control Management works collaboratively with other control disciplines and oversees existing control functions as well as the development of new control functions and protocols. The team's objective is to empower the three lines of defense with risk-based information to manage their control environment. We achieve this by collecting, analyzing, and monitoring firmwide risk-based intelligence across all lines of business and corporate functions. As a Control Manager Program Vice President, you will be a key member of the team, leading cross-functional delivery for firmwide programs that impact Control Management.

As a Control Manager Program Vice President within the Controls Room organization, you will translate enterprise requirements into executable project strategies, integrated roadmaps, and measurable outcomes. You will serve as a senior delivery and governance leader, aligning stakeholders across lines of business, product, and technology; proactively identifying and mitigating delivery, operational, and control risks; and driving disciplined execution against milestones, quality standards, and service-level agreements.

You will also own User Acceptance Testing governance for in-scope programs by establishing the UAT strategy, readiness standards, entry and exit criteria, and consolidated reporting. Working across business and technology teams, you will ensure end-to-end testing is appropriately planned, staffed, and executed, and that UAT scope, defects, and results remain aligned with program objectives and control effectiveness outcomes. title: Systems Engineer, APAC Controls Deployment and Service Team
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
The Data Center Capacity Delivery Asia-Pacific Controls Deployment and Service (DCCD APAC CDS) team delivers and services the control systems which monitor and ensure the health of our data centers. APAC CDS’ mission is to safely provide our customers with the unmatched reliability, security, and performance that AWS is known for. APAC CDS covers six disciplines of deployments, projects, service, colo, on-call support, and management.  
  
As Amazonians, we work in a competitive environment. Our customers are always beautifully, wonderfully dissatisfied. Being successful in our roles is not just about doing our jobs well, but also evolving and innovating. Change is the only constant, and applies to our customers, our roles, our team organization, our tools, and our mechanisms.  
  
To be successful in this team, you will also have:  
  
Ability to thrive at the pace and scale of Amazon  
Ability to work independently and manage multiple competing priorities  
Ability and willingness to collaborate with peers around the globe, which may involve some participation in meetings at odd hours  
Ability and willingness to travel domestically or globally as and when needed  
  
Are you experienced in building and managing Windows systems, with a passion for maintaining highly-available IT infrastructure and services at a massive scale? The Controls Fleet team is responsible for supporting some of Amazon's most critical infrastructure services. As part of Amazon Web Services (AWS), we power the infrastructure behind the world's premier e-commerce and cloud computing environments. To meet the growing demand for AWS services worldwide, we seek exceptionally motivated individuals driven by learning and innovation. We are looking for a passionate and motivated Windows Engineer to join our team of Systems Engineers.  
  
By joining us, you'll become part of a world-class team in a dynamic environment with the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up. This is an opportunity to operate and engineer systems on a massive scale, gaining world-class experience in managing and supporting critical infrastructure. You'll work alongside passionate individuals dedicated to deploying and supporting essential IT infrastructure that powers AWS.  
  
The ideal candidate will be innovative, possess excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. They should have a keen attention to detail and the ability to solve problems at their root. The Controls Fleet Operations team services customers globally, requiring the ability to manage multiple tasks and adapt to different challenges.  
  
In addition, the ideal candidate should have an expert understanding of Windows tools such as Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, Hyper-V, Windows Failover Clustering, and System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM). Proficiency in PowerShell and windows automation are essential. This role demands a solid foundation in networking principles and hands-on experience with hardware troubleshooting and system building.  
  
Following Technical Skills are required:  
  

* Cross-platform Expertise (Windows/Linux): Proficient in managing mostly Windows but Linux environments as well. For Windows skills, this includes experience with Active Directory/LDAP, Group Policy, and system administration. Skilled in PowerShell or Python scripting, with the ability to implement cross-platform security measures and manage core network services like DNS and DHCP.
* Enterprise-scale Automation: Experienced in developing and implementing large-scale automation solutions using Python, PowerShell, and configuration management tools. Capable of creating efficient global deployment scripts, integrating automated testing, and utilizing version control systems to maintain and optimize infrastructure as code.
* Network Redundancy and Optimization: Adept at configuring layer two network setups for maximum reliability and performance. This includes implementing NIC teaming, load balancing, and failover clustering. Skilled in network administration of larger layer two networks with layer three switch and routing concepts.

  
Other relevant skills:  
  

* High-availability Configurations: Skilled in designing and maintaining high-availability systems through clustering services, load balancer setups, and redundancy planning. Experienced in conducting failover testing, implementing robust disaster recovery procedures, and setting up continuous system health monitoring to ensure maximum uptime.
* AWS Cloud Integration: Well-versed in AWS services and their implementation in enterprise environments. Able to manage cloud resources effectively, optimize costs, and integrate AWS automation tools. Experienced in implementing cloud security best practices and designing hybrid cloud configurations that leverage AWS Systems Manager, EC2, and S3.
* Storage Solutions and RAID Management: Experienced in designing and managing enterprise storage solutions, including RAID array configuration and optimization. Proficient in implementing backup and recovery solutions, planning for data redundancy, and managing storage capacity. Capable of setting up monitoring tools and implementing disaster recovery procedures.

  
If you are passionate about technology, excited by the prospect of working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, and driven to solve complex problems, we would love to hear from you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Key job responsibilities  

* Innovation and Problem Solving: Utilize creativity and analytical skills to solve complex problems and implement innovative solutions.
* Adaptability: Quickly adjust to changing priorities and manage multiple tasks efficiently.
* Large-Scale Windows Server Environments: Design, build, and support extensive Windows server environments.
* Enterprise Tooling: Implement and manage enterprise-scale tooling, such as SCCM, for a large Windows fleet.
* Automation and Scripting: Develop and implement best practices for automating tasks and scripting in large server environments. Proficiency in PowerShell is essential.
* Hardware Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve hardware issues, with hands-on experience in system building.
* Networking and Windows Administration: Strong understanding of networking principles and expert-level Windows administration.
* Global Deployment: Create scripts and automation tasks applicable to a global server fleet.
* On call: Participate in a 24x7 on call rotation that supports global customers
* Documentation: processes, maintain run-books, and contribute to continuous improvements of Amazon Control Systems support practices. Enhance knowledge sharing and drive process enhancements.

  
A day in the life  
Your day begins with a review of outstanding actions and site conditions alongside the Facility Manager, setting the work plan for your team. From there, you move into the data center environment—performing hands-on maintenance, supervising corrective work, and responding to emergent situations where your technical judgment guides risk mitigation. You may serve as the Incident Commander during event response, coordinate with partner teams on complex problems, and identify opportunities to improve processes that keep our infrastructure reliable.  
  
About the team  
About AWS  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Cross-platform Expertise (Windows/Linux): Proficient in managing mostly Windows but Linux environments as well. For Windows skills, this includes experience with Active Directory/LDAP, Group Policy, and system administration. Skilled in PowerShell or Python scripting, with the ability to implement cross-platform security measures and manage core network services like DNS and DHCP.
* Enterprise-scale Automation: Experienced in developing and implementing large-scale automation solutions using Python, PowerShell, and configuration management tools. Capable of creating efficient global deployment scripts, integrating automated testing, and utilizing version control systems to maintain and optimize infrastructure as code.
* Network Redundancy and Optimization: Adept at configuring layer two network setups for maximum reliability and performance. This includes implementing NIC teaming, load balancing, and failover clustering. Skilled in network administration of larger layer two networks with layer three switch and routing concepts.
* High-availability Configurations: Skilled in designing and maintaining high-availability systems through clustering services, load balancer setups, and redundancy planning. Experienced in conducting failover testing, implementing robust disaster recovery procedures, and setting up continuous system health monitoring to ensure maximum uptime.

About Vijay InvestEdge

Established in 1994, Vijay InvestEdge is an AMFI-registered Mutual Fund Distributor based in Pune, built on the principles of trust, integrity, transparency, and long-term client relationships.

We believe wealth creation is not about chasing short-term returns or meeting transactional targets. It is about understanding clients’ financial goals, maintaining disciplined investment practices, and building lasting relationships that compound in value over time.

The Role: What You Will Own

This is a growth-oriented role, not simply a client servicing position. You will be responsible for developing client relationships, acquiring new clients, and growing your portfolio through consistent engagement and a strong understanding of client needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Build and grow a client portfolio:**
  Develop and manage relationships with retail investors and emerging HNI clients, with a focus on long-term retention and portfolio growth.
* **Drive new client acquisition:**
  Generate business through referrals, professional networking, existing relationships, and proactive outreach.
* **Understand client objectives:**
  Engage with clients to understand their financial goals, investment horizon, risk appetite, and liquidity requirements.
* **Conduct structured portfolio reviews:**
  Discuss portfolio performance, asset allocation, investment suitability, and opportunities for portfolio improvement.
* **Expand existing relationships:**
  Identify opportunities to deepen client engagement and grow assets under management through relevant mutual fund offerings.
* **Take ownership of portfolio movements:**
  Monitor inflows, redemptions, and changes in client portfolios, proactively addressing concerns and strengthening investor confidence.
* **Ensure disciplined execution:**
  Work closely with research and operations teams to deliver timely, accurate, and consistent client service.
* **Maintain a structured approach:**
  Follow defined processes for client engagement, reviews, follow-ups, reporting, and business development.

Who We’re Looking For

We are looking for an experienced professional who combines relationship-building skills with commercial awareness, investment knowledge, and an ownership mindset.

**Essential Experience**

* 7–10 years of experience in wealth management, mutual fund distribution, or a related financial services business.
* At least 7 years of relevant experience in business relationship management and mutual funds.
* Demonstrated ability to acquire clients, manage relationships, and grow a client portfolio.

**Skills and Mindset**

* Strong communication, networking, and relationship-management skills.
* A sound understanding of mutual funds, investment risk, asset allocation, and long-term investing.
* The ability to translate client requirements into suitable investment solutions within the applicable regulatory and distribution framework.
* A disciplined approach to follow-ups, portfolio reviews, and business development.
* Commercial awareness and the ability to identify opportunities for sustainable business growth.
* A self-driven, accountable, and ambitious approach to professional development.

What to Expect at Vijay InvestEdge

* **Structured working environment:**
  Work within defined processes designed to improve client experience, execution, and consistency.
* **Collaborative execution:**
  Partner with Research, Marketing and Operations to deliver a coordinated client experience.
* **Long-term career development:**
  Build expertise, strengthen client relationships, and grow alongside an expanding wealth distribution business.
* **A relationship-first culture:**
  Focus on trust, investor understanding, and sustainable business rather than purely transactional interactions.

We are building a platform where the right people can grow their professional capabilities, create lasting client relationships, and contribute meaningfully to the business.

Who Should Apply?

This opportunity is best suited to professionals who already understand the mutual fund distribution business and are ready to take greater ownership of client acquisition, portfolio growth, and relationship management.

If your primary focus is only on servicing an existing client base, this may not be the right fit.

**If you want to build a strong client book, take ownership of business growth, and build a serious long-term career in wealth management, we would like to hear from you.**

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their profile directly via DM or email their CV to:

aakash@vijayinvestedge.com

title: Delivery Head
description:
**HEAD – CUSTOMER ENGINEERING & DELIVERY**

**Location: Pune [on-site]**

**Experience: 14-20 years**

**Qalifications:**

* Engineering degree or equivalent technical qualification.
* Postgraduate management qualification would be an advantage.

**About i-TEK**

i-TEK is one of India's leading AIDC and RFID technology organisations with a strong focus on next-generation products, platforms, intelligent edge ecosystems and embedded device engineering.

Over the past 26 years, i-TEK has built deep technology and domain expertise and a marquee enterprise customer base across retail, manufacturing, logistics and banking.

Today, i-TEK has:

* Over 5 billion items tagged
* More than 1,000 customers
* Over 250 million scans processed every day
* Deployments across 3,000+ retail outlets
* Coverage across more than 10 million sq. ft. of warehouse space

As i-TEK enters its next phase of growth, we are strengthening our product and platform-led strategy while expanding internationally.

i-TEK deployments typically combine sophisticated software platforms, RFID/AIDC technologies, edge devices and integration with customer enterprise environments. Successful delivery therefore requires much more than conventional project management. It requires a strong understanding of technology, domain processes, customer environments and execution at scale.

The incumbent will build and lead a multidisciplinary organisation comprising:

* Pre-Sales / Techno-Functional Consulting
* Business Analysis
* Project & Program Management
* Solution Architecture
* Customer/Project Software Engineering
* Quality Assurance
* Hardware / Device Engineering for customer deployments
* Hardware Production & Procurement Coordination
* Implementation & Deployment
* Customer Support
* Customer Success

**Job Description:**

The role requires a leader who combines strong customer orientation, techno-functional depth, operational rigour and the ability to build and lead diverse, high-performing teams.

Key Responsibilities

1. End-to-End Customer Lifecycle Ownership

* Own the customer engineering and delivery journey from pre-sales engagement through implementation, go-live, support, adoption and ongoing customer success.
* Establish clear accountability across every stage of the customer lifecycle.
* Ensure seamless hand-offs between Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Delivery and Support.
* Build mechanisms to proactively identify and address customer risks before they become escalations.
* Ensure customer commitments are realistic, clearly documented and delivered with predictability.

2. Pre-Sales & Techno-Functional Solutioning

* Build and lead a strong pre-sales capability capable of combining technology understanding with deep domain knowledge.
* Work closely with Sales during customer discovery and opportunity development.
* Understand customer business processes, technology landscapes and operational requirements.
* Demonstrate the techno-functional capabilities of i-TEK products and platforms.
* Translate customer requirements into appropriate deployment and implementation approaches.
* Support solution workshops, demonstrations, RFP/RFI responses, technical proposals and customer presentations.
* Help Sales articulate differentiated value propositions based on i-TEK's technology and domain strengths.
* Ensure that commitments made during the sales cycle are technically feasible, scalable and commercially responsible.
* Ensure that pre-sales becomes a significant force multiplier for the business organisation.

3. Delivery & Program Management

* Own execution of customer programs across software, hardware and integrated deployments.
* Establish strong project and program governance.
* Ensure delivery against agreed scope, quality, cost and timelines.
* Establish clear milestone, dependency, risk and escalation management mechanisms.
* Create visibility through delivery dashboards and management reviews.
* Drive predictability and execution discipline across the delivery portfolio.
* Establish appropriate governance for large, complex and strategic customer programs.

4. Business Analysis & Requirements Management

* Build a strong Business Analysis capability capable of understanding both customer domains and i-TEK platform capabilities.
* Ensure requirements are clearly captured, analysed and translated into appropriate configurations, integrations or customer-specific implementation requirements.
* Prevent unnecessary customization by ensuring teams understand and leverage standard platform capabilities wherever possible.
* Establish traceability from requirements through implementation, testing and customer acceptance.
* Feed recurring requirements and market insights systematically back to Product Management and Engineering.

5. Solution Architecture & Deployment

* Oversee the Solution Architecture function responsible for defining deployment strategies for both SaaS and customer-hosted environments.
* Ensure customer deployments address scalability, high availability, security, performance, network topology, load balancing, firewalls, integration architecture, disaster recovery and business continuity.
* Ensure effective integration of Garuda Vigil and Skanixa into customer technology ecosystems.
* Maintain deployment standards and reusable reference architectures.
* Ensure Solution Architects act as trusted technical advisors to customer technology teams.

6. Software Implementation & Quality Assurance

* Lead customer/project software engineering required for integrations, configurations and approved customer-specific requirements.
* Establish clear boundaries between reusable product/platform engineering and customer-specific implementation engineering.
* Ensure strong engineering practices are followed even for customer-specific development.
* Build rigorous QA and testing disciplines across deployments.
* Drive automation across regression testing, integration testing and deployment validation.
* Ensure production releases meet agreed quality, security and performance standards.

7. Hardware, Devices & Fulfilment

* Plan hardware requirements aligned with project schedules.
* Coordinate production and procurement of devices and associated components.
* Ensure appropriate inventory and supply planning.
* Drive quality assurance for customer-bound hardware.
* Coordinate configuration, testing and readiness of devices prior to deployment.
* Ensure hardware and software components come together as an integrated customer deployment.
* Manage dependencies and risks across suppliers, production, logistics and implementation teams.

8. Implementation, Go-Live & Operational Readiness

* Establish robust deployment and go-live methodologies.
* Ensure appropriate readiness reviews prior to production rollout.
* Drive structured migration, cutover and stabilization processes.
* Ensure monitoring, support processes and escalation mechanisms are operational before go-live.
* Minimise disruption to customer operations during implementation.
* Establish clear acceptance and transition-to-support criteria.

9. Customer Support

* Build a mature support organisation combining proactive/preventive and reactive support.
* Establish clearly defined support processes and service levels.
* Monitor platform and device environments proactively wherever applicable.
* Identify recurring issues and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Establish effective incident, problem and escalation management.
* Build appropriate L1/L2/L3 support models and clear escalation paths into Engineering.
* Drive root-cause analysis rather than repeated symptomatic fixes.
* Use automation and AI to improve support responsiveness and resolution quality.

10. Customer Success

* Establish a structured Customer Success function for strategic customers.
* Track adoption and utilisation of deployed capabilities.
* Conduct periodic customer reviews.
* Identify opportunities to improve value realization from i-TEK products and platforms.
* Proactively identify customer dissatisfaction or adoption risks.
* Build strong executive relationships with key customers.
* Create mechanisms for capturing customer feedback and feeding it into Product Management, Engineering and Business teams.
* Drive referenceability, advocacy and long-term customer relationships.

11. AI, Automation & Productivity

* Aggressively leverage AI and automation across the organisation, including AI-assisted requirements analysis and documentation, software development and code review, automated test generation and QA, project risk identification, knowledge management, support diagnostics, incident analysis, customer query resolution, documentation and training, and delivery analytics and forecasting.
* Drive measurable improvements in productivity, quality, speed and customer experience rather than adoption of AI tools for its own sake.

12. Delivery Processes & Operational Excellence

* Define standardized methodologies across pre-sales, implementation, deployment, support and customer success.
* Build reusable playbooks, templates and deployment frameworks.
* Establish meaningful operational metrics and dashboards.
* Drive continuous improvement using data and root-cause analysis.
* Reduce dependence on individual knowledge by institutionalising processes and documentation.
* Ensure lessons from customer deployments are systematically captured and reused.

13. Cross-Functional Leadership

* Work closely with the Chief Business Officer / Sales on opportunity qualification, pre-sales, customer commitments and strategic pursuits.
* Work closely with the Head of Engineering on product readiness, engineering escalations, quality and platform improvements.
* Work closely with the Chief Architect on architecture standards and complex deployment patterns.
* Work closely with Product Management on requirements, customer feedback and product roadmap inputs.
* Work closely with Supply Chain, Finance and Commercial functions on procurement, hardware planning, commercial commitments and program economics.
* Create strong alignment between what is sold, built, deployed and supported.

**Customer obsession will be a defining characteristic of this role.**
The incumbent should establish a culture where teams:

* Understand the customer's business rather than merely the technical specification.
* Take ownership of customer outcomes.
* Communicate transparently.
* Anticipate problems rather than wait for escalation.
* Treat quality and reliability as non-negotiable.
* Balance responsiveness to customers with the integrity and scalability of i-TEK's products and platforms.

Team Leadership

* Build strong functional leaders beneath the role.
* Define clear accountability across teams.
* Develop technical and domain capabilities.
* Establish a high-performance culture.
* Mentor future leaders.
* Build succession plans for critical roles.
* Ensure teams are equipped to support i-TEK's international expansion and increasingly complex global customers.

**Experience**

* Approximately 15-20+ years of relevant experience, with significant leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated experience leading large and diverse customer-facing technology organisations.
* Proven track record delivering complex software and hardware / device-led programs for enterprise customers.
* Experience managing multiple simultaneous customer programs at scale.
* Strong exposure to enterprise software/platform implementations and integrations.
* Experience across the full lifecycle from pre-sales through delivery and support/customer success.
* Experience in Retail Technology, Manufacturing Technology, Supply Chain & Logistics, Enterprise Automation, Industrial IoT, and/or AIDC / RFID would be particularly valuable.
* Direct RFID experience is desirable but not mandatory; strong enterprise technology delivery experience and the ability to understand the domain are more important.

Leadership & Personal Attributes

* Exceptional customer orientation.
* Strong techno-functional capability.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to engage credibly with CIOs, CTOs and senior business stakeholders.
* Strong program and operational management capability.
* Ability to lead diverse technical and customer-facing teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* High ownership and accountability.
* Ability to operate effectively in complex and ambiguous situations.
* Passion for quality and execution excellence.
* Ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on intervention when required.

***Success Metrics***

* On-time and on-quality delivery
* Customer satisfaction
* Customer adoption and success
* Deployment quality
* Program predictability
* Reduction in implementation escalations
* Support SLA performance
* Reduction in recurring incidents
* Hardware fulfilment predictability
* Quality and first-time-right performance
* Improved pre-sales effectiveness
* Customer referenceability
* Productivity improvements through AI and automation
* Improved reuse and standardization across implementations

**At i-TEK, the objective is not merely to successfully complete projects. It is to ensure that customers derive sustained value from products and platforms that become integral to their operations.**

title: Data Conversion Delivery Manager
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
As a Historical Data Conversion Delivery Manager, you will serve as the essential link between our technical Data Solution Consultants (DSCs) and the client’s business stakeholders. While DSCs focus on the technical execution of data migration and complex analysis, your role is to translate that work into a clear narrative for the client while relaying client requirements back to the internal team. You will leverage a strong understanding of HDC processes, investment data, and technical frameworks to comfortably bridge the gap between technical execution and client expectations. By working side-by-side with the DSCs to identify data remediation strategies, you will translate technical requirements into actionable directives for the client and proactively secure necessary inputs. This role is for a subject matter expert who can navigate technical language and investment complexities to drive project progress and maintain high-impact communication regarding status, gaps, and timelines.
  
  
You’ll also be among the first members of the Data Solutions team based in India, helping establish our presence in the region while working closely with colleagues across the U.S., U.K., and other global offices. This is a collaborative role offering the opportunity to shape our operating model locally and strengthen how our global teams deliver together.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Partner with Data Solutions: Serve as the dedicated partner to the internal Data Solutions Consultants, ensuring they have clear specifications and context while managing administrative workflows to allow them to focus on technical execution.
* Translate Technical Progress: Translate technical progress, data challenges, and migration results provided by the Data Solutions team into digestible business narratives for client stakeholders.
* Lead Client Status Calls: Lead regular status calls with clients to convey project health, presenting successful data loads and managing expectations around timelines or data discrepancies.
* Facilitate Information Flow: Facilitate the flow of information between parties, ensuring client requirements are accurately scoped for the technical team and technical constraints are clearly explained to the client.
* Oversee Portfolio of Projects: Prioritize and context-switch effectively to oversee simultaneous projects, maintaining close alignment with the Data Solutions team on resource availability.
* Drive Process Improvement: Identify and drive opportunities to improve the communication workflow between the Project Management and Data Solutions functions.

**Who You Are**

* Experienced: Minimum 3+ years of experience in project management, finance, or consulting, with a strong record of managing client relationships and communicating complex project updates.
* Client-Focused: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business outcomes and manage "difficult conversations" regarding timelines or scope.
* Investment-Savvy: Strong understanding of financial products and securities modeling (technical implementation skills not required, but conceptual understanding is key).
* Solutions-Oriented: Creative problem-solver who operates with ownership and accountability in ambiguous environments.
* Collaborative: Works effectively across teams and functions to deliver measurable impact, specifically in bridging the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Process-Minded: Highly organized, detail-oriented, and continuously looking for ways to improve efficiency and scale.
* Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and global stakeholders.
* Technical (Bonus): Familiarity with Python or SQL. While you won’t be building the infrastructure, your ability to query data or understand automated workflows will help you scale your impact and communicate more effectively.

**Important Note: This role will require you to work from Pune office 3 days a week in UK shift i.e. 2:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST. (hybrid role)**
**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

title: IT Senior Director
description:

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a IT Senior Director to join our team in Pune, Mahārāshtra (IN-MH), India (IN).
  
  
Cloud, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity Managed Services Operations | Experience: 14+ Years
  
At NTT DATA, we know that consistent service delivery builds lasting client trust. We invest in operational leaders who combine disciplined execution, technical understanding and strong people leadership to deliver reliable outcomes every day.
  
Role Purpose
  
The Client Delivery Manager (CDM) is accountable for day-to-day service delivery, operational governance, SLA/KPI performance, cost efficiency, resource management and continual service improvement across assigned Cloud, Infrastructure and Cybersecurity engagements.
  
  
Reporting into the Client Delivery Executive (CDE), the CDM converts contractual and client commitments into disciplined daily, weekly and monthly execution. The CDM works with the Client Architect to operationalize transformation roadmaps, automation and AIOps improvements without compromising service stability.
  
  
Lead complex enterprise operations where service reliability, operational discipline and continuous improvement directly shape client confidence. The role operates in a clear three-in-a-box model: the CDE owns the business and client outcomes, the CDM runs service operations, and the Client Architect shapes technology strategy and transformation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Service Operations Delivery Control
  

* Own daily operations across relevant service towers and ensure delivery meets SLAs, KPIs, SLOs, contractual commitments and operating procedures.
* Run daily, weekly and monthly operating rhythms, including service reviews, delivery dashboards, action tracking and closure governance.
* Maintain operational stability, service quality and business continuity across global, multi-vendor and multi-tower environments.

Incident, Problem, Change Risk Management
  

* Lead operational response for major incidents, outages, missed SLAs and service escalations; ensure timely communication, restoration and follow-through.
* Drive root-cause analysis, problem management, corrective actions and service improvement plans to prevent recurrence.
* Govern change execution, operational risks, audit actions, security/compliance obligations and continuity or disaster-recovery readiness.

Resource, Vendor Asset Management
  

* Manage workforce demand, staffing, shifts, skills, utilization, onboarding/offboarding, knowledge transfer and succession coverage.
* Coordinate tower leads, operations managers, partners and vendors; establish clear ownership and consequence-based closure of commitments.
* Oversee operational hardware/software assets, licenses and vendor dependencies within the service scope.

Cost Efficiency Financial Operations
  

* Control delivery costs in line with the account operating plan and provide accurate operational inputs for revenue, cost, margin and forecast reviews.
* Drive productivity, pyramid optimization, capacity alignment, leakage prevention and efficient ramp-up/ramp-down of resources.
* Track operational benefits from automation, continuous improvement and cost-efficiency initiatives; escalate forecast or cost gaps with corrective actions.

Client Operations Governance
  

* Serve as the primary contact for client operations leadership and lead service reviews, operational governance and action closure.
* Maintain clear and timely communication on performance, risks, incidents, recovery plans and improvement priorities.
* Support the CDE with MBR, QBR inputs, client escalations, renewals and delivery-led opportunities while keeping ownership centered on operational execution.

Automation, AIOps Continual Improvement
  

* Identify repetitive work, ticket drivers and process gaps suitable for automation, AIOps and intelligent service management.
* Partner with the Principal Client Architect and practices to implement approved improvements and embed them into standard operations.
* Measure realized outcomes such as ticket reduction, faster restoration, reduced manual effort, improved reliability and better user experience.

People Leadership
  

* Coach delivery and operations leaders, set clear expectations and build a culture of accountability, ITIL discipline, collaboration and customer focus.
* Develop operational capability, certifications, cross-skilling, engagement and retention across geographically distributed teams.

Required Experience Qualifications
  

* 14+ years in IT services or managed services, including substantial responsibility for enterprise infrastructure, cloud or cybersecurity operations.
* Proven leadership of day-to-day service delivery across complex, global and multi-tower accounts with measurable SLA/KPI and customer outcomes.
* Strong experience in major incident, problem, change, risk, transition, service improvement and operational governance.
* Working financial knowledge covering cost control, forecasting inputs, productivity, utilization and margin drivers.
* Broad understanding of cloud, compute, storage, backup, virtualization, operating systems, networks, cybersecurity and ITSM operations.
* ITIL v4 certification is required; relevant cloud, infrastructure, security or service-management certifications are preferred.
* Strong client communication, structured problem solving, data-driven decision making and ability to influence cross-functional global teams.

We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. description:

=======================================

×

**Date:** Nov 3, 2026

**Location:** Pune, MH, IN

**Company:** Datwyler

Datwyler’s high-tech elastomer components make a vital contribution to the safety, reliability and functionality of critical systems in billions of syringes and coffee capsules, in every second vehicle worldwide, and in energy-related applications. Datwyler serves highly regulated and technologically demanding markets, such as Healthcare, Automotive, Food & Beverage and Industry.
  
With around 7,500 employees and 25 production sites on four continents, we work closely with customers from concept to series production. Our employees are at the heart of Datwyler. Guided by Mastery, Impact and Respect, we continuously improve, focus on meaningful results and collaborate with trust and openness.

  

**Goal**

Govern and coordinate IT demand intake, change execution and capacity planning across the Infrastructure domain in order to align business requirements with IT capabilities, deliver changes in a controlled and compliant manner, and ensure that infrastructure capacity supports current and future business needs.

  

**Responsibilities**

  

Manage IT demand intake and prioritization in order to create a transparent, aligned and resource-aware demand pipeline.

  

This includes the following duties and responsibilities:
  

* Capture, assess and prioritize incoming business and IT demands.
* Align demand with strategic objectives, infrastructure priorities and resource availability.
* Coordinate demand discussions with Infrastructure, Applications, Network and End User Services domains.
* Maintain transparency of the demand pipeline and decision-making process.

  

Govern the end-to-end IT change lifecycle in order to ensure controlled, compliant and high-quality change execution.

This includes the following duties and responsibilities:
  

* Assess change requests and coordinate risk evaluation, scheduling and approvals.
* Coordinate CAB preparation and governance activities.
* Oversee implementation readiness and post-implementation review.
* Act as approver for critical changes and enforce quality standards.

  

Manage infrastructure capacity planning in order to ensure that compute, storage, network and end-user assets meet current and future needs.

  

This includes the following duties and responsibilities:
  

* Monitor infrastructure capacity and identify risks related to under-capacity or over-capacity.
* Lead monthly and quarterly capacity planning cycles.
* Forecast future needs based on the project pipeline and business demand.
* Propose mitigation actions for gaps in servers, WAN, devices or other resources.

  

Coordinate governance and stakeholder communication in order to align Infrastructure priorities with business roadmaps and organizational standards.

  

This includes the following duties and responsibilities:
  

* Facilitate cross-functional governance forums such as CAB and capacity reviews.
* Ensure structured communication between business stakeholders, IT teams and governance bodies.
* Align Infrastructure priorities with Enterprise Architecture and business roadmaps.
* Support compliance with organizational policies and standards.

  

Report on performance and drive continuous improvement in order to support decision-making, scalability and operational efficiency.

  

This includes the following duties and responsibilities:
  

* Provide regular reporting on the demand pipeline, change success, risks, capacity utilization and forecasts.
* Analyze process performance and recommend improvements to demand, change and capacity management.
* Identify optimization initiatives for performance, scalability and cost.
* Support regular analysis and recommendations for management decisions.

  

**Experience Required**

* 8-10 years of experience

* Bachelor degree in Information Technology, Business Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent by experience.

* Several years of experience in IT service management, infrastructure operations, demand management, change management or capacity management.

* Strong knowledge of ITIL processes, especially Demand, Change and Capacity Management.

* Ability to manage stakeholders and coordinate across Infrastructure, Network, Security, Application, business and vendor teams.

* Analytical skills for capacity planning, forecasting, reporting and continuous improvement.

* Governance and risk management mindset with the ability to make decisions under constraints related to resources, risk and priorities.

* Professional English language skills; additional local language skills are an asset.

  

**Be yourself at Datwyler**

People make the difference at Datwyler. We offer a wide range of career and development opportunities in an international company where you can contribute your skills, ideas and experience. Together, we create an environment where people can grow and help shape our future.

**Role Purpose**
----------------

We are looking for an experienced **Interface Administrator specializing in MuleSoft** to manage, monitor, support, and maintain enterprise integrations across cloud and on-premises systems.

The role requires hands-on experience with **MuleSoft Anypoint Platform** and a strong understanding of **Salesforce integrations** , including REST/SOAP APIs, authentication, API security, integration troubleshooting, and production support.

The successful candidate will work closely with application teams, Salesforce administrators/developers, infrastructure, security, and business stakeholders to ensure reliable and secure data exchange between enterprise applications.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **MuleSoft Administration & Operations**

* Administer and support **MuleSoft Anypoint Platform** environments, including Development, Test, UAT, and Production.
* Monitor Mule applications, APIs, interfaces, queues, transactions, and integration jobs.
* Perform deployments, configuration changes, environment management, and application restarts.
* Monitor application performance using **Anypoint Monitoring** and related logging/monitoring tools.
* Troubleshoot failed integrations, API errors, connectivity problems, authentication failures, and performance issues.
* Support **CloudHub** , Runtime Manager, API Manager, and on-premises/hybrid Mule runtime environments.
* Manage API policies, certificates, credentials, properties, secrets, and environment-specific configurations.
Coordinate platform upgrades, Mule runtime updates, certificate renewals, and maintenance activities.  

  

### **Salesforce Integration**

* Support integrations between **Salesforce and MuleSoft** and other enterprise applications.
* Hands-on understanding of: Salesforce REST API Salesforce SOAP API Bulk API Platform Events OAuth 2.0 authentication Connected Apps Salesforce Connector for MuleSoft
* Troubleshoot synchronization and data-transfer issues between Salesforce and downstream/upstream systems.
* Work closely with Salesforce administrators and developers on integration-related incidents and changes.
Understand Salesforce objects, custom objects, fields, permissions, profiles, API limits, and integration-user concepts.  

  

### **API & Interface Management**

* Manage and monitor APIs through **Anypoint API Manager** .
* Support REST and SOAP-based integrations.
* Implement or maintain API security policies such as: OAuth 2.0 Client ID enforcement Rate limiting IP restrictions TLS/mTLS
* Maintain interface inventories and technical documentation.
* Monitor API consumption, availability, errors, and performance.
Support integration lifecycle management across development, testing, and production.  

  

### **Incident & Problem Management**

* Provide **L2/L3 support** for MuleSoft and integration-related incidents.
* Perform root-cause analysis for recurring interface failures.
* Coordinate with application owners, vendors, developers, infrastructure, network, and security teams.
* Participate in major incident resolution for business-critical integrations.
Maintain operational SOPs, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, and support documentation.  

  

### **Security & Governance**

* Ensure interfaces comply with organizational security and integration standards.
* Support certificate, API key, OAuth client, service-account, and secret lifecycle management.
* Follow change, incident, problem, and release-management processes.
* Support audit and compliance requirements related to enterprise integrations.
Ensure appropriate logging and monitoring without exposing sensitive credentials or business data.  

  

**Required Skills**
-------------------

AreaRequired KnowledgeMuleSoftAnypoint Platform, Runtime Manager, API Manager, Anypoint MonitoringMule RuntimeMule 4.xSalesforceSalesforce APIs, Connected Apps, OAuth, Salesforce ConnectorAPIREST, SOAP, JSON, XML, RAML/OpenAPIAuthenticationOAuth 2.0, Basic Auth, certificates, API keys, mTLSIntegrationSynchronous and asynchronous integration patternsTroubleshootingAPI, connectivity, authentication, data and performance issuesMonitoringAnypoint Monitoring, logs and enterprise monitoring platformsNetworkingDNS, proxy, firewall, ports, TLS/SSLIT OperationsIncident, Problem, Change and Release Management

  

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for Mule deployments using tools such as **Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab** .
* Experience integrating Salesforce with ERP, HR, finance, identity, or other enterprise platforms.
* Exposure to **SAP, Workday, Microsoft Azure, Entra ID, ServiceNow, or Microsoft Dynamics 365** integrations.
* Experience with SQL databases and SFTP/file-based integrations.
* Understanding of enterprise API governance and API-led connectivity.
* Ability to analyze logs using tools such as Splunk or Azure Monitor.
Experience supporting global, business-critical integration environments.  

  

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* **4–7 years of overall IT/integration experience.**
* Minimum **3 years of hands-on MuleSoft experience** preferred.
* Demonstrated experience supporting **Salesforce integrations through MuleSoft** .

MuleSoft and/or Salesforce certifications are advantageous.

* Salesforce Platform Administrator
Salesforce Platform Developer

--------------------

* Ability to understand end-to-end integration flows

title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced individual to lead and support our technical support team. This role involves overseeing daily operations, ensuring high-quality customer support, mentoring team members, and driving process improvements. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise, leadership skills, and a passion for delivering excellent customer experiences.

**Team Management & Leadership:**

* Supervise and mentor the technical support team, ensuring optimal performance
* Assist in recruiting, onboarding, and training new team members
* Monitor team productivity, provide feedback, and conduct performance evaluations
* Foster a positive and collaborative team culture that encourages problem-solving and innovation

**Technical Support Operations:**

* Oversee day-to-day technical support activities, ensuring timely resolution of customer issues
* Act as the escalation point for complex technical issues and ensure resolution within SLA timelines
* Monitor support metrics (e.g., response times, resolution rates, customer satisfaction) and drive continuous improvement
* Collaborate with other departments to resolve technical issues and enhance service delivery

**Process Improvement & Reporting:**

* Identify and implement process improvements to enhance support efficiency
* Develop and maintain documentation, FAQs, and knowledge base articles
* Analyze support trends, generate reports, and provide recommendations to senior management

**Customer Experience & Relationship Management:**

* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction by delivering prompt and effective support
* Implement customer feedback to refine support processes and enhance user experience.

**Information Security Responsibilities**

* Adhere to JCI policies, guidelines and procedures pertaining to the protection of information assets

* The software, licenses, shall be deployed and used only in accordance with JCI licensing agreements

* Implement appropriate physical and technical safeguards to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information assets
* All employees, contractors and third parties shall be responsible to report all information security incidents, alerts, warnings and suspected vulnerabilities, in a timely manner, and share such information only with authorized personnel

**Qualifications**:

* A degree in engineering or related field is a must, preferably BE / B.Tech /ME/ M.Tech/BCA/MCA, BSC/MSC.

**Skills and Qualifications Required:**

* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Excel and Power point
* Experience with Salesforce is a must
* Strong customer service know-how
* Good interpersonal and problem-solving skills
* Excellent leadership, communication, and conflict-resolution skills
* Ability to work in shifts: all time zones in US
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
