title: Senior Manager Product Support
description:
What You'll Do:

**Senior Manager, Technical Support**

**Reporting to:** Director, Global Support Operations

The Senior Manager, Technical Support will lead and scale a high-performing global support organization, delivering exceptional technical assistance and customer experience. This role operates in a manager-of-managers capacity, overseeing frontline leaders and driving operational excellence across support functions.  
  
You will be responsible for optimizing support operations, enhancing customer satisfaction, and driving strategic initiatives—including the adoption of AI and automation—to improve efficiency, scalability, and outcomes. This role requires a balance of strong technical acumen, leadership capability, and a data-driven approach to continuous improvement.
  
  
Your role is critical in shaping the future of support by combining technical depth, leadership, and AI-driven transformation. You will play a key role in building a scalable, efficient, and customer-centric support organization that directly impacts customer success and business growth

  
What Your Responsibilities Will Be:

Leadership & Team Development

* Set clear performance expectations, conduct evaluations, and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Technical Support Operations

* Drive adherence to SLAs, improve operational efficiency, and scale support processes.
* Partner with global teams to continuously improve KPIs such as TTR, CSAT, and productivity.
* Identify and implement opportunities for AI and automation to improve case deflection, triaging, and resolution times.

Customer Experience & Escalation Management

* Oversee critical escalations and provide guidance on complex technical issues.
* Engage directly with customers as needed to resolve high-impact issues and ensure satisfaction.
* Ensure clear, effective communication of technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Training teams to drive product improvements and better customer outcomes.
* Influence the development of AI-driven tools, self-service capabilities, and knowledge management systems.
* Act as a key stakeholder in aligning support strategy with broader organizational goals.

Performance Management & Insights

* Analyze support metrics, trends, and customer feedback to identify improvement opportunities.
* Provide regular insights and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
* Use data to drive decision-making and continuous optimization.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

* Champion initiatives to improve support quality, efficiency, and scalability.
* Stay current with industry trends, especially in AI-enabled customer support, and bring innovative practices into the organization.
* Drive a culture of experimentation and continuous learning.

What You'll Need to be Successful:

* Graduate in any discipline (technical or business background preferred).
* 12+ years of experience building and scaling customer-facing technical support teams, **i****ncluding experience managing managers.**
* Proven ability to lead in a manager-of-managers capacity and scale global support operations.
* Strong experience in API-based or technically complex support environments.
* Expertise in support operations, process optimization, and service delivery.
* Proficiency with CRM and support platforms (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow) and multi-channel support environments.
* Demonstrated experience leveraging AI, automation, or machine learning in support operations (e.g., chatbots, case routing, predictive analytics, knowledge systems).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
* Flexibility to work in rotational night shifts (work from office, 5 days a week).

Avalara is an AI-first Company:

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

  
What You Need To Know About Avalara:

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

title: Manager, Performance & Analytics
description:
Lead Commercial Performance Through Data-Driven Business Impact as Manager of Performance & Business Analytics

  

Are you ready for the next step in your career? We are looking for a Head of Performance & Business Analytics who can turn commercial data into actionable business insights and help shape better decisions across the business. In this role, you will lead the Commercial Excellence analytics function while owning the commercial fact base across Sales, Service, Installed Base, Pricing, Marketing, and Customer Lifecycle Management. You will drive analytics initiatives that improve forecasting accuracy, increase sales productivity, and support profitable market expansion. Working across business strategy, commercial operations, finance, CRM systems, and analytics capabilities, you will play a key role in helping the organization achieve stronger commercial performance.

  

Your responsibilities

* Lead and manage a team of process development specialists to improve process performance across multiple functions.
* Own and develop the Commercial Excellence analytics function and commercial fact base.
* Partner with leaders across production, supply chain, sales, and other functions to identify key development opportunities.
* Lead cross-functional process development projects and ensure actions deliver targeted business results.
* Transform commercial data into actionable insights that support business growth and decision-making.
* Provide transparency, analytics, and decision-support tools to commercial leaders.
* Improve forecasting accuracy, sales productivity, and profitable market expansion through analytics-driven recommendations.
* Analyze business needs, resource requirements, and internal demand to prioritize development activities.
* Manage team recruitment, performance management, and succession planning.
Act as a bridge between business strategy, commercial operations, finance, CRM systems, and advanced analytics capabilities.  

  

Expectations from you

* Engineering Degree in Mechanical, or Electrical.
* You have 4-7 years of relevant experience.
* You have experience leading teams and managing specialist resources.
* You have a strong understanding of process development and business performance improvement.
* You have experience working across multiple business functions and stakeholder groups.
* You can lead cross-functional projects and drive measurable business outcomes.
* You can analyze business needs, resource requirements, and competing priorities.
* You have experience using analytics to support commercial decision-making.
You can work effectively across sales, service, marketing, finance, CRM, and business operations environments.  

  

To succeed in this role

Success in this role requires the ability to connect commercial strategy with analytics and process development to drive measurable business results. You must be able to lead cross-functional initiatives, prioritize development activities based on business needs, and convert complex commercial data into actionable insights that improve performance. Strong leadership capabilities, stakeholder management, and experience working across business, finance, operations, and analytics functions are essential.

  

We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical behaviors that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:

* Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through
* Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly
* Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety
Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value  

  

We offer

You will join a team responsible for Commercial Excellence analytics and commercial performance insights. The team owns the commercial fact base across Sales, Service, Installed Base, Pricing, Marketing, and Customer Lifecycle Management, providing the transparency and analytics needed for informed decision-making. Together, the team supports growth initiatives, forecasting improvements, sales productivity, and profitable market expansion. The function works closely with business strategy, commercial operations, finance, CRM systems, and analytics stakeholders, creating a highly collaborative environment with broad business exposure. You will have the opportunity to lead both people and business improvement initiatives while contributing directly to commercial success.

  

Valmet offers an inspiring and challenging position with opportunities to make a meaningful impact. You will work in a collaborative environment that supports professional development, innovation, and continuous learning. We value our employees and provide opportunities to grow your skills while contributing to business success.

  

When everything works together

*Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers; we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.*

  

*At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. *Join the team – and lead the way with us!*

title: Senior Client Solutions Manager - X (Twitter) Ads
description:
**Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?**
At
**Aleph**
, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.
  
  
Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.
  
  
With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.
  
  
As Senior Client Solutions Manager for X in India, you will be the day-to-day link between our advertisers, their agencies and the teams that run their campaigns. You will own client relationships end to end, from planning and launch through to optimisation and review. This is not a coordination-only role. You will step in on campaigns and help with set-up and troubleshooting where it matters or when your judgement says it will move results faster. You are expected to understand how campaigns are built and optimised, explain it clearly to clients, and push back when a request will not deliver the result they want.
  
  
**Location: Gurgaon (office-based, 3 days a week in office)**
**What you will do :-**

* Own and grow relationships with advertisers and agencies on X, acting as their primary point of contact
* Understand client business goals and turn them into campaign plans, media plans and proposals
* Guide campaign set-up, targeting, creative and budget decisions. Step in hands-on where needed to setup, launch and optimize campaigns
* Monitor performance, spot issues early and recommend optimisations that improve results
* Prepare and present campaign reports, post-campaign analyses and quarterly business reviews
* Handle client and agency queries, objections and escalations calmly and professionally
* Work closely with X's partner and product teams to raise requests, access new features and resolve blockers
* Support billing, approvals and collections follow-ups with clients and agencies
* Bring market and category insights back to the team and help build a stronger book of business in North India

**What you bring :-**
**Must have :-**

* 4 to 8 years of experience in client servicing, account management or client solutions within digital advertising, a media agency, an ad platform or a performance marketing team
* Hands-on experience running or optimising paid performance campaigns (for example X, Meta, Google or programmatic)
* Strong command of performance metrics such as CPM, CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS and conversion tracking
* Confident communicator who can hold a client conversation, handle objections and manage demanding agency stakeholders
* Strong presentation and reporting skills, including building clear decks and campaign summaries
* Comfortable working across clients, agencies and internal teams at the same time

**Good to have :-**

* Experience on X Ads or other social and video platforms
* Exposure to sectors such as auto, BFSI, gaming, tech or e-commerce
* Existing relationships with agencies or advertisers in North India

**Where You Will Work :-**

title: Renewal Manager II
description:
**Description**
**What We’re Looking For:**
In this role, you'll play a vital part in our organization, with your primary focus being to secure on-time renewal revenue and secure revenue across our Indian portfolio. You will work closely with our extended account teams to maximize the value provided to the customer, ensuring our long-term partnership, while also owning the discipline that keeps renewals and payments on track across a broad client base spanning SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise. Meltwater offers an environment where you'll be surrounded by talented coworkers at the cutting edge of AI Martech, working across one of our most diverse account portfolios in the region.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**

* Lead efforts to ensure on-time renewal revenue across your India portfolio, spanning SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise accounts, collaborating closely with our account teams.
* Own collections end-to-end on your book chasing overdue invoices, resolving billing disputes, and working with Finance/AR to keep outstanding balances current and DSO in check.
* Handle the hard conversations at volume. This portfolio involves customers weighing competitors, raising product or billing concerns, or facing payment delays you'll be the person having those conversations, calmly and commercially, week in and week out.
* Proactively cultivate relationships with customers, ensuring their awareness of our product offerings and adoption of their current package.
* Identify upcoming renewals and maintain accurate account and payment status data within the CRM system.
* Develop quotes, manage administrative tasks, and oversee the execution of renewal contracts.
* Flag payment risk and churn risk early, and build recovery plans before either becomes a surprise.
* Feed what you're hearing from customers competitor moves, product gaps, payment friction back to leadership to shape our approach to the market.
* Run an accurate forecast which identifies outlook, best case scenarios, and risk, including collections status as part of that picture

**What You’ll Bring:**

* A Bachelor's degree or higher is required for this role.
* 3+ years in sales, renewals, or customer success, ideally SaaS including experience retaining customers in competitive or at-risk situations.
* Direct experience with collections or accounts receivable follow-up comfortable owning difficult payment conversations, not just renewal conversations.
* Comfort managing a varied portfolio across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise accounts, each with different stakeholders and different risk profiles.
* Exceptional organisational skills, emphasizing data accuracy and meticulous attention to detail.
* Customer-centric mindset, adept at engaging with customers and effectively addressing their concerns.
* A proactive approach to identifying and flagging upcoming renewals, payment risk, and potential issues before they arise.
* Strong communication skills to articulate renewal options clearly and collaborate effectively with Account Managers and customer success colleagues.
* Commercial acumen to spot risk early and ensure our services are evolving alongside our clients.
* Proficiency with CRM systems, ensuring the maintenance of accurate and up-to-date information. Salesforce experience is preferred.

**What We Offer:**

* Enjoy flexible paid time off for enhanced work-life balance.
* Meltwater demonstrates commitment to your well-being by contributing towards Discovery Health, ensuring robust healthcare coverage.
* Complimentary CalmApp subscription for you and your loved ones because mental wellness matters.
* Energetic work environment with a hybrid work style, providing the balance you need.
* Benefit from our family leave program, which grows with your tenure at Meltwater.
* Thrive within our inclusive community and seize ongoing professional development opportunities to elevate your career.

**Where You'll Work:**
New Delhi
  
  
**When You'll Join:**
As Per Offer Letter
  
  
**About Meltwater**
At Meltwater, we believe that when you have the right people in the right environment, great things happen. Our best-in-class technology empowers our
**27,000 customers**
around the world to make better business decisions through data. But we can’t do that without our global team of developers, innovators, problem-solvers, and high-performers who embrace challenges and find new solutions for our customers. Our award-winning global culture drives everything we do and creates an environment where our employees can make an impact, learn every day, feel a sense of belonging, and celebrate each other’s successes along the way. We are innovators at the core who see the potential in people, ideas and technologies. Together, we challenge ourselves to go big, be bold, and build best-in-class solutions for our customers. We’re proud of our diverse team of
**2,200+ employees**
in
**50 locations**
across
**25 countries**
around the world. No matter where you are, you’ll work with people who care about your success and get the support you need to unlock new heights in your career.
  
  
**We are Meltwater. Inspired by innovation, powered by people.**
**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**
*Meltwater is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind: At Meltwater, we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered. We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity and strive to provide a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment.
  
  
All employment decisions at Meltwater are made based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by the applicable laws and regulations.
  
  
Meltwater does not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, and we actively promote a culture of respect, fairness, and inclusivity. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities to apply and join us in our mission to drive innovation and make a positive impact in the world.

These tools are used only to assist our team through increased efficiencies. Every output continues to be reviewed by humans, and all hiring decisions are made by humans. title: Account Head - Growth
description:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.
  
  
As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.
  
  
We operate with an AI-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.
  
  
If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.
  
  
Let’s build what’s next, together.
  
  
**Customer Orientation**

* Build and maintain trusted relationship with assigned (Tier1) clients to achieve overall customer health and growth (regular meetings, share Infobip strategy and roadmap, help position Infobip against competitors).
* Serve as a focal point for client when it comes to meeting client’s business and technical expectations (technical escalations, services/product adoption, communicate customer feedback and ideas to Product teams). Coordinate different teams in order to best serve customer.
* Understand client’s structure and processes around choosing/implementing new solutions.
* Meet and exceed quarterly KPIs, to ensure overall business growth for assigned clients (gross profit, margin% and cross-sells as the most important metrics).
* Work closely with Customer Success for existing and future SaaS business.
* In cooperation with TAA, ensure client's account is properly set-up / collaborate with Platform Operations teams to arrange setup which enables client's activities based on agreed business scope (account creation and set-up, route management, sender registration, allowed content filtration setup and maintenance).
* In cooperation with Revenue Assurance, monitor and take actions to minimalize health risks (actively involve ensuring financial collections and netting).
* Analyze and forecast client's traffic, take immediate reactions to ensure ongoing business growth, minimize losses, and maximize GP/revenue.

**Internal initiatives**

* Power user, and help improving (by providing constructive feedback and ideas) Infobip’s internal tools for account setup, traffic monitoring and troubleshooting (Qlik, SU).
* Coordinate internal teams to timely fulfill client's requirements (Customer Success, Sales Engineers, Customer Support, Technical Account Administration, Platform Operations, Customer Analyst, Procurement, Revenue Assurance).
* Update all activities regarding client engagements and opportunities in dedicated tools (SF).
* Influence Infobip’s ever-evolving end-to-end customer experience by grasping and continuously promoting client’s perspective to the internal stakeholders.

**Continuous Development**

* Promote team spirit and nourish critical thinking.
* Help mentor and onboard other team members and newcomers.
* Have an excellent knowledge of Infobip products, platform, and relevant markets.
* Have an excellent knowledge of client`s business and ways they (can) use Infobip.
* Be up to date with industry trends and competition.

If you are enthusiastic about contributing to the future of communication technology and believe you have what it takes to thrive in a dynamic and innovative environment, Infobip is the place for you.
  
  
**Diversity drives connection**
**Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.**
We’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.
  
  
No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.
  
  
**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.**
Read more about our hiring process.

enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns
  
  
India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited,
  
  
a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004.
  
  
Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s
  
  
network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our
  
  
robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player
  
  
with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
  
  
We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top
  
  
Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to
  
  
creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
  
  
If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and
  
  
safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to
  
  
cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
  
  
Position Overview:
  
  
The Senior Business Development Executive/Associate Territory Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth within
  
  
the assigned Area by effectively managing the sales process for all products, including Domestic Priority (DP),
  
  
International, Retail, Cargo, and E-Retail. The role will also focus on revenue enhancement through channel partners such
  
  
as Regional Service Providers (RSPs), Consolidators, Franchise Collection Centres (FCCs), and One-Stop Centres (OSCs).
  
  
The incumbent will play a crucial role in customer acquisition, relationship management, and adherence to company sales
  
  
policies.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
This role will focus on managing the end-to-end sales cycle, ensuring customer satisfaction, and driving sustained business
  
  
development. It requires a highly motivated and target-driven individual with a strong understanding of the logistics and
  
  
courier industry.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**
Sales & Revenue Growth
  
  
  

* Monitor and drive Area revenue performance to achieve targeted sales growth and profitability.
* Evaluate the profitability of key accounts and take corrective measures to achieve profit targets.
* Track product-wise yields regularly and develop action plans to meet set targets.
* Manage the end-to-end sales process for the Area, ensuring revenue growth for all products.

Channel Partner & Customer Management
  
  
  

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing customers, ensuring revenue retention.
* Identify and drive new business opportunities through channel partners.
* Monitor and enhance channel partner performance in terms of revenue, sales, and profitability.
* Support sales capability-building initiatives for sales teams and channel partners.

Sales Operations & Compliance
  
  
  

* Ensure adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) among sales teams and channel partners.
* Implement sales and marketing strategies to enhance market share and profitability.
* Follow up and ensure closure of product-specific sales leads received from telemarketing or other departments.
* Negotiate rates and service offerings with customers within set approval limits.
* Maintain and update prospect details in the Saffire system on a daily basis.
* Address and resolve customer service issues in coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
* Provide insights to the Branch Sales Head regarding modifications to existing product offerings to enhance revenue and profitability.

Collection & Remittance
  
  
  

* Ensure achievement of collection targets within the set remittance cycle and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) benchmarks.

People Management
  
  
  

* Guide and support the sales team to ensure high performance and goal alignment.
* Ensure optimal staffing levels within the Area sales team.

**Qualifications & Experience:**
Education:
  
  
  

* Essential: Graduate degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
* Preferred: An MBA or Postgraduate degree in Sales & Marketing.

Experience:
  
  
  

* 1-3 years of experience in sales, business development, or key account management in the logistics, courier, supply chain, or e-commerce industry.
* Experience in B2B sales, managing channel partners, and driving revenue growth is an added advantage.

**Skills & Capabilities:**
Technical Skills:
  
  
  

* Strong understanding of sales processes, revenue management, and market expansion strategies.
* Experience in logistics, courier services, or supply chain management.
* Proficiency in using sales tracking tools like Saffire and Avature.
* Knowledge of data analytics and business intelligence tools for tracking sales trends and performance.

**Key Competencies:**

* Result-Oriented: Strong drive to achieve sales targets and revenue growth.
* Customer-Centric: Ability to develop and maintain strong customer relationships.
* Analytical Thinking: Proactive approach to market analysis and business development.
* Negotiation & Influence: Strong persuasion skills to drive sales and revenue enhancement.

**Sr. No.**
**Key Result Areas**
**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
1
  
  
Ensure timely response to customer pickup and delivery requests
  
  
  

* % of calls answered within defined number of rings/seconds
* Number of abandoned calls
* Average number of calls handled

Adherence to defined timelines for pickup requests
  
  
2
  
  
Drive revenues from the customer service channel
  
  
  

* Revenue from Cash Desk Sales, TDD

3
  
  
Ensure capability building of self
  
  
  

* Scores on functional training-related tests

4
  
  
Ensure performance-driven culture
  
  
  

* Adherence to Performance Management System timelines and guide

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**
When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
  
  
Here’s what makes us stand out:
  
  
Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well-being.
  
  
Competitive pay and performance-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
  
  
Structured learning, global exposure, and on-the-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
  
  
Best-in-class benefits—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
  
  
A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
  
  
Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220+ countries and territories.
  
  
The pride of working with India’s most awarded logistics brand, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.
  
  
This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.

Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.

**Practice Development Manager (Medical Devices / Digital Dentistry)**

Delhi NCR | Field sales, full time

I'm hiring a Practice Development Manager in Delhi NCR for a global MedTech leader in digital dentistry. You'll own a territory of dental and orthodontic practices, grow existing accounts, bring new doctors on board and help them move to digital workflows such as intraoral scanning, digital treatment planning and clear aligner therapy.

This is a sales role with clear numbers attached. What changes is the conversation. You'll sit with doctors and their teams as a business partner, look at how the practice runs and where it can grow, and sell on value rather than price. Parts of the territory are underpenetrated, so we need someone who enjoys building demand from a low base.

**What you'll do**

• Build and run a territory plan using account data and opportunity analysis

• Grow revenue with existing doctors and activate new practices

• Run consultative, value-led conversations with clinicians and handle competitive objections

• Drive adoption of digital workflows and help practices fit them into daily operations

• Work with clinical, marketing and training teams on doctor education and events

**What you need**

• 6 to 9 years of sales experience, with at least 4 years in medical devices

• Direct selling to doctors (surgeons, specialists, dentists). This is mandatory. Distributor-only or trade sales profiles won't fit

• Experience with an MNC medical device company or a global MNC pharma company

• A record of beating targets that you can back with numbers: rankings, awards, growth %

• Stable career history, around 2.5 to 3 years or more in each organisation

• Experience growing a low-revenue or new territory

• Degree in science, pharmacy, biomedical, engineering or similar. MBA is a plus

Dental or orthodontic experience helps but isn't required. Backgrounds that tend to do well: orthopaedics, cardiology, ophthalmology and surgical devices, diagnostics, capital equipment, and specialty pharma with strong doctor relationships.

**Package**

Fixed CTC up to ₹20 LPA, plus retirals, incentives of up to 65%, and medical insurance.

Many device sales people see dentistry as niche. In practice, this role builds clinician influence, digital adoption skills, territory ownership and practice consulting experience, all of which carry across healthcare technology. The company is also expanding its presence in India.

title: Senior Growth Manager
description:
**About Moloco:**
Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet. Founded in 2013 by machine learning engineers who had built AI advertising systems inside the world's largest technology companies, Moloco began from a shared mission: to build that same engine for the open internet.
  
  
Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system.
**Moloco Ads**
is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet.
**Moloco Commerce Media**
is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by
**CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture)**
, the AI system behind every Moloco product.
  
  
At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer.
**Come build what's next.**
**The Impact You'll Be Contributing to Moloco:**
Join Moloco as a Senior Growth Manager and help advertisers grow their mobile businesses. Moloco Ads is an AI-native performance advertising platform that helps app marketers acquire and re-engage high-value users across the open internet, optimising campaigns towards measurable business outcomes.
  
  
You’ll build a deep understanding of each client’s business, shape their growth strategy, and work with colleagues across Sales, Marketing, Data Science, and Product to turn insights into better performance and lasting partnerships.
  
  
This role is based in Gurgaon, with a hybrid working model.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**

* Develop a deep understanding of clients’ businesses and marketing objectives, and show how Moloco Ads can help achieve them.
* Build a clear, data-driven strategy for each client, taking ownership of account performance and long-term growth.
* Partner with Sales, other Growth Managers, Data Science and cross-functional teams to improve campaign performance and grow client accounts.
* Lead client relationships, meetings and business reviews, building trust through clear communication and actionable recommendations.
* Analyse campaign data, translate complex findings into clear insights, and use them to guide client decisions.
* Identify and recommend opportunities to expand client investment in line with growth objectives.
* Work with GTM, Product, and Data Science to improve products and client solutions, bringing client needs and feedback into the process.
* Look beyond individual campaigns to identify recurring challenges, address root causes and develop approaches the wider team can use.
* Stay informed about developments in the mobile advertising ecosystem and translate relevant trends into practical advice for clients.

**How Do I Know if the Role is Right For Me?**

* 6+ years of experience in mobile advertising account management, with experience in programmatic marketing.
* A track record of managing and growing major advertiser accounts.
* Hands-on experience in day-to-day campaign management and optimisation.
* Familiarity with mobile measurement partners (MMPs), the mobile app ecosystem and advertising technology, alongside confidence working with large datasets.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into compelling stories, clear recommendations and effective client presentations.
* Sound commercial judgment: you use data and client context to recommend next steps, explain trade-offs and adapt as new information emerges.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills: you bring clients and cross-functional partners into the work early, communicate recommendations clearly and build alignment across different perspectives.
* A strong sense of ownership and a curious, proactive approach to solving problems.
* Attention to detail and a data-driven approach to decision-making.
* Adaptability, initiative and a willingness to learn in a fast-moving environment.
* Fluency in English.
* Flexibility to travel according to business needs.

**Supporting Your Best Work and Your Best Life:**
Our benefits are designed to support our people in doing their best work and living well, at work and beyond. Benefits vary by country, employment type, and eligibility. Connect with a recruiter to learn more about benefits in your region.
  
  
**Moloco Values:**

* Lead with Humility: Everyone’s voice is respected, valued, and heard. We win, lose, and learn together. Accountability and feedback are essential to our success.
* Uncapped Growth Mindset: We see all situations as opportunities to learn, grow, and improve as individuals and as an organization. We seek diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and promote experimentation to push the boundaries of what’s possible.
* Create Real Value: We pursue the most impactful opportunities with intensity and rigor. We take intelligent risks and make disciplined trade-offs to maintain deep focus. We help our customers win by delivering durable value.
* Go Further Together: We’re one team working towards one vision. We collaborate proactively and inclusively, involving the right people at the right time and in the right way. We strive to create a more equitable workplace. We won’t let each other fail.

**Additional Resources:**

* Moloco Company Blog
* Moloco Leadership

title: Manager, Customer Order Solutions
description:

Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.

title: Associate Director of Partnerships

title: Customer Service & Operations Unit Leader DSARs
description:

title: Senior SAP Basis Consultant
description:
**SAP DCEM (Digital Customer Engagement Manager)**

Primary role/ responsibility for this role is to understand customer requirements about their SAP Landscape and facilitate solutions, technical services with alignment of SAP backend support (TechOps) team on SAP RISE Platform.

· DCEM team member works very closely with SAP IAE, CAA, TSM, CDM teams to ensure Customer has all necessary guidance, information needed for their SAP Landscape functioning & planning (Refer detailed Roles & Responsibilities below)

· SAP RISE Platform offers all latest SAP Technologies (Products) with options for customer to select their own Hyperscaler (AWS, Azure or GCP).

· This role is Customer facing and will require to join meetings, answer technical queries from customer team & present assessments.

· Since it is an Engagement Manager role so there is no expectation from the resource to perform any hands-on work.

**Technical Skill Set required to perform above tasks:**

· Technical expertise in SAP Basis area with minimum of 5+ years of experience.

· 2+ Cloud knowledge (e.g. through Solution Management, Consulting and/or Delivery Program management).

· Good understanding & hands-on experience required in S/4 HANA Application & HANA database.

· Experience in SAP Upgrade & Migration (OS/DB) is mandatory.

· Experience in SaaS products (Ariba, Salesforce, C4S etc.) integration with SAP Landscape is plus.

· Hands-on experience in any of hyper scaler (AWS/ Azure/ GCP) is needed.

**Scope for the career**

· Have a scope of learning new technologies on SAP Products (S/4HANA, HANA Database, MDG, SaaS Products (Ariba, Salesforce etc.) & Cloud (AWS, Azure OR GCP)

· Will have access to all SAP internal training & learning materials to gain knowledge in latest technologies.

· Will gain exposure to all latest build architectures in one single place/ position which will be valuable/ useful in future.
*Generally this exposure is not available in any regular SAP Basis position.*

· Will not be assigned/ dedicated to one single customer but will engage with Multiple customers in various Industries to gain knowledge about different SAP Landscape setups, Delivery processes & Challenges.

· Will rotate in different internal SAP dCEM CoE (Migrations, Upgrade, Escalation, Go-Live etc.)

**Key tasks comprise the following:**

· Technical Architecture, Landscape issues/ queries guidance to end customers.

· Supports sales to delivery handover and customer onboarding to SAP Enterprise Cloud Services

· Contributes to onboarding/transitioning customers to SAP ENTERPRISE CLOUD SERVICES

· Supports in de-escalations of critical customer situations

· Supports critical customer situations in conjunction with Major Incident Management (MIM), SAP Enterprise Cloud Services Customer Office teams and SAP Product Support, as applicable

· Contributes to customer release and maintenance activities

· Supports customers on technical requirements throughout their lifecycle within the SAP Enterprise

· Executes and supports problem management and continuous improvement

· Contributes to the liaison with different SAP stakeholders, esp. Virtual customer success partner involved in the accounts, to ensure customer success

· Supports in reviewing account status and analyzing if account needs to be transitioned to another team, based on growth in volume or complexity of the account overtime.

· Systematic and faster onboarding of associates: mandatory trainings documentation

· Enable continuous delta KTs on new topics and refresher sessions.

**Primary pointers:**

Proven hands-on technical experience

Basis skillset with Migration experiences from On-Prem to the cloud environment

Hyperscaler understanding and experience

Understanding of Technical Managed Services and related ITSM processes

Excellent internal and external stakeholder management, presentation, and communication skills

Customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results-driven / Self-organized

title: Corporate Function Technology Lead
description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer – and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.

Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.

**A PURPOSE DRIVEN COMPANY – 150 YEARS**

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.

Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.

  

**What you will do:**

As the Corporate Function Technology Lead in Global Technology, you won't just manage a team; you'll build one. You will establish and lead a new platform engineering team supporting a diverse portfolio of corporate function technologies across Human Resources, Corporate Real Estate, Global Security, Communications, Privacy, Financial Crimes, and Records Management. You will be responsible for building the team, engineering culture, operating model, and delivery practices that drive platform reliability, operational excellence, and business outcomes.

Working closely with the Business Technology Officer, business leaders, and technology partners across geographies, you will translate strategic priorities into execution, establish scalable engineering and governance practices, manage vendor and delivery partnerships, and ensure platforms meet the risk, security, and regulatory expectations of a global financial services organization. As a member of the Corporate Function Technology leadership team, you will help shape the growth of a new Global Capability Center while building trusted relationships and developing high-performing talent.

In addition to deep technical expertise and experience, you will bring excellent problem solving, communication and teamwork skills, along with agile ways of working, strong business insight, an inclusive leadership attitude and a continuous learning focus to all that you do.

  

**What you can expect:**

* Build and scale a high-performing platform engineering organization within Prudential's new Innovation Hub, establishing the culture, talent strategy, delivery model, and engineering practices that will support long-term growth and success.
* Lead the delivery, reliability, security, support, and continuous improvement of a portfolio of technologies supporting Human Resources, Corporate Real Estate, Global Security, Communications, Privacy, Financial Crimes, and Records Management.
* Establish and oversee platform operations, including application lifecycle management, release management, environment management, monitoring, operational support, and service resiliency.
* Partner closely with business leaders, product owners, architects, and technology teams across the U.S. and India to translate strategic priorities into executable roadmaps, operational excellence, and measurable business outcomes.
* Establish modern engineering practices, governance frameworks, quality standards, and risk management processes appropriate for a global, highly regulated financial services organization, including testing, incident management, production readiness, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
* Drive platform modernization, automation, resiliency, and operational excellence through cloud-native technologies, DevOps practices, observability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure effective security and access management practices while maintaining compliance with regulatory, audit, data privacy, and information security requirements.
* Build trusted relationships across business, technology, and vendor ecosystems, providing leadership across service providers, delivery partners, and distributed teams.
* Develop and mentor technology leaders and engineers, fostering a culture of accountability, knowledge sharing, cross-training, inclusion, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Help shape the growth and success of the PFI Innovation Hub by bringing local market insights, leadership experience, and a builder's mindset to a fast-growing organization.

**T****he skills and expertise you bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 8-10+ years of technology leadership experience, including 4+ years leading engineering, platform, or delivery teams.
* Experience operating within a Global Capability Center, shared services, or offshore delivery model, including building, scaling, or transforming teams.
* Proven track record of hiring, developing, and leading high-performing teams.
* Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence and translate complex technical concepts for business and technology audiences.
* Experience supporting enterprise corporate functions such as Human Resources, Security, Communications, Real Estate, Privacy, Compliance, or Financial Crimes.
* Deep understanding of platform engineering, including application architecture, cloud technologies, integration patterns, DevOps, SRE, and agile delivery practices.
* Experience managing strategic vendors, third-party relationships, and associated risk.
* Knowledge of governance, risk, compliance, information security, and data privacy requirements within financial services or other highly regulated industries.
* Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with success leading across global, matrixed organizations and navigating complex organizational dynamics.
* Demonstrated change leadership, including the ability to build new capabilities, establish processes, and drive transformation in evolving environments.
* Strong business acumen, problem-solving ability, collaboration skills, and a commitment to continuous learning and innovation.
* Lead and effectively leverage diverse ideas, experiences, thoughts, and perspectives to the benefit of the organization.

title: Director, Talent Supply Chain Operations
description:
The Company
  
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  
Role Overview
  
At the heart of every successful organization is the ability to attract, move, and onboard great talent seamlessly. As our Director, Talent Supply Chain Operations, you will lead the engine that powers that journey.
  
This role is responsible for the operational excellence of our talent supply chain—from approved requisition through candidate selection, and from offer acceptance through successful onboarding. You will ensure that every step of the process is efficient, scalable, complaint, and delivers outstanding experience for candidates, hiring managers, and new employees.
  
Working closely with Talent Acquisition, People Culture partners, and business leaders, you will transform how talent moves into the organization by leveraging data, process excellence, technology, and a relentless focus on service delivery.
  
What You'll Do
  
Lead End-to-End Talent Supply Chain Delivery
  

* Own the operational delivery of the talent acquisition and onboarding lifecycle.
* Ensure smooth, timely, and high-quality execution from requisition approval through onboarding readiness.
* Create a scalable operating model that enables the organization to meet its workforce demands efficiently and consistently.

Drive Operational Excellence
  

* Lead recruitment operations teams responsible for:

o Requisition management
  
o Interview coordination and scheduling
  
o Candidate administration
  
o Assessment logistics
  
o Offer management
  
o Background verification and pre-employment processes
  
o New hire onboarding readiness
  

* Simplify, standardize, and continuously improve processes to increase efficiency and quality.

Deliver Exceptional Experiences
  

* Create a seamless journey for candidates, hiring managers, and new hires.
* Partner across the People Culture ecosystem to remove friction points and improve service delivery.
* Champion service excellence through clear accountability, responsiveness, and stakeholder engagement.

Leverage Data and Insights
  

* Establish and monitor key operational metrics and service levels.
* Use insights and analytics to identify trends, improve performance, and influence business decisions.
* Drive transparency through meaningful reporting and workforce delivery dashboards.

Enable Transformation and Innovation
  

* Lead automation, digitization, and process transformation initiatives.
* Maximize the value of recruiting and HR technologies to create a more connected and efficient talent ecosystem.

title: VP -Product
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**POSITION DESCRIPTION**

apexanalytix is the world's leading provider of supplier onboarding, risk management and recovery solutions. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Greensboro, NC, apexanalytix is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management Solutions, recognized for both Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute. More than 320 of the world's largest companies use our AI-native, Quantum Era-ready platform to protect over $9.5 trillion in annual spend.

apexanalytix is seeking an experienced Head of Product to own product strategy and execution across apexanalytix's full platform.

The portfolio spans three connected pillars — supplier onboarding, supplier risk management, and audit and recovery — delivered through a configurable enterprise platform, a self-service data validation and risk API business, and a supplier-facing community platform, with a substantial AI and automation capability underpinning all of them. apexanalytix has also been named Risk Management Company of the Year by SupplyTech Breakthrough and rated the top Supplier Relationship Management and Risk solution by Spend Matters.

This role sits at the center of the business — translating customer and market needs into a coherent, prioritized roadmap across that portfolio, and holding product managers and cross-functional partners in Engineering, Design and Go-to-Market accountable to it. This is a player-coach role: you'll set direction across the full portfolio while staying close enough to individual product areas to make sharp calls when it matters.

This role will lead a team of product managers covering apexanalytix's core product lines, working in close collaboration with Engineering, Sales, Customer Success and Marketing to ensure the roadmap reflects both customer value and business priority.

**The Portfolio:**

Supplier management and risk platform. Multi-tenant enterprise SaaS covering supplier registration and onboarding, self-registration and invite flows, document collection and e-signature, validation gates, approval and status workflow, risk scoring and scorecards, segmentation, revalidation, ERP integration, tax and withholding validation, and consent management. This platform is delivered largely through configuration rather than code — dozens of distinct tenant-scoped configurable surfaces mean a significant share of what a client experiences as "the product" is a configuration decision, not a release.

QubitOn. A product-led, self-service data validation and risk API business with a published price list from a free tier through pay-as-you-go, Pro and Enterprise. Over 70 capabilities spanning data validation, banking and financial verification in 180+ countries, global tax ID and regulatory validation, business intelligence and golden-record matching, compliance and watchlist screening, risk scoring, monitoring and questionnaires — backed by 280M+ verified golden records from 1,000+ sources across 250+ countries. Packaged offerings include BankPro and Registration Essentials, and the platform is also delivered through a self-service developer portal.

Conductor. The supplier-side platform, serving our clients' suppliers and customers rather than the clients themselves: signup, identity and passkey authentication, invite and onboarding flows, invoice visibility and risk information. This is the second side of a two-sided market, with its own adoption dynamics.

Cyberrisk. Third-party and supplier cyber risk monitoring, adjacent to the supplier risk and TPRM capability in the core platform.

Audit, recovery and payment integrity. The accounts payable and contract compliance recovery audit practices — apexanalytix is the largest commercial AP recovery audit firm in the world — and firststrike® Fraud Detect, the duplicate payment prevention product that grew out of our audit algorithms and has run in daily client operations since 2006. A services-plus-software business with a contingency commercial model.

apexanalytix Learn. Subscription-based training and enablement.

AI-enabled capability. A significant AI and automation capability — document intelligence, conversational assistants, supplier intelligence, ESG scoring and AI-assisted audit — built and delivered by a separate AI & Automation organization. This role owns what is packaged, positioned and priced from it for clients, and the prioritized demand signal into that organization.

**Trusted Advisor**

* Leverages deep subject-matter expertise across apexanalytix's product portfolio to advise executive leadership on product strategy and investment trade-offs.
* Acts as the voice of the customer and internal advocate, ensuring insights from enterprise clients (many on the Global 2000) shape the roadmap rather than getting lost between teams.
* Partners with Engineering, Design and Go-to-Market leaders to translate business priorities into a shared, prioritized product roadmap.
* Roles and Requirements
* Owns end-to-end product strategy and roadmap across apexanalytix's core product lines, ensuring alignment with overall company strategy and value-creation priorities.
* Leads, mentors and develops a team of product managers, setting a consistent bar for discovery, prioritization and go-to-market execution across product areas.
* Partners with Engineering leadership to translate roadmap priorities into delivery plans, balancing new feature development against platform investment.
* Owns the commitment-to-delivery discipline: every commitment made to a client, prospect or analyst has a named owner, an entry in the delivery system of record, and a date Engineering has agreed to.
* Owns the configuration-versus-code boundary for the supplier management platform — deciding what becomes a configurable capability, what remains a per-tenant configuration, and what becomes a product feature — and is accountable for the long-run support and upgrade cost of that choice.
* Drives customer discovery and market research to validate product bets, working directly with enterprise customers, Sales and Customer Success.
* Owns the supplier-side product experience as a first-class concern with its own adoption metrics, not as a downstream consequence of client-side decisions.
* Defines and tracks product success metrics — adoption, retention, revenue impact, API consumption and supplier activation — and reports progress to executive leadership.
* Leads pricing and packaging decisions in partnership with Finance and Sales leadership across materially different commercial models: enterprise SaaS subscription, usage-metered self-service API with a published free tier, contingency-based recovery audit services, and subscription-based offerings such as apexanalytix Learn.
* Represents Product in executive reviews and with industry analysts, providing clear, data-driven narratives on roadmap progress and business impact.
* Champions a consistent product management practice — discovery frameworks, roadmap cadence, prioritization criteria — across the team.

**Required Skills**

* 10+ years of product management experience, including 4+ years leading and developing a team of product managers.
* Experience owning product strategy for a B2B enterprise SaaS platform, ideally serving large, complex enterprise customers.
* Direct experience with at least two distinct commercial models — enterprise subscription, usage-metered/API, marketplace or network, or services-attached.
* Experience with a self-service or product-led growth motion, including free-tier design, conversion funnel, usage-based pricing and developer experience.
* Experience with a highly configurable enterprise product, and a clear point of view on where configurability creates leverage and where it creates unmanageable divergence.
* Strong technical fluency — comfortable partnering directly with engineering leadership on architecture and platform trade-offs, even without a hands-on engineering background.
* Proven track record turning customer and market insight into a prioritized, well-communicated roadmap.
* Experience with pricing/packaging strategy and business-case development for new products or product lines.
* Strong executive presence — able to represent Product credibly in front of executive leadership, industry analysts and, as needed, the Board.
* Experience working with a distributed engineering organization across US and India time zones.
* Strong communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience in supply chain, procurement, accounts payable, fintech, audit, third-party risk or data/analytics domains.
* Experience with a two-sided or network product where adoption on the non-paying side determines the value of the paying side.
* Experience packaging and pricing AI capability as a product, including the guardrail, assurance and liability considerations that accompany it.
* Experience in regulated or attested environments (SOC 2, FedRAMP) where compliance shapes the roadmap.
* Education Levels/Credentials (Degree types and Emphasis) - Undergraduate degree required; MBA or other graduate business degree a strong plus but not required.

**Location**

* apexanalytix Headquarters (HQ) at Greensboro, NC, USA (hybrid).

**Travel required — occasional, including periodic travel to the Noida, India GCC and to enterprise clients.**

**Scope Boundaries:**

**This role owns what gets built and why, for whom, and at what price. title: Director - Engineering, Forward-Deployed Engineering and Customer Outcomes
description:
**Customer Success at Innovaccer**

Our mission is to turn our customers into tech-savvy superheroes, ensuring they achieve success using our platform to meet their organization’s business goals. If you're passionate about helping customers realize the value they seek with technology, then our customer success team is the right place for you.

About the Role

As the Director of Engineering, FDE and Customer Outcomes, you will lead an elite organization of multiple cross-functional engineering teams, each dedicated to a portfolio of tier-one healthcare customers. You are ultimately accountable for the technical delivery, enterprise configuration, and operational success of our AI-driven platform within complex healthcare ecosystems.

Each team under your leadership operates with high autonomy, directly owning their customer delivery plans, data quality standards, and clinical/business outcomes. You will mentor engineering managers and technical leads across a global footprint to architect robust data ingestion pipelines, configure complex enterprise software, and deploy production-grade, compliant AI agents into live healthcare environments.

**A Day in the Life**

**Global Team Leadership & Delivery Ownership**

* Scale and Govern Multiple Teams: Hire, mentor, and scale multiple customer-facing engineering teams across regions, optimizing global resource allocation across health systems, payers, and life sciences clients.
* Delivery Plan Accountability: Empower autonomous teams to own, track, and execute comprehensive implementation delivery plans, navigating critical paths from discovery to live production.
* Customer Outcome Management: Focus engineering execution on direct business and clinical metrics (reducing administrative burden, improving workflow efficiency) to drive customer retention and high NPS/CSAT.
* Quality Assurance & Standards: Establish baseline organizational standards for data integrity, product quality, architectural reviews, and formal customer sign-off criteria.

**Data Ingestion & Data Quality**

* Clinical Data Ingestion: Guide teams in building high-throughput pipelines to ingest structured and unstructured datasets (EHR notes, lab results, imaging metadata, claims) via HL7, FHIR, and DICOM.
* Data Quality & Normalization: Standardize validation frameworks to sanitize, deduplicate, and normalize raw, heterogeneous healthcare data for downstream AI/ML consumption.
* Deterministic Guardrails: Implement automated data-quality testing and schema enforcement protocols to intercept data corruption or format mismatches pre-ingestion, ensuring absolute clinical data integrity.

**Product Configuration & Enterprise Implementation**

* Enterprise Customization: Oversee platform configuration, tailoring core software capabilities to match specific clinical workflows and varied healthcare operational taxonomies.
* Seamless Integration: Lead native platform deployments into complex enterprise ecosystems, integrating directly with production EHR systems and native provider workflows.
* Solution Architecture: Design scalable pre-sales and post-sales technical solution architectures that align customer requirements with platform capabilities.

**Build & Deploy AI Agents**

* AI Agent Engineering: Oversee the forward-deployed development, local integration, optimization, and fine-tuning of autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents utilizing advanced LLM orchestration frameworks.
* Clinical Safety & Benchmarking: Enforce a high rollout bar which includes deployment-level guardrails, and real-time monitoring and ensure safe outputs.

 **Requirements**

* Professional Experience: 12+ years in software engineering, technical consulting, or enterprise systems architecture.
* Industry Experience: 5+ years within US Healthcare, HealthTech, or Digital Health sectors, working directly with clinical data ecosystems.
* Leadership Experience: 5+ years managing a manager-of-managers organization or multiple concurrent, customer-facing technical delivery teams.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Health Informatics, or equivalent practical experience.

Technical Competencies

* AI/ML Production: Hands-on experience building, optimization, and deploying enterprise-grade AI Agents.
* Data Engineering Stack: Proficiency in designing and managing batch and real-time big data processing systems, pipeline orchestration, Medallion Architecture, and end-to-end ETL/ELT pipeline engineering.
* Healthcare Protocols: Operational knowledge of healthcare standards like HL7, FHIR, C-CDA, X12/EDI

We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.

 **Benefits**

Here’s What We Offer

  

* Generous Leave Benefits: Enjoy generous leave benefits of up to 40 days.
* Parental Leave: Experience one of the industry's best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition.
* Sabbatical Leave Policy: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break? We've got you covered.
* Health Insurance: We offer health benefits and insurance to you and your family for medically related expenses related to illness, disease, or injury.
* Pet-Friendly Office\*: Spend more time with your treasured friends, even when you're away from home. Bring your furry friends with you to the office and let your colleagues become their friends, too. \*Noida office only
* Creche Facility for children\*: Say goodbye to worries and hello to a convenient and reliable creche facility that puts your child's well-being first. \*India offices

Where and how we work

Our Noida office is situated in a posh tech space, equipped with various amenities to support our work environment. Here, we follow a five-day work schedule, allowing us to efficiently carry out our tasks and collaborate effectively within our team.

Innovaccer is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status, feel valued and empowered.

title: Manager, Global IT Security Operations
description:
**Position**- Manager, Global IT Security Operations

**Location**- Gurugram (Hybrid)

The Manager, Global IT Security Risk Management is responsible for leading the operational management and continuous improvement of Lonza's information security risk management program. This role ensures cybersecurity and technology risks are identified, assessed, documented, monitored, and managed in alignment with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and organizational risk appetite.

Reporting to the Global Head of IT Security & Compliance, the incumbent will partner with business leaders, IT teams, procurement, legal, quality, compliance, audit functions, customers, and external providers to strengthen security governance, enhance risk visibility, and drive a consistent enterprise-wide approach to cybersecurity risk management.

Success in this role is demonstrated through improved risk governance, strengthened compliance posture, reduction of unmanaged risk exposure, and delivery of meaningful insights that enable informed business decision-making.

**What you will get:**

* An agile career and dynamic working culture.
* An inclusive and ethical workplace.
* Compensation programs that recognize high performance.
* A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

**What You’ll Do**

**Information Security Risk Management**

* Lead and continuously improve the IT security risk management program.
* Conduct risk assessments, maintain the security risk register, and drive mitigation and remediation activities.
* Provide risk-based guidance to stakeholders and support risk acceptance decisions.

**Governance, Compliance & Audit**

* Maintain security policies, standards, and risk management processes aligned with industry frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST).
* Support internal and external audits, compliance reviews, and remediation of findings.
* Ensure security requirements are embedded in business and technology initiatives.

**Third-Party Risk Management**

* Manage the global third-party cybersecurity risk program.
* Assess security risks of vendors and service providers and oversee remediation of identified gaps.
* Partner with Procurement and business stakeholders to strengthen supply chain security.

**Customer Security Assurance**

* Lead responses to customer security assessments, questionnaires, and due diligence requests.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to demonstrate compliance and security capabilities.
* Maintain customer assurance documentation and address evolving customer requirements.

**Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and report key risk, compliance, and security metrics.
* Facilitate governance reviews and risk reporting for leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement of cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance processes.

**What we are looking for**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, IT, Risk Management, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity risk management, governance, compliance, audit, or information security.
* Strong understanding of security frameworks such as ISO 27001 and NIST.
* Experience managing security risk assessments, third-party risk, audits, and compliance activities.
* Knowledge of DLP, Privileged Access Management (PAM), and security governance practices is preferred.
* Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or ISO 27001 Auditor/Implementer are advantageous.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills in a global environment.
* Proven ability to drive risk-based decisions, manage competing priorities, and deliver results collaboratively.

**About Lonza**

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
