As an organization, we are intentional about our DEI and philanthropic work (like our G2 Gives program) because it encourages us all to be better people.

**About The Role:**
===================

The Buyer Success Specialist is a dual-function role with a primary focus on lead review and quality assurance, complemented by buyer email and ticket support across Capterra, GetApp, and Software Advice.The specialist reviews and enhances lead notes before delivery to software vendor partners, verifies information against recorded calls, and identifies opportunities to improve lead quality and revenue outcomes. The role also responds to buyer inquiries and coordinates follow-up with Advisors and Advocates to support a positive software buying experience.This position supports a U.S.-based team and requires an overnight schedule in India, with availability through **7:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time year-round**.Shift Times between - 8:00PM - 7:00AM.

**In This Role, You Will Be Responsible For:**
----------------------------------------------

**Lead Review & Quality Assurance-**
------------------------------------

* Review, proofread, and enhance lead notes before they are sent to software vendor partners, ensuring information is accurate, complete, clear, and professionally written.
* Compare lead notes with recorded call audio to verify that documentation accurately reflects the buyer’s needs, requirements, and stated interests.
* Identify missing information, inconsistencies, qualification gaps, and missed opportunities before leads are delivered.
* Coordinate with Advisors and Advocates to clarify buyer information, correct documentation, and arrange appropriate follow-up.
* Review a sampling of Advisor calls to assess adherence to established call flows and lead qualification standards.
* Identify relevant opportunities to improve lead quality and maximize revenue while accurately representing buyer needs.
* Manage a high volume of lead reviews within required turnaround times while maintaining consistent quality and attention to detail.
* Provide clear, constructive feedback that recognizes effective practices and highlights opportunities for improvement.

**Buyer Email & Ticket Support-**
---------------------------------

* Manage assigned buyer emails and passback tickets, responding to, resolving, and closing inquiries within established deadlines.
* Answer buyer questions clearly and directly, minimizing unnecessary handoffs.
* Re-engage selected buyers to clarify needs, address outstanding questions, and identify appropriate next steps.
* Process direct unsubscribe requests accurately and promptly.
* Document buyer interactions, behaviors, and outcomes to support continuity of service and understanding of the buyer journey.
* Balance buyer support responsibilities with the role’s primary lead review workload, following team priorities and service requirements.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement-**
-------------------------------------------

* Coordinate with Buyer Success and Quality Assurance teammates to apply lead review and support standards consistently.
* Work with Advisors, Advocates, and their managers to resolve quality issues and communicate new or follow-up opportunities.
* Identify recurring documentation errors, buyer concerns, and process gaps, and recommend practical improvements.
* Build and maintain knowledge of the software markets covered by the business.
* Adapt to changes in workflows, review standards, and queue priorities while maintaining accuracy and productivity.

**Minimum Qualifications:**
---------------------------

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 1–3 years of experience in quality assurance, content review, proofreading/editing, or customer support, with demonstrated ability to review detailed information accurately.
* Strong written and spoken English communication skills, including excellent grammar, proofreading, and editing skills.
* Strong active listening skills and the ability to compare recorded conversations with written documentation.
* Experience using Microsoft Excel and customer relationship management (CRM) tools.
* Ability to maintain accuracy and consistency while handling high-volume, repetitive work within strict deadlines.
* Strong organizational skills, sound judgment, and accountability for the quality and completeness of work.
* Ability to provide constructive feedback and collaborate effectively with colleagues.
* A customer-focused approach to responding to buyer inquiries and resolving issues.
* Ability to learn software markets, qualification criteria, and operational processes quickly.
* Availability to work the required overnight schedule in India and adjust working hours for U.S. daylight saving time changes to maintain coverage through 7:00 p.m. Central Time.

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Direct experience reviewing sales leads or validating lead qualification information.
* Experience proofreading and enhancing vendor-facing lead notes.
* Experience reviewing recorded calls or chat transcripts for quality assurance.
* Experience providing email customer support or managing ticket queues.
* Experience in a software marketplace, B2B lead generation, or a related environment.
* Experience coaching, teaching, or delivering actionable quality feedback.

title: Key Account Manager (Q-Commerce – Ambient & Frozen -SM
description:
**Job Description**
Job Description – Key Account Manager (Q-Commerce – Ambient & Frozen)
  
  
Company: Sarya Holdings Pvt. Ltd.
  
  
Location: Kolkata
  
  
Department: Sales – Quick Commerce
  
  
Position: Key Account Manager (KAM) – Q-Commerce
  
  
Experience: 4–8 Years
  
  
**About The Company**
Sarya Holdings is an FMCG distribution group operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and India. In India, the company focuses on building and scaling Korean food brands, including Good Seoul, Samyang, OKF, and other partner brands.
  
  
The company operates across Quick Commerce, Modern Trade, and General Trade, with a strong presence on platforms such as Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket, Flipkart Minutes, and Amazon Fresh.
  
  
**Job Overview**
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Key Account Manager – Q-Commerce to manage and drive the overall business for both Ambient and Frozen product categories.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing national/platform-level sales, developing strong relationships with Quick Commerce platforms, driving business growth, improving product availability, managing listings, promotions, pricing, inventory, and ensuring operational excellence.
  
  
The role will involve managing both regular ambient products and temperature-sensitive frozen products, ensuring proper cold chain management, inventory control, and business expansion across platforms.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Key Account & Business Management

Manage and grow business across Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket, Flipkart Minutes, and Amazon Fresh.
  
  
Act as the primary point of contact for Quick Commerce platform central teams.
  
  
Build and maintain strong relationships with platform category managers and key stakeholders.
  
  
Drive sales targets, revenue growth, account profitability, and business expansion.
  
  
Lead commercial negotiations, visibility packages, pricing discussions, and Joint Business Planning (JBP).
  
  

* Sales & Category Management – Ambient and Frozen

Drive sales growth across both Ambient and Frozen product categories.
  
  
Develop category-wise sales strategies and expansion plans.
  
  
Monitor primary and secondary sales performance across platforms.
  
  
Ensure product assortment, pricing, and availability across relevant platforms.
  
  
Identify opportunities for new product launches and category expansion.
  
  

* Availability & Inventory Management

Monitor daily product availability and stock levels across platforms.
  
  
Identify and resolve Out-of-Stock (OOS) issues.
  
  
Coordinate with supply chain and warehouse teams to ensure timely stock replenishment.
  
  
Maintain healthy inventory levels and minimize stock-outs and product expiry.
  
  
Prepare rolling forecasts and monitor forecast accuracy.
  
  

* Frozen Category & Cold Chain Management

Ensure proper cold chain compliance throughout transportation and storage.
  
  
Coordinate reefer dispatches, temperature monitoring, and cold chain documentation.
  
  
Manage freezer capacity at distribution centres (DCs) and dark stores.
  
  
Coordinate freezer allocation and infrastructure requirements with platform teams.
  
  
Handle temperature-related rejections and resolve operational issues.
  
  
Monitor FEFO (First Expiry, First Out), shelf life, ageing inventory, and expiry risks.
  
  

* Promotions, Listings & New Product Launches

Plan and execute promotional campaigns across Quick Commerce platforms.
  
  
Manage product listings, catalogue accuracy, pricing, and visibility.
  
  
Coordinate new product launches (NPD) and ensure timely platform onboarding.
  
  
Monitor promotional performance and analyse ROI.
  
  
Ensure promotional activities are aligned with stock availability and inventory requirements.
  
  

* Reporting & Analytics

Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales and business performance reports.
  
  
Monitor platform-wise sales, availability, inventory, and category performance.
  
  
Track key business KPIs and identify improvement opportunities.
  
  
Conduct regular business reviews with management and platform partners.
  
  
Maintain dashboards and provide actionable business insights.
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
4–8 years of experience in FMCG, Food & Beverage, or food distribution sales.
  
  
Minimum 2+ years of direct experience managing Quick Commerce or E-commerce key accounts.
  
  
Hands-on experience with platforms such as Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket, Amazon, or Flipkart.
  
  
Experience managing both Ambient and Frozen/Food categories will be highly preferred.
  
  
Strong understanding of sales growth, account management, commercial negotiations, and category management.
  
  
Knowledge of inventory management, forecasting, product availability, and supply chain operations.
  
  
Understanding of cold chain logistics, temperature-controlled storage, and frozen product handling.
  
  
Strong analytical skills with advanced Excel and familiarity with Power BI, GobbleCube, or platform dashboards.
  
  
Ability to manage platform relationships and independently drive business targets.
  
  
Graduate degree required; MBA or Supply Chain qualification preferred.
  
  
**Preferred Industry Background**
Candidates from the following industries will be preferred:
  
  
FMCG and Food & Beverage
  
  
Frozen Foods and Frozen Snacks
  
  
Dairy and Ice Cream
  
  
Ready-to-Eat and Packaged Foods
  
  
Food Distribution and Supply Chain
  
  
Quick Commerce and E-commerce
  
  
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
Overall sales growth and revenue achievement.
  
  
Product availability across Quick Commerce platforms.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Senior Manager Contract Management Services you are responsible for the teams entrusted by the CPS Market Unit to oversee and optimise the financial aspects of the Contracts they agree with our customers, you will provide direction and leadership to your team of professionals to ensure that Contract costs are controlled, revenue is maximised and all key contractual obligations are met.

  

Your team will support Market Unit customer facing Contract Managers to prep for contract negotiations and management, reviewing contracts to ensure favourable terms and conditions which align with our financial goals, including assessing risks, identifying cost saving opportunities and ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.

  

You will implement processes and controls within your team to monitor and manage costs associated with CPS contracts, leading a team of professionals who will analyse financial data, identify cost variances and implementation strategies to mitigate risks and optimise cost efficiency.

  

In support of customer facing Market Unit contract managers, you will develop strategies to optimise revenue generation from contracts, including pricing optimisation, revenue recognition and contract performance analysis. Your teams will undertake financial analysis and reporting to assess financial impact of contracts, track revenue and cost trends, they will identify and mitigate financial risks such as financial fluctuations, contract disputes or non-compliance by implementing risk assessment frameworks, developing contingency plans and ensuring adherence to internal controls and regulatory requirements.

  

You will drive strong stakeholder management/ partnership capability within your team, delivering professional and effective stakeholder relationships with legal, finance, sales and operations team to ensure alignment and effective communication regarding contract terms, financial implications and performance metrics.

You will collaborate with Service Control colleagues to ensure that ITIL framework principles are deployed across your team and supporting ITIL capabilities available in the Managed Service space are utilised to further enhance the professionalisation of your function.

  

You will drive transformation within your function, sponsoring the design and delivery of a major transformation programme designed to optimise a strategic system driven approach to cost assurance and revenue management to optimise the service we offer at best cost and utilise our professional resources on the highest value activities within the function.

  

Overall you will play a crucial role in optimising financial outcomes related to the contracts we manage on behalf of the Market Unit customer facing contract managers, you and your teams will be seen as trusted partners of the Market Unit Contract Management teams, you will help ensure that our contracts are financially viable, costs are controlled, revenue is optimised and risks are mitigated, ultimately contributing to the CPS aorganisations financial success.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

**Strategic Oversight**  
Accountable for the strategic direction, organisation, operational performance and cost-to-serve of Contract Management Services (CMS), leveraging industry best practices and strategic tooling.
  
Develop and implement strategies to enhance customer trust, satisfaction and colleague experience while delivering professional services at optimum customer value.
  
Define end-to-end CMS processes in alignment with Market Unit Contract Management partners.
  
Champion emerging industry practices and leverage ITIL principles across Service Control to continuously improve CMS capabilities.
  
**Operational & Commercial Management**  
Lead implementation of the Service Operations strategy and delivery of contractual service requirements, maximising service profitability and customer outcomes.
  
Provide SME leadership across complex, high-risk commercial opportunities, including negotiations, SLAs, contract management and P&L responsibilities.
  
Accountable for implementation of CMS governance across CPS contracts in partnership with customer-facing Contract Managers.
  
Define processes and governance, coordinate cross-functional teams, and drive improvement and quality assurance plans.
  
Optimise resources, demand, capacity and cost base to support operational and commercial objectives.
  
Drive integration and transformation across CMS, working with Service Control, Design & Delivery, Procurement, Product, Finance, Legal and Market Units to improve customer experience, reduce costs, optimise revenue and maintain regulatory compliance.
  
**Quality Assurance & Performance**  
Establish and monitor quality assurance standards across CMS and matrix teams.
  
Define and track KPIs to measure operational effectiveness, efficiency and service quality.
  
Translate performance data into actionable insights that improve quality, resource allocation and business outcomes.
  
Drive governance and best practice, particularly across processes impacting cost, revenue and customer experience.
  
**Team Leadership & Development**  
Lead and develop CMS leaders and teams, creating an inclusive, collaborative and high-performance culture.
  
Coach leaders to improve performance, navigate challenges and deliver customer and operational objectives within a matrix environment.
  
Develop training and communication programmes to strengthen CMS capability and service standards.
  
Build strong partnership and stakeholder-management capabilities across the team.
  
Promote appropriate professional accreditation and continuous development to strengthen expertise.
  
**Stakeholder & Customer Management**  
Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, department heads, internal partners and customers.
  
Understand business requirements and align CMS priorities with customer and organisational objectives.
  
Drive a strong understanding of customers within CMS, protecting their brand, customers and service expectations.
  
Act as the customer champion for CMS across Service Control, Managed Services and the wider business.
  
**Continuous Improvement & Crisis Management**  
Drive continuous improvement, innovation, process automation and strategic tool optimisation across CMS and matrix teams.
  
Identify, analyse and resolve complex operational issues, implementing proactive measures to maintain service continuity and improve outcomes.
  
Lead change initiatives that enhance efficiency, quality, customer experience and colleague experience.

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

**Operational Expertise:** Proficiency in ITIL principles and experience working within a Contract Management, Cost Assurance and Revenue Management environment, preferably within a global context. A good understanding of BT products and services and the e2e customer lifecycles process. Strong working knowledge of Managed Services, CPS contract tooling ecosystem. Possesses the ability to take well-evaluated risks and be audacious in making decisions and taking action.

**Customer Focus:** Ability to understand customer needs, infrastructure, brand and business objectives and foster positive relationships at a Senior level to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty. Strong customer focus and drive to provide proactive, pre-emptive and best in class service.
  
**Communication Skills:** Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders and customers at all levels.
  
**Problem-Solving Abilities:** Proven track record of identifying root causes, analysing data, and implementing effective solutions to resolve operational issues. Demonstrable tenacity in driving improvements through matrixed teams.
  
**Change Management:** Experience managing organisational change and driving transformational initiatives to improve operational performance. Proven ability to lead teams through transformation and continuous change Clear focus on continuous improvement and uses initiatives such as upskilling, automation and process improvement on a regular basis across their area of expertise and specific processes.
  
**Leadership Standards:** Demonstrated leadership qualities, including integrity, accountability, customer-centricity, and a growth mindset.

title: Supervisor III, Applications Development
description:
**The** **Opportunity:**
------------------------

Oversees day-to-day operational objectives through the supervision of a team of application development engineers, ensuring efficient software build, release, deployment, and configuration management. Sets objectives that directly impact operational plans, contributing to the implementation of new applications, deployment frameworks, automation processes, and software quality standards. Evaluates and refines work methods, recommending enhancements to improve software implementation effectiveness, deployment efficiency, and system stability. Works on technical challenges that require data analysis, troubleshooting, and strategic consideration of infrastructure dependencies. Communicates regularly with internal teams, including QA, IT, and cloud operations, to align release strategies with organizational priorities. Engages external partners, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure smooth coordination in deployment efforts and software updates.  
  

About the Role

We are converting this position from contract to full-time. Sanjay built the automation layer that now vets every release. We need someone who owns the quality strategy, manages a small team of test engineers, and keeps our AI-driven test infrastructure running as product demands grow.

You will report to the Senior QA Manager, Development team. You will work with product, platform, and DevOps teams. You decide what "good enough to ship" means for our applications; you build the systems that prove it.

  
  

What You'll Own



Automation architecture. Design and maintain test frameworks on the Appvance AI Quality Platform. You decide how tests get structured, how data flows through them, and where they plug into our release pipeline.

* Team management. Directly manage 2–4 test automation engineers. Set their weekly priorities. Review their pull requests. Run 1:1s. Write their annual performance reviews. You decide who takes which feature area. You decide whether their work meets our standards before it merges.

* AI application testing. Build test suites that validate LLM-based features. Test prompt regression. Verify RAG workflows. Detect hallucinations. Validate agent behavior. Use LangChain and LangSmith.

* Scripting and tooling.Write and review Appvance Designer Scripts. Write JavaScript/TypeScript code. Build API test suites for REST and GraphQL. You set the coding standards others follow.

* CI/CD integration.Wire tests into GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and AWS deployments. When a build fails, your tests tell us why within minutes.

* Cross-platform coverage. Ensure web, mobile, desktop, and API layers each have appropriate automated coverage. Cover functional, regression, smoke, integration, end-to-end, security, performance, and database scenarios.

* Quality metrics.Track failure rates, flakiness, coverage gaps, and release-blocking defects. Present these to leadership in plain language.

* Hiring and growth.Interview candidates for automation roles. Write growth plans for your reports. Push them toward harder problems. Do not let them stay comfortable.

* Incident support. Join production release calls. Respond to critical incidents when automation uncovers—or misses—something that hits customers.

  
  

What You've Done Before

* 2–3 years hands-on with the Appvance AI Quality Platform, including Appvance Designer Scripting.

* You write clean JavaScript ES6+ and TypeScript. You read production-grade code and you write it.

* You tested AI-powered applications with LangChain and LangSmith. You validated prompts. You checked response accuracy. You verified RAG pipelines.

* You built or maintained test frameworks for UI, API, database, and cross-browser scenarios.

* You integrated test suites into Git, GitHub, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS, and CI/CD workflows.

* You worked with SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL (MongoDB) data stores.

* You know REST APIs, GraphQL, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, JWT.

* You worked in Agile/Scrum. You know SDLC, STLC, and defect lifecycle.

* You managed or mentored at least one other engineer, even informally.

* Bachelor's or master's in CS, IT, or equivalent.

  
  

How You Work

  
  

* You debug like a detective. When a test fails, you do not re-run it and hope. You trace the failure to its source.

* You write code others can read. Your scripts have clear structure. You comment where needed. Your naming stays consistent.

* You communicate across roles. You explain a flaky test to a product manager. You explain a coverage gap to a director.

* You care about shipping speed. You know the difference between a test that catches real bugs and a test that slows releases but adds no value.

* You give direct feedback. Your reports know where they stand because you tell them.

  
  

Work Environment

  
  

* Hybrid, following our Coimbatore office policy.

* Primarily computer-based work.

* Availability for production releases and critical incidents as needed.

title: Network and Technology Operations Analyst
description:
**#RunwiththePack**
At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to
**end cyber risk**
.
  
  
We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.
  
  
More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.
  
  
We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.
  
  
**About The Position**
**Job Description**
At Arctic Wolf, we're not just navigating the cybersecurity landscape - we're redefining it. Our global team of dedicated Pack members is driving innovation and setting new industry standards every day. Our impact speaks for itself: we've earned recognition on the
**Forbes Cloud 100, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fortune Future 50, and Fortune Cyber 60**
lists, and we recently took home the
**2024 CRN Products of the Year**
award. We’re proud to be named a
**Leader**
in the
**IDC MarketScape**
for Worldwide Managed Detection and Response Services and earning a
**Customers' Choice**
distinction from
**Gartner Peer Insights**
. Our
**Aurora Platform**
also received
**CRN’s Products of the Year**
award in the inaugural
**Security Operations Platform**
category. Join a company that’s not only leading, but also shaping, the future of security operations.
  
  
Our mission is simple:
**End Cyber Risk.**
We’re looking for a
**Network and Technology Operations Analyst**
to be part of making this happen.
  
  
**Position Overview And Objective**
The Network and Technology Operations Analyst provides operational support for Arctic Wolf’s security services by monitoring customer environments, troubleshooting technical issues, and ensuring the health of deployed solutions. This role demonstrates independence in resolving routine issues, revising playbooks when gaps are identified, and mentoring peers on basic troubleshooting. Analysts at this level also contribute recommendations for process improvements and continuously expand technical knowledge.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities And Duties**

* Independently monitor and maintain operational health of sensors and scanners in customer environments.
* Troubleshoot endpoint agent installation and connectivity issues using documented procedures; escalate advanced issues as needed.
* Resolve cloud sensor configuration and communication problems with minimal guidance.
* Triage customer requests, apply playbook-driven solutions, and recommend improvements based on findings.
* Revise troubleshooting documentation or playbooks when gaps are identified.
* Investigate and interpret moderately complex technical issues to identify solutions.
* Interact effectively with customers and internal teams to ensure timely resolution of issues.
* Mentor new team members on processes and troubleshooting techniques.
* Participate in after-hours coverage rotation for urgent support needs.
* Attend training sessions to expand technical knowledge and improve job performance.

**Key Skills**

* Networking fundamentals (DHCP, DNS, VLANs).
* Familiarity with Windows, Linux, and Mac operating systems.
* Basic virtualization experience (VMware, Hyper-V).
* Cloud technologies (AWS, Azure).
* Strong troubleshooting and communication skills.
* Ability to follow structured processes and contribute to improvements.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Currently enrolled in or recently completed a degree in IT/Cybersecurity OR 2 years of IT industry experience.
* Demonstrated interest in networking or cybersecurity.
* Customer-facing experience in any capacity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CompTIA Network+ or Security+ certification.
* Experience with deployment tools (GPO, SCCM, Intune, Jamf).
* Familiarity with scripting (PowerShell, Bash).

**Environment and Physical Demands**
Work is primarily sedentary in nature and can be executed sitting or standing positions in an office environment.
  
  
Requires ability to utilize technology related to using a keyboard, verbal communication, and work with device screens which require visual acuity.
  
  
If located in a company office, often requires the mobility to physically navigate the space.
  
  
In the event of business travel, mobility sufficient to utilize public and private transport and navigate to essential locations.
  
  
May include moving or lifting of 25 pounds or less (e.g., office chair, reams of paper).
  
  
**About Arctic Wolf**
At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including
**Top Workplace USA**
(2021-2024),
**Best Places to Work – USA**
(2021-2024),
**Great Place to Work – Canada**
(2021-2024),
**Great Place to Work – UK**
(2024), and
**Kununu Top Company – Germany**
(2024). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 7,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.
  
  
**Our Values**
Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion, and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.
  
  
We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here.
  
  
We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.
  
  
**All Wolves Receive Compelling Compensation And Benefits Packages, Including**
Equity for all employees
  
  
Flexible time off and paid volunteer days
  
  
RRSP and 401k match
  
  
Training and career development programs
  
  
Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical, mental health, dental, disability, life and AD&D, and value-added services
  
  
Robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health services
  
  
Fertility support and paid parental leave
  
  
**On-Camera Policy**
To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews.
  
  
Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers.
  
  
We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.
  
  
Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our
  
  
entire employee experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodations by emailing recruiting@arcticwolf.com.
  
  
**Security Requirements**
Conducts duties and responsibilities in accordance with AWN’s Information Security policies, standards, processes and controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of AWN business information (in accordance with our employee handbook and corporate policies).
  
  
Background checks are required for this position.
  
  
This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration
  
  
Regulations (“EAR”). Please note that, if applicable, an offer for employment will be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations.
  
  
**Benefits**
All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:
  
  

* Equity for all employees
* 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
* A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru

**Security Requirements**
At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
  
  
Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.
  
  
**Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.**

title: MES Application Support
description:
**We are looking for an MES / POMSnet Application Support Engineer with 3–8 years of experience supporting MES applications in the pharmaceutical domain. The candidate should have hands-on experience with POMSnet or other MES platforms and be capable of supporting business-critical manufacturing applications.**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide L2 application support for POMSnet applications.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application incidents and user-reported issues.
* Perform initial analysis, root-cause investigation, and coordinate with technical/vendor teams for resolution.
* Support application configuration, deployments, upgrades, and production support activities.
* Work with manufacturing/site users to understand and resolve MES-related issues.
* Follow applicable GxP, change-control, and support processes within a pharmaceutical environment.
* Maintain troubleshooting and knowledge documentation.

**Required Skills**

* 3–5 years of relevant experience in MES application support.
* Hands-on experience with POMSnet or another MES platform.
* Experience working within the pharmaceutical/life-sciences domain.
* Good understanding of manufacturing/MES processes.
* Strong troubleshooting, incident analysis, and application-support skills.
* Good communication and stakeholder coordination skills.

**Good to Have**

* Experience handling incidents/service requests using ServiceNow (SNOW).
* Exposure to SQL/database troubleshooting, application interfaces/integrations, and Windows/server environments.
* Experience supporting validated/GxP applications.
* MES application integration with SAP, DCS, Bartender and others

**Detailed Responsibilities**

* Provide functional and technical production support for MES POMSnet applications across multiple pharma manufacturing sites, ensuring system availability and business continuity.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis to diagnose and resolve complex issues related to Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and integrated applications.
* Configure, maintain, and optimize MES application settings to meet business, operational, and regulatory requirements.
* Create, maintain, and update technical documentation, SOPs, support procedures, and system configuration records in compliance with GxP standards.
* Ensure adherence to regulatory and compliance requirements, including FDA regulations, 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, and other pharmaceutical industry standards.
* Develop and maintain knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and best practices to improve operational efficiency and reduce recurring incidents.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality Assurance (QA), Validation, and IT teams, providing regular updates on incidents, service requests, changes, and ongoing support activities.
* Monitor system health and application performance, proactively identifying risks and implementing corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to ensure system stability.
* Mentor and guide junior analysts and team members on MES applications, support processes, pharmaceutical compliance requirements, and industry best practices.
* Coordinate incident, problem, change, and release management activities to ensure timely resolution and controlled system changes.
* Support MES upgrades, enhancements, deployments, and hypercare activities to ensure successful implementation and smooth post-deployment stabilization.
* It’s preferred the candidate possessess strong functional knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, including MES operations, dispensing/weigh & dispense, recipe execution, and shop floor manufacturing processes, along with hands-on experience in MES tools (POMSnet/ PAS-X/ Syncade/ FTPS or similar) and ServiceNow (SNOW) for production support activities.

title: Technical Support Engineer - US Shift
description:
**Who We Are**
**Job Description - CS - Technical Support Engineer**
Testsigma is building the world's first Quality Intelligence Platform - AI-powered, agent-driven, and designed to make software testing intelligent rather than just automated. Our platform learns your application, your history, and your domain. It doesn't just generate tests - it understands risk, detects gaps, and gives teams the confidence to release.
  
  
**What This Role Is**
The TSE who joins us now will be the technical bridge between our customers and our engineering team - helping some of the world's leading QA organisations solve complex problems and get the most out of the platform they rely on to release software with confidence.
  
  
You are the front line of technical ownership for our customers. You combine technical troubleshooting, product understanding, and customer communication to solve issues quickly and effectively.
  
  
You are not a ticket router. You are a technical problem solver who owns customer issues from the first message to the final resolution.
  
  
You own two things above everything else: customer trust and issue resolution - not as competing priorities, but as a single standard. A technically correct answer delivered too late is a poor customer experience. A fast response without meaningful resolution erodes trust. You hold both simultaneously, and you build customer confidence in every interaction.
  
  
Beyond support, this role has direct involvement with Product, Engineering, and DevOps. You act as the voice of the customer, bringing real-world feedback into the product and helping shape what we build next.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Customer Support and Resolution
* Own inbound technical issues from enterprise and SMB customers across chat, email, and calls in a 24x5 rotational shift environment
* Investigate problems thoroughly, reproduce issues, identify root causes, and drive them to closure
* When issues require engineering involvement, escalate with full context and continue to own the customer communication until the issue is fully resolved
* You do not stop at acknowledgement. You own the outcome.
* Technical Troubleshooting
* Troubleshoot issues across web applications, browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge), and automation workflows
* Diagnose cross-browser compatibility issues and understand HTML DOM and CSS behaviour
* Review logs, error traces, and application behaviour to identify root causes
* Support both manual and automation testing workflows
* You understand the difference between symptoms and causes, and you know how to isolate both.
* SLA Management and Operational Discipline
* Meet ticket and chat SLAs consistently -- prioritise issues appropriately and communicate proactively
* Ensure customers receive timely updates without having to follow up
* When timelines are at risk, you are the first to know and the first to act
* Solution Guidance and Consulting
* Help customers understand how to use Testsigma more effectively
* This includes requirements gathering, use-case identification, fit-gap analysis, multi-product solution design, system integration guidance, and workflow design
* Your goal is not just to solve problems -- it is to help customers automate better
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with Engineering, DevOps, and Product to resolve customer issues and improve the platform
* Provide detailed technical analysis, reproduce issues accurately, and ensure the right teams have the context they need to act
* Build and update internal knowledge base articles, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides based on recurring issues
* Customer Advocacy
* Act as the voice of the customer -- identify trends, recurring issues, and feature requests and translate them into actionable feedback for Product
* Ensure what customers experience directly influences what we prioritise

**Non-negotiable**
**What You Need to Have Done Before**

* 1 to 3 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role -- Technical Support, Application Support, L2 Support, or Consulting
* Strong understanding of web-based applications and browser technologies
* Basic knowledge of HTML DOM and CSS
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
* Ability to work in a 24x5 rotational support model
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a technical discipline -- or equivalent relevant experience
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high ownership and attention to detail

**Technical Depth: Hands-on required**

* Can independently investigate a technical issue in a customer environment without being handed the answer
* Can read logs, error messages, and browser output and form a hypothesis about root cause
* Has worked with web applications, APIs, or integrations in a real support context -- not just theoretical knowledge
* Has enough scripting or coding exposure to read what a developer is telling you and to investigate technical issues without a runbook

**Strong Advantage**

* Awareness of programming languages such as JavaScript, Java, Python, or PHP
* Familiarity with testing frameworks and automation concepts -- testing knowledge is not required to join, we will train you on Testsigma and on software testing; what we cannot train is the instinct to own a problem and see it through
* Exposure to hybrid cloud-based SaaS solutions
* Experience in requirements gathering and solution design
* Background in system integrations
* Experience with tools like Postman, Jira, Salesforce, or similar support and developer tooling

**How You Work**
You are energetic, driven, and hands-on. You approach problems with curiosity and persistence.
  
  

* You take ownership from start to finish
* You communicate clearly and confidently
* You stay calm under pressure
* You focus on outcomes rather than activity
* You learn quickly and adapt to new technologies
* You work collaboratively across teams
* You meet commitments consistently

You do not wait for someone else to solve the problem. You drive it to completion.
  
  
**What You Are Not**
**This is not a role for someone who:**

* Treats support as a ticket-closing exercise
* Escalates issues without meaningful analysis
* Struggles to communicate with customers clearly
* Avoids ownership when problems become complex
* Needs constant supervision to stay organised
* Prefers routine over problem-solving

**Why Join Testsigma**

* Work directly with engineering and QA teams at large enterprises across the US, APAC, and Europe
* Act as the voice of the customer with direct influence on product priorities
* Grow into L2, TAM, or Solutions Engineering tracks based on performance
* Build deep product expertise in a fast-growing test automation category
* Flat hierarchy, continuous learning, and direct exposure to product and engineering teams
* 100% company-paid medical insurance, daily catered lunch, and free snacks

**One Question to Ask Yourself**
Have I solved technical problems for customers where I was responsible not only for finding the root cause, but also for communicating clearly, coordinating internally, and ensuring the customer regained confidence in the product?
  
  
If yes, and if helping global engineering teams automate testing at speed and scale sounds like the right next chapter, we should talk.
  
  
When applying, include a specific example of a technically challenging customer issue you resolved, how you communicated throughout the process, and what you learned from it. We read every application.

title: Senior AIOps Support Engineers
company: BCE Global Tech - A Bell Canada Company
description:
Back
  
  
**About The Role**
As part of Bell's AIOps program, AIOps Support Engineers perform hands-on, manual triage of alarms and monitoring alerts across a large and diverse application portfolio. The role starts with 50 applications and grows to roughly 320 over two years, spanning different technology stacks, different log aggregation tools, and different lifecycle dispositions (Invest, Tolerate, Retire, Migrate). The focus today is disciplined, high-quality manual triage with a clear roadmap toward more automated, proactive detection as the underlying telemetry backbone (built on Open Telemetry) matures. This is not an Agentic-automation role; it is the foundational human layer that makes accurate, standardized data and eventually automation possible.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Perform manual Tier 1 triage: monitor, detect, classify, and route incidents based on alarm and alert signals from a range of source applications.
* Work across a diverse toolset: interpret alerts from multiple log aggregation and observability platforms Dynatrace, New Relic, ManageEngine, Glass box, and others and translate them into consistent, actionable incident data.
* Support standardized, real-time telemetry help build and maintain a clean Open Telemetry-based data backbone, ensuring alarm and alert data is standardized, timely, and reliable.
* Move from reactive to proactive: contribute to the shift from reactive incident response toward proactive issue prevention by flagging patterns, gaps, and data-quality issues in monitoring coverage.
* Understand a complex app ecosystem: learn and track the technology stack, architecture disposition (Invest, Tolerate, Retire, Migrate), and ownership of each supported application.
* Engage support groups and app owners: coordinate with the correct support group and application owner for each application to resolve or escalate incidents quickly.
* Support a growing, moving target: adapt as new applications are onboarded the portfolio will grow from 50 to approximately 320 applications over two years.
* Practice data stewardship: flag inconsistent, noisy, or low-quality alert data and help drive it toward a clean, standardized state.

Key Technical Competencies
  
  

* Application & Production Support (L1/L1.5)
* Incident, Problem & Change Management (ITIL)
* Application, Middleware & Database Log Analysis
* Monitoring & Observability (Dynatrace, New Relic, AWS CloudWatch, and similar tools)
* OpenTelemetry & Distributed Tracing (working knowledge)
* Proactive Alert Monitoring & Outage Prevention
* Linux & Windows OS Troubleshooting
* Basic Networking (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL, Load Balancers)
* SQL & Database Query Analysis
* API & Integration Troubleshooting
* Hybrid Environment Support (On-Premises + Cloud)
* ServiceNow / Jira Ticket Management

What We're Looking For
  
  

* Experience: 3–6 years in application or production support (L1/L1.5), preferably supporting hybrid on-premises and cloud environments.
* Willingness to do manual, hands-on triage: comfortable with the detail work of alert monitoring and classification, especially in the early stages of the program before automation scales.
* Adaptability: able to work across a complex, changing application ecosystem different technology stacks, different log aggregation tools, and different architecture placements.
* Customer-centric mindset: focused on service stability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Clear, fast communication: able to interpret alert data with speed and clarity and turn it into actionable next steps for support groups and application owners.
* Growth orientation: interested in developing toward more proactive, automation-supported monitoring as the program matures.

Must-Have Skills
  
  

* Understanding of the Incident Management Lifecycle, and Problem, Change Request, and Service Request concepts (ITIL)
* Basic CMDB concepts
* Hands-on experience working with log aggregation technologies (Dynatrace, New Relic, ManageEngine, Glassbox, or similar)
* Working knowledge of JSON and XML, and basic file/task automation
* Knowledge of IT infrastructure and basic networking: VMs, firewalls, load balancers, containers, OpenShift (OCP), Kubernetes
* Unix Shell scripting and Windows batch file creation
* Basic knowledge of cloud concepts, storage, and security
* Basic understanding of TLS, SSL, tokens, and secret management
* Familiarity with API gateways and API toolkits (Postman, SOAP UI, or similar)
* Ability to support outage response and work effectively with cross-functional teams
* Ability to contribute to Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) and knowledge/runbook creation
* Basic understanding of SLA/SLO concepts, reporting, and availability calculation
* Basic understanding of data concepts: data latency, data fragmentation, data lineage, and data marts

Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Familiarity with AI concepts such as prompt engineering, knowledge graphs, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Exposure to public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Scripting or automation experience beyond basic file automation (e.g., Python)

What We Offer
  
  

* Competitive salaries and comprehensive health benefits.
* Flexible work hours options.
* Professional development and training opportunities.
* A supportive and inclusive work environment.

title: Operational Specialist - Young Graduate Trainee
description:
**Transform the future of workplace operations.**
Drive global real estate systems, data excellence, and service delivery while enabling seamless business operations worldwide.
  
  
**Be the engine behind smarter processes, better insights, and exceptional user support across a global Real Estate ecosystem.**
Your role
  
  
Key responsibilities in your new role
  
  

* Support the rollout of RE systems (e.g. SAP RE-FX, IWMS/CAFM) and processes by preparing and migrating data, validating workflows, conducting user-acceptance tests, documenting issues, preparing training materials, and tracking operational readiness until go-live.
* Support the setup and transition of services to the RE Service Centre by preparing process maps, responsibility matrices, work instructions, service-catalogue entries, and handover checklists for new or changed services Administer RE systems, contracts, locations, spaces, workplaces, occupancy data, assignments, mass uploads and user access in SAP RE-FX,IWMS/CAFM, and other CRE applications based on approved and validated information.
* Perform recurring data-quality controls and resolve identified inconsistencies or coordinate their correction in systems, including access reviews, completeness and plausibility checks, duplicate assignments or conflicting records.
* Act as the central first point of contact for global RE requests and incidents, clarify and document cases, analyse root causes, coordinate and track their resolution with responsible team or specialist functions, and provide transparent updates.
* Prepare recurring KPI dashboards and management reports, maintain the request backlog and workload overview, and support capacity planning, service monitoring, escalation, automation, and continuous improvement.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
**Who we are**

Born in 2014, Yoti is a digital identity and biometric technology company that makes it safer for people to prove who they are. The Yoti app was designed with privacy at its core, giving people a secure way to prove their identity and share third-party credentials with organisations and other people.

Today, we have over twenty million app downloads around the world. We’ve expanded our offering to a suite of business solutions that span identity verification, age verification and estimation, e-signing, AI anti-spoofing technologies and we continue to think of innovative new offerings.

From day one, we’ve been working to fix an outdated identity system. This is not a journey we make on our own but with policy advisors, think tanks, researchers, academics, humanitarian bodies, our users and everyday people. We are committed to solving identity problems through grassroots research and social purpose initiatives. Our dedication to our mission and our team is why Yoti was proudly named one of the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2026 in the UK.

**Purpose of the Role:**
Serve as the main technical contact for Level 2 client support and lead improvements in Yoti’s support processes. Own and maintain public developer documentation to ensure seamless integrations for clients and partners.

**Role Dimensions:**
Member of the Solutions team within Client Services, working closely with Product, Customer Support, BI (Business Intelligence), and Operations.

**Principal Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage Level 2 client support channels, resolving technical integration queries and complex support cases for Yoti’s products and services.
* Analyse support trends to identify and implement process improvements, reducing repetitive queries and driving efficiency.
* Proactively build and maintain expertise in Yoti’s APIs, and web and mobile SDKs.
* Own and update Yoti’s public-facing developer documentation—improving guides, API references, and resources for clarity and accuracy.
* Serve as an advocate for integration best practices, advising clients and external developers on onboarding, troubleshooting, and implementation.
* Mentor colleagues in support and non-technical teams, empowering them to address routine technical queries more independently.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to triage escalations, validate integration requirements, and share insights for product improvements.
* Participate in technical discussions; present complex ideas clearly and support client onboarding and go-live.
* Create and maintain internal technical documentation and handover materials to support internal teams and processes.

**Knowledge, Skills, Qualifications and Experience:**

* Minimum 4 years of experience in solutions engineering, technical support, integrations, or similar roles within SaaS, API, or tech environments.
* Strong knowledge of web technologies (JavaScript, REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks) and backend concepts; containerization (Docker) is a bonus.
* Proficient in languages such as JavaScript (Node.js), Python, Java, or C#, with hands-on SDK and REST API experience. Mobile development (Android/iOS) is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues for external clients, particularly in Level 2 support and escalations.
* Experience writing and maintaining high-quality technical documentation and architecture diagrams.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills; able to convey technical topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Analytical thinker with strong problem-solving skills; proactive and detail-focused.
* Collaborative and effective team player, able to work cross-functionally and support a culture of shared learning.
* Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field (e.g. Computer Science, Information Technology) or equivalent hands-on experience.

**Interview Process**

Stage 1 - Call with a Talent acquisition Team member (30 minutes)

Stage 2 - Call with Head of Solutions (45 minutes)

Stage 3 - Activity/Presentation

Stage 4 - Call with Head of Solutions and Director of Client services (60 minutes)

**What’s in it for you?**

* Flexible working (Core working hours, Hybrid working)
* Performance based discretionary annual bonus
* LTIP (Long term incentive plan)
* Medical Insurance cover of INR 5 lakhs
* Life Insurance / Accidental cover
* Gratuity as per law
* PF as per law
* 18 days paid leave + 6 sick day leave (Annually)
* 10 declared holidays (Annually)
* 5 fully paid days of Selfie Time - for your own personal development, volunteering, charity events, etc
* Quarterly Team and company activities, Social clubs.
* Continuous learning opportunities (Annual Training budgets, conferences etc)

This is a great opportunity to join a company that is leading the way for innovative and responsible identity verification. We’re looking for people who can adapt to a fast-paced environment, as well as champion our brand and what we stand for. We value a positive attitude and people who have a collaborative, creative and transparent approach to solving problems.

**AI Usage during the recruitment process**

Please read our
AI Usage in Recruitment policy
to know more about how Yoti uses AI in the recruitment process and our stance on how candidates can use AI during the interview process.

**We believe in equal opportunities**

It takes a diverse community of passionate, talented and committed people to build a simpler, more secure way of proving identity. We’re an equal opportunity employer, so we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, with different outlooks and experiences.

We are proud to be a Disability Confident employer and we’re committed to making our recruitment process as inclusive and accessible as possible. If you have a disability or long-term condition and need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we’ll do everything we can to support you and to enable you to bring your best self to our hiring process.

**Pre-employment checks**

If your application is successful please be aware that as part of our pre-employment checks, we will check identity and proof of education. If you have previously been employed elsewhere, we will also carry out - Employment, Credit and Database Checks.

For more information about how we manage your data please read our
Applicant Privacy Notice

title: Global People Operations - Systems Administrator
description:
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team And The Role**
The People Systems Operations Administrator supports the day-to-day work that keeps Stripe’s People technology running accurately and reliably. The role sits in the Service Delivery Center and works as part of the wider People Solutions team, with a close dotted-line partnership to People Solutions Systems Management.
  
  
You’ll own a defined set of routine tier 1 and tier 2 operational work across Workday and related People Systems. This includes monitoring support channels and system inboxes, triaging requests, completing repeatable administrative tasks, maintaining documentation, and routing complex issues to the right People Systems owner.
  
  
This is a hands-on operations role. It creates clearer separation between routine support work and the configuration, architecture, governance, and project delivery owned by the People Systems team.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
Support queue and request triage
  
  

* Monitor the Salesforce case management queue and Jira requests for People Systems work.
* Triage incoming requests by urgency, business impact, data sensitivity, and defined support process.
* Resolve standard requests using documented procedures, and route exceptions or higher-complexity work to the appropriate People Systems owner. Keep request records accurate and complete, including status updates, required approvals, supporting documentation, and clear handoffs.
* Identify recurring request patterns and flag opportunities to improve documentation, self-service, or system processes.

Workday operations
  
  

* Monitor the Workday inbox for business process errors, stuck transactions, alerts, and other operational issues.
* Complete routine Workday support tasks, including standard access requests, account maintenance, and operational follow-up.
* Support Salesforce and JIRA run work and respond to common People Systems questions using approved guidance.
* Help with recurring operational tasks such as account monitoring, account resets, and quarterly account reviews.
* Support year-end activity, including schedule extensions, alert configuration, audit requests, and tracking follow-up items.
* Assist with release readiness by reviewing assigned Workday updates, completing test steps, documenting results, and escalating issues found during testing.
* Support recurring People programs, such as performance-cycle launches, using established runbooks and checklists.

Reporting, documentation, and Jira support
  
  

* Intake and triage Workday reporting and data requests. Confirm required information, route requests to the right owner, and provide status updates to requesters.
* Complete standard reporting tasks and access-related requests where there is a documented process and appropriate approval.
* Maintain runbooks, Trailhead content, standard operating procedures, and request templates so guidance stays current and easy to find.
* Support data-quality checks and follow established processes to correct or escalate issues.

Partnership with People Systems
  
  

* Work closely with People Systems analysts and engineers to understand support priorities, upcoming releases, recurring work, and escalation paths.
* Provide clear handoffs for work that requires configuration changes, advanced reporting, integrations, security decisions, or policy interpretation.
* Participate in regular reviews of queue trends, service levels, documentation gaps, and operational risks.
* Build platform knowledge over time, with opportunities to take on more complex administration and configuration work as skills develop.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Experience in People operations, HR administration, systems support, service delivery, or another operations role involving high-volume, process-driven work.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly where accuracy affects People records, access, payroll, compliance, or reporting.
* Ability to work through a queue independently, prioritize requests, follow defined processes, and escalate issues at the right time.
* Clear written communication and comfort giving requesters concise status updates.
* Experience using Jira, Salesforce, or a similar case-management or ticketing tool.
* Comfort learning enterprise systems and following structured procedures across multiple tools.
* Strong organization skills and a consistent approach to documenting work and following requests through to resolution.
* Good judgment when working with confidential information.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting Workday, including Core HCM, business processes, security administration, reporting, or Workday inbox monitoring.
* Experience handling reporting requests, data access requests, and standard user provisioning.
* Experience supporting cyclical People programs, compliance activities, audit requests, or system-release testing.

What success looks like
  
  
**Within The First Six Months, You Will**

* Own the defined tier 1 and routine tier 2 People Systems queue work with accurate, timely resolution and clear escalation.
* Establish dependable monitoring for People Systems tickets in Salesforce, JIRA, the Workday inbox, and recurring operational tasks.
* Reduce avoidable handoffs and ensure complex work reaches the right People Systems owner with the context needed to act.
* Keep core runbooks and self-service guidance current based on recurring request patterns.
* Give People Systems analysts and engineers more capacity for configuration, governance, architecture, and strategic delivery work.

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

title: System Administrator
description:
About Scaler AI Labs

Scaler AI Labs is Scaler’s frontier AI research and engineering division. We build Reinforcement Learning (RL) environments for the world’s leading AI research companies.

We operate at the intersection of product, engineering, and frontier AI, working closely with world-class AI researchers to build and deliver high-quality AI infrastructure and solutions. We move fast, maintain high engineering standards, and thrive in an environment that demands ownership, technical depth, and operational excellence.

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on
**IT Administrator**
to own and manage the organisation's IT infrastructure, end-user support, identity and access management, network operations, cloud security, and compliance requirements.

You will be responsible for ensuring seamless IT operations across the organisation, managing the complete employee IT lifecycle, maintaining secure and reliable infrastructure, and implementing scalable IT systems and processes.

The ideal candidate is technically strong, highly proactive, comfortable troubleshooting complex issues, and capable of independently managing IT operations in a fast-paced technology environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. IT Operations & End-User Support

* Own end-to-end IT support for employees, acting as the primary point of contact for all IT-related issues and requests.
* Manage L1, L2, and L3 troubleshooting across hardware, software, operating systems, applications, and connectivity.
* Handle employee onboarding and offboarding, including device provisioning, account creation, access provisioning, and access revocation.
* Troubleshoot issues related to Windows, macOS, VPN, Wi-Fi, email, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, and other enterprise applications.
* Manage IT helpdesk operations through ticketing platforms such as Jira Service Management or Freshservice.
* Establish and maintain IT support SLAs, ticket prioritisation processes, troubleshooting documentation, and knowledge bases.
* Identify recurring technical issues and implement permanent fixes and automation to reduce support overhead.

2. Identity & Access Management (IAM)

* Manage identity providers and directory services such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Google Workspace.
* Configure and maintain Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and authentication policies.
* Implement role-based access control (RBAC), least-privilege access, and secure access management practices.
* Manage the complete Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) lifecycle for employee access.
* Conduct periodic access reviews and audits to ensure appropriate access permissions.
* Manage privileged accounts, service accounts, shared credentials, and password vaults.

3. IT Asset & Device Management

* Own the complete lifecycle of IT assets, including procurement, inventory management, allocation, maintenance, recovery, and disposal.
* Maintain accurate hardware, software, and enterprise licence inventories.
* Manage endpoint devices across macOS and Windows environments.
* Implement and administer Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions such as Jamf, Microsoft Intune, or Kandji.
* Ensure endpoint security through device encryption, OS patching, security policies, antivirus, and remote device management.
* Manage device provisioning, configuration, tracking, and remote wiping.
* Monitor software licences, renewals, utilisation, and costs.

4. Network & Infrastructure Management

* Set up, configure, and maintain office network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless access points.
* Manage LAN, WAN, VLAN segmentation, guest Wi-Fi, DNS, DHCP, and internet connectivity.
* Configure and maintain VPN and Zero Trust Network Access solutions such as Cloudflare, Tailscale, or Zscaler.
* Monitor network performance, troubleshoot connectivity issues, and ensure network availability.
* Manage ISP relationships, network redundancy, and infrastructure upgrades.
* Maintain network architecture documentation and implement appropriate network security controls.

5. Cloud Infrastructure & Security

* Support the setup and administration of cloud environments across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Configure cloud identity and access management, SSO, multi-account structures, and security guardrails.
* Implement secure cloud networking through VPCs, subnets, security groups, and firewall policies.
* Ensure encryption of data at rest and in transit, secure secrets management, and appropriate access controls.
* Configure centralised logging, monitoring, and security alerting using tools such as AWS CloudTrail, GuardDuty, and SIEM platforms.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments, security reviews, and infrastructure audits.
* Support cloud security posture management (CSPM), disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives.
* Collaborate with engineering teams on Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) security reviews and Terraform-based infrastructure management.

6. Information Security & Compliance

* Drive IT security controls and operational readiness for compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
* Work with compliance platforms such as Vanta, Drata, or Secureframe to implement controls and collect audit evidence.
* Maintain IT security policies, access control documentation, asset registers, risk assessments, and audit trails.
* Coordinate internal and external security audits and ensure timely closure of identified gaps.
* Implement data protection, endpoint security, backup, and incident response procedures.
* Support GDPR requirements, including data access controls, vendor security reviews, and data protection processes.
* Support HIPAA-related security safeguards and compliance requirements wherever applicable to the organisation's operations.

7. IT Process Automation & Continuous Improvement

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IT operations, including onboarding, offboarding, access provisioning, and device management.
* Build scripts and workflows to improve operational efficiency.
* Evaluate and introduce IT tools, platforms, and solutions to improve employee experience and infrastructure reliability.
* Establish scalable IT processes, documentation, and standard operating procedures.
* Stay updated on emerging IT infrastructure, enterprise security, and cloud technologies.

What We Are Looking For

* 3–6 years of experience in IT Administration, IT Infrastructure, Systems Administration, or a similar role.
* Strong hands-on experience managing enterprise IT operations and end-user support.
* Experience administering Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Okta, or Microsoft Entra ID.
* Good understanding of macOS and Windows administration and endpoint management.
* Experience with MDM platforms such as Jamf, Intune, or Kandji.
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewalls, VLANs, and Wi-Fi infrastructure.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, particularly around IAM and security configurations.
* Familiarity with information security frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
* Experience with IT ticketing systems and helpdesk management.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently and drive them through resolution.
* Strong ownership, problem-solving skills, documentation practices, and stakeholder management abilities.

Good to Have

* Experience working in a startup, SaaS, or fast-growing technology organisation.
* Experience managing IT infrastructure across multiple office locations.
* Familiarity with Zero Trust architecture and endpoint security solutions.
* Exposure to Terraform, scripting (Python, Bash, or PowerShell), and IT automation.
* Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Network+, Security+, Microsoft, AWS, or Google Cloud certifications.
* Experience supporting security audits and compliance certifications.

title: Mainframe Technical Tower Support Cost
description:

You will ensure the resilience, availability, and recoverability of critical business systems while supporting enterprise-wide recovery objectives and compliance requirements.
