* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues identified during DR testing, recovery execution, and resilience assessments.
* Maintain and enhance disaster recovery documentation, runbooks, recovery procedures, and operational standards.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing recovery outcomes, mitigating risks, and strengthening enterprise resiliency and business continuity capabilities.  

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

  

* 7+ years of experience in IBM Z (Mainframe) platform administration, operations, infrastructure support, and advanced technical troubleshooting within large-scale enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience supporting and executing Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity activities in enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of IBM Z infrastructure components, including z/OS, storage, networking, database, middleware, and security technologies.
* Experience performing recovery validation, recovery testing, and analysis of DR exercise outcomes.
* Strong understanding of infrastructure operations, production support, incident management, and service restoration processes.
Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and coordinate recovery activities across multiple technology domains.  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* Experience with IBM GDPS, Parallel Sysplex, replication technologies, and DR orchestration tools.
* Knowledge of enterprise resiliency, high-availability, and business continuity frameworks.
* Familiarity with Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) management.
* Experience participating in large-scale recovery exercises, failover testing, and audit/compliance activities.
Relevant IBM Mainframe, Infrastructure, Disaster Recovery, or Business Continuity certifications.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

description:
Posted on: 03 Nov 2026

**Location:** Bangalore

**Employment Type:** Contract

**Experience:** 2–3 years of clinical or research experience

### **Job Summary:**

Rheumatoid Arthritis affects approximately 0.5–1% of the adult population, translating into a substantial disease burden and contributing disproportionately to societal disability. Methotrexate monotherapy is the standard first-line treatment; however, it leads to only 30–50% achieving low disease activity and most patients require addition of other DMARDs (conventional, biologic or targeted-synthetic). Initiating treatment with combination of methotrexate and hydroxychloroquine, may improve efficacy by 10–20%; partly by increasing methotrexate levels. In addition, hydroxychloroquine has favorable metabolic effects like lipid lowering. Despite widespread use, robust adequately powered randomized evidence comparing first-line methotrexate monotherapy with methotrexate–hydroxychloroquine combination is lacking. This proposed study is a Sequential step-up strategy trial that mirrors real-world decision making and aims to answer two clinically relevant questions in one study with a resource-efficient framework: (i) the optimal initial csDMARD strategy, and (ii) the most effective step-up approach in patients with inadequate response. By generating pragmatic and contextually relevant evidence, this study has the potential to directly inform treatment algorithms in resource-constrained settings.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Cyber Managed Services – Identity and access Management – Airlock SSO/CIAM Senior**
We are seeking an experienced and knowledgeable Senior Consultant for Airlock SSO/CIAM or similar product to join our operations team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in identity and access management, with extensive experience in managing and optimizing Airlock SSO and CIAM solutions. This role will involve leading operational initiatives, provide expert guidance, and ensuring the security and efficiency of our SSO environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide expert L2 and L3 support for Airlock SSO/CIAM-related issues, including troubleshooting complex user access problems, application integration challenges, and system outages.
* Configure and troubleshoot access issues, MFA methods, risk-based authentication rules, and user-profile issues.
* Diagnose complex authentication failures, service degradation, and system outages.
* Perform technical and change-impact analysis for platform, policy, and application changes.
* Maintain installation, configuration, deployment, patching, upgrades, and post-change validation.
* Maintain incident remediation, root-cause, prevention, and operational documentation.
* Monitor platform, directory infrastructure, backups, and integrations for potential issues.
* Develop and maintain SSO policy documentation, user guides, and training materials to support end-users and promote best practices across the organization.
* Conduct regular security reviews and audits of Entra SSO configurations to ensure alignment with industry standards and compliance requirements and recommend improvements as necessary.
* Coordinate with technical teams, security leads, stakeholders, and product vendors.
* Provide technical guidance to junior team members and contribute to knowledge-management activities.
* Produce service-level reports, performance metrics, and recommendations for service improvement.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs, ITIL processes, change controls, and documentation standards.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4–8 years of overall Identity and Access Management experience, including strong hands-on experience with Airlock Access Management or similar.

**Required Skills And Expertise**

* Advanced experience in Airlock SSO operations, configuration and troubleshooting,
* Strong knowledge of federation and authorization protocols, including SAML, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect.
* Experience with one or more enterprise Access Management products such as Airlock, Okta, PingFederate, Microsoft Entra ID, PingID, Azure MFA, or RSA.
* Ability to manage authentication policies, selectors, sessions, identity profiles, protocol endpoints, OAuth scopes, client registration policies, grant mappings, token mappings, and OIDC policies.
* Experience with application onboarding, IdP configuration, patch/version upgrades, and production rollout.
* Good knowledge of authentication, authorization, provisioning, IAM, and core security concepts.
* Working knowledge of Windows, Linux, or Unix operating-system internals and monitoring tools.
* Experience in ITIL-based service management and supporting sglobal or remote teams.
* Strong verbal and written communication, stakeholder management, and technical documentation skills.

**Preferred Certifications**

* ITIL or equivalent certification is preferred.
* CIAM, Microsoft Azure, or AWS certification or similar sssssis an advantage.

**Work Requirements**

* Willingness to work in shifts and provide on-call support as required.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Principal Technical Account Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Serves as the main contact for individual contracts, providing extensive business processes, product/service (e.g., hardware, applications, software) functionality, and/or implementation knowledge. Provides services, adjusting to ensure alignment, and educates customers on ways to leverage Oracle services. Reviews service requests and gathers information to determine next steps, identifies potential crises, leveraging extensive knowledge and other customer experience to develop innovative solutions, and connects and/or escalates issues to appropriate teams to reach solutions, anticipating and reporting pain points. Develops and maintains plans and ensures positive margins, seeks opportunities to review and update documentation, and leverages understanding and collaborates across teams to identify and submit delivery leads for new opportunities and contract renewals. Proactively provides ongoing maintenance, mentors team members to act as a liaison between teams, and seeks opportunities to improve customer ability to adopt product and service changes. Works closely with peers within and sometimes beyond the team to identify and develop innovative ways of delivering services, provides direction, experiments with new approaches, and seeks opportunities to share product/support information, and plays a key role in the development of new services and/or processes, remaining up-to-date with technological business, and industry trends.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Customer Engagement:**

* Serves as the main point of contact for individual-level contracts, providing advanced business process, product/service (e.g., hardware, applications, software) functionality, and/or implementation knowledge in an advisory manner.
* Provides timely services, adjusting to ensure alignment with their practices, procedures, contractual budgets, leveraging contractual agreements and identifying revisions.
* Maintains customer relations, communicating with customers and across related teams regularly to ensure satisfaction. Provides updates on customer status to leadership.
* Educates customers on the most effective and efficient way to leverage Oracle services, products, and tools, experimenting with new approaches and providing feedback on customer organization performance.

**Issue Resolution:**

* Reviews service requests and gathers information from appropriate parties to determine next steps.
* Identifies potential crises or concerns and works to resolve customer issues and incidents in a timely manner, leveraging advanced knowledge of appropriate resources and other customer experience to develop innovative solutions.
* Connects and/or escalates issues to appropriate teams to reach solutions and minimize impact on the business, anticipating and reporting pain points to minimize impact on the business.

**Account Management and Governance:**

* Develops and maintains service delivery and/or project plans throughout their lifecycle and ensures positive margins according to governance and account management expectations and contracted terms.
* Proactively updates and maintains accurate customer account, contract, and service history information, identifying and addressing areas missing information.
* Independently and proactively conducts account planning and account reviews, tracking and communicating status on a wide range of projects including risk identification and mitigation recommendations.
* Seeks opportunities to review and update documentation and collaborates with peers to maintain contract cost, resources and scheduling, and scope, working to meet contract revenue and margin objectives.
* Leverages understanding of business needs and collaborates across teams to identify and submit delivery leads for custom new opportunities and contract renewals.

**Technical Delivery Management:**

* Proactively advises customers on optimal use and health or their Oracle product/service investment, proactively providing ongoing maintenance to optimize and ensure effectiveness and performance of the product and/or service.
* Collaborates with cross-functional teams, driving the execution and development of technical delivery plans.
* Mentors more junior team members to act as a liaison between customers, internal, and external teams.
* Seeks opportunities to increase customer understanding and improve their ability to adopt product and service changes according to policies and best practices.

**Innovation and Continuous Improvement:**

* Works closely with peers within and sometimes beyond the team to identify and develop innovative ways to deliver service and improve overall product and service utilization to achieve ROI goals.
* Contributes to the team by providing guidance, experimenting with new approaches, and seeking opportunities to share knowledge of product, service, and/or support information or issues.
* Identifies and recommends opportunities for enhanced value for services.
* Plays a key role in the development of new services and/or processes, remaining up-to-date with technological, business, and industry trends.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

**Problem Solving:**

* Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.

**Performance and Development:**

* Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

title: L1/L2 NOC
description:

NOC L2 Engineers are responsible for carrying out monitoring operations as well configuring network and telecommunication equipment in datacenter and other organizations.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Provide 24×7 Level-2 operational support for Data Center, COLO, and Cloud infrastructure environments.

* Resolve escalated incidents from NOC L1 within agreed SLA and OLA timelines.
* Support day-to-day operations of enterprise and Data Center LAN, WAN, Internet, MPLS, VPN, and cloud network connectivity.
* Configure, troubleshoot, and maintain network devices including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and wireless infrastructure, IB switches.
* Administer and troubleshoot routing and switching protocols including BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, STP, VLANs, VRRP/HSRP, LACP, and MPLS.
* Support Data Center Spine-Leaf, VXLAN/EVPN (where applicable), and high-availability network architectures.
* Support load balancing technologies such as F5 BIG-IP, Radware, NGINX, or equivalent Application Delivery Controllers (ADCs).
* Monitor infrastructure health, network performance, utilization trends, and service availability using enterprise NMS platforms.
* Analyze recurring incidents, identify problem trends, and recommend preventive actions.
* Execute operational runbooks and standard maintenance activities, including software upgrades, patch validation, failover testing, and recovery procedures.
* Participate in Major Incident Management (MIM), technical bridge calls, and service restoration activities.
* Coordinate with vendors, OEMs, carriers, cloud providers, and internal engineering teams for issue resolution.
* Manage Incident, Change, Problem, and Service Request records in accordance with ITIL processes.
* Maintain technical documentation, Support ISO Audits, operational procedures, network diagrams, and knowledge base articles.
* Perform capacity monitoring, performance analysis, and infrastructure health assessments.
* Support planned maintenance activities and validate services before and after implementation.
* Mentor NOC L1 engineers by providing technical guidance, troubleshooting support, and knowledge transfer.
* Ensure compliance with operational standards, security policies, and service-level agreements (SLAs).

**Experience & Educational Requirement**
BE/B-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics & Communication
  
  
**Relevant Experience**

* 4–7 years of experience in Network Operations, Data Center Operations, or Managed Services environments supporting enterprise and cloud infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, MPLS, SD-WAN, Routing & Switching, including BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VLANs, STP, and High Availability protocols.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise networking platforms such as Cisco, Juniper, Arista, and Data Center switching technologies like, Spine Leaf, Spectrum and InfiniBand.
* Experience supporting Firewalls, VPNs, Load Balancers (F5 or equivalent), and network security operations.
* Working knowledge of Windows/Linux administration, DNS, DHCP, NTP, SNMP, Syslog, and network services.
* Experience with Azure, AWS, or other cloud networking and hybrid Data Center environments.
* Hands-on experience with Network Monitoring and Observability tools such as SolarWinds, Site24x7, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk/ELK, Wireshark, or equivalent.
* Experience using ITSM platforms such as Zoho, ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, Jira Service Management, or equivalent for Incident, Change, and Problem Management.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) skills with the ability to resolve complex infrastructure incidents.
* Strong understanding of Industry security standards like ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, SOC-1&2
* Familiarity with scripting or automation using PowerShell, Python, or Bash is desirable.
* Excellent communication, documentation, stakeholder coordination, and customer service skills.
* Work in a 24×7 rotational shift environment.
* Good interpersonal skills and ability to work as a high performing team
* ITIL Foundation certification (preferred).
* CCNP Enterprise or equivalent networking certification (preferred).
* Proficiency in any coding languages (Preferred)
* Cloud certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate, AWS SysOps Administrator, or equivalent are an added advantage.
* Vendor certifications such as CCNP, RHCSA, Fortinet, Palo Alto, or Splunk are desirable.

Strong experience in production support or AMS for Kronos, with working knowledge of incident, problem, change and release management (ITIL).

Experience integrating Kronos with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and/or SAP HCM / Employee Central Payroll.

Working SQL and reporting skills for data analysis and reconciliation.

Good understanding of time-clock and device configuration.

Clear written and spoken communication; able to document root causes and work with business, payroll and vendor teams.

Experience with SAP Integration Suite (CPI) or Boomi interface monitoring and error handling.

Multi-entity or multi-country Kronos support, including multiple pay groups and legal entities.

Experience with UKG Advanced Scheduler, Attendance, Analytics and Reporting.

Exposure to Agile delivery, ITSM tools (e.g. ServiceNow) and SLA-driven service models.

title: Factory Devices & Printing Expert
description:
Job title: Digital Workplace Device Expert
  
  

* Hiring Manager: Cédrick Magny
* Location: India / Hyderabad
* Level: L2-2

**About the job:**
At Opella, we have one shared mission – we work passionately, every day, to ‘serve healthier, fuller lives’ now and for the generations to come. In order to do so, we strive to act as a force for good by integrating sustainability along our business and employees’ mission and operate responsibly from both a social and environmental point of view. Everything we do is centered around people’s interests – our consumers, our customers, healthcare professionals, and our employees – across the world. We are building loved brands that serve 1bn consumers worldwide, through our key platforms: Allergy, Physical & Mental Wellness, Pain, Digestive Wellness and Cough, Cold & Flu. We aspire to become the best Fast Moving Consumer Health (FMCH) company In & For the world and we aim to build a work environment where people can thrive, grow, enjoy and be at their best.
  
  
**Our team**
Our team is engaged in designing, delivering and supporting Digital Tech Services for all CHC worldwide.
  
  
We deliver our solutions in a highly competitive market answering FMCH needs and sometimes supporting regulated environments (GxP, SoX and other regional or local regulations).
  
  
Our team operates in an international context, serving all markets in most of the countries around the world.
  
  
Digital Technology & Architecture organization encompasses following capabilities: Integration, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud engineering, Platform Engineering (e.g. DevOps & related framework), Platforms (ServiceNow, Observability, Chatbots, SAP, Commercial, RPA, …), Digital Workplace and more “classical” infrastructures (hosting, servers, …).
  
  
The Digital Workplace & Facilities team manages all digital capabilities across 60+ sites, including 12 manufacturing plants. We are looking for a specialist to bridge the gap between global Intune standards and the unique, mission-critical requirements of our factory device environments, focusing on rugged handhelds, thermal printers, and shop-floor hardware.
  
  
**Are you passionate about providing exceptional Digital Workplace services that serve all our users every minute of their daily work? Influencing the way our associates collaborate and communicate? Join us to as a Digital Workplace Factory Devices Expert**
within our Digital Workplace & Facilities crew!
  
  
**As part of the Device Experience and DEX team, you will manage the following capabilities:**

* Factory & Industrial Device Management.
* SOTI Product Ownership & MDM Management.
* Enterprise Printing Services Management.
* Automation & Integration.
* Product Roadmap & Stakeholder Management.
* Security & Compliance

We are looking for a Device Expert in our Device Experience and DEX team, with following core responsibilities, for all capabilities listed above.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities:**

* Factory Device Management (Rugged & Mobile):

**Zebra Integration:**
Manage Zebra devices using Zebra Mobility Extensions (MX) and Lifeguard Over-the-Air (OTA) updates via the Intune admin centre.
  
  
**Kiosk & Shared Mode**
: Implement "Multi-app Kiosk mode" and "Shared Device" policies to ensure shop-floor associates have secure, restricted access to required factory applications.
  
  
**SOTI Management**
: Maintain and optimize legacy or specialized device groups within SOTI MobiControl where applicable, ensuring parity with global security standards.
  
  
**Intune for Frontline**
: Design and implement Intune enrolment profiles for Windows and Android Enterprise dedicated devices (COSU) and rugged handhelds used in warehouse/factory settings
  
  

* Office & Industrial Printing and Peripherals:

**Printer Deployment:**
Design & operate the Office printing for Opella (based on HP/LRS) and automate the deployment of factory and office print queues using Intune, PowerShell, and tools like PaperCut Print Deploy or Universal Print.
  
  
**Label & Thermal Support:**
Support the configuration and connectivity of industrial label printers (e.g., Zebra, Sewoo) and POS hardware within the factory network.
  
  
**Driver Management:**
Manage the lifecycle of print drivers and specialized peripheral software, ensuring compatibility with evolving OS versions.
  
  

* Operations & Governance:

**Staging & Provisioning:**
Develop automated provisioning workflows to streamline the "out-of-the-box" experience for factory workers.
  
  
**Performance Monitoring**
: Utilize Endpoint Analytics and DEX tools to monitor the health of factory devices and proactively resolve connectivity or performance bottlenecks.
  
  
**Security & Compliance:**
Enforce Conditional Access and AppLocker policies to protect factory data while maintaining GxP compliance.
  
  
**About you:**
**Technical Background Required.**

* Industrial knowledge: deep experience working with industrial environment, knowing their constraints (GxP, continuity of service, zoning, persona, …).
* SOTI MobiControl: Experience managing devices within SOTI MobiControl (highly preferred).
* Printing: Understanding of Cloud printing services (like HP/LRS) associated with MFP. Understanding of Industrial printing (Zebra, Barcode printing, …).
* Rugged Device Expertise: Hands-on experience managing Zebra, Honeywell, or similar rugged hardware.
* Expert Intune Knowledge: Deep experience with Microsoft Intune (Plan 2/Suite), specifically for Android Enterprise and Windows "Frontline Worker" scenarios.
* Scripting: Advanced PowerShell skills for automating device configurations and printer mapping.
* Identity & Networking: Understanding of Azure AD (Entra ID), Conditional Access, and factory VLAN/network troubleshooting.

**General.**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or a related field.
* Experience: 5+ years in Endpoint Management, with at least 2 years focused on industrial or factory IT environments.
* Industrial: Deep knowledge in industrial aspects, typically GxP and other regulatory & manufacturing constraints at stake in industrial environments.
* Frameworks: Familiarity with ITIL service management and Agile/Scrum methodologies.

**Soft Skills Required.**

* Fluent in English.
* Curious and open-minded, « out of the box » thinking with growth mindset, willing to stay up to date with emerging trends and technologies in device management and automation.
* Proven experience working & performing in global team, in a matrix organization, with strong capacity to manage activities across web meetings and collaborative solutions.
* Ability to lead & take ownership even in unclear situations. Contribute to clear the unclear
* Ability to provide innovative solutions, propose ideas to solve a problem by implementing them.
* Agile and continuous improvement mindset, with critical-thinking and root-cause-analysis paradigms.
* Able to write and speak fluently in English for any audience.

**Why us?**
At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
  
  
**We Are Challengers.**
We are dedicated to making self-care as simple as it should be. That starts with our culture. We are challengers by nature, and this is how we do things:
  
  
All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
  
  
Courageous: We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
  
  
Outcome-Obsessed: We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
  
  
Radically Simple: We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.
  
  
Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.
  
  
www.opella.com/en/careers

title: Technical Enablement Specialist
description:
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a technically strong and business-oriented
**Technical Enablement Specialist**
with experience in Graph Database technologies, Data Engineering, and technical product enablement.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of graph database concepts, data modeling, query development, database architecture, and technical troubleshooting. Experience with platforms such as
**Neo4j**
,
**TigerGraph**
,
**AWS Neptune**
, or other graph database technologies is highly preferred.
  
  
In this role, you will develop deep expertise in the TigerGraph platform—understanding its architecture, functionalities, product capabilities, and new feature releases—and translate this knowledge into effective technical and business-oriented training programs. You will work closely with Sales, Presales, Product, Engineering, Delivery, Developers, and Clients to enable stakeholders to understand, position, implement, and leverage TigerGraph solutions effectively.
  
  
We seek someone who seamlessly combines hands-on technical expertise with strong communication, presentation skills, stakeholder management, and business acumen.
  
  
**Requirements**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Graph Database & Technical Expertise
  
  

* Graph & Data Engineering: Demonstrate a strong understanding of graph database concepts, architecture, data modeling, graph traversal, and graph analytics using technologies like Neo4j, TigerGraph, or AWS Neptune.
* Query & Performance Optimization: Utilize query languages (e.g., GSQL, Cypher, Gremlin) while demonstrating a strong grasp of database performance, query optimization, data integration, and distributed systems.
* TigerGraph Mastery: Develop hands-on expertise in TigerGraph products, architecture, capabilities, and ecosystems. Analyze new product releases and updates to translate them into practical learning modules.
* Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis: Independently investigate, troubleshoot, and identify root causes for technical issues, performance bottlenecks, query failures, and configuration challenges in graph implementations.
* Product & Engineering Collaboration: Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to understand technical defects, enhancements, and product behaviors.
* Documentation & Knowledge Base: Create technical FAQs, troubleshooting guides, knowledge repositories, and best-practice documentation.

Technical Training & Enablement
  
  

* Program Design & Delivery: Design, develop, and deliver structured technical training programs, workshops, product demonstrations, and hands-on technical bootcamps on TigerGraph products and graph technologies.
* Multi-Stakeholder Enablement: Tailor enablement programs for diverse internal and external groups:

+ Sales & Presales: Product capabilities, business value, competitive positioning, use cases, and solution demos.
+ Product Teams: Product architecture, new features, functionality, enhancements, and technical dependencies.
+ Developers & Engineering: Graph modeling, query development, implementation, debugging, integrations, and best practices.
+ Clients & External Stakeholders: Product onboarding, solution understanding, technical adoption, and implementation guidance.

* Content & Assessment Creation: Develop engaging training presentations, technical documentation, practical assignments, hands-on lab environments, assessments, and product demo materials.
* Gap Analysis: Continuously evaluate training effectiveness and identify capability gaps across teams to refine enablement strategies.

title: Forward Deployed Solution Engineer - CONNECT Data Services
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Job Title:**
Forward Deployed Solution Engineer - CONNECT Data Services
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full time, regular, hybrid work arrangement
  
  
**The job**
The Forward Deployed Solution Engineer owns a defined technical workstream within an FDE engagement. Working within agreed architecture and standards, the role applies customer domain context to configure, integrate, test, troubleshoot, validate, document, and hand over AVEVA solutions using real customer data, systems, and constraints. The role is accountable for quality, timelines, reusable technical outputs, and timely risk escalation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own a defined FDE technical workstream from implementation through validation and handover.
* Build, configure, integrate, test, troubleshoot, and adapt AVEVA solutions in real customer environments.
* Apply established architecture, standards, methods, and governance to deliver reliable outcomes.
* Clarify requirements, dependencies, risks, feasibility, and implementation needs for the workstream.
* Implement creative and out of the box solutioning strategies against identified product feature gaps
* Resolve non-routine technical issues across APIs, integrations, data flows, configuration, performance, security, and deployment.
* Support demonstrations, acceptance testing, performance checks, validation, and production-readiness activities.
* Create reusable configurations, connectors, templates, AI patterns, implementation notes, and troubleshooting guidance.
* Coordinate with peers and adjacent teams, guide less-experienced contributors where appropriate, and escalate material risks early.

**Essential Skills**

* Typically, 5-8 years of relevant experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability in industrial technology implementation and technical project delivery.
* Hands-on capability in AVEVA solution configuration, integration, testing, troubleshooting, validation, and handover.
* Working knowledge of AVEVA products, customer domain workflows, industrial data, customer systems, APIs, cloud/edge, security, performance, and deployment constraints.
* Practical domain awareness of the customer’s operating model, workflows, KPIs, and value drivers, so the solution solves the right industrial problem.
* Ability to work within agreed architecture, standards, methodologies, governance, and engagement priorities.
* Sound judgment in resolving non-routine technical issues and escalating risks early.
* Clear customer-facing and cross-team communication skills.
* Developing AI Agents, Skills, Tools, Plugins etc. using any one of the agentic framework preferably MAF
* AI tools for SDLC like Copilot & practical awareness of AI/ML and Generative AI use cases within agreed technical, safety, and governance guidance.
* Accountability for quality, schedule, documentation, testing evidence, reusable outputs, and reliable handover.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Defined FDE technical workstreams are delivered reliably, on time, and in line with agreed architecture, standards, and customer success criteria.
* AVEVA solutions are configured, integrated, tested, validated, documented, and handed over with clear evidence of quality and operational readiness.
* Non-routine technical issues are resolved using sound judgment, with material risks, dependencies, and trade-offs escalated early.
* Reusable configurations, templates, troubleshooting notes, implementation guidance, and AI or integration patterns improve delivery quality for future FDE engagements.
* Peers, Architects, Leads, and customer-facing stakeholders view the role as a dependable technical contributor who builds confidence through practical execution, clear communication, and reliable handover.

**Services at AVEVA**
Our dynamic global team of 700+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting-edge solutions to customers. The work is complex and technical, but immensely rewarding: we empower customers to harness the full transformative potential of AVEVA’s solutions. If you’re analytical, pragmatic, and driven to make a tangible impact on the sustainability of the industrial sector, our team is the perfect place for you.
  
  
You’ll also be joining an award-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our
awards and recognition
.
  
  
Find out more:
https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/

Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support
  
  
It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
  
  
**Hybrid working**
We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.
  
  
**Hiring process**
Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/

Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.
  
  
AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Cyber Security Specialist - Zscaler SME
description:
Company Description: Meta Infotech Limited (An ISO 9001-2008 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified company and listed in BSE as “METAINFO”) is a leading Information Technology firm. Meta Infotech is a comprehensive solution provider offering inventive solutions for the corporate world. Our activities encompass niche services specialising in IT infrastructure and Security management solutions. Meta Infotech came into existence in 1997, and since then has proactively involved itself in providing quality software and solutions to the corporate world. Meta Infotech has always won the best solution provider award for most of its products it has committed to promote - right from Imperva, Zscaler, Palo Alto, Microsoft, SentinelOne, Symantec, Bluecoat, F5, ProofPoint to CrowdStrike. These formative years have seen Meta Infotech grow from a mere $5,000 investment to a $20 million company today.

**Zscaler Subject Matter Expert (SME) – Operations & Support (L2/L3)**

**Location: Mumbai | Shift: General / 24x7 rotational | Experience: 3–6 years**

**Role Summary**

We’re looking for a hands-on Zscaler Operations SME to run and continuously improve a live Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange environment (ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, ZDLP). You’ll own run-state stability, act as the technical escalation point for incidents, manage policy changes through governance, and drive lifecycle and optimisation initiatives. This is an operations role.

**Core Responsibilities**

**1. Monitoring & Incident Management**

Monitor ZIA/ZPA service health, GRE/IPsec tunnel status, App Connector availability, and Zscaler cloud status (trust portal/admin alerts).

Use ZDX to proactively identify and troubleshoot end-user experience issues (latency, application performance, device/network path problems).

Act as the L2/L3 escalation point for connectivity, latency, authentication, and application access issues.

Triage and resolve incidents related to ZCC, App Connectors, PAC files, forwarding profiles, SSL inspection, and policy misconfigurations.

Lead major incident bridges and coordinate with Zscaler TAC on P1/P2 cases through to resolution and RCA.

**2. Policy Administration & Change Management**

Maintain and tune URL Filtering, Cloud Firewall, Cloud App Control, SSL Inspection, Sandbox, DLP, and CASB policies in line with business requirements.

Manage ZPA application segments, segment groups, server groups, and access policies.

Evaluate and implement change requests (new application segments, SSL inspection exemptions, allowlisting, policy exceptions) through the change advisory board (CAB), with risk assessment and rollback plans.

Conduct periodic policy and configuration reviews to remove stale or redundant rules and align with security baselines.

**3. Identity & Integration**

Maintain SAML/SCIM integration with IdPs (Entra ID, Okta, Ping); troubleshoot provisioning, group sync, and authentication failures.

Maintain NSS / Cloud NSS and Log Streaming Service (LSS) feeds into SIEM/SOAR platforms (Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar), ensuring log continuity for compliance and audit.

**4. Lifecycle & Continuous Improvement**

Manage App Connector and ZCC fleet health: capacity, version compliance, patching, and upgrade cycles.

Review Zscaler release notes and assess the impact of platform changes and new features ahead of rollout.

Produce periodic operational reports covering availability/SLA, threat and DLP incident trends, policy changes, and capacity forecasts.

Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues and feed findings into policy, process, and architecture improvements.

Maintain runbooks, SOPs, and configuration documentation, and transfer knowledge to L1/L2 teams.

**5. Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

Act as the primary technical contact with Zscaler TAC and account teams.

Present operational metrics, risks, and improvement recommendations to IT and security leadership.

Support internal and external audits with evidence, configuration reports, and responses to observations.

**Technical Skills - Must-have**

Zscaler: Strong hands-on administration of ZIA, ZPA, and ZDX, including admin portal, logging, alerting, and policy management.

Networking: DNS, HTTP/S, proxies and PAC files, GRE/IPsec tunnels, routing basics, and SD-WAN failover behaviour.

Identity: SAML 2.0, SCIM, and OAuth fundamentals for troubleshooting sync and authentication issues.

Security: SSL/TLS inspection and its application impact, PKI and certificate lifecycle, DLP and CASB tuning.

Troubleshooting: Zscaler web/firewall/ZPA logs, NSS log analysis, ZCC diagnostics, and packet capture analysis (Wireshark).

**Good-to-have**

Zscaler Browser Isolation, Deception, Cloud/Branch Connector, or Workload segmentation exposure.

**Qualifications & Certifications**

Experience: 4+ years in network/security operations, including at least 2 years supporting a production Zscaler environment at L2/L3 level.

**Certifications:**

ZCCA-IA / ZCCA-PA or the current Zscaler administrator-level equivalent: required

ZCCP-IA / ZCCP-PA or the current Zscaler professional/engineer-level equivalent: preferred

**Soft skills:**
Clear communication under pressure during incidents, strong documentation habits, and the ability to explain technical risk to non-technical stakeholders.

description:
Job Description: Case & Communication Executive (Customer Support)

**Location:**
Colaba, Mumbai
  
**Work Mode:**
Work from Office (WFO)

Full-time
  
**Experience:**
0–2 Years (Freshers can apply)

Up to ₹28,000–₹30,000 per month (depending on experience and interview performance)
  
**Working Days:**
Monday to Friday
  
**Working Hours:**
10:00 AM – 7:00 PM
  
**Weekly Off:**
Saturday & Sunday

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented, and customer-focused
**Case & Communication Executive**
to manage customer interactions across multiple communication channels, including inbound and outbound calls, emails, and WhatsApp.

The role involves handling customer queries, conducting onboarding and follow-up calls, managing case-related communications, maintaining documentation, and ensuring timely resolution of requests as per established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, basic computer knowledge, and the ability to manage both voice and non-voice customer support activities in a fast-paced, TAT-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Inbound & Outbound Calling**

* Handle inbound and outbound customer calls related to queries, case updates, and follow-ups.
* Make callback calls wherever required and ensure timely communication with customers.
* Conduct onboarding calls to guide new users through the registration and case initiation process.
* Provide necessary information and assistance to customers while maintaining professional telephone etiquette.

**2. Email & WhatsApp Management**

* Handle customer queries received through emails and WhatsApp.
* Draft clear, professional, and accurate responses in accordance with established SOPs.
* Ensure timely responses and follow-ups to avoid delays in query resolution.

**3. IVR & Query Management**

* Download and process Interactive Voice Response (IVR) data.
* Prepare call transcripts and maintain relevant records.
* Monitor daily queries received through different communication channels and ensure appropriate action is taken.

**4. Case Management & Documentation**

* Update and maintain the Case Board (CB) with accurate case-related information.
* Upload, organize, and maintain customer documents and case records.
* Perform documentation activities such as file naming, saving, zipping, and CSV creation.
* Ensure data accuracy and proper record maintenance.

**5. TAT & Process Management**

* Ensure all assigned activities are completed within defined Turnaround Times (TATs).
* Follow established SOPs and operational guidelines.
* Coordinate with internal teams wherever required for smooth case processing and query resolution.
* Maintain accuracy, quality, and consistency in daily operations.

Skills & Qualifications

* Graduation or above in any discipline.
* 0–2 years of experience in customer support, customer service, operations, or a similar role.
* Freshers with good communication and computer skills are welcome to apply.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Comfortable handling regular inbound and outbound customer calls.
* Good telephone etiquette and customer-handling skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel, email handling, and documentation.
* Comfortable working with multiple digital platforms and operational tools.
* Ability to follow SOPs and process guidelines accurately.
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks within defined timelines.

Ideal Candidate Profile

* Should be comfortable with both voice and non-voice customer support activities.
* Must be willing to handle inbound/outbound calls, customer onboarding calls, and follow-ups.
* Should have good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Must be organized, detail-oriented, and capable of maintaining accurate records.
* Should be comfortable working in a process-driven and TAT-oriented environment.
* Candidates with a positive attitude, willingness to learn, and a customer-first approach will be preferred.

Important Role Clarification

**This is a combination of voice and non-voice.**

The role involves regular customer interaction through:

* Inbound & Outbound Calling
* Customer Onboarding & Follow-up Calls
* Email Communication
* WhatsApp Support
* IVR & Callback Management
* Case Documentation & Backend Operations

Candidates should be comfortable with calling responsibilities and should not be looking exclusively for a non-voice or backend process role.

Compensation & Benefits

* Salary up to ₹28,000–₹30,000 per month, depending on experience and interview performance.
* Five-day working week (Monday to Friday).
* Fixed Saturday and Sunday off.
* Fixed working hours: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM.
* Full-time, work-from-office opportunity in Colaba, Mumbai.

description:
**Brief Description**
We're looking for a Service Desk Manager with a strong technical support background to lead the day-to-day operations of our Service Desk. You'll drive first line and escalation support performance, keep incident and ticket management sharp, and build a team of technically skilled analysts who deliver excellent customer outcomes, all while acting as the go-to escalation point when things get critical.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Lead and develop a team of technical and non-technical support analysts, ensuring they're fully trained across all supported systems, platforms, and processes
* Own the team's technical performance call/ticket quality, first-contact resolution, productivity, and adherence to SLAs

* Monitor incident and ticket management against defined ITSM processes, identifying technical skill gaps and rolling out targeted training
* Own onboarding and technical readiness for new services and customers transitioning into the Service Desk, ensuring a smooth path to steady state support
* Act as Escalation Manager for incidents and service impacting issues, driving technical triage, coordinating with resolver groups, and keeping stakeholders updated until resolution.
* Lead root cause analysis on recurring issues.
* Manage performance against KPIs, feedback, and monthly 1:1s
* Stay current on the technologies and platforms your team supports, and keep building your own technical depth.

**Requirements**
What You'll Bring
  
  

* 5+ years' experience managing a Service Desk or technical support team in an IT Services environment
* Solid hands-on background in technical/IT support you understand the systems your team troubleshoots, not just the process around them
* Strong knowledge of ITSM ticketing and call management systems (ServiceNow experience)
* Experience in incident management, root cause analysis, and escalation handling
* Proven people management experience leading a large technical team
* Strong stakeholder management and the ability to translate technical issues for non-technical audiences
* Analytical mindset comfortable deep-diving into technical/performance data as well as owning the bigger strategic picture
* ITIL Foundation certification (minimum)

A Few Things to Know
  
  
This role supports a 24/7 service desk, so flexibility for out-of-hours emergencies, escalations, and on-call rotations is essential. You'll lead from the front line, working hands-on with your team's technical queue while collaborating with an internationally distributed team across multiple time zones.

title: Network Delivery Engineer 1
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
  
  
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
As a Network Delivery Engineer, you will be responsible for the execution of network provisioning tasks and 24/7 continuous monitoring, initial troubleshooting, and escalation of network infrastructure and service incidents. This role requires strong problem-solving skills, a foundational understanding of networking concepts, and the ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment to ensure maximum network uptime and performance.
  
  
**Experience bucket: 1-3 years**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Handling BAU tasks:
* Conduct network provisioning deployments.
* Perform Firewall configuration which includes ACL management, Periodic Firewall reviews and IPSec/NAT.
* Perform periodic Patch Management for Network switches/firewalls and servers.
* Upgrade OS for network devices to maintain a stable environment.
* Undertake network maintenance activities during business off-peak hours.
* Performance Optimization:
* Conduct performance analysis and implement optimizations to ensure the network operates at peak efficiency.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to fine-tune network parameters and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks.
* Network Automation:
* Develop and implement automation scripts to streamline routine network tasks and enhance operational efficiency.
* Integrate automation tools and frameworks to support network provisioning, monitoring, and management.
* Incident Response and Resolution:
* Act as a primary on-call engineer in resolving complex network incidents and outages and file RCAs wherever applicable.
* Function as L1 point of escalation for Network Operations.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor Engineering in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 1-3 years of experience in network operations, network engineering or a related role.
* Familiarity with Data Center topologies and network routing and switching concepts like BGP, OSPF, VLAN, VRRP, etc. Knowledge of VxLAN will be an added advantage
* Basic scripting and automation skills, with entry-level proficiency in languages like Python, Go, Shell and orchestration tools like Ansible, Salt or similar.
* Basic fundamental knowledge of Linux esp. Distributions like Ubuntu and RHEL and web-servers like Nginx and Apache2.
* Experience in a 24x7 on-call rotation environment and in handling critical incidents.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills.
* Certifications/Course Completion for Cisco CCNA/Juniper JNCIA or equivalent would be an added advantage.

Area(s) of responsibility
  
  
**AD Device management – Quest Migration**
An AD device management quest job" is not a specific, standardized job title but likely refers to a role focused on Active Directory (AD) and device management, possibly involving migration or modernization efforts, using tools and solutions developed by Quest Software. Responsibilities typically include managing Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), designing and implementing device management solutions like Microsoft Intune, automating AD tasks, maintaining AD health, ensuring security, and potentially migrating devices to cloud platforms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Active Directory Management: Administering AD domains, forests, Group Policies, and user accounts.
* Device Management: Implementing and managing mobile device management (MDM) and endpoint management solutions like Microsoft Intune to enroll, configure, and secure devices.
* Identity and Access Management: Configuring and managing cloud-based identity and authentication services, such as Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD).
* Automation and Migration: Using tools to automate AD tasks and assist with migrating users and devices to new platforms, often with a focus on cloud adoption.
* Security: Ensuring devices and the network are secure and compliant with company policies through patching, security policy implementation, and threat mitigation.

title: Manager Client Technology
description:
The Duty Manager is a senior operations position providing leadership for a team of up to 35 engineers supporting 100+ clients on a rotating shift pattern.
  
  

* The Duty Manager is responsible for the efficient a professional execution of activities associated with providing an unreasonable level of hospitality for our client's mission critical system.
* The Duty Manager will have primary responsibility for the rating & review of each of the employees dedicated to rotating with the Duty Manager with input from the Tower Manager.
* The Tower Manager who is accountable for best practices, effective training/testing and for overall architecture and direction of their service delivery tower will provide functional direction and have input as well on the employees rating. The employees will hard line into their Tower Manager with a dotted line to the Duty Manager.
* Key responsibilities of the Duty Manager are:
* Major Incident / Critical issue early detection and fast remediation for all matters during their shift.
* Ensuring all client requests, incidents and problems are addressed in a timely and professional manner
* Stand up calls with their team managing proper hand-over of activities and client status between shifts and teams
* Allocating resources, as necessary, across teams to provide efficient, effective resolution of issues
* Identify and implement operational process improvements across teams
* Provide detailed and accurate job performance feedback for each resource working under their guidance.
* Change Approver, Quality controller and Post change validation functions within their Shift
* Supervision of employee attendance and participation.
* Assisting the Shift Site Reliability Engineers in client communication and escalations.
* Inspiring and Motivating the employees on their rotating shift
* Driving for results through agreed KPI’s for Alerts, monitoring tools, and case/SNOW metrics

title: Associate, Consultant BPA
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Role Description**
There is an opportunity for an “
***experienced and knowledgeable***
” applicant to join the
***Transfer Agency BPA***
team in India. The prime responsibility of BPA team is to deal with business support, system upgrades and development, small change and major capital projects. This role involves development, support and testing of the InvestOne and all its ancillary applications used within Fund Accounting business unit.
  
  
**The Key Responsibilities Of The Role Include**

* Review and analyze system specifications, collaborate with project team to develop effective test strategies and plans.
* Provide support for functional and technical queries, ensuring superior client service to the business users.
* Execute test cases (manual or automated) and review results for Multifonds and other Transfer Agency Applications and troubleshoot defects
* Interact and liaise with IT and external vendors to resolve issues/defects in a timely fashion
* Consistently demonstrates expertise in high profile projects and system upgrades, testing for large and small projects/changes, system changes and upgrades
* Collaborates, elicit, analyse, outline and develop requirements for dockets and small changes coordinating with business and technology teams.
* Provide analysis and takes ownership throughout the lifecycle of the project from scoping, high level business requirements, detailed business requirements and implementation as required.
* Utilize available subject matter expertise to perform functional reviews of transformational initiatives and on-going BAU change agendas.
* Serve as a Change Advocate; establish trust within the corresponding business teams; gain enthusiasm within the teams.
* Work closely with regional functional managers in various processes / projects to ensure communication and smooth implementation.

**Skills/Experience Required**

* Proven experience as a QA tester or similar role for Fund accounting/applications
* Experience in project management and QA methodology
* Familiarity with Agile frameworks and regression testing
* Ability to document and troubleshoot errors/defects
* Working knowledge of Fund accounting and testing guidelines
* Excellent communication skills and Attention to detail
* Analytical mind and problem-solving aptitude
* Strong organizational skills
* A good understanding of the Transfer Agency Multifonds application , overall experience of 4-6 years and minimum 4 years of Business Analyst/ Testing experience in Transfer Agency department is required
* ISTQB certification and BA certification would be preferred

**Eligibility for Internal Partners**

* 24 months as a Senior Analyst to move as a Technical coordinator/Associate Consultant.
* Movement within TC and Associate Consultant is 12 months

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

Experienced with SDLC/Agile methodologies and project management

title: Deputy Manager_MDM Intune Support Specialist _Pune
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a knowledgeable and service-oriented individual to provide Level 2 operational support for enterprise mobile devices managed through Microsoft Intune. This role focuses on ensuring device availability, compliance, and timely resolution of incidents for iOS and Android environments. The individual will work within defined processes and escalation paths, supporting large-scale enterprise mobility operations and contributing to stable, compliant device services.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Provide Level 2 support for Intune-managed iOS and Android devices, addressing device, application, email, VPN, and connectivity issues
* Support device enrolment, de-enrolment, retirement, and wipe activities across the device lifecycle.
* Configure and deploy standard Intune profiles, compliance policies, and configuration policies in line with approved runbooks.
* Support application deployment and remediation for managed, store, and line-of-business applications, coordinating with application teams where required.
* Handle incidents, service requests, and change tasks within agreed service levels using ITSM tools.
* Track recurring issues, perform basic root cause analysis, and prepare operational and compliance reports.
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues to Level 3 or customer teams in line with defined RACI and escalation paths

**Who You Are**

* An individual with 4–6 years of hands-on experience supporting Microsoft Intune MDM environments in an operational role
* Confident in troubleshooting and supporting Android Enterprise and Apple iOS device management scenarios.
* Experienced in device and user lifecycle management, including compliance and configuration profiles.
* Familiar with ABM and Managed Google Play from an operational perspective.
* Comfortable working within ITIL-based support environments, using ticketing tools such as ServiceNow or equivalent
* Analytical, organised, and able to prioritise tasks independently while collaborating effectively with wider teams.
* Willing to work within business-hours support models with on-call participation for priority incidents.

**Not a Perfect Fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**

* Exposure to large-scale enterprise mobility environments supporting 10,000+ devices.
* The opportunity to work with established runbooks and processes within a mature global IT operations landscape.
* Collaboration with diverse technical and business teams across geographies.
* A role that builds depth in modern endpoint management and operational excellence

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced operational troubleshooting within Microsoft Intune and endpoint management ecosystems
* Practical exposure to compliance monitoring, reporting, and service health analysis.
* Improved incident management and escalation handling within ITIL-aligned environments.
* Foundational scripting and automation awareness to support operational efficiency

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
