title: Associate Technical Support Consultant
description:
**Job Title:**
Associate Technical Support Consultant
  
  
**Experience:**
Fresher / 0–1 year
  
  
**Location:**
Remote
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Department:**
Technical Support / Customer Support
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a motivated and technically inclined
**Associate Technical Support Consultant**
to join our Technical Support team. This is an entry-level opportunity for a fresher who is passionate about technology, problem-solving, and helping customers.
  
  
The successful candidate will receive training on our enterprise healthcare software products and support processes and will work closely with experienced consultants to troubleshoot and resolve customer issues.
  
  
The role provides an opportunity to develop expertise in
**enterprise applications, databases, interfaces, application troubleshooting, incident management, and healthcare IT systems**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide first-level technical support to customers using enterprise healthcare software applications.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application and technical issues reported through ServiceNow or other ticketing systems.
* Analyse reported problems by gathering relevant information, reviewing logs, identifying error messages, and following established troubleshooting procedures.
* Follow documented Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Knowledge Articles, and troubleshooting guides to resolve common issues.
* Perform basic application configuration, validation, and troubleshooting activities under the guidance of senior team members.
* Collaborate with senior technical consultants, development, infrastructure, database, interface, and other technical teams when additional expertise is required.
* Maintain accurate and detailed case documentation, including troubleshooting steps, findings, resolution, and customer communication.
* Meet defined SLA, productivity, quality, and customer satisfaction expectations.
* Participate in knowledge-transfer sessions and continuously build knowledge of supported products.
* Identify recurring issues and contribute ideas for improving knowledge articles, SOPs, automation, and support processes.
* Use available tools, documentation, and AI-assisted troubleshooting capabilities responsibly to improve investigation efficiency and resolution quality.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with customers and internal teams through email, chat, and support calls.
* Participate in rotational shifts, including evening/night/weekend coverage, based on business requirements.
* Escalate critical or high-impact issues promptly and ensure appropriate follow-up until resolution.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Electronics, or a related technical discipline.
* Fresh graduates with strong technical aptitude are encouraged to apply.
* Basic understanding of:
* Operating systems, particularly Windows
* Networking fundamentals
* Databases and SQL concepts
* Application troubleshooting
* Software development/support concepts
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Flexible to work in rotational shift timings with certain weekend on call.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**
These are
**not mandatory for freshers**
, but candidates with exposure to any of the following would be preferred:
  
  

* Basic SQL / database querying
* Windows Server fundamentals
* Networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DNS, ports, and connectivity
* ServiceNow or similar ITSM tools
* ITIL fundamentals
* Healthcare IT / EMR / EHR concepts
* Basic scripting such as PowerShell, Python, or batch scripting
* Exposure to AI tools used for troubleshooting or technical support

title: Sr Technical Support Consultant
description:
**Role Summary**
The Senior Technical Support Consultant provides advanced application support to healthcare clients, independently investigating complex issues and coordinating resolution across clients, vendors, and internal teams. The role supports reliable service delivery through sound troubleshooting, clear communication, accurate case management, and knowledge sharing.
  
  
The consultant handles priority escalations, contributes to problem and change management, and supports the development of colleagues through peer guidance and knowledge-transfer sessions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Provide remote application support to hospital IT staff and other healthcare clients.
* Investigate and resolve complex product issues; identify when to engage Development, vendors, or other support teams.
* Manage incidents and service requests through their lifecycle, maintaining clear case notes, action plans, ownership, and client updates.
* Handle priority incidents and participate in P1/P2 escalations, calls, and bridge calls as required.
* Troubleshoot SQL Server and T-SQL issues, including query execution, data validation, job failures, and common performance or space-related problems; escalate issues requiring deeper specialist investigation.
* Troubleshoot Windows Server and application-environment issues, such as services, scheduled tasks, permissions, storage, and connectivity, within the role’s access and support scope.
* Explain application functionality and workarounds to clients, and share product feedback with appropriate internal teams.
* Create and maintain useful knowledge articles and document recurring issues or defects to support problem management.
* Follow change-management, patient-safety, security, and support procedures.
* Collaborate with Development, Services, vendors, and other Product Support teams to progress cases and achieve resolution.
* Share product and troubleshooting knowledge with colleagues through case reviews, peer guidance, and knowledge-transfer sessions.
* Contribute to queue monitoring, handovers, and other team activities that support service continuity.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Typically 5+ years of experience in technical support, software support, or a related role. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Strong practical SQL skills, including writing and troubleshooting queries and using SQL Server/T-SQL in a support context.
* Experience investigating common SQL Server issues, such as failed jobs, query performance, and data or storage concerns, with appropriate escalation of complex database problems.
* Working knowledge of Windows Server support, including services, scheduled tasks, permissions, storage, and basic connectivity troubleshooting.
* Experience troubleshooting software applications and analysing complex customer issues.
* Understanding of software development and support lifecycles, including defect identification, change, testing, and release processes.
* Ability to manage cases independently, prioritise effectively, and escalate issues with clear supporting evidence.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues to clients and colleagues.
* Experience working with international clients or in a distributed support environment.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across teams while taking ownership of assigned work.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting healthcare applications or working in a patient-care environment.
* Familiarity with healthcare terminology and operational workflows.
* Exposure to healthcare interfaces or HL7.
* Relevant certifications in SQL Server, Windows Server, healthcare IT, or a related field.
* Experience contributing to knowledge management, problem management, or peer learning.

Skills and Behaviours
  
  

* Structured problem-solving and sound technical judgement.
* Client-focused communication and professional case ownership.
* Clear documentation and dependable follow-through.
* Ability to balance independent troubleshooting with timely escalation.
* Collaborative approach to supporting colleagues and sharing knowledge.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and meet service commitments.

Working Arrangements
  
  

* Flexible work arrangement, with work-from-home and/or office options in line with company policy.
* Willingness to work within a 24×5 support model.
* Participation in a rotational after-hours, holiday, or on-call support schedule as required.

**MuleSoft Administration & Operations**

* Support CloudHub, Runtime Manager, API Manager, and on-premises/hybrid Mule runtime environments.
* Manage API policies, certificates, credentials, properties, secrets, and environment-specific configurations.

* Coordinate with application owners, vendors, developers, infrastructure, network, and security teams.
* Participate in major incident resolution for business-critical integrations.
* Maintain operational SOPs, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, and support documentation.

**Security & Governance**

* Ensure interfaces comply with organizational security and integration standards.
* Support certificate, API key, OAuth client, service-account, and secret lifecycle management.
* Follow change, incident, problem, and release-management processes.
* Support audit and compliance requirements related to enterprise integrations.
* Ensure appropriate logging and monitoring without exposing sensitive credentials or business data.

* Experience with SQL databases and SFTP/file-based integrations.

description:

**Advanced Technical Support Engineer - APJ, EMEA & AMER Shift**
================================================================

**This role is** **Office Based, Pune Office**

**Advanced Product Support Engineer | Pune | APJ, EMEA & AMER Shift**

**About Cornerstone**

Cornerstone believes human potential grows exponentially when AI works in service of people. Global Customer Support is where that promise is kept — one customer, one case, one conversation at a time.
  
At Cornerstone, we're passionate about helping organizations unlock the full potential of their people. Our customers rely on our technology to develop talent, build skills, and drive business success. Delivering exceptional customer experiences is at the heart of everything we do.
  
Our Global Customer Support team plays a critical role in bringing that commitment to life. We are relentlessly customer-obsessed, focused not only on resolving issues but also on building trust, driving engagement, and ensuring customers realize the full value of their Cornerstone solutions. We believe every customer interaction is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference, strengthen relationships, and help our customers succeed.
  
We're looking for individuals who share our passion for delivering exceptional service, embrace innovation and AI-powered technology, and take pride in making every customer interaction count.

**The Role**

As an Advanced Product Support Specialist (Level 3), you will serve as a technical authority within Cornerstone's Global Customer Support organization, providing deep product expertise to resolve our most complex technical challenges and improve the overall effectiveness of our support teams.
  
Working in a collaborative, AI-enabled support environment, you will leverage advanced troubleshooting capabilities, AI-powered insights, and strong partnerships with Engineering and Product teams to identify root causes, resolve critical issues, and proactively address emerging customer challenges. Rather than managing a traditional case queue, you will focus on the most complex, high-risk, and aging cases where your expertise can make the greatest impact.
  
You will also play a critical role in developing technical capabilities across the team, strengthening product knowledge, and ensuring our customers receive exceptional support that builds confidence, drives engagement, and maximizes the value of their Cornerstone solutions.

**In This Role You Will...**

Serve as the technical authority for your assigned product area, proactively identifying and taking ownership of the most complex, high-risk, and aging support cases to drive timely and effective resolution.
  
Lead advanced technical investigations, performing in-depth root-cause analysis to identify underlying product defects, configuration challenges, and integration issues.
  
Partner closely with Engineering and Product teams to validate defects, ensure accurate reproduction steps, and support prioritization and resolution through established defect management processes, including OneList.
  
Leverage AI-powered tools, customer sentiment insights, and support analytics to identify recurring issues, improve troubleshooting effectiveness, and proactively address opportunities to enhance the customer experience.
  
Own technical knowledge development for your product area, identifying knowledge base gaps, contributing to certification content, and leading technical deep-dive sessions to strengthen team capabilities.
  
Mentor and coach Level 2 support specialists, using case quality insights and Level AI performance data to identify development opportunities and improve technical problem-solving across the team.
  
Provide technical expertise on critical customer escalations, partnering with escalation management teams, including DEEP, to validate solutions and ensure accurate, effective resolution.
  
Partner directly with the Pod Director to identify technical risks, improve support processes, and strengthen overall pod performance, including case aging, backlog health, defect quality, and customer satisfaction.

**You've Got What It Takes If You...**

Have 5+ years of experience in advanced technical support, SaaS product support, or a similar technical role, with deep expertise in complex enterprise software environments.
  
Possess advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills, with demonstrated experience resolving complex product, integration, configuration, and data-related challenges.
  
Are recognized as a trusted technical expert who can confidently diagnose complex issues, validate solutions, and guide others through challenging technical situations.
  
Have experience collaborating with Engineering and Product teams to investigate defects, document technical findings, and drive effective issue resolution.
  
Are comfortable leveraging AI-powered tools, support analytics, and customer sentiment data to identify trends, improve technical support quality, and drive operational improvements.
  
Demonstrate strong mentoring, communication, and knowledge-sharing skills, with the ability to develop technical capabilities across a team and influence others without direct authority.
  
Are proactive, collaborative, and customer-obsessed, with a strong sense of accountability and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer outcomes.

title: Deployment Engineer
description:
Zero Forg turns the CCTV cameras already in factories and warehouses into a real-time safety, security and operations

layer. Every site runs an AI server on the premises, connected to the site's cameras. The Deployment Engineer takes

that server from a blank machine to a live, monitored system.

**Responsibilities**

**Area Details**

**Working with Linux**
Run Ubuntu servers and NVIDIA Jetson devices from the terminal: users and SSH keys,

systemd services, logs (journalctl), disks, permissions and updates. Find out why a

service stopped and bring it back.

**Installing the OS**
Install Ubuntu on GPU workstations and flash JetPack on Jetsons. Set BIOS/UEFI

correctly (storage mode, boot order, dual boot), install NVIDIA drivers and CUDA, and

verify the GPU with nvidia-smi.

**Docker-based systems**
Deploy and update services as containers with Docker and Docker Compose, give them

GPU access (NVIDIA Container Toolkit), read container logs, keep data on volumes, and

roll back to the previous version.

**Scripting**
Run, read and fix Bash and Python scripts for installs, health checks and log collection.

Follow install runbooks step by step and improve them.

**Checking connections**
Get every camera talking to the server: IP plan, DHCP reservations, PoE switches, NVR

access, RTSP streams (ffprobe, VLC). Trace an offline camera to the camera, cable,

switch, site internet or DNS using ping, traceroute and nmap. Set up and check remote

access (Tailscale, SSH).

**Site deployment**
Install the server at customer sites, test every camera stream, confirm remote access

before leaving, hand over to the customer and write an install report.

**Requirements**

**Area Details**

**Experience**
1-3 years of hands-on work with Linux servers

**Operating systems**
Has installed an OS from scratch and recovered a machine that would not boot

**Containers**
Docker in regular use: images, containers, Compose, logs, volumes

**Scripting**
Bash; Python is a strong plus

**Networking**
IP addressing, subnets, DHCP, DNS, ports, VPNs

**Edge hardware**
NVIDIA Jetson, CUDA, GPU workstations

**CCTV**
CCTV and NVR setup (Hikvision, Dahua, CP Plus), RTSP and ONVIF

**Remote access and tools**
Tailscale or WireGuard, SSH tunnels, Git

**Travel**
Willing to travel to factory and warehouse sites

**Bonus**

**Area Details**

**Industrial protocols**
Modbus (RTU and TCP), OPC UA, MQTT, and other industrial or IoT protocols

**Robotics**
ROS / ROS 2: nodes, topics, launch files, working with robot hardware.

title: Field Services Technician I
description:
**Overview**
The Field Service Technician plays an important role in enabling a seamless user experience. Responsibilities encompass a wide range of tasks, from meticulously tracking orders to efficiently managing hardware and accessory deployment. Field Service Technicians are the backbone of front-line user support, ensuring that conference rooms are well-maintained and behind-the-scenes user setups are flawlessly executed. Beyond their technical duties, Field Service Technicians focus on fostering strong relationships with users, understanding their needs, and ensuring their satisfaction. They will support Astreya's ever-expanding customer base and ensure a consistently high-quality user support experience. The successful candidate will be familiar with industry best practices and willing to go above and beyond for our clients.
  
  
**Scope**

* Provide end-to-end onsite and remote user support, ensuring high-quality solutions and user experiences.
* Manage inventory, assets, and e-recycling, utilizing data management software for accuracy and workflow efficiency.
* Diagnose hardware issues, support AV equipment, and collaborate across teams to ensure smooth operations and customer satisfaction.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* User Support: Provide end-to-end onsite and remote user support on service requests raised by clients. Use logic and reasoning to identify alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to solving problems and delivering the best possible solutions resulting in a high quality user experience.
* Inventory & Asset Management: Handle inventory and asset management and e-recycling. Utilize Inventory Data management software to maintain inventory accuracy and workflow. Deploy and recover assets and accessories. Assist in Workstation dressing and other asset management racks and locations.
* Hardware Support & Management: Diagnose and resolve hardware issues. Support product lifecycle management activities, tracking and managing inventory, e-recycling of hardware.
* Room & Audio Equipment Support: Support a complex and fast paced environment focused on video conference rooms and ensure audio and visual quality, troubleshooting any issues and requests that may arise. Participate in installing AV equipment and displays.
* Ticket Management: Ensure assigned request tickets for support are prioritized and completed in a timely manner. Handle tasks related to order tracking, hardware deployment, and user setup, which may be tracked through ticketing systems. Use the defined ITSM System to properly manage your work related to defined service activities.
* Issues Escalation: Effectively document and escalate issues which cannot be resolved within the Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Proactively communicate to your supervisor when you encounter errors in documented support procedures. Adhere to incident management, problem management, change management, and knowledge management best practices.
* Collaboration: Participate in cross team/site collaboration used to share service knowledge, isolate potential problems and ensure the consistent delivery of defined service activities. Collaborate within the broader IT customer experience team, as well as extended IT organization to ensure the highest level of customer support and experience.
* Customer Experience: Ensure positive user experience and customer satisfaction through smooth working operations and effective work management. Enable the success of your peers and teammates.
* Complete other duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications/Skills**

* High school diploma or general education degree (GED) and 1 to 2 years’ related experience and/or training in IT Services; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Strong knowledge in policies and procedures related to requested support activities.
* Capable of understanding customer needs and providing a high level of interaction, ensuring customer satisfaction.
* Proactive in mastering all aspects of service delivery processes, communication, and the quality of your work.
* Facilitate and promote a team culture which encourages ownership of team goals, trust, respect, and strong cross collaboration throughout the service program.
* Provide general IT support within a high volume and fast-paced technology environment.
* Possess the ability to assist with a variety of basic technical issues, including but not limited to applications, hardware, mobile technologies.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Windows 11, Mac OS X, Linux Fundamentals, Hardware Level troubleshooting, Hardware Installation, Upgrades.
* Knowledge of basic functionality and use of various mobile devices (iOS, Android, etc.)
* Knowledge of hardware (desktop/laptop) deployment methods using image deployment tools.
* Ability to quickly diagnose, organize, and prioritize competing deadlines and properly set service expectations with clients.
* Time Management: Must possess strong time management skills to prioritize tasks effectively, meet deadlines, and deliver exceptional customer support

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Active listening and detail oriented to perform and document your work
* Enjoy working with collaborative individuals and understand that you are in a customer-facing support role.
* Strive to deliver a high quality user support experience.
* Excellent written and verbal communications are second to none.
* Self-motivated and the ability to execute tasks and handle time sensitive situations
* Commitment to excellence

**Other Requirements**

* This role requires weights of 50lbs/22kg to be regularly lifted
* Strong Communication Skills, Written and Verbal English required.
* This is an office based role, it requires the successful candidate to be on site during working hours.

**Health & Safety Requirements**

* Must conduct work activities in accordance with all applicable Environmental, Health & Safety regulations and rules. Additionally, will follow all Astreya’s Health & Safety Program, Code of Conduct, and client Health & Safety rules at all times.

* Strong knowledge of federation and authorization protocols, including SAML, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect.

title: Customer Operations Specialist
description:
**About The Role**
MyOperator is hiring a Customer Operations Specialist to execute day-to-day administrative, configuration and ticketing workflows for a dedicated portfolio of reactive B2B accounts.
  
  
In this role, you will be the primary operational owner for low-touch accounts. You will handle plan changes, user provisioning, invoicing queries and ticket resolution across internal teams (Support, Implementation, Billing and Finance). You act on requests as they come in and do not run proactive account management. Account Managers own revenue, upsells, contract renewals and proactive relationship work, and you coordinate with them on every account in your book. Customer Support works the shared ticket queue; you own a named book of accounts end to end. You are responsible for speed, accuracy and operational resolution within strict turnaround time (TAT) SLAs.
  
  
**About MyOperator**
MyOperator is a Business AI Operator and category leader that unifies WhatsApp, Calls, and AI-powered chatbots & voice bots into one intelligent business communication platform. Unlike fragmented communication tools, MyOperator combines automation, intelligence, and workflow integration to help businesses run WhatsApp campaigns, manage calls, deploy AI chatbots, and track performance — all from a single no-code platform. Trusted by 12,000+ brands including Amazon, Domino’s, Apollo, and Razor-pay, MyOperator enables faster responses, higher resolution rates, and scalable customer engagement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Observable Work Outputs**

* Account Servicing & Configuration Execution: Execute operational change requests for your account book within defined SLAs. These include plan upgrades and downgrades, WhatsApp Business API parameter setups, phone number and extension provisioning, and user deactivations.
* Inter-Departmental Ticket Resolution: Log, track and close internal cross-departmental tickets (Support, Engineering, Finance) on behalf of assigned accounts, with daily updates in Zoho Desk so customers never have to follow up.
* Billing Operations & Reconciliations: Resolve customer billing inquiries via Zoho Books/CRM, including invoice retrieval, GST verification, payment link generation and pro-rata credit note processing.
* Early Churn Signal Reporting: Review weekly account activity metrics. Flag accounts showing a decline in monthly active usage, repeated SLA breaches or aging open tickets.
* Data Hygiene & CRM Maintenance: Maintain 100% data accuracy across assigned Zoho CRM account fields: point-of-contact updates, active plan details, renewal dates and interaction logs.
* SOP & Checklist Development: Draft and maintain standard execution checklists for the highest-volume operational requests.

**Must-Have Requirements**

* Total Experience: 2–4 years in a B2B customer support, back-office operations or account operations role.
* SaaS / CPaaS / Tech Product Context: Supported a B2B SaaS, telecom or CPaaS product for at least 12 months.
* Ticketing & CRM Tools: Worked tickets daily in an enterprise ticketing tool (Zoho Desk, Freshdesk, Zendesk or Salesforce Service Cloud), and updated account records in a CRM (Zoho CRM, Salesforce or HubSpot).
* Account Ownership Model: Handled requests for a dedicated book of named accounts, not only an unassigned shared queue.

**Good-to-Have / Preferred Signals**

* Supported Cloud Telephony, Voice/IVR, WhatsApp API or Conversational AI platforms.
* Worked in high-volume, SMB-heavy B2B account operations.

**Target Metrics & Operational KPIs**

* First Response SLA: 100% of operational requests acknowledged within [confirm: hours].
* TAT Resolution: 95% of operational changes completed within 24 hours.
* Account Data Accuracy: 98% audit accuracy across Zoho CRM fields for assigned accounts.
* CSAT: 90% transactional CSAT on closed operational tickets.
* Unresolved Ticket Aging: Zero tickets open beyond 5 business days without a documented manager escalation.

description:
Position : Senior Windows Server Administrator
  
  
Work Hours (Client) : Monday to Friday (iFull night shift covering U.S. business hours)
  
  
Pay Range : $ 1,500 to $ 1,600 / month
  
  
Location of Search : New Delhi, India
  
  
Work Location : In office
  
  
Employment Type : Full-time
  
  
**Company Overview**
Our client is a managed IT and cloud hosting provider built exclusively for tax and accounting firms in America.
  
  
The company operates two lines of business: a hosted cloud environment where accounting firms run their tax and accounting applications on virtual machines, and a managed security and compliance service for firms that need to meet industry regulations. As the client base grows, the company is hiring a Senior Windows Server Administrator to resolve its most complex client machine issues.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are hiring a Senior Windows Server Administrator to serve as the main escalation point for issues on client machines hosted on the company platform. As their client base grows, the Support team needs one senior engineer who can resolve complex issues end-to-end across networking, the Windows Server operating system, Remote Desktop Services (RDS), and virtualization. This is a hands-on, generalist role working directly with the Manager - IT and the Support team.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**
Escalation Ownership & Root Cause Analysis
  
  

* Own escalated client machine issues end-to-end, including during peak tax season, isolating the fault across the network, the virtual machine (VM), the operating system, and the application.
* Own all issues on the machine itself, including session host performance, and hand over issues that relate only to Active Directory to the Active Directory administrator.
* Deliver Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports for client-facing and repeat incidents, and explain findings to clients in clear, non-technical terms.
* Convert each resolved escalation into a documented known fix so that Support can resolve similar issues at first contact.

Networking & Connectivity
  
  

* Diagnose client connection failures, slowness, and disconnects by measuring latency, packet loss, and routing path, and prove whether the fault is on the client side or the platform side.
* Troubleshoot Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) transport, Domain Name System (DNS) resolution, certificate, and Virtual Private Network (VPN) connectivity issues.
* Review Palo Alto firewall traffic logs to confirm blocked traffic, and raise precise change requests to the security owner.

Windows Server, RDS & Application Hosting
  
  

* Resolve operating system issues on Windows Server 2016, 2019, 2022, and 2025, including performance degradation, crashes and memory dump analysis, failed updates, and system file corruption.
* Resolve RDS issues, including failed logons, user profile errors, stuck sessions, licensing errors, and printer and drive redirection.
* Troubleshoot QuickBooks, Drake, Lacerte, ProSeries, UltraTax, Accounting CS, and Sage at the operating system and SQL Server level, and engage vendors when needed.

Virtualization, Automation & Standards
  
  

* Perform VM-level administration in VMware vCenter, including console recovery, performance analysis, snapshots, and resource changes, and support the planned migration to Hyper-V.
* Build PowerShell scripts for diagnosis and repeat fixes, and deploy them across the fleet through Datto Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM).
* Maintain standards for the golden VM image, fleet health checks, and pre-season readiness, keeping client VMs on the security baseline that supports IRS Publication 4557 and the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Safeguards Rule.
* Mentor Support engineers and junior administrators, including the use of AI tools for troubleshooting and documentation.

Role Modeling & Culture
  
  

* Technical mentoring: acting as the team's technical reference and mentoring agents on complex cases through shadowing, troubleshooting together and debriefs after a case is resolved.

Key Performance Metrics
  
  

* Escalation Resolution: Mean time to resolve escalations and share closed without further escalation.
* Repeat Incidents: Number of recurring issues with the same root cause.
* Knowledge Transfer: Known fixes published and reduction in escalation volume from Support.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 6+ Years of Windows Server administration experience, including at least 1+ years in an escalation (L3) role at a managed service provider (MSP) or hosting provider.Strong working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, VPN, firewall log analysis, and diagnosis of latency and packet loss.
* Advanced troubleshooting skills in Windows Server and RDS, including performance, crash dump, and event log analysis, user profiles, and licensing.
* Hands-on experience with VMware vSphere and vCenter at the VM level, working knowledge of Microsoft Hyper-V, and proficiency in PowerShell scripting for diagnosis and automation.
* Demonstrated ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical clients and to write structured RCA reports.
* Full professional fluency in written and spoken English, as the primary working language with United States-based clients.
* Availability to work a full night shift from the Noida office, covering United States business hours.
* Ability to operate independently with minimal day-to-day oversight during live incidents.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience hosting tax and accounting applications on multi-user RDS servers, including basic SQL Server troubleshooting.
* Experience in MSP or cloud hosting environments, and relevant certifications in Windows Server, VMware, or networking.
* Familiarity with CrowdStrike Falcon, Datto RMM, Veeam, Palo Alto, and AI tools such as Claude.

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst – Billing & Quote to Cash
description:
An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives. Come join the excellence!
  
  
**Overview**
Our Enterprise Business Systems Group is seeking a Senior Business Systems Analyst – Billing & Quote to Cash to join our team connecting technology with evolving business needs.
  
  
This role will serve as a senior business systems analyst supporting TNS's billing applications and end-to-end quote-to-cash processes. The position will partner closely with Finance, Commercial, Product, Sales Operations, and Technology teams to translate business needs into scalable system and process solutions across quoting, ordering, billing, invoicing, and related revenue processes.
  
  
The successful candidate will develop deep functional and technical knowledge of the applications that enable TNS's quote-to-cash capabilities, with particular emphasis on Salesforce and Expedite Commerce and their integration with other enterprise and billing systems. The analyst will act as a subject matter expert for one or more applications and will help ensure that systems, integrations, data, and business processes work together effectively across the quote-to-cash lifecycle.
  
  
The role will support both strategic initiatives and ongoing application improvement, including new products and capabilities, system enhancements, process optimization, integration activities, and resolution of complex application and business-process issues.
  
  
The Senior Business Systems Analyst will work directly with business stakeholders, application teams, developers, and quality assurance resources throughout the solution lifecycle, including requirements definition, process and data analysis, functional design, testing, implementation, and post-implementation support.
  
  
Experience with TNS's business, products, customers, and billing environment is a strong plus.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**What You Will Do In Your Role**

* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to understand business objectives and translate them into clear, actionable business and system requirements.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for applications and processes supporting billing and the end-to-end quote-to-cash lifecycle, including quoting, ordering, product/service configuration, billing, invoicing, and related downstream processes.
* Develop deep functional knowledge of Salesforce, Expedite Commerce, and related applications and integrations supporting TNS's commercial and billing ecosystem.
* Analyze complex business processes, system interactions, data flows, and integration points to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Facilitate requirements and solution-design sessions with stakeholders across Technology, Finance, Commercial, Product, and other business teams.

* Work closely with development and architecture teams to translate business requirements into practical system solutions and support technical estimation and solution design.
* Partner with Software Quality Assurance and business users to develop test scenarios, coordinate testing and user acceptance testing, validate results, and ensure solutions meet defined business requirements.
* Evaluate the downstream impacts of new products, customer requirements, pricing models, acquisitions, and business-process changes on billing and quote-to-cash applications.
* Support application integrations and data flows between commercial, ordering, billing, financial, and enterprise platforms.
* Investigate and help resolve complex application and process issues, identifying root causes and sustainable solutions rather than relying on manual workarounds.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve data quality, eliminate manual effort and waste, strengthen controls, and increase automation.
* Serve as a liaison between business stakeholders, application teams, development teams, and other technology functions.
* Support application and process changes through requirements, design, testing, implementation, stakeholder communication, and stabilization.
* Apply Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies as appropriate to the initiative.
* Demonstrate strong ownership, sound judgment, curiosity, and the ability to independently drive complex work across multiple stakeholder groups.

**Requirements**
**The Experience You Will Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 5+ years of experience as a Business Systems Analyst, Systems Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar applications-focused role.
* Demonstrated experience analyzing complex enterprise applications, business processes, integrations, and data flows.
* Experience gathering and translating business requirements into functional requirements, user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria, and system changes.
* Experience supporting billing, order-to-cash, quote-to-cash, ERP, CRM, CPQ, commerce, or other transaction-oriented enterprise applications.
* Experience working with software development, QA, architecture, and business teams throughout the application development lifecycle.
* Experience planning and supporting system testing and user acceptance testing.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to work across multiple interconnected systems and business processes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical audiences.
* Ability to prioritize and independently drive multiple initiatives in a changing business environment.

**Qualifications**
**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Experience with Salesforce, particularly in a complex enterprise environment involving commercial, quoting, ordering, or billing processes.
* Experience with Expedite Commerce or similar CPQ, product configuration, order management, or quote-to-cash platforms.
* Experience with enterprise billing platforms, billing integrations, invoicing, pricing, rating, usage-based billing, or recurring-revenue processes.
* Experience analyzing data and integration flows across CRM, CPQ/commerce, order management, billing, and financial systems.

title: GPU Cluster Reliability Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

Ishan Technologies is looking for an experienced
**Cluster Reliability Engineer**
to manage and maintain the compute infrastructure of Saksham AI Services' 1000+ GPU cluster.

The role involves managing GPU servers, Linux infrastructure, Slurm and Kubernetes environments, cluster reliability, automation and MLOps operations. The selected candidate will play a key role in ensuring high availability, performance, scalability and reliability of AI training and inference workloads.

The position will also serve as an L2/L3 technical escalation point, working closely with the 24x7 NOC team, platform engineers, customers and technology partners.

Key Responsibilities

**1. GPU Infrastructure & Server Management**

* Receive, rack, configure and maintain GPU servers.
* Manage BIOS, firmware, Linux OS images, GPU drivers and software libraries.
* Perform GPU server burn-in, hardware diagnostics and acceptance testing.
* Maintain consistent server configurations and manage firmware and security updates.
* Coordinate with OEM vendors for hardware faults, replacements and RMAs.

**2. Cluster Management – Slurm & Kubernetes**

* Administer and maintain Slurm and Kubernetes environments for AI training and inference workloads.
* Manage Slurm controllers, partitions, QoS, fairshare and resource allocation.
* Configure Kubernetes GPU Operator, device plugins, Helm and related operators.
* Manage cluster upgrades, patching, tenant onboarding and scheduling.
* Ensure stable and efficient multi-tenant GPU cluster operations.

**3. Cluster Reliability & Monitoring**

* Develop and maintain GPU and node health checks.
* Monitor GPU errors, ECC events, RAS events and hardware failures.
* Implement automated fault detection and remediation mechanisms.
* Develop monitoring dashboards and alerts using Prometheus, Grafana, Loki or ELK.
* Maintain cluster availability in line with the 99.9% uptime commitment.
* Maintain operational logs and monitoring records in accordance with applicable compliance requirements.

**4. MLOps & AI Workload Support**

* Build and maintain optimized framework images for PyTorch, JAX and vLLM.
* Develop ready-to-use job templates for AI training and inference.
* Conduct workload benchmarks and GPU performance testing.
* Support distributed AI workloads, including data, tensor and pipeline parallelism.
* Provide technical assistance to customers and solution architects on workload performance and tooling.

**5. Incident Management & Automation**

* Handle L2/L3 technical escalations from the 24x7 NOC team.
* Lead incident investigations, root cause analysis and post-incident reviews.
* Develop automation scripts using Python and Bash.
* Maintain operational runbooks and auto-remediation procedures.
* Track capacity, GPU utilisation, goodput and service-level performance.
* Identify recurring issues and implement long-term corrective actions.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience in Linux System Administration.
* Experience managing GPU servers, GPU drivers, firmware, BIOS and kernel configurations.
* Hands-on experience with multi-GPU accelerator servers.
* Strong knowledge of Slurm administration and workload scheduling.
* Experience with Kubernetes administration for GPU workloads.
* Knowledge of GPU Operator, Helm, Kubeflow and KubeRay.
* Familiarity with GPU monitoring, ECC/RAS events and vendor diagnostic tools.
* Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki or ELK.
* Working knowledge of PyTorch, JAX, vLLM and GPU collective communication libraries.
* Experience with Docker, Apptainer and container image management.
* Automation experience using Python, Bash and Ansible or Terraform.
* Familiarity with bare-metal provisioning tools such as MAAS, Ironic, Metal3 or Warewulf.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology.
* Preferred specialisations: Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics or related disciplines.
* Relevant certifications in Linux, Kubernetes or GPU computing will be an added advantage.

**Preferred Certifications:**

* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).
* Red Hat RHCSA/RHCE or Linux Foundation Certified System Administrator (LFCS).
* GPU vendor training or certifications.

Experience Requirements

* 4–8 years of overall IT infrastructure or engineering experience.
* Minimum 2+ years of relevant experience in GPU/HPC cluster operations, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) or MLOps.
* Hands-on experience with Linux GPU servers and Slurm and/or Kubernetes is essential.
* Experience supporting production environments with on-call and incident management responsibilities.
* Experience with multi-vendor data-centre GPU platforms will be an advantage.
* Exposure to distributed AI training and inference workloads is preferred.

Preferred Additional Exposure

* NVIDIA GPU ecosystem and related management tools.
* ClusterMAX standards and CMAX audit tool.
* Public cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS.
* HPC infrastructure and large-scale AI compute environments.

Key Competencies

* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
* Hands-on technical ownership and attention to detail.
* Ability to handle critical production incidents under pressure.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Willingness to participate in a 24x7 on-call support rotation.
* Ability to learn and adapt to evolving GPU, HPC and AI technologies.

* Strong knowledge of federation and authorization protocols, including SAML, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect.

title: Fraud Ops Manager
description:
**About The Company**
Founders today are building global companies from day one — but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!
  
  
We’re building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building.
  
  
Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment.
  
  
Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50,000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J.P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we’re building for the next generation of global companies.
  
  
**About The Team**
At Aspire, we are committed to empowering our customers throughout their journey with us. The team combines operational rigor, data insights, and cross-functional collaboration to detect, investigate, and prevent fraud. We work closely with product, engineering, strategy, and compliance to continuously enhance detection capabilities, improve and secure customer experience and reduce losses. Your decisions will directly reduce losses and strengthen protection for thousands of Aspire customers globally.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Fraud Operations Manager to join our team. You will lead Aspire’s day-to-day fraud operations, managing a team of analysts to detect, investigate, and mitigate fraud across products, processes, and geographies. The role drives operational excellence, refines processes, and ensures scalable workflows while partnering with risk, compliance, product, engineering, and support teams. Your responsibilities will include:
  
  
**OPERATIONAL LEADERSHIP**

* Lead and manage daily fraud operations, including case review, investigation workflows, queue health, and SLA performance.
* Oversee a team of fraud analysts, providing coaching, performance feedback, and career development to build a high-performing, motivated team.
* Establish and maintain operational metrics, dashboards, and KPIs to measure team effectiveness, fraud trends, and loss outcomes.
* Act as an escalation point for complex or high-impact fraud cases and decisions.

**PROCESS & CONTROLS**

* Develop, refine, and implement fraud investigation processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and escalation rules that ensure high quality and consistency.
* Collaborate with the fraud strategy, product, engineering, and data teams to operationalize controls, streamline review workflows, and contribute to strategy by identifying emerging fraud patterns and recommending countermeasures and process enhancements.
* Conduct root cause analysis of fraud trends and implement process improvements to enhance detection and reduce false positives.

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION**

* Partner with risk, compliance, and legal teams to ensure fraud operations align with regulatory requirements and internal risk frameworks.
* Work with customer support to improve fraud communication, resolution quality, and customer experience.

**Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in financial crime, fraud operations or risk management, with at least 2+ years in a leadership or management role.
* Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or financial services is highly preferred.

**Skills**

* Strong operational leadership and people management skills, including coaching, performance management, and team development.
* Deep understanding and knowledge of card scheme rules, payment industry fraud risks, and fraud modules like Visa Risk Manager and MasterCard Decision Intelligence.
* Deep understanding of fraud typologies (account takeover, payment fraud, money mule, APP fraud, synthetic identity) and fraud control mechanisms.
* Analytical mindset with high proficiency in using data and metrics to drive decisions and improvements.
* Experience with fraud detection tools, case management systems, and analytics platforms. Knowledge of SQL or data querying is a plus.
* Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate cross-functionally across global teams to ensure execution against regulatory requirements and internal policies

EDUCATION
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Risk Management, or related field.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CFE, ACAMS, FRM) are a plus.

* Consolidating and presenting ISR activity reporting data for Regions Business Reviews
* Defining and implementing staffing strategies in agreement with ISR domain leads
* Leading competency development for the ISR team in line with Alstom's requirements and processes
* Consolidating workload forecasts and ensuring proper staffing to secure execution of ISR work packages
* Validating ISR Design and Work Package (WP) Reviews
* Developing and promoting standard ISR practices compliant with international standards and Alstom procedures
* Managing coordination with sourcing teams and other engineering functions to ensure smooth collaboration
* Driving continuous improvement initiatives, including the induction training program and APSYS implementation

**All about you**

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

* Minimum 15 years of experience in engineering management roles within projects, with people and QCD responsibility
* Experience in managing large and/or complex engineering teams
* Proven track record in managing engineering work packages and project stakeholders
* Experience in Rolling Stock Maintenance, Signalling, or Infrastructure Maintenance, ideally within a maintenance contract
* Knowledge of standards and regulations for railways
* Strong leadership skills, including team management, managing diversity, and managerial courage
* Technical knowledge in maintainability, LCC (Life Cycle Cost), LSA, configuration management, and prognostics and health management (PHM)
* Effective communication and customer interfacing skills
* Familiarity with serviceability improvement and change management processes

**Things you’ll enjoy**
Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of mobility
* Utilise our inclusive and flexible working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development through award-winning learning opportunities
* Progress towards senior leadership roles or other exciting career paths
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

**Important to note**

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: Branch Manager

title: Manager - Lending Business
description:
**Company Description**
MoneyGate Technology Private Limited is a compliance-first fintech company that provides secure, scalable, and reliable digital payment solutions for businesses across India. Founded in 2023, the company focuses on trust, security, and regulatory excellence, enabling organizations to accept, process, and manage digital transactions with confidence and transparency. MoneyGate offers a broad suite of APIs and whitelabel solutions, including payment gateway services, PAN and e-KYC verification, SMS and marketing APIs, recharge and bill payment services, and bank account validation. The company is PCI-DSS certified, ISO 27001 compliant, and audited by government-empaneled CERT-In agencies, and holds multiple industry recognitions and registrations. MoneyGate is committed to building long-term partnerships through secure technology, strong governance, and high standards of data protection and operational integrity.

**Role Description**
The Manager – Lending Business will oversee and grow MoneyGate’s lending-related products and services, ensuring efficient loan servicing operations and strong portfolio performance. This full-time, on-site role in the Greater Bengaluru Area involves managing daily lending workflows, monitoring loan pipelines, and coordinating with internal teams to optimize processes, risk controls, and customer experience. The manager will analyze lending performance metrics, implement strategies to improve portfolio quality, and support new product initiatives in line with regulatory and compliance requirements. The role includes building and maintaining relationships with lending partners, banks, NBFCs, and key clients, resolving complex customer issues, and ensuring service standards are met. The individual will also prepare reports, support audits, and contribute to policy development for the lending business.

**Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of loans, with experience in managing lending products or services.
* Hands-on experience with loan servicing processes, including Business Alliances, disbursement, repayment tracking, and delinquency management.
* Proficiency in portfolio management, including performance analysis, risk monitoring, and improvement strategies.
* Customer service skills focused on resolving lending-related queries and maintaining high client satisfaction.
* Background in fintech, banking, or NBFCs, preferably in digital lending or payment ecosystems.
* Understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements in financial services in India.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and reporting skills, with proficiency in Excel or similar tools.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities, with capacity to work cross-functionally.
* Fluent in English, Hindi, and Kannada, with strong cross-cultural communication skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field; postgraduate qualifications are an advantage.

title: Senior Service Ops Manager II
description:
The role will own IT service delivery end-to-end across fulfilment centres/warehouses, and Points of Delivery (PODs). You will be accountable for keeping the technology that moves orders (networks, scanners, printers, handhelds, POS and kiosk devices, CCTV and access control) running at high uptime, and for the full lifecycle of IT assets at these locations. He will build a scalable site-IT operating model, manage vendors and SLAs, and be the escalation point for any technology disruption that impacts order throughput.
  
  
You will partner with Information Security on incidents, patching, access, and compliance requirements.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**

* IT Service Operations
* Own IT service desk and field support (L1/L2/L3) across warehouses and PODs, with defined SLAs for incidents, requests, and changes.
* Run ITSM processes (incident, problem, change, request) using a standard ITSM tool. Drive root-cause analysis for repeat failures.
* Build a 24x7 or shift-based support model aligned to warehouse operating hours and peak-season demand by partnering with central IT Helpdesk.
* Own business continuity and DR readiness for site IT, including peak-event planning (festive sales, promotions, high-volume days).
* Warehouse and POD Technology Operations
* Ensure availability and performance of site technology: LAN/Wi-Fi, ISP links and SD-WAN, RF scanners, handheld terminals, label/thermal printers, weighing and sorting systems interfaces, billing/POS, CCTV, biometric/attendance, and access control.
* Support go-lives, expansions, and closures of warehouses and PODs: site surveys, IT bill of materials, rack and cabling standards, vendor mobilisation, and handover. Target repeatable, templatised site launches.
* Coordinate with Warehouse Operations, Supply Chain, and WMS/OMS/TMS application teams to resolve technology issues affecting inbound, putaway, picking, packing, and dispatch.
* Define site-level monitoring and proactive alerting for network and device health.
* IT Asset Management (ITAM)
* Own the end-to-end asset lifecycle: procurement coordination, tagging, deployment, tracking, refresh, repair, retirement, and secure disposal (e-waste compliant).
* Maintain an accurate CMDB/asset register for laptops, desktops, mobile and handheld devices, printers, network and surveillance equipment, and peripherals across all locations.
* Run periodic physical audits and reconciliations. Drive asset loss, damage, and shrinkage down.
* Manage spares pools, buffer stock, and repair/replacement turnaround at site and regional hubs.
* Support software and licence compliance along with Finance and Procurement for asset capitalisation and depreciation inputs.
* Vendor, SLA and Commercial Management
* Manage MSPs, ISPs, field-service and hardware OEM/AMC vendors, with SLA scorecards, penalties, and quarterly business reviews.
* Contribute to the IT operations budget (Opex and Capex), track spend against plan, and drive cost optimisation and vendor consolidation.
* Lead sourcing evaluations, negotiations, and contract renewals together with Procurement.
* Governance, Risk and Compliance Support
* Ensure site IT adheres to InfoSec policies: endpoint protection, patching, device encryption, access hygiene, network segmentation, and physical access to IT rooms.
* Support internal and external audits (ISO 27001 and others) with evidence for asset, change, and operations controls.
* Maintain SOPs, runbooks, and site IT checklists.
* Leadership and Stakeholder Management
* Hire, coach, and develop service desk leads, regional IT managers, and site IT teams. Set goals and build succession.
* Report operational KPIs and service health to the Head of IT and business leadership. Translate technical issues into business and throughput impact.
* Build strong working relationships with Warehouse, Last-Mile, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and InfoSec stakeholders.

**Good to Have**

* Experience launching and scaling multiple dark stores, fulfilment centres, or PODs
* Exposure to automation in the warehouse (conveyors, sorters, AMRs) and IoT/edge devices
* Experience with asset tracking technology (barcode/RFID), and with automation of ITSM and ITAM workflows
* Working knowledge of data protection requirements (DPDP Act) as they apply to site devices and CCTV

**Key Competencies**

* Operational discipline and a strong sense of urgency
* Ownership of outcomes, particularly during peak events
* Vendor negotiation and commercial acumen
* Structured problem solving and root-cause thinking
* Ability to lead dispersed teams and influence without direct authority
* Clear communication with business and senior leadership

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Site IT availability/uptime (network, critical devices) and incident MTTR
* SLA adherence for incidents and requests, and CSAT
* Repeat incident rate and problem closure rate
* Asset register accuracy (target 98%+), audit variance, and loss/damage rate
* Time and quality of new warehouse/POD IT launches
* Opex and Capex adherence, and vendor SLA compliance
* Audit observations closed on time

**Success Measures (First 12 Months)**

* Standardised site IT model and launch checklist deployed across all warehouses and PODs
* Reliable, reconciled asset register with defined lifecycle and refresh policy
* Measurable reduction in site downtime and repeat incidents during peak periods
* Vendor scorecards and SLA reviews running on a regular cadence
* A stable, trained support team with documented runbooks and escalation paths

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 12-16 years in IT Service operations, with at least 4-5 years leading multi-location teams. Prior exposure to warehouse, logistics, retail, or e-commerce environments is strongly preferred.
* Education: Diploma/B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent.
* Certifications: ITIL v4 (preferred). Others such as PMP, CCNA, or equivalent are an advantage.
* Technical and functional depth:

+ End-user computing and field support at scale (endpoints, MDM/Intune, mobile device management)
+ Network fundamentals for distributed sites (LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi design, SD-WAN, ISP management)
+ ITSM and ITAM tooling (ServiceNow, Freshservice, Jira Service Management, or similar), CMDB and asset lifecycle practices
+ Vendor and contract management, including SLA design and enforcement
+ Basic understanding of WMS/OMS workflows and warehouse hardware

* Leadership: Proven record of running high-availability operations, managing outsourced partners, and delivering during peak-load periods.

**Additional Information**
**Visit our tech blogs to learn more about some the challenges we deal with: https://medium.com/swiggy-bytes**
**We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by the law.**

title: SAP SD-E-Invoicing Service Delivery Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Assistant Director**
Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to support over 300,000 EY people. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and world-class technology infrastructure.
  
  
Our aim is to build an outstanding customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business specialists to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**The opportunity**
The Service Delivery Manager plays an integral and wide-ranging role in the delivery of the services provided by the MST to the Mercury User Community. A Service Delivery Manager is required for each of the business process or functional areas which form the backbone of the Mercury solution, namely Finance, Procurement, Service Delivery / Engagement Management and Customer Relationship Management. As such, the Service Delivery Manager should have deep techno-functional experience in one or more of the in scope functional areas. This experience should include specific and detailed knowledge of configuration in SAP, gained through both program implementation and support, and the technical integration of SAP with other applications, including data transfer and interface management via SAP PI/PO and other middleware solutions.
  
  
The Service Delivery Manager will have full responsibility for the end-to-end business process chains, in the functional area for which they are accountable, which are managed and executed via the Mercury solution and more particularly within SAP. From a day-to-day operational support perspective, the Service Delivery Manager should ensure the timely and satisfactory resolution of production impacting incidents within their own functional area or where cross-functional incidents required their input. The Service Delivery Manager must work closely with the functionally aligned / process aligned support teams which form part of the service delivered by the AMS vendor. Similarly, they must work closely with the EY Technology teams, where there are incidents involving applications which are dependent or impacted by the Mercury solution. As such, the Service Delivery Manager will take the lead role in the restoration of service and investigation of incidents with of critical or high priority and must ensure that specific actions are agreed and undertaken to determine the root cause and then deliver the relevant fix safely and without impact on the production environment.
  
  
As the deployment of Mercury continues beyond the pilot phase, the Service Delivery Manager will work closely with the Product Managers within the MST and relevant representatives from the business community and the GLOBAL PROCESS OWNERs to define the road map and portfolio for their own functional or process area. The Service Delivery Manager will ensure that solutions proposed by the Product Managers are technically viable and do not have any adverse impact from a technical integration perspective. They must ensure that a full impact assessment is conducted and co-ordinate the solutioning and delivery by the AMS vendor where appropriate, working closely with EY Technology on cross-application delivery.
  
  
The Service Delivery Manager will work closely with the Service Manager regarding service performance for their own functional area, agreeing action plans with the AMS functional team, as required, to help prioritize incident backlog and develop demand plans for the delivery of service requests, maintenance requests and enhancement requests.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Detailed and specific knowledge of the relevant functional area in SAP, gained through a combination of program delivery / implementation and support.
* Manage the delivery of MST services to the Mercury user community from a functional perspective.
* Manage the functional resources of the AMS vendor in terms of resource planning, demand management and the prioritization of workload.
* Manage stakeholders across the EY Technology landscape regarding the operational support of the Mercury solution, with a particular focus on technical integration, including interfaces between impacted and / or dependent applications.
* Make informed judgments and take appropriate action regarding issues which may potentially impact the quality of services delivered by the MST across the functional area.
* Analyse requirements from the business and take appropriate steps to define action plans which are detailed, meaningful and set expectations appropriately with the business.
* Analyse service performance based on data provided and interpret the data to determine the quality of the service – validate this against the user perception of the service.
