title: Manager, Stores
description:
Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid-flow technology, with over 1,400 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet.

As part of our team, you'll be immersed in an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration. Here, you'll have the opportunity to push boundaries, tackle exciting challenges, and develop cutting-edge solutions that promote energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact. Every day offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution to a more sustainable future, driving innovations that help lower global carbon footprints. Together, we’re creating a legacy that goes beyond business—one that’s changing the world for the better.

The Manager, Stores is accountable for the safe custody, accurate recording and timely supply of all materials in the factory: raw materials, components, packing materials, consumables, spares, tools and, where applicable, finished goods. The role ensures that production never waits for a material that should have been available, that system stock always matches physical stock, and that inventory is stored, handled and issued safely, in the right sequence and in compliance with statutory and audit requirements

**Key Accountabilities**

**Receiving and Inbound Control**

* Receive materials against valid PO, invoice and delivery challan; verify quantity, specification, batch/lot, expiry and condition of goods.
* Coordinate with Quality for incoming inspection and ensure materials are segregated (accepted, on hold, rejected) until cleared.
* Post GRNs in the ERP promptly and accurately.
* Raise shortage, excess, damage and wrong-supply reports and coordinate with Purchase and suppliers for resolution or return.
* Schedule vehicle unloading and manage dock/gate flow to avoid detention and congestion.

**Storage, Location Control and Material Preservation**

* Define and maintain storage layout, bin and rack locations, and a location-wise record of every item.
* Apply FIFO/FEFO strictly and ensure batch, lot and expiry traceability.
* Protect materials from damage, contamination, moisture, rust, pest and pilferage; arrange special storage for hazardous, high-value, temperature-sensitive and fragile items.
* Ensure clear labelling, identification tags, colour coding and status marking.
* Optimise space utilisation through layout improvement, racking and vertical storage.

**Issue and Supply to Production**

* Issue materials against approved requisitions, work orders or BOM-based pick lists in the right quantity, at the right time and to the right location.
* Support line-side replenishment systems (kanban, two-bin, milk-run) to reduce production waiting time.
* Ensure every issue, return and transfer is booked in the ERP on the same day.
* Control issue of consumables, tools and spares through authorised indents and consumption tracking.
* Handle returns of unused, excess or rejected material with proper documentation.

**Inventory Accuracy and Control**

* Maintain min, max, reorder and safety stock levels in coordination with Planning.
* Run daily/weekly cycle counts (A-class items most frequently) and the annual physical verification; investigate every variance and correct root causes.
* Reconcile stores records with ERP and Finance records at month end.
* Maintain accurate stock status for unrestricted, quality inspection, blocked and consignment stock.
* Prevent unauthorised movement of stock through gate pass and access controls.

**Replenishment and Shortage Management**

* Review stock against reorder levels daily and raise purchase requisitions on time.
* Share a daily/weekly critical shortage list with Planning, Purchase and Production.
* Work with Planning and Purchase to track in-transit materials and expedite urgent requirements.
* Provide early warning of potential line stoppages and maintain a record of shortage incidents with root causes.

**Slow-Moving, Obsolete and Scrap Management**

* Prepare monthly ageing and non-moving stock reports and review with Planning, Purchase and Finance.
* Drive actions for slow-moving and obsolete items: reuse, substitution, return to vendor, rework or disposal.
* Segregate, store and account for scrap and surplus; support scrap sales with proper weighment, documentation and approvals.
* Support write-off proposals with complete documentation and approvals.

**Dispatch, Outbound and Documentation (where applicable)**

* Plan picking, packing, labelling and loading of finished goods against dispatch schedules.
* Prepare dispatch documents: delivery challan, invoice copy, packing list, e-way bill, gate pass and lorry receipt, with the billing/logistics team.
* Ensure right product, right quantity, right packing and right documentation on every dispatch.
* Coordinate with Logistics for vehicle placement, loading supervision and proof of delivery.
* Manage returns and customer rejections: receipt, inspection coordination and credit documentation.

**Safety, Housekeeping and Compliance**

* Enforce safe stacking, load limits, fire safety, emergency access and safe handling of hazardous material.
* Ensure material handling equipment (forklifts, pallet trucks, cranes, stackers) is maintained, inspected and operated only by authorised, trained personnel.
* Implement 5S and visual management across all stores.
* Comply with statutory and regulatory requirements (factory rules, hazardous storage rules, GST documentation, environmental and fire norms).
* Investigate incidents and near misses and close corrective actions.

**Systems, Data Integrity and Reporting**

* Ensure timely and accurate ERP transactions: GRN, issue, transfer, return, scrap, stock adjustment.
* Maintain accurate material master data in coordination with Planning and IT (description, UoM, storage location, batch management).
* Deploy and improve barcode, RFID, WMS and other digital tools for traceability and accuracy.
* Publish daily, weekly and monthly MIS: stock status, GRN pending, shortages, ageing, accuracy, issue turnaround and safety.

**Audit Readiness, Cost Control and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain audit-ready records for internal, statutory, customer and certification audits (ISO, IATF, GMP, etc.); close audit observations on time.
* Control stores operating cost (manpower, equipment, packaging, handling losses, pilferage and shrinkage).
* Reduce handling damage, search time, double handling and material losses through Kaizen and lean tools.
* Standardise SOPs, work instructions and checklists for all stores activities.

**People Leadership and Team Development**

* Plan manpower and shifts to match inbound, issue and dispatch peaks.
* Set clear goals, review performance and coach store staff and supervisors.
* Train team members on ERP, material handling, safety, FIFO/FEFO and documentation discipline.
* Build backup and succession cover for critical roles; maintain discipline, engagement and ethical conduct.

**KPIs by KRA**

* The Stores and Warehouse function will be evaluated across 11 Key Result Areas (KRAs), with KPIs and indicative targets calibrated to the industry, plant maturity, and existing performance baseline.
* Receiving and Inbound Control will focus on completing Goods Receipt Note (GRN) postings within 24 hours, unloading vehicles within 2–3 hours, maintaining receiving accuracy of at least 99%,
* Reducing vehicle detention costs to zero or by 20% year-on-year, and reporting all material discrepancies to the Purchase team within 24 hours.

**Storage, Location Control and Material Preservation**

* Focus on maintaining at least 99% location accuracy, ensuring 100% FIFO/FEFO compliance, limiting expiry, damage, and deterioration losses to less than 0.2% of inventory value, maintaining space utilisation between 75% and 85%, and ensuring 100% proper labelling and material identification.
* Issue and Supply to Production will aim to fulfil material requisitions within 30–60 minutes, maintain issue accuracy of at least 99.5%, achieve zero production line stoppages due to delays in material issuance, ensure at least 99% of material issues and returns are posted in the ERP system on the same day, and maintain line-side stock adherence of at least 95%.

**Inventory Accuracy and Control**

* Focus on achieving overall inventory record accuracy of at least 98% and 99.5% for A-class items, completing 100% of planned cycle counts, keeping physical inventory variance below 0.1% of inventory value
* Closing discrepancies within three working days, and maintaining zero unauthorised stock movements. Replenishment and Shortage Management will require at least 98% of reorder alerts to be acted upon within one day, zero stock-out incidents for A-class items against active demand, daily shortage reporting to all relevant stakeholders, and safety stock compliance of at least 95%.

**Slow-Moving, Obsolete and Scrap Management**

* Aim to limit slow-moving and obsolete inventory to less than 2%–3% of total inventory, issue monthly ageing reports by the fifth of each month, achieve at least 90% of planned slow-moving and obsolete (SLOB) stock disposal, ensure 100% reconciliation of scrap generated, recorded, and sold, and maintain complete approvals and documentation for all write-offs.
* Dispatch, Outbound and Documentation, wherever applicable, will focus on achieving dispatch accuracy of at least 99.5%, on-time dispatch performance of at least 98%, 100% accuracy in invoices, e-way bills, and delivery challans, transit damage claims below 0.5% of dispatches, and processing customer returns within three to five working days.

**Safety, Housekeeping and Compliance**

Will aim for zero lost-time incidents and statutory violations, 100% closure of reported near-miss corrective actions within 15 days, a minimum 5S audit score of 90%, 100% compliance with material-handling equipment fitness requirements and operator training, and completion of all planned safety training.

**Systems, Data Integrity and Reporting**

Focus on achieving at least 98% timely ERP transaction posting, eliminating pending GRNs and unbilled receipts aged beyond seven days, maintaining master data accuracy of at least 98%, ensuring 100% on-time submission of daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports, and achieving digital transaction adoption of 80% or above, subject to the approved project plan.

**Audit Readiness, Cost Control and Continuous Improvement**

Require zero major audit observations, closure of minor observations within 30 days, maintenance of stores operating costs within 2% of budget, control of shrinkage and pilferage to zero or below 0.05% of inventory value, completion of at least four measurable improvement projects annually, and 100% timely review and updating of SOPs.

**People Leadership and Team Development**

Focus on completing 100% of performance reviews on time, providing at least 20 training hours per team member annually, ensuring trained backups for at least 80% of critical roles, maintaining regretted attrition below 10%, and keeping absenteeism below 3% while ensuring zero major disciplinary cases.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Qualifications and Experience**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor's degree in Engineering, diploma in Materials Management or Logistics is an added advantage.
* **Experience:**
  10 to 14 years in stores, warehousing or materials management in a manufacturing set-up, with at least 3 to 5 years leading a stores team, Hands-on experience with ERP-based inventory transactions (SAP MM/WM, Oracle or similar), Exposure to audit-driven environments (ISO, IATF, GMP, FDA or customer audits) preferred.
* **Certifications (preferred):**
  Certification in Warehouse and Inventory Management (for example CPIM or equivalent), Lean/5S/Kaizen training, and industrial safety certification.

**Skills and Competencies**

**Technical skills**

* Inventory control: ABC/XYZ analysis, min/max, reorder point, cycle counting, stock reconciliation
* Warehouse operations: FIFO/FEFO, layout and slotting, material handling equipment
* ERP proficiency and barcode/RFID/WMS usage
* Documentation and statutory knowledge: GRN, delivery challan, GST invoicing, e-way bill, gate pass
* Hazardous material storage and industrial safety standards
* 5S, lean, Kaizen and root cause analysis (5 Why, fishbone)
* Excel and MIS reporting

**Behavioural competencies**

* Integrity and strong control mindset
* Attention to detail and documentation discipline
* Ownership, accountability and urgency in supporting production
* Cross-functional coordination and communication
* Team leadership, coaching and discipline
* Problem solving under pressure

**Why Armstrong Fluid Technology?**

* By joining us, you’ll become part of a global community dedicated to pushing the boundaries of fluid-flow technology while upholding Armstrong's commitment to sustainability. You’ll have endless opportunities to learn, grow, and make a significant impact on the world. Together, we'll build tomorrow’s solutions today.

title: Manager, Support Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
Manages a team on resolving incoming service requests and manages the operation of customer service delivery, serving as point of escalation for difficult customer inquiries. Monitors the Incident Management process within a team to address gaps in incident resolution. Reviews and ensures resolution of escalated service issues and proactively identifies recurring and potential issues. Manages cross-functional collaboration with other technical leadership teams to resolve complex issues and ensure timely and complete resolution. Manages team efforts in producing documentation and promotes the expansion of the Knowledge Base to enhance customer support and user experience. Coordinates the escalation of identified issues in products or infrastructure to QA and Development Teams for resolution. Drives collaboration with cross-functional teams on business problems and coordinates support service improvement projects and proactive support initiatives. Partners with next-level management on product, process, and customer experience improvement initiatives. Monitors and evaluates key metrics to ensure team meets desired goals and implements moderately complex operational and procedural improvements within a team. Collaborates with internal teams to drive the optimization and automation of customer feedback and KPI analysis within a team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Support and Solution Delivery-Customer Support and Advocacy:**

* Manages a team on being points of contact and resolving incoming service requests and manages the operation of customer service delivery to ensure timely and effective solutions.
* Serves as point of escalation for unresolved and/or difficult customer inquiries.
* Monitors the Incident Management process within a team to identify and address gaps in incident resolution and support processes to enhance efficiency.
* Supports team members in and coordinates preparing training for new product releases or enhanced functionalities, ensuring resolution of customer technical and/or non-technical inquiries across multiple systems or products in a timely manner, driving high adoption and satisfaction rates.
* Works with customers through user group meetings and/or outreach programs to gather feedback and foster customer relationships, following up on survey results as needed.

**Technical Support and Solution Delivery-Technical Problem-Solving and Resolution:**

* Reviews and ensures escalated service issues and customer complaints are resolved, owning the escalated service request through resolution, proactively identifying recurring and potential issues and collaborating with leadership team, when necessary, to implement long-term solutions.
* Coordinates relevant groups to resource expertise for customer escalation requests, and develops an immediate action plan for resolution, guiding junior team members through the resolution request and/or on escalated issues by leveraging senior staff.
* Manages cross-functional collaboration with other technical leadership teams in resolving complex customer technical issues to ensure complete resolution in a timely manner.

**Technical Support and Solution Delivery-Technical Support Documentation:**

* Manages team efforts in producing documentation, reviewing and managing service-related documentation and continuing to build and evolve knowledge base for customer technical support.
* Promotes the expansion of the Knowledge Base to enhance customer technical support and user experience.

**Technical Proficiency and Support Enhancement-Technical Support Collaboration:**

* Coordinates the escalation of identified issues or bugs in products or infrastructure to Quality Assurance and Development teams for resolution.
* Collaborates with cross-functional teams on product enhancement initiatives, providing actionable insights on key customer pain points.

* Manages team to follow established processes and implements process improvements to enhance team efficiency and effectiveness.
* Drives collaboration with cross-functional teams on business problems or improvement opportunities.
* Coordinates support service improvement projects and proactive support initiatives that help drive customer satisfaction and internal success and reduce customer-impacting events.

title: Deputy Store Manager
description:
Role overview

The Deputy Store Manager is a point of reference for employees and supports the Store Manager in overseeing all aspects of store performance, including people, commercial results, operations and customer experience. The role monitors sales performance and helps the team achieve the company’s targets.

Key responsibilities

**Product and commercial performance**

* Monitor sales budgets across the store’s three sections and organise the team to achieve them.
* Control sales performance and ensure products are displayed correctly in line with the commercial strategies of each department.
* Propose improvements to the store’s design and facilities, including furniture, fitting rooms, stockroom and break areas.
* Maintain high image standards throughout the store and ensure shop windows meet company guidelines.

**People and team development**

* Participate in decisions relating to the selection of strategic positions within the store.
* Support the Store Manager in managing labour relations, developing employees and identifying potential.
* Prepare rotas according to business needs, and support team training, KPI achievement and productivity.
* Act as a spokesperson for customer experience, sustainability, diversity and inclusion within the store, working with the relevant team members.
* Support HR in developing projects that encourage employee involvement and motivation.

**Store processes and operations**

* Improve organisational processes across the store and stockrooms, working with managers to ensure activities are organised effectively and available resources are used well.
* Ensure compliance with health and safety regulations and provide guidance on managing working hours in line with established forecasts and sales periods.
* Work with the General Services team to maintain the store’s image, including maintenance, cleaning and lighting.
* Support and implement action plans with the Store Director/Store Manager to achieve objectives related to sales, productivity, team motivation and development.
* Develop new business projects and follow up on their progress.
* Establish general guidelines for the organisation of in-store processes and carry out operational visits to streamline them in cooperation with the relevant person in charge.
* Support the Operations Manager and their team in resolving operational issues.
* Participate in operational meetings and communicate objectives to the team during regular meetings.
* Develop sales and working-hour forecasts in line with company specifications.
* Monitor KPIs and propose action plans for improvement.
* Support store opening and closing procedures.

Skills and attributes

* Passionate, curious, motivated, customer-oriented and dynamic, with a willingness to contribute new ideas.
* Detail-oriented, creative and proactive, with a strong interest in fashion and the ability to share that passion with customers and teams.
* Strong analytical, prioritisation, delegation and organisational skills.
* Commercially minded, goal-oriented and focused on customer needs.
* Strong communication and data-analysis skills.
* Team management, leadership and influencing skills.
* Able to manage time and pressure, multitask and prioritise in a fast-paced environment.
* Flexible, with an interest in developing others and building management skills.

Experience and qualifications

* Strong fashion knowledge, merchandising skills and market research experience.
* More than two years of management experience in fashion retail.
* Experience with MS Office.
* Higher education preferred.
* Fluent English.

Reporting and working relationships

* Reports to the Store Manager.
* Works closely with the store management team, including Product, Operations, Customer Experience and in-store HR, where the position exists, as well as the wider store team.
* Works with regional teams across Product, Visual Commercial, Image, Operations, HR, General Services, IT and other functions.

title: Associate Relationship Manager
description:
**About SmartQ:**

SmartQ is redefining how the world experiences food. As a next-generation food-tech innovator, we solve real operational challenges through empathy-led insights and powerful technology. Our mission is clear: to elevate everyday dining into a seamless and meaningful experience.

In the last decade, we’ve transformed cafeteria and food operations across industries with scalable, cutting-edge solutions. Operating in 14 countries and backed by Compass Group- a $60B global foodservice leader SmartQ continues to push the boundaries of what modern food-tech can achieve.

Since our inception in 2015, we’ve become a trusted partner for corporates, hospitals, universities, and food courts worldwide. With a bold vision to become the world’s largest B2B food-tech company, we connect people through exceptional food experiences powered by advanced technology. Today, we proudly serve 400+ global clients, including leaders like Google, HSBC, Amazon, and Wells Fargo.

At the heart of SmartQ is a culture shaped by four core pillars:

**Great People | Great Food | Great Experience | Greater Good**

These values inspire collaboration, innovation, humility, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

To dive deeper into what drives us, explore our cultural pillars on the SmartQ LinkedIn ‘Life’ page. It offers an authentic glimpse into the journey you could be part of:

https://www.linkedin.com/company/smartq-bottlelabs/life/cdc290f8-ff81-4e7f-9c96-37d842f936c4/?viewAsMember=true

As an Associate Relationship Manager at SmartQ, your primary goal will be to lead and oversee a frontline Partner team of food service associates. In addition, the candidate must coordinate various tasks related to food production planning, engineering, and front-of-house services. Also, ensure all activities comply with Health & Safety and Food Safety regulations.

Exercise general responsibilities to facilitate the efficient organization of the contract, aligning with contractual terms and conditions. Additionally, focus on enhancing the overall customer experience through effective management and service delivery.

Do you possess all these skills and wish to make an impact in the world of food and technology? Join us now!

Role

* Promote a positive work culture and ensure punctual delivery of high-quality service. Resolve issues and promptly report incidents, accidents, and near misses to the reporting manager.
* Prioritize client retention and exhibit a passionate commitment to delivering quality service to both clients and employees.
* Conduct food wastage analysis and implement cost-optimization initiatives.
* Collaborate effectively within a team and demonstrate initiative when working independently. Uphold honesty and integrity, fostering a family-oriented culture.
* Possess excellent communication skills to engage with a diverse range of people, both within your work area and among various stakeholders.
* Adhere to legislation and follow all rules and regulations outlined in the client handbook, ensuring service deliverables, hygiene, health, and safety standards are met.
* Embrace a team-player mentality with a can-do attitude. Take pride in personal appearance and hygiene standards.
* Display self-motivation, responsibly using personal initiative. Maintain a positive attitude under pressure, demonstrating resilience and adaptability.
* Manage vendor rotations and plan the operations for the assigned clients

**Qualifications:**

* Graduate/Diploma in Hotel Management discipline.
* Overall 3+years of experience in food industry.
* Strong work ethic, integrity and personal accountability to be a self-starter and make independent decisions.
* The ability to handle pressure and meet deadlines.
* Flexible and willing to take on any tasks to support team efforts.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills.
* Sound knowledge and experience of working with food, technology and people management
* Result-oriented and accountability
* Proven experience in managing successful teams in a similar environment
* Excellent financial and application acumen
* Self-motivated, agile and ability to adapt to a changing environment.

**Message from CEO:**

Food is an everyday necessity, but the experience around it can influence how we feel, connect, and go about our day. At SmartQ, we see an opportunity to make these everyday moments better, one meal at a time. Our aggregation model, powered by technology and operational excellence, brings together food partners, processes, and people to transform dining experience. By combining these capabilities, we continuously seek better ways to solve problems, improve efficiency, and create experiences that are simpler, smarter, and more human. As we continue to redefine this space, we believe the next breakthrough can come from anyone who questions convention, sees possibilities where others see routine, and brings a fresh perspective to a familiar challenge.

We look forward to welcoming minds who will challenge our thinking and help shape what SmartQ becomes next. We invite you to be that person. Together, let’s make everyday experiences extraordinary.

title: Owner of Charvi Tuition and Coaching Centre
description:
**Company Description**
Charvi Tuition and Coaching Centre is an education-focused organization based in Bengaluru, dedicated to supporting school and college learners through structured tuition and exam coaching. The centre aims to provide high-quality, affordable academic support in a safe and encouraging learning environment. Its approach emphasizes strong fundamentals, personalized attention, and consistent performance improvement for learners. The centre is steadily growing and offers opportunities for education professionals who are passionate about teaching, management, and community impact.
  
**Role Description**
The Owner of Charvi Tuition and Coaching Centre is responsible for overseeing all aspects of the institution’s operations, academic quality, and business growth. Day-to-day tasks include managing staff and instructors, planning class schedules, monitoring student performance, and ensuring a positive learning environment. The role includes handling admissions, communicating with learners and families, managing finances, and implementing marketing and outreach activities to grow enrollment. The Owner will also develop and refine curriculum offerings, maintain regulatory and safety compliance, and build partnerships with schools and local communities. This is a full-time, hybrid role based in Bengaluru, with a mix of on-site responsibilities at the centre and some work-from-home flexibility for administrative and planning tasks.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong background in education, tutoring, or coaching, with demonstrated ability to support learners’ academic progress.
* Experience in centre or small business management, including scheduling, budgeting, and basic financial oversight.
* Ability to lead and motivate teaching staff, manage teams, and foster a collaborative, learner-centered culture.
* Comfort with parent and student communication, including counseling on academic plans and handling feedback or concerns.
* Skills in basic marketing and outreach, such as promoting programs locally, managing online presence, and building community relationships.
* Organizational and planning skills to design programs, track performance metrics, and ensure smooth daily operations.
* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Commerce, Management, or a related field; advanced qualifications in education or coaching are an added advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in Bengaluru with some flexibility for remote administrative work; readiness to work extended hours during peak academic seasons.

title: DGM - RCM (Revenue Cycle Management)
description:
**Job Summary**

The Deputy General Manager (DGM) will be responsible for the successful transition, implementation, and operational management of assigned projects within the Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) domain, with a primary focus on Accounts Receivable (AR).

The role involves end-to-end project and transition management, operational excellence, financial performance, client relationship management, and people leadership. The incumbent will drive service delivery in alignment with contractual Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), quality standards, and business objectives while ensuring high customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Client Relationship & Domain Management

* Maintain a strong understanding of the US Healthcare industry, particularly Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and Accounts Receivable (AR) processes.
* Manage client relationships and coordinate with stakeholders on operational performance, process updates, and escalations.
* Ensure adherence to contractual SLAs, KPIs, regulatory requirements, and applicable healthcare industry standards.
* Act as the primary point of contact for client-related operational matters and ensure timely resolution of concerns.
* Develop and maintain strong domain knowledge across the team.

2. Financial & Business Management

* Manage the overall Profit and Loss (P&L) for the assigned process.
* Drive financial performance through effective cost management, resource utilization, and productivity improvements.
* Implement quality improvement initiatives to minimize operational errors and avoid SLA-related penalties.
* Monitor financial and operational metrics to ensure achievement of business targets.

3. People & Team Management

* Lead, manage, and develop large operational teams, ensuring effective workforce management and performance.
* Drive employee engagement and attrition management initiatives.
* Conduct performance reviews, appraisals, and individual development discussions.
* Identify training needs and develop action plans to improve employee performance.
* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, and administrative issues.
* Build a strong leadership pipeline by mentoring and developing future leaders.
* Ensure adequate skill inventory and domain expertise within the team.

4. Operational Excellence & Process Management

* Oversee day-to-day operations and ensure adherence to defined process workflows and quality standards.
* Monitor operational performance, productivity, accuracy, and service delivery metrics.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Identify opportunities to improve process efficiency, quality, and productivity.
* Ensure timely preparation and submission of MIS reports and management dashboards.
* Monitor process performance and implement corrective and preventive action plans.
* Coordinate with internal support functions, including HR, Administration, IT/TSG, Quality Assurance, and Finance.
* Manage operational risks, escalations, and transition-related challenges.
* Provide regular updates to senior management on project performance and business progress.

5. Project Transition & Governance

* Lead end-to-end transition activities, including project initiation, planning, implementation, tracking, and reporting.
* Ensure successful project transitions within agreed timelines and defined quality parameters.
* Identify project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and ensure timely resolution of transition challenges.
* Establish project governance frameworks, performance tracking mechanisms, and reporting processes.
* Ensure effective coordination between internal stakeholders and clients throughout the transition lifecycle.

**Required Skills & Competencies:**

* Minimum 16+ years of overall experience in US Healthcare RCM, specifically in Accounts Receivable (AR) operations, with a strong background in quality management. Must have experience in a leadership/management role.
* Strong understanding of US Healthcare RCM, particularly Accounts Receivable (AR) operations.
* Proven experience in managing large teams within the Healthcare BPO / BPM industry.
* Strong knowledge of operational P&L management, financial metrics, and cost optimization.
* Excellent understanding of SLAs, KPIs, quality metrics, and productivity parameters.
* Strong client management, stakeholder management, and escalation-handling skills.
* Experience in project transitions, process management, and operational delivery.
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office and other standard business applications.
* Ability to manage diverse teams and adapt to changing business requirements.

description:
**Description**
As a Risk Manager of the Quality & Audits team, you will be responsible for providing the overall management for a team of employees and direct leadership to the audit and investigation team, overseeing and developing employee performance and process improvement activities. This team conducts quality audits and risk reviews across multiple identity verification and compliance programs with investigatory resources and tools to validate identity. The group has responsibility for taking appropriate actions on accounts to protect Amazon from risk of account takeover and to prevent/mitigate fraud. The team aims and works towards zero fraud, zero account takeovers, zero false positives, and zero scams of any kind. The team seeks the best possible trade-off between customer experience and risk related losses, and when they have to make difficult choices, they will err towards the customer experience.
  
  
You will be responsible for building and maintaining SOP's, implementing, managing and reporting through Metrics, Service Level Agreements and Key Performance Indicators through Strategic Leadership and Vision, Daily Operational Management and Continuous Process improvements. You will be responsible for building operational cadences and review mechanisms to enable the team to achieve performance standards. You will have a strong voice in the forecasting accuracy of audits and investigations, the necessary staffing requirements to achieve SLAs, and in ensuring all coaching, training needs are met. You will be a functional Operations owner, who works closely with the global program owners to design and deploy business strategies for enhanced Customer experience, including SLAs, First Contact Resolution, feedback on policies and decision quality and overall tools enhancements.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Manage a team of auditors and investigators across multiple identity verification and compliance programs
* Provide data analysis and conduct investigations as needed
* Pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed
* Take appropriate action to identify and help minimize the risk posed by fraud or abuse patterns and trends
* Identify and eliminate root causes of defects in order to drive efficiency in Amazon's operations
* Understand the business impact of trends and make data-driven decisions based on available data
* Systematically escalate problems or variances in information and data to the relevant owners and teams
* Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and identifying activities performed
* Create narratives outlining weekly findings and variances to goals, and present these findings in review forums
* Achieve operational excellence and drive process improvements
* Develop employees and their skill sets to expand team capabilities
* Manage and execute for defined metrics and quality, maintain clear metrics on audit and investigation handling volumes, performance, and decision quality
* Drive operational efficiencies across all processing areas whilst improving internal and external customer experience
* Willing to work in rotational shifts in a 24x7 environment

**About The Team**
It's no secret that Amazon relies on its technology to deliver millions of packages every day to its customers – on time, with low cost. Within Amazon's middle mile transportation network, our team provides scalable solutions across identity verification, quality audits, and process improvement programs – ensuring operational compliance and protecting the network from fraud and abuse. We proactively monitor processes, conduct risk reviews, and drive continuous improvement across multiple programs serving both North America and Europe. Our mission is zero fraud, zero account takeovers, and zero false positives – while always prioritizing the customer experience. This is a fast-growing, data-driven team where your work has direct, measurable impact.

GSK’s Global Supply Chain D&T team is the front facing business tech group supporting GSK’s critical business of Global Manufacturing across all product portfolios. In addition the team is accountable for business operations for each of the towers, in ensuring all Finance, HC and Contracts are clearly understood and driven with the respective GSC D&T LT members, VPs.
  
  
The Senior Principal - Business Operations Manager role is a key position for to setup and execute standards and processes on business operations for each of the GSC D&T Towers, to ensure all Finance, HC and Contracts are clearly understood and controlled.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deploy and run a robust financial management service in close collaboration with the GSC D&T Finance Business Partner for the specific function.

* Design, improve and operate governance systems and processes, working with senior business stakeholders to provide independent, consistent governance across GSC D&T. Ensure finance and contract decisions use the same demand route and prioritisation criteria as portfolio management, and that every funded item links to strategy and OKRs.
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Technology, Computer Science, or a relevant discipline.

* Experience managing financial planning, budget allocation and cross-charging models.
* Experience managing vendors and commercial contracts.
* Experience managing supplier commitments, vendor risks, contract records and contract governance processes.
* Experience establishing and operating business operations, financial management or governance processes.
* Experience working with Director, VP or equivalent leadership-level stakeholders on financial, vendor, contract, workforce or business-operations decisions.

* Master’s degree with a specialization in Finance, or a professional finance/accounting qualification such as CIMA, ACCA, or equivalent.
* Finance/accounting qualification, such as CIMA, ACCA or equivalent.
* PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner or equivalent project/programme management certification.

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

The Planning Leader will establish clear ways of working across inbound and outbound planning, drive root cause analysis of demand and supply variances, challenge assumptions, and ensure risks and misses are communicated early with clear mitigation actions and ownership.
  
  
**You Will Be Responsible For**

* Coach, mentor and develop supply planning team.
* Ensure Supply Planning systems and processes in place are aligned to global supply planning standards.
* Delivery of optimal supply network plan to meet customer service OTIFNE targets and drive Diageo inventory performance to level of top 3 CPG companies.
* Own appropriate inventory policies in partnership with markets to deliver upon agreed business targets.
* Represent Supply in leading S&OP process, balancing demand and supply signals whilst ensuring strategy and annual targets can be delivered.
* Lead and embed continuous improvement agenda across wider supply planning team enabling effective delivery of performance improvement plans prioritised by business targets. Including customer service and inventory targets.
* Track progress of performance improvement plans and course correct to consistently ensure projected benefits are achieved.
* Address any supply disruption or conflict situation through consensus solution or recommendation for escalation.
* Coach, mentor and develop supply planning team.

**To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Need**

* 5 years + Supply Chain planning experience in CPG (Demand Planning, Supply Planning, SMR, Logistics).
* Additionally, some wider cross functional experience preferable e.g. commercial, finance or supply.
* Exceptional systems experience within supply chain optimisation platforms (ERP / master data, time-phased replenishment planning systems, SAP, APO,OMP).
* Understand, implement and sustain global supply planning codification agenda.
* Detailed understanding of end-to-end supply chain operational processes e.g. DRP, MPS, inventory, conversion, logistics and customer service.
* Exceptional influencing and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Ability to challenge senior stakeholders and manage tension in demand/supply and S&OP conversations.
* Exceptional communication skills – verbal, written and presentation.
* Customer centric mind set.
* Numerate with statistical, and analytical skills and attention to detail.
* High degree of quantitative and analytical skills.
* Proficient in MS applications e.g. Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Access.

**Working with Us**
Flexibility is key to success in our business and many of our staff work flexibly in many ways, including part-time, compressed hours, flexible location. Please talk to us about what flexibility means to you and don’t let anything stop you from applying.
  
  
Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.
  
  
We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.
  
  
Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

* Implement cost-control measures without compromising product quality.
* Ensure effective utilisation of manpower and operational resources.
* Drive store-level profitability and support business breakeven initiatives.

**C. Store Operations & SOP Compliance**

* Ensure consistent implementation of operational SOPs across all outlets.
* Conduct regular store visits and operational audits.
* Monitor hygiene, food safety, product quality, and service standards.
* Ensure compliance with FSSAI and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Maintain operational discipline and ensure timely closure of audit observations.

**D. Ice Cream & Product Operations**

* Ensure consistency in ice cream quality, taste, presentation, and serving standards.
* Monitor product handling, storage temperatures, cold-chain management, and equipment maintenance.
* Coordinate with the central production unit (CPU), procurement, and supply chain teams.
* Minimise product wastage and ensure proper stock rotation.
* Introduce operational improvements to enhance product quality and customer experience.

**E. Team Management & Leadership**

* Lead, guide, and motivate store managers, area managers, and operational teams.
* Develop effective manpower planning and succession plans.
* Identify training requirements and ensure regular operational training.
* Monitor employee productivity, attendance, discipline, and performance.
* Build a performance-driven culture with clear accountability at every level.

**F. New Store Openings & Business Expansion**

* Coordinate with Business Development and Projects teams for new store openings.
* Support location feasibility studies and operational assessments.
* Ensure operational readiness before launching new outlets.
* Monitor post-launch performance and implement improvement plans.
* Explore opportunities for new business formats, including cloud kitchens.

**G. Customer Experience & Brand Standards**

* Ensure excellent customer service across all outlets.
* Monitor customer feedback, complaints, and online ratings.
* Implement corrective measures to improve customer satisfaction.
* Maintain brand standards and consistency across all locations.

**H. MIS & Management Reporting**

* Review daily sales, store performance, operational expenses, and profitability.
* Prepare and present monthly operational performance reports.
* Conduct periodic business reviews with store and functional teams.
* Submit action plans to management for revenue improvement and cost optimisation.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance Area / Key Measurement

Revenue Growth :- Achievement of monthly and annual sales targets

Store Profitability :- Outlet-wise P&L and contribution improvement

Food Cost Control :- Food cost percentage and wastage reduction.

Manpower Productivity :- Sales per employee and manpower cost control

Operational Excellence :- SOP compliance and audit scores

Product Quality :- Product consistency, quality, and customer feedback

Customer Experience :- Customer satisfaction and complaint resolution

Inventory Management :- Stock accuracy, variance, and expiry control

New Store Launches :- Timely operational readiness and successful launch.

Team Performance :- Training, retention, productivity, and accountability

4. Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* MBA in Operations or Business Management will be an added advantage.

5. Experience & Industry Requirements

* 10–15 years of overall experience in the Food & Beverage industry.
* Minimum 5 years in a senior operational leadership role managing multiple outlets.
* Preference for candidates with experience in ice cream parlours, dessert chains, premium ice cream brands, or QSR businesses.
* Experience in managing multi-location operations, cloud kitchens, and central production units will be an advantage.
* Demonstrated experience in revenue growth, P&L management, and operational profitability.

6. Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong business acumen and commercial understanding.
* Excellent leadership and team management capabilities.
* Strong analytical and decision-making skills.
* Expertise in P&L management and cost optimisation.
* Strong understanding of food safety and operational compliance.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, growth-oriented business environment.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and execution capabilities.

7. Desired Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be a hands-on operational leader with a strong understanding of the ice cream and dessert business, capable of managing multiple outlets, driving revenue, improving profitability, developing teams, and maintaining consistent brand and product standards.

**The candidate must demonstrate a strong track record of converting operational strategies into measurable business results.**

Pay: ₹22,000.00 - ₹99,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: MS - FDL - Manager - Data Operations
description:
Location: Bengaluru

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

Date: Nov 2, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1756017

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Job Title: Manager – Data Operations**

  

**Summary:**

  

We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation.

  

This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.

  

You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels.

**Responsibilities:**

  

**Data Operations & Technical Oversight**

* Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
* Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
* Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
* Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
* Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
* Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

  

**Service Delivery & Operational Excellence**

* Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
* Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
* Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
* Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
* Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

  

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
* Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
* Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

  

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules.
* Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries.
* Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
* Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

  

**Data Quality & Continuous Improvement**

* Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
* Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
* Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

  

**Qualifications**

  

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* **7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.**
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

  

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

  

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to manage production data services against SLAs, prioritize incidents by business impact, and coordinate effective service restoration.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management, release support, runbooks, and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, or DataOps practices.
* Ability to interpret operational metrics, identify performance and capacity issues, and coordinate improvements with engineering and platform teams.

  

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), finance data flows, and the importance of timely and accurate reporting is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, ERP-connected data pipelines, analytics platforms, or period-end reporting operations is highly desirable.

  

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and collaboration skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain incidents, business impact, and resolution progress to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to remain organized under pressure, apply structured problem-solving, and balance hands-on troubleshooting with effective delegation.
* High ownership mindset focused on data reliability, service quality, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

### **Description and Requirements**

* Partner with Finance on annual planning, rolling forecasts, accruals, cost-center reviews, and month-end financial performance reviews.

2. Cost Governance, Budget Control & Optimization

* Monitor OPEX and CAPEX against approved budgets, forecasts, purchase commitments, and operating plans.

* Identify cost overruns, unfavorable trends, underutilized capacity, stranded spend, and financial leakage, and coordinate corrective actions.

* Validate savings and distinguish realized P&L impact from cost avoidance, productivity benefit, and risk reduction.

3. AI-Enabled P&L Analytics & Automation

* Lead implementation of AI and automation for P&L analysis, financial reporting, forecasting, reconciliations, and management commentary.

* Design automated data flows combining finance, operational, billing, supplier, and service-performance inputs into governed reporting models.

* Use Microsoft Copilot, Power BI, Power Automate, SQL, Python, and approved AI capabilities to accelerate variance analysis and surface decision-relevant insights.

* Develop anomaly and exception monitoring for unusual spend, duplicate charges, margin deterioration, billing inconsistency, and forecast deviation.

* Create predictive and scenario-based models for demand, cost, capacity, supplier spend, and profitability with documented assumptions and human review.

* Establish data-quality checks, model governance, approval controls, and traceability for AI-assisted financial outputs.

* Measure automation outcomes through cycle-time reduction, reporting accuracy, manual-effort elimination, decision speed, and validated financial impact.

4. Financial Controls, Billing Validation & Reconciliation

* Validate supplier invoices and service billing against contracts, statements of work, pricing models, purchase orders, and service-delivery records.

* Perform billing audits to identify duplicate charges, overbilling, unsupported charges, rate deviations, and financial leakage.

* Support accrual reviews, reconciliations, invoice aging analysis, disputed-item resolution, and period-close readiness.

* Establish approval checkpoints, exception thresholds, evidence requirements, and audit-ready documentation.

* Partner with Finance, Procurement, Accounts Payable, and suppliers to resolve billing and payment exceptions.

5. Service Operations Governance & Performance Management

* Maintain governance across global ITC, CFS, Registration, Infrastructure, and Configuration Services operations.

* Monitor performance against SLAs, KPIs, quality measures, productivity expectations, capacity plans, and customer commitments.

* Integrate operational and financial measures to show how service outcomes and resource consumption affect cost and profitability.

* Support Monthly Business Reviews, Quarterly Business Reviews, executive reviews, issue management, escalations, and action closure.

* Provide centralized visibility and consistent performance narratives through the GICS Control Tower.

6. Business Intelligence & Executive Decision Support

* Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, executive scorecards, financial packs, and self-service analytical views.

* Translate complex P&L and operational trends into concise management insights, decisions, and recommended actions.

* Define consistent metric logic, reporting calendars, data ownership, and governance standards.

* Present clear insights on profitability, budget performance, cost drivers, supplier performance, productivity, risks, and opportunities.

7. Vendor Governance, Risk & Compliance

* Analyze supplier spend, price adherence, invoice quality, service levels, and corrective-action closure.

* Identify operational, financial, contractual, compliance, and supplier risks and coordinate mitigation plans.

* Support internal audits, compliance reviews, governance assessments, and evidence requests.

* Ensure adherence to company policies, contractual obligations, delegated authority, segregation of duties, and control standards.

title: Senior Principal - Business Operations Manager
description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organization. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigor and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose:**

GSK’s Global Supply Chain D&T team is the front facing business tech group supporting GSK’s critical business of Global Manufacturing across all product portfolios. The team comprises of multiple business tech disciplines from site specific D&T partnering through to above site and global services like Data & Analytics and Global Demand & Supply Planning processes.

The Team consists of a set of portfolio and business operations manager aligned to GSC D&T Towers and VPs. The team is responsible for defining as well as ensuring portfolio delivery processes, standards, reporting and governance are adhered to and understood by product owners and VPs across GSC D&T. The team is also responsible for the PMO delivery toolset and its maintenance.

In addition the team is accountable for business operations for each of the towers, in ensuring all Finance, HC and Contracts are clearly understood and driven with the respective GSC D&T LT members, VPs.

The Senior Principal - Business Operations Manager role is a key position for to setup and execute standards and processes on business operations for each of the GSC D&T Towers, to ensure all Finance, HC and Contracts are clearly understood and controlled.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Deploy and run a robust financial management service in close collaboration with the GSC D&T Finance Business Partner for the specific function.
* Keep the Tower's financial, headcount and contract plan integrated with the delivery plan, and manage the dependencies, risks and decisions that affect budget and supplier commitments.
* Define and execute clear processes for capturing, reviewing and allocating financial requirements across GSC D&T LT members and their portfolios.
* Lead monthly management of the GSC D&T financial summary and tower-level views across employment costs (FTE and non-FTE), contracts, depreciation, training and T&E.
* Own the discretionary budget allocation process and support the decisions across the Tower using data-driven insights on Capex/Opex, benefits, risks and impacts. Ensure every funded item has a baseline, a named benefit owner and a measurement schedule, and track benefits beyond closure.
* Deploy and run a proactive vendor and contract management service for the GSC D&T function, with clear structure and stakeholder accountabilities. Manage vendor risk, keep contract records audit-ready, and apply supplier controls proportionate to GxP requirements.
* Establish a unified vendor and contract management approach that can be applied consistently across all parts of GSC D&T.
* Coach Product Directors, Product Owners and Tower teams on budget ownership and contract discipline and raise the maturity of the business-operations method across towers.
* Design, improve and operate governance systems and processes, working with senior business stakeholders to provide independent, consistent governance across GSC D&T. Ensure finance and contract decisions use the same demand route and prioritisation criteria as portfolio management, and that every funded item links to strategy and OKRs.
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Technology, Computer Science, or a relevant discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of job-related experience in a technology or digital environment.
* Experience managing Capex and Opex budgets valued in the millions of pounds or equivalent currency.
* Experience managing financial planning, budget allocation and cross-charging models.
* Experience managing vendors and commercial contracts.
* Experience managing supplier commitments, vendor risks, contract records and contract governance processes.
* Experience establishing and operating business operations, financial management or governance processes.
* Experience working with Director, VP or equivalent leadership-level stakeholders on financial, vendor, contract, workforce or business-operations decisions.
* Experience managing delivery against defined budget, timeline and quality requirements.
* Experience using Microsoft Excel for financial/budget analysis and Microsoft PowerPoint for management reporting and presentations.
* Availability for business travel as required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Master’s degree with a specialization in Finance, or a professional finance/accounting qualification such as CIMA, ACCA, or equivalent.
* Finance/accounting qualification, such as CIMA, ACCA or equivalent.
* PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner or equivalent project/programme management certification.
* Qualification/certification related to portfolio management or governance.
* Qualification/certification related to procurement or vendor management.
* The education section specifically states that a Finance-focused master's degree is preferred.

**Skills**

Change Management, Compliance Risk Management, Dependency Analysis, Executive Reports, Financial Acumen, Portfolio Performance Management, Portfolio Prioritization, Problem Solving, Project Management Governance, Shareholder Communications, Stakeholder Management

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. title: Manager - Transfer Pricing
description:
**Job Summary**

* The Direct and Indirect Tax Change Champion exists to translate tax strategy, legislative developments and operational requirements into controlled, sustainable changes across direct and indirect tax processes. The role enables Tax teams to adopt new policies, processes, data capabilities and technologies while maintaining regulatory compliance, operational continuity and effective internal controls.
* The role is accountable for shaping and delivering tax transformation initiatives, coordinating impact assessments, strengthening process and data controls, and preparing affected stakeholders for implementation. This includes establishing clear transformation governance, managing dependencies and risks, and using process analysis and tax expertise to identify opportunities for automation, standardisation and improved reporting.
* Working across Country and Group Tax teams, Finance, Technology and relevant business functions, the role influences tax process owners and supports subject-matter experts in converting regulatory and business requirements into practical solutions. The role does not own underlying tax legislation, business strategy or technology development. It provides the change leadership, tax context and governance required to implement agreed changes effectively.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Tax Transformation Strategy & Prioritisation**

* Translate tax strategy, regulatory developments and operational priorities into a structured transformation roadmap that addresses material direct and indirect tax requirements.
* Evaluate proposed changes against tax, business, data and technology needs to establish clear scope, outcomes, dependencies and implementation priorities.
* Shape business cases and delivery options for process, data and technology improvements that strengthen tax compliance and operational effectiveness.
* Provide tax transformation insight to process owners and governance forums, enabling informed decisions on investment, sequencing and implementation risk.

**Change Impact & Stakeholder Adoption**

* Assess the impact of tax policy, legislative, process and technology changes on affected teams, controls, data flows and operating procedures.
* Develop and execute change and communication approaches that build stakeholder understanding, readiness and adoption across Group and Country Tax teams.
* Identify adoption barriers and stakeholder concerns early, escalating material issues and coordinating practical mitigation actions with accountable owners.
* Engage Tax, Finance, Technology and business stakeholders to maintain alignment on intended outcomes, responsibilities and implementation requirements.

**Tax Process Optimisation**

* Analyse direct and indirect tax workflows to identify control gaps, duplication, manual intervention and opportunities for standardisation or automation.
* Design improved tax processes and operating practices that enhance accuracy, efficiency, traceability and consistency across relevant jurisdictions.
* Apply process mapping, data analysis and operational requirements analysis to define credible future-state workflows and measurable improvement outcomes.
* Embed continuous improvement mechanisms that use stakeholder feedback, performance information and operational learning to refine tax processes.

**Tax Technology & Data Enablement**

* Define tax business and operational requirements for tax engines, automation tools, data warehouses and reporting platforms in partnership with Technology teams.
* Coordinate tax input into solution design, testing, user acceptance and implementation readiness to confirm that agreed requirements and controls are addressed.
* Support the controlled deployment of tax technologies by coordinating user guidance, adoption support, issue resolution and post-implementation review.
* Monitor solution performance and data outcomes after implementation, directing identified defects, control concerns and enhancement opportunities to accountable owners.

**Transformation Governance, Risk & Controls**

* Establish proportionate governance for tax change initiatives, providing transparent oversight of scope, milestones, dependencies, decisions and delivery risks.
* Integrate tax compliance, internal control and conduct requirements into transformation design and implementation decisions.
* Maintain clear project documentation and performance reporting that enables timely escalation, governance review and accountable decision-making.
* Coordinate the identification, assessment and resolution of tax transformation risks and issues, escalating matters outside the role’s authority to the appropriate owner.

**Legislative & Regulatory Change Readiness**

* Monitor relevant direct and indirect tax developments and assess potential implications for processes, data, controls, systems and reporting obligations.
* Work with tax technical specialists and process owners to convert legislative interpretation into clear operational and technology change requirements.
* Coordinate implementation readiness for regulatory change, ensuring that dependencies, control updates, documentation and stakeholder actions are understood.

Evaluate external tax transformation practices and emerging technologies to identify approaches that may strengthen the Bank’s tax operating environment.
  
  
**Transfer Pricing & Intercompany Recharges**

* Ensure clarity of objectives agreed with the LM and are broken down to tasks with regular updates to the LM.
* Managing the assigned tasks professionally and efficiently.
* Ensuring compliance of regulations, policies and requirements.
* Contributing to the effectiveness of the team by utilizing interpersonal skills to work with members effectively.
* Gain cross functional knowledge & System Training to uplift the skills especially in the assigned domains.
* Develop and apply testing processes. Create detailed, comprehensive and well-structured test plans and test cases. Co-ordination of Test data/Environment with upstream/downstream teams.
* Ensure detailed project transition plan to be considered in different aspects like End User Training, Resource Considerations & Training Materials.
* Responsible for managing deliverables throughout the project lifecycle collaborating with various project/program teams, stakeholders; finance stakeholders across geographies, process and technology teams.
* Evidence of strong Project Management skills, enabling the delivery of multiple diverse data initiatives from inception to delivery
* Excellent business and technical process design and execution skills, enabling the effective execution of a change
* Responsibility for prioritisation and management of critical path delivery items
* Design the target state solution and target state processes
* Drive the establishment of a target operating model and internal capability to support and drive ongoing change / enhancement initiatives
* Ensure strong engagement with senior leaders and stakeholders across Finance.
* Responsible for risk and issue resolution

**Skills And Experience**
**Priority Skills**

* Tax Compliance
* Tax Returns
* Tax Structuring
* Regulatory Compliance
* Risk Management

**Other Skills**

* Collaboration
* Communication
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Continuous Improvement
* Problem Solving
* Issue Management
* Operations Optimization
* Strategic Planning
* Talent Development
* Requirements Elicitation

**Motivations**

* Motivated by protecting customer and organisational data through practical, proportionate and sustainable privacy solutions.
* Energised by solving complex risk and control challenges with stakeholders from different business, legal, compliance and technology disciplines.
* Thrives in environments that value sound judgement, continuous improvement, collaboration and personal accountability.

**Qualifications**

* Experience operating in complex, regulated financial services environments with multiple jurisdictions, stakeholder groups and governance requirements.
* Exposure to direct and indirect tax operating models, tax compliance processes and the organisational impact of legislative or policy change.
* Experience contributing to large-scale transformation involving process redesign, automation, data platforms, tax engines or regulatory reporting solutions.
* Exposure to structured change delivery across business, tax, finance and technology teams, including testing, implementation readiness and post-deployment stabilization.
* Experience working with complex data flows, control frameworks and reporting requirements where accuracy, traceability and timely issue resolution are critical.
* Experience in intercompany recharges / allocations, transfer pricing methodologies and knowledge on controllership requirements.
* Business English (required)

**Come Join Our Team!**
