title: Director – Master Data Management
description:
**Job Description**
The Director – Master Data Management will lead the Finance GBS master data capability from Hyderabad. The role is accountable for setting the strategic direction, governance framework, operating model, control environment and data quality agenda for Finance GBS master data while staying aligned to overall Enterprise MDM strategy. The Director will partner with global process owners, tower leads, Finance leadership, IT, compliance and audit teams to improve master data accuracy, strengthen controls, reduce downstream process issues and enable scalable service delivery across Finance GBS.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**MDM Strategy and Governance**

* Own the Finance GBS master data strategy, roadmap and operating model, covering both in-house and outsourced delivery.
* Establish global policies, standards, controls, ownership and decision rights for Finance master data.
* Provide governance across master data domains, regions and systems, including prioritization, escalation and exception management.
* Align MDM priorities with Finance GBS objectives, global process owners and business requirements.

**Global MDM Operations and Service Delivery**

* Lead the Hyderabad MDM organization and oversee end-to-end master data operations across customer, vendor, material and other applicable Finance data domains.
* Manage both in-house and outsourced delivery through clear accountabilities, service levels, operating routines and performance expectations.
* Ensure consistent execution of master data creation, maintenance, validation and deactivation in accordance with policies, controls and service expectations.
* Build and develop the MDM team, including organization structure, role clarity, capability development, performance management and succession coverage.
* Drive standardization of request intake, approvals, documentation and exception handling across regions and systems.

**Data Quality, Controls and Technology Enablement**

* Own the Finance GBS master data quality and control agenda, including KPIs, monitoring, issue remediation and audit readiness.
* Ensure master data processes comply with internal controls, segregation of duties, regulatory requirements and data governance standards.
* Partner with process owners and IT to address root causes of data issues and strengthen ERP workflows, validation rules, integrations and system controls.
* Represent Finance GBS MDM requirements in ERP changes, system enhancements and broader technology initiatives.

**Transformation and Capability Building**

* Own the MDM improvement roadmap, including process simplification, automation, workflow enhancement, data cleansing and duplicate reduction.
* Use performance data and stakeholder feedback to improve service quality, productivity and control effectiveness.
* Strengthen functional capability through training, documentation, knowledge management and adoption of consistent MDM practices.
* Partner with Finance GBS transformation teams to connect master data improvements with broader process performance and value delivery.

**Qualifications**
**Education / Experience / Expertise**

* Master’s degree in accounting or related field required.
* Data governance, ERP, Six Sigma, PMP or master data management certifications are preferred.

**MDM and Finance Expertise**

* 18+ years of experience across master data management, Finance operations, GBS/shared services or data governance.
* Deep understanding of Finance master data and its impact on PTP, OTC, RTR, financial controls and operational performance.
* Strong knowledge of MDM governance, data quality, ERP-enabled workflows, internal controls and audit requirements.

**Global Operations and Transformation**

* Proven experience leading a global MDM function across multiple regions, business units and ERP environments.
* Experience designing or transforming an MDM operating model, including capability setup, offshore transition and management of in-house and outsourced delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to drive standardization, technology enablement and sustainable process improvement at scale.

title: MS-FDL-Senior Manager-Platform Engineering Lead
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Senior Manager – Platform Engineering**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager – Platform Engineering to lead the strategy, engineering, and operations of a scalable enterprise platform supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines platform architecture, engineering execution, and people leadership, with accountability for secure, reliable, and cost-efficient shared capabilities. The ideal candidate will enable application and data engineering teams through self-service infrastructure, standardized delivery workflows, and a strong developer experience, supporting finance transformation solutions across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will own the platform engineering roadmap, delivery governance, and team development, partnering with product, architecture, security, and business leaders to improve engineering productivity and deliver measurable business outcomes across client engagements.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Technology & Architecture Leadership**

* Own the platform engineering strategy and architecture roadmap, aligning cloud infrastructure, shared services, and modernization priorities with business and product goals.
* Lead the design and evolution of secure, resilient cloud-native platforms, including container orchestration, networking, identity, secrets management, and standardized environments.
* Establish engineering standards, reference architectures, infrastructure-as-code patterns, and automated guardrails for consistent provisioning and operation of platform services.
* Enable application, data, and AI/ML workloads through reusable platform capabilities, APIs, integration patterns, and scalable compute and storage services.
* Own CI/CD and release engineering capabilities, including automated testing, security checks, artifact management, deployment strategies, and rollback readiness.
* Provide technical leadership for critical incidents, architectural reviews, and complex engineering decisions; drive root-cause analysis and durable corrective actions.

**Delivery & Operational Excellence**

* Lead delivery planning and governance across platform workstreams, managing priorities, dependencies, risks, and commitments against agreed business outcomes.
* Embed agile, DevOps, and SRE practices, including service ownership, observability, on-call readiness, incident response, and tested disaster recovery.
* Define and track service-level indicators and objectives, agreed SLAs, and engineering delivery metrics to improve reliability, deployment performance, and recovery times.
* Drive capacity planning, performance optimization, and FinOps practices; manage platform budgets and vendors to improve cost efficiency without compromising reliability.
* Partner with security and governance teams to embed access controls, vulnerability remediation, auditability, data protection, and compliance requirements into platform operations.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Lead and scale multidisciplinary platform engineering teams spanning cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, and automation; develop engineering managers and technical leads.
* Build a high-performance, inclusive engineering culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes.
* Own workforce planning, hiring, performance management, succession planning, and capability development aligned with the platform roadmap.
* Coach managers and engineers on technical judgment, execution discipline, stakeholder engagement, and career growth; delegate effectively while maintaining accountability.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with product teams, enterprise architects, security leaders, finance transformation stakeholders, and clients to translate business needs into platform priorities.
* Balance platform investment, delivery capacity, risk, and business value; align stakeholders on trade-offs, service expectations, and measurable outcomes.
* Support solutioning, proposals, and client discussions with platform architecture, delivery estimates, operating models, and cost considerations.
* Communicate roadmap progress, investment needs, service health, delivery risks, and business impact clearly to executive stakeholders.

**Platform & Product Mindset**

* Manage the platform as an internal product, using developer feedback and adoption metrics to prioritize capabilities that reduce friction and accelerate delivery.
* Build self-service workflows, reusable infrastructure modules, service catalogs, and standardized delivery paths with clear documentation and onboarding.
* Measure platform value through adoption, developer satisfaction, onboarding time, delivery lead time, and reduced operational toil; enable secure analytics and AI use cases.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of experience across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or SRE, including substantial architecture and delivery ownership.
* 5+ years of engineering people-management experience, with a demonstrated track record of leading multiple teams and developing engineering managers or technical leads.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including networking, identity, security, resilience, and cloud operating models.
* Strong expertise in cloud-native architecture, containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform), and automated environment provisioning.
* Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, observability, and automation using relevant tools and languages (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Argo CD, OpenTelemetry, Python, or Go).
* Strong understanding of APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and shared platform services; experience enabling data platforms and integration workloads.
* Experience with secure-by-design engineering, identity and access management, secrets management, software supply-chain security, and enterprise governance.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to deliver enterprise platform programs, manage cross-team dependencies, and establish effective execution and risk governance.
* Experience implementing DevOps and SRE practices, including SLOs, error budgets, incident management, post-incident reviews, and disaster recovery testing.
* Strong understanding of scalability, capacity planning, performance tuning, cloud cost optimization, budget ownership, and vendor management.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Understanding of enterprise data and application needs; exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A) is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, analytics platforms, or other data-intensive enterprise products is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong people leadership, organizational planning, and talent development skills, with the ability to lead through managers and technical leads.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including executive-level engagement and influence across business and technology teams.
* Ability to balance long-term platform strategy with pragmatic delivery, sound technical judgment, and hands-on engagement when needed.
* High ownership mindset focused on platform adoption, developer productivity, reliability, and measurable business outcomes.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.
  
  
  
  
Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com

**Job Description**

**Role Overview**

As a Senior Cost Manager in Cost Management, you will be responsible for leading the execution of cost management services for construction projects, ensuring cost control and quality objectives are met. You are expected to lead cost management project teams and/ or key cost management roles, and coordinate with clients and stakeholders and foster a collaborative and high-performing project environment. This role also includes commission management responsibilities overseeing invoicing processes and project compliance through D-365 to ensure financial accuracy and compliance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Hold the highest level of professional integrity and business ethics.
* Contribute to a positive team culture by promoting open communication, mutual respect, and shared accountability.
* Demonstrate professionalism, reliability, and a proactive attitude in team interactions.
* Motivate team members, and drive towards positive client outcomes and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Assist in onboarding new team members and helping them integrate into project workflows.
* Assist in conducting interviews for vacant positions in line with the team’s recruitment process and resource requirements

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Lead multidisciplinary project teams including clients, consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
* Build productive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders through consistent follow-up and responsiveness.
* Support conflict resolution and issue management by escalating appropriately and offering practical solutions.
* Facilitate effective communication and collaboration across all stakeholders through structured meetings, reporting, and documentation.

**Project Strategy & Planning**

* Critically analyze, challenge and brainstorm project requirements and cost deliverables, in order to find creative solutions and alternatives on behalf of clients.
* Collaborate in developing robust cost reporting structures and control mechanisms.

**Project Controls & Reporting**

* Act as Commission Manager, taking responsibility for end-to-end service delivery, often with respect to large or complex commissions or multiple commissions.
* Managing estimating and cost planning activities to include taking ownership of and presenting the final revisions of cost plans.
* Leading the production of monthly post-contract cost reports and presenting them to the client.
* Leading value engineering and life cycle costing exercise.
* Implement and maintain cost controls mechanisms incorporated into projects’ schedule, cost, risk, and change management.

**Financial and Risk Management**

* Lead commercial negotiations and contract administration on projects alongside the cost management team
* Responsible for supporting the internal risk management procedures and systems, including client care processes and the contract database.
* Manage invoicing processes using D-365, including:
  + Reviewing and validating invoice data for accuracy and completeness.
  + Coordinating with finance teams to ensure timely submission and approval.
  + Tracking invoice status and resolving discrepancies.
  + Ensuring compliance with client billing requirements and internal financial controls.

**Qualifications**

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cost Management, Quantity Surveying, Construction, Engineering, or a related field; Master’s degree is a plus.
* 11-15 years’ experience in cost management or construction projects (e.g. cost manager, construction manager, procurement, project manager, vendor, consultant etc.).
* Strong communication and leadership skills; experience in people management in a plus.
* Strong business acumen, with the ability to drive outcomes on behalf of clients and coordinate with construction and design teams to meet deadlines and deliverables
* Experience in client management with solid experience in client facing environment that requires incumbent to utilise critical business development skills and advisory skills to enhance project delivery on value management, value engineering, and life cycle costing.
* Native-level proficiency in (local language), Business-level proficiency in English.
* Proficiency in Cost-X or equivalent cost estimation software.

**Additional Information**

**KPIs**

Your performance KPIs will be evaluated as part of every employee’s performance review process, including the following:

* Conduct quarterly check-ins with direct reports to provide feedback, identify growth opportunities and career development, as reflected in Peakon survey results.
* Set clear objectives during performance reviews, actively monitor progress, and apply insights to drive career growth and achieve professional goals.
* Successful project delivery by meeting agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards, with outcomes reflected through client care score.

* Maintain financial reporting through D-365, with 100% compliance to internal controls and client billing requirements.

description:

**Job Description**

The Procurement Manager will oversee purchasing activities for engineering, fabrication, and industrial automation projects. The role is responsible for sourcing materials, developing vendor relationships, negotiating commercial terms, controlling procurement costs, and ensuring timely availability of materials and services to meet project schedules and quality requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop procurement plans based on project BOMs, engineering requirements, production schedules, and delivery milestones.

* Track purchase orders, supplier commitments, material lead times, deliveries, and pending items.
* Maintain vendor databases, approved supplier lists, historical pricing, and supplier performance records.
* Monitor procurement budgets and identify opportunities for cost reduction without compromising quality.
* Coordinate material inspection, incoming quality issues, shortages, replacements, and supplier corrective actions.
* Manage supplier relationships and develop alternative sources for critical and long-lead items.
* Coordinate with accounts for invoice verification, payment follow-ups, and reconciliation of purchase records.
* Provide procurement status reports and highlight risks that could affect project execution.

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.
* Experience in procurement for engineering, manufacturing, machine building, or industrial automation.

5–8 years in procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management, preferably with supervisory responsibility.

Vendor development, cost negotiation, procurement planning, supplier management, Excel, ERP/accounting systems, and commercial analysis.

title: Senior Revenue Operations Systems Manager
description:
#### **Hyderabad, -, India**

Digital Product Development, Sales and Marketing

UKIMEA Region

  

HYD00003G Requisition #

**Senior Revenue Operations Manager**
  
Location: India, Hyderabad
  
Region: Arup Digital Products
  
Group: Business Management & Operations
  
Grade: 5
  
Employment type: Permanent, full time
  
**1. Joining Arup**
  
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.
  
Arup Digital Products (ADP) develops and commercialises specialist engineering software globally. Our ambition is to become a commercially robust software business that turns Arup’s trusted expertise into scalable products that provides strategic value for the firm. As ADP diversifies across products, markets and regions, we need connected customer and revenue journeys, trusted data and systems that combine global consistency with appropriate local flexibility.
  
We are seeking an experienced Senior Revenue Operations Manager to build and lead a scalable revenue-operations capability for our growing multi-product, international software business.

  

**2. The Opportunity**
  
This role will build the revenue operations backbone for ADP’s next phase of growth. You will own the systems, data and operating processes that support the customer-to-revenue lifecycle, helping ADP scale new products, commercial models and markets with greater consistency and control.
  
You will own the development roadmap for Dynamics 365, HubSpot and any other key commercial operations systems for ADP. Our Dynamics platform extends beyond conventional CRM to support product and pricing data, quoting, order and licence delivery records, invoice preparation, royalty reporting and customer support. You will lead the developers and delivery partners who maintain and improve this environment.
  
Working across Sales, Marketing, Product, Software Engineering, Customer Support and Success, Customer Operations, Finance and Digital Technology, you will translate agreed pricing, product, licensing and go-to-market decisions into scalable systems, data, workflows and controls.
  
The role sits within ADP’s Operations Function. Reporting to ADP’s Global Commercial Manager, you will work cross-functionally across the global business and manage the India-based CRM development team, specialist technology suppliers and relevant Arup Digital Technology stakeholders.
  
You will use AI, automation and workflow technology to simplify work, improve data quality and reduce cost,.
  
You will shape a business-led revenue systems roadmap, strengthening ownership of commercial data and determining how Dynamics, HubSpot, licensing tools and wider Arup platforms should work together. This will include representing ADP’s requirements in any future integration between Dynamics and Arup’s wider commercial systems.
  
Your principal responsibilities will include:
  

* Own the development roadmap and governance for Dynamics 365, HubSpot, licensing tools and connected revenue systems, aligning investment and delivery priorities with ADP’s product pipeline and growth plans.
* Lead ADP’s in-house D365 CRM developers, HubSpot consultants and technology partners, setting priorities, requirements, delivery standards, testing, documentation, releases and user support arrangements.
* Own HubSpot as ADP’s top-of-funnel platform, governing lead capture, quality, lifecycle stages and hand-off to Dynamics.
* Oversee integrations across CRM, marketing, licensing and finance systems, defining process boundaries, data flows, controls and ADP’s requirements for future platform changes.
* Lead revenue operations improvements with an aim to increase robustness to handle multiple product portfolios across multiple regions. Improvement aspects in both processes and revenue data quality & definitions.
* Enable functional leads to establish clear data ownership, governance and quality standards across the commercial lifecycle.
* Partner with functional leaders to translate agreed pricing, product configurations, licensing models and go-to-market decisions into scalable operating systems and processes.
* Establish the system controls, data and reporting processes required to support reliable commercial and financial reporting, including sales commission calculations, working closely with Finance and other functional owners and supporting relevant audit coordination.
* Enable Finance and Sales to operate effective forecasting processes through appropriate systems, data, controls and governance.
* Drive system adoption through appropriate technology training, onboarding, SOPs, in-system guidance and maintained knowledge content.
* Implement AI and automation where appropriate and remove inefficient processes and controls.

As ADP expands its portfolio, markets and revenue, you will build a global Revenue Operations capability that combines software-business agility with Arup’s expertise. This is a unique opportunity to create the operating infrastructure through which ADP takes products to market, processes revenue and supports customers.
  
Success in the role will be demonstrated through outcomes including:
  

* clear ownership and an effective development roadmap for ADP’s revenue and commercial systems;
* strong adoption of Dynamics, HubSpot and other business systems, supported by effective leadership of developers, consultants and suppliers;
* agreed product, pricing, licensing and go-to-market decisions translated effectively into scalable operating systems and processes;
* well-governed commercial data, effective system controls and reliable reporting that support operational and financial decision-making;
* more consistent and scalable customer-to-revenue processes across products, markets and functional teams;

Experience of software licensing, subscription or usage-based commercial models, product and pricing data, finance system integration, customer support platforms, engineering software or distributor channels would be advantageous but is not essential.

**4. What we offer you**
  
At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.
  
Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.
  
Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup.

Please contact the relevant recruiter to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. **6. Our Application Process**
  
Applications will be reviewed against the essential experience and capabilities set out above. **Job Overview**

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Event Operations Manager to oversee the planning, coordination, and execution of events from the initial planning stage through successful on-ground delivery.

· Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

**We are looking for a Incharge of Switchyard & Rectifier Smelter Plant (f/m/d) to join our team at Innomotics.**
**The Industry-Leader of Motors and Drives**
Innomotics is an industry-leading supplier of motors and large drive systems. With a trusted legacy of more than 150 years of engineering expertise, our products power all of the world’s most essential industries. Today, we are bringing the #EnergyTransition to life with a portfolio that enables our customers to boost energy efficiency, reduce greenhouse gases, and minimize the carbon footprints of plants.
  
  
**Our Most Powerful Engine: Our People**
We are a team of more than 15,000 dedicated experts, doers, and innovators. For us, engineering the future means keeping businesses in motion. As a global player operating with the spirit and speed of a mid-sized champion, the future holds unlimited opportunities for us. If you share our bold mindset to be best-in-class, we want you IN.
  
  
**Your Profile**
We are looking for an experienced
**Manager – Head Electrical**
to lead the
**400 kV Switchyard and Substation Operations & Maintenance**
function. The position will be responsible for ensuring safe, reliable and efficient operation and maintenance of the 400 kV switchyard, plant substations, transformers, rectifier systems, HT motors and associated electrical assets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Switchyard & Substation Operations
* Lead the operation and maintenance of the 400 kV switchyard and plant substations.
* Ensure reliable operation of approximately 45 bays and 22 area substations.
* Manage electrical systems associated with four potlines, including ABB rectifier systems.
* Ensure availability and reliability of 24 ABB rectifier systems, 5 × 750 MVA ICTs and 3 × 120 MVA transformers.
* Manage operation and maintenance of approximately 50 nos. 11 kV HT ID Fan Motors, 146 distribution transformers and 13 power transformers across the plant.
* Reliability & Continuous Improvement
* Identify and execute electrical reliability improvement projects to improve equipment availability and reduce failures.
* Lead reliability initiatives such as hot-spot reduction, tripping reduction, asset health improvement and predictive maintenance.
* Implement and horizontally deploy successful reliability and maintenance improvement projects across the plant.
* Drive Asset Optimization initiatives to maximize equipment life, reliability and operational efficiency.
* Demonstrate strong focus on reducing electrical breakdowns and unplanned outages.
* Maintenance & Overhauling
* Plan and execute preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance of EHV/HV electrical equipment.
* Lead overhauling and maintenance of transformers, SF6 circuit breakers, VCBs, switchgear and associated electrical equipment.
* Manage overhauling of MVA-class transformers in coordination with OEMs and specialized service teams.
* Lead execution of ABB SF6 breaker overhauling, including approximately 121 breakers, using the existing maintenance team.
* Ensure effective testing, commissioning and restoration of electrical equipment following maintenance activities.
* Protection, Relay & SCADA
* Provide technical leadership for protection systems and relay coordination.
* Hands-on knowledge of various types of protection relays, relay programming and testing.
* Ensure effective operation and maintenance of ABB protection and control systems.
* Manage and troubleshoot SCADA systems such as ABB RET670/REC670 and MicroSCADA.
* Analyze electrical faults, tripping events and protection system operations and implement corrective actions.
* Safety & Compliance
* Ensure strict compliance with electrical safety standards, statutory requirements, plant procedures and safe work practices.
* Drive a Zero Harm culture across electrical operations and maintenance.
* Conduct regular safety reviews, risk assessments and audits.
* Ensure safe isolation, LOTO, permit-to-work and switching procedures are rigorously followed.
* Maintain strong customer/client compliance with zero or minimum observations and notices.
* Team Leadership & Capability Development
* Lead a large multidisciplinary electrical team of approximately 120 personnel, including engineers, technicians and support resources.
* Directly/indirectly manage approximately 35 engineers and 70 technicians.
* Build technical capability within the team through structured training, coaching and knowledge sharing.
* Develop engineers and technicians in 400 kV switchyard, rectifier and substation operations.
* Drive succession planning and competency development for critical electrical positions.
* Operational Excellence
* Drive reduction of overtime and improve manpower productivity through effective planning and resource optimization.
* Establish robust maintenance systems to minimize equipment failures, breakdowns and production interruptions.
* Monitor key electrical maintenance KPIs and drive corrective actions.
* Ensure high equipment availability and reliability while optimizing maintenance costs.
* Collaborate with Operations, Production, Projects, EHS and OEM teams for smooth plant operations.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized institution.
* 15–20 years of relevant experience in electrical operation and maintenance, preferably in a large-scale process industry, power-intensive plant, metals, aluminium, steel, cement or similar industry.
* Strong hands-on experience in 400 kV/220 kV switchyards, substations, transformers, protection systems and HT electrical equipment.
* Experience in managing large electrical O&M teams.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills for EHV/HV electrical systems.
* Experience in reliability improvement, asset optimization and maintenance excellence.
* Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder-management capabilities.

Ability to work in a high-volume, safety-critical industrial environment.
  
  
**Desired Competencies**
The incumbent will be expected to demonstrate measurable improvements in:
  
  

* 400 kV Switchyard & Substation availability
* Reduction in electrical equipment tripping and breakdowns
* Reduction in transformer and switchgear hot spots
* Improved reliability of rectifier systems
* Reduction in unplanned downtime
* Optimization of maintenance manpower and overtime
* Electrical asset optimization and life-cycle management
* Zero injury / strong safety performance
* Effective technical capability development
* Customer satisfaction and compliance

Ready to power the future with us? Join Innomotics and start making a difference now. #TeamInnomotics #JoinReliableMotion

The Senior Manager Digital & Technology Transformation Rooms Operations, APEC plays a critical role in Marriott’s Digital and Technology Transformation, reporting to Vice President, Operations, South Asia, with a dotted line to Director of Rooms Operations, APEC, based in Mumbai, Bangalore or New Delhi.
  
  
This role will provide a bridge between current and future processes in Rooms Operations, guiding hotels on the deployment of the new systems and business processes, supporting the guest and associate journey to ensure a smooth transition and cutover. The role will conduct workshops and trainings to transitioning hotels, ensuring that property teams are fully prepared to successfully operate the new systems from Day 1.

**Key Responsibilities**

* End-to-End Testing and Product Validation: Contribute to end-to-end business process validation testing for the discipline, collaborating with relevant stakeholders in DGE, Rooms Operations, and Loyalty Operations disciplines in APEC
* End-to-End Deployment Validation:

* Assist with Command Center operations during the Launch phase, ensuring operational queries and support tickets are resolved promptly
* Continue supporting IMs and discipline teams throughout the Stabilization phase, helping properties adapt to new business processes and tools

* Act as a trusted advisor to property operators and deployment teams.
* Communicate complex system concepts in clear, actionable terms.

* Gather feedback from early adopters and share insights to improve future workshops and deployment processes.
* Foster a collaborative, supportive learning environment.
* Materials & Continuous Improvement
* Utilize and continuously refine workshop facilitation materials, participant guides, and job aids.
* Contribute to the development of new learning content and process documentation.

+ Deep knowledge of existing operations within APEC and the systems that support it, including Opera PMS, MARSHA, EMPOWER: GXP, EMPOWER: RES, and the Marriott Bonvoy loyalty program.
+ Ability to quickly learn and build expertise in the new systems and processes that create the entire end-to-end experience for Rooms associates, including Opera Cloud PMS, SPOG, and ARA

* Change Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

+ Proven ability to lead hotels and operations teams through complex system and process changes, articulating what is changing and what is staying the same.
+ Skilled in training, stakeholder communication, and change enablement strategies.
+ Strong influencing skills with the ability to align cross functional teams across disciplines.

* Problem-Solving & Decision-Making

+ Analytical thinker with strong root cause analysis skills and structured risk mitigation approach.
+ Comfortable operating in fast paced, ambiguous environments.
+ Strong judgment to prioritize effectively and manage competing demands.

* Collaboration & Cross-Functional Partnership

+ Ability to build strong relationships across regional teams and hotel teams.
+ Comfortable bridging the gap between business requirements, product design, and technical stakeholders.
+ Collaborative mindset focused on shared outcomes and continuous improvement.

* Communication & Facilitation

+ Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills tailored to both operational and executive audiences.
+ Ability to simplify complex concepts and provide clear direction during implementation and support phases.
+ Confident facilitator of workshops, discussions, and rapid problem solving sessions.

+ Resilient under pressure, maintaining a positive, proactive approach.

* You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance

**About our EA RESIG Team:**
For more than 20 years, the EA RESIG team has focused on working with medium- to large-sized funds across every asset class in the real estate world. It’s by fully immersing ourselves in this one area that we’re able to both create opportunities for our employees to thrive in the industry and provide the most innovative advisory solutions to our clients.
  
  
We pride ourselves in fostering an environment based on both continuing education and enabling employees to take on new responsibilities and become business leaders. As the second-largest real estate private fund administrator, we offer a full suite of financial products to our clients, from general accounting and tax planning to outsourced services and investor relations. Between our scope of services and culture of always learning, EA RESIG employees not only see the entire lifecycle of our clients but serve as strategic partners as they grow.
  
  
**About EisnerAmper:**
EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with nearly 4,000 employees and more than 400 partners across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.
  
  
Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start-ups, global public firms, and middle-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not-for-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Bangalore and Hyderabad. We are a culturally diverse pool of over 500 professionals supporting our global clientele from a range of startups to Fortune 500 entities.

title: MDS AMEA Customer Experience Regional Lead
description:
**Job Description**
**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.**
You are part of a team that experiments with cutting-edge technologies, delivering solutions revealed as a result of the testing and learnings, and developing strong partnerships to enable growth through innovation and agile methodologies.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
You will implement pilot projects to drive disruptive ideas across the organization, using the learnings from these projects to inform decisions on whether to incorporate them as a portfolio project or to introduce them as a new proof of concept. You will also get to experiment with cutting-edge technologies while at the same time building strong partnerships within the business to build a strong pipeline of ideas to pursue. In addition, you will get to bring the outside in by building relationships with start-ups and building your knowledge of actual proof-of-concept cases, and scope, align, adopt and leverage technology for respective learnings and pilots.
  
  
**What You Will Bring**
A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
  
  

* Project management including knowledge of Agile
* Technical expertise and a passion for innovation, understanding a variety of disruptive technology products and services
* Technical and business acumen to evaluate opportunities with internal and external partners
* Machine learning/artificial intelligence programming languages
* The start-up landscape
* Familiarity with the fast-moving consumer goods or related sector
* Leading internal and external teams through complex challenges and developing creative solutions/options
* Driving for results and Analytical Skills

**More About This Role**
**What you need to know about this position:**
This is a hands-on leadership role with a
**Product mindset**
— not a coordination or engagement function. The OTC Regional Success Manager is the
**regional integrator**
across all four OTC product areas, responsible for connecting strategy to execution and ensuring value delivery at scale.
  
  
The role holder acts as the single point of accountability at the regional level for:
  
  

* Synergizing business requirements across Business Units
* Maintaining real-time visibility on project portfolio and operations performance
* Driving digital adoption of OTC tools
* Holding Product Managers and Operations leaders accountable for outcomes

This role spans all four OTC product areas:
  
  

* Order Capture - End-to-end order intake, validation, EDI/portal management
* Order Fulfillment - Order processing, availability, delivery execution & monitoring
* Bill to Cash - Invoicing, collections, cash application, dispute resolution
* Customer Care - Customer query handling, issue resolution, service performance

**What extra ingredients you will bring:**
**Regional OTC Community of Practice & Governance**

* Establish and sustain a Regional OTC Community of Practice spanning all four product areas.
* Drive a monthly governance cadence with structured inputs/outputs that feed all downstream accountabilities.
* Ensure the Community of Practice serves as the activation engine for change adoption, best practice sharing, and regional alignment.
* Curate and escalate regional themes, pain points, and opportunities into global product and operations forums.

**Business Requirements Synergization & Gatekeeper Role**

* Synergize and rationalize OTC business requirements (BRDs) at regional level in partnership with OTC Product Business Analysts.
* Act as the gatekeeper to prevent BU-level fragmentation — blocking unauthorized customizations in the form of MEs, siloed projects, shadow IT, or ungoverned local builds.
* Ensure all regional requirements are aligned with the enterprise product roadmap and S4/HANA migration timelines.
* Provide a consolidated regional demand view to Global Product Managers for backlog prioritization.

**Project Portfolio Visibility & Accountability**

* Own the OTC Project Portfolio view — maintaining real-time visibility across MEs, ND Projects, and Celonis-linked value delivery initiatives.
* Connect the dots between Funding, Cost, and Value Realization — ensuring every investment has a measurable outcome.
* Hold Product Managers accountable for delivery gaps, timeline slippages, and value leakage.
* Provide executive-ready portfolio reporting (weekly/monthly) to the Global OTC Lead and regional stakeholders.

**BPO Operations Performance & Accountability**

* Own the BPO Operations performance lens — tracking Celonis KPIs across the regional operations footprint.
* Hold Operations Leaders and OTC Product Managers accountable for performance gaps against contracted SLAs and KPIs.
* Drive corrective action plans when performance deviates from targets — not just flagging, but fixing.
* Partner with BPO governance leads to ensure operational insights inform technology roadmap priorities.

**Digital Adoption & Value Realization**

* Drive digital adoption of OTC tools (Celonis, SAP, Non-SAP) by setting adoption targets and measuring usage.
* Leverage the Community of Practice as the primary channel for driving tool awareness, training, and behavioral change.
* Track adoption metrics at country level to identify laggards and deploy targeted interventions.
* Ensure adoption translates to measurable business value (not just login counts, but process improvement outcomes).

**Experience**

* 12+ years of progressive experience in OTC/shared services operations, product management, or transformation leadership.
* 3+ years in a senior role (Senior Manager or Director) with cross-functional accountability.
* Proven track record of driving adoption and value realization across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Experience in OTC / Order Management / Finance shared services in a large CPG/FMCG or similar enterprise.
* Demonstrated ability to act as a gatekeeper — saying “no” to fragmentation while maintaining stakeholder relationships.
* Experience with process mining tools (Celonis preferred) and linking process insights to business outcomes.
* Familiarity with Agile product management frameworks and portfolio governance.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of OTC end-to-end processes: Order Capture, Fulfillment, Billing, Collections, Cash Application, Dispute Management, and Customer Care.
* Working knowledge of SAP ECC / S4HANA OTC modules (SD, FI-AR).
* Proficiency in Celonis — ability to interpret process mining data and translate into action.
* Familiarity with project portfolio management tools and dashboards.
* Data literacy — ability to connect cost, adoption, and value metrics into a coherent narrative.
* Financial acumen — understanding of funding models, cost allocation, and value realization tracking.

**Leadership & Soft Skills**

* Assertive accountability — ability to hold peers and senior stakeholders accountable without direct authority.
* Integrator mindset — connecting dots across products, projects, operations, and adoption.
* Executive communication — ability to synthesize complex information into clear, actionable insights.
* Influence without authority — driving outcomes through governance, data, and relationships.
* Strong stakeholder management across Supply Chain, Finance, IT, and Commercial functions.
* Data-driven decision making — leveraging analytics for prioritization and accountability.
* Cultural sensitivity and ability to operate effectively across diverse regional contexts

Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy

At Mondelēz International, our purpose is to empower people to snack right by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. That means delivering a broad range of delicious, high-quality snacks that nourish life's moments, made with sustainable ingredients and packaging that consumers can feel good about.
  
  
We have a rich portfolio of strong brands globally and locally including many household names such as

biscuits;

chocolate;

candy and

gum. We are proud to hold the top position globally in biscuits, chocolate and candy and the second top position in gum.
  
  
Our 80,000 makers and bakers are located in more than 80 countries and we sell our products in over 150 countries around the world. Our people are energized for growth and critical to us living our purpose and values. We are a diverse community that can make things happen—and happen fast.

**Division Profile**
Morgan Stanley is a worldwide leader in investment banking and is one of the top firms in mergers and acquisitions, underwriting equity and equity-related transactions, corporate debt issuance, and high-yield debt financing. With professionals in 30 countries, we are consistently recognized for our performance in both traditional and innovative financing techniques, helping a wide range of clients around the world to make and execute decisions about their business strategy and financial structure.
  
  
Morgan Stanley’s Investment Banking Division and Global Capital Markets (IBD/GCM) Groups provide industry, regional and product expertise to corporations, institutions, and government clients in order to develop and execute innovative and customized solutions to the most challenging strategic and financing issues faced in the global marketplace.
  
  
The Investment Banking Group is comprised of a number of industry coverage groups which work closely with Global Capital Markets teams to provide product structuring and creativity, relevant market insight, and execution expertise to clients. These solutions include initial public offerings; public and private equity and equity-linked financings; mergers, acquisitions, and restructurings; defense advisory assignments; strategic partnerships; public and private debt placements; share repurchases; and hedging, swaps and derivative transactions.
  
  
**Team Profile**
Expense Hub Team within IBD/GCM Management supports IBD/GCM bankers globally with preparing expense reports, vendor onboarding, vendor invoice processing, Travel request review and approval. Team works closely with respective core region, bankers and assistants to ensure expenses reported accurately in compliance with firm policy, Travel requests are reviewed to facilitate business requirements with regards to meetings and project executions across client locations.
  
  
**Summary: Primary Role**
The Manager – Travel & Expense will serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for travel approvals, leading a team responsible for reviewing and approving travel requisitions across APAC and EMEA regions. The role requires sound judgment, strong analytical capabilities, and the ability to make timely decisions while ensuring compliance with firm travel policies. The individual will provide guidance to the team, manage escalations, maintain process documentation, and partner with stakeholders to ensure seamless travel operations.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 5–7+ years of experience in Travel & Expense (T&E) operations.
* Prior experience managing or supervising a team in the current or previous role.
* Strong knowledge of travel approval processes, travel policies, and expense management (Concur experience preferred).
* Good understanding of global geography and international travel itineraries.
* Excellent analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to ask relevant questions and interact professionally with stakeholders.
* High attention to detail with a strong focus on accuracy and quality.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment while managing multiple priorities.
* Flexible to work in rotational shifts:

+ APAC: 6:30 AM – 3:30 PM
+ EMEA: 3:30 PM – 12:30 AM

* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and documentation management.
* Use AI tools to re-define existing process and create efficiencies
* Willing to carry and respond to Firm-issued mobile device emails and voicemails as required.

**Primary Responsibilities**
**Travel Review & Approval**

* Review and approve travel requisitions for APAC and EMEA bankers within defined service levels.
* Validate travel itineraries, including flight and hotel bookings, ensuring compliance with company travel policies.
* Assess business justification for travel, identify cost exceptions, and determine the appropriateness of requests.
* Evaluate incomplete or ambiguous requests by asking relevant and precise questions to obtain required information before making decisions.
* Exercise sound judgment to approve, reject, or return travel requests based on policy and business requirements.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of global geography to accurately assess travel destinations and itineraries.
* Handle time-sensitive travel approvals with accuracy while maintaining composure under pressure.

**Team Leadership & SME Responsibilities**

* Act as the Travel Approval SME for the team and provide guidance on complex travel-related queries and policy interpretations.
* Support and coach team members on travel approval processes, decision-making, and quality standards.
* Handle escalations, complex travel scenarios, and priority requests with confidence and professionalism.
* Drive consistency, quality, and compliance across all travel approval activities.
* Ensure all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process documentation, and knowledge repositories are maintained and kept up to date.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Respond promptly to multiple stakeholder queries, travel-related requests, and PNR (Passenger Name Record) inquiries.
* Build effective relationships with bankers, travel coordinators, and internal stakeholders through professional and timely communication.
* Ensure clear, concise, and accurate written communication while resolving travel-related concerns.

**General Responsibilities**

* Support Concur Expense submission reviews and related queries.
* Review and process invoices while ensuring compliance with established controls.
* Support new vendor maintenance and enrolment activities.
* Ensure high levels of accuracy and compliance across all operational processes.
* Maintain operational documentation, process updates, and knowledge articles.
* Monitor workload and prioritize tasks effectively to meet turnaround times and service level agreements.
* Work collaboratively across functions and support team members as business requirements evolve.
* Demonstrate flexibility in supporting different business groups and bankers as organizational needs change.
* Carry, use, and respond to Firm-issued mobile device emails and voicemails as required.
* Contribute to continuous process improvement initiatives and operational excellence.
* Make good use of Artificial intelligence in order to make processes efficient.

**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

title: Senior Engineer, Production
description:
Lead Production Operations and Drive Continuous Improvement as Senior Production Engineer
  
  
Are you ready to take the next step in your manufacturing career? Join a role where you will lead daily production operations, guide a team of more than 15 employees, and play a key part in delivering productivity, quality, safety, and continuous improvement results. You will work closely with planning, quality, and other cross-functional teams to solve operational challenges, optimize performance, and ensure production targets are achieved. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact through strong people leadership, problem-solving, and process improvement initiatives.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and monitor daily production line operations, ensuring compliance with plant policies, procedures, and production targets.
* Supervise a production team of more than 15 employees, including work allocation, shift planning, rotations, overtime coordination, and absence coverage.
* Drive productivity improvements through Kaizen activities, multiskilling initiatives, and continuous improvement projects.
* Monitor production performance, prepare MIS reports, track costs, and identify opportunities for cost savings.
* Record and report daily production activities in ERP/M3 and maintain accurate production documentation.
* Partner with Planning, Quality, and other cross-functional teams to resolve day-to-day operational challenges.
* Ensure products meet quality requirements, investigate quality concerns, prepare quality reports, and lead root cause analysis activities.
* Maintain a safe, clean, and disciplined shop floor by implementing Health & Safety standards, HIRA activities, risk observations, and work permit processes.
* Support implementation of operational excellence initiatives, including 5S, Kanban (2-bin system), and assembly shop Kaizens.
* Develop team capability through training plans, skills development activities, and participation in new product development and shop improvement projects.

Expectations from you
  
  

* You have 4-5 years of relevant production or manufacturing experience.
* You have experience supervising production operations and leading shop floor teams.
* You have experience with production reporting, MIS preparation, and ERP/M3 transactions.
* You have knowledge of productivity improvement methodologies such as Kaizen, 5S, and Kanban.
* You have experience managing quality issues, conducting root cause analysis, and implementing corrective actions.
* You have strong understanding of workplace safety practices, HIRA activities, risk observation processes, and work permit systems.
* You have experience coordinating with cross-functional teams such as Planning and Quality.
* You have experience training and developing workmen to enhance skills and performance.
* You can effectively manage machinery breakdowns, production challenges, and operational issues.
* You have experience working in a unionized environment.

To succeed in this role
  
  
Success in this role requires hands-on production leadership, the ability to drive productivity and continuous improvement, and strong experience in managing quality, safety, and people performance on the shop floor. You will need to excel at coordinating cross-functional activities, solving operational challenges quickly, and creating a disciplined, high-performing production environment while consistently achieving production targets.
  
  
We Also Expect You To Align With Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical Behaviors That Guide How We Lead, Collaborate, And Succeed Together
  
  

* Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through
* Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly
* Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety
* Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value

We offer
  
  
You will join a production environment focused on delivering safe, high-quality, and efficient manufacturing operations. The team is responsible for achieving production targets, driving productivity improvements, maintaining quality standards, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives across the shop floor. Working closely with Planning, Quality, and other functions, the team plays a critical role in resolving operational challenges and improving overall plant performance. You will have the opportunity to lead a sizeable team, contribute to employee development, and participate in new development and shop improvement activities. The role offers meaningful exposure to production excellence, problem-solving, and operational leadership.
  
  
Valmet offers an inspiring and challenging position, providing an excellent opportunity to contribute to our success. Our team-oriented and international work environment fosters innovation and continuous learning. We value our employees and provide opportunities for professional development, modern work tools, and ongoing growth.
  
  
When everything works together
  
  
*Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers; we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.*

title: Production Manager
description:
Job Description – Production Manager

Company: Manish Prints

Department: Production & Operations

Position: Production Manager

Experience: 4-7 years (preferably in the printing and packaging industry)

Qualification: Graduate in Management, Packaging Technology, Printing Technology, or a related discipline.

**About Manish Prints**

**Manish Prints** is a printing and packaging manufacturing company specialising in the production of high-quality mono cartons, duplex boxes, and corrugated packaging solutions.

We cater to businesses across diverse industries, including confectionery, sweets, food products, retail, and consumer goods. Our focus is on delivering customised packaging solutions that combine functional efficiency, structural strength, print quality, and visual appeal.

At Manish Prints, we believe that effective packaging goes beyond aesthetics. It involves understanding our clients' requirements, optimising material usage, maintaining consistent quality, and ensuring efficient production and timely delivery.

We are looking for an experienced and proactive **Production Manager** to oversee our end-to-end manufacturing operations and establish efficient, quality-driven production processes.

Role Overview

The Production Manager will be responsible for managing and coordinating the entire production lifecycle of mono cartons and corrugated boxes, from procurement of raw materials to manufacturing, quality inspection, finishing, packing, and final dispatch.

The candidate will ensure that all production activities are carried out efficiently, cost-effectively, and in accordance with established quality standards and delivery schedules.

Key Responsibilities

1. End-to-End Production Management

* Oversee the complete production process for mono cartons and corrugated boxes.
* Coordinate all stages of manufacturing, including printing, lamination, UV coating, die-cutting, punching, creasing, pasting, stitching, and finishing, wherever applicable.
* Plan and allocate production schedules based on order requirements and delivery commitments.
* Monitor production progress and ensure optimum utilisation of manpower, machinery, and resources.
* Identify production bottlenecks and implement corrective measures to improve efficiency.

2. Quality Control & Assurance

* Establish and implement quality checkpoints at every stage of the production process.
* Ensure incoming raw materials meet the required specifications and quality standards.
* Inspect printing quality, colour consistency, lamination, die-cutting accuracy, pasting, dimensions, and structural strength.
* Conduct in-process inspections to identify and minimise defects, rejections, and material wastage.
* Ensure finished products meet approved samples, specifications, and customer requirements.
* Maintain quality inspection records and implement corrective and preventive actions.

3. Procurement & Inventory Management

* Coordinate with vendors and suppliers for timely sourcing of paperboard, duplex board, corrugated sheets, inks, adhesives, laminates, and other production materials.
* Ensure raw materials are procured in accordance with production schedules and order requirements.
* Monitor inventory levels and maintain adequate stock of essential materials.
* Negotiate with suppliers to achieve competitive pricing without compromising on quality.
* Develop and maintain strong vendor relationships.
* Avoid production delays arising from material shortages or procurement inefficiencies.

4. Dispatch & Delivery Management

* Coordinate with the production, packaging, and logistics teams to ensure timely completion and dispatch of orders.
* Monitor order status and ensure adherence to committed delivery timelines.
* Plan dispatch schedules and coordinate transportation arrangements.
* Ensure finished goods are properly inspected, packed, labelled, and dispatched.
* Maintain communication with the sales and customer-facing teams regarding production progress and delivery status.

5. Process Improvement & Cost Optimisation

* Identify opportunities to reduce production costs, material wastage, and operational inefficiencies.
* Standardise production processes and introduce systematic quality-control procedures.
* Maintain production records, job cards, material consumption reports, and daily production reports.
* Monitor production efficiency, rejection rates, material utilisation, and turnaround time.
* Recommend improvements in manufacturing methods, workflow, and resource allocation.

6. Team & Vendor Coordination

* Supervise production workers and coordinate with machine operators, supervisors, vendors, and external job-work units.
* Ensure clear communication of job specifications, production priorities, and quality requirements.
* Monitor workforce productivity and ensure accountability at every stage.
* Coordinate effectively with management, procurement, sales, and dispatch teams.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong understanding of printing, packaging, and carton manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of mono carton and corrugated box production.
* Understanding of paperboard grades, GSM, BF, bursting strength, flute types, and other packaging specifications.
* Strong quality-control and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent production planning, procurement, and inventory management skills.
* Ability to coordinate multiple production activities simultaneously.
* Strong vendor negotiation and team management skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate will be evaluated on:

* Adherence to production schedules and delivery commitments.
* Quality consistency and reduction in rejection rates.
* Reduction in material wastage and production costs.
* Timely procurement and availability of raw materials.
* Efficient utilisation of manpower and machinery.
* Accuracy of production planning and inventory management.
* Customer satisfaction and reduction in quality-related complaints.

**Ideal Candidate:** We are looking for a hands-on, detail-oriented professional who can take complete ownership of production operations, ensure stringent quality control at every stage, and build a systematic and efficient manufacturing environment at Manish Prints.

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Expert Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview:**
The Service Delivery Manager is a senior operations position providing leadership for rotational team and collaborate with duty managers supporting 100+ clients on a rotating shift pattern, responsible for the efficient and professional execution of activities associated with providing an exceptional level of hospitality for clients' mission-critical systems. The Service Delivery Manager also serves as the accountable owner of Change Management governance for the entire business unit under the Altera Cloud Operations Change Management Process (v2.1) — chairing the Technical Review Board (TRB), overseeing implementation and validation, and holding final closure authority across all towers and shifts.
  
  
Change Implementation, Validation & Closure
  
  

* Facilitate TRB meeting for change reviews across cloud BU.
* Staff and lead the Hosting Response Bridge (HRB), providing 24x7 monitoring across the post-change stability window; trigger swarms the moment an anomaly is detected.
* Enforce alert-suppression discipline and confirm pre-change baseline capture and post-change comparison before closure.
* Oversee validation against Validation Test Library pass/fail criteria and evidence — including mandatory application and technical validation for production changes.
* Hold final closure authority: confirm the 24-hour or TRB approved closure window with HRB observation if the change was clean and evidence is complete before authorizing closure; refuse closure otherwise.
* Invoke rollback directly against a pre-agreed trigger without further approval; escalate exceptions to the Tower Leader.
* Carry open items into shift handover with clear owners so closure is never missed across a shift boundary.

Operational Leadership & Incident Management
  
  

* Major incident / critical issue early detection and fast remediation for all matters during their shift.
* Ensure all client requests, incidents, and problems are addressed in a timely and professional manner.
* Run stand-up calls with their team, managing proper hand-over of activities and client status between shifts and teams.
* Allocate resources as necessary across teams to provide efficient, effective resolution of issues.
* Identify and implement operational process improvements across teams.
* Assist Shift Site Reliability Engineers with client communication and escalations.
* Drive results through agreed KPIs for alerts, monitoring tools, and case/ServiceNow (SNOW) metrics.

TRB Ownership & Change Process Governance
  
  

* Chair the Technical Review Board: the final gate reviewing risk classification, architectural impact, rollback adequacy, and monitoring plan for every change; approve, send back for rework, or escalate.
* Pre-agree and record rollback triggers at TRB, each with a maximum time-to-decide.
* Own and continuously improve the end-to-end process, intake template, and Validation Test Library across all towers.
* Track and report TRB gate-hold and rework rates monthly; a near-zero rework rate signals the board is a formality, not a control.

People Management
  
  

* Provide detailed and accurate job performance feedback for each resource working under their guidance.
* Supervise employee attendance and participation.
* Inspire and motivate employees on their rotating shift.

Reporting Relationships
  
  
The Service Delivery Manager has primary responsibility for the rating and review of each employee dedicated to rotating with them, with input from the Tower Manager. The Tower Manager is accountable for best practices, effective training/testing, and the overall architecture and direction of their service delivery tower, and provides functional direction and input into employee ratings. Employees have a hard-line reporting relationship into their Tower Manager, with a dotted line to the Service Delivery Manager.
  
  
Metrics Ownership
  
  

* Report monthly: peer-review SLA breaches, TRB gate-hold/rework rates, closure refusals, change success and change-caused incident rates (24-hr/7-day), rollback invocation/success rate, and process exceptions by tower, alongside case/SNOW and alerting KPIs.
* Success rate for changes driven thought TRB , all changes should be successful.
* Bi-weekly reporting of change management team control deck.

title: Regional Manager -Strategy & Operations
description:
**About the Company**

Founded in 2015, Rapido is India’s leading multi-modal mobility platform. What began with bike taxis has rapidly evolved to include auto-rickshaws, cab-hailing, and peer-to-peer deliveries. Today, Rapido commands a dominant 70% market share in bike taxis, 40% in auto rides, and holds the second-largest position in the cab segment with a 22% share—establishing us as the overall market leader in ride-hailing. With over 4 million rides completed daily and more than 2 billion rides served to date, Rapido operates in 200+ cities and is aggressively expanding toward a presence in 500 cities. In 2024, we proudly achieved unicorn status with a valuation of $1.1 billion. Driven by technology and innovation, we’re expanding into new categories while remaining committed to improving last-mile connectivity and empowering livelihoods at scale. We are not an option; we are a choice!

**About the Role**

As a Regional Manager you are responsible for growing and maintaining reliable service delivery of your cities. You are the micro-CEO for your markets and are involved in building both the supply as well as the demand sides of the market with a strong focus on ensuring order fulfillment and a good experience for both the customer and the riders. You should be excited to identify key marketplace problems and collaborate effectively with supply, product, marketing and other supporting functions to drive growth in your cities. You are expected to have a balance between tactics and long-term sustainable initiatives and have good leadership skills so as to keep your team motivated, guide them along and deliver results.

**Responsibilities**

* Owning and delivering the aggressive revenue [P&L] and ride [Growth] targets
* Develop in-depth product and market understanding to identify the right target segments.
* Assess business requirements and recommend product improvements to help increase market penetration.
* Build, nurture and grow a vibrant team - provide guidance and mentorship to develop your team members into future leaders.
* Improvise customer pricing, discounting strategy, partner incentivization using sound analytical ideas and smart market [competitor] assessment.
* Conduct periodic review of the team performance, metrics and trends to identify and implement appropriate interventions in line with Rapido values, processes and business practices.

**Collaboration**

* Work closely with the technical and product team to solve bugs or introduce new features which could improve a seamless driver partner experience.
* Work closely with the central Operations team to solve for geographical or product level changes in the product/processes to improve customer experience.

**Qualifications**

* 4 - 8 years overall experience
* MBA (Tier-1) with 2-3 years of Operations / relevant experience preferred.

**Required Skills**

* Excellent project and people management skills
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Analytical bent of mind and data backed decision making skills.
* Ability to work under pressure with limited resources and tight timelines.
* Passionate, result-oriented with strong bias for action

* Collaborate with other departments to resolve technical issues and enhance service delivery

* Develop and maintain documentation, FAQs, and knowledge base articles
* Analyze support trends, generate reports, and provide recommendations to senior management

* Implement customer feedback to refine support processes and enhance user experience.

* Adhere to JCI product security standards and guidelines for secured software product development

description:

**Production Support Lead Analyst**
is the
**operational leader and primary accountability owner for platform stability**
across one or more FNZ platforms. This role provides day‑to‑day leadership for the Production Support team, ensures consistent operational standards, and leads incident response and stability improvements.
  
  
This is a
**player‑coach role**
: the Lead Analyst is expected to provide strong people leadership and operational governance, while remaining hands‑on during major incidents, complex investigations, and critical decision points.
  
  
The role works closely with Analysts, Senior Analysts, Developers, and global operational teams to ensure high‑quality service outcomes, effective incident management, and continuous improvement of platform reliability.

* Develop, maintain, and ensure adherence to comprehensive documentation on team activities.
