**Position Summary**
Ingersoll Rand India Ltd. is seeking an experienced and results-driven
**Project Manager - Strategic Initiatives, Facilities & Maintenance**
to lead strategic infrastructure projects while ensuring reliable operation and maintenance of plant facilities, utilities, and support infrastructure.
  
  
The role will be responsible for planning, executing, and sustaining facility expansion projects, manufacturing footprint initiatives, utility systems, building infrastructure, and maintenance excellence programs. The incumbent will manage the complete project lifecycle from concept to commissioning while ensuring world-class facility reliability, safety compliance, and cost-effective maintenance practices.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess 12-15 years of experience in industrial manufacturing environments with significant exposure to EPC project execution, facility management, utility systems, asset management, statutory compliance, and maintenance leadership.
  
  
This role requires a strong leader capable of delivering projects on Quality, Cost, and Delivery (QCD) metrics while maintaining a safe, compliant, and highly reliable manufacturing infrastructure.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent.
* Master's Degree / MBA preferred.
* PMP, Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP), Lean Six Sigma certification preferred.

**Experience**

* 10-15 years of experience in:

+ Facility Engineering
+ Plant Engineering
+ Industrial Infrastructure Projects
+ Maintenance Management
+ Utilities Management
+ Capital Projects

**Strategic Projects & Facility Expansion**

* Lead factory footprint optimization and infrastructure development projects.
* Drive facility expansion, brownfield development, capacity enhancement, and operational improvement projects.
* Manage complete EPC project lifecycle, including:

+ Feasibility studies
+ Concept design
+ Engineering reviews
+ Procurement
+ Construction management
+ Commissioning and handover

* Develop project schedules, budgets, risk mitigation plans, and execution strategies.

**Facilities Management**
**Building Infrastructure**

* Warehouses

* Security systems

**Utilities Management**

* Electrical distribution systems
* DG sets
* Air compressors
* HVAC systems
* Chillers and cooling systems
* Water supply systems
* STP/ETP facilities
* Fire protection systems
* Industrial gases and utility networks

Drive energy management initiatives focused on cost reduction and sustainability.
  
  
**Maintenance Excellence**

* Develop and implement world-class maintenance programs.
* Drive preventive, predictive, and reliability-centered maintenance strategies.
* Improve asset availability and equipment reliability.
* Establish maintenance KPIs and governance mechanisms.
* Lead maintenance planning and shutdown management activities.
* Drive MTBF and MTTR improvements.
* Optimize maintenance costs while improving operational effectiveness.

**Reliability & Asset Management**

* Develop long-term asset management strategies.
* Implement condition-based monitoring and predictive maintenance tools.
* Utilize digital systems for maintenance planning and asset tracking.
* Drive lifecycle cost optimization of critical assets.
* Lead criticality assessment and reliability improvement projects.

**Safety & Compliance Leadership**

* Champion a Zero Harm safety culture.
* Ensure compliance with all statutory requirements related to facilities, utilities, and maintenance operations.
* Conduct periodic safety audits and risk assessments.
* Drive contractor safety management programs.

**Regulatory & Statutory Compliance**
Responsible for obtaining and maintaining all statutory approvals and ensuring facility compliance.

title: Control & Instrumentation Lead (O&M- PSP Hydro)
description:
Control & Instrumentation lead is responsible for overseeing the SCADA, automation and instrumentation operation and maintenance works for Hydro and PSP Assets. This role is pivotal in ensuring optimal power generation, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement within the Hydro and pump storage plant. The position aligns with Adani Group’s mission to drive sustainable energy solutions and supports PSP Hydro’s strategic focus on operational excellence, risk management, and stakeholder collaboration.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Ensure reliable, safe and efficient operation of all generating units, auxiliaries, and balance of plant systems.
* Ensures full compliance with Statutory HSS, environmental, cybersecurity and technical requirements from central and state governmental bodies (i.e. CEA, CERC, DSA, SCEI, AP/CPCB etc. compliances).
* Support and Guide site teams for Operation & Maintenance of OT and IT systems for Plant SCADA and control system.
* High level understanding of SCADA and Control System factory and site acceptance testing (FAT and SAT) and its associated documentation.
* Implement external interfaces to the plant i.e. RCI, EMI, AGC, interface to SLDC / RLDC over PLCC and Forte etc. Co-ordination for implementation of Remote-Control Interface (RCI) at Plant with central team.
* Ensure O&M for C&I systems at Hydro and PSP Assets are aligned and carried out in line with prevailing O&M practices in the organization.
* Implement analytical tools, procedures, protocols etc. for ensuring efficient and effective monitoring, cost and performance optimization of C&I systems/works at Hydro and PSP Assets.
* Supports site teams in handling all operational emergencies/trouble shootings pertaining to C&I area, for sustainable production. Monitoring critical parameters and render technical help to resolve the anomalies. Analyze the performance and bring operational improvement.
* Support and guide site teams to manage inventory of instruments, Plant OT, IT system and maintain all licenses.
* Develop and coordinate with site teams for implementation of maintenance procedures for Plant SCADA/control system equipment.
* Guide and train site engineers on maintenance and troubleshooting of plant SCADA / control system equipment.
* Assist Lead C&I in equipment failure investigations and analysis for C&I part, establish RCA framework and implement performance monitoring, corrective actions and continuous improvement methodology.
* Preparation of service contract and contract management for C&I maintenance for works outsourced to external service providers.
* Assist Lead C&I in preparing and managing C&I maintenance budget, work to optimize the costs and maximize production.
* Assist Lead C&I in establishing Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) at plant level, for C&I systems.
* Assist lead C&I in driving plant improvement projects, modernization initiatives, digital transformation, and automation upgrades.
* IMS implementation, documentation preparation and updating, pertaining to your area.
* Ensures adherence to Cybersecurity requirements and compliance for Plant process control system. Support IT team in documentation and implementation of ISMS 27001 at Hydro and PSP Assets.
* Perform any other duties as may be assigned by Lead C&I, from time to time.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* B.E/B.Tech in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics/Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering.
* 13+ years of experience C&I within hydro power generation sector.
* Strong knowledge of statutory and regulatory requirements pertaining to C&I and Cybersecurity for Hydro/PSP Plants.
* Knowledge of IEC 104, IEC 101, IEC 61850, Modbus, OPC, and similar control system network protocols.
* Experience in IMS implementation for operational Plant. Including ISMS 27001.
* Experience with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) for Plant maintenance works.
* Proven experience with C&I system, including specification, design, assessment, verification, testing, installation, commissioning, and maintenance of Hydro/PSP Plant SCADA and Control system.
* Knowledge of analytics tools for performance optimization and risk assessment.

title: Associate Manager – GBS, Intelligent Automation COE
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title:**
Assistant Manager ACOE
  
  
**Reporting Line**
ACOE Head
  
  
**Role Purpose Statement**
The Assistant Manager ACOE will be responsible for development, implementation, and management of automation initiatives. He/She will work alongside the GBS & Non GBS Operations, GPOs, and Service Delivery Leads to identify these points of improvement and will work alongside the ACOE Lead to establish the initiative's case for change, outlining key inputs to creating a value case, method for value realization, and metrics that will indicate the success of the initiative. In addition, he/she will work alongside the Demand Generation and Process & Task Mining team to determine opportunities to leverage automation/enabling technologies to better streamline GBS processes and more effectively delivery customer service excellence.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
Enabling the RPA solution to be developed and deployed: He/She is responsible to oversee the initial infrastructure setup for the dev, test and production environments. He/She will also explores the server and other RPA deployment options. He/She will be responsible for getting everyone on the CoE including the stakeholders to agree on the best practices to be followed. he/she makes sure that proper coding standards and guidelines are laid out. Collaborating with the Business Analyst on feasibility and optimization is undertaken. As part of the preparation he/she is also responsible to estimate the time and cost and plans on the technical meetings to be conducted during the process. He/She is responsible for identifying reusable components that can save duplicate effort and also defining how to manage configurable parameters, queues and schedules of Robots to optimize the cost and runtime. A document describing outstanding challenges is also created to log any challenges that may or may not be taken care of during the implementation. He/She will oversee the development effort being carried out to develop the component workflows and is responsible to document extra requirements after the PDD has been signed-off, he / she will mentor the developers through constant monitoring and helps in troubleshooting and debugging of the issues. He/She is the source control owner and makes sure the logging and reporting happens as per the requirements laid down. He/ She will be responsible for a timely and diligent code review and audit to ensures there are fewer bugs and the solution is compliant and robust. As part of the Monitoring and Control the solution developed and deployed is monitored and any changes needed are documented in addition to the support provided to fix any unknown issues popping out of the production environment

* Significant process automation experience driving large, complex RPA automations to successful completion in a global environment.

* Experience designing processes and evaluating and quantifying efficiency levers.

* RPA Architecture Setup Knowledge

* Team Management
* Cross team planning capability and coordination
* Problem solving capability with ability to unite different teams towards a goal

title: Electrical Lead (O&M- PSP Hydro)

The Electrical Maintenance Lead is responsible for overseeing the electrical maintenance work of the PSP Hydro facility in Chitravati, Andhra Pradesh. This role is pivotal in ensuring optimal power generation, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement within the pump storage plant. The position aligns with Adani Group’s mission to drive sustainable energy solutions and supports PSP Hydro’s strategic focus on operational excellence, risk management, and stakeholder collaboration.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Ensure reliable, safe and efficient operation of all generating units, auxiliaries, and balance of plant systems.
* Ensures full compliance with Statutory HSS, environmental and technical requirements from central and state governmental bodies (i.e. CEA, CERC, DSA, SCEI, AP/CPCB etc. compliances).
* Contribute to developing safe systems of work (SSOW) procedures, including HIRA, PTW, LOTO, JSA etc. for your area.
* To provide oversight of all electrical maintenance activities, management of the maintenance teams, financial control, contract management, environmental compliance, regulatory compliance, technical compliance, risk evaluations and relationship management.
* Prepare maintenance strategy to achieve higher reliability (maximized MTTF) and greater efficiency (minimized MTTR) and implement the maintenance plans at plant level accordingly.
* Lead equipment failure investigations and analysis, establish RCA framework and implement performance monitoring, corrective actions and continuous improvement methodology, for your area.
* Maintain plant machinery to ensure it’s at acceptable standards, aiming at zero breakdown.
* Preparation of service contract and contract management for electrical maintenance works outsourced to external service providers.
* Preparation and implementation of complete plant maintenance reports and checklists, including daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual reports and checklists.
* Prepare and manage plant maintenance budget, work to optimize the costs and maximize production. This includes developing and tracking the monthly, quarterly, and annual maintenance budgets.
* Define and monitor maintenance plans to achieve yearly Generation targets (including minimization of APC consumption) and yearly agreed Plant/Machines Availability targets.
* Delegates and assigns work tasks to electrical maintenance team to maintain optimum plant performance.
* Support O&M head in plant improvement projects, modernization initiatives, digital transformation, and automation upgrades.
* Maintains plant critical spares inventory of your area, to meet the exigencies.
* Lead, train and develop electrical maintenance team at Plant and prepare a detailed training calendar for electrical maintenance team accordingly.
* Develop and execute risk management strategies to mitigate maintenance related risks and ensure compliance with internal audits.
* Prepares and maintains plant electrical maintenance records and presents the same to management on need basis.
* Inspects and monitors production equipment to ensure operational healthiness, maintain a cost-effective production process, by utilizing optimum resources to achieve generation targets.
* IMS implementation, documentation preparation and updating, pertaining to your area.
* Ensures Cybersecurity requirements and compliance for Plant process control system

**Qualification & Experience**

* B.E/B.Tech in Electrical Engineering
* 15+ years of experience in electrical maintenance within hydro power generation sector.
* Strong knowledge of Statutory and regulatory requirements pertaining to Hydro/PSP Plants.
* Must have electrical maintenance experience of large-scale hydropower/ pump storage power plants.
* Managed Team of Engineers and technicians, working as section head for hydro / PSP plant equipment maintenance works for at least 10 years.
* Experience with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) for Plant maintenance works.
* Knowledge of analytics tools for performance optimization and risk assessment
* Advanced certifications in maintenance management or other power generation technologies or energy manager and auditor certification are preferred.

**Job Description**
  
Job Summary
  
  
The Program Planning & Controls Lead is responsible for developing, maintaining, and controlling the integrated programme baseline across Solar, Wind, and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) workstreams. The role ensures the delivery of accurate, defensible schedules, performance measurement frameworks, forecasting methodologies, and progress reporting to support effective programme governance and client decision-making.
  
  
The position provides leadership in planning, schedule assurance, risk-based forecasting, and programme controls while coordinating with package planning teams and project stakeholders to maintain schedule integrity and transparency.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Programme Planning & Schedule Management
  

* Develop and maintain integrated Level 1 and Level 2 programme schedules linked to package-level Level 3 and Level 4 control schedules.
* Establish and maintain programme schedule baselines, control processes, and governance frameworks.
* Review and validate package planning submissions to ensure alignment with programme objectives and milestones.
* Monitor schedule performance, critical path activities, float consumption, and forecast completion dates.
* Lead schedule integration activities across Solar, Wind, and BESS workstreams.
  

Programme Controls & Performance Management
  

* Define and implement progress measurement methodologies, weightages, and reporting protocols.
* Establish data cut-off procedures and schedule change control processes.
* Validate progress updates and ensure consistency across all work packages.
* Reconcile planning information with procurement, engineering, construction, testing, commissioning, and HOTO (Hand Over Take Over) activities.
* Produce programme-level forecasts and performance insights for internal and client stakeholders.
  

Risk, Analysis & Recovery Planning
  

* Lead schedule risk assessments and milestone risk forecasting.
* Perform critical path analysis, trend assessments, and scenario modelling.
* Develop and evaluate recovery and mitigation plans for schedule deviations.
* Identify programme risks and planning exceptions requiring management intervention or escalation.
  

Stakeholder & Client Management
  

* Support the Program Director in programme governance and reporting activities.
* Coordinate with package planning teams, project controls functions, and programme leadership.
* Present schedule analyses, forecasts, and recommendations to client and senior management teams.
* Ensure timely communication of planning issues, opportunities, and corrective actions.
  

Deliverables
  

* Integrated programme baseline schedules.
* Periodic programme update and performance reports.
* Critical path analysis and schedule recovery assessments.
* Forecast and risk assessment reports.
* Executive schedule dashboards and management presentations.
* Monthly progress certificate support documentation.
  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
* Professional certifications such as PMP, PSP, AACE, or equivalent are desirable.
  

Experience
  

* **15+ years of experience**
  in project controls, programme planning, or schedule management.
* Significant experience on large-scale infrastructure, energy, or renewable energy programmes.
* Proven experience managing integrated schedules across multiple work packages and stakeholders.
  

**Additional Information**

* Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 and enterprise scheduling systems.
* Strong understanding of programme controls, schedule risk analysis, forecasting, and earned value principles.
* Experience in dashboarding and reporting tools such as Power BI or equivalent.
* Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.

title: DGM - APS & Lean Management
description:
Purpose of the Role
  
  
Managing and leading a cross-functional team of engineers and production specialists to design, deploy, and sustain a world-class Production System (PS) grounded in Lean Manufacturing principles. The role is pivotal in driving cultural and operational transformation across the cell manufacturing plant by embedding lean tools, methodologies, and a continuous improvement mindset at every level of the organisation. The DGM will be responsible for developing and implementing the Agratas Production System (APS) framework, standardising work processes, eliminating waste, and enabling measurable improvements in people, safety, quality, delivery, cost, maintenance, energy and environment (PPSQDCMEE). The role requires close collaboration with production, maintenance, quality, supply chain, and HR functions, as well as engagement with external partners and benchmarking organisations.
  
  
Key Responsibility Areas
  
  
Technical / Functional
  
  

* Agratas Production System (APS) Development & Deployment: Design, develop, and implement a comprehensive Production System framework aligned with Lean principles (LEAN MANUFACTURING -PS-derived), covering all manufacturing areas of the cell plant.
* Lean Transformation Leadership: Lead end-to-end lean transformation initiatives across all shop floors, including Electrode, Assembly, Formation, and End-of-Line, ensuring sustained change management and cultural adoption.
* Value Stream Mapping (VSM): Conduct detailed current-state and future-state VSM exercises to identify waste, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities across the manufacturing value chain.
* Standardised Work & Work Instruction Management: Establish, maintain, and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), standardised work documents, and operator work instructions.
* Kaizen & Continuous Improvement Programme: Plan, facilitate, and drive structured Kaizen events, improvement workshops, and CI projects targeting PSQDCME metrics. Track and report savings and impact.
* 5S & Visual Management: Design and sustain 5S systems, visual factory standards, shadow boards, andon systems, and production control boards across all production areas.
* Line Balancing & Flow Optimisation: Lead cycle time studies, takt time analysis, line balancing exercises, and layout optimisation to enhance throughput and reduce WIP

Knowledge Generic
  
  
IT SkillsExperience with layout design, ergonomics, and material flow optimisation in greenfield or brownfield plants is desirable
  
  
- Proficiency in MS Excel (advanced), PowerPoint, and data analysis tools such as Minitab and project management.
- Familiarity with digital lean tools, plant simulation software, or Industry 4.0 platforms is an advantage.
- Good presentation and facilitation skills for senior stakeholder engagement and shop-floor coaching.


* Strong understanding of the Lean manufacturing - Production System philosophy and its application in high-volume high-speed discrete or process manufacturing.
* Proven experience in leading large-scale lean transformations with measurable business impact.
* Knowledge of statistical process control (SPC), Six Sigma methodologies (Black Belt preferred), and problem-solving tools (A3, 8D, PDCA).
* Understanding of battery cell manufacturing processes (Mixing, Coating, Calendaring, Slitting, Assembly, Formation) is desirable.
* OEE Improvement: Drive Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvement programmes in collaboration with maintenance and production teams; identify and eliminate losses across availability, performance, and quality.
* Pull System & Kanban Implementation: Design and implement pull-based material flow systems, supermarkets, and Kanban replenishment loops across internal logistics and production areas.
* People Development & Lean Capability Building: Develop and deliver lean training programmes for all levels of the organisation, from operator to senior management. Coach and mentor internal lean champions.
* Production System Governance & Lean Maturity Model Adherence: Establish LMM frameworks to assess PS maturity, compliance, and sustainability. Drive corrective action plans based on findings.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, Launch Integration, Supply Chain, and HR to align lean initiatives with overall plant and business objectives.
* Benchmarking & Best Practice: Lead external benchmarking activities across automotive and adjacent industries. Adapt and integrate best practices into the Agratas Production System.
* Project Management: Manage multiple lean and PS projects simultaneously, ensuring on-time delivery, resource allocation, budget adherence, and stakeholder communication.
* KPI Monitoring & Reporting: Define, track, and report on lean KPIs including lead time, cycle time, defect rates, first-pass yield, scrap, OEE, and cost savings to senior leadership.
* Establish metrics: Ability to identify and drive the drill down of organisational metrics to the front-line leadership level
* Ability to integrate concepts such as TPM with the broader Production System and lean transformation

Job Context Specific
  
  
**Mandatory / Desired**

* Engineering degree in Mechanical / Industrial Engineering / Manufacturing Engineering or equivalent.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (minimum); Black Belt preferred.
* Formal Lean / Production System training from an automotive OEM, Tier-1 supplier, or recognised lean institute.

**Mandatory Desired**

* 15 to 20 years of experience in manufacturing operations with at least 8 to 10 years in a dedicated Lean / Production System role.
* Demonstrated track record of implementing Production Systems in high-volume manufacturing industries such as Automotive, Battery / EV, Pharma, Electronics, FMCG, Tyre, or Aerospace.
* Proven experience in building and leading lean teams, coaching frontline supervisors and managers, and driving cultural change.
* Experience working in greenfield manufacturing set-ups or transformative lean journeys from inception is strongly preferred.

title: Operation Lead
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Operations Lead to own our post-sales operations. Once the Sales Team confirms an order, you will take charge of execution: order review, invoice verification, processing, shipping coordination, tracking, and delivery. You will work closely with Sales, Finance, Procurement, Warehouse, Logistics, and Customer Support.

Key Responsibilities

* Oversee the post-sales workflow from order confirmation to final delivery, and resolve bottlenecks before they cause delays
* Review order details, specifications, quantities, pricing, and delivery commitments
* Verify and approve customer and purchase invoices against sales orders, quotations, and agreed pricing, coordinating with Finance and Sales on discrepancies
* Manage shipping and dispatch with couriers, freight forwarders, and logistics vendors; track shipments and resolve delayed, lost, damaged, or returned orders
* Follow up with suppliers and vendors on availability, production timelines, quality, and dispatch schedules
* Act as the primary coordination point between teams for post-sales activities
* Create SOPs for order processing, invoice approvals, shipping, and logistics
* Identify inefficiencies and introduce improvements, using automation and AI-driven tools where applicable
* Lead and develop the operations team, setting targets and building a culture of accountability and accuracy
* Prepare MIS reports and dashboards, track KPIs, and share performance updates with management

Key Performance Indicators

* Invoice verification accuracy and turnaround time
* Order processing turnaround time
* On-time shipment and delivery percentage
* Reduction in order and documentation errors
* Shipping cost optimisation
* Issue resolution time
* Vendor and logistics partner performance
* SOP adherence and team productivity

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a related field
* Experience in operations, order management, logistics, supply chain, or e-commerce operations, including post-sales and order fulfilment
* Good understanding of invoicing, billing verification, shipping documentation, and logistics coordination
* Experience coordinating with multiple internal teams and external vendors
* Strong leadership, team management, and decision-making skills
* Excellent organisational, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, and operational management tools
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

Preferred Experience

* International e-commerce operations, cross-border logistics, and global order fulfilment
* Familiarity with Shopify and other e-commerce management systems
* Experience with international invoices, shipping documentation, and logistics vendors
* Knowledge of workflow automation and AI-powered productivity tools

Job Description: General Manager

Company: SKS Accessories, Coimbatore (pumps and industrial machines manufacturing)

Role Summary

The General Manager leads the entire factory and business, owning production, quality, supply chain, sales delivery, costs, people and compliance. The role is hands-on and combines shop-floor presence with business and customer leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy: Prepare the annual plan, budget and capex, and track company and departmental KPIs.

Production: Deliver output, on-time dispatch and productivity across machining, fabrication, assembly and testing, using lean, 5S and TPM.

Quality: Own the QMS (ISO 9001, BIS/IS standards) and bring down rejections and customer complaints through root cause analysis and CAPA.

Maintenance and Engineering: Ensure preventive maintenance, tooling readiness and design improvements that cut cost and downtime.

Purchase and Stores: Source materials at the right cost and quality, and manage vendors and inventory.

Sales and Customers: Work with sales to convert orders, manage key customers and dealers, and ensure delivery and after-sales support.

Finance: Control product costing, margins, working capital and budgets, and support banks, auditors and GST/TDS compliance.

People: Build a strong second line of leaders, drive hiring, training and appraisals with HR, and maintain healthy industrial relations.

Compliance and Safety: Ensure compliance with the Factories Act, labour laws, PF/ESI, POSH, pollution control and fire safety, and aim for zero accidents.

Systems: Implement ERP, SOPs and internal controls, and give the Management accurate MIS.

Qualifications

B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Production or Industrial Engineering (MBA preferred)

15 to 20+ years in manufacturing, preferably pumps, motors or industrial machinery

7+ years as Plant Head, Works Manager or General Manager with plant or P&L responsibility

Experience managing skilled, semi-skilled and contract workforce

Key Skills

Lean and quality systems, costing and budgeting, Indian labour law, ERP/MIS, leadership and negotiation, and fluency in English and Tamil (Hindi is an advantage).

KPIs

Revenue and profit against budget, on-time delivery, productivity (OEE), rejection and complaint rates, inventory turnover, attrition, and safety and compliance record.

Send your resume with current CTC, expected CTC and notice period to naveengotmail2002@gmail.com or call 9150617406

**Job Summary**

The Supervisor will be responsible for managing a team of AR specialists, ensuring timely and accurate billing, claims processing, payment posting, and denial management.

* Oversee the billing and claims processing functions, ensuring that claims are submitted accurately and timely, and that any issues or errors are promptly addressed and resolved.
* Manage payment posting activities, reconciling payments received with billed charges, and identifying and addressing any discrepancies or variances.

* Foster a positive and collaborative work environment, promoting teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a point of contact for escalated issues and inquiries from internal stakeholders, external partners, and patients related to accounts receivable matters.

* Bachelor's degree in any related field.
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, with a focus on accounts receivable.

* Strong understanding of healthcare payer policies and claims adjudication processes.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively lead and motivate a team.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on driving results and achieving objectives.

This role combines platform architecture, engineering execution, and people leadership, with accountability for secure, reliable, and cost-efficient shared capabilities. title: Supervisor III, Applications Development
description:
**The Opportunity**
Oversees day-to-day operational objectives through the supervision of a team of application development engineers, ensuring efficient software build, release, deployment, and configuration management. Sets objectives that directly impact operational plans, contributing to the implementation of new applications, deployment frameworks, automation processes, and software quality standards. Evaluates and refines work methods, recommending enhancements to improve software implementation effectiveness, deployment efficiency, and system stability. Works on technical challenges that require data analysis, troubleshooting, and strategic consideration of infrastructure dependencies. Communicates regularly with internal teams, including QA, IT, and cloud operations, to align release strategies with organizational priorities. Engages external partners, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure smooth coordination in deployment efforts and software updates.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are converting this position from contract to full-time. Sanjay built the automation layer that now vets every release. We need someone who owns the quality strategy, manages a small team of test engineers, and keeps our AI-driven test infrastructure running as product demands grow.
  
  
You will report to the Senior QA Manager, Development team. You will work with product, platform, and DevOps teams. You decide what "good enough to ship" means for our applications; you build the systems that prove it.
  
  
What You'll Own
  
  
Automation architecture. Design and maintain test frameworks on the Appvance AI Quality Platform. You decide how tests get structured, how data flows through them, and where they plug into our release pipeline.
  
  

* Team management. Directly manage 2–4 test automation engineers. Set their weekly priorities. Review their pull requests. Run 1:1s. Write their annual performance reviews. You decide who takes which feature area. You decide whether their work meets our standards before it merges.
* AI application testing. Build test suites that validate LLM-based features. Test prompt regression. Verify RAG workflows. Detect hallucinations. Validate agent behavior. Use LangChain and LangSmith.
* Scripting and tooling.Write and review Appvance Designer Scripts. Write JavaScript/TypeScript code. Build API test suites for REST and GraphQL. You set the coding standards others follow.
* CI/CD integration.Wire tests into GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and AWS deployments. When a build fails, your tests tell us why within minutes.
* Cross-platform coverage. Ensure web, mobile, desktop, and API layers each have appropriate automated coverage. Cover functional, regression, smoke, integration, end-to-end, security, performance, and database scenarios.
* Quality metrics.Track failure rates, flakiness, coverage gaps, and release-blocking defects. Present these to leadership in plain language.
* Hiring and growth.Interview candidates for automation roles. Write growth plans for your reports. Push them toward harder problems. Do not let them stay comfortable.
* Incident support. Join production release calls. Respond to critical incidents when automation uncovers—or misses—something that hits customers.

What You've Done Before
  
  

* 2–3 years hands-on with the Appvance AI Quality Platform, including Appvance Designer Scripting.
* You write clean JavaScript ES6+ and TypeScript. You read production-grade code and you write it.
* You tested AI-powered applications with LangChain and LangSmith. You validated prompts. You checked response accuracy. You verified RAG pipelines.
* You built or maintained test frameworks for UI, API, database, and cross-browser scenarios.
* You integrated test suites into Git, GitHub, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS, and CI/CD workflows.
* You worked with SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL (MongoDB) data stores.
* You know REST APIs, GraphQL, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, JWT.
* You worked in Agile/Scrum. You know SDLC, STLC, and defect lifecycle.
* You managed or mentored at least one other engineer, even informally.
* Bachelor's or master's in CS, IT, or equivalent.

How You Work
  
  

* You debug like a detective. When a test fails, you do not re-run it and hope. You trace the failure to its source.
* You write code others can read. Your scripts have clear structure. You comment where needed. Your naming stays consistent.
* You communicate across roles. You explain a flaky test to a product manager. You explain a coverage gap to a director.
* You care about shipping speed. You know the difference between a test that catches real bugs and a test that slows releases but adds no value.
* You give direct feedback. Your reports know where they stand because you tell them.

Work Environment
  
  

* Hybrid, following our Coimbatore office policy.
* Primarily computer-based work.
* Availability for production releases and critical incidents as needed.

title: Associate Director, Biostatistics and Programming
description:
Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At
**Worldwide Clinical Trials**
, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.
  
  
With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
**SUMMARY: The Associate Director, Biostatistics and Programming, is a key member of the Biostatistics and Statistical Programming department. The provide daily supervision of Biostatistics and Statistical Programming operations and personnel to ensure the achievement of departmental goals and levels. This role will plan, analyze, and summarize the results of individual clinical studies or groups of studies (integrated summaries)in accordance with Worldwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) or study specific guidelines. They will manage and mentor biostatistics and programming staff, lead department initiatives, report out to senior leadership, participate in business development activities and assist functional leads in the financial plus operational oversight of their projects.**
**Responsibilities**
Tasks may include but are not limited to:
  
  

* Provide oversight on multiple clinical research projects.
* Support Leads in low/moderate/high complexity studies in various phases of development.
* Effectively manage broad-based projects such as NDA submissions or complex, multi-protocol programs, potentially coordinating activities across multiple locations.
* Provide technical expertise, in conjunction with internal and external team members, to design, implement, analyze, report, and validate clinical trials.
* Collaborates with internal and external project team personnel, as needed, to meet project deliverables and timelines and ensure accurate, statistically valid deliverables.
* Ensure adequate staffing of all project teams and help coordinate resources across the Department.
* Represent department and company in a multi-disciplinary setting, including project team meetings, client meetings/presentations, and bid defense meetings.
* Provide statistical and programming advice/recommendations regarding clinical study design/study endpoints, sample size requirements, statistical methodology for the study protocol and clinical study report, programming strategy and document review/approval.
* Oversee all biostatistical and statistical programming activities, including statistical analysis plan development, database specification, reporting specification, statistical programming analysis, and statistical summary/report writing.
* Maintain awareness of project budgets and tasks, and effectively communicate the status of such tasks to Finance and/or senior Leadership. Help staff identify resource or scope of work changes.
* Lead implementation of departmental objectives and strategies, including but not limited to SOP development, training, professional development, standardizations, and team building activities.
* Attend and contribute to continuing education programs, professional meetings, and other career development activities.
* Assist in marketing and business development opportunities as needed.
* Position will have management responsibilities. Development, oversight, and direction of departmental staff which may include interviewing, Managerial Requirements/ terminations, training, personal growth, retention plans, coaching/performance management, goal setting, & salary.

Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive.
  
  
**Other Skills And Abilities**

* Knowledge of clinical trial study design and multiple therapeutic areas.
* Advanced knowledge of SAS and other specialist software.
* Able to work independently and lead various teams and committees.
* Lead study team meetings as needed.
* Capable of conducting exploratory statistical analyses using statistical software packages.
* A high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Excellent presentation skills.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
* Ability to manage priorities and workflow.
* Versatility, flexibility, and a willingness to work within constantly changing priorities.
* Proven ability to handle multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Strong interpersonal skills.
* Global communication and time zone awareness.
* Ability to work effectively with a diversity of individuals at all organizational levels.
* Commitment to excellence and high standards.
* Creative, flexible, and innovative team player.
* Ability to travel for meetings or training activities.
* Ability to travel internationally may be required.
* Develop and guide implementation of departmental objectives and strategies.
* Proven ability to effectively manage and mentor junior staff.
* Ability to effectively engage with executive leadership.
* Experience with financial and budget management.

**Requirements**
Education:
  
  

* Master’s degree, equivalent, or higher in biostatistics or a related field.
* A satisfactory combination of education and experience may be accepted as a substitute for the specific education and experience listed above.

**Experience**

* A minimum of 10+ years of relevant work experience.
* A minimum of 5+ years line management experience.
* Previous experience in a pharmaceutical research or CRO setting required.
* Previous experience in multiple therapeutic areas, including oncology.
* Hands on Experience with CDISC/SDTM/ADaM Programming including but not limited to SAS: Data Step Manipulation, Merge, Sort, Transpose, Reporting (Proc Report), Comparison (Proc Compare), Error Checking (Log resolution), modeling, missing data handling approaches/procedures, figure development.
* Capable of conducting exploratory statistical analyses using statistical software packages.

* Partner with Global Alliance leaders, Service Line leaders, Industry teams and Microsoft stakeholders.

* Help facilitate ideation workshops, solution incubation activities and Frontier Innovation planning sessions.

* Help accelerate the transition from concept to market-ready offering.
* Contribute to the continuous evolution of EY’s Frontier Innovation operating model.

This role provides exposure to emerging technologies, including AI, cloud platforms, automation and next-generation business solutions.
  
  
**Enable Go-To-Market Success**
Developing strong solutions is only part of the journey; enabling market activation, adoption and measurable growth is equally important.
  
  
**You will:**

* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Alliance teams and Solution Owners on activation plans.
* Coordinate development of solution collateral, demos, case studies, enablement content and marketplace assets.
* Support readiness and enablement activities for client-facing and business development teams.
* Track adoption, pipeline contribution, commercialization progress and related performance metrics.
* Contribute to co-sell initiatives and strategic growth programs with Microsoft.

**Deliver Insight Through Governance and Reporting**
**Responsibilities include:**

* Prepare executive reporting, leadership updates and portfolio dashboards.
* Monitor key metrics related to solution maturity, activation, adoption, funding and business impact.
* Support business reviews, governance meetings and leadership decision forums.
* Maintain reporting accuracy, governance discipline and compliance with agreed operating standards.
* Provide insights and recommendations that support prioritization, investment decisions and strategic growth.

We are looking for someone who brings a balance of strategic thinking, execution excellence, and relationship-building capabilities.
  
  

* Thrive in fast-paced, evolving and ambiguous environments.
* Enjoy turning ideas into tangible plans, outputs and measurable outcomes.
* Are comfortable managing multiple priorities, deadlines and stakeholder groups in parallel.
* Can influence outcomes without direct authority.
* Have a passion for innovation, technology, alliances and business transformation.
* Bring strong organizational, communication, governance and program management skills.
* Have a continuous improvement mindset, with a focus on simplifying, automating and scaling ways of working.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 15+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Experience in program management, product management, solution management, consulting, technology transformation, innovation management or alliances.
* Proven experience working across complex, global and matrixed stakeholder environments.
* Strong communication, governance, project management and executive reporting capabilities.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives with clear outcomes, measurable impact and disciplined follow-through.

**What We Look For**

* We are looking for individuals who are curious, collaborative and passionate about innovation. The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys connecting strategy with execution, can navigate ambiguity and is energized by working with diverse teams to create meaningful business outcomes.
* This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to one of EY’s most important alliance ecosystems while helping shape innovative solutions that drive growth, transformation and long-term client value.

* Transformative leadership: Gain insights, coaching and experiences that help you grow into the leader the world needs.

title: School Lunch Services Supervisor - School Food Services Branch (Leeward)
description:
**Description**

All new external applicants will be placed on the initial step of the salary range. However, placement above the initial step of the salary range will be based on special characteristics and critical needs of the position, an applicant's exceptional qualifications, the availability of funds, and other relevant factors. Such appointments require prior approval. Hawaii State Department of Education employees will be placed on the salary range in accordance with Department regulations.
  
  
School Lunch Services Supervisor, SR-24: $6,221.00 - $7,568.00 per month
  
  
**Examples of Duties**

* Visits public schools in an assigned district and supervises cafeteria managers for effective and efficient cafeteria operations.
* Reviews and instructs on school lunch menus for the maintenance of well-balanced lunches.
* Reviews and directs improvements in methods of food preparation and serving, storage, purchasing and other operations.
* Instructs on cleaning methods, hygiene and safe kitchen practices.
* Checks cafeteria records and reports and explains pertinent policies and procedures.
* Inspects public and private schools and institutions for the proper use and storage of federal food commodities.
* Reports on the maintenance of lunch standards by public schools.
* Recommends the transfer and placement of school lunch personnel, and encourages cafeteria managers to obtain further training.
* Reviews cafeteria equipment and supply needs of schools in an assigned district.
* Recommends and effectuates the transfer of cafeteria equipment between schools.
* Participates in the in-service training of cafeteria managers.
* Reviews and acts on reports prepared by cafeteria managers.
* Prepares summary reports of cafeteria operations in an assigned district, and reports on work activities.
* Prepares printed guides and other instructional and informational materials relative to the school lunch program.
* Participates in the review of plans for remodeling and building school cafeterias; and,
* Discusses the school lunch program with school officials, interested groups and individuals.

**Minimum Qualifications**
**Education Requirement**
: Graduation from an accredited college or university with specialization in food service management or nutrition.
  
  
**Substitution of Experience for Education**

**E**
**xperience Requirement**
: Four years of one or a combination of the following: 1) food service management experience. Which involved training and directing personnel, managing the purchase of food and supplies, enforcing sanitary regulations, preparing records and reports, and planning menus; or 2) experience as a teacher or consultant in the field of nutrition or food service management.
  
  
**Substitution of Education for Experience**
: Possession of a Master’s degree in a field specified under the education requirement may be substituted for one year of the experience required.
  
  
**Quality of Ex**
**perience**
: Possession of the required amount of experience will not in itself be accepted as proof of qualification for a position. The applicant’s overall experience must have been of such scope and responsibility as to conclusively demonstrate that applicant has the ability to perform the duties of the position for which applicant is being considered.
  
  
**Driver's License Requirement**
: Applicants must possess a current, valid driver's license.
  
  
**Food Safety Certification Requirement**
: Applicants must possess a valid food handler's training level certification from the Hawaii Department of Health, American National Standards Institute (ANSI) accredited organizations, or equivalent organization as determined by the Department of Education.
  
  
**Supplemental Information**
**Salary:**
The advertised salary is based on full-time employment and includes shortage and school year differentials, if applicable.
  
  
**Requirements:**
Applicants must meet all the requirements for the position they are seeking as of the date of the application, unless otherwise specified. Unless specifically indicated, the required education and experience may not be gained concurrently. Calculation of experience is based on full-time, 40-hour workweeks. Part-time experience is pro-rated. Example: Twelve months of experience at 20 hours/week is equivalent to six months of experience, not one year. Also, hours worked in excess of 40 hours/week will not be credited. Example: Twelve months of experience at 60 hours/week is equivalent to one year of experience, not one and a half years.
  
  
**********Temporary Assignment:**********
Claims of Temporary Assignment (TA) experience to meet the minimum qualification requirements must be verified and attached to the application using one of the options below:
  
  

* A copy of the applicant’s TA History Report or equivalent system-generated report;
* A signed letter from the applicant’s supervisor that includes the applicant’s name, his/her TA job title, the TA start and end dates (from mm/yy to mm/yy), his/her specific TA duties performed, and either the TA hours worked per week or total TA hours worked; or,
* Copies of the applicant’s signed SF-10 Forms.

******Documents:******
Attach all relevant supporting documents to your application. Documents that were attached to applications submitted before November 16, 2023 do not automatically attach or transfer to applications submitted on and after December 16, 2023. All submitted documents become the property of the Hawaii State Department of Education.
  
  
**Information about Temporary Positions:**
Temporary positions may be extended year to year, dependent upon funding and departmental needs. Making yourself available for temporary positions increases your employment possibilities and may lead to permanent opportunities. A person hired for a temporary position may also become a temporary employee upon satisfactory completion of the initial probation period of at least six months. Once a temporary employee, you would be eligible to apply for promotion and transfer opportunities to permanent as well as other temporary positions. You may also enjoy other rights and benefits as afforded to an employee in a permanent position, with the exception of return rights and placement rights associated with a reduction-in-force.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
The Hawaii State Department of Education does not discriminate in its educational policies, programs, and activities on the basis of sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, and disability in accordance with Title IX of the Education Amendments of 1972, Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, Age Discrimination Act of 1975, and Americans with Disabilities Act of 1991. The Department does not discriminate in its employment policies, programs, and activities on the basis of sexual orientation, arrest and court record, and National Guard participation, as well as on the basis of sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, and disability, in accordance with Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Age Discrimination in Employment Act of 1967, Americans with Disabilities Act of 1991, Equal Pay Act of 1963, and Chapter 378, Part I, Hawaii Revised Statutes.
  
  
**Payday**
New employees can expect their first paycheck within the first 3 pay periods of their start date. Payday is on the 5th and 20th (or previous business day) of every month.
  
  
**12-month civil service and SSP employees enjoy a range of competitive benefits:**

* Holidays: You may be eligible for 13 paid holidays each year; 14 holidays during an election year.
* Vacation: Employees of Bargaining Units 1, 2, 3, 4, 9, 10 and 13 earn 21 days per year.
* Sick Leave: Employees of Bargaining Units 1, 2, 3, 4, 9, 10 and 13 earn 21 days per year. Accumulated (unused) credits may be used toward computing retirement benefits.
* Health Insurance: If eligible, the State pays a part of the premiums for each employee's enrollment in a State sponsored Medical, Drug, Vision, and Adult Dental Plan.
* Group Life Insurance: The State provides a free life insurance policy for employees and retirees.

* Flexible Spending Accounts: Eligible employees can reduce their federal and state income taxes and social security taxes through a tax-savings benefit program called Island Flex. This program allows employees to set aside money from their paychecks to pay for out-of-pocket health care expenses and eligible dependent care expenses on a BEFORE-TAX basis.
* Retirement Plan: The State contributes to a retirement plan for eligible employees. Generally, employees with at least 10 years of credited service and who have reached 62 years of age or have 30 years of credited service and are 55 years old may retire and receive benefits.
* Tax Shelter Annuity (TSA): If eligible, Department employees are able to participate in a tax shelter annuity program. The TSA plan allows eligible employees to contribute pre-tax dollars to an employee-selected investment service provider authorized to provide TSA products.

* Temporary Disability Insurance: Qualified employees may be eligible to receive benefits for a disability caused by a non-work related injury or illness under this program.

Some employee unions provide discounts, insurance and other opportunities. Employees may also decide not to join a union, however, employees are required to pay union service fees unless the employee's job is excluded from collective bargaining.

at

title: Senior Finance Analyst(FP&A)
description:
**Job Title**
Senior Finance Analyst, AMEA
  
  
**The Practical Detail**
Location: Bangalore, India
  
  
Working Model: Hybrid
  
  
Contract Type: Full-time
  
  
**Why this role matters**
In your first year, you will deliver clear, accurate financial insights that empower markets across the AMEA region to make smarter business decisions. This role is vital to Flora Food Group’s growth journey, providing the financial clarity and analysis needed to support expanding markets and evolving consumer needs. By translating complex financial data into actionable business insights, you help ensure our products reach kitchens with the right balance of taste, nutrition, and sustainability. Your work enables markets to focus on growth and innovation, strengthening our position as a leader in natural, nutritious food.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Prepare and consolidate daily, weekly, and monthly performance dashboards covering sales, margins, costs, and profit and loss metrics.
* Support market teams with variance analysis against budgets, forecasts, and prior year results to highlight key business drivers.
* Collaborate with finance teams to ensure accurate month- and year-end closing, resolving issues and driving continuous improvement.
* Lead finance projects from concept to implementation, focusing on process standardization and automation to improve efficiency.
* Partner with commercial teams to translate financial analysis into actionable recommendations that improve profitability and support sustainable growth.

**Performance**
You own the accuracy and timeliness of financial reporting and analysis across multiple markets, driving operational excellence and strategic decision-making. Your data-driven insights will directly influence business performance, helping markets meet their financial targets and improve profitability. By standardizing processes and enhancing reporting tools, you enable faster, more reliable financial management across the region.
  
  
**Care**
You will report to the FP&A Manager - AMEA and work closely with a regional finance team and multiple market finance and commercial teams. Your role supports cross-functional collaboration and governance, ensuring financial data integrity and alignment across markets. You contribute to building a sustainable finance function that supports long-term business growth and responsible decision-making.
  
  
**Passion**
As a finance professional passionate about food, you understand how financial insights connect to consumer trends, product innovation, and market dynamics. You bring curiosity and rigor to your work, helping Flora Food Group deliver better food that balances taste, nutrition, functionality, and reliability. Your commitment to excellence supports our mission to create delicious, natural, and sustainable food choices.
  
  
**About You**
You bring strong commercial acumen and a deep understanding of financial analysis, forecasting, and reporting. You have experience working in fast-evolving environments, ideally within consumer goods or retail, and you are comfortable navigating complex data systems like Excel, Power BI, and SAP. You communicate clearly and influence stakeholders by simplifying complex financial information. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional teams and bring a proactive, problem-solving mindset. You balance strategic insight with operational detail and are driven to deliver impactful commercial outcomes.
  
  
You take pride in working for a company with over 150 years of expertise in food, and you understand that excellent work in every function is what allows Flora Food Group to put better food on tables around the world. You bring the same rigour and care to your discipline that our teams bring to every product, because how we work is as important as what we make.
  
  
**Where this could lead to**
This role typically leads to senior finance positions within regional or global FP&A teams, offering opportunities to take on broader strategic responsibilities and lead larger projects. Over time, you could progress to roles such as FP&A Manager or Finance Business Partner, deepening your influence on business performance and growth.
  
  
**What's Next**
If this opportunity sounds exciting, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
Apply before: 10-Nov-2026
  
  
We understand your resume might not be up to date and recommend that you apply with what you have or your LinkedIn Profile. Flora Food Group is dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workplace, we understand that you might not meet all the requirements stated in the description, but we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the right candidate for this role or other roles.
  
  
*Flora Food Group is an employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and equal opportunities for all. We recruit based only on values, qualifications, performance, skills, behaviours, experience, and knowledge. We ensure job advertisements are free from unintentional bias.*
*No personal characteristics should be a barrier to joining Flora Food Group. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or other personal characteristics.*

title: Analyst/Senior Analyst - P&L Reporting
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
The D. E. Shaw group uses a combination of quantitative and qualitative tools to uncover self-governing, hard-to-find sources of return across global public and private markets. We are seeking an analyst/Senior Analyst to join our P&L Reporting team at the firm’s office based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram, India which is responsible for producing firm-wide reports that provide insights and analyses into key performance indicators— including profit and loss (P&L), expenses, capital, returns, and fees— for the offices of the Chief Operating Officer (COO), Chief Financial Officer (CFO), business unit (BU) heads, and portfolio managers. The group handles ad hoc requests related to P&L and capital from portfolio managers and senior stakeholders, facilitating effective decision making through clear reporting, analyses, and recommendations. Another key responsibility is driving technology initiatives—leveraging a combination of proprietary and third-party tools to prepare and present reports, streamline workflows, improve process controls, and enhance user experience.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will take end-to-end ownership of the team’s recurring P&L reporting suite — across daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and year-end cycles — ensuring every report on P&L, expenses, capital, returns & fees is accurate, timely and complete. You will also coordinate with various teams including Front Office, Risk, Pricing, and other teams in FinOp to ensure accuracy of data while managing recurring workflows to sync, reconcile and allocate P&L, expenses and capital. Additionally, you will act as the domain expert and “human in the loop” for automated recurring workflows — running, validating and troubleshooting outputs (including those produced with GenAI) and owning the controls that keep reporting accurate. You will also respond to P&L and capital-related ad-hoc requests from portfolio managers and senior stakeholders. Finally, you will understand changes in the firm’s businesses, like new products and fund launches, and incorporate these changes into the recurring reports independently.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* Finance domain knowledge, robust analytical and problem-solving skills, someone who is a quick learner and can excel while working under tight deadlines
* The ability to be self-motivated, exhibit keen attention to detail, and have a high sense of ownership with an attitude to take initiative in driving process enhancements
* 1 to 3 years of relevant experience in P&L / management reporting, fund accounting, financial planning & analysis (FP&A), or a related finance function
* Working knowledge of how hedge funds operate and their revenue model (fees and expenses), along with core financial concepts — instruments, ratios, accounting terms and statements
* Robust data and analytical skills — advanced MS Excel
* Comfort working alongside automation and GenAI tools — able to run, validate and critically evaluate their output as the domain expert, with a solid controls and process-improvement mindset
* Learning agility and adaptability to evolving workflows, tools, and business changes
* Excellent written and oral communication skills along with deft interpersonal skills are essential for managing interactions with senior stakeholders and ability to collaborate with multiple groups

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* A CA / MBA degree from a reputed college with 1 to 3 years of work experience in the Financial Services industry
* A Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) / Financial Risk Manager (FRM) Qualification
* Exposure to SQL, Python, or BI / analytics tools

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/AnaPnLOct26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers
  
  
Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex, race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

title: SR PRICING ANALYST II - INDIA
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.
  
  
At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
  
  
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.
  
  
**The Role**
As a member of our APAC Commercial Operations team, the Lead Strategic Pricing Analyst (“Lead Analyst”) is responsible for deals pricing, profitability analysis, and the development of financial models and business cases for RFPs and complex deals. The Lead Analyst will evaluate key P&L drivers, including revenue, expenses, gross margin, SG&A, CAPEX, and NETEX, and will assess capital investment constructs using ROI, NPV, payback period, and the time value of money. Working closely with Sales, Finance, Product, Solution Architecture, and other stakeholders, the Lead Analyst will obtain and challenge revenue and cost assumptions, construct pricing from available cost and margin inputs, and prepare concise recommendations and approval briefs for senior leaders.
  
  
The role requires the ability to manage multiple opportunities under pressure and to communicate clearly when pricing targets cannot be achieved. The Lead Analyst is a key member of the Commercial Operations team to mitigate any risks associated with a client, by leveraging similar or better back-to-back terms with vendors and partners. In addition to driving accurate and competitive proposals for potential opportunities, the Lead Analyst will provide insight and work with management to enable success for the region’s deals. The Lead Analyst will review and recommend potential process enhancements to meet the changing needs of the business. Knowledge of contractual and bid support activities is a plus. Candidates who are keen to learn may also take on selected contractual duties as the role expands, including supporting contractual paperwork, SOW reviews, commercial terms, and bid compliance activities
  
  
**The Main Responsibilities**

* Evaluate opportunities and prepare accurate, competitive pricing and financial deliverables for RFPs and complex deals.
* Develop pricing structures based on the relationship between price, margin, revenue, and cost.
* Independently construct business cases and P&L models from scratch for new and existing services.
* Analyze key financial metrics, including revenue, expenses, gross margin, SG&A, CAPEX, and NETEX.
* Assess capital investment constructs and articulate returns using ROI, NPV, payback period, and the time value of money.
* Work with stakeholders to obtain cost levers and challenge both revenue and cost assumptions in business cases.
* Perform scenario, sensitivity, and profitability analysis to support commercial decisions and management approvals.
* Prepare and present concise deal review decks, recommendations, and escalation materials for senior leadership approval.
* Partner with Sales, Finance, Product, Solution Architecture, and other teams to develop commercially viable proposals.
* Clearly communicate when a pricing target cannot be met and provide evidence-based alternatives or trade-offs.
* Manage the Commercial Operations queue, handle multiple ongoing opportunities, and prioritize requests in a fast-paced environment.
* Support pricing for IT solutions, managed services, and security services, where applicable.
* Review and recommend improvements to pricing models, tools, governance, and Commercial Operations processes.
* Where required, support bid compliance activities and the preparation of customer-facing commercial proposal language.
* As an additional duty and area for development, assist with selected contractual activities, such as contractual paperwork, SOW reviews, interpretation of commercial terms, and engagement with Legal on relevant matters.

**Mandatory Skills**
**What We Look For in a Candidate**

* Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, business administration, or a related field; an MBA will be a plus.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in pricing, commercial finance, financial analysis, or business case development, in the IT solutions, Network, managed services, or security industry is must.
* Experience with advance Power BI or other data visualization tools will be a plus
* Demonstrated experience working with P&L statements, financial modelling, pricing, profitability analysis, and capital investment evaluation.
* Fluency in English, in both writing and speech, is required.

**Preferred Skills**

* Strong understanding of P&L and key financial metrics, including revenue, expenses, gross margin, SG&A, CAPEX, and NETEX.
* Ability to evaluate capital investment constructs and articulate ROI, NPV, payback period, and the time value of money.
* Strong understanding of the relationship between price, margin, revenue, and cost, with the ability to construct pricing from available inputs.
* Ability to independently build business cases and P&L models from scratch and challenge revenue and cost assumptions.
* Advanced analytical, financial modelling, scenario analysis, and critical-thinking capabilities.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple ongoing opportunities under pressure in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills, including the ability to manage pricing expectations with Sales, challenge stakeholder assumptions, and prepare concise approval briefs for senior leaders. Attention to detail, strong organizational capabilities, and sound commercial judgment.

title: Assistant Manager Finance
description:
**About The Company**
We, RentoMojo, were founded by IITM alums and serial entrepreneurs who worked out of almost every major city in India
  
  
in his first five years of corporate career. Frustrated with the hassles of relocating from one place to the other, and tired of
  
  
finding that perfect cluster of home essentials that suited their lifestyle.
  
  
"The spending youth, especially the millennials & Gen Z's prefer staying light, desire flexibility and are value conscious.
  
  
Willing to experiment with new stuff across categories that make life simpler and not boring, these generations are also
  
  
sensitive to our planet's sustainability. Our customers and employees identify with what we do '', is what Geetansh
  
  
Bamania, our Founder and CEO has to say.
  
  
RentoMojo caters to the needs of the working professionals which is unmet due to nonavailability of furnished rental flats
  
  
by offering furniture and appliances on rental basis, thus, providing more flexibility than owning the expensive furniture and
  
  
appliances.
  
  
Currently, we have 130,000+ subscribers with a typical rental period of 1214 months. The current market size (as per a
  
  
recent report by Grant Thornton) is estimated to be US$ 4.1 Billion and expected to grow to US$ 13 Billion by 2025.
  
  
With 1000+ people operations, the company has a presence in 16 cities across India. Looking back, Rentomojo has not only
  
  
made a new market of lease which never existed for the consumer, they have also become market leaders in the consumer
  
  
rental industry. Unlike the norm, they are now seeing a reverse trend wherein a version of ours is being copied in the US
  
  
and UK. We are a profitable company and are excited about exponentially growing the profits of the company in months
  
  
and years to come.
  
  
**Five Pillars Of Our Culture**
Zoom InZoom Out :
  
  

* We zoom in and go micro; our focus would be doing better in everything, including things we already do well.
* We zoom

out a lot for creating successful pilots that can potentially scale into a lot of value add in the future, like strengthening our
  
  
offline presence.
  
  
Enterprising Mindset: If you are bold enough, you will have life changing growth opportunities here.
  
  

* We will continue to expand the responsibilities of hungry and willing people. If you are ready to do what you have never done, you will find roles that you have never managed.
* Growing people from within was a significant contributor to the Fortune employers choice award that we won in 2022

and more importantly that's one of the biggest reasons of our success & continued momentum
  
  
Frugality: Measure Twice and Cut once.
  
  

* It is always easy to spend more money to get more done, but it lacks any form of challenge. We have to grow and become

better without a proportionate increase in cost.
  
  

* For every penny that we spend or that we put up to spend, expect a lot of discussions, debates and conversations.

Planning is going to be important, data has to be the foundation, detailing will be a must and world class execution is the
  
  
only way we will move forward in this journey.
  
  
Accountability: Less Why, more How.
  
  

* We will always have more to bite than we can chew, we will always have to make choices and prioritize while we

progress. We can have hundreds of reasons behind why something can not be done, but we have to remain focused on the
  
  
how of things. The focus on how will help us find ways to get done, what needs to get done.
  
  
Think, decide, play and act for the long term.
  
  

* The only time we will make short term decisions is when they help us in the longer term. To me, the long term is all about

consistency and not intensity.
  
  
Recent Media Coverage: YourStory , Dec 2022
  
  
**The Core Team**
Geetansh Bamania - Founder & CEO
  
  
Ketan Krishna - People & Governance Head
  
  
Prabhat Verma - VP of Engineering, Data & Product
  
  
Hakim Ujjainwala - Head of Capital and Resourcing
  
  
Shivendu Ojha - Customer Operations and Sales
  
  
Rohan Kulkarni - Head of Corporate Finance and Strategy
  
  
Aman Jha - Head of Operations & Procurement
  
  
Akash Jangid - Chief of Staff
  
  
Dhruv Wahal - AVP - Growth and Marketing
  
  
**About The Role**
