title: Assistant Manager - Advisory Services
description:
Role: Assistant Manager – Advisory Services

Practice Areas: Transaction Advisory | Risk Advisory | Strategic Business Advisory

Reporting to: Senior Manager – Advisory

Location: Bangalore (100% On-Site)

Experience: 2 – 5 Years (Chartered Accountants with 2–3 years in deal/consulting execution)

**About Advith:**

Advith is an integrated finance, tax, corporate advisory, and global delivery firm combining a 40+ year legacy with a modern execution backbone. Our Advisory practice operates across three core pillars:

1. Transaction Advisory: M&A, valuations, 360° due diligence, deal structuring, and fundraise management.

2. Risk Advisory: Internal Financial Controls (IFC), process re-engineering, SOPs, and governance frameworks.

3. Business Advisory: Founder’s Office support, family business succession, ESOP design, and Transfer Pricing strategy.

**The Opportunity: Front-Line Advisory Execution**

This is an intense, front-line execution role for a driven professional who wants genuine exposure to live transactions, corporate restructurings, and boardroom advisory.

Working directly alongside our Senior Manager, you will serve as the core coordinator and execution engine for client mandates. You will not be doing isolated back-office research—you will build financial models, manage Virtual Data Rooms, analyze operational risks, draft executive deliverables, and ensure engagements move forward with strict momentum.

**Key Responsibilities & Deliverables:**

* India Entry & Cross-Border Advisory: Support global businesses entering India with entity structuring, regulatory landscape mapping, location analysis, and operating model setups.
* Strategic Business Advisory: Assist in founder’s office mandates, family business succession frameworks, ESOP/incentive design, and corporate restructuring assignments.
* Risk & Governance Frameworks: Participate in process reviews, mapping operational workflows, drafting SOPs, and testing Internal Financial Controls (IFC).
* Financial Modeling & Deal Support: Build dynamic three-statement financial models, valuation schedules, and assist in due diligence coordination and data room management.
* Research & Executive Collateral: Conduct market and regulatory research, competitor benchmarking, and prepare executive-ready presentations, advisory notes, and strategy decks.
* Mandate Coordination & Delivery: Serve as the central execution coordinator across client engagements—tracking milestone delivery and liaising seamlessly between clients and internal multidisciplinary teams.

**Who We Are Looking For:**

* Qualification: Chartered Accountant who has hunger to execute, problem-solving attitude, and raw capability matter far more than tier-1 pedigree).
* Core Technical Knowledge: Strong conceptual grounding in financial statement analysis, corporate finance, valuation methods, deal mechanics, and internal control frameworks.
* Analytical & Presentation Skills: High proficiency in MS Excel (financial modelling, formulas, scenario building) and MS PowerPoint (creating structured, executive-grade presentations).
* Execution Mindset: A proactive "doer" who takes end-to-end ownership of tasks and drives deliverables to completion with zero follow-up.
* Professional Maturity & Coordination: Clear written and verbal communication, structured thinking, and the confidence to follow up actively with senior stakeholders and client leadership.
* Work Ethic: High energy, resilience, and adaptability to excel in a fast-paced, high-performance on-site consulting environment.

**Why Join Advith Advisory?**

* Direct Live Exposure: Immediate immersion in live mandates, due diligence reviews, and strategic consulting assignments from day one.
* Steep Learning Curve: Daily problem-solving alongside experienced Chartered Accountants, transaction advisors, and practice leaders.
* High Ownership & Growth: Fast-track career progression driven entirely by your delivery capability, reliability, and measurable impact.

**IMPORTANT FITMENT NOTE (PLEASE READ CAREFULLY BEFORE APPLYING):**

* This role is focused strictly on Transaction Advisory, Risk Advisory, Strategic Business Advisory, financial modelling, deal structuring, and mandate execution.
* This is NOT an accounting, bookkeeping, routine tax filing, or compliance-management role.
* Candidates whose primary interest, background, or career intent is limited to routine accounting or statutory compliance management are requested NOT to apply.
* We are looking for candidates who want to understand how businesses grow, make strategic decisions, raise capital, structure transactions, manage risk, and create value—not simply record or report what has already happened.

The rapidly expanding Regional Credit Risk department at Grab Financial Group (Grab's newest vertical in Financial Services space), develops and launches credit products across multiple countries in SouthEast Asia.
  
  
The position is within the core credit risk team that looks after Grab's Buy-Now-Pay-Later (BNPL) product, as we do this from scratch we have complete responsibility for each product: developing the backend (Credit Decision engine), the front-end (Limit Management), use of the data science models, and then creating a local setup in each country with scalable risk management and portfolio management solutions.
  
  
The Lending team is made up of a mix of risk management, product, design and software professionals, providing lots of opportunity to share knowledge and learnings across functions.
  
  
**Get to Know the Role**
The Assistant Manager for Regional Credit Risk in consumer lending is responsible for managing and driving credit risk management strategies, policies, and procedures. This role offers a unique opportunity for rapid professional growth, encompassing all aspects of the credit risk framework, from data integrity to system reporting. The individual will be involved in designing underwriting and account management strategies for the consumer portfolio and will work closely with the vertical/ functional heads, country risk teams, and other functional stakeholders to execute them.
  
  
This role will be reporting to Manager, Regional Credit Risk, Consumer Lending and be based onsite in our Bangalore office.
  
  
**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**
The role will be responsible for combining advanced analytics with strategic foresight to optimize our credit risk strategy, operations, ensuring sustainable growth and steadfast compliance in a dynamic financial landscape
  
  

* Optimize underwriting and portfolio management risk policies through use of analytics and strategies for consumer portfolios
* Understand, implement, and promote best lending practices across different countries, ensuring successful acquisition and portfolio management strategies are integrated.
* Continuously monitor portfolio risk reports, leveraging them to pinpoint and capitalize on opportunities for enhancing credit program efficiency.
* Regularly provide ad-hoc credit risk evaluations and advisory to Regional teams, Group Risk Head, and other key stakeholders.
* Assist in product and credit program development, reviewing and estimating risk parameters, product pricing, structure, and ensuring regulatory compliance.
* Drive business agenda with potential partners, ensuring optimal risk and profitability economics.

**Qualifications**

* A Master's/Bachelor's degree in a related domain in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics or relevant

* Experience with the retail banking customer credit life cycle, including origination and portfolio management; with prior experience in consumer lending (preferably credit cards/ personal loans/ Buy now pay later).
* Advanced technical expertise concerning credit risk models, database management, and segmentation techniques.
* Expertise in using Python and SQL for data analysis. Knowledge in visualization/dashboard tools such as Power BI will be an advantage.

Corporate Planning & Management (CPM) brings together Finance & Planning, Product & Reporting, and Global Procurement to drive firmwide planning, financial governance, operational excellence, supplier management, and strategic transformation. CPM partners across the firm to deliver actionable insights, strengthen controls, optimize spend, and modernize business processes and platforms.

Leads budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, analytics, and business insights, while partnering with divisional CFO organizations to support strategic decision-making and financial stewardship.
  
  

* Product & Reporting

Drives the evolution of finance and operational platforms, delivering business-led transformation, automation, and technology solutions that improve efficiency, controls, and user experience.
  
  

* Global Procurement

Strategically enables the firm's engagement with third parties, ensuring robust commercial and compliance controls while driving sustainability.
  
  
**CPM Product & Reporting Team**
Manages end-to-end product lifecycle and reporting capabilities for vendor-supplied and internally developed solutions. We empower CPM stakeholders with intuitive tools and actionable insights while ensuring solutions meet business needs and regulatory demands. The Product team oversees development and maintenance of a diverse portfolio of technology platforms including Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) systems, Spend Management platforms, and Third Party Risk Management tools. The team includes enhancing user experience and enabling business units to manage vendor relationships, process transactions, and monitor compliance through integrated digital workflows. The Reporting team delivers comprehensive reports, dashboards, and data analytics providing visibility into spending patterns, risk metrics, and operational performance. This enables our stakeholders to monitor KPIs, identify cost savings opportunities, and make evidence-based decisions while ensuring data accuracy and regulatory compliance.

* Manage monthly cost center lifecycle activities, including setup, updates, closures, and governance reviews.
* Maintain and support organizational hierarchies, ensuring alignment across planning, reporting, and finance systems.
* Perform data quality checks, reconciliations, and operational controls to ensure hierarchy integrity.
* Partner with Finance, HCM, Controllers, and business stakeholders to support organizational change initiatives.

* Support testing, release management, and adoption of new platform capabilities and process automation initiatives.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, or related field.
* 2-3 years of experience in Reference Data Management. Finance Transformation, Business Analysis, Product Ownership.
* Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with financial hierarchies, cost centers, governance processes, or enterprise data platforms is preferred.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery and tools such as Anaplan, Oracle/HCM, Power BI, or workflow platforms is a plus.

**Glassdoor Best Place to Work 2025, Great Place to Work-Certified in five countries, and honored by Cigna as a Healthy Workforce honors for three consecutive years; and what we build is world class: named CybersecAsia’s Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024**
— clear evidence that when first-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So, what if the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you?
**Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next.”**
In a world where you can be anything,
**Be Infoblox.**
**Sales Compensation Operations And Controls Analyst**
We have an opportunity for a Sales Compensation Operations and Controls analyst to join our Finance team in Bangalore, India, reporting to Supervisor, sales compensation - Finance. In this pivotal role, you will support accurate, timely, compliant, and audit-ready administration of Infoblox’s global sales incentive programs. You will manage commission operations, accruals, reconciliations, controls, audit activities, and related accounting processes across Xactly Incent, Salesforce, enterprise financial systems, payroll, and reporting tools.
  
  
Collaborating closely with Sales Compensation, Sales Finance, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Accounting, Human Resources, Payroll, Information Technology, and external auditors, you will independently manage audit requests and queries from preparation through resolution. You will strengthen documentation, data quality, process governance, and automation while using approved AI-enabled tools responsibly to identify anomalies, improve productivity, and help move recurring processes toward zero touch.
  
  
**Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do**

* Administer recurring global sales compensation activities in Xactly Incent, including employee setup, organizational data, quotas, bookings uploads, sales hierarchies, advances, draws, crediting, and plan maintenance
* Validate and reconcile bookings, sales crediting, quotas, attainment, commissions, payouts, and employee data across Salesforce, Xactly Incent, ERP, HCM, payroll, and reporting systems
* Review and process employee lifecycle changes, including new hires, transfers, promotions, leaves of absence, terminations, territory changes, and other events affecting eligibility, quota, crediting, or payout treatment
* Prepare and review monthly and quarterly commission calculations, accruals, payout files, contractor payments, payroll submissions, and management reporting
* Perform accounting support activities for commission expense, accruals, related payroll taxes, adjustments, journal-entry support, and period-end close
* Establish, execute, and maintain operating controls over commission calculations, plan changes, access, approvals, exceptions, evidence retention, and segregation of duties
* Maintain control narratives, process documentation, standard operating procedures, operating calendars, review checklists, issue logs, and audit evidence throughout the year
* Manage external and internal audits end to end, including preparing requests, coordinating evidence, responding to audit queries, tracking open items, supporting walkthroughs and testing, and driving timely resolution of findings
* Investigate commission inquiries, missing credits, opportunity splits, negative orders, payout variances, accrual differences, and other exceptions; document root causes, approvals, corrective actions, and closure
* Support plan configuration changes and user acceptance testing in Xactly Sandbox by preparing test scenarios, validating results, documenting defects, and retaining approval evidence before production migration

**Be Prepared — What You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in sales compensation, finance operations, accounting, FP&A, audit, sales operations, revenue operations, payroll, or a related analytical function
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline; CPA, CA, CMA, or other relevant professional qualification is a plus
* Experience supporting sales compensation operations, including quotas, crediting, attainment, commissions, accruals, payouts, adjustments, and exception management
* Demonstrated experience with accounting processes, reconciliations, accruals, journal-entry support, close activities, and audit evidence
* Experience managing audit requests or queries independently from initiation through response and resolution; public-company or SOX environment experience is preferred
* Experience with Xactly Incent, Callidus, Varicent, CaptivateIQ, or another incentive compensation platform is preferred
* Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, complex formulas, data validation, Power Query, and reconciliation techniques; exposure to Power BI or Tableau is an advantage
* Familiarity with Salesforce, ERP, HCM, payroll, reporting, and data-integration environments, with the ability to reconcile information across multiple systems
* Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, judgment, confidentiality, control discipline, and ability to manage competing priorities and recurring deadlines
* Practical experience using AI-enabled productivity, analytics, automation, or content-generation tools responsibly, including the ability to validate outputs, recognize limitations, and maintain human accountability

**Be Successful — Your Path**
First 90 Days: Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short- and long-term goals.
  
  
**Six Months:**

* Independently complete assigned monthly and quarterly commission operations, accruals, reconciliations, controls, and audit deliverables with accurate, timely, and well-documented results
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of Infoblox’s compensation plans, accounting processes, control requirements, approval workflows, systems, and audit calendar
* Manage routine audit requests and queries through evidence collection, response preparation, follow-up, and closure with appropriate escalation
* Complete variance investigations across source systems and resolve recurring issues through root-cause analysis and documented corrective actions
* Deliver at least one approved automation, AI-enabled productivity improvement, or process redesign that reduces manual effort or strengthens quality and control coverage

**One Year:**

* Own an assigned portfolio of global sales compensation operations, accounting support, controls, and audit activities from data readiness through payout, accrual submission, reporting, and issue closure
* Serve as a dependable subject-matter resource for Xactly, commission calculations, accruals, reconciliations, controls, audit evidence, and query management
* Support annual audits independently, including walkthroughs, selections, evidence coordination, query responses, finding remediation, and stakeholder communications
* Implement measurable improvements that increase accuracy, audit readiness, transparency, scalability, or cycle-time performance
* Help move recurring sales compensation and accounting processes toward exception-based and zero-touch execution through workflow automation, analytics, and responsible AI use

**Belong — Your Community**
Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.
  
  
**Be Rewarded — Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong**

* Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
* Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops
* Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy
* Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks, and culture celebrations
* Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match
* We practice pay transparency and reward performance. Offers reflect role location, internal equity, experience, skills, education, and certifications

**Ready to Be the Difference?**

description:
Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: www.chubb.com .

**About Chubb India**

At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. We are proud to share that we have been officially certified as a Great Place to Work® for the third consecutive year, a reflection of the culture at Chubb where we believe in fostering an environment where everyone can thrive, innovate, and grow

With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we encourage a start-up mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape.

We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.

Chubb's finance technology teams keep the financial backbone of the business accurate, auditable and dependable. This role supports our PeopleSoft Financials platform across Asset Management, General Ledger and Accounts Payable, and works closely with Finance and IT to deliver reliable period-end close, asset accounting and financial reporting.

**Position Details**

**Job Title:** PeopleSoft Financials Techno-Functional Analyst (Asset Management, GL & AP)

**Function/Department:** Technology

**Experience:** 8–12 Years

**Location:** Bangalore

**Role Overview:**

**Position Summary:**

As a PeopleSoft Financials Techno-Functional Analyst, you are responsible for the functional configuration, implementation, support and optimization of the PeopleSoft Asset Management (AM), General Ledger (GL) and Accounts Payable (AP) modules. You ensure accurate asset lifecycle management, depreciation processing and financial reporting. You work closely with Finance and IT teams and explain technical solutions clearly to nontechnical stakeholders. This is a techno-functional role, approximately 80% functional and 20% technical. You are the functional authority for your modules. You also know the technical layer well enough to work effectively with developers on customizations, interfaces, reports and App Engine changes

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Configure and maintain the PeopleSoft Asset Management module, including asset profiles, depreciation methods, cost types and asset books. Manage the asset lifecycle: acquisition, transfers, retirements and disposals.
* Configure and maintain integration between AM and General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP) and Project Costing (PC). Support integrations between the GL and subledgers, and review Accounting Entry Definitions and Journal Generator Templates.
* Configure and maintain GL setups: SetIDs, Business Units, Calendars, Ledgers, Ledger Groups, ChartFields, Combination Edits, Trees and Source Codes.
* Manage journal processing, including Journal Generator, Spreadsheet Journal Import, Allocations, Recurring Journals and Intercompany/Interunit transactions. Support month-end, quarterend and year-end close, including Journal Edit/Post, Open Periods, Closing Rules and Summary Ledgers.
* Support month-end and year-end depreciation runs and reconciliation. Perform Mass Change, Mass Transfer and Mass Retirement processes. Support physical inventory reconciliation.
* Troubleshoot asset depreciation calculation issues, journal entry errors and integration failures.
* Gather and document business requirements and translate them into PeopleSoft functional solutions. Write functional specifications and work with developers on customizations, interfaces, reports and conversions.
* Develop and maintain nVision, PS/Query and Tree-based reports. Support fixed asset reporting for audit, tax and financial compliance. Assist with reconciliation of the fixed asset sub-ledger to GL. Generate and validate depreciation reports, asset schedules and NBV reports.
* Develop and execute functional test scripts (unit, system and UAT). Participate in new features, patches and bundles and assess their functional impact. Coordinate with the technical team on customizations and App Engine program changes.
* Create and maintain functional design documents (FDDs), configuration workbooks and SOPs. Train end users and provide ongoing support

**Technical Skills:**

* 8–12 years of PeopleSoft Financials functional experience.
* PeopleSoft modules: Asset Management (primary), General Ledger (primary) and Accounts Payable.
* AM expertise: depreciation methods, asset books, profiles, cost types and integration setup.
* GL expertise: Journal Generator, Spreadsheet Journal Import, Allocations, Recurring Journals and Intercompany/Interunit transactions.
* Tools: PeopleSoft Query, PS/nVision, SQR (basic) and App Designer (navigation).
* Methodology: fit-gap analysis, requirements gathering and UAT facilitation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to financial data accuracy.
* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders.
* Self-driven, with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment

  

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, business or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that simplify claims processing and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.

**Why Chubb?**

Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company!

Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start-up-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.

* **Industry leader:** Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
* **A Great Place to work:** Chubb India has been recognized as a Great Place to Work® for the years 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026
* **Laser focus on excellence** : At Chubb we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results
* **Start-Up Culture** : Embracing the spirit of a start-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter
* **Growth and success** : As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment

**Employee Benefits**

Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision related requirements. We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. Our benefits include:

* Savings and Investment plans: We provide specialized benefits like Corporate NPS (National Pension Scheme), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP), Retiral Benefits and Car Lease that help employees optimally plan their finances
* Upskilling and career growth opportunities: With a focus on continuous learning, we offer customized programs that support upskilling like Education Reimbursement Programs, Certification programs and access to global learning programs.

title: Data & IT Cost Analyst
description:
**Position Overview**

The Data & IT Cost Analyst will join the IT Asset Management and Optimization (ITAMO) service of BNP Paribas Cardif, based in Chennai. Working at the intersection of data analytics and financial operations, the analyst will provide visibility, rigor and actionable intelligence on IT infrastructure costs across production and non‑production environments. The role owns the end‑to‑end cost‑analytics cycle—from data collection and modelling, through trend and anomaly analysis, to executive‑level reporting and recommendation delivery—directly influencing infrastructure spending decisions and resource‑optimization strategies.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Analyze application, server and environment data to quantify technical consumption (CPU, memory, storage, bandwidth) and attribute associated costs.
* Identify cost trends, consumption anomalies and financial‑risk signals, translating findings into concrete optimisation recommendations.
* Build and maintain cost‑allocation, show‑back and charge‑back models that provide transparent IT‑spending visibility by team, application or service.
* Monitor budget versus actual consumption, flagging deviations early to relevant stakeholders.
* Design, develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that deliver real‑time or near‑real‑time insight into spending patterns, capacity usage and efficiency KPIs, while managing access rights and audience segmentation.
* Conduct focused case studies and ad‑hoc analyses (e.g., migration cost, de‑commissioning impact, ROI of right‑sizing initiatives) and develop decision‑support tools to improve data‑driven financial management.
* Partner with operational and finance teams to validate cost drivers, align on findings and deliver clear, impactful presentations to operational teams and senior leadership (CODIR level).
* Act as a trusted advisor on IT cost matters, bridging technical infrastructure data and financial decision‑making.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of data‑analysis processes, reporting standards and cost‑governance practices.

**Required Education, Skills, AND Experience (MUST‑HAVE)**

* Master’s degree (or equivalent) in a quantitative discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Economics, Data Science).
* Minimum five years of professional experience in data analytics combined with IT cost management.
* Advanced proficiency in Power BI, including dashboard design, DAX, and data modelling.
* Strong SQL skills for querying and aggregating financial and operational datasets.
* Demonstrated ability to identify cost trends, anomalies and savings opportunities from complex data sets.
* Solid understanding of IT infrastructure cost components (servers, storage, network, applications, production vs. non‑production environments).
* Excellent communication skills, with proven experience presenting financial insights to both technical and executive audiences.
* Ability to work autonomously, manage multiple analytical workstreams simultaneously and prioritize competing demands.

**Preferred Education, Skills, AND Experience (NICE‑TO‑HAVE)**

* Advanced expertise in Python or R for statistical analysis, automation or anomaly detection.
* Experience with cost‑allocation, show‑back or charge‑back frameworks within large, multi‑cloud or hybrid environments.
* Familiarity with project‑management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence and ServiceNow.
* Prior exposure to the insurance or financial services sector, particularly within a multinational environment.
* Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and related cost‑optimization practices.

BNP Paribas India Solutions, a wholly‑owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, operates 24 × 7 delivery centres in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai. With more than 10 000 professionals, we support the Group’s Corporate & Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking businesses worldwide.

The FinOps Process expert is responsible for managing and optimizing financial operations processes, ensuring accurate invoicing, billing, accounts receivable/payable activities, dispute resolution, financial reconciliations, and compliance with company policies. The role collaborates with internal stakeholders, customers, and vendors to ensure efficient financial transactions and continuous process improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Ensure timely and accurate processing of customer and vendor invoices.
* Monitor and resolve invoice disputes, credit notes, and payment discrepancies.
* Perform account reconciliations and maintain financial records with high accuracy.
* Support month-end and year-end financial closing activities.
* Analyze financial data and prepare operational and performance reports.
* Collaborate with Customer Experience, Commercial, Procurement, and Finance teams to resolve operational issues.
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, accounting standards, and company policies.
* Identify process gaps and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and productivity.
* Support system testing, UAT activities, and implementation of new financial processes or tools.
* Handle customer and stakeholder queries related to billing, charges, and financial transactions.
* Monitor KPIs, SLAs, and workflow backlogs to ensure service delivery targets are met.
* Strong understanding of financial processes and accounting principles.
* Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, or similar platforms.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial reporting tools.

**Key Skills**

* Financial Analysis
* Billing & Invoicing
* Accounts Receivable & Payable
* Reconciliation & Reporting
* Dispute Management
* Process Improvement
* Stakeholder Management
* Problem Solving
* Attention to Detail
* Communication Skills
* Data Analysis
* ERP Systems Knowledge

**Success Measures**

* Timely invoice processing and dispute resolution.
* Reduction in financial workflow backlog.
* Improved billing accuracy and customer satisfaction.
* Compliance with SLAs and operational KPIs.
* Successful implementation of process improvements and automation initiatives.

title: Specialist-Finance(OTC)
description:
**Join our “Finance Team” at DHL Global Forwarding, Freight (DGFF) GSC – Global Service Centre!**
**Job Title:**
Specialist – Finance (Order to Cash - OTC - Non-Voice)
  
  
**Job Location:**
Chennai
  
  
Are you dynamic and results-oriented with a passion for logistics? Join our high-performing Global Shared Services Team (GSC) at DHL Global Forwarding, Freight (DGFF); a Great Place to Work certified organization and one of the “Top 20 most admired Shared Services Organizations in 2022” by the independent global Shared Services & Outsourcing Network (SSON).
  
  
We are the captive Shared Service Provider for DHL Global Forwarding and DHL Freight (DGFF). We are an organization of more than 4,600 colleagues complemented by approximately 500 virtual FTE (i.e., bots applied in process automation). Our colleagues are based across six service delivery centers in Mumbai, Chennai, Chengdu, Manila, Bogota & Budapest. You will interact with people from all over the world and get the chance to a truly international organization.
  
  
As an Order to Cash Specialist, you will manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, ensuring timely payment application, credit control, and resolution of billing issues. This role requires solid accounting knowledge, financial system expertise, and excellent communication for customer and team interaction. You will ensure record accuracy, support financial reporting, and contribute to process improvements for operational efficiency.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Efficiently apply customer payments against outstanding invoices and manage account balances.
* Facilitate the creation and modification of accounts for both cash and credit customers.
* Conduct thorough reviews and appraisals of credit applications and maintain communication with the Credit Clerk for updates and decisions.
* Assess creditworthiness of new customers, determine appropriate credit limits, and oversee the creation and updates of customer credit details in the system.
* Regularly manage the renewal process for customer credit accounts, ensuring compliance with company policies.
* Implement credit holds and releases on accounts as required, following strict risk management protocols.
* Oversee the management of receivables and payables for foreign agents, ensuring accurate and timely transactions.
* Coordinate and complete month-end activities related to Accounts Receivable (AR), ensuring all financial reporting deadlines are met.
* Deliver a high level of service quality through timely and accurate completion of services.
* Collaborate with colleagues within the business to identify solutions, best practices, and opportunities to improve the service to our business partners.
* Flag any challenges in the operations to the immediate supervisor and business partner in a timely manner.
* Co-ordinate with the relevant stakeholders for regular communication and flow of information as defined for the respective service.
* Contribute as a subject matter expert in problem-solving and process improvement.
* Collaborate with business partners to enhance processes and identify best practices.
* Assist staff in resolving complex issues, maintain thorough process documentation, and ensure quality control.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field.

**Skills Required:**

* 2 – 5 years of relevant work experience, with a preference for candidates with a background in Accounts Receivable processes.
* Proficient understanding of accounting and financial principles, specifically for Accounts Receivable
* Experience with financial software and ERP systems, such as SAP or Oracle, is crucial for managing transactions and financial records.
* Familiarity with the logistics industry and shared services operations is highly preferred, enhancing the ability to navigate industry-specific financial practices.
* Work experience in logistics or shared services operations is preferred.

**Apply now and embark on an exciting journey with us! We offer:**

* We recognize and reward your hard work through a competitive compensation and performance-based incentive.
* We empower you to learn and grow through training that gives you the knowledge, skills, and abilities to develop into your role and a great range of resources to support your future career aspirations & personal development.
* Flexible work arrangements to support work/life balance.
* Generous paid time off: Privilege (earned leave).
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage including voluntary parental cover (applicable for IN only)
* Recognition & Engagement culture

By joining one of the world's leading logistics companies, you have a chance to explore a wide range of interesting job challenges and opportunities across our GSC service lines and in our different divisions around the globe.

title: Accountant
description:
**Company Description**
Aanshe Medtech Pvt Ltd is a medical technology company specializing in the development and manufacture of high-precision devices for interventional cardiology and vascular care. The organization focuses on innovation, quality, and reliability to support healthcare professionals in delivering advanced, minimally invasive treatments. Its products are engineered to meet stringent clinical standards and enhance patient outcomes. Team members collaborate across engineering, manufacturing, and clinical domains, contributing to meaningful technological advancements in cardiovascular care. The company offers opportunities for professionals to work in a regulated, growth-oriented environment driven by medical excellence.
  
**Role Description**
The Accountant role at Aanshe Medtech Pvt Ltd is a full-time, on-site position based in Chennai. The individual in this role will manage day-to-day accounting operations, including preparing and maintaining financial records, posting journal entries, reconciling bank and ledger accounts, and supporting month-end and year-end closing activities. Responsibilities include handling accounts payable and receivable, monitoring cash flow, assisting with budgeting, and ensuring timely invoicing and vendor payments. The Accountant will help prepare financial reports, support internal and statutory audits, and ensure compliance with relevant accounting standards and local tax regulations. This role involves close coordination with finance, operations, and management teams to provide accurate financial data for decision-making and to maintain strong internal controls.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in general accounting principles, including journal entries, ledger maintenance, account reconciliation, and financial reporting.
* Experience with accounts payable and receivable processes, invoicing, vendor management, and cash flow monitoring.
* Proficiency in accounting software and ERP systems, as well as solid skills in spreadsheet tools (e.g., MS Excel) for data analysis and reporting.
* Understanding of taxation, statutory compliance, and audit support procedures within the local regulatory framework.
* Attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and the ability to maintain organized financial records in a fast-paced environment.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CA Inter, CMA, or equivalent) are an advantage.
* Prior experience in manufacturing, medical devices, or a regulated industry is preferred but not mandatory.

title: Manager - Transfer Pricing
description:
**Job Summary**

* The Direct and Indirect Tax Change Champion exists to translate tax strategy, legislative developments and operational requirements into controlled, sustainable changes across direct and indirect tax processes. The role enables Tax teams to adopt new policies, processes, data capabilities and technologies while maintaining regulatory compliance, operational continuity and effective internal controls.
* The role is accountable for shaping and delivering tax transformation initiatives, coordinating impact assessments, strengthening process and data controls, and preparing affected stakeholders for implementation. This includes establishing clear transformation governance, managing dependencies and risks, and using process analysis and tax expertise to identify opportunities for automation, standardisation and improved reporting.
* Working across Country and Group Tax teams, Finance, Technology and relevant business functions, the role influences tax process owners and supports subject-matter experts in converting regulatory and business requirements into practical solutions. The role does not own underlying tax legislation, business strategy or technology development. It provides the change leadership, tax context and governance required to implement agreed changes effectively.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Tax Transformation Strategy & Prioritisation**

* Translate tax strategy, regulatory developments and operational priorities into a structured transformation roadmap that addresses material direct and indirect tax requirements.
* Evaluate proposed changes against tax, business, data and technology needs to establish clear scope, outcomes, dependencies and implementation priorities.
* Shape business cases and delivery options for process, data and technology improvements that strengthen tax compliance and operational effectiveness.
* Provide tax transformation insight to process owners and governance forums, enabling informed decisions on investment, sequencing and implementation risk.

**Change Impact & Stakeholder Adoption**

* Assess the impact of tax policy, legislative, process and technology changes on affected teams, controls, data flows and operating procedures.
* Develop and execute change and communication approaches that build stakeholder understanding, readiness and adoption across Group and Country Tax teams.
* Identify adoption barriers and stakeholder concerns early, escalating material issues and coordinating practical mitigation actions with accountable owners.
* Engage Tax, Finance, Technology and business stakeholders to maintain alignment on intended outcomes, responsibilities and implementation requirements.

**Tax Process Optimisation**

* Analyse direct and indirect tax workflows to identify control gaps, duplication, manual intervention and opportunities for standardisation or automation.
* Design improved tax processes and operating practices that enhance accuracy, efficiency, traceability and consistency across relevant jurisdictions.
* Apply process mapping, data analysis and operational requirements analysis to define credible future-state workflows and measurable improvement outcomes.
* Embed continuous improvement mechanisms that use stakeholder feedback, performance information and operational learning to refine tax processes.

**Tax Technology & Data Enablement**

* Define tax business and operational requirements for tax engines, automation tools, data warehouses and reporting platforms in partnership with Technology teams.
* Coordinate tax input into solution design, testing, user acceptance and implementation readiness to confirm that agreed requirements and controls are addressed.
* Support the controlled deployment of tax technologies by coordinating user guidance, adoption support, issue resolution and post-implementation review.
* Monitor solution performance and data outcomes after implementation, directing identified defects, control concerns and enhancement opportunities to accountable owners.

**Transformation Governance, Risk & Controls**

* Establish proportionate governance for tax change initiatives, providing transparent oversight of scope, milestones, dependencies, decisions and delivery risks.
* Integrate tax compliance, internal control and conduct requirements into transformation design and implementation decisions.
* Maintain clear project documentation and performance reporting that enables timely escalation, governance review and accountable decision-making.
* Coordinate the identification, assessment and resolution of tax transformation risks and issues, escalating matters outside the role’s authority to the appropriate owner.

**Legislative & Regulatory Change Readiness**

* Monitor relevant direct and indirect tax developments and assess potential implications for processes, data, controls, systems and reporting obligations.
* Work with tax technical specialists and process owners to convert legislative interpretation into clear operational and technology change requirements.
* Coordinate implementation readiness for regulatory change, ensuring that dependencies, control updates, documentation and stakeholder actions are understood.

Evaluate external tax transformation practices and emerging technologies to identify approaches that may strengthen the Bank’s tax operating environment.
  
  
**Transfer Pricing & Intercompany Recharges**

* Ensure clarity of objectives agreed with the LM and are broken down to tasks with regular updates to the LM.
* Managing the assigned tasks professionally and efficiently.
* Ensuring compliance of regulations, policies and requirements.
* Contributing to the effectiveness of the team by utilizing interpersonal skills to work with members effectively.
* Gain cross functional knowledge & System Training to uplift the skills especially in the assigned domains.
* Develop and apply testing processes. Create detailed, comprehensive and well-structured test plans and test cases. Co-ordination of Test data/Environment with upstream/downstream teams.
* Ensure detailed project transition plan to be considered in different aspects like End User Training, Resource Considerations & Training Materials.
* Responsible for managing deliverables throughout the project lifecycle collaborating with various project/program teams, stakeholders; finance stakeholders across geographies, process and technology teams.
* Evidence of strong Project Management skills, enabling the delivery of multiple diverse data initiatives from inception to delivery
* Excellent business and technical process design and execution skills, enabling the effective execution of a change
* Responsibility for prioritisation and management of critical path delivery items
* Design the target state solution and target state processes
* Drive the establishment of a target operating model and internal capability to support and drive ongoing change / enhancement initiatives
* Ensure strong engagement with senior leaders and stakeholders across Finance.
* Responsible for risk and issue resolution

**Skills And Experience**
**Priority Skills**

* Tax Compliance
* Tax Returns
* Tax Structuring
* Regulatory Compliance
* Risk Management

**Other Skills**

* Collaboration
* Communication
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Continuous Improvement
* Problem Solving
* Issue Management
* Operations Optimization
* Strategic Planning
* Talent Development
* Requirements Elicitation

**Motivations**

* Motivated by protecting customer and organisational data through practical, proportionate and sustainable privacy solutions.
* Energised by solving complex risk and control challenges with stakeholders from different business, legal, compliance and technology disciplines.
* Thrives in environments that value sound judgement, continuous improvement, collaboration and personal accountability.

**Qualifications**

* Experience operating in complex, regulated financial services environments with multiple jurisdictions, stakeholder groups and governance requirements.
* Exposure to direct and indirect tax operating models, tax compliance processes and the organisational impact of legislative or policy change.
* Experience contributing to large-scale transformation involving process redesign, automation, data platforms, tax engines or regulatory reporting solutions.
* Exposure to structured change delivery across business, tax, finance and technology teams, including testing, implementation readiness and post-deployment stabilization.
* Experience working with complex data flows, control frameworks and reporting requirements where accuracy, traceability and timely issue resolution are critical.
* Experience in intercompany recharges / allocations, transfer pricing methodologies and knowledge on controllership requirements.
* Business English (required)

title: Supervisor, Accounts Receivable
description:
Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities.
  
  
**Come Join Our Team!**

* As part of our robust Rewards & Recognition program, this role is eligible for our Ventra performance-based incentive plan, because we believe great work deserves great rewards

**Help Us Grow Our Dream Team — Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!**
**Job Summary**

* We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Healthcare RCM Supervisor, Accounts Receivable, to oversee our accounts receivable department. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills, a comprehensive understanding of healthcare revenue cycle management, and a proven track record of optimizing accounts receivable processes. The Supervisor will be responsible for managing a team of AR specialists, ensuring timely and accurate billing, claims processing, payment posting, and denial management.

**Essential Functions And Tasks**

* Lead and manage a team of accounts receivable specialists, providing guidance, support, and coaching to ensure high performance and productivity.
* Develop and implement strategies to optimize the accounts receivable process, reduce aging of accounts, and improve cash flow.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics related to accounts receivable, such as days in accounts receivable (AR days), denial rates, and cash collection ratios, and take proactive measures to address any deviations from targets.
* Oversee the billing and claims processing functions, ensuring that claims are submitted accurately and timely, and that any issues or errors are promptly addressed and resolved.
* Manage payment posting activities, reconciling payments received with billed charges, and identifying and addressing any discrepancies or variances.
* Coordinate denial management efforts, analyzing denial trends, implementing corrective actions, and appealing denials as necessary to maximize revenue recovery.
* Collaborate with other departments, such as coding, billing, and compliance, to ensure alignment and consistency in revenue cycle processes and workflows.
* Stay informed about changes and updates in healthcare regulations, payer policies, and industry trends related to accounts receivable management, and implement necessary changes to ensure compliance and optimization.
* Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews, providing feedback, recognition, and development opportunities to team members.
* Foster a positive and collaborative work environment, promoting teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a point of contact for escalated issues and inquiries from internal stakeholders, external partners, and patients related to accounts receivable matters.
* Keep accurate records of accounts receivable activities, performance metrics, and outcomes, and generate reports as needed to track progress and measure success.

**Education And Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in any related field.
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, with a focus on accounts receivable.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Previous leadership experience, preferably in a healthcare setting.
* In-depth knowledge of medical billing processes, reimbursement methodologies, and regulatory requirements.
* Strong understanding of healthcare payer policies and claims adjudication processes.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively lead and motivate a team.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on driving results and achieving objectives.
* Proficiency in healthcare revenue cycle management software and systems.
* Certified Professional Coder (CPC) or Certified Revenue Cycle Representative (CRCR) certification is a plus.
* Willingness to stay updated on industry trends and best practices through continuing education and professional development opportunities.

**Compensation**

* Base Compensation will be based on various factors unique to each candidate including geographic location, skill set, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons .
* This position is also eligible for a discretionary incentiv e bon us in accordance with company policies .

title: Accountant Travel and expenses
description:
Join Our Travel & Expense Team as an Accountant
  
  
**Are you looking for a next step in your finance career?**
Join our Travel & Expense team and play a key role in supporting Valmet's global financial operations. In this position, you will ensure the accurate processing of travel and expense transactions, support end users, and contribute to reliable financial reporting and compliance. You will work with colleagues across multiple countries, gain exposure to global finance processes, and help drive efficiency through standardized and automated ways of working. If you enjoy solving problems, working independently, and supporting an international business environment, this could be the opportunity for you.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Reconcile accounts and verify journal entries to ensure the general ledger is accurate and complete.
* Analyze financial information and prepare accounting reports, statements, and regulatory filings.
* Provide technical accounting support and advice to help stakeholders understand financial reports and forecasts.
* Process travel and expense invoices, including auditing, payments, and reconciliations.
* Maintain and support expense management systems, including Workday Expense and Service Now.
* Complete payment processing and finalization activities accurately and on time.
* Perform period-end closing activities in line with accounting standards and reporting requirements.
* Monitor compliance with Valmet's travel and payment card policy.
* Support users through training, system guidance, and up-to-date instructions.
* Collaborate with colleagues across Valmet units and countries to ensure efficient financial operations.

Expectations from you
  
  

* 1-3 years of relevant accounting experience.
* Experience in performing accounting activities in accordance with accounting principles and standards.
* Ability to work independently while managing routine accounting tasks accurately.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail when reviewing financial information.
* Interest in problem solving and continuous learning.
* Previous experience handling travel and expense invoices is considered an advantage.
* Good written and spoken English communication skills.
* Additional language skills are considered an advantage.
* Relevant educational background is considered an advantage.

To succeed in this role
  
  
Success in this role requires a solid understanding of accounting processes, attention to detail, and the ability to manage financial transactions accurately and efficiently. You need to be comfortable working independently, supporting users, and collaborating with stakeholders across different countries. A proactive approach to problem solving and a willingness to learn new systems and processes will help you make an impact.
  
  
We Also Expect You To Align With Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical Behaviors That Guide How We Lead, Collaborate, And Succeed Together
  
  

* Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through
* Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly
* Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety
* Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value

We offer
  
  
You will become part of Valmet's Global Financial Operations organization, a global finance expert team responsible for operational financial management with a strong focus on process harmonization and automation. More than 120 finance professionals work within the organization, supporting business operations across different countries and functions.
  
  
The Travel & Expense team plays a vital role in processing travel and expense invoices globally, covering auditing, payments, reconciliations, system support, training, and user guidance. You will work in an international environment where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement are highly valued. The team supports colleagues around the world and contributes to maintaining efficient and compliant financial processes.
  
  
Valmet offers an inspiring and international work environment where you can continue developing your financial management expertise. You will have the opportunity to work with global stakeholders, modern systems, and experienced finance professionals while building your skills in a collaborative and supportive team.
  
  
When everything works together
  
  
*Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.*

title: Power BI
description:
**Job Summary**
This role focuses on designing developing and optimizing advanced business intelligence solutions using MS Power BI tools for an MNC insurance environment. The AI Data Specialist will transform complex datasets into impactful dashboards and paginated reports that support strategic and operational decisions. The role involves close collaboration with business stakeholders in life and annuities insurance ensuring high quality reporting strong data governance and reliable insights for day to da
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop advanced interactive dashboards using MS Power BI to deliver clear and actionable insights for business stakeholders in life and annuities insurance ensuring that complex data is presented in a way that supports informed decisions and improves operational performance in a work from office environment.
* Create and maintain high quality paginated reports using Power BI Report Builder that meet detailed regulatory and management reporting needs ensuring that all metrics related to life and annuities insurance products are accurately calculated clearly documented and consistently delivered within agreed timelines.
* Configure and manage Power BI Report Server environments to support secure on premise report hosting ensuring appropriate access control performance optimization and reliable scheduling that aligns with the company reporting calendar and day shift operations.
* Perform advanced data modeling within MS Power BI by designing robust data sets relationships and measures that support analytical scenarios ensuring that calculations and aggregations for insurance policies claims and annuities are consistent transparent and aligned with business rules.
* Collaborate with underwriting actuarial operations and finance teams to gather detailed reporting requirements translating functional needs from life and annuities insurance stakeholders into efficient Power BI solutions that improve visibility into portfolio performance and risk indicators.
* Optimize Power BI reports and dashboards for performance and usability by refining query logic minimizing refresh times and enhancing visual design ensuring that users can quickly interpret results and make data driven decisions during standard office hours without technical barriers.
* Implement robust data quality checks and validation procedures across Power BI data pipelines ensuring that input data from core insurance systems is accurate complete and consistent and that any anomalies are identified documented and resolved to maintain trust in reporting outputs.
* Support deployment version control and change management for Power BI artifacts across development test and production environments ensuring that enhancements to reports and dashboards are thoroughly reviewed regression tested and communicated to relevant stakeholders with minimal disruption.
* Provide expert guidance to business users on how to interpret Power BI content and leverage self service analytics capabilities conducting focused training sessions and documentation updates that empower teams to explore trends segment customer data and evaluate product performance independently.
* Work closely with data engineering teams to define and refine data extraction transformation and loading processes feeding Power BI models ensuring that data structures from policy administration and claims systems are optimized for analytics usage and long term maintainability.
* Monitor usage patterns and feedback for Power BI solutions analyzing user adoption metrics and stakeholder input to prioritize enhancements that improve accessibility reduce manual reporting effort and align with strategic objectives of the insurance portfolio.
* Ensure compliance with company policies audit requirements and industry regulations by embedding appropriate data security practices access controls and documentation standards into Power BI report and dashboard development activities.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of business intelligence standards and practices by proposing new visualization techniques reusable templates and data modeling patterns that help the organization scale its analytics capabilities and deliver greater value to customers and society through better insurance services.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate strong hands on experience in MS Power BI including data modeling DAX calculations report design and deployment gained over seven to ten years of professional work in business intelligence or analytics roles.
* Show advanced proficiency in Power BI Report Builder with a consistent track record of delivering complex paginated reports that handle large datasets and detailed layouts suitable for regulatory and management reporting in insurance or similar domains.
* Exhibit solid experience in configuring and managing Power BI Report Server environments including setup permissions scheduling and performance tuning for secure on premise reporting solutions in an enterprise setting.
* Apply deep understanding of relational databases SQL querying and data warehousing concepts to design efficient data sources for Power BI solutions that support robust analysis and reliable refresh mechanisms.
* Display familiarity with life and annuities insurance concepts such as policy lifecycle premium calculations claims processes and reserve monitoring using this domain knowledge to design business relevant measures and dimensions in reports and dashboards.
* Leverage strong analytical and problem solving skills to investigate data issues reconcile discrepancies between source systems and reports and propose sustainable improvements that enhance data accuracy and clarity for stakeholders.
* Utilize effective communication and collaboration abilities to work closely with cross functional teams gather detailed reporting requirements explain technical constraints in simple terms and align solutions with business priorities while operating primarily in a work from office day shift model.

**Certifications Required**
Preferred certifications include Microsoft Certified Power BI Data Analyst Associate or equivalent industry recognized credentials in business intelligence and analytics.

title: General Manager/ Business Head
description:
**Job Description :**

**Company**
: KeminCBR Pvt.Ltd. (A fully owned subsidiary of Kemin South Asia Pvt Ltd)

**Role :**
General Manager /Business Head

**Location**
:Chennai

* Lead and transform our Ruminant Retail business (B2C) by driving 2X profitable growth, expanding customer and distribution reach, executing winning sales and marketing strategies, and building high-performing teams.
* Expected to be jointly responsible for providing business leadership, strategic directions and be accountable for the overall business KPIs of the company. Work closely as a team member, manage and lead the company towards achievement of the overall company’s shared goals
* Partner closely with Manufacturing, C&F, Finance, and Sales to unlock market opportunities, optimize business performance, and leverage technology, data, and AI to create sustainable growth.
* Work Environment: The position will be based at the head office in Chennai and will require traveling both regionally and internationally depends upon the needs of the regional and global requirements

Necessitates 16-18 days of business travel in a month

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Business Strategy and Leadership

* Develop and execute the annual operating plan and medium-term growth strategy for the ruminant retail business.
* Define business priorities, target markets, customer segments, geographic expansion plans, and channel strategy.
* Convert business objectives into clear functional plans, budgets, performance targets, and accountability for the team.
* Lead periodic business reviews and present performance, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions to senior leadership.
* Balance revenue expansion, profitability, customer value, and organizational capability when allocating resources.

2. Full P&L Ownership and Financial Performance

* Own the business P&L, including net sales, cost of goods sold, gross margin, operating expenditure, and operating profit against approved targets.
* Prepare and manage annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and financial performance reviews in partnership with Finance.
* Analyze product, customer, channel, and territory profitability and implement actions to improve the quality of earnings.
* Govern pricing, discounts, trade schemes, and promotional investments within delegated authority; obtain approvals for exceptions.
* Identify and address adverse variances in revenue, sales mix, margins, trade spending, and operating costs.
* Assess the commercial viability and financial return of new products, market expansion, headcount, and other business investments.
* Own business-level working capital outcomes in partnership with Finance and Supply Chain, including receivables, inventory, and cash conversion.

3. Sales and Retail Channel Development

* Lead delivery of sales targets through the sales team and distributor, dealer, and retail network.
* Develop territory coverage, distributor and retailer development plans, and channel productivity standards.
* Review primary and secondary sales, channel inventory, market reach, product availability, and repeat purchase trends.
* Lead strategic customer and channel partner relationships and support major negotiations and issue resolution.
* Ensure trade terms, incentives, and channel programs support profitable growth and comply with company policy.
* Conduct regular field reviews to assess execution quality, farmer demand, competitive activity, and channel effectiveness.

4. Product Portfolio and Marketing Direction

* Provide strategic direction to the Product Manager on portfolio priorities, positioning, pricing, launch plans, and marketing investments.
* Approve product and brand plans within delegated authority and ensure alignment with business growth and profitability objectives.
* Prioritize new product opportunities using customer needs, scientific differentiation, commercial potential, and financial feasibility.
* Review product lifecycle performance and decide on expansion, repositioning, rationalization, or discontinuation through the appropriate approval process.
* Oversee integrated marketing, farmer engagement, veterinary outreach, and channel activation programs.
* Ensure product claims, marketing communication, and promotional practices follow applicable requirements and internal review processes.

5. Forecasting, Supply Alignment, and Working Capital

* Own the commercial demand forecast and align Sales, Product Management, Finance, and Supply Chain on assumptions and priorities.
* Participate in demand and supply planning reviews to balance service levels, inventory investment, and business risk.
* Monitor stock availability, channel inventory, inventory aging, returns, and expiry exposure; drive timely corrective action.
* Ensure sales execution respects approved credit limits and terms, and drive collection accountability with Finance and Sales.
* Coordinate responses to supply constraints, product quality concerns, and customer service issues with the responsible functions.

6. Customer, Veterinary, and Farmer Engagement

* Build strategic relationships with distributors, retailers, veterinary professionals, dairy and livestock stakeholders, and key customers.
* Ensure farmer and customer insights inform business strategy, portfolio development, and field execution.
* Oversee technical and educational programs that support responsible product use and strengthen customer confidence.
* Establish clear processes for customer feedback, complaint escalation, technical support, and service recovery.
* Represent the business at relevant customer meetings, industry events, and strategic partnership discussions.

7. People Leadership and Organizational Capability

* Lead, coach, and develop the business team, including the Product Manager and sales leadership or sales team, as defined by the approved structure.
* Set measurable goals, review performance, and establish clear decision rights and cross-functional working practices.
* Build capability in commercial management, channel development, scientific selling, financial discipline, and customer engagement.
* Identify capability gaps and support recruitment, succession planning, talent development, and retention with HR.
* Create a culture of accountability, ethical conduct, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

8. Governance, Risk, and Continuous Improvement

* Ensure adherence to financial controls, approval limits, company policies, and applicable commercial and regulatory requirements.
* Identify and manage business risks, including customer concentration, credit exposure, channel conflict, supply disruption, and margin erosion.
* Work with Quality, Technical Services, and other responsible functions on product issues and business continuity responses.
* Improve reporting, business review processes, forecasting accuracy, and decision-making through reliable data.
* Maintain timely escalation of material risks, deviations, and investment requirements to senior leadership.

**Educational Qualification & Years of Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in
  **agriculture, Veterinary Science, Dairy Technology, Agribusiness**
  , or a related field (MBA is a strong plus) with
  **15–20 years of progressive experience in Sales,**
  Marketing, Business Development, or Commercial leadership and relevant experience in animal health, animal nutrition, livestock products, agricultural inputs, or a comparable retail-led business.
* At least
  **3–5 years in business leadership,**
  sales and marketing leadership, or a comparable role with demonstrable P&L responsibility.
* Demonstrated experience in distributor and retail channel management, team leadership, budgeting, pricing, and profitable business growth.
* Experience in the ruminant, dairy, or livestock sector is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional execution across product management, sales, marketing, technical services, and supply operations.

**Competencies - Skills required:**

Business and Financial

* P&L management, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
* Pricing, margin management, investment evaluation, and working capital discipline.
* Business strategy, market development, and resource allocation.

Commercial and Operational

* Sales leadership, distributor management, and retail channel development.
* Product portfolio strategy, marketing effectiveness, and customer relationship management.
* Demand planning, negotiation, execution management, and business risk assessment.

Leadership and Behavioral

* Strategic thinking, commercial judgment, and decisive problem-solving.
* People leadership, coaching, talent development, and accountability.
* Cross-functional influence, executive communication, ethical conduct, and change leadership.

Travel Requisite:

* Up to 50% of travel, domestically and internationally, as and when warranted

**Other Key Consideration:**

* The above noted job description document is not intended to describe in exhaustive detail, the multitude of tasks that may be entailed with this position, but rather to give a general sense of the responsibilities and expectations. As the nature of business demands change, so too do the essential functions of this position.

title: Senior Internal Auditor
description:
This role plays a key part in our company’s success by providing independent assurance and advisory services across the organization. As a Senior Auditor, you’ll work closely with management and process owners to assess governance, risk management, and control effectiveness. We value a proactive attitude towards exploring new tools, techniques, and learning opportunities, as continuous improvement is central to our approach.

Key responsibilities include executing audit testing, reporting on Sarbanes-Oxley and internal audits, and ensuring compliance with policies and regulations through your strong analytical and communication skills.

This position also offers a unique opportunity for travel, with up to 25% domestic and international travel, allowing you to broaden your experience and gain a global perspective. If you’re eager to make a meaningful impact, embrace new challenges, and grow in a collaborative environment, we’d like to hear from you.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

Executes audit strategies with a focus on risk-based auditing and an appropriate level of professional skepticism to validate the effectiveness of internal controls and evaluate potential areas of improvement.

Works both independently and as part of a team, performs thorough self-reviews of testing performed, and proactively surfaces issues to management in a timely manner.

Collaborates with a diverse range of stakeholders, including external auditors, business process owners, IT specialists, and senior management, to drive audit objectives and ensure transparency.

Develops a deep understanding of the organization's business model, digital transformation initiatives, processes, and strategic goals to align audit activities with organizational priorities.

Identifies and leverages opportunities to use data analytics, robotic process automation (RPA), and other advanced audit techniques to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and insights during audits.

Embraces a continuous learning mindset and keeps up to date with emerging technologies, regulatory changes, and industry best practices in audit and risk management.

Supports, coaches, and mentors less experienced team members and guest auditors, fostering a culture of knowledge-sharing and professional growth within the audit team

**Skills & Competencies**

* Demonstrates genuine curiosity and interest in continuous learning.
* Excellent interpersonal, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with ability to communicate confidentially with all levels of management.
* Strong project management skills; ability to manage multiple responsibilities and projects simultaneously with varying degree of complexity and timelines.

**Educational Qualifications and Experience**

* Minimum of three (3) years of progressive experience in financial and/or operational audits, ideally with Big Four accounting firms, major consulting firms, government contractors, or engineering and construction (E&C) companies.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Accountancy, or Commerce.
* Preferred professional qualifications include Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Chartered Accountant (CA), Associate Company Secretary (ACS), or Institute of Cost and Management Accountants (ICMA).
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365 and Power Platform tools, including Power BI, Power Query, and Power Automate

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you.
