As part of our Consulting Enterprise Risk team, our clients look for EY’s expertise across the consulting solutions and specifically for engagements related to Internal Audit, Process compliance and reviews, SOX 404, Payment application, Developing Standard Operating Procedure manuals, Third Party Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance and Enterprise Risk Management.
  
  
There really is no average day in this role, since every client will have multi-faceted challenges and a distinct business environment. What it means is that you’ll have an opportunity to learn and adapt to our clients’ cultures and contribute towards developing unique solutions that are tailored to individual engagements. Whichever industry or client you’re working with, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to expand your business network and transform yourself into a truly global professional.
  
  
**The opportunity**
This is client-facing role in a rapidly growing practice, where you’ll build client relationships with key stakeholders, including management executives for some of the most globally recognized brands. It makes this the perfect place to gain a deeper understanding of complex businesses transactions, all the while recommending solutions to some of the most pressing business challenges and process inefficiencies. You'll also team with our performance improvement professionals in multidisciplinary engagements, helping major global clients transform and sustain business performance. The team is focused on leveraging emerging technologies like Robotics, AI, Advanced Analytics to enhance various Internal Audit and internal control solutions being provided to the client and actively work in building multiple tools and assets for efficient and effective client delivery. + Meet quality guidelines within the established turnaround time (or allotted budget) for assigned requests
+ Demonstrate application and solution-based approach to problem solving while executing client engagements and documenting working papers

+ Develop strong working relationships with the client and onshore client teams
+ Maintain excellent rapport and proactive communication with the client

* People related

+ Display teamwork, integrity and leadership. Work with team members to set goals and responsibilities for specific engagements. Foster teamwork and innovation.
+ Utilize technology & tools to continually learn and innovate, share knowledge with team members and enhance service delivery.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Exceptional command on spoken and written English
* Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations
* Highly analytical, organized and meticulous consulting skills
* Strong academic history (degree in Business, Accounting, or similar work experience in similar industry, Big 4 preferred)
* Proficient in MS-Office Suite, data analysis & validation
* Team player with strong interpersonal skills
* Ability to prioritize deliverables effectively in order to achieve optimum results.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 2-3 years of work experience of a “Big 4” or professional firm or professional industry experience in risks & controls
* CA, bachelor’s in commerce OR MBA (Master’s in business administration)
* Understanding of SOX and COSO framework
* Strong academic history (degree in Business, Accounting, Engineering or similar)
* Exceptional command on spoken and written English
* Team player with strong interpersonal skills

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Problem solving skills
* Ability to think differently and innovate

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* Opportunities to work with EY Risk -Internal Audit practices global with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

The advisor would take on the functional responsibility of handling one/more markets within Mobility Finance Operations scope. * Robust and fit-for-purpose uncertainty and risk analysis (decision analysis support),
* Effective and timely challenge, guidance, and support in making quality investment decisions,
* Economic discipline sub-team participation.
* Drive CI initiatives to improve economics and premise data for investment decisions.
* Progress ESSA (eliminate, standardize, simplify and Automate) projects and embed process excellence through digitalization and CI Mindset
* Work closely with Finance Manager to support forecasting and modelling of significant changes in business and adhoc analysis as needed from a value and risk perspective.
* Custodian and implementer of economic standards governed by Downstream business.

**What You Bring**

* Well-rounded finance professional (MBA, CA, CFA, CIMA, ACCA etc.)
* 10 -12 years' experience in finance (preferably with financial modelling, equity research, transaction support, and investment analysis).
* Advanced excel skills are mandatory

* Project management skills.
* Strong stakeholder management - The ability to achieve results through influencing and motivating others (inside and outside finance) and to communicate effectively across all hierarchies within the organization.
* Problem solving mindset with the courage to ensure professional financial rigor is applied to decision-making process.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, commercial mindset and analytical aptitude; demonstrating good collaboration & interpersonal skills.
* Be organized and structured in completion of tasks.
* Prior relevant business/technical experience in Financial Valuation and research is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of SAP ERP systems and reporting tools like Power BI is a plus.
* Knowledge and ability to work with VBA/Macros is a plus.
* Ability to apply a risk-based, practical approach to problem solving, coupled with the ability to rationalize decisions with significant uncertainty and incomplete info.
* Self-starter with sound judgment and strong interpersonal skills (listening, inquiry, advocacy, facilitation and negotiation) and overall stakeholder engagement skills
* Willingness and capacity to dive into analytical details, and surface with crisp summary of key insights.

**What We Offer**
You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
* Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
* Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non-birthing parents.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

**Shell India**
Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R&D, digitalisation, and business operations.
  
  
Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050. As India moves towards its target of net-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.
  
  
Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end-to-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.
  
  
Shell owns and operates a LNG re-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and a LNG truck-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Sprng Energy in a $1.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Sprng is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.
  
  
Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.
  
  
We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programmes on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.

title: Director of Finance and Business Support
description:
We are looking for an experienced and strategic Director of Finance & Business Support who can oversee the hotel's overall financial operations and business support functions while ensuring profitability, financial accuracy and compliance with company policies and statutory requirements.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be responsible for protection hotel assets, managing financial risks and providing strategic financial guidance to the General Manager and leadership team. The role involves financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, cost control, procurement oversight and ensuring effective financial governance across all hotel operations.
  
  
As Director of Finance & Business Support, you will direct the hotel's financial operations and serve as the primary point of contact for all financial and accounting-related matters involving hotel ownership, internal and external auditors, regulatory agencies and corporate finance teams. You will also provide strategic support to operational departments to enhance business performance and operational efficiency.
  
  
Your Day-to-Day
  
  
Every day is different, but you will mostly be:
  
  

* People
* Lead, manage and develop the Finance & Business Support team to ensure effective performance and operational excellence.
* Manage daily departmental activities, allocate responsibilities and ensure appropriate staffing levels.
* Coach and develop team members through regular feedback, training and performance reviews.
* Establish individual performance and development goals while recognising and rewarding good performance.
* Ensure team members understand and comply with IHG policies, procedures and financial standards.
* Guide department heads on the financial impact of operational decisions and promote cost-conscious practices.
* Build a positive working environment and encourage collaboration across all hotel departments.
* Recommend and initiate appropriate employee-related actions in coordination with Human Resources.
* Responsible Business
* Establish and maintain strong financial controls, accounting standards and ethical business practices in compliance with IHG policies and statutory regulations.
* Ensure financial control procedures and systems are ethical, transparent and legally compliant.
* Maintain compliance with applicable accounting standards, taxation requirements and government regulations.
* Oversee hotel contracts, vendor agreements, service contracts and lease arrangements.
* Ensure effective risk management practices and safeguard the hotel's financial interests and assets.
* Oversee purchasing and procurement processes to ensure transparency, cost efficiency and compliance with established procedures.
* Monitor supplier performance and maintain effective vendor relationships.
* Participate in recognised professional and hospitality industry associations.
* Undertake additional responsibilities as required to support hotel business operations.
* Financial
* Oversee the preparation of annual budgets, financial forecasts, monthly financial statements and management reports.
* Maximise hotel profitability through financial analysis, cost control, revenue monitoring and identification of business opportunities.
* Monitor cash flow, working capital, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll and general ledger activities.
* Work closely with the General Manager and department heads to review financial performance and achieve business objectives.
* Analyse financial statements, business trends and market information to identify opportunities, anticipate financial challenges and recommend appropriate actions.
* Provide analytical support during budget reviews and identify cost-saving and productivity opportunities.
* Ensure timely reconciliation of all accounts and oversee credit management, collections and outstanding receivables.
* Review room rates and recommend pricing strategies in coordination with the General Manager and Revenue Management team.
* Participate in sales and revenue strategy meetings to support the hotel's financial objectives.
* Manage accounts payable and supplier payments while maintaining healthy cash flow and strong vendor relationships.

* Manage internal and external audits, ensuring accurate financial records and timely compliance with audit requirements.
* Monitor taxation, statutory filings and other regulatory requirements.
* Ensure effective purchasing controls, inventory management and safeguarding of hotel assets.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support strategic business decisions and long-term growth.
* Business Support

* Accounts Payable
* Accounts Receivable
* Credit and Collections
* Income Audit
* General Accounting
* Purchasing and Procurement

* Payroll

What We Need From You
  
  

* Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Accounting, Finance, Commerce or a related field.

What You Can Expect From Us
  
  
We give our people everything they need to succeed. From a competitive salary that recognises your contribution to a wide range of benefits designed to support your professional and personal wellbeing, we are committed to creating a rewarding workplace.

title: Associate I - Reconciliation Analyst
Risk Consulting - Actuarial - P and C - Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description**
**Staff, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Staff member to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Staff member within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
**On engagements, you will:**

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Seniors, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members

**Within the actuarial practice you will:**

* Estimate actuarial liability for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR model using the data supplied for estimation
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Updating the report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS, Alteryx, IGLOO, ResQ or other reserving software are good to have, but not must criteria
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Knowledge of how insurance works and basics of Actuarial profession
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc, will be a plus
* Ability to utilize AI tools to expedite current processes and workflows
* Good exam progress consistent with experience

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**

* Strong foundational understanding of actuarial concepts acquired through actuarial examinations, with the ability to apply these concepts to practical business and insurance scenarios.
* knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting.
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Financial Analyst, Customer Service Finance
description:
**Description**
Senior Finance Analyst — Customer Service Finance (CSF) — Hyderabad work from office
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
Function: Finance
  
  
Team: Worldwide Customer Service Finance (CSF)
  
  
Role: Senior Finance Analyst
  
  
Reports to: Finance Manager, Customer Service Finance
  
  
Experience: 3+ years of relevant business finance, accounting, FP&A, controllership and analytical experience
  
  
Qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) — Mandatory
  
  
**About Amazon Finance**
Finance at Amazon is about much more than numbers. It is about understanding the story behind the data, challenging assumptions, identifying risks and opportunities, and partnering with business leaders to make informed, timely decisions.
  
  
Our Finance teams work closely with Operations, HR, Technology, Retail, and other cross-functional organizations. Finance professionals serve as trusted business advisors, combining financial expertise, data-driven analysis, business judgment, and strong communication skills to influence decisions and improve business outcomes.
  
  
We are seeking a highly analytical, commercially minded, and proactive Chartered Accountant to join the Worldwide Customer Service Finance (CSF) team. The ideal candidate will bring strong controllership fundamentals along with experience in financial analysis, reporting, forecasting, process improvement, automation, and stakeholder management.
  
  
**About Customer Service Finance**
Customer Service Finance (CSF) is a strategic finance partner to one of the world's largest Customer Service organizations. The team supports business leaders through financial analysis, controllership, planning, forecasting, and data-driven decision-making.
  
  
Working across geographies and functions, CSF partners with Customer Service Operations, Retail, Technology, HR, and other Finance teams to optimize costs while maintaining and improving customer experience.
  
  
This is an excellent opportunity for a Chartered Accountant who thrives in a fast-paced, international environment and wants to operate as a strategic finance partner rather than focus solely on traditional accounting activities.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Finance Analyst will support the Customer Service organization across financial controllership, planning, forecasting, reporting, and business analysis.
  
  
The role will serve as the financial owner and trusted advisor for assigned sites or business areas. This includes partnering closely with operational leadership to understand business performance, identify risks and opportunities, and drive actions that improve financial outcomes.
  
  
The successful candidate will go beyond reporting historical results to explain what happened, why it happened, what is likely to happen next, and what actions should be taken.
  
  
**Key Areas Of Responsibility Include**
Financial controllership
  
  
Month-end close and reporting
  
  
Forecasting and financial planning
  
  
Variance and root-cause analysis
  
  
Financial modeling
  
  
KPI and metrics analysis
  
  
Business partnering
  
  
Cost optimization and productivity
  
  
Process improvement and automation
  
  
Data analytics and reporting
  
  
Risk and opportunity management
  
  
Management reporting
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Financial Controllership

Own controllership activities for assigned Customer Service sites or business areas.
  
  
Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes.
  
  
Prepare and review monthly financial metrics and management reports.
  
  
Ensure financial information is accurate, complete, timely, and aligned with accounting and controllership standards.
  
  
Analyze performance against plan, forecast, and prior periods.
  
  
Identify financial risks, anomalies, and control gaps and drive corrective actions.
  
  
Partner with Accounting and business teams to resolve discrepancies.
  
  
Establish and maintain effective financial controls and mechanisms.
  
  

* Financial Planning & Forecasting

Support annual operating plans, budgets, and periodic forecasting cycles.
  
  
Develop financial models for business planning and investment decisions.
  
  
Analyze actuals against budget, forecast, and prior-year performance.
  
  
Identify key drivers of financial movements and communicate them clearly to leadership.
  
  
Develop forward-looking views of business performance.
  
  
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis.
  
  
Assess the financial impact of operational initiatives, investments, and cost-saving opportunities.
  
  

* Variance Analysis & Business Insights

Conduct detailed variance analysis across costs, headcount, productivity, and other financial and operational KPIs.
  
  
Identify the underlying business drivers behind financial performance.
  
  
Perform deep dives to uncover trends, risks, opportunities, and root causes.
  
  
Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights.
  
  
Present findings and recommendations to senior management.
  
  
Challenge assumptions and proactively highlight areas requiring management attention.
  
  

* Business Partnering

Act as a trusted financial advisor to Customer Service Operations and site leadership.
  
  
Partner with Operations, HR, Technology, Retail, and Finance teams.
  
  
Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and influence decisions through data and financial insights.
  
  
Understand operational processes and connect business drivers with financial outcomes.
  
  
Provide timely financial guidance to business leaders.
  
  
Help stakeholders understand the financial implications of their decisions.
  
  
Constructively challenge assumptions and recommend alternative solutions where appropriate.
  
  

* "CFO of Your Sites" Ownership

For assigned sites or business areas, operate as the CFO of the site, taking end-to-end ownership of financial performance.
  
  
**This Includes**
Owning the financial performance narrative.
  
  
Partnering directly with site leadership.
  
  
Understanding the operational drivers of financial performance.
  
  
Identifying and quantifying risks and opportunities.
  
  
Tracking financial actions through completion.
  
  
Establishing effective finance mechanisms.
  
  
Driving accountability for financial performance.
  
  
Ensuring leadership has timely and accurate financial information.
  
  
Recommending actions that improve both cost efficiency and customer experience.
  
  

* Cost Optimization & Productivity

Identify opportunities to reduce costs while maintaining or improving customer experience.
  
  
Partner with Operations to understand cost drivers and productivity metrics.
  
  
Evaluate the financial impact of operational and process changes.
  
  
Develop business cases for cost-reduction and productivity initiatives.
  
  
Track benefits realization and ensure savings are measurable.
  
  
Benchmark performance and identify opportunities for standardization and scalability.
  
  

* Data Analytics & Reporting

Analyze large volumes of financial and operational data.
  
  
Build recurring reports, dashboards, and financial metrics.
  
  
Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities through data analysis.
  
  
Develop automated reporting solutions to reduce manual effort.
  
  
Use SQL and other analytical tools to extract and transform data.
  
  
Partner with Data and Technology teams to improve data quality and accessibility.
  
  
Ensure reporting is consistent, scalable, and aligned with stakeholder needs.
  
  

* Process Improvement & Automation

Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and improve Finance processes.
  
  
Eliminate unnecessary manual activities and reduce reporting complexity.
  
  
Design scalable solutions that can be adopted across multiple sites or businesses.
  
  
Lead automation initiatives that improve accuracy, efficiency, and controllership.
  
  
Standardize financial reporting and business mechanisms where appropriate.
  
  
Measure and communicate the impact of process improvements.
  
  
Challenge existing mechanisms and develop better solutions as business needs evolve.
  
  

* Reconciliation & Financial Systems

Reconcile financial reports across businesses, systems, and reporting sources.
  
  
Investigate and resolve discrepancies between financial and operational data.
  
  
Work with financial systems such as Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards, Essbase, Cognos, or similar platforms.
  
  
Maintain data integrity across reporting mechanisms.
  
  
Identify recurring reconciliation issues and implement sustainable solutions.
  
  
Support system and process changes that affect financial reporting.
  
  

* Management Reporting & Communication

Prepare regular financial reviews and business performance updates.
  
  
Present results, risks, opportunities, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  
  
Communicate financial concepts clearly to non-finance stakeholders.
  
  
Develop concise narratives explaining key financial and business movements.
  
  
Ensure leaders understand both the numbers and the underlying business drivers.
  
  
Influence decisions through fact-based analysis and strong financial judgment.
  
  
Key Performance Indicators
  
  
The role may involve analyzing and reporting on metrics such as:
  
  
Actual vs. Budget and Actual vs. Forecast
  
  
Month-over-month and year-over-year performance
  
  
Operating expenses and cost per contact/transaction
  
  
Cost per customer interaction
  
  
Headcount and labor costs
  
  
Productivity and capacity utilization
  
  
Staffing efficiency
  
  
Forecast accuracy
  
  
Financial controllership metrics
  
  
Cost savings and productivity benefits
  
  
Process efficiency
  
  
Customer-experience-related financial metrics
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) — mandatory.
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Engineering, Statistics, or another quantitative discipline.
  
  
3+ years of relevant experience in finance, accounting, controllership, financial analysis, FP&A, business finance, or a related analytical role.
  
  
Strong understanding of accounting and financial principles.
  
  
Proven experience in financial analysis, variance analysis, forecasting, and management reporting.
  
  
Experience working with financial KPIs and business performance metrics.
  
  
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, PivotTables, financial modeling, and data analysis.
  
  
Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
  
  
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  
  
Ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
MBA, Master's degree in Finance, or equivalent advanced qualification.
  
  
Experience in a multinational, technology, e-commerce, shared-services, or high-growth environment.
  
  
Experience with SQL and large-scale data analysis.
  
  
Experience with Tableau, Power BI, or similar visualization tools.
  
  
Experience with Oracle, SAP, Essbase, Cognos, JD Edwards, Lawson, MS Access, or other financial/reporting systems.
  
  
Experience in financial controllership and month-end close.
  
  
Experience in FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning.
  
  
Experience leading process improvement or Finance automation initiatives.
  
  
Experience working with large datasets and developing automated reporting solutions.
  
  
Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, continuous improvement, or process re-engineering.
  
  
CPA, MBA, or equivalent professional qualification in addition to CA is an advantage.
  
  
Core Competencies
  
  
Financial Acumen
  
  
Strong accounting and finance fundamentals.
  
  
Ability to understand financial statements and business drivers.
  
  
Strong financial modeling and forecasting capabilities.
  
  
Analytical Thinking
  
  
Ability to analyze complex datasets.
  
  
Strong root-cause analysis skills.
  
  
Ability to distinguish meaningful insights from low-value details.
  
  
Business Judgment
  
  
Understands the commercial and operational implications of financial decisions.
  
  
Balances cost, risk, operational efficiency, and customer experience.
  
  
Stakeholder Management
  
  
Comfortable working with senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
  
  
Able to influence without direct authority.
  
  
Builds credibility as a trusted Finance partner.
  
  
Problem Solving
  
  
Takes ownership of ambiguous and complex problems.
  
  
Uses data to identify root causes.
  
  
Develops practical, scalable solutions.
  
  
Process Improvement
  
  
Continuously seeks opportunities to simplify, automate, standardize, and scale.
  
  
Demonstrates measurable impact from improvement initiatives.
  
  
Communication
  
  
Converts complex financial analysis into clear and compelling business narratives.
  
  
Confidently presents findings and recommendations to senior leadership.
  
  
Ideal Candidate Profile
  
  
We are looking for a qualified Chartered Accountant who combines strong accounting fundamentals with commercial awareness and analytical thinking.
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate**
Thrives in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  
  
Independently owns financial deliverables from data gathering through executive communication.
  
  
Has strong controllership and financial analysis experience.
  
  
Understands how operational decisions translate into financial outcomes.
  
  
Is comfortable working with large datasets and financial systems.
  
  
Uses data to challenge assumptions and identify opportunities.
  
  
Demonstrates strong ownership and a bias for action.
  
  
Can simplify complex financial problems.
  
  
Enjoys collaborating across functions and geographies.
  
  
Is comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities.
  
  
Has a continuous-improvement mindset.
  
  
Communicates effectively with both Finance and non-Finance stakeholders.
  
  
Wants to grow into a strategic business partner rather than remain focused solely on traditional accounting.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
**Success In This Role Means**
Financial reporting is accurate, timely, and well controlled.
  
  
Forecasts and financial plans are reliable and supported by clear assumptions.
  
  
Leadership has clear visibility into financial risks and opportunities.
  
  
Variances are understood at their root cause rather than simply reported.
  
  
Finance insights translate into measurable business decisions and outcomes.
  
  
Cost-reduction and productivity opportunities are proactively identified and delivered.
  
  
Finance processes become increasingly automated, scalable, and efficient.
  
  
Manual reporting and reconciliation activities are reduced.
  
  
Site and business leaders view Finance as a trusted strategic partner.
  
  
Financial risks and opportunities are identified early and driven through to closure.
  
  
Why Join Customer Service Finance?
  
  
**Role**
This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Operations, Technology, Data, and Customer Experience. As a Finance Analyst and qualified Chartered Accountant, you will have the opportunity to:
  
  
Serve as a trusted Finance advisor to a global Customer Service organization.
  
  
Work directly with senior business and operational leaders.
  
  
Influence significant business and investment decisions.
  
  
Analyze large-scale financial and operational datasets.
  
  
Build and automate Finance mechanisms.
  
  
Drive measurable cost and productivity improvements.
  
  
Gain exposure to a highly international and cross-functional environment.
  
  
Develop from a Finance specialist into a broader business leader.
  
  
Make a measurable impact on both customer experience and business performance.
  
  
Ideal Candidate at a Glance
  
  
Qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) — Mandatory
  
  
Experience: 3+ years of relevant finance, accounting, or analytical experience
  
  
Finance: Controllership, FP&A, forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and financial modeling
  
  
Analytics: Advanced Excel; SQL preferred; Tableau/Power BI preferred
  
  
Systems: ERP/financial systems experience preferred, including Oracle, SAP, Essbase, or Cognos
  
  
Business Skills: Business partnering, stakeholder management, cost optimization
  
  
Process Skills: Automation, standardization, and continuous improvement
  
  
Communication: Strong English communication and executive presentation skills
  
  
Mindset: Analytical, curious, ownership-driven, customer-focused, and comfortable with ambiguity
  
  
Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History.
  
  
Amazon is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* professional tax, accounting or legal qualification (e.g., Chartered Accountant (CA), Associate Chartered Accountant (ACA), Chartered Tax Adviser (CTA), Chartered Institute of Taxation (CIOT) or similar), or LL.M. (Taxation)
* 3+ years of business or financial analysis experience
* Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results, or experience in finance role where you owned financial reporting for a business area
* Experience developing financial models in Excel with advanced functions (pivot tables, macros, VBA, Power Query), or experience in financial modeling
* Experience applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses, or experience using financial models, KPIs, and data analysis to support business decisions
* Experience working with stakeholders, or experience in commercial finance business partnering or FP&A
* Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience

title: Analyst
description:
**Company Overview**
Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
  
  
Financial technology is a high-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
  
  
We are looking for an Analyst to join our Financial Operation group. This group is responsible for various post-trade activities and is an integral part of our global operations. If hired, you will one of the sub-departments mentioned below
  
  
**Trade Accounting and Operation**
: Fund accounting, position and cash reconciliation, resolution of trade and settlement issues, and provide business analysis to firm wide SIP initiatives.
  
  
**Middle Office**
: Securities and Transaction Management, Asset Servicing and Corporate Action management across various asset classes, Reference, and Static data management.
  
  
**Treasury:**
Manage liquidity, margin related movements, and optimize financing arrangements.
  
  
**Pricing**
: Build valuation tools and provide valuation for the firm’s investments, reconcile, and analyze prince difference between Arcesium’s platform and Admin/Street
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Develop a thorough understanding of Arcesium platform, various asset classes and market standards supporting post trade life cycle management.
* Be accountable for your work output: Daily and monthly processes around trade and security management, reconciliations margin management.
* Liaise with multiple internal and external counterparts as required for issue resolution.
* Provide adequate support to various process supporting the investment life cycle.
* Ensure all activities are captured correctly and book appropriate adjustments wherever required.
* Collaboration with technology teams on special projects, bespoke reporting requirements and UTA of new functionalities.

**What You’ll Need**

* A Postgraduate/Professional degree (CA, CPA) and/ or a Bachelor’s Degree with minimum 2 years’ experience.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills with a collaboration attitude.
* Support clients need during different time zones.
* Excellent oral/written communication skills
* Ability to work under pressure and take on additional responsibilities.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office application especially MS Excel
* Hands on experience with VBA macrons / Python will be a big plus.

**Recruiting Security**
Emails from genuine Arcesium recruiters who are employees of the company will always come from the @arcesium.com domain. In some cases, you may also be contacted by independent search firms engaged to recruit on our behalf; emails from their employees should always come from their firm's applicable domain. We'll never ask for your banking information or any payment as part of the recruiting process. If something seems off or you're contacted by an unexpected third party, please reach out to us at careers@arcesium.com (US/UK), careers-india@arcesium.com (India) or careers-europe@arcesium.com (Portugal/Sweden).
  
  
*Arcesium is an equal opportunity employer.*

description:

**Position Summary**

As a Senior Consultant, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation on the Controllership team, you will be responsible for:

Deloitte Advisory’s Controllership team helps organizations reduce risk and improve reporting capabilities to meet accounting and regulatory requirements, governance in complex operating models, and support for major business events and transactions. Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata

11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST as per business requirements

Required:

title: Financial Consulting Manager  - Fund Services
description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.
  
  
**Business Practice Overview:**
RSM’s Fund Services+ within our Financial Consulting practice is a dedicated team of experienced professionals who specialize in providing managed services Real Estate Groups for fund administration, helping to navigate end to end property technical accounting, assisting with financial reporting requirements, fund performance measurements and supporting Management to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of their accounting and finance functions through an integrated, streamlined technology platform. With our blend of deep technical knowledge, real estate industry experience, and property accounting know-how, we can provide an integrated team of fund administrators, valuation and tax specialists, and other subject matter experts who can help manage the day-to-day back-office functions for Real Estate funds. It’s a global integrated team with transactional to strategic capabilities and comprehensive areas of specialization drawing on our entire RSM market leading organization.
  
  
**About this role:**
RSM is actively seeking talented Fund accounting professionals who are characterized by high motivation, self-direction, strong analytical skills, and a track record of excellence in their previous roles.
  
  
Are you an experienced property accounting professional on the hunt for an exciting career opportunity with a leading fund service provider that boasts a best-in-class technology platform and an end-to-end real estate service model?
  
  
Do you aspire to deepen your technical expertise in intricate fund/property terminologies, address complex accounting challenges, and navigate the intricacies of real estate fund structures? Are you enthusiastic about engaging with and collaborating alongside a diverse range of clients? Are you in pursuit of a career that promises stimulating and diverse avenues for professional growth?
  
  
If so, RSM's Fund Services + is the right fit for you!
  
  
**Specific Responsibilities**

* Assume ownership of the real estate property accounting, encompassing complete end-to-end responsibilities for property accounting.
* Prepare/review monthly/quarterly/annual workpapers and financial statements variance analysis.
* Ensure that proper accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls are maintained and that all financial transactions are recorded in accordance with GAAP requirements.
* Handle bookkeeping for entity’s operations which includes cash booking, expense accruals, assets and depreciation accounting, leases, asset management fees, loan draw packages, CAM, commercial billing, AR aging, actual vs budget, acquisitions, dispositions, Lender compliance etc.
* Support with queries from client, property/fund accounting team, regulatory authorities and external auditors.
* Assist with onboarding new clients, setting up the entities, assets and build customized reports in line with client’s reporting requirements.
* Create SOPs and checklists for various processes to ensure completeness, accuracy and timeliness.
* Work collaboratively with global team members to manage day-to-day operations, implemented month-end close processes and provide client servicing.
* Offer mentorship and guidance to new or junior team members.

**Qualifications**
RSM seeks to hire individuals who are highly motivated, self-driven, analytical and have demonstrated excellence in prior endeavors.
  
  

* 7+ years of experience in Fund Accounting.
* Undergraduate degree in accounting
* CPA and/or CA preferred
* Strong analytical skills, detail oriented and highly organized
* Demonstrates a strong work ethic, team player, upholds personal and professional integrity, and maintains a positive attitude.
* Possesses effective oral and written communication skills, as well as influencing skills and leadership capabilities.
* Adapts well to dynamic, fast-paced environments and excels at managing multiple projects simultaneously.

At RSM, we offer a competitive benefits and compensation package for all our people. We offer flexibility in your schedule, empowering you to balance life’s demands, while also maintaining your ability to serve clients. Learn more about our total rewards at https://rsmus.com/careers/india.html.

title: Vice President
description:
**Job Description: Vice President (VP) – Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management**

Experience - 18+ years

Location - Mumbai & Hyderabad

**1. Role Purpose**

The Vice President (VP) – Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership across the RCM business, with end-to-end accountability for financial performance, operational excellence, customer relationships, and business transformation.

The role requires a combination of deep healthcare RCM domain expertise, strong financial acumen, analytical capabilities, and executive-level customer engagement skills. The AVP will translate business and operational data into strategic insights, identify opportunities to improve profitability and operating efficiency, and lead cross-functional initiatives that deliver measurable business outcomes.

As a strategic partner to customers and internal leadership, the AVP will drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, innovation, and customer-centricity while ensuring alignment between business objectives, operational execution, and long-term growth.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Strategic Business Leadership**

* Define and execute business strategies aligned with organizational goals, customer priorities, financial commitments, and growth objectives.
* Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the healthcare RCM landscape, industry trends, payer dynamics, reimbursement practices, and emerging technology opportunities.
* Translate strategic priorities into actionable business plans with clear outcomes, ownership, timelines, and performance measures.
* Provide strategic direction to leadership teams and influence decisions that strengthen business performance and competitive positioning.

**B. P&L Management and Financial Performance**

* Own the financial health of the assigned business portfolio, including revenue, operating costs, contribution margins, profitability, and budget adherence.
* Develop a strong understanding of financial drivers and their relationship to operational performance, productivity, quality, and customer commitments.
* Lead budgeting, forecasting, financial reviews, variance analysis, and financial risk mitigation.
* Identify opportunities to optimize cost structures, improve resource utilization, enhance margins, and strengthen operating leverage.
* Evaluate the financial implications of business decisions, process changes, technology investments, and customer-specific requirements.
* Establish accountability for financial outcomes and ensure corrective actions are implemented to address performance gaps.

**C. Healthcare Revenue Cycle Domain Leadership**

* Provide strategic oversight across the healthcare revenue cycle, including patient access, eligibility verification, charge capture, medical coding, billing, payment posting, accounts receivable, denial management, and underpayment recovery.
* Identify opportunities to reduce revenue leakage, improve reimbursement outcomes, accelerate cash flow, and strengthen revenue integrity.
* Evaluate operational and financial performance against relevant RCM benchmarks, payer requirements, and industry best practices.
* Guide teams in resolving complex process challenges and improving end-to-end revenue cycle effectiveness.
* Advise customers on improvement opportunities that align operational interventions with measurable financial and business outcomes.

**D. Business Analytics and Performance Insights**

* Establish a data-driven operating culture by leveraging financial, operational, quality, and customer performance data.
* Analyze trends, patterns, and underlying performance drivers to identify opportunities, emerging risks, and root causes.
* Translate complex data into actionable business insights, strategic recommendations, and measurable improvement plans.
* Establish executive dashboards and performance scorecards covering financial health, operational effectiveness, customer outcomes, and transformation benefits.
* Develop compelling business narratives that connect operational performance to financial impact and customer value.
* Use forward-looking indicators and scenario analysis to anticipate business challenges and guide proactive decision-making.

**E. Executive Customer Engagement and Value Realization**

* Build and maintain strategic relationships with customer executives and key decision-makers.
* Understand customer business models, financial priorities, operational challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Lead executive business reviews and position recommendations through a consultative, insight-led, and value-oriented approach.
* Articulate business performance through clear storytelling, supported by data, root-cause analysis, financial implications, and proposed actions.
* Influence customer decisions by demonstrating the business case, expected benefits, risks, and implementation requirements of recommended initiatives.
* Proactively manage escalations, strengthen customer confidence, and drive measurable value realization and long-term partnership growth.

**F. Operational Excellence and Productivity Transformation**

* Drive continuous improvement across operations by identifying opportunities to improve productivity, quality, turnaround time, resource utilization, and cost efficiency.
* Evaluate operating models, workflow design, capacity, spans of control, and resource allocation to improve delivery effectiveness.
* Sponsor process standardization, reengineering, and best-practice adoption across teams and customer portfolios.
* Establish measurable efficiency targets and ensure improvements translate into sustainable financial and operational benefits.
* Challenge existing practices and promote innovative approaches to improving business performance without compromising quality, compliance, or customer experience.

**G. Governance, Controls, and Risk Management**

* Establish robust governance frameworks for monitoring financial performance, service delivery, customer commitments, quality, compliance, and operational risks.
* Review business performance, control effectiveness, and process adherence to identify gaps and areas requiring intervention.
* Lead structured business reviews, root-cause discussions, and corrective action planning with clear accountability.
* Ensure action plans address underlying causes rather than symptoms and are monitored through successful closure.
* Provide guidance to leadership teams on risk mitigation, escalation management, control improvements, and performance recovery.
* Promote a culture of ownership, transparency, and disciplined execution.

**H. Cross-Functional Leadership and Organizational Alignment**

* Drive alignment across Operations, Quality, Training, Workforce Management, Finance, Analytics, Technology, Human Resources, and Client Management.
* Establish effective calibration mechanisms to ensure consistency in process execution, performance expectations, quality standards, and customer commitments.
* Resolve cross-functional dependencies and systemic workflow challenges that affect operational and financial outcomes.
* Align teams around common business objectives and facilitate effective collaboration across organizational boundaries.
* Develop leadership capability, strengthen accountability, and build a performance-oriented culture across the business.

**I. Technology, Automation, and Digital Transformation**

* Identify and prioritize technology opportunities across the RCM value chain, including automation, artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, workflow optimization, and system integration.
* Partner with technology and transformation teams to assess business requirements, solution feasibility, implementation risks, and expected returns.
* Sponsor technology-enabled transformation initiatives that improve productivity, reduce manual effort, enhance accuracy, and strengthen controls.
* Build business cases for technology investments and evaluate benefits

title: Accounting Manager
description:
**Job Description – Accounting Manager**

Accelyst is an innovative AI Consultancy that leverages a unique catalog of industry specific Agents and leading-edge AI platforms to deliver tangible, integrated, secure and ROI-optimized solutions. We combine deep industry and technical expertise to enable rapid deployment of innovative AI-driven capabilities to augment and automate client workflows for employees, customers, prospects, and investors.

**Why Accelyst?**

Join Accelyst to be part of a dynamic team that leverages AI-driven technology to make a positive impact. Our leadership, with Big Four Consulting experience, fosters a nimble, client-focused environment, minimizing bureaucracy to enhance delivery and professional growth. You'll work on complex AI projects that challenge and inspire, meeting high client expectations. Additionally, benefit from our profit-sharing model, reflecting our commitment to respect and integrity for all employees.

**Job Summary:**

Accelyst is seeking an accomplished Accounting Manager to support its corporate headquarters located in the United States of America. Hands-on experience in standard U.S. accounting practices and methods is essential for the successful execution of the responsibilities of the position that include preparing, reviewing, and analyzing financials and reporting systems for our company. The Accounting Manager will report directly to the U.S.-based Finance and Accounting Manager and will be tasked with helping to ensure legal and regulatory compliance for all accounting and financial reporting functions. The Accounting Manager and will also oversee audits, cost and general accounting, budgeting, accounts receivable/collection, and billing. All specified responsibilities will similarly extend to guiding the work of the company’s accounting team based in India.

**Job Roles and Responsibilities:**

• Manage and oversee accounting operations for the company's U.S. and India entities,

• Monitor intercompany transactions, cash flows, and financial reporting between U.S. and

India entities, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and effective financial controls

• Responsible for preparing financial reports for management and outside agencies on a

monthly, quarterly, yearly basis, as required.

• Perform project life-cycle cost analysis, to include a review of sales and marketing

expenditures, sales orders, and purchase orders.

• Responsible for providing and interpreting financial information.

• Develop financial management mechanisms that minimize financial risk.

• Hands-on work experience with external auditors and ability to prepare required

reporting as per the audit checklist.

• Develop external relationships, e.g. auditors, bankers, and statutory organizations.

• Responsible for conducting and coordinating internal and external audits and preparing

fiscal documentation.

• Manage the company's financial accounting, monitoring, and reporting systems.

• Responsible for planning and preparation of budget and forecasting

• Responsible for monitoring and interpreting cash flows and predicting future trends.

• Manage the Finance and Accounting team, including accounts receivable, accounts

payable, invoicing, bank and account reconciliations, billing, coding, and payments.

• Responsible for federal and state tax reporting’s, quarterly and year-end closing

**Job Requirement Qualifications:**

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance

• CPA certification

• Must have direct experience with USA and India- based accounting systems and

business operations is preferred.

• 5 years of experience in managing full accounting duties in a medium- or large-size

company

• Advanced knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)

• Strong analytical and mathematical skills

• High professional standards and ethics, with an ability to handle confidential

information.

• Excellent communications skills and ability to handle multiple tasks at one time.

• Performance management of support staff

• Direct experience coordinating internal and external audits

title: Financial Reporting - Senior Manager
description:
****Who We Are Looking For:****
The purpose of the job is to provide end to end support to investment company clients for timely completion of preparation of financial statements, portfolio schedules and associated mandatory reporting’s within stringent deadlines for audit / review and successful submission to the regulators.
  
  
Selected candidates will be required to work at shifts which allow reasonable overlap with US, APAC and EMEA hours and allow for trainings, on the job practice, feedback etc.
  
  
****Why This Role Is Important To Us:****
The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Global Services (SSGS). SSGS gives asset owners and managers access to the essential financial tools they need to deliver effective investment solutions. From core custody, accounting, fund administration and shareholder recordkeeping, to complete operations solutions and servicing for alternative assets like OTC derivatives, private equity and real estate, SSGS’ tools help our clients make better investment choices and act on growth opportunities.
  
  
Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
  
  
****What You Will Be Responsible For:****
As an Officer you will:
  
  

* Perform 1st, 2nd and targeted reviews on client financial statements, NQs, Form N-MFP or other similar forms / activities. Ensure all regulatory filings are made on time; manages draft and support distribution to all parties
* Comprehend the scope of services offered to clients and reviews with the team; demonstrate technical expertise; ensure team meets all client deliverables and manages relationships of assigned clients
* Ensure all controls/checklists and procedures are adhered to as well as make recommendations for improvement
* Proactively manage risk at the business level; feel fully accountable for all steps of the production chain
* Ensure effective use of automation (FundSuite, MCH, Macros, etc.) and make recommendations for current system enhancements
* Oversee the effective coordination of activities between multiple departments within organization, including our global offshoring partners
* Coordinate the research and resolution of any accounting issue, auditor or client comments and/or JV inquiries
* Responsible for reviewing staff level work, as needed
* Participate in the resolution of client issues
* Provide coaching and development opportunities to staff and responsible for completing and delivering performance reviews on time

title: Associate Manager, Forecasting
description:
About the Team:
  
  
The Workforce Demand Forecasting team is part of Global Support and Integrity Operations. We help DoorDash deliver reliable, efficient, and high quality support by translating business activity into demand forecasts and actionable planning insights.
  
  
Our work informs customer experience, workforce investment, operational readiness, and cost. We partner with Workforce Management, Operations, Finance, Business Intelligence, Data Science, Product, and Engineering to improve forecast accuracy, strengthen planning decisions, and build scalable operating mechanisms.
  
  
The team supports a broad set of global support workstreams. Our goal is to provide leaders with the forecasts, insights, and decision frameworks needed to balance service, customer experience, and cost.
  
  
About the Role:
  
  
We are seeking an Associate Manager to lead a defined set of Forecasting workstreams and strengthen the team's operating model.
  
  
This role goes beyond forecast production. You will own workstream performance from end to end, including forecast quality, prioritization, business readiness, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement. You will translate complex data into clear recommendations, make informed tradeoffs, and help leaders understand key risks, opportunities, and decisions.
  
  
You will also guide and develop analysts through coaching, technical support, and clear performance expectations. The ideal candidate combines analytical depth, strategic judgment, operational discipline, and strong cross functional influence.
  
  
Success in this role requires advanced SQL skills, strong business acumen, and demonstrated experience improving forecasting, planning, or operational processes at scale.
  
  
You're excited about this opportunity because you will own:
  
  
Forecasting Performance and Business Readiness
  
  
Lead demand forecasting across designated business lines and workstreams, with accountability for forecast accuracy, assumptions, risks, and recommended actions across planning horizons. Ensure forecasts reflect key demand drivers, including initiatives, promotions, operational changes, and seasonality, while establishing consistent mechanisms for performance reviews, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
  
  
End-to-End Workstream Leadership
  
  
Serve as the primary Forecasting leader for assigned workstreams. Set priorities, align stakeholders, manage delivery, and make informed tradeoffs based on customer impact, operational risk, financial impact, and team capacity. Translate complex findings into clear recommendations and decision requests for senior leaders.
  
  
Strategy, Scale, and Process Improvement
  
  
Identify and lead opportunities to improve forecasting methods, planning processes, data quality, systems, and automation. Build scalable solutions that improve accuracy, efficiency, and decision quality while adapting operating models to the needs of each business line.
  
  
Data and Technical Partnership
  
  
Partner with Data Science, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, and Software Engineering to shape forecasting capabilities. Define requirements for models, metrics, dashboards, datasets, and planning tools, resolve data and pipeline issues, and influence the roadmap for automation and machine learning.
  
  
Talent Development and Operating Excellence
  
  
Coach analysts across forecasting, analytical problem solving, stakeholder management, and executive communication. Set clear expectations, strengthen accountability, standardize best practices, and help team members expand their judgment, scope, and cross-functional influence.
  
  
We're excited about you because you:
  
  

* You have a Masters Degree in a Quantitative field +4yrs of relevant experience OR a Bachelors in a Quantitative field +6yrs of relevant experience
* You bring strong experience in forecasting, demand planning, workforce management, operations strategy, business analytics, or a related field, with the ability to connect analytical insights to business decisions.
* You are highly proficient in SQL and Excel and can build and evaluate dashboards, metrics, models, and analytical tools across platforms such as Tableau, Sigma, Power BI, QuickSight, or Looker.
* You can translate ambiguous business problems into structured analyses, clear recommendations, and executable plans. You understand how to balance customer experience, operational performance, cost, and scalability.
* You have led complex, cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through implementation and measurement. You work effectively with Data Science, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Operations, and Finance, and can influence without direct authority.
* You communicate clearly with individual contributors, cross-functional partners, and senior leaders. You exercise sound judgment, prioritize effectively across competing workstreams, and know when to escalate risks, recommend tradeoffs, or challenge existing processes.
* You are curious, proactive, and motivated to improve the DoorDash support ecosystem through better decisions, stronger operating mechanisms, and scalable solutions.

**About DoorDash**
At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.
  
  
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
