title: Senior Manager – Trade Finance & Working Capital
description:
**Trade Finance & Debt Fundraising Manager**

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Experience:**
4–10 Years

**Department:**
Finance / Corporate Treasury

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Compensation:**
Based on Current CTC, Relevant Experience & Interview Performance

**Role Purpose**

We are looking for an experienced Trade Finance & Debt Fundraising Manager to take ownership of sourcing, structuring, negotiating, and securing trade finance, working capital, alternative debt, and other funding facilities for our import-export and cross-border trading business. The candidate will be responsible for developing relationships with international trade-finance platforms, fintech lenders, NBFCs, institutional lenders, and private credit funds and converting these relationships into actual funding facilities and successful disbursements.

Key Responsibilities

·      Research and map suitable alternative trade finance providers based on the company's trade corridors, buyers, suppliers, transaction structures, and funding requirements.

·      Identify and build relationships with trade-finance platforms and lenders, including Drip Capital, Incomlend, Tradewind, Stenn, KredX, Velotrade, Demica, PrimaDollar, and other suitable international/domestic funding providers.

·      Evaluate financing products such as Invoice Factoring, Invoice Discounting, Receivables Financing, Receivables Discounting, Supply Chain Financing, Purchase Order Financing, Pre-Shipment Finance, Post-Shipment Finance, Trade Credit Facilities, and other alternative working-capital solutions.

·      Identify financing options that offer collateral-free, unsecured, or collateral-light funding wherever commercially and legally feasible.

·      Initiate, develop, and manage relationships with trade-finance companies, fintech lenders, NBFCs, institutional lenders, private credit funds, and alternative financing providers.

·      Present the company's business model, trade cycles, buyers, suppliers, financial position, and funding requirements to potential lenders and funding partners.

·      Prepare and submit complete funding applications and coordinate all documentation required by lenders and financing platforms.

·      Collect and coordinate trade documents, purchase orders, commercial invoices, export/import documents, buyer and supplier information, buyer/supplier credit history, financial statements, bank statements, KYC documents, corporate/legal documents, and other lender requirements.

·      Manage the complete lender due-diligence process and coordinate responses to lender queries until approval, sanction, documentation, and disbursement.

·      Compare funding proposals across multiple providers based on advance rate, discount/interest rate, tenor, processing fees, arrangement fees, other charges, recourse vs. non-recourse, collateral/security requirements, repayment structure, and overall cost of capital.

·      Negotiate with lenders and funding providers to obtain competitive interest/discount rates, higher advance rates, suitable tenors, lower fees, and favorable financing terms.

·      Structure appropriate debt and working-capital facilities based on the company's trade cycles and funding requirements.

·      Explore and structure blended funding solutions, combining trade finance, trade credit lines, working-capital debt, alternative debt, equity, venture debt, or other suitable funding sources where required.

·      Evaluate whether debt, equity, venture debt, or a combination of funding sources is most appropriate for a particular funding requirement.

·      Continuously identify new domestic and international funding sources to reduce dependency on traditional collateral-based bank financing.

·      Liaise with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure that cross-border financing structures comply with applicable FEMA, RBI regulations, RBI ECB Guidelines, OFAC/sanctions requirements, AML/KYC requirements, UCP 600, and other applicable regulatory requirements depending on the transaction and jurisdiction.

·      Maintain a detailed funding pipeline covering potential lenders, discussions, applications submitted, due diligence, approvals, sanctioned limits, documentation, disbursements, outstanding facilities, and upcoming funding requirements.

·      Monitor approved credit lines, utilization, outstanding amounts, repayment schedules, available limits, and future funding requirements.

·      Report regularly to the CFO / Senior Management on funding opportunities, lender discussions, approved and sanctioned credit lines, disbursements, funding pipeline, financing terms, and cost of capital.

·      Take complete ownership of funding transactions from lender identification → initial discussion → application → due diligence → negotiation → credit approval → documentation → sanction → successful disbursement.

**Required Skills and Background**

·      4–10 years of relevant experience in Trade Finance, Export-Import Banking, Corporate Treasury, Debt Fundraising, Alternative Lending, Fintech Lending, NBFCs, or Banking/Financial Services.

·      Hands-on experience in raising or arranging trade finance, working capital, or alternative debt facilities.

·      Strong practical knowledge of Invoice Discounting, Factoring, Receivables Financing, Supply Chain Finance, Purchase Order Finance, LC, SBLC, Trade Credit, and other trade-finance instruments.

·      Experience dealing directly with international trade-finance fintechs, NBFCs, private credit funds, institutional lenders, or alternative funding providers.

·      Existing network or demonstrated ability to build relationships with global trade-finance fintechs and private credit funds.

·      Strong financial analysis, negotiation, relationship management, communication, documentation, and execution skills.

·      Practical understanding of FEMA, RBI regulations, RBI ECB Guidelines, OFAC/sanctions, AML/KYC, UCP 600, and applicable cross-border financing regulations.

·      Ability to independently manage funding transactions and deliver actual financing approvals and disbursements.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

·      Candidates who have personally sourced, negotiated, and successfully closed financing transactions will be strongly preferred.

·      Preference will be given to candidates who can demonstrate experience in:

·      Securing unsecured/non-collateralized or collateral-light funding

·      Raising trade finance and working-capital facilities

·      Building relationships with alternative lenders

·      Negotiating financing terms

·      Managing lender due diligence

·      Closing financing documentation

·      Obtaining successful fund disbursements

·      Managing multiple lenders and financing facilities

Candidates with an existing network of trade-finance companies, fintech lenders, NBFCs, private credit funds, or institutional funding providers will be strongly preferred.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience managing the complete accounts function of a small or medium-sized business and should be able to work independently with minimal supervision.

**1. Day-to-Day Accounting**

* Maintain books of accounts, including journal entries, ledgers, expenses and financial transactions.
* Handle accounts receivable and accounts payable.

**2. Payments & Banking**

* Process vendor payments, employee reimbursements and other company expenses.
* Prepare payment schedules and ensure timely payments.
* Track customer collections and outstanding receivables.
* Maintain proper documentation and approvals for all payments.

**3. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Prepare and file GST returns, including GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, and reconcile GST input tax credit.
* Calculate, deduct, deposit and file TDS returns.
* Manage Provident Fund (PF), ESI (where applicable), Professional Tax and other statutory payments and filings.
* Maintain records relating to gratuity and other employee statutory benefits.
* Ensure timely payment of applicable taxes and statutory dues.

**4. Payroll & Employee-Related Accounting**

* Process monthly payroll, including salary calculations, deductions and reimbursements.
* Maintain employee salary and statutory deduction records.
* Handle full-and-final settlements and leave encashment calculations.
* Coordinate statutory contributions and employee-related payments.

**5. Financial Reporting & Audit**

* Prepare monthly profit and loss statements, expense reports and basic MIS reports.
* Monitor cash flow, outstanding receivables and upcoming payment obligations.
* Assist with monthly and annual closing of accounts.
* Coordinate with the company's Chartered Accountant for audits, income tax filings and annual financial statements.
* Maintain accurate accounting records and supporting documentation.

**6. Inventory & Purchase Accounting**

* Record purchase invoices, supplier payments and purchase returns.
* Reconcile supplier statements and outstanding balances.
* Coordinate with procurement and production teams for invoice verification.
* Assist in tracking inventory purchases, material costs and stock reconciliation.

* **3–5 years of hands-on accounting experience**

   and Microsoft Excel.
* Good working knowledge of GST, TDS, PF, ESI and other applicable Indian statutory compliances.
* Experience independently handling accounts payable, receivable, payroll and bank reconciliations.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage deadlines and work independently.

Preferred Candidate

We are looking for a 
**hands-on accounts professional, not just a data-entry operator**

title: Senior Cost Manager - Civil
description:
**Company Details:**

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.
  
  
Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy, and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.
  
  
Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.
  
  
We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.
  
  
  
  
Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com

**Job Description**

**Role Overview**

As a Senior Cost Manager in Cost Management, you will be responsible for leading the execution of cost management services for construction projects, ensuring cost control and quality objectives are met. You are expected to lead cost management project teams and/ or key cost management roles, and coordinate with clients and stakeholders and foster a collaborative and high-performing project environment. This role also includes commission management responsibilities overseeing invoicing processes and project compliance through D-365 to ensure financial accuracy and compliance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Hold the highest level of professional integrity and business ethics.
* Contribute to a positive team culture by promoting open communication, mutual respect, and shared accountability.
* Demonstrate professionalism, reliability, and a proactive attitude in team interactions.
* Motivate team members, and drive towards positive client outcomes and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Assist in onboarding new team members and helping them integrate into project workflows.
* Assist in conducting interviews for vacant positions in line with the team’s recruitment process and resource requirements

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Lead multidisciplinary project teams including clients, consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
* Build productive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders through consistent follow-up and responsiveness.
* Support conflict resolution and issue management by escalating appropriately and offering practical solutions.
* Facilitate effective communication and collaboration across all stakeholders through structured meetings, reporting, and documentation.

**Project Strategy & Planning**

* Critically analyze, challenge and brainstorm project requirements and cost deliverables, in order to find creative solutions and alternatives on behalf of clients.
* Collaborate in developing robust cost reporting structures and control mechanisms.

**Project Controls & Reporting**

* Act as Commission Manager, taking responsibility for end-to-end service delivery, often with respect to large or complex commissions or multiple commissions.
* Managing estimating and cost planning activities to include taking ownership of and presenting the final revisions of cost plans.
* Leading the production of monthly post-contract cost reports and presenting them to the client.
* Leading value engineering and life cycle costing exercise.
* Implement and maintain cost controls mechanisms incorporated into projects’ schedule, cost, risk, and change management.

**Financial and Risk Management**

* Lead commercial negotiations and contract administration on projects alongside the cost management team
* Responsible for supporting the internal risk management procedures and systems, including client care processes and the contract database.
* Manage invoicing processes using D-365, including:
  + Reviewing and validating invoice data for accuracy and completeness.
  + Coordinating with finance teams to ensure timely submission and approval.
  + Tracking invoice status and resolving discrepancies.
  + Ensuring compliance with client billing requirements and internal financial controls.

**Qualifications**

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cost Management, Quantity Surveying, Construction, Engineering, or a related field; Master’s degree is a plus.
* 11-15 years’ experience in cost management or construction projects (e.g. cost manager, construction manager, procurement, project manager, vendor, consultant etc.).
* Strong communication and leadership skills; experience in people management in a plus.
* Strong business acumen, with the ability to drive outcomes on behalf of clients and coordinate with construction and design teams to meet deadlines and deliverables
* Experience in client management with solid experience in client facing environment that requires incumbent to utilise critical business development skills and advisory skills to enhance project delivery on value management, value engineering, and life cycle costing.
* Native-level proficiency in (local language), Business-level proficiency in English.
* Proficiency in Cost-X or equivalent cost estimation software.

**Additional Information**

**KPIs**

Your performance KPIs will be evaluated as part of every employee’s performance review process, including the following:

* Conduct quarterly check-ins with direct reports to provide feedback, identify growth opportunities and career development, as reflected in Peakon survey results.
* Set clear objectives during performance reviews, actively monitor progress, and apply insights to drive career growth and achieve professional goals.
* Successful project delivery by meeting agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards, with outcomes reflected through client care score.

* Maintain financial reporting through D-365, with 100% compliance to internal controls and client billing requirements.

title: FAAS FO Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS FAAS (Control and Compliance) - Senior position**
**The opportunity**
Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) professionals provide advisory services including Accounting and regulatory support for accounting change and special matters; accounting processes and controls support.
  
  
As an SOX professional, the individual should be a qualified CA/CPA/ACCA/MBA with experience in IFC and strong knowledge of SOX audit processes. The role involves handling large projects covering SOX implementation, documentation, control testing, internal control evaluation, financial reporting reliability, compliance, and operational efficiency.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Delivery and Subject Matter Expertise -**

* Execute SOX and IFC design, walkthrough, and implementation
* Perform business process reviews and create flowcharts and RCMs
* Conduct risk assessments and identify key accounts and transactions
* Prepare SOX documentation (narratives, flowcharts, RACM)
* Test design and operating effectiveness of controls and suggest improvements
* Lead SOX compliance phases including walkthroughs, testing, and reporting
* Support audit planning, execution, and reporting
* Ensure clear communication of control deficiencies and remediation
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Business Development & Solution Development -**

* Lead pursuit teams to understand client problem statements & formulate that in solutions
* Lead developing client specific solutions for the engagement team
* Lead proposal development or lead proposal teams
* Lead collaboration with market teams to develop relationship and drive business growth for EY
* Collaborate cross service lines to ensure smooth execution of the project.
* Lead development of internal capability development and lead training sessions to coach internal teams to develop capability
* Lead operational initiatives within the practice areas.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Business Skills and Knowledge –**

* Strong business development skills
* Very strong solution conceptualization/ideation skill
* Strong solution/product build skills
* Strong project management skills

**Human Skills –**

* Excellent written & oral communication & articulation
* Flexible work attitude
* Proven ability to lead diverse team over multiple geographies
* Strong collaboration skills
* Ability to comprehend complexity quickly & apply solutions
* Comfort in dealing with ambiguity
* Strong entrepreneurial skills in terms of ownership of problem & solutions
* Strong problem-solving skills
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure and deliver results
* Willingness to travel for short or long duration at short notice

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* CA/CPA/ACCA with 3+ years of relevant experience
* 2–7 years of experience in SOX/IFC implementation
* Experience in RACM, control testing, and remediation
* Strong understanding of COSO framework and PCAOB requirements
* Knowledge of financial statements (Indian/US GAAP)
* Strong analytical, communication, and teamwork skills
* Proficiency in Excel, Word, Visio, and MS Office tool
* Experience of working with international clients preferred
* Experience with previous multinational consulting firms or Big4 firms

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**PROGRAMME AND PROJECT SERVICES ANALYST**
**Purpose of the role**
The Programme and Project Services Analyst is part of the Central Portfolio Project Management Office (PMO) of the, Group COO Transformation Services.
  
  
The activities are centralized around the Portfolio/Programme Governance, assurance, resource and work planning & control, budget management, benefit management and change management. This role will act as a source of guidance and provide governance and metrics to the global change initiatives and in supporting the delivery leaders for making strategic decisions. This role helps initiatives adhere to the HSBC Change Framework, using the standard project management tools aligned to the group’s Strategic Tooling Spine such as Clarity and JIRA.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will Be**

* Support schedule/plan management, identify, and monitor internal/external dependencies and milestones for successful delivery of Portfolio/Programme outcomes in line with agreed delivery plans.
* Design and maintain delivery dashboards for insightful visualisation of flow of project plan, key milestones, dependencies to support decision-making. support and co-ordinate monthly Governance meetings and prepare materials for key Programme/ Project level meetings.
* Support portfolio investment allocations, benefit projections & a holistic view of the financial performance and ensure those are in line with defined Portfolio strategy, customers & business outcomes managing Portfolio/Programme resource capacity.
* Report on financial guardrails, ensure controls are in place and variances are tracked.
* Support in facilitating adherence to Change control around the business case commitments (funding, outcomes, and value delivered) and ensure Business cases are impact assessed and approved in line with agreed tolerances.
* Support management of portfolio/programme risks and issues through appropriate tracking and involving key members of the transformation team as needed.
* Support portfolio control monitoring activities that monitor quality and adherence to the standards, ensuring compliance to HSBC Change Framework, HSBC Functional Instruction Manuals, SAFE, AGILE etc.
* Above list is not exhaustive & covers core responsibilities expected of the resource securing the role. Additional responsibilities may form part of the role depending on the project, programme or portfolio where the resource is assigned / on boarded.

**To Be Successful You Will Be**

* Minimum 5 years’ relevant experience in project/programme/portfolio delivery, financial management, or PMO/PPM roles, and a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Business, Finance, Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Strong critical thinking—able to bring structure to ambiguous or large-scale problems and solve them systematically, logically, and independently.
* Proven analytical and problem-solving capability, with effective interpersonal communication and negotiation skills to drive outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management with a consultative approach to engaging internal clients and aligning priorities across teams.
* PPM standards & ways of working: Working knowledge of industry standards across Project/Programme/Portfolio management, including Waterfall and Agile delivery approaches.
* Financials, tools & certification (preferred): Understanding of billing, cost allocation/recharges, annual operating & investment planning, and investment/benefits reporting (including GPDM hierarchy), plus strong skills in MS Office (Excel/PowerPoint/Word) and PPM/change tools (Clarity, Jira, Confluence, HSBC Change Framework). Certifications such as PMP (or equivalent), P3O/MSP/MoP, and/or Agile certification are an advantage.

We are seeking an

You’ll work closely with Finance and IT teams to ensure smooth month‑end close, maintain the integrity of core financial modules, and help drive continuous improvement across our Record‑to‑Report processes. In this role, your expertise will help colleagues across regions work more efficiently and confidently using Oracle Fusion Cloud.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide functional and technical support for R2R‑related Oracle Fusion modules including General Ledger (GL), Fixed Assets (FA), Cash Management (CM) and associated integrations.
* Troubleshoot and resolve incidents, service requests, and enhancement needs related to financial processes.
* Support quarterly Oracle Cloud updates, perform R2R regression testing, and maintain related documentation.
* Collaborate with Finance teams to translate business requirements into system solutions.
* Work with third‑party vendors and Oracle engineers to resolve technical issues.

**Essential Requirements**

* 8+ years of experience supporting Oracle Fusion Cloud financial modules (GL, FA, CM).
* Strong understanding of R2R processes close cycles, reconciliations, asset accounting, financial reporting.
* Experience supporting global users across multiple regions.
* Familiarity with change management and compliance frameworks such as SOX.
* Fluency in English.
* Candidates are expected to work in a 24/7 Model in shifts covering all the time zones.

**Desired Skills (aligned With AVEVA Values)**

* Impact: Ability to identify process improvements that enhance financial accuracy and efficiency.
* Aspiration: Enthusiasm for mastering new Oracle features and contributing to transformation initiatives.
* Curiosity: Interest in emerging financial technologies, BI tools, and analytics capabilities.
* Trust: Strong stakeholder communication skills and reliability in handling sensitive financial data.

Our global team of 300+ IT professionals is responsible for the systems and platforms that keep AVEVA running. title: Senior Health Economics Consultant
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose. We move with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation. With Heart®
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Consultant, Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR): Evidence Evaluation to join our Access Consulting. As a Senior Consultant, you will provide scientific and technical leadership across evidence evaluation projects, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of systematic and targeted literature reviews that inform regulatory, reimbursement, and publication decisions.
  
  
You will lead key aspects of project delivery, provide methodological and scientific direction, and lead client-facing technical discussions and presentations, with opportunities to shape how evidence is generated and used across the industry.
  
  
You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through project leadership, scientific expertise, and the adoption of approved AI and technology-enabled approaches. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Consultant can guide and develop junior colleagues, contribute to business development, and expand their influence across evidence evaluation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Guide literature reviews for regulatory activities, HTA and JCA submissions, AMCP dossiers, global value dossiers, orphan drug designation, publications, and other evidence-generation needs, including the expected outputs for each purpose
* Lead project kick-off activities and client discussions, ensuring clear agreement on scope, methodology, deliverables, responsibilities, and timelines
* Provide expert input on review protocols, complex search strategies, and eligibility criteria, aligned with relevant JCA and national HTA requirements
* Guide screening, study selection, data extraction, and critical appraisal, and oversee the quality of these activities
* Provide overall direction on evidence synthesis and reporting, ensuring key findings, evidence gaps, limitations, and conflicting evidence are clearly identified and communicated
* Ensure all project deliverables meet client-ready quality standards, and monitor milestones, timelines, and project financial health
* Lead day-to-day client communication, present key findings, and take ownership of technical, methodological, and deliverable queries
* Lead, mentor, and develop junior team members through technical training, constructive feedback, and knowledge sharing
* Contribute to business development, including project scoping, change-order requests, and competitive proposals
* Contribute to abstracts, posters, manuscripts, and thought leadership on topics such as AI applications, JCA, and methodological refinements
* Apply approved AI and technology-enabled workflows across all stages of systematic and targeted literature reviews, with rigorous human quality oversight
* Maintain clear activity guidance, query logs, and decision records to support consistent application of agreed decisions across the project team

**You Will Thrive In This Role If You Bring**
Strong computing skills, particularly in MS Office
  
  
High analytical ability and a strong attention to detail, with a high degree of written accuracy
  
  
Good communication skills, both oral and written, especially in relaying technical information
  
  
Self-motivation, enthusiasm, and a flexible attitude toward new assignments and new learning
  
  
The ability to manage multiple and varied tasks and prioritize workload effectively
  
  
A genuine interest in medical research, healthcare provision, and the pharmaceutical industry.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Master's degree or equivalent in a life science or quantitative discipline, such as health economics, economics, mathematics, or statistics
  
  
8+ years of training and extensive experience in health economics, including the conceptualization and development of cost-effectiveness and budget impact models
  
  
Experience managing modeling projects and leading or coaching a project team
  
  
Fluent English, with excellent verbal and written skills.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience in a consultancy environment.
  
  
Experience with programming and software such as VBA, SAS, or R or R.
  
  
We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

title: Financial Analyst, Portfolio Valuation and Fund Advisory – Structured Products
description:
**Business Unit:**
Financial And Valuation Advisory
  
  
**Industry:**
Portfolio Valuation
  
  
**Overview**
Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.
  
  
**Financial and Valuation Advisory**
Over the past 50+ years, Houlihan Lokey has established one of the largest worldwide financial and valuation advisory practices. Our transaction expertise and leadership in the field of valuation inspire confidence in the financial executives, boards of directors, special committees, investors, and business owners we serve. In 2025, LSEG ranked us the No. 1 global M&A fairness opinion advisor over the past 25 years. Our stability, integrity, technical leadership, and global capabilities make us a trusted advisor for clients worldwide, across a wide range of services, including the Transaction Opinions, Transaction Advisory Services, Corporate Valuation Advisory Services, Portfolio Valuation and Fund Advisory Services, Real Estate Valuation and Advisory Services, and Dispute Resolution Consulting practices.
  
  
**Structured Products Valuation Advisory**
Drawing on our extensive experience analyzing, structuring, securitizing, underwriting, investing in, and trading whole loans and structured credit instruments, our professionals employ thorough analytical methods and powerful proprietary modeling techniques. Our valuation process incorporates robust market data to provide clients with superior valuation and advisory services that reflect current market developments for all structured products.
  
  
Our professionals have analyzed multibillion-dollar portfolios of individual securities, whole loans, and everything in between on behalf of originators, hedge funds, private equity funds, banks, insurance companies, fund administrators, and other financial institutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The Financial Analyst position presents an excellent career opportunity for you to join our rapidly growing firm. Financial Analysts within our Financial Valuation Advisory Services business are fully integrated members of our engagement teams. You will work with a dedicated, highly talented staff of professionals who will give you a broad exposure to many issues and concerns affecting businesses today.
  
  
We offer a unique opportunity to work on a wealth of projects that provide exposure to various financial advisory challenges, including the valuation of complex securities. You will also have an opportunity to interact with clients on active engagements and participate in the firm’s marketing efforts. After completing training specific to certain valuation techniques, databases and tools, your general responsibilities will include the following:
  
  

* Analyzing and valuing various structured products, asset-backed loans, loan pools and other illiquid securities
* Determining relevant valuation assumptions based on historical performance, collateral type, and economic scenarios
* Utilizing a discounted cash flows framework to derive value indications at appropriate market discount margins / yields
* Performing market research; calibrating proprietary valuation models to incorporate market-based assumptions
* Reviewing and compiling published financial information, such as industry research reports, remittance data, and market data across a wide range of asset classes
* Preparing client deliverables including valuation reports, pitch materials and information requests
* Participating in due diligence meetings/discussions and drafting responses to auditor questions regarding valuation analyses prepared by Houlihan Lokey
* Participating in presenting valuation analyses and conclusions internally to review committees, externally to our clients’ senior management and boards of directors, and to fiduciaries
* Performing quantitative and qualitative assessments on distribution reports, financial statement, and other sources of information, as required
* Assisting in the researching and reporting on (a) general economic conditions, (b) industry-specific conditions and trends, and (c) various investment attributes of illiquid securities
* Assisting with sales and marketing initiatives for prospective and existing clients
* Performing other ad-hoc research, analytics, and support for the FVA project teams as required

**Qualifications**
The environment at Houlihan Lokey is collegial and entrepreneurial and, as such, rewards staff with substantial responsibility and interaction with senior-level professionals and clients. The ideal candidate thinks strategically, is motivated, detail oriented, creative, outgoing, possesses strong quantitative skills and exhibits exceptional work ethic. The Financial Analyst will primarily support Structured Products valuation professionals in the Portfolio Valuation & Advisory Services practice and will gain broad exposure to a wide range of assets.
  
  
The following general qualifications are required:
  
  

* The ideal candidate should have 1-3 years of work experience
* Completed CFA Level 1
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in finance, accounting, business, applied mathematics, statistics, engineering, or equivalent quantitative field
* A fundamental understanding of financial valuation theory, methodologies, and applications
* Understanding of basic probability and statistical concepts
* Strong analytical abilities including demonstrated ability to model discounted cash flows
* Strong problem solving skills and the ability to work through complex financial models to determine the key assumptions, implicit caveats and limitations
* Strong knowledge of Excel
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to prepare reports and presentations to team and clients, including graphic and written sections
* Demonstrated ability to work cooperatively with team members
* Ability to work independently in a fast paced environment
* An exceptional work ethic and attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple projects and interact with clients and internal management
* Flexibility to travel to client site for due diligence meetings as required

title: Manager - Finance
description:

**Division**
Piramal Critical Care
  
  
Piramal Critical Care (PCC), a business unit of Piramal Pharma, is the fourth-largest producer of inhaled anesthetics and a global player in hospital generics. The strategic locations of our facilities help us supply high-quality products around the world, timely at optimal costs.
  
  
For more details, please visit https://www.piramalcriticalcare.com/global/
  
  
Job Title
  
  
Manager - Finance
  
  
**Job Description**
Piramal Critical Care (PCC) is a global pharmaceutical business with operations across 7+ entities spanning the US, UK, Netherlands, Italy, India, South Africa and Australia. We are looking for a finance professional to support our FP&A, MIS, planning and finance transformation agenda. The role will primarily focus on executing monthly management reporting, supporting Anaplan and Qlik-based reporting operations, assisting in budgeting and forecasting cycles, and supporting PCC's SAP S/4HANA reporting transition — ensuring timely and accurate financial information to support business decision-making.
  
  
**Business:**
Piramal Critical Care
  
  
**Department:**
Finance
  
  
**Location:**
Kurla, Mumbai
  
  
**Travel:**
Low
  
  
**Reporting to**
Chief Manager – Finance (FP&A, Management Reporting & Finance Transformation)
  
  
**Essential Qualification & Experience**
CA / MBA Finance with 5–8 years of experience in FP&A, MIS or commercial finance, preferably in
  
  
a global / multi-entity environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Monthly Management Reporting & MIS

+ Support timely release of monthly sales flash on the 2nd working day; coordinate with entity controllers and 3PL teams to validate data accuracy and resolve discrepancies.
+ Prepare and consolidate monthly MIS reports across PCC entities, including P&L, balance sheet, product margin and KPI schedules.
+ Execute the monthly MIS production cycle through Anaplan, replacing the legacy Excel-based process.
+ Process inter-company stock margin elimination workings, including SKU-level reconciliation, GIT inclusion, entity-level validation and analytical checks.
+ Prepare variance analysis (Actual vs. Budget vs. Prior Year), supporting schedules, exhibits and analytics requested by senior management.

* Budgeting, Forecasting & Long-Range Planning

+ Assist in preparation of the annual budget across PCC entities, including data collection, template population, consolidation and validation of submissions.
+ Collect, validate and consolidate forecast inputs from Sales, SCM, Site Controllers and Corporate Finance; assist in preparing weekly revenue trackers, monthly EBITDA forecasts and rolling outlook submissions.
+ Support preparation of financial performance statements and supporting workings for Long-Range Planning (LRP) cycles.
+ Prepare profitability analysis across products, customers, entities and businesses (IA, IP, Other Pharma, ITT, CHG).
+ Support cashflow forecasting and working capital reporting workings in coordination with site finance and corporate finance teams.

* Anaplan & Qlik Operations

+ Maintain Anaplan modules covering Actuals, Budget, Forecast, P&L, Balance Sheet and Cashflow reporting across PCC's global entities.
+ Execute data uploads, mapping updates, hierarchy maintenance, version freeze/rollover and module validations.
+ Maintain Qlik dashboards covering Revenue, Product Margin, AR Ageing, MTD Daily Sales, Reporting Margin Variation and Fixed Asset reporting.
+ Execute Qlik rollover activities for FY budget cycles; ensure smooth data flow between Anaplan, EDP and Qlik.
+ Provide inputs to Business IT and EDP teams on AR Intelligence dashboard requirements (SAP S/4HANA customer master + Azure sales master linkage).
+ Liaise with PwC, Anaplan technical teams and Piramal IT on day-to-day issue resolution and minor enhancements.

* SAP S/4HANA Transition Support

+ Support readiness for SAP ECC → S/4HANA migration (India go-live Apr 2026; rest of entities Dec 2026).
+ Execute mapping updates for revenue pipelines, GL mappings, profit centre, cost centre hierarchy, capex/loan/manual GL logic and product master integration.
+ Coordinate with PwC, SAP team, EDP and the broader project team on parallel-run validations during transition.

* Daily Sales & 3PL Reporting

+ Maintain the MTD Daily Sales dashboard; support entity controllers in adoption, capture of manual finance adjustments and reconciliation.
+ Support automation of SAP entries for 3PL sales and manage source file structure changes across geographies.

* Leadership Reporting & Stakeholder Coordination

+ Prepare supporting slides and data exhibits for MBR, PEC, Finance Opscomm, Townhalls, Board decks and ExComm reviews.
+ Coordinate with global finance stakeholders, entity controllers, corporate teams and external partners (PwC) to ensure timely closure of deliverables.
+ Escalate issues and risks to the Chief Manager – Finance in a timely manner.

* Process Documentation & Governance Support

+ Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for Anaplan modules, Qlik dashboards and MIS processes.
+ Support exception tracking, escalation logs and process review activities.

**Key Competencies**

* Hands-on experience in Anaplan, Qlik Sense, SAP / S/4HANA and advanced Excel; Power BI a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with sharp attention to detail.
* Exposure to system implementation or ERP migration projects preferred.
* Good stakeholder coordination skills across geographies and time zones.
* Process orientation, ownership mindset and ability to deliver under tight deadlines.
* Comfort working in a transformation-heavy, fast-paced environment.
* Digital & AI Skill

+ Leverage AI and automation tools to enhance financial analysis, forecasting, reporting and management insights, improving speed and quality of decision-making.
+ Demonstrate an AI-first mindset by identifying and implementing use cases that simplify FP&A processes, automate repetitive activities and improve finance productivity.

**Why Join Us**
This is an opportunity to be part of a dynamic commercial finance team driving one of the most significant finance transformation journeys within the Piramal Group. You will gain hands-on exposure to Anaplan, Qlik and SAP S/4HANA across a global pharmaceutical business, work closely with senior leadership and contribute meaningfully to building a future-ready finance operating model

description:
Job Description – Research Analyst / Senior Research Analyst – US Equities
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**Department:**
Research
  
  
**Experience:**
3–8 Years
  
  
**Industry:**
Capital Markets / Equity Research / Investment Banking / Asset Management
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced US Equity Research Analyst to conduct in-depth fundamental research and analysis of US-listed companies and sectors. The role involves identifying investment opportunities, developing financial models, analysing market trends, and delivering actionable research insights to support investment and trading decisions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Equity Research: Conduct fundamental research on US-listed companies, sectors, and industries to identify investment opportunities.
* Financial Modelling & Valuation: Develop and maintain financial models, earnings forecasts, and valuation frameworks using DCF, comparable company analysis, and other relevant methodologies.
* Market Analysis: Monitor US equity markets, macroeconomic developments, Federal Reserve policies, earnings announcements, and sector-specific trends.
* Investment Recommendations: Generate actionable investment ideas, stock recommendations, and research reports supported by detailed analysis.
* Earnings & Portfolio Tracking: Analyse quarterly earnings, company guidance, financial performance, and key business developments.
* Research Publications: Prepare company initiation reports, earnings updates, sector outlooks, and market commentaries.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with the Research Head, trading desks, and investment teams to provide timely market insights and research support.
* Risk Assessment: Evaluate company-specific, sectoral, valuation, and macroeconomic risks associated with investment recommendations.

Desired Candidate Profile
  
  

* 3–8 years of relevant experience in equity research, preferably covering US equities or global developed markets.
* Strong understanding of US equity markets, listed companies, sector dynamics, and investment strategies.
* Hands-on experience in financial modelling, financial statement analysis, and company valuation.
* Ability to independently research companies, build investment theses, and generate actionable stock ideas.
* Familiarity with Bloomberg, Refinitiv, FactSet, Capital IQ, or similar financial databases.
* Strong analytical, quantitative, report-writing, and presentation skills.
* Understanding of US market regulations, corporate disclosures, and financial reporting standards.
* Willingness to work flexible hours to accommodate US market developments, earnings announcements, and business requirements.

**Educational Qualifications**

* MBA / PGDM in Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.
* CFA / CA or equivalent professional qualifications preferred.

**Preferred Candidate Background**
Professionals from equity research firms, institutional broking houses, investment banks, asset management companies, hedge funds, or global research teams with direct exposure to US-listed equities.
  
  
**Key Hiring Requirement:**
Candidates must have hands-on experience in fundamental equity research, financial modelling, and valuation, with the ability to independently generate well-researched investment ideas on US-listed companies. Direct US equity coverage experience will be strongly preferred.

title: Financial Director
description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for a hands-on Finance Director to run day-to-day financial reporting, cost control and P&L management for a growing, multi-unit hospitality group in Mumbai.

This is an execution-focused role: pulling information out of outlets, kitchens, purchase teams and

vendors, turning it into accurate reporting, and using it to actively manage costs, cash flow and

profitability.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Financial Planning & Budgeting

• Prepare annual budgets, monthly/quarterly forecasts and rolling cash-flow and profitability

projections for the group and each outlet, tracking actuals against budget and chasing down variances.

2. Management Information System (MIS)

• Prepare the group's MIS - daily revenue flash, weekly P&L, monthly management accounts and outlet-

wise P&L - with cost percentages, margins, EBITDA and variance explanations.

3. Cost Control & Profitability

• Monitor food, beverage, labour and operating costs with the F&B Cost Controller; track inventory

variances, wastage and vendor pricing to catch leakage and fix recurring issues with operations and

kitchen teams.

4. Purchase & Vendor Controls

• Run the purchase-order process against budgets and approved rates, track vendor balances and

payment schedules, and benchmark rates to flag duplicate or inflated purchases.
5. Events & Commercial Pricing

• Work out event contribution margins and pricing against minimum-margin requirements, and review

profitability after each event to sharpen future pricing.

6. Cash Flow & Treasury

• Prepare weekly cash-flow forecasts, plan payment runs, track receivables and collections, and flag

cash-flow gaps early.

7. Capex & New Projects

• Prepare pre-opening and project budgets, track capex and vendor commitments against approvals,

and build financial models for new locations.

8. Outlet Financial Accountability

• Set clear monthly targets for each outlet, then walk through performance with the GM every month -

what was budgeted, what actually happened, why, and what's being done about it.

9. Compliance, Accounting & Statutory Matters

• Handle monthly closing, keep books accurate, and coordinate with CAs, auditors and tax consultants

on GST, TDS, income tax and annual audits.

10. Partner Reporting

• Prepare group- and outlet-wise reporting on revenue, margins, EBITDA, cash position and key risks for partner review.

11. Coordination & Follow-Through

• Work alongside the Accounts and Cost Control team day to day, keep SOPs followed on the ground,

and support better systems and less manual reconciliation.

**Skills & Competencies**

• Financial: P&L management, budgeting & forecasting, cash-flow management, cost accounting, variance

analysis, working-capital & capex tracking, statutory compliance.

• Hospitality/Commercial: Restaurant P&L, food & beverage costing, inventory control, vendor

management, event profitability, outlet-level profitability, labour-cost management.

• Systems: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets, accounting/ERP systems, POS and MIS dashboards - used hands- on, daily.

**Personal Attributes**

• Hands-on and detail-oriented - comfortable doing the legwork of pulling numbers together, not just

reviewing what others prepare.

• Organised and analytical, with strong follow-through on chasing information from the right people

until variances are explained.

• Able to work directly with founders, partners, GMs and vendors, and communicate financial

information clearly to non-finance colleagues.

• Most importantly: reliable and thorough - someone who executes and turns raw information into

accurate, timely reporting, every time.

**Key Performance Indicators**

• Accuracy and timeliness of MIS, P&L delivery and reporting.

• Budget-vs-actual performance and reduction in financial leakage or unexplained variances.

• Food and beverage cost improvement and vendor cost optimisation.

• Purchase compliance, cash-flow visibility and capex control.

• Statutory compliance and reduced partner involvement in day-to-day financial administration.

**The Person We Are Looking For**

We're not looking for someone who only reviews numbers other people have prepared. We need a hands-on Finance Manager who pulls data from outlets, the kitchen, vendors and the accounts team, puts it together accurately, and follows up until the numbers add up — while still getting the day-to-day books right.

Please share you CV and cover letter to:

hr@lalocamaria.in

anders@lalocamaria.in

title: Risk Reporting 2LOD Sr. Analyst, Assistant Vice President
description:
As a Senior Market Risk Reporting Analyst, you will shape how market risk is measured, monitored, and reported across Citi's key European and UK legal entities. You will join the EMEA Legal Entity Market Risk Reporting team at a pivotal time, combining regulatory-grade production reporting with the opportunity to build advanced portfolio analytics using Python, automated data pipelines, and interactive dashboards. This role places you at the intersection of risk management, data science, and regulatory compliance, giving you direct visibility into Citi's cross-asset risk profile.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Produce, analyze, and present comprehensive market risk profiles across Rates, FX, Credit, Equities, and Commodities.
* Conduct deep-dive analysis on key risk measures, including Value at Risk, Expected Shortfall, Factor Sensitivities, Issuer and Concentration Risk, and Firmwide Stress Testing.
* Ensure legal entity compliance with European and UK regulatory frameworks, including ECB, PRA, FCA, and EBA standards.
* Deliver auditable analytics for regulatory examinations, ICAAP exercises, and periodic regulatory filings.
* Maintain a strong control environment across the data lifecycle and identify data quality issues at the source.
* Drive remediation of data issues in partnership with first-line and technology teams.
* Apply Python, machine learning, and statistical modeling to detect anomalies in risk movements and automate risk commentary.
* Partner with Market Risk Managers, Traders, Structurers, and Legal Entity Risk Officers to explain P&L and risk fluctuations.
* Design and deploy interactive dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, and Python to transform static risk reporting into real-time analytics tools.
* Oversee the governance, calibration, and monitoring of market risk limits and early warning triggers.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* You bring 5+ years of experience in a Markets-focused function at a large financial institution, ideally within a risk discipline.
* You hold a solid understanding of financial markets and risk management practices across asset classes and financial products.
* You work effectively both independently and as part of a team to deliver on project objectives.
* You apply strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills to complex risk questions.

**Beneficial Skills & Qualifications**

* You have experience running projects successfully from initiation through completion.
* You combine Tableau or Power BI expertise with Python coding skills.
* You bring a data-driven mindset, with experience in SQL, Tableau, Python, and workflow automation tools such as Alteryx.
* You hold a bachelor's degree in a related scientific discipline, along with a master's degree.
* You hold or are working toward a financial qualification such as FRM or CFA.

What We Offer
  
  
Join a team at the center of Citi's market risk oversight, where your analytical insight will directly influence regulatory reporting and governance for the bank's largest European and UK entities.
  
  

* Work in a hybrid model with three days in the office and two days working remotely each week.
* Collaborate with risk, trading, and technology teams across Citi's global network.
* Access structured learning and development opportunities to build regulatory, analytics, and data science expertise.
* Benefit from programs supporting financial wellbeing, family support, and work-life balance.
* Gain visibility and influence within Citi's risk governance framework as you shape how market risk is reported and monitored.

Apply today to help shape the future of market risk reporting and analytics at Citi.

title: Analyst - Accounting
description:
**Main purpose**

This role is responsible for the accounting, reporting and control of the Trading legal entities with primary responsibilities of monthly closing of the books, entity-specific accounting policy, legal entity maintenance, account reconciliation & account structure management. The role will require an in-depth understanding of these entities including their business strategies, associated technical accounting and disclosure requirements.

**Key responsibilities**

**Balance Sheet Review & Control**

* Provide and support input into the end-to-end control and ownership of legal entity balance sheets for the division supported

* Drive the monthly financial close which entails analytical review and sign off of the balance sheet, profit and loss accounts for entities of the specified trading division

* Perform the month end close process including but not limited to revenue recognition checks, stock verification and valuation, debtors aging along with provision review, intercompany & related party balance confirmation

* Ensure strong control framework by implementing and maintaining effective internal controls

* Address ad hoc requests from various stakeholders and counterparts like consolidation, and regional accounting teams

* Coordinate with multiple teams on matters relating to intercompany settlements, transfer pricing, legal, compliance

* Analyse impact of various journals and processes on trial balance areas.

* Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual MIS packs, dashboards and KPI reports for management.
* Ensure timely and accurate month-end close inputs and reconciliation of reports.

**Audit**

* Liaise with external auditors during the group & statutory audits

* Coordinate with various functions to provide auditable support & evidence to external auditors

* Prepare audit documentations and walkthrough

**Change Management**

* Drive change projects to support any accounting policy changes or new reporting requirements for the legal entities in scope

* Challenge the current processes for improvement and constantly review processes for efficiencies

* Identify and escalate control gaps, data discrepancies and process improvement opportunities.

**Tax Accounting**

* Oversee accurate tax accounting, monthly tax provisions and tax-related financial reporting across assigned legal entities.

* Ensure timely preparation, review and filing of corporate income tax returns and compliance with local tax regulations.

* Support Pillar Two reporting, transfer pricing requirements and intercompany tax assessments.

* Coordinate with tax advisors, manage tax audits and assessments, and monitor tax payments, filing deadlines and overall tax risks

**Required qualifications**

* Minimum  1-3 years experience in Accounting.
* Chartered Accountant / post-graduation accounting qualification
* Determined and able to take end-to-end ownership
* Keen to question and challenge the existing processes with a view of creating reporting efficiencies and improvements
* Can work with multiple data sets, various systems and Excel
* Eager to take up fresh challenges and support the team wherever required
* Comfortable to work with non-accounting teams for regular activities and projects

**Attributes for success**

* Strong interpersonal skills
* Eager to take up fresh challenges and support the team wherever required

 

**Department overview**

The Financial Control & Reporting team operates across various APAC and MEA locations, acting as the entity-level financial reviewer, reporting to the Regional Controller. The team plays a critical role in ensuring accurate accounting, reviewed financial statements, compliance with applicable accounting standards, and effective financial controls across all legal entities. This covers both trading and non-trading entities, including financial reporting, reconciliations, P&L and balance sheet oversight, tax accounting, tax compliance, and ensuring accurate tax provisions and disclosures while mitigating financial and tax risks.

title: Growth & Revenue Lead
description:
**About Project Noon**

Project Noon is building India's first Sun Control brand- reimagining how people protect, comfort, and recover from everyday sun exposure. We believe the future of sun care goes far beyond sunscreen, and we're creating an entirely new category of products designed to help people live better under the sun.

Built at The Foundery, backed by Nikhil Kamath, Kishore Biyani, and Ronnie Screwvala, Project Noon is being built as a next-generation consumer brand with the ambition to define a new category from India for the world. By combining breakthrough product innovation, thoughtful design, and world-class brand building, we're creating a company that's changing the way millions of people experience the sun.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Revenue Lead to own and drive Project Noon's revenue performance across every sales channel. This is a high-ownership, commercially focused role for someone who can connect the dots between channel strategy, sales execution, marketing investment, customer behaviour and business profitability.

You will be responsible for translating the company's growth ambitions into clear channel-wise targets and actionable plans across D2C, e-commerce marketplaces, quick commerce and general/traditional trade. You will build the revenue planning and reporting discipline that helps the business understand where growth is coming from, what is holding it back, and where to place its next bets.

This role works closely with the Founder and is a central partner to Performance Marketing, Brand, Finance, Supply Chain and external channel partners. It offers the opportunity to shape the commercial engine of an ambitious, early-stage consumer brand as it scales.

**Experience:**

Minimum 5 years of relevant experience across fast growing FMCG brands

**Work arrangement:**

Full-time, on-site | Worli, Mumbai

**Key Responsibilities:*****Revenue Strategy & Channel Ownership***

* Own the overall revenue plan and delivery against monthly, quarterly and annual business targets.
* Develop channel-wise growth strategies and targets across D2C, e-commerce marketplaces, quick commerce and GT/MT.
* Track revenue, orders, average order value, repeat behaviour, channel mix and growth trends; identify gaps and build clear action plans.
* Identify opportunities to improve channel productivity, expand distribution, increase product visibility and accelerate sell-through.
* Build a strong understanding of the economics, operating models and growth levers of each channel.

***Commercial Planning & Performance***

* Build and maintain revenue forecasts, budgets, monthly business plans and channel-wise performance dashboards.
* Monitor net sales, gross-to-net movements, discounts, promotions, commissions, trade spends and contribution margins.
* Strategize on & Evaluate the commercial impact of offers, bundles, pricing, assortment, launches and channel-specific promotions.
* Partner with Finance to track revenue realisation, channel costs, profitability, reconciliations and business performance.
* Use data to distinguish between topline growth and profitable, sustainable growth.

***Channel Partner & Account Management***

* Build and manage working relationships with marketplace, quick-commerce and other channel partners.
* Coordinate with channel teams on onboarding, assortment, catalogue readiness, visibility plans, promotional calendars and business reviews.
* Track channel-specific requirements, commercial terms, campaign opportunities and execution timelines.
* Work with partners to address sales or operational bottlenecks and improve availability, discoverability and conversion.

***Growth & Cross-Functional Collaboration***

* Work closely with the Performance Marketing Associate to connect paid media performance with overall revenue outcomes, channel priorities and business targets.
* Collaborate with Brand and Creative teams to translate consumer, category and channel insights into campaigns, launches, offers and growth initiatives.
* Partner with Supply Chain & Operations on demand forecasts, inventory availability, replenishment priorities and launch planning to minimise stock-outs and excess inventory.
* Work with Finance to ensure that revenue reporting, budgets, channel costs and profitability metrics are accurate and timely.
* Bring together insights from D2C, marketplaces and quick commerce to identify what is working, what is not, and where the business should focus.

***Reporting & Business Reviews***

* Own the weekly and monthly revenue review cadence, including channel-wise performance against targets.
* Create clear, decision-oriented reports that explain performance drivers, risks, opportunities and recommended actions.
* Establish consistent metrics, reporting definitions and processes so that leadership has a reliable view of business performance.
* Translate analysis into decisions and follow through to ensure agreed actions are implemented.

**What We're Looking For**

* A minimum of 5 years of experience in revenue, sales, business growth, category management, e-commerce or commercial roles.
* Previous experience in fast-paced FMCG or consumer brands is ideal; experience in D2C, beauty, skincare, personal care, wellness or lifestyle is highly relevant.
* Strong understanding of multi-channel consumer businesses, ideally spanning D2C, e-commerce marketplaces and quick commerce.
* Demonstrated ability to own revenue targets, build forecasts and translate business goals into channel-level plans.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including familiarity with net revenue, gross margins, contribution margins, discounts, trade spends and channel economics.
* Comfortable working with data, building and interpreting dashboards, and using Excel/Google Sheets to drive decisions.
* Strong stakeholder and partner-management skills, with the ability to work across internal teams and external platforms.
* A hands-on, ownership-oriented approach and the ability to operate in a fast-paced startup environment.

**Key Stakeholders & Liaison**

* Founder: revenue priorities, business reviews, growth plans and key commercial decisions.
* Performance Marketing Associate: paid marketing performance, acquisition efficiency, channel contribution and budget priorities.
* Finance: budgets, revenue reporting, reconciliations, channel costs and profitability.
* Brand & Creative: product launches, campaigns, promotions, consumer insights and channel-specific marketing plans.
* Supply Chain & Operations: demand planning, inventory availability, replenishment and fulfilment readiness.
* External channel partners: marketplace, quick-commerce and other sales-platform teams.

﻿

**Preferred Traits**

* Commercially sharp, analytical and comfortable taking ownership of business outcomes.
* A builder mindset: able to create structure, reporting rhythms and processes where they do not yet exist.
* Able to move between strategic thinking and hands-on execution.
* Curious about consumer behaviour, category trends and the evolving Indian beauty and personal-care landscape.
* Clear communicator who can influence stakeholders and turn insights into action.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, pace and the demands of building a new consumer category.
* Candidates from Tier-1 institutions will be preferred.

*Project Noon is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diverse perspectives and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.*

We pride ourselves in fostering an environment based on both continuing education and enabling employees to take on new responsibilities and become business leaders. As the second-largest real estate private fund administrator, we offer a full suite of financial products to our clients, from general accounting and tax planning to outsourced services and investor relations. **About EisnerAmper:**
EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with nearly 4,000 employees and more than 400 partners across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.

  Strong analytical mindset, high attention to detail, and excellent communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.

  Master-level knowledge of data manipulation tools, including XLOOKUP/Index-Match, Power Query, nesting formulas, and basic VBA/Macros.

  Strong understanding of data modeling, creating relationships between disparate tables, and writing custom

title: Analyst - Accounting
description:

This role is responsible for the accounting, reporting and control of the Trading legal entities with primary responsibilities of monthly closing of the books, entity-specific accounting policy, legal entity maintenance, account reconciliation & account structure management. The role will require an in-depth understanding of these entities including their business strategies, associated technical accounting and disclosure requirements.

**Key responsibilities**

**Balance Sheet Review & Control**

* Provide and support input into the end-to-end control and ownership of legal entity balance sheets for the division supported
* Drive the monthly financial close which entails analytical review and sign off of the balance sheet, profit and loss accounts for entities of the specified trading division
* Perform the month end close process including but not limited to revenue recognition checks, stock verification and valuation, debtors aging along with provision review, intercompany & related party balance confirmation
* Ensure strong control framework by implementing and maintaining effective internal controls
* Address ad hoc requests from various stakeholders and counterparts like consolidation, and regional accounting teams
* Coordinate with multiple teams on matters relating to intercompany settlements, transfer pricing, legal, compliance
* Analyse impact of various journals and processes on trial balance areas.

* Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual MIS packs, dashboards and KPI reports for management.
* Ensure timely and accurate month-end close inputs and reconciliation of reports.

**Audit**

* Liaise with external auditors during the group & statutory audits
* Coordinate with various functions to provide auditable support & evidence to external auditors
* Prepare audit documentations and walkthrough

**Change Management**

* Drive change projects to support any accounting policy changes or new reporting requirements for the legal entities in scope
* Challenge the current processes for improvement and constantly review processes for efficiencies
* Identify and escalate control gaps, data discrepancies and process improvement opportunities.

**Tax Accounting**

* Oversee accurate tax accounting, monthly tax provisions and tax-related financial reporting across assigned legal entities.
* Ensure timely preparation, review and filing of corporate income tax returns and compliance with local tax regulations.
* Support Pillar Two reporting, transfer pricing requirements and intercompany tax assessments.
Coordinate with tax advisors, manage tax audits and assessments, and monitor tax payments, filing deadlines and overall tax risks  

  

**Required qualifications**

* Minimum 1-3 years experience in Accounting.
* Chartered Accountant / post-graduation accounting qualification
* Determined and able to take end-to-end ownership
* Keen to question and challenge the existing processes with a view of creating reporting efficiencies and improvements
* Can work with multiple data sets, various systems and Excel
* Eager to take up fresh challenges and support the team wherever required
* Comfortable to work with non-accounting teams for regular activities and projects

**Attributes for success**

* Strong interpersonal skills
* Eager to take up fresh challenges and support the team wherever required

**Department overview**

The Financial Control & Reporting team operates across various APAC and MEA locations, acting as the entity-level financial reviewer, reporting to the Regional Controller. The team plays a critical role in ensuring accurate accounting, reviewed financial statements, compliance with applicable accounting standards, and effective financial controls across all legal entities. This covers both trading and non-trading entities, including financial reporting, reconciliations, P&L and balance sheet oversight, tax accounting, tax compliance, and ensuring accurate tax provisions and disclosures while mitigating financial and tax risks.

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Responsibilities**

* Benefit from programs supporting financial wellbeing, family support, and work-life balance.
