title: Cloud Finops Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced
**Cloud FinOps Engineer**
with
**9-12 Years of experience**
having experience in optimizing AWS cloud spending, improving financial visibility, and driving cost efficiency across the organization.

The ideal candidate will work closely with Finance, IT Leadership, Cloud Platform Engineering, DevOps/SRE, and application teams to improve cloud cost forecasting, establish cost accountability, and deliver measurable cost savings while maintaining application performance, scalability, and reliability.

**Job Requirements**

* Hands-on experience in Cloud FinOps, AWS Cost Management, or Cloud Financial Analysis.
* Strong understanding of AWS billing and cost management.
* Experience with AWS Cost Explorer, Cost and Usage Reports (CUR), Savings Plans, and Reserved Instances.
* Understanding of cloud resource tagging, cost allocation, budgeting, and forecasting.
* Experience identifying and implementing AWS cost optimization strategies.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial reporting.
* Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Good to Have**

* Knowledge of SQL for cloud cost data analysis.
* AWS certifications related to Cloud, Solutions Architecture, or Cloud Financial Management.
* Experience working with large-scale AWS environments.
* Understanding of cloud infrastructure, resource utilization, and architecture from a cost optimization perspective.
* Familiarity with FinOps frameworks and best practices.

**Job Responsibilities**

**1. Cloud Cost Analysis**

* Analyze AWS spending, usage trends, cost drivers, budget variances, and anomalies.
* Identify opportunities for cloud cost optimization.
* Monitor cloud consumption patterns and provide recommendations to improve cost efficiency.

**2. AWS Cost Optimization**

* Drive resource rightsizing and idle-resource cleanup.
* Optimize storage costs and manage non-production environment scheduling.
* Evaluate and recommend AWS Savings Plans and Reserved Instances.
* Identify opportunities to reduce cloud infrastructure costs without compromising performance or reliability.

**3. Tagging & Cost Allocation**

* Define and implement AWS tagging standards.
* Ensure tagging compliance across cloud resources.
* Improve cost attribution and allocation across teams and projects.
* Implement showback and chargeback practices.

**4. Financial Planning & Forecasting**

* Develop cloud budgets, financial forecasts, and cost models.
* Perform scenario analysis to support cloud investment decisions.
* Work with Finance teams to improve budgeting accuracy and financial visibility.

**5. Savings Realization & Reporting**

* Track cost optimization initiatives and assign accountability to respective owners.
* Validate actual savings achieved against projected savings.
* Prepare regular reports on cloud spending, cost trends, and optimization progress.
* Establish cost controls, budget alerts, and dashboards.

**6. Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Finance, Engineering, Procurement, AWS representatives, and vendors.
* Work with DevOps/SRE and application teams to identify cost optimization opportunities.
* Drive FinOps best practices and promote cost-conscious cloud usage across the organization.

**Benefits**

* Innovative Engineering: Collaborative, fail-fast, flat hierarchy. Fosters learning, initiative, curiosity.
* Masterful Development: Emphasizes clean code, SOLID principles, TDD/BDD. Utilizes robust CI/CD and polyglot engineering.
* Continuous Growth: Structured mentorship, masterclasses, Geeknights, workshops, continuous skill enhancement, blog contributions.
* Agile & Client-Centric: Adopts Agile (Scrum, XP), promotes project ownership and deep client understanding for impactful solutions.
* Supportive Environment: Healthy work-life balance, flexible schedules, comprehensive benefits (generous leave), strong team-building.

title: Finance Manager
description:
**The Finance Manager**
will be responsible for overseeing the company's financial operations (customer invoicing & supplier payments), accounting and financial reporting. The role will partner closely with the company leadership team to ensure financial discipline, improve profitability and support strategic business decisions.

**Responsibilities:**

**Revenue and Billing Management:**

* Oversee revenue tracking, invoicing, unbilled revenue, deferred revenue, and accounts receivable.
* Ensure revenue is recognized in accordance with applicable accounting standards and contractual terms.
* Coordinate with sales, delivery, and project management teams to ensure timely and accurate client billing.
* Monitor contract milestones, purchase orders, timesheet approvals, and billing schedules.
* Identify revenue leakage and resolve billing disputes in coordination with relevant stakeholders.

**Supplier Payment Processing and Vendor Management:**

* Oversee end-to-end supplier payment processing, ensuring payments are accurate, timely, and in accordance with agreed payment terms and company policies.
* Review and verify supplier invoices, purchase orders, goods or service confirmations, and supporting documentation before payment approval.
* Prepare and review payment runs, maintain payment schedules, and ensure appropriate authorization in accordance with the company's approval matrix.
* Maintain proper documentation and audit trails for all supplier payments and ensure compliance with internal controls and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Identify opportunities to streamline and automate accounts payable processes, reduce payment errors, and improve processing efficiency.

Project and Client Profitability

* Monitor project-wise, client-wise, and service-line profitability.
* Track project budgets, resource utilization, billable hours, realization rates, and delivery costs.
* Analyze the financial impact of fixed-price, time-and-materials, managed services, and other client contracts.
* Monitor subcontractor costs, offshore and onsite delivery costs, and employee bench costs.

Accounting and Financial Reporting

* Review general ledger accounting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, payroll accounting, and month-end closing undertaken by accounting firm.
* Ensure timely preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
* Strengthen financial controls, accounting procedures, and documentation.

**Skills and Competencies:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related discipline.
* Typically 7–10 years of relevant finance and accounting experience.
* Strong financial analysis, accounting, and management reporting skills.
* Experience in the IT services industry and understanding of IT services business models, project economics, resource utilization, and client profitability.
* Knowledge of revenue recognition principles and contract-based billing.
* Experience with ERP/accounting systems and financial reporting tools.
* Advanced Excel skills.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and commercial judgment.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and work in a fast-paced environment.
* High standards of integrity, accuracy, confidentiality, and professional ethics.

title: Senior Revenue Accountant (ASC 606 Contract Review)
description:
**At Precisely, we're not just building software — we're shaping the future of data integrity.**
As a global leader in data quality, data enrichment, and location intelligence, Precisely helps thousands of the world's most trusted brands make confident decisions with data they can rely on. We're an AI-first organization, which means artificial intelligence isn't a buzzword here — it's woven into how we build products, how we work, and how we think about solving complex problems for our customers. When you join Precisely, you join a team of curious, driven innovators who believe that better data makes the world run better. If you're ready to do meaningful work at the intersection of AI and data — and help define what's possible — we'd love for you to apply!
  
  
**Overview**
You are an experienced Senior Revenue Accountant with 5+ years of accounting experience and deep expertise in revenue recognition under ASC 606. You will be a key member of our Corporate Revenue Accounting team based in India, leading technical reviews of customer contracts (both short-form and long-form) so that revenue is recorded correctly under our policies. You will analyze distinct performance obligations, evaluate non-standard terms, and partner closely with Sales, Legal, Deal Desk, and our US-based Revenue Accounting leadership to document conclusions and drive consistent application of our revenue recognition standards. You will also prepare revenue forecast schedules, support monthly and quarterly close activities, and respond to internal and external audit queries, including statutory audits across our global entities. We are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, communicates clearly with cross-functional and cross-region partners, and manages multiple priorities to firm deadlines. You will report to the Manager, Revenue Accounting and partner with cross-functional and global teams across the organization.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Lead technical reviews of customer contracts under ASC 606, including identifying distinct performance obligations, allocating the transaction price, and determining the timing of revenue recognition during pre and post contract negotiation phases.
* Document revenue recognition conclusions in deal-specific technical accounting memos and advise Sales, Legal, and Deal Desk on non-standard contract terms, including carveouts, geographic clearances, and multi-element arrangements.
* Prepare revenue forecast schedules with supporting tickmarks, post monthly and quarterly revenue journal entries, and complete account reconciliations and variance analyses.
* Prepare and post monthly and quarterly revenue journal entries, account reconciliations, and variance analyses.
* As primary point of contact, manage and respond to internal and external audit requests for statutory audits across our global entities, providing supporting documentation, contract evidence, revenue analyses and follow up query resolution.
* Own key quarterly revenue accounting controls related to go-to-market business motions that are not accounted for under ASC 606 in NetSuite ARM.
* Work across NetSuite, NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management, Blackline, and Salesforce to execute close activities and maintain supporting evidence for revenue conclusions.
* Manage your own time and deadlines, accurately determine task duration and dependencies, and communicate status updates to your manager on a regular basis.

**What We Are Looking For**
**This role requires alignment with the US workday and will involve working a regular night shift from India (approximately 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST / 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM EST). Flexibility during quarter-end and year-end close periods is expected.**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Commerce (equivalent work experience will be accepted in place of the education requirement).
* 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 3 years focused on revenue accounting in a multinational software or SaaS environment.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience applying ASC 606 to software, SaaS, or similar contract-based environments, including reviewing customer contracts and documenting performance obligation analysis.
* Working knowledge of US GAAP, with proficiency researching authoritative accounting literature and performing technical analysis; strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and the broader Microsoft 365 suite.
* Comfortable working US time zone hours with US-based stakeholders, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* AI Skills/Knowledge:

+ Able to apply AI tools (such as Microsoft Copilot) to review contract language at scale and surface non-standard or higher-risk terms for further review by the revenue team.
+ Critically evaluates AI-generated outputs against authoritative accounting literature and source contracts before incorporating them into technical memos or revenue conclusions.
+ Open to continuously adopting new AI capabilities to streamline contract review, the monthly close, and reporting workflows.

* Preferred Skills:

+ Hands-on experience with NetSuite and NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management (ARM).
+ Familiarity with Blackline, Salesforce, and Alteryx or similar analysis and automation tools.
+ 2-3 years of current or previous Big 4 or national tier public accounting firm audit experience.
+ CA, CPA, or equivalent qualification, and familiarity with multi-element software and SaaS contracts, including subscription, term license, and professional services arrangements.

title: OTC Analyst
description:
**Role Overview**
The OTC Analyst is responsible for independently managing cash collections, resolving complex customer disputes, and maintaining accurate accounts receivable balances for a defined portfolio of key customers. This position plays a critical role in the Order‑to‑Cash (OTC) cycle by ensuring timely collections, analyzing overdue items, driving effective dispute resolution, and partnering with internal and external stakeholders. Strong execution in this role supports cash flow stability, reduces financial risk, and strengthens customer relationships across Versigent’s EMEA operations.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Collections & Dispute Operations:
* Manage assigned customer accounts end‑to‑end, ensuring timely follow‑ups and effective resolution of open items.
* Work closely with Cash Application and Billing teams to maintain a holistic view of customer account activity.
* Prepare accurate cash collection forecasts, highlight risks, and escalate issues proactively.
* Review past‑due and current‑due items using HRC and initiate targeted collection actions.
* Secure and document “Promise to Pay” commitments in HRC.
* Communicate with customers via email, portals, and HRC to resolve payment issues, clarify invoice details, and negotiate next steps.
* Investigate overdue items and initiate actions to ensure collection of unpaid balances.
* Manage overdue receivables using the HRC Collections Workflow and support cycle‑time improvement.
* Monitor, track, and escalate broken promises in accordance with escalation protocols.
* Gather remittances from customers and provide necessary details to Cash Application.
* Support Cash Application in payment matching, clarifications, and reconciliation of customer accounts.
* Prepare key reports (past‑due aging, forecasting, collection notes) for team reviews and leadership updates.
* Identify and recommend opportunities for process improvements and improved customer account performance.
* Participate in customer calls and provide timely updates on account status.
* Provide documentation required for internal and external audits.
* Execute manual dunning activities and send Statements of Account (SOA) to customers.
* Prepare and submit write‑off proposals for business unit approval in line with company procedures.
* Review incoming claims/deductions and gather supporting documents to validate their accuracy.
* Build dispute cases (e.g., price discrepancies, shortages) and update reason codes in internal systems.
* Validate data from internal systems and customer documents to determine appropriate resolution paths.
* Respond to disputes professionally, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and timely closure.
* Escalate disputes or claims where timely feedback has not been provided.
* Partner with internal departments (Sales, Customer Service, Billing, Logistics) to resolve disputes efficiently.
* Participate in continuous learning activities and internal training sessions.
* Drive implementation of at least one Lean initiative or improvement project within the OTC process.
* Financial Control & Reporting:
* Ensure compliance with Versigent policies, procedures, and internal control requirements.
* Support leadership in actions that improve overall cash collection efficiency.
* Plan, organize, and manage assigned customer portfolios with accountability.
* Act as a primary Point of Contact (POC) for assigned customers or internal stakeholders.
* Ensure accurate categorization and confidentiality of customer data.
* Uphold Versigent’s values and ethics in all OTC process activities.
* Prepare and deliver documentation for internal and external audits.
* Support reconciliation of accounting ledgers, customer balances, and dispute records.
* Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement:
* Updating and maintaining Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Address process-related questions and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Identify and participate in improvement opportunities within collections or dispute processes and propose solutions.
* Support or lead smaller automation or efficiency initiatives (e.g., reporting simplification, HRC enhancements).
* Participate in cross-functional projects and improvement sessions as assigned.
* Stakeholder Collaboration:
* Demonstrate strong business partnering skills with internal teams and external customers.
* Communicate and coordinate effectively with Sales, Finance, Billing, Customer Service, and third‑party teams.
* Build and maintain strong professional relationships to support timely issue resolution.
* Represent the OTC function professionally during cross‑functional calls and meetings.
* Other Responsibilities
* Perform additional tasks assigned by the Team Leader or Manager in support of OTC operations.

**Basic Requirements (R – Required, P – Preferred)**
Education & Experience
  
  

* Above 1 year of experience in OTC, Collections, Disputes, or AR processes (R)
* Experience with bad debt reserves and write‑off procedures (P)
* Experience executing at least one OTC improvement project within the last two years (P)
* Knowledge of billing and payment regulations across EMEA (P)

Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong MS Office skills: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint (R)
* Strong knowledge of SAP or another ERP platform (P)
* Strong analytical skills and ability to make decisions using limited information (R)

Soft Skills
  
  

* Effective customer relationship and business partnering skills (R)
* Strong organizational skills; detail‑oriented and results‑driven (R)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; very good command of English (R)
* Active listening, negotiation, and conflict‑resolution capabilities (R)

Ice Cream is the largest global Ice Cream Company in the world, with over 100 years of experience delivering a diverse range of indulgent, yet responsible, craft food experiences and treats delighting consumers. Committed to innovation, quality, and sustainability we have 35 brands, including 3 one billion Euro brands (Magnum, Wall’s, Ben & Jerry’s), a strong presence in over 60 countries, generating annual revenue of over $8 billion. All brands are driven to transform moments into memories through indulgent yet responsibly made and marketed products. We have a well-developed strategy to deliver growth and value creation which is clear on where to play and how to win. We turn the ordinary into the extraordinary by designing unique and innovative Ice Cream experiences that make life taste better, creating joyful experiences. In our Ice Cream business, we’re crafting the future through innovation and imaginative minds, creating unique products. We spark moments of happiness for people and within the communities where we operate. However, it is not as simple as it may seem. As Ice Cream makers we are serious about happiness. With warm hearts, we create the coolest products.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Sr. Specialist is responsible for the day-to-day operational excellence and delivery of the Invoice-to-Cash lifecycle across the global regions. This role acts as a critical bridge between global process standards and regional execution, ensuring that the Third-Party Service Provider (3PSP) performs O2C activities at the keystroke level with accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with business requirements. The role focuses on “running the engine”- supporting vendor performance, resolving operational issues, and ensuring that order management, invoicing, collections, and dispute processes are executed seamlessly in the global market context.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 1. Operational Oversight & Vendor Management
  
  

* 3PSP Coordination: Act as the primary point of coordination and escalation for the 3PSP vendor, ensuring delivery of O2C services including collections, cash applications, credit management and dispute management meets contractual SLAs.
* Keystroke-Level Governance: Monitor execution quality in transactional systems (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Serrala, SAP-FSCM), ensuring adherence to Global Process Owner (GPO) standards.
* Service Delivery: Oversee timely execution of daily and period-end O2C processes including order entry, billing cycles, cash application, and collections follow-ups. 2. Regional Performance & Execution
* KPI Accountability: Own delivery of key O2C KPIs, including: Days Sales Outstanding (DSO), Cash Collection Effectiveness, Dispute Resolution Cycle Time, Cash Application on Time, etc.
* Operational Reviews: Conduct weekly/monthly performance reviews with the 3PSP and stakeholders to address service gaps and drive improvements.
* Exception Management: Identify and resolve issues such as blocked orders, billing errors, overdue receivables, and disputes. 3. Process Localization & Compliance
* Standardization Adherence: Ensure O2C operations are aligned with global O2C standards, minimizing deviations unless business-critical.
* Documentation & Knowledge: Maintain regional SOPs and ensure 3PSP documentation (SOPs, DTPs) is accurate and up to date.
* Audit & Controls: Ensure compliance with internal controls, SOX requirements, credit policies, and data privacy regulations. 4. Technology & Tactical Enablement
* System Utilization: Ensure effective use of SAP S/4HANA, and other supporting O2C tools like Serrala for Cash Applications, SAP-FSCM for Credit Management, Collections and Disputes Management.
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Support/lead testing for system changes or deployments, ensuring all the requirements are validated.
* Data Integrity: Ensure accuracy of master data (customer master, pricing, credit limits, payment terms). 5. Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Alignment
* Regional Bridge: Act as liaison between Commercial, Customer Service, Finance (AR/Credit), and Global GPO teams.
* S&OP Integration: Work with sales and customer teams to resolve order blocks, disputes, and improve customer experience.
* Conflict Resolution: Manage trade-offs between revenue realization, customer service, and risk (credit exposure). 6. Issue Resolution & Continuous Improvement
* Identify root causes of recurring O2C issues (billing errors, delayed collections, disputes).
* Drive corrective actions with 3PSP and internal stakeholders.
* Support automation and process improvement initiatives in O2C operations.

**What You Need To Succeed**
Experiences & Qualifications
  
  

* University degree in Finance, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or related field.
* 10+ years of experience in Order-to-Cash, Accounts Receivable, or Customer Operations.
* Significant track record managing 3PSPs or BPO partners in a high-volume, keystroke-level environment.
* High "Super-User" comfort level with SAP S/4HANA, SAP-FSCM, and Serrala.
* Experience navigating the diverse market landscape of global regions and managing stakeholders across different time zones and languages. Must have competencies
* Analytical Thinking
* Strategic Vision
* Communication Skills
* Problem Solving
* Collaboration
* Leadership
* Adaptability

**Why join us?**
This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
  
  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
  
  
**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.

title: Head of Finance
description:
**Job Title:**
Head of Finance

About Eternal Robotics

Eternal Robotics operates in the areas of AI, Robotics, Computer Vision, and industrial automation. We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Head of Finance to lead our finance function, strengthen financial controls, ensure accounting accuracy, and support business growth through effective financial planning and management.

**Role Overview**

The Head of Finance will be responsible for the overall finance and accounting function, with primary accountability for accounting quality, financial reporting, cash flow management, working capital, statutory compliance, audit, banking relationships, and corporate finance.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical accounting knowledge, hands-on experience managing finance operations in a smaller or growing organisation, and the ability to communicate financial insights to senior management, the Board, auditors, and shareholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Accounting, Financial Reporting and Controls**

* Lead the complete accounting function and ensure accurate, complete, and timely financial records.
* Own the monthly closing process and ensure management accounts and MIS are reviewed and issued by the 5th working day of the following month.
* Review journals, accruals, provisions, project revenue, costs, and account reconciliations.
* Establish and strengthen financial controls, approval matrices, maker-checker processes, and segregation of duties.
* Lead statutory audits and maintain audit-ready financial records and schedules.
* Develop and maintain finance policies and SOPs.

**2. Cash Flow and Working Capital Management**

* Prepare and manage a rolling 13-week cash flow forecast.
* Monitor cash flow, payment schedules, budgets, receivables, and payables.
* Review payment proposals against approved budgets and cash flow forecasts.
* Lead annual budgeting and periodic financial forecasting.
* Monitor project-level profitability and working capital requirements.

**3. Accounts Receivable and Collections**

* Oversee customer invoicing based on contractual and project milestones.
* Monitor receivables ageing and follow up on overdue collections.
* Coordinate with Sales and Project teams to resolve billing and collection issues.
* Ensure customer balances and TDS reconciliations are accurate.

**4. Costing, Pricing and Vendor Negotiations**

* Develop and review project costing and pricing models.
* Evaluate project margins before commercial proposals are released.
* Lead supplier negotiations relating to pricing, payment terms, and credit facilities.
* Track actual project margins against quoted margins.

**5. Banking and Treasury**

* Manage banking relationships, account operations, mandates, authorised signatories, and banking facilities.
* Ensure compliance with the approved payment and spending framework.
* Manage foreign inward remittances and related documentation, including FIRC.

**6. Tax and Regulatory Compliance**

* Oversee GST returns, input tax credit reconciliation, e-invoicing, and e-way bills.
* Ensure timely TDS deductions, deposits, quarterly returns, and Form 16/16A issuance.
* Manage income tax returns, advance tax, tax audits, and assessments.
* Oversee transfer pricing documentation and Form 3CEB filings.
* Ensure compliance with Companies Act requirements for related-party transactions.
* Manage FEMA/RBI reporting, including FC-GPR, FC-TRS, and annual FLA returns, as applicable.
* Maintain the statutory compliance calendar and ensure timely filings.

**7. Corporate Finance and Strategic Support**

* Prepare funding requirements, cash runway analysis, and financial scenarios.
* Manage working capital and debt financing requirements.
* Support shareholder funding, equity, and ESOP-related matters.
* Prepare financial reports, analysis, and inputs for Board presentations and strategic decisions.

**Mandatory Qualifications and Experience**

* Chartered Accountant (CA – ICAI) is mandatory.
* 10–12 years of experience in Accounting and Finance.
* At least 3–4 years of experience independently managing the finance function of a smaller or growing organisation.
* Strong hands-on experience in accounting, month-end closing, reconciliations, financial reporting, and statutory audits.
* Practical experience in GST, TDS, Income Tax, and Transfer Pricing.
* Experience with FEMA/RBI compliance in an organisation with foreign shareholding is strongly preferred.
* Experience in technology, manufacturing, engineering, or project-based businesses is preferred.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Indian Accounting Standards and financial reporting.
* Accounting controls, audit management, and financial governance.
* Cash flow forecasting and working capital management.
* GST, TDS, Income Tax, Transfer Pricing, Companies Act, and FEMA/RBI compliance.
* Project costing, pricing, and profitability analysis.
* Banking, treasury, and vendor negotiations.
* Advanced MS Excel and financial MIS reporting.
* Zoho Books or similar cloud-based ERP systems.
* Strong leadership, accountability, communication, and stakeholder management.

**Key Competencies**

* Financial Accuracy
* Accountability and Ownership
* Commercial Acumen
* Leadership and Team Development
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Management

title: Digital Customer Insights & Renewal Intelligence Specialist
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
  
  
**The Role**
Digital Customer Success provides structured, scalable Customer Success engagement for customers outside dedicated one-to-one coverage. The function combines customer intelligence, proactive risk identification, digital engagement, and cross-functional coordination to help customers realize value and enable account teams to take timely, informed action.
  
  
You will own the account-intelligence and renewal-risk workstream, converting multi-source customer data into repeatable health reviews, early-warning insights, portfolio reporting, and actionable Customer Success narratives. The role combines hands-on analysis with process ownership, data quality, stakeholder coordination, and automation readiness.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**Account health reviews:**
Build standardised reviews that combine renewal timing, product usage, entitlement, support activity, training, certification, version adoption and customer sentiment into clear strengths, risks and recommended actions.
  
  
**Early-warning and risk analysis:**
Maintain risk inputs, logic, thresholds and tiering; validate outputs and distinguish genuine customer risk from data gaps.
  
  
**Portfolio and segmentation:**
Maintain priority account cohorts using approved segmentation rules, renewal timing, risk triggers and stakeholder inputs.
  
  
**Renewal intelligence:**
Track renewal cohorts, surface concerns early and prepare account-level inputs for regional renewal reviews.
  
  
**Risk and leadership reporting:**
Produce concise account and portfolio reporting with evidence, data-quality caveats and recommended follow-up.
  
  
**CRM health narratives:**
Draft and maintain clear health, risk and next-step entries aligned to the review cadence.
  
  
**Data and source management:**
Extract, reconcile and quality-check information from CRM, BI, usage, support, training, version and survey sources.
  
  
**Cross-functional collaboration:**
Work with account teams, Customer Success Operations and technical data owners to validate context and recommendations.
  
  
**Documentation and controls:**
Maintain source links, definitions, standard operating procedures, quality checks, templates and cadence calendars.
  
  
**Automation and enablement:**
Help translate review and risk-reporting processes into scalable workflows while preserving quality and traceability.
  
  
What You'll Need
  
  
**Experience:**
3–5 years in Customer Success operations, customer-health or renewal analytics, business analytics, data analytics or comparable work.
  
  
**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Analytics, Business, Information Systems or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  
  
**Data capability:**
Advanced Excel skills and demonstrated experience handling and reconciling multiple data sources.
  
  
**Reporting tools:**
Hands-on experience with a business intelligence tool such as Power BI and experience working with CRM data.
  
  
**Business judgement:**
Working understanding of customer health, adoption, churn or attrition risk, renewals and Customer Success operating models.
  
  
**Communication:**
Ability to convert complex evidence into concise, defensible narratives and practical recommendations for business stakeholders.
  
  
**Operating discipline:**
High attention to detail, source traceability, documentation quality and recurring delivery commitments.
  
  
**Preferred / Nice To Have**
**Customer Success platforms:**
Experience with Gainsight or a comparable platform.
  
  
**Data and automation:**
Exposure to Snowflake or other data-warehouse extracts, Power Query, SQL, scripting or workflow automation.
  
  
**Relevant models:**
Experience developing health scores, early-warning models, renewal dashboards or executive account reviews.
  
  
**Industry context:**
Experience in B2B enterprise software or industrial software.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
**Reliable delivery:**
Account reviews, risk refreshes, reports and CRM narratives are accurate and completed against an agreed operating calendar.
  
  
**Actionable insight:**
Account teams can understand the evidence, validate the context and act on the recommendations.
  
  
**Data integrity:**
Material data gaps are visible and tracked rather than being misclassified as customer risk.
  
  
**Scalability:**
Processes and controls are documented and progressively standardised or automated without reducing quality.
  
  
How This Role Works
  
  
This role supports customers and internal stakeholders across multiple regions and requires effective collaboration in a globally distributed environment. The role enables account teams with structured insights or scaled engagement and does not replace commercial account ownership.

* Global operating model: Proven track record of building and scaling India-based Centers of Excellence that partner with US/EMEA senior leadership; ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate complex technical-financial topics into clear business narratives.

title: Project Management/Consultant Specialist
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**
**Role Purpose**
The PMO supports effective governance, financial management, workforce oversight and operational performance across HSBC Technology portfolios. The role provides accurate management information, financial analysis, resource allocation oversight and governance coordination to support portfolio leads, operations management and senior stakeholders.
  
  
The role holder works closely with technology, finance, workforce management and portfolio stakeholders to maintain appropriate controls, improve data quality, monitor operational and financial performance, and support informed decision-making. The role requires strong analytical and organisational skills, sound judgement, stakeholder management capabilities and the ability to identify exceptions, drive corrective actions and deliver reporting in a complex technology environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Programme and Portfolio Governance**

* Establish and maintain appropriate governance processes, controls and reporting routines to support effective portfolio oversight.
* Monitor adherence to established governance requirements, operational processes and data quality standards across assigned portfolios.
* Coordinate governance activities and follow up on outstanding actions with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain accurate and consistent portfolio information to support transparency, accountability and effective management oversight.

**Planning and Delivery Management**

* Support portfolio planning and operational coordination by consolidating financial, resource and performance information.
* Monitor portfolio performance against agreed financial and operational objectives, identifying variances and areas requiring management attention.
* Coordinate with portfolio leads, Business Partner owners and other stakeholders to address emerging concerns and support corrective action planning.
* Support resource allocation and forecasting activities to maintain alignment between portfolio requirements, resource utilisation and financial expectations.

**Risk, Issue and Dependency Management**

* Identify and monitor operational, financial and data-quality exceptions that may affect portfolio performance, governance or financial control.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to investigate discrepancies, resolve outstanding issues and ensure appropriate corrective actions are implemented.
* Escalate material or unresolved concerns through established management channels, providing clear information on the issue, its potential impact and the actions required.
* Promote timely resolution of exceptions through regular monitoring, stakeholder follow-ups and effective action tracking.

**Financial and Resource Management**

* Support portfolio financial governance through budget monitoring, actuals analysis, forecast reviews and financial variance reporting.
* Consolidate financial information across portfolios, markets, projects and applications to provide visibility of expenditure, budget utilisation and potential cost efficiencies.
* Coordinate resource allocation tracking and reconcile resource-related cost information to support financial accuracy and transparency.
* Monitor resource time booking and allocation information, identifying discrepancies and coordinating corrections with relevant stakeholders.
* Support the identification of cost optimisation opportunities, including the review of application expenditure and resource-related costs.
* Ensure financial and resource management information is accurate, timely and appropriately validated to support governance and management decisions.

**Management Information and Reporting**

* Deliver accurate and insightful status reporting for senior stakeholders, including dashboards, KPIs and portfolio performance updates.
* Analyse and validate data across workstreams, highlight trends and exceptions, and provide concise management information to support decisions on financial performance and workforce governance.
* Highlight trends, exceptions and emerging concerns rather than simply reporting activity.
* Ensure reporting is tailored to the audience, from detailed working-level information to concise executive summaries.

**Stakeholder and Team Collaboration**

* Build effective working relationships with Operations Managers, portfolio leads, Business Managers, Tech Leads and other relevant stakeholders.
* Coordinate with technology, finance, workforce management and resource management teams to address portfolio governance and operational matters.
* Drive accountability for outstanding actions through structured follow-ups, appropriate escalation and clear communication of requirements.
* Provide financial and operational insights to portfolio leadership to support planning, performance management and decision-making.
* Facilitate collaboration across stakeholder groups to resolve discrepancies, improve compliance and maintain effective portfolio operations.
* Provide guidance and coaching to PMO analysts and less experienced colleagues.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to simplify reporting, improve governance and increase delivery efficiency.
* Standardise PMO processes, templates and controls where appropriate.
* Use data and lessons learned to improve future programme performance.
* Support the adoption of tooling and automation for planning, reporting and governance activities.
* Contribute to the development of the wider PMO community and professional standards.

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:
  
  

* Significant experience in a PMO, technology portfolio management, business management, financial governance or operational management environment.
* Experience in management information reporting, KPI monitoring, data analysis and executive-level reporting.
* Ability to analyse complex information, identify exceptions and present clear, actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, coordination and escalation skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with experience using enterprise reporting, analytics and portfolio management tools.
* Experience working in financial services, banking or a large, complex technology environment is desirable.
* Relevant professional qualifications in project, programme or portfolio management are desirable.
* Relevant professional qualification, such as PMP, PRINCE2, is desirable.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
  
www.hsbc.com/careers
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Manager Credit Initiation
description:
**Job Summary**
This role exists to support sustainable retail portfolio growth by making prudent, timely and consistent credit decisions for mortgage and wealth management products. The role evaluates customers’ creditworthiness, risk exposure, affordability and application quality to ensure lending decisions align with the Bank’s credit policies, risk appetite, regulatory obligations and business objectives.
  
  
The role balances risk management with customer experience by ensuring credit applications are assessed accurately, efficiently and consistently. It contributes to portfolio quality, operational effectiveness and business growth through sound underwriting judgement, risk assessment and continuous process improvement.
  
  
The role also supports the evolution of credit operations by identifying opportunities to improve turnaround times, strengthen controls, support product launches and contribute to operational initiatives that enhance service delivery and decision-making effectiveness. Where applicable, the role provides operational guidance, supports team capability development and helps maintain underwriting consistency across the function.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Credit Assessment & Underwriting**

* Assess retail mortgage and wealth management applications to deliver prudent credit decisions that balance customer needs with portfolio risk objectives.
* Evaluate customer financial profiles, affordability, repayment capacity and credit history to determine appropriate lending outcomes.
* Apply credit policies, underwriting standards and delegated authorities consistently to support high-quality credit decision-making.
* Escalate complex or higher-risk cases appropriately to ensure sound risk governance and decision integrity.

**Credit Risk & Fraud Management**

* Identify, assess and mitigate credit and fraud risks that may affect portfolio quality or customer outcomes.
* Apply regulatory requirements and internal risk controls to ensure lending decisions remain compliant and defensible.
* Detect indicators of potential fraud, misrepresentation or suspicious activity and initiate appropriate escalation processes.
* Support a strong risk culture through disciplined application of credit policies and controls.

**Operational Excellence & Process Improvement**

* Improve underwriting efficiency by identifying process enhancements that reduce turnaround times while maintaining control effectiveness.
* Contribute to operational initiatives that enhance service quality, productivity and customer experience.
* Support the implementation of new products, policy changes and process enhancements to ensure operational readiness.
* Use operational insights and performance trends to recommend improvements in credit assessment and workflow management.

**Business Support & Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with Product, Sales, CRM, Fraud Risk, Lending Operations and support teams to facilitate effective credit assessment and application processing.
* Provide underwriting expertise that supports business growth initiatives, marketing campaigns and new product introductions.
* Resolve credit-related queries and exceptions by collaborating with relevant stakeholders to achieve balanced customer and risk outcomes.
* Contribute operational insights to projects and initiatives that improve the effectiveness of the end-to-end lending process.

**Governance, Compliance & Controls**

* Ensure credit decisions and operational activities comply with regulatory requirements, Bank policies and internal control standards.
* Maintain accurate documentation and audit readiness to support transparency and regulatory compliance.
* Apply anti-money laundering and financial crime prevention requirements, escalating suspicious activities where appropriate.
* Support governance activities that strengthen underwriting consistency, policy adherence and operational risk management.

**Motivations**

* Building trusted, long‑term relationships that deliver sustainable, risk‑adjusted growth.
* Aligning products, regions and stakeholders around clear strategic priorities.
* Applying sector‑ and segment‑specific knowledge and judgment to solve complex client problems and create value, leveraging data and AI‑enabled insights to deepen client understanding, sharpen focus and drive commercial impact.

**Skills And Experience**
**Priority Skills**

* Application Processing
* Banking Strategy
* Compliance Audit
* Compliance Monitoring
* Continuous Improvement
* Financial Services

**Other Skills**

* Create Credit Policy
* Credit Administration
* Credit Management
* Operational Monitoring
* Risk Assessment
* Stakeholder Engagement

**Qualifications**

* Experience in regulated financial services environments where risk, compliance and customer outcomes are closely managed.
* Exposure to retail lending, mortgage, wealth management or consumer banking products involving structured credit assessment frameworks.
* Experience in high-volume processing environments requiring strong judgement, prioritisation and attention to detail.
* Exposure to cross-functional collaboration involving Product, Sales, Operations, Risk and Control functions.
* Experience supporting operational improvement initiatives focused on efficiency, service quality and control effectiveness.

• Coordinate the operational risk toolkit: risk and control self-assessment, key risk indicators and loss-event data.

•Track regulatory developments relevant to risk and assess their impact, prepare and file risk-related regulatory returns within timelines, and support the annual review of risk policies and risk appetite.

title: Power trading
description:
**Company Description**
Kundan Group is one of India’s leading manufacturing and exporting companies, with a diverse portfolio spanning gold and precious metals, refineries, cosmetics, chemicals, agro commodities, polymers, petro products, bullion imports, and pharmaceutical items. Recognized by the Government of India as a Four Star Trading House, Kundan is also a nominated agency and ISO 9001-2008 certified, reflecting strong quality and compliance standards. Headquartered in New Delhi, India, the group has a turnover exceeding USD 4 billion and employs around 700 people worldwide. As a bulk importer, exporter, and manufacturer, Kundan has secured exclusive licensing partnerships that strengthen its global presence. The company emphasizes ethical conduct, ambitious growth, and a core set of values that guide its corporate culture and long-term vision.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Power Trading role based in Delhi, India. The role involves monitoring power markets, demand-supply trends, and regulatory updates to identify trading opportunities and manage risk exposures. Responsibilities include executing power purchase and sale transactions, coordinating with utilities, generation companies, and internal stakeholders, and maintaining accurate records of trades and positions. The role also requires preparing daily and periodic reports on market movements, portfolio performance, and forecasts, as well as supporting the development of trading strategies aligned with the group’s business objectives. The Power Trading professional will collaborate closely with finance, operations, and compliance teams to ensure efficient settlement, adherence to regulatory requirements, and optimization of trading margins.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong analytical and quantitative skills, including proficiency in data analysis, forecasting, and basic financial modeling.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of power markets, energy trading mechanisms, demand-supply dynamics, and relevant regulatory frameworks in India.
* Candidates should possess solid communication and negotiation skills to manage interactions with counterparties, internal teams, and external stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess good proficiency in MS Excel and other relevant software tools for market monitoring, reporting, and portfolio management.
* Candidates should possess strong attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to work accurately under time-sensitive conditions.
* Relevant experience in power trading, energy markets, or commodities trading is highly beneficial.
* A bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Finance, Business, or a related field is preferred; advanced qualifications in energy or finance are an advantage.
* Candidates should possess a commitment to ethical practices and alignment with Kundan Group’s core values and growth-focused culture.

title: Financial Controller
description:
**Job Description – Finance Controller (UAE – Dubai)**

**Experience:**
8+ years of post-qualification experience

**Qualification:**
Chartered Accountant (CA)

**Location:**
New Delhi, India

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Finance Controller to lead and manage the overall finance and accounting function for our UAE business operations. The role will be responsible for end-to-end financial controllership, financial reporting, budgeting, taxation, statutory compliance, internal controls and business finance.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of UAE financial regulations and taxation, along with experience in managing finance operations in a fast-paced, multi-location business environment. The role will also involve close coordination with the India/HQ finance team to ensure alignment of financial reporting, governance and business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Financial Controllership & Reporting**

* Lead the end-to-end accounting and financial controllership function for UAE operations.
* Manage monthly, quarterly and annual financial closures.
* Ensure accurate preparation and review of P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statements and management reports.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, including IFRS.
* Oversee revenue recognition, expense accounting, provisions, accruals and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Drive timely and accurate financial reporting to senior management and the India/HQ finance team.

**2. UAE Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Manage UAE VAT compliance, including return preparation, filing and reconciliations.
* Oversee UAE Corporate Tax compliance, assessments and filings.
* Ensure adherence to applicable UAE financial regulations and statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with external tax consultants, auditors and regulatory authorities.
* Monitor changes in UAE taxation and regulatory frameworks and ensure timely implementation.

**3. Budgeting, Forecasting & Business Finance**

* Drive annual budgeting, financial planning and periodic forecasting for UAE operations.
* Monitor actual performance against budgets and analyse financial variances.
* Track revenue, profitability, gross margins, operating expenses and business performance.
* Partner with business teams to identify cost optimisation and profitability improvement opportunities.
* Support management in evaluating new business initiatives and financial investments.

**4. Internal Controls & Audit**

* Establish and strengthen internal financial controls across UAE operations.
* Ensure adherence to financial policies, approval matrices and delegation of authority.
* Lead statutory and internal audit coordination and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Identify financial risks and implement appropriate control mechanisms.
* Ensure audit readiness and maintain proper financial documentation.

**5. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management**

* Oversee cash flow planning, liquidity management and working capital requirements.
* Monitor accounts payable, accounts receivable and vendor reconciliations.
* Ensure timely vendor payments and customer collections.
* Drive effective cash utilisation and working capital optimisation.

**6. Group Reporting & Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate with India/HQ finance teams for group reporting and financial consolidation.
* Manage intercompany transactions, reconciliations and related-party accounting.
* Ensure consistency in financial reporting and accounting practices across entities.
* Work closely with business, operations, procurement and leadership teams to support financial decision-making.

**7. Team Management & Process Excellence**

* Manage and develop the UAE finance and accounting team.
* Drive automation, process improvements and standardisation of finance operations.
* Ensure operational efficiency, financial discipline and accountability across the function.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with 8+ years of post-qualification experience.
* Prior experience in UAE/GCC finance operations is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of UAE VAT, Corporate Tax, IFRS and local statutory compliance.
* Experience in managing end-to-end financial controllership for a business entity.
* Experience in retail, e-commerce, D2C, FMCG or consumer-facing businesses will be an advantage.
* Strong exposure to financial reporting, budgeting, audits, internal controls and working capital management.
* Experience in group reporting and intercompany transactions.
* Proficiency in ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle or similar platforms.
* Strong leadership, analytical and stakeholder management skills.

title: RevOps & Automation Specialist

title: Associate, Program Operations
description:
**Position Overview:**

The Associate, Program Operations will support the effective implementation of literacy and gender equality programs across states. . Reporting to the Manager/Senior Manager, Program Operations, the role will assist in program planning, execution, reporting, and budget management to ensure alignment with organizational objectives. The position involves close coordination with state teams, as well as departments at the Country Office (CO) and Global Office (GO) levels while ensuring adherence to organizational policies and guidelines.

**Responsibilities:**

* Support procurement processes ensuring compliance with quality standards and procurement guidelines.
* Support timely preparation and submission of program, project& event reports and Implementation Calendars for allocated states, coordinate monthly operation calls.
* Coordinate the submission and review of Country Office (CO) and Global Office (GO) level reports from assigned states, working closely with RM&E for final reporting.
* Coordinate across department teams, including Finance, Admin, GEP, and Literacy Programs to complete activities at Country and State level, to ensure smooth operations, identify operational challenges and facilitate timely resolution.
* Maintain records of state-level partnerships, ensuring timely renewal of agreements and MoUs.
* Identify implementation challenges and propose actionable solutions, escalating unresolved issues to the Manager.
* Undertake field visits as per touch points and program requirement, participate in the trainings and review meetings in consultation with the manager.

**Operational Excellence Support:**

* Provide operational support to State and Country Office teams to ensure efficient program delivery while maintaining quality standards.
* Support in designing and implementing adaptive systems to enhance field-level operational efficiency, including updating ICs and managing trackers, toolkits, and frameworks.
* Support the progress tracking for agreed program outcomes, collate monthly and quarterly program reports, dashboards, and performance metrics.
* Coordinate the weekly and monthly meetings, review meetings with the state teams and departments and share the meeting minutes.
* Contribute to generating timely reports on GSD to track program implementation and conduct basic data analysis.
* Support operations team in coordinating with all departments for execution of national events, trainings and meeting, along with managing procurement, logistics and administration as required.

**People & Team Coordination:**

* Assist in coordinating recruitment, onboarding, and capacity-building efforts for State teams.
* Ensure compliance with HR policies, labor laws, and workplace regulations.
* Financial & Compliance Support:
* Support in analyzing budgets and forecasts for LP & GEP programs and respective activities, highlighting variances in spending and escalating issues as needed.
* Work closely with program operations and senior leadership to develop accurate and realistic budgets aligned with organizational goals. Additionally, lead the budget revisions process which is necessary throughout the fiscal year in response to changing circumstances and organizational priorities, ensuring financial stability and alignment with strategic objectives.
* Support the budget planning, Outlook, Cash Forecast, BVA, payments and financial approvals for allocated states, ensuring compliance with financial guidelines.
* Collaborate with state teams to ensure effective budget utilization aligned with the program plan.
* Support the Annual Planning and Budget process.
* Ensure compliance with Room to Read’s Child Protection Policy and organizational standards.
* Monitor budget vs. actual performance and provide timely analysis and recommendations to ensure financial targets are met
* Track expenses against the donor budget and report variances.
* Provide support in preparing budgets for donor proposals in collaboration with the Global Donor Finance Team.
* Collaborate with DEV and Operations team to ensure door budget adherence.
* Technical Assistance, Donor & Government Engagement Support:
* Assist in preparing technical assistance proposals for allocated states.
* Provide logistical and operational support to State Teams in implementing technical assistance projects.
* Support in coordination of donor visits in collaboration with Communications and Development teams.
* Coordinate the timely submission of donor reports and case studies.
* Support in documenting the best practices and learning from state-level implementation.

**Qualifications:**

**Required:**

* Master’s in education / social sciences / Social Work/management/consulting or equivalent.
* Minimum 3-6 years of relevant experience.
* Knowledge of various programs and organizations in the field of early grade reading/literacy in India and abroad.
* Excellent managerial and interpersonal skills, including skills of managing and mentoring people.
* Good written and oral communication skills.
* Knowledge/ training in linguistics will be an added advantage.
* Have passion for our mission and a strong desire to impact a dynamic non-profit organization.
* Be an innovative and creative thinker that tries new things and inspires others to do so.
* Have a very high level of personal and professional integrity and trustworthiness.
* Have a strong work ethic and require minimal direction.
* Work well independently as well as part of a team.
* Thrive in a fast-paced and fun environment.

**Compensation:**

Room to Read offers a competitive salary with excellent benefits. Benefits include thirteenth month bonus, health insurance and a retirement plan. The non-monetary compensation includes a unique opportunity to be part of an innovative, meaningful, and rapidly growing organization that is changing transforming the lives of millions of children in developing countries on literacy and gender equality in education.

**Room to Read is a child-safe organization. All personnel are expected to adhere to Room to Read’s Child Protection Policy and Child Protection Code of Conduct.**

title: SPM/PL – RMEAL
description:
**About The Job SPM/PL - RMEAL**
**Organisation:**
Central Square Foundation
  
  
**Position: Senior Project Manager/ Project Lead**
**Team:**
Research, Monitoring & Evaluation, Assessments, and Learning (RMEAL)
  
  
**Location:**
Delhi
  
  
**About Central Square Foundation (CSF)**
Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation is a non-profit philanthropic foundation working to ensure quality school education for all children in India. CSF has a mission focused on ensuring high-quality foundational learning for all children in India. To achieve this, we partner with individuals and social impact organizations to bring innovative solutions in education to build the capacity of the government to drive systemic impact. To learn more about us and our work, visit www.centralsquarefoundation.org.
  
  
**About the**
**Research, Monitoring, Evaluation, Assessment and Learning (RMEAL)**
**team**
CSF endeavours to transform the school education system in India and advance children’s learning outcomes, especially for those from vulnerable socio-economic backgrounds. The RMEAL practice undertakes a range of research and M&E activities to understand the ‘what works’ and ‘why it works’ elements of driving systems improvement and impact. Intending to generate evidence to strengthen education programs and policy, the team provides technical support to other verticals within CSF as well as oversight on third-party research studies.
  
  
CSF’s Research and M&E team is deeply engaged, advised, and mentored by renowned experts like Luis Crouch (Chief Technical Officer, RTI International), Ben Piper (Sr. Director, RTI International), Karthik Muralidharan (Chair, JPAL S.Asia), Asiya Kazmi (Global Education Policy Lead, Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation). The Project Manager will join a high-caliber leadership team with collective experience working in both corporate and development sector organizations like BCG, IFMR, J-PAL, IGC, NITI Aayog, and National Skill Development Corporation.
  
  
The team is looking for a Project Lead/Senior Project Lead to drive our efforts on spearheading rigorous evaluations for our programmatic efforts, institutionalising monitoring, and leading research and evidence generation. S/he will work closely with programmatic teams within CSF, our technical partners and state officials. The candidate will be expected to support and engage with existing experts and build partnerships with other leading experts in the field. S/he will join a high-calibre leadership team with collective experience in both corporate and development sector organisations such as BCG, IFMR, J-PAL,
**IGC, NITI Aayog, and the National Skill Development Corporation.**
**Key Responsibilities**
The candidate will play a senior technical role in shaping and delivering the RMEAL vertical’s agenda and portfolio, while providing key inputs in agenda setting itself. The post holder will lead multiple workstreams, leading the design, measurement, analysis, documentation and dissemination of the work. The post holder will also help ensure effective use of evidence and contribute to learning across the wider organisation beyond the immediate vertical.
  
  
The candidate’s key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
  
  
**Evidence strategy and leadership**
Set and own the RMEAL strategy for the evidence portfolio: the learning agenda, evaluation pipeline, monitoring priorities and research roadmap, aligned to CSF's organisational strategy
  
  
Represent the RMEAL function in organisational strategy, programme design and annual planning discussions
  
  
Build and maintain CSF's evidence standards, templates and guidance for evaluation design, monitoring frameworks, data quality and research ethics
  
  
Lead engagement with government, funders and senior partner stakeholders to socialise results, frame successes and challenges, and drive decisions on adaptation, continuation and scale
  
  
**Evaluation**
Lead the design of rigorous evaluations - including research frameworks, sampling approaches, and tools - to understand the impact of our programs on improving student learning
  
  
Provide technical direction on evaluation design across the portfolio, including research frameworks, identification strategies, sampling approaches, power calculations and tools, to understand the impact of programmes on student learning
  
  
Identify, build and manage long-term relationships with evaluation partners, research institutions and independent researchers for CSF's programmes
  
  
Oversee the commissioning of external evaluations end to end, from terms of reference and partner selection to contract management and quality assurance
  
  
Engage with partners to socialise preliminary results to help identify successes/challenges and undertake decisions around scale
  
  
**Monitoring**
Conceptualise and design end-to-end monitoring frameworks (including tools and processes) that can be adopted by internal teams, state governments, and partners
  
  
Review existing approaches and management information systems of states, and align and support required changes
  
  
Design and operationalise dashboards that can facilitate data use and decision-making
  
  
Coordinate between different teams within and outside of CSF to ensure the generation of high-quality monitoring data
  
  
Ensure the data informs key programmatic iterations
  
  
**Research**
Identify critical research areas to strengthen the portfolio practices
  
  
Conceptualise and manage robust research studies, analysis, and findings generation
  
  
Contribute to intervention design and organisational strategy through evidence-driven decision-making
  
  
**Team Leadership and Research Quality**
Lead and grow a team of Leads, Senior Managers, Managers and Associates, including hiring, performance management and career development
  
  
Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and professional development support to Associates and other team members, including Managers, Senior Managers and Leads
  
  
Support the effective allocation of work across projects and ensure timely, high-quality delivery of research outputs.
  
  
Act as the final quality reviewer for the portfolio's research designs, tools, analysis and reports
  
  
Undertake field visits and partner engagement where useful for strengthening research design, understanding implementation realities, and ensuring research quality
  
  
**Required Qualifications, Skills And Abilities**
Minimum requirement of a Master’s degree in relevant fields, including economics, public/education policy or any related field
  
  
Senior Project Manager (5-8 Years) or 8-10 years (Project Lead) of relevant experience in M&E in development projects/contexts
  
  
Knowledge of the major evaluation methodologies (experimental and non- experimental), data collection and analysis methodologies
  
  
Keen understanding of both quantitative and qualitative research methods
  
  
Experience in designing, implementing, and operating project M&E systems
  
  
Strong understanding of concepts like Logic Model/ Logical Framework, Theory of Change, Monitoring cycles, baselining, end-lining, benchmarking, etc. Ability to understand complex research/data to draw actionable inferences
  
  
Ability to facilitate and serve as project liaison for externally-managed evaluations
  
  
Proven experience of managing multiple team members and projects, setting priorities, planning timelines and meeting deadlines
  
  
Excellent writing and presentation skills
  
  
**Desired Qualities**
Strong action-bias, influencing & communication skills - ability to synthesise technical insights into actionable program agendas, facilitate conflicting points of view, drive collective decision-making
  
  
Passion to make a scaled impact in education and belief in the possibility of foundational learning for all children
  
  
Excellent people and project delivery skills, including ability to manage multiple projects at a time and maturity to influence multiple internal and external stakeholders
  
  
Willingness to adapt to the dynamic nature of work and travel to project locations
  
  
Ability to work independently and proactively, without support staff and with little supervision
  
  
Enthusiasm to collaboration and work with multiple teams and stakeholders
  
  
**Compensation**
Remuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy pay scales and will depend upon the candidate’s experience level.
  
  
**How To Apply**
Interested candidates can click on the Application Form and fill in the required details before the stipulated deadline. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Senior Analyst, Market Insights
description:
**About ETS**
ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization enabling lifelong learners worldwide to be future-ready. For more than 75 years, we've been advancing the science of measurement to build benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment across cultures and borders. Our worldwide impact extends through our renowned assessments including TOEFL®, TOEIC®, GRE® and Praxis® tests, serving millions of learners in more than 200 countries and territories. Through strategic acquisitions, we've expanded our global capabilities: PSI strengthens our workforce assessment solutions, while Edusoft, Kira Talent, Pipplet, Vericant, and Wheebox enhance our educational technology and assessment platforms across critical markets worldwide.
  
  
Through ETS Research Institute and ETS Solutions, we're partnering with educational institutions, governments, and organizations globally to promote skill proficiency, empower upward mobility, and unlock opportunities for everyone, everywhere. With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.
  
  
The Senior Analyst, Market Insights will be a member of the Strategic Insights team and will provide support to the Senior Managers. The Senior Analyst is responsible for monitoring, analyzing, and reporting on industry and market trends, competitor strategies, and will produce market sizing (TTM>TAM>SAM>SOM) and support market forecasting. S/he will provide insightful recommendations, identify opportunities and threats for ETS, and evaluate and size new market and business opportunities. The incumbent will develop and communicate actionable business intelligence for strategic decision-making to support strategy formulation, business and marketing plans, new product development, and business development initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Research & Intelligence Gathering**

* Conduct primary and secondary research to gather needed market and competitive intelligence for assigned internal clients.
* Monitor and analyze industry trends to report on market intelligence and developments.
* Build and maintain an active network of internal and external intelligence sources. Develop and maintain a bank of relevant secondary data sources.

**Market Sizing & Opportunity Assessment**

* Conduct market sizing and opportunity assessments using TTM/TAM/SAM/SOM frameworks and methodologies to quantify market potential and prioritize existing or emerging market opportunities.
* Identify and analyze new business opportunities in existing, adjacent or new markets and businesses.
* Develop market forecasts and scenario planning models to support strategic decision making.

**Competitive & Strategic Analysis**

* Track competitors, develop competitor profiles and SWOT analyses, and provide reports with insights about competitor strategic plans, products, positioning, marketing communications and social media activities.
* Prepare and communicate industry, market and competitive intelligence assessments, with business implications and actionable recommendations for ETS strategies and business investments.
* Identify and evaluate prospective business partners and acquisition candidates.

**Communication & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Analyze information/data and build client-ready PowerPoint presentations.
* Make presentations to marketing and product/program teams, Business Units, and other business stakeholders.
* Serve as the competitive intelligence subject matter expert on cross-functional teams and other teams as needed.

**Governance & Project Oversight**

* Adhere to ethical standards and comply with the laws and regulations applicable to the job function.
* Provide industry, market and competitive intelligence support to Senior Managers.
* Design and manage third party market and competitive intelligence studies. Manage consultants to ensure achievement of project objectives within established deadlines and budgets.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's degree is required. Master of Business Administration (MBA) or Master's degree in an analytical field.

**Experience**

* Business/Management consulting experience is preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Market/Competitive Intelligence Analyst, Market Research/Consumer Insights Assistant/Associate or other relevant analytical position is required.
* Ability to travel (up to 5% of work hours).

**Skills**

* End-to-End Project Management: Strong organizational and time management skills. Excellent project management skills and ability to manage multiple projects concurrently, prioritize assignments, and work under pressure to complete assignments within tight deadlines. Strong ability to work independently and collaboratively with Senior Managers and on teams. Strong problem-solving skills and customer service orientation. Strong detail orientation across all aspects of project planning, execution, analysis and reporting. Must be very effective in quality controlling the content of their project work.
* Competitive Intelligence: Deep understanding of market and competitive intelligence approaches and terminology to effectively conduct assigned projects. Strong ability to work within an ambiguous and rapidly changing business environment. Ability to operate as part of an always-on and analytics function, delivering consistent, high-quality outputs to support strategic synthesis and advisory work.
* Data Analyses: Strong critical thinking and data analysis skills. Superior ability to synthesize large quantities of data from disparate sources and translate data succinctly into key insights. Ability to read, understand and translate financial statements into major findings and implications. Superior analytical skills, with the ability to make connections between multiple data points from disparate sources, derive meaningful insights and determine business implications. Superior ability to interpret, integrate qualitative and quantitative data, employing advanced analytical methods for market sizing (TTM, TAM, SAM, SOM), forecasting, and scenario planning to support strategic business decisions.
* Communication Skills (Written & Oral): Excellent strategic thinking, analytical, and report writing skills. Strong data visualization and reporting skills. Excellent interpersonal and oral communication skills. Ability to express complex ideas and findings in a concise and audience relevant manner. Strong presentation skills in English.
* Language Proficiency: Must be fluent in English (reading, writing, listening and speaking). Fluency in a second language is a plus (e.g., Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish or Portuguese).
* Interpersonal Skills: Excellent interpersonal skills. Ability to forge good working relationships with internal clients at all levels, industry experts/analysts and service providers.
