title: Renewal Manager II
description:
**Description**
**What We’re Looking For:**
In this role, you'll play a vital part in our organization, with your primary focus being to secure on-time renewal revenue and secure revenue across our Indian portfolio. You will work closely with our extended account teams to maximize the value provided to the customer, ensuring our long-term partnership, while also owning the discipline that keeps renewals and payments on track across a broad client base spanning SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise. Meltwater offers an environment where you'll be surrounded by talented coworkers at the cutting edge of AI Martech, working across one of our most diverse account portfolios in the region.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**

* Lead efforts to ensure on-time renewal revenue across your India portfolio, spanning SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise accounts, collaborating closely with our account teams.
* Own collections end-to-end on your book chasing overdue invoices, resolving billing disputes, and working with Finance/AR to keep outstanding balances current and DSO in check.
* Handle the hard conversations at volume. This portfolio involves customers weighing competitors, raising product or billing concerns, or facing payment delays you'll be the person having those conversations, calmly and commercially, week in and week out.
* Proactively cultivate relationships with customers, ensuring their awareness of our product offerings and adoption of their current package.
* Identify upcoming renewals and maintain accurate account and payment status data within the CRM system.
* Develop quotes, manage administrative tasks, and oversee the execution of renewal contracts.
* Flag payment risk and churn risk early, and build recovery plans before either becomes a surprise.
* Feed what you're hearing from customers competitor moves, product gaps, payment friction back to leadership to shape our approach to the market.
* Run an accurate forecast which identifies outlook, best case scenarios, and risk, including collections status as part of that picture

**What You’ll Bring:**

* A Bachelor's degree or higher is required for this role.
* 3+ years in sales, renewals, or customer success, ideally SaaS including experience retaining customers in competitive or at-risk situations.
* Direct experience with collections or accounts receivable follow-up comfortable owning difficult payment conversations, not just renewal conversations.
* Comfort managing a varied portfolio across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise accounts, each with different stakeholders and different risk profiles.
* Exceptional organisational skills, emphasizing data accuracy and meticulous attention to detail.
* Customer-centric mindset, adept at engaging with customers and effectively addressing their concerns.
* A proactive approach to identifying and flagging upcoming renewals, payment risk, and potential issues before they arise.
* Strong communication skills to articulate renewal options clearly and collaborate effectively with Account Managers and customer success colleagues.
* Commercial acumen to spot risk early and ensure our services are evolving alongside our clients.
* Proficiency with CRM systems, ensuring the maintenance of accurate and up-to-date information. Salesforce experience is preferred.

**What We Offer:**

* Enjoy flexible paid time off for enhanced work-life balance.
* Meltwater demonstrates commitment to your well-being by contributing towards Discovery Health, ensuring robust healthcare coverage.
* Complimentary CalmApp subscription for you and your loved ones because mental wellness matters.
* Energetic work environment with a hybrid work style, providing the balance you need.
* Benefit from our family leave program, which grows with your tenure at Meltwater.
* Thrive within our inclusive community and seize ongoing professional development opportunities to elevate your career.

**Where You'll Work:**
New Delhi
  
  
**When You'll Join:**
As Per Offer Letter
  
  
**About Meltwater**
At Meltwater, we believe that when you have the right people in the right environment, great things happen. Our best-in-class technology empowers our
**27,000 customers**
around the world to make better business decisions through data. **FlixStock**
is an AI-powered visual content platform helping global retail and fashion brands automate and scale their product photography. As we grow our international footprint, we're looking for a detail-oriented Finance Analyst to strengthen our finance function.

**Why this role exists**

As we scale across geographies, our financial analysis team needs a much sharper lens. We need someone who can go beyond number crunching, tracking spend and budgets is table stakes, but we need someone who can look at product and SKU-level data and tell us where the money is actually being made or lost, and how can we do better.

**What is excepted from you**

* Ability to conduct cost analysis at the product and SKU level to identify margin and efficiency opportunities, and turn findings into cost control and revenue optimization recommendations.
* Track and control budgets across departments, flag deviations before they become a problem, and run budget-vs-actual variance analysis for leadership.
* Own and maintain MIS reports for management decision-making, working with Sales, Operations and Product to gather the spend and revenue inputs behind them.
* Manage forex transactions, exposure tracking and related accounting entries.
* Ability to explain your numbers and workings without fumble.
* Support day-to-day accounting operations, and assist with tax and accounting compliance across Poland, Singapore and the USA.

**Who you are**

* You think in margins, not just numbers. A cost report isn't the end point for you it's the start of a "so what should we do" conversation.
* You're precise. Compliance and MIS reportings don't leave room for "close enough."

title: Specialist Finance - BRAC UPGI - India
description:
BRAC is an award-winning international non-governmental development organization, with the vision of a world free from all forms of exploitation and discrimination, where everyone has the opportunity to realize their potential. BRAC is a leader in developing and implementing cost-effective, evidence-based programs to assist poor and disadvantaged communities in low-income countries, including in conflict-prone and post-disaster settings. It is an organization of and for the people of the Global South, pioneering new development and social enterprise approaches to equip communities to achieve prosperity. As well as being the world's biggest NGO by the number of staff and people directly reached, BRAC has regularly been ranked the number one NGO in the world by the Geneva-based NGO Advisor, an independent organization committed to highlighting innovation, impact, and governance in the non-profit sector. BRAC retained the top spot in 2020 among the top 500 NGOs for the fifth consecutive year.
  
  
BRAC was founded in Bangladesh in 1972 by Sir Fazle Hasan Abed. It started its first programs outside of Bangladesh in Afghanistan in 2002 and today has activities in 14 countries across Africa and Asia. BRAC has a holistic approach to development that uses a wide array of programs that include microfinance, education, health, agriculture, gender, and human rights. BRAC invests in communities’ own human and material resources, catalyzing lasting change and creating an ecosystem in which people in poverty have the chance to seize control of their own lives.
  
  
To learn more about BRAC International, please visit (www.bracinternational.org.com).
  
  
**About The Ultra-Poor Graduation Initiative**
The Ultra-Poor Graduation Initiative (“UPGI”) is a global unit within BRAC that was founded in 2016 to build off the success of BRAC’s Ultra-Poor Graduation programme in Bangladesh. BRAC UPGI aims to position the evidence-backed Graduation approach as a key driver to eradicate extreme poverty worldwide. It does this by:
  
  

* Advocating for uptake of the Graduation approach by policymakers, national governments, multilateral institutions, and non-governmental organisations; and
* Effective adaptation and implementation of the Graduation approach in countries around the world, supported through technical assistance and capacity strengthening for external stakeholders.

In 2002, BRAC pioneered the Ultra-Poor Graduation (“Graduation”) approach in Bangladesh — a sequenced, two-year investment that enables people to create lasting pathways out of extreme poverty — after recognising that existing programmes were not reaching the poorest people. Through the provision of a productive asset, basic needs support, and ongoing coaching, the Graduation approach tackles multiple constraints at once and achieves lasting impact.
  
  
Graduation has been adapted and implemented across a wide variety of contexts and countries, with dozens of rigorous evaluations documenting its effectiveness at achieving broad and lasting impact, as well as returns that greatly outweigh the costs. So far, a total of 6.7 million households has been reached by Graduation programs, more than 2 million of which BRAC reached through its flagship Graduation programme in Bangladesh.
  
  
To help eradicate extreme poverty, BRAC UPGI is working with governments across Africa and Asia to scale Graduation by integrating it into existing government programmes. Alongside governments, BRAC aims to equip 21 million more people to lift themselves from extreme poverty by 2030.
  
  
**About BRAC International’s Work In India**
The National Rural Livelihood Promotion Society under the Ministry of Rural Development has signed an MoU with BRAC International, formalising a shared commitment to promote holistic economic inclusion and social protection for people living in extreme poverty, particularly women. The MoU envisions a focused strategy to reach the poorest and most excluded households through a time-bound investment in the Graduation approach, enabling more inclusive and sustainable livelihoods across rural India.
  
  
The partnership positions BRAC International as a strategic orchestrator, demonstrating how targeted interventions can reach extremely vulnerable groups while generating evidence for scale across State Rural Livelihood Missions (SRLMs). In this role, BRAC is not only providing technical assistance for the implementation of the Samaveshi Aajeevika Yojana (SAY) but also convening stakeholders, aligning systems, and enabling coordinated action across levels. Through its partner agencies, BRAC International has established Project Management Units (PMUs) at national and state levels to support the government in co-designing approaches and ensuring strong strategic guidance alongside effective implementation support.
  
  
**About The Position**
BRAC UPGI India is expanding its programme and operational portfolio, working with multiple programme and implementation partners across India. As the India operation grows, BRAC is also exploring the establishment of a legally registered entity in India.
  
  
The transition towards a registered entity will require stronger country-level financial systems and capacity to support accounting, bookkeeping, taxation, regulatory financial compliance, cash management, payroll, budgeting and financial reporting.
  
  
The India Finance function currently supports programme and partner financial management as well as the broader operational and financial requirements of the country office. As the organisation expands, additional finance capacity is required to ensure that financial records are maintained accurately, partner expenditure is appropriately monitored, and day-to-day financial operations are managed efficiently.
  
  
BRAC UPGI India is inviting applications for a position aimed at providing financial and operational support to its India Finance function. The role will involve close collaboration with the program and grants teams, operations and HR teams, program partners and relevant external finance and compliance service providers. The reporting line will be Senior Program Specialist Finance and Administration, with a dotted line to Country Lead, India.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The candidate will be responsible for providing financial and operational support to the BRAC India Finance function. Key roles and responsibilities of the candidate include:
  
  

* Partner Financial Management:
* Review periodic financial reports submitted by Implementing Partners for accuracy, completeness and consistency with approved budgets and grant requirements within the stipulated timelines.
* Conduct desk and on-site reviews of the partner records and support documents on a sampling basis, recommend mitigations for any observations arising out of the reviews,
* Analyse partner expenditure against approved budgets and work plans.
* Monitor partner expenditure rates and utilisation levels against programme timelines and deliverables.
* Support financial review during grant extensions, budget revisions and project close-outs.
* Onboarding implementation partners while working closely with the Programme team to ensure alignment in selection, onboarding processes and proper documentation.
* Internal Controls and Finance Management
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date books of accounts and financial records. This includes but is not limited to recording cash inflows and outflows, maintaining appropriate documentation for financial transactions, maintaining schedules for receivables, payables and other financial balances and recording those expenses.
* Support bank and cash reconciliations.
* Assist with month-end and year-end close activities.
* Support preparation of financial statements and financial schedules, as required.
* Support the implementation and maintenance of accounting systems appropriate for a registered India entity.
* Support development and implementation of standard finance processes and SOPs.
* Support maintenance of appropriate internal financial controls and documentation.
* Identify opportunities to streamline repetitive or manual finance processes.
* 3. Office finance and operational support
* Support monthly payroll processing and reconciliation, including coordination with HR and relevant payroll service providers. Verify payroll-related financial inputs, deductions and reimbursements and maintain payroll-related financial records and documentation.
* Manage petty cash records, supporting documentation and reconciliations.
* Support petty cash replenishment and monitoring of office cash balances.
* Process approved vendor payments, staff reimbursements and other operational payments.
* Maintain payment trackers and follow up on outstanding payments and documentation.
* Track staff advances and support timely settlement and reconciliation.
* Support the office procurement processes and maintain appropriate documentation for the same.
* Support invoice verification and maintenance of vendor documentation.
* Support procurement-related financial documentation.
* Assist with travel and other operational expense processing.
* Respond to routine finance-related queries from staff and escalate issues where required.
* Maintain finance trackers, templates and reporting tools.
* Country Budget Management
* Monitor actual expenditure against approved budgets.
* Prepare budget-versus-actual analysis and identify significant variances.
* Monitor commitments and anticipated expenditure.
* Flag potential budget overruns or significant deviations to the Finance Lead.
* Support updating of forecasts based on actual expenditure and changing requirements.
* Support in the creation, consolidation and reporting for Country budgeting
* Support cross-functional coordination with program, grants, operations and HR teams on finance-related matters.
* Risk and Compliance
* Ensure that there is compliance with statutory requirements,
* Coordinate with external accountants, tax advisors and auditors as required,
* Support taxation-related accounting and documentation as well as audit related documentation and preparation.
* Maintain financial compliance trackers and calendars.
* Coordination with UPGI and SBI central finance team
* Coordinate and support organizational deliverables and alignment with Brac International policies, processes and systems,
* Organize for regular drawdown requests from Brac India cash requirements for planned operational and programmatic activities

Additional work streams can be added based on emerging requirements of India operations.
  
  
**Qualifications**
The candidate should have:
  
  

* Minimum 4 years’ experience working in accounting, financial analysis, finance operations, grants finance or a similar role.
* A Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, CA degree preferred.
* Good understanding of accounting and bookkeeping principles.
* Experience with budgeting, financial reporting and expenditure analysis.

title: Risk Analyst
description:
**Role Overview**

You will be part of the core Risk team, contributing to underwriting strategy, portfolio analytics, and credit policy for retail lending products (Personal Loans / LAMF). This role is suited for someone who combines strong data skills with a solid grasp of lending fundamentals and can translate analysis into actionable risk decisions.

**What You'll Do**

**Underwriting Strategy**

* Contribute to the design and refinement of underwriting rules and credit policies for Personal Loans and LAMF
* Evaluate creditworthiness using bureau data and alternate data sources
* Balance approval rates against risk thresholds and business objectives

**Portfolio Analytics & Monitoring**

* Track and report on key portfolio metrics: disbursals, approval rates, delinquency, collection roll rates, DPD buckets, and NPAs
* Perform vintage and cohort analyses to detect early risk signals and portfolio trends
* Translate data findings into actionable policy recommendations

**Portfolio Actions**

* Support initiatives around limit management — identifying candidates for limit increases or decreases based on behavioral and risk signals
* Assist in building frameworks for proactive portfolio interventions

**Data & Decisioning**

* Write SQL/Python queries to extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets
* Provide data support for analysis and ad-hoc investigations
* Build and maintain reports and monitoring dashboards

**What We're Looking For**

*Must-Have*

* 1–4 years of experience in credit risk, underwriting, or lending analytics
* Hands-on experience with SQL and Python for data querying, manipulation, and analysis
* Prior exposure to unsecured retail lending products — Personal Loans and/or Credit Cards
* Demonstrated contribution to at least one of: underwriting strategy, portfolio analytics, or portfolio actions (limit management)
* Solid understanding of bureau data (CIBIL / Experian) and core risk metrics — DPD, roll rates, vintage curves, PD

*Good to Have*

* Experience with scorecard development or risk model building
* Familiarity with fintech or digital lending platforms
* Exposure to BI tools (Tableau / Power BI)
* Understanding of collections strategies and early warning frameworks

**Why This Role**

This is a high-ownership role sitting at the intersection of data, credit, and product. You'll work closely with Data Science, Product, and Business teams — with direct visibility into how risk decisions shape customer outcomes and business performance at INDmoney.

title: Associate/Sr. Associate - Foundation
description:
**Do you have what it takes to build India’s most valuable startups?**
Startups aspire to change the way we live and work. They are here to create economic value. Enabling their founders with empathy and assertiveness is an art. We are seeking such partners as part of YourNest’s journey to nurture success for DeepTech startups.
  
  
At YourNest, we've been scouting for diamonds in the rough since 2011: with three flagship funds and a continuum fund adding up to $ 160 mn, being the first to focus on DeepTech startups, having delivered more than 10 exits in last 5-years, and while ensuring we remain among India's best-performing early-stage funds,
**we've made it a habit to set new benchmarks**
in the country's venture capital sector. And we've done this thanks to an enterprising team of committed young people who work closely with our founders to help them succeed.
  
  
YourNest is all set to launch its flagship
**Fund IV of INR 1500 crores**
and is seeking to strengthen its Portfolio Management and Growth team. Now, we’re looking for a dynamic professional to take on the role of Associate & Senior Associate - Foundation, who owns the outcomes across the 0→1 portfolio companies and helps founders move faster on the decisions that matter most. Most VC associates support deals. This role owns outcomes.
  
  
**How does this role contribute?**
Foundation (0→1) is the most founder-critical, most relationship-intensive part of YourNest's portfolio work. Companies at this stage are pre-product-market fit, navigating the hardest stretch of their journey — and they need a YourNest business partner who shows up weekly, knows their business as well as the founders do, and can make decisions with them, not just advise them from a distance. While doing this, the associate will simultaneously be building YourNest’'s investable track record with each company.
  
  
**What will help you succeed?**

* 0→1 Execution Mindset: Comfort operating in ambiguity with early-stage founders; the ability to convert loose hypotheses into structured action, iterate quickly, and stay resilient through non-linear progress.
* Strong Problem Solving & First-Principles Thinking: Ability to break down ambiguous growth, product or organizational challenges into clear components, identify root causes, and drive practical, high-leverage solutions rather than theoretical recommendations
* Founder Empathy with High Ownership: Ability to build trust with founders while holding a high bar on outcomes; knowing when to listen, when to challenge, and when to escalate.
* Commercial & Capital Efficiency Orientation: Strong understanding of revenue drivers, unit economics, hiring leverage, and trade-offs that shape early-stage company progress.
* Judgment under pressure: Ability to make calls in real time, especially when a founder is stuck, a company is under strain, or the path forward is unclear.

**You own — directly and accountably**

* Nurture Capital, you are the tip of the spear that carries the Nurture Capital ethos to the founders
* Two to five founder relationships in your portfolio companies' 0→1 journey, end-to-end. You are the primary YourNest contact. The founder calls you first.
* Weekly rhythm of engagement with each owned company. Not monthly check-ins. Not 'I'll get back to you.' Weekly presence on the substantive questions of the business.
* 100-day playbook execution for each company — Capital (who to raise from next), People (which 2-3 hires unlock the next stage), Revenue (what drives early traction).
* Capital, People & Revenue milestones across all owned companies, with measurable outcomes you are personally accountable for.
* Targeted network activation for your companies — customer intros, hire intros, advisor connections, co-investor warm leads. Tracked by outcome, not volume.
* Pre-Series A fundraise readiness for your companies — narrative coordination with the Principal, and with Growth Equity & Exit team for companies approaching the Pre-Series A close (they lead the close, you've built the runway up to it).
* Board pack preparation for your companies' board meetings — substantive content, not just logistics.
* Founder trust — the qualitative signal that your companies' founders consider you a genuine partner, not a process check-in.
* Strengthening data led Fund Raise Narrative - Build and maintain the narrative record for each owned company, the measurable 'before/after' of your YourNest’s engagement, so the investor story writes itself at fundraise time

**You do not own — Four distinct lanes sit elsewhere**

* Growth-stage rounds and exits — Growth Equity & Exit team. When one of your companies is ready for its Pre-Series A close or beyond, the Growth Equity & Exit team leads the round execution and engagement with growth-stage / PE investors. You hand over the relationship context; they drive the close. Same applies to acquirer conversations and exit execution.
* LP relationships — Fund Raise & IR team. All LP engagement, fund-level fundraising, LP reporting, and IR work sits with the Fund Raise & IR team. You do not interface with LPs in this role.
* Compliance, board minutes, statutory work — Governance & IM cohort. Routine compliance, board minute preparation, rights tracker, audit cycles, statutory filings all sit with Governance & IM. You collaborate with them tightly but you do not duplicate them. Their Principal owns the portfolio's governance continuity; your role is the business outcome of your 2-4 companies.
* Sourcing new deals — Deal Cultivation. Deal Cultivation handles the pipeline. You are post-investment-focused, not pre-investment.

**KPIs and Impact Measurement**- Time-to-PMF improvement across 3-6 owned companies: Baseline established at onboarding for each company (months expected to PMF given starting position). Measured at 6-month intervals — actual vs. baseline. Score: % of companies tracking ahead of, on, or behind baseline. Threshold target: 75%+ on or ahead of baseline across the book.
- Fundraise narrative: the documented before/after of YN's engagement with each company, built continuously, not at fundraise time. This is what makes the Series A story credible before the book goes out.
- 100-day playbook completion rate: Each new investment has a written 100-day playbook with 8-12 milestones (split across C, P, R). Measured at day 100 per company. Threshold target: 80%+ milestones completed across the book; 90%+ have plans in place for misses. Quality of milestones reviewed by the Principal, not just completion %.
- Founder trust signal across all companies: Structured founder feedback at mid-year and year-end — five qualitative anchors: responsiveness, judgment, follow-through, network value, partnership feel. Anonymous to the founder, attributable to you. Threshold: positive on 4 of 5 anchors across the book; no founder rating you 'replaceable' on partnership feel.
Demonstrated independence trajectory: Principal tracks frequency and substance of escalations to them across two dimensions: routine (asking for input on decisions you should be making) and substantive (escalating real judgement calls). Routine escalations should trend down quarter-on-quarter; substantive escalations stay roughly stable. Threshold: by month 18, routine escalations <1 per week across the book.
  
  
**What qualifications & experience must you have?**

* Relevant experience across operating roles, consulting, venture, portfolio operations, founder-support, or business-building environments with 0→1 or early-stage startups, with exposure to founder problem solving, execution, scaling, or fundraise readiness 5–8 years for Senior Associate, 4-6 years for Associates.
* Financial modelling in Excel: Ability to Build a clean 3-statement model (P&L, cash, balance sheet) from scratch. Comfortable with sensitivities, scenario modelling, unit economics breakdowns. Knows when a model is over-engineered and when it's under-built.
* Cap table mechanics: Reads and builds cap tables fluently. Understands pre-money / post-money, dilution math, ESOP pool sizing, anti-dilution mechanics, liquidation preferences. Can model a notional Pre-Series A round and articulate founder impact in plain English.
* Written communication: Writes a 1-page memo on a complex situation in 30 minutes. Sharp framing, no padding, can hold a senior reader's attention. Comfortable writing IC notes, board pack inputs, founder follow-up summaries.
* Founder-facing conversation: Can run a 60-min founder check-in without scripts. Knows when to listen, when to challenge, when to coach, when to escalate. Comfortable being the most junior person in a board meeting.
* Spreadsheet / data fluency: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets & dashboard building. Comfortable structuring messy data into a usable view in under 2 hours.
* Calendar and commitment discipline: Manages 3-6 simultaneous founder relationships without anything dropping. Founders never wait more than 24 hours for a substantive reply.

Skills: financial modelling,pmf,revenue & profit growth,gtm,foundation,0-1 execution

title: Revenue Management Manager
description:
**Overview**
Role - L10
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
The Manager, Revenue Growth Management will lead the development and execution of the RGM agenda across markets, with accountability for unlocking sustainable revenue and profit growth through pricing, Price-Pack Architecture, mix optimization and trade investment effectiveness.
  
  
The role will shape strategic commercial choices, assess implications across consumer value, competitive positioning, PEP and Bottler economics, volume and market share, and translate advanced analytics and market insights into actionable recommendations.
  
  
Acting as a strategic partner across Franchise, Category, Finance, Commercial and Bottler organizations, the incumbent will drive cross-functional alignment, execution governance and value realization to ensure RGM initiatives translate into measurable and sustainable business impact.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Accountabilities :
  
  
Lead RGM Agenda Across Markets : Shape and drive the RGM agenda across AOP, PSP and strategic business priorities, leveraging pricing, price-pack architecture, mix management and trade investment optimization to identify, quantify and align growth opportunities with Bottlers and CU leadership. Ensure initiatives deliver sustainable Net Revenue growth and support NRR and VC/NR commitments. Provide a forward-looking perspective on market opportunities, risks and commercial interventions required to strengthen business performance.
  
  
Pack Price : Lead the development and evaluation of Price-Pack Architecture and pricing scenarios across markets, balancing:
  
  

* Consumer and shopper value
* Competitive positioning
* Volume and market share implications
* PEP and Bottler profitability
* Revenue realization and margin delivery
* Channel and occasion requirements

Develop strategic recommendations in response to structural market changes including Excise Tax, VAT, inflation, currency devaluation and other macroeconomic pressures.
  
  
Ensure pricing and PPA decisions reflect both immediate business requirements and the longer-term portfolio and market strategy.
  
  
Pack Performance & Mix Optimization : Own the assessment of PEP and competitor portfolio performance across pack volume, NWSP, channel, customer and market dynamics. Identify emerging trends and translate insights into actions that improve revenue realization, strengthen portfolio mix and create differentiated pack-price propositions by channel. Partner with Franchise, Category and Commercial teams to identify opportunities across recruitment, affordability, frequency, premiumization, stock-up and consumption occasions.
  
  
Build Bottler RGM Capability & Lead Transformation : Accelerate Bottler RGM maturity by leading the deployment and adoption of advanced RGM capabilities, including AI-enabled tools, analytics platforms, third-party studies and core governance solutions such as NRR Scorecards, SKU optimization and Promo Effectiveness. The role will own project delivery and change management end to end, ensuring strong Bottler engagement, effective adoption of new ways of working, and translation of capability investments into sustained commercial impact.
  
  
Planning, Governance & Value Realization : Establish strong governance across RGM initiatives through pre/post evaluations, Pricing Councils and performance reviews. Global Best Practices & Capability Development : Build strong connectivity with Sector and Global RGM communities to identify emerging capabilities, tools and best practices. Translate relevant external and internal learnings into scalable solutions that strengthen RGM maturity and competitive advantage across the markets.

Educational Credentials : Postgraduate degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred; strong undergraduate degree with relevant experience can also be considered.

RGM Expertise : Knowledge of pricing, Price-Pack Architecture, mix optimization, promotion effectiveness, trade investment and Net Revenue Realization, with the ability to assess implications across revenue, margin, volume and share.
  
  
Strategic & analytical capability: Strong quantitative, financial modelling, problem-solving and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear commercial recommendations.
  
  
Transformation & program leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects, deploy new tools and capabilities, manage change and embed new ways of working across markets and partner organizations.
  
  
Digital & AI orientation: Data and digital literacy with the ability to lead adoption of advanced analytics, AI-enabled RGM tools and third-party analytical solutions. Experience with visualization/analytics platforms is an advantage.
  
  
Project & governance capability: Program/project management skills, including prioritization, governance, value tracking, risk management and delivery across multiple workstreams and markets.
  
  
Tools: Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, including strong financial/commercial modelling skills; familiarity with BI, analytics, pricing or RGM platforms is preferred.
  
  
Language: Full professional proficiency in English; additional regional language capability can be considered an advantage where relevant.

title: Accountant
description:
Job Description: Chartered Accountant or CA – E-commerce & B2C B2B Operations

About the Role

We are a growing e-commerce business operating across leading online marketplaces and corporate B2B channels. We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Chartered Accountant (CA) to lead our financial operations, strengthen financial controls, ensure regulatory compliance, and drive sustainable business growth. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in e-commerce accounting, taxation, financial reporting, and marketplace reconciliation.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Management: Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts receivable, accounts payable, bank reconciliations, general ledger maintenance, and working capital management.

Marketplace Reconciliation: Reconcile sales, settlements, commissions, returns, refunds, penalties, advertising expenses, and other deductions across platforms such as Myntra, Flipkart, Amazon, Ajio, Nykaa, and Shopify.

GST & Tax Compliance: Manage GST returns, TDS compliance, income tax filings, e-invoicing, e-way bills, and other statutory requirements, ensuring timely and accurate submissions.

Inventory Accounting: Maintain accurate inventory valuation, stock reconciliation, cost of goods sold, purchase accounting, and inventory movement records across warehouses and sales channels.

Financial Reporting: Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, MIS reports, profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow forecasts.

Profitability Analysis: Analyze platform-wise, channel-wise, and SKU-wise profitability to identify cost-saving opportunities and improve margins.

Audit & Internal Controls: Coordinate statutory and internal audits, maintain financial documentation, and implement effective accounting controls.

Strategic Planning: Support budgeting, pricing decisions, vendor payments, working capital optimization, and long-term financial planning.

Candidate Requirements

Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with relevant post-qualification experience.

Proven experience in e-commerce, online retail, marketplace accounting, or B2B business operations.

Strong knowledge of GST, taxation, financial auditing, and statutory compliance.

Advanced proficiency in Tally, MS Excel, and financial reporting tools.

Excellent analytical, reconciliation, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Ability to manage high-volume transactions, multiple sales channels, and strict reporting deadlines.

Ideal Candidate

A commercially minded finance professional who can ensure financial accuracy, improve operational efficiency, minimize revenue leakage, and provide actionable insights to support the company's growth and profitability.

title: Senior Analyst (Pricing), Analytics
description:
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,000+ employees and ~24,000+ customers worldwide, including 53% of the Fortune 500. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world, transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers human connection.
  
  
As Senior Pricing Analyst, you are the hands-on analytical engine behind Cvent's pricing and monetization strategy. Working within the Analytics & Insights team and reporting to the Analytics Manager, you will build pricing models, run elasticity and willingness-to-pay analyses, support deal desk and discount governance, and turn complex, multi-dimensional data into clear pricing recommendations for Product, Sales, Finance, and Marketing. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who pairs deep technical analytics skill with strong pricing and commercial acumen, and who can own pricing workstreams end-to-end with limited supervision.
  
  
**Pricing Analytics (core focus)**

* Build and maintain pricing and demand models, including price elasticity, cross-price elasticity, willingness-to-pay, and cohort value models.
* Drive price optimization across tiers, products and geographies; surface revenue and margin opportunities and flag pricing risks.
* Provide deal-support analytics to Sales, including custom pricing simulations, ROI models, discount scenarios, and competitive positioning.
* Support discount governance by analyzing discounting patterns and building the data to inform policy and approval thresholds.
* Conduct deal win/loss analysis and competitive benchmarking to refine pricing and discount strategy.
* Power Quarterly Pricing Reviews with structured analysis, insights, and clear recommendations for Finance and GTM leadership.
* Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into coherent, business-friendly recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Conduct comprehensive lifecycle analysis including data gathering and cleansing, statistical modeling, and strategic recommendations.
* Build and maintain self-serve dashboards and reports in Sigma so business teams can access pricing and revenue insights independently.
* Partner with Engineering and Data Platform teams to improve data quality, pipeline reliability, and the metrics underpinning pricing analysis.
* Document methodologies and maintain analytical best practices and definitions.
* Partner with Product, Sales, Finance, and Marketing to align on metric definitions and reporting standards.
* Communicate findings and recommendations clearly through presentations and written reports for senior audiences.

**AI & Automation**

* Apply AI/ML techniques (forecasting, segmentation, propensity, churn) to pricing and revenue problems.
* Use LLM/GenAI tools to accelerate analysis, reporting, and documentation, following responsible-AI practices around accuracy and data governance.
* Expert-level proficiency in SQL/Snowflake, with the ability to work independently against large, complex datasets.
* Hands-on experience with BI tools; Sigma and/or Tableau required.
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint; able to build clear, executive-ready analyses and presentations.
* Strong working knowledge of statistics applied to pricing, elasticity, segmentation, or forecasting.
* Demonstrated experience developing pricing or value models using advanced statistical techniques.
* Ability to decipher large, multi-dimensional datasets and present findings in a coherent, business-friendly structure.
* Excellent written and oral communication; comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Ability to frame ambiguous, open-ended business problems into structured analyses and decision-ready outputs.

**Qualifications**

* 4-6 years of relevant experience in pricing, revenue management, or advanced analytics; SaaS/Tech industry preferred.
* BTech or graduation in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with SQL/Snowflake, Sigma/Tableau, and Advanced Excel.
* Proven track record of delivering pricing or analytics work that drove measurable business impact.
* Demonstrated experience applying statistical and/or AI/ML techniques to real-world pricing, revenue, or customer analytics problems (preferred).

***Financial Analyst – Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)***  
***Job Description Section:***

Agilent inspires and supports discoveries that advance the quality of life. We provide life science, diagnostics and applied market laboratories worldwide with instruments, software, services, consumables and expertise. Agilent enables customers to gain the answers and insights they seek — so they can do what they do best: improve the world around us.

**This is an exciting opportunity to join Agilent’s Finance team within the Financial Planning and Analysis function. The team plays a critical role that helps leadership make strategic business decisions by evaluating financial data, forecasting future performance, and managing budgets.**

***About the Role:***  
As a Financial Analyst, you will be responsible for performing financial forecasting, budgeting, reporting and operational metrics tracking. You will be responsible playing a pivotal role driving business decisions by analysing metrics, evaluating strategic options, and forecasting the financial impact on profitability and cash flow. Working closely with cross functional teams such as Sales, Marketing, and Operations to build budgets, monitor departmental spending, and guide operational choices. Developing predictive models, conducting scenario planning, and performing variance analysis to compare actual results against forecasts. Leveraging ERP systems, advanced financial software, and data visualization tools, they automate reporting and extract insights from large datasets.

***Your key responsibilities will include:***  

* Provide financial services, analytical support, reporting, and business insights to company management.
* Ensure that Agilent’s operations are conducted in accordance with established financial policies and internal controls.
* Oversee the collection, recording, consolidation, reconciliation, analysis, reporting, and presentation of accounting and financial information used by management for planning and control purposes.

**About The Role**
As a Senior Manager Contract Management Services you are responsible for the teams entrusted by the CPS Market Unit to oversee and optimise the financial aspects of the Contracts they agree with our customers, you will provide direction and leadership to your team of professionals to ensure that Contract costs are controlled, revenue is maximised and all key contractual obligations are met.
  
  
Your team will support Market Unit customer facing Contract Managers to prep for contract negotiations and management, reviewing contracts to ensure favourable terms and conditions which align with our financial goals, including assessing risks, identifying cost saving opportunities and ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
  
  
You will implement processes and controls within your team to monitor and manage costs associated with CPS contracts, leading a team of professionals who will analyse financial data, identify cost variances and implementation strategies to mitigate risks and optimise cost efficiency.
  
  
In support of customer facing Market Unit contract managers, you will develop strategies to optimise revenue generation from contracts, including pricing optimisation, revenue recognition and contract performance analysis. Your teams will undertake financial analysis and reporting to assess financial impact of contracts, track revenue and cost trends, they will identify and mitigate financial risks such as financial fluctuations, contract disputes or non-compliance by implementing risk assessment frameworks, developing contingency plans and ensuring adherence to internal controls and regulatory requirements.
  
  
You will drive strong stakeholder management/ partnership capability within your team, delivering professional and effective stakeholder relationships with legal, finance, sales and operations team to ensure alignment and effective communication regarding contract terms, financial implications and performance metrics.
  
  
You will collaborate with Service Control colleagues to ensure that ITIL framework principles are deployed across your team and supporting ITIL capabilities available in the Managed Service space are utilised to further enhance the professionalisation of your function.
  
  
You will drive transformation within your function, sponsoring the design and delivery of a major transformation programme designed to optimise a strategic system driven approach to cost assurance and revenue management to optimise the service we offer at best cost and utilise our professional resources on the highest value activities within the function.
  
  
Overall you will play a crucial role in optimising financial outcomes related to the contracts we manage on behalf of the Market Unit customer facing contract managers, you and your teams will be seen as trusted partners of the Market Unit Contract Management teams, you will help ensure that our contracts are financially viable, costs are controlled, revenue is optimised and risks are mitigated, ultimately contributing to the CPS aorganisations financial success.

description:

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a data-driven
**Process Excellence & MIS Analyst**
to anchor our operational reporting and performance analytics within the Service Partner Operations team in Kolkata. This role is heavily centered on Management Information Systems (MIS), daily data management, automated reporting, and deep-dive analytics to optimize last-mile logistics and channel operations performance.

You will be responsible for transforming raw operational data from the field into clear, executive-level dashboards, tracking key performance indicators (KPIs), and supporting ground-level process improvement through data insights.

**Key Responsibilities & KPIs**

**1. Management Information Systems (MIS) & Reporting**

* **Daily / Weekly / Monthly MIS Management:**
  Design, automate, and maintain routine operational dashboards, MIS reports, and performance scorecards for the Kolkata region.
* **Performance & SLA Tracking:**
  Continuously monitor and report on key logistics metrics, including delivery compliance, turn-around time (TAT), first-mile/last-mile efficiency, and service partner SLAs.
* **Data Verification & Audit Support:**
  Reconcile ground-level operational data against system logs to identify discrepancies, leakage, and non-compliance during field audits and investigations.

**2. Advanced Analytics & Excel Modeling**

* **Advanced Excel Operations:**
  Utilize advanced Excel functions (XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, Nested IFs, Dynamic Pivot Tables, Data Validation, Power Query, Macros/VBA) to clean, consolidate, and model multi-source logistics datasets.
* **Analytical Curiosity:**
  Conduct trend analysis, variance analysis, and root-cause analyses on operational bottlenecks and incident reports to highlight performance gaps.
* **Data-Driven Action Plans:**
  Support local action plan development by providing actionable quantitative evidence and impact projections to field operations teams.

**3. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Alignment**

* **On-the-Ground Data Alignment:**
  Work closely with field auditors, hub operations, and last-mile teams to gather unstructured operational feedback and convert it into structured metrics.
* **Cross-Functional Governance:**
  Present periodic data insights and risk highlights to hub managers, service partner managers, and regional leadership to drive process adherence.
* **Adaptability & Resilience:**
  Adapt reporting frameworks quickly to accommodate emergency operational shifts, system changes, or new logistics channel rollouts.

**Key Requirements**

* **MIS & Data Expertise:**
  Strong, hands-on experience in MIS reporting, data analysis, and dashboard preparation (Logistics, Express Cargo, Supply Chain, or E-commerce background preferred).
* **Advanced Excel Skills (Mandatory):**
  Mastery in complex formulas, Power Query, automated reporting workflows, and data visualization.
  *(Note: Candidates will undergo a strict practical Excel assessment during the interview process).*
* **Analytical Mindset:**
  Exceptional attention to detail with an ability to spot anomalies in large datasets quickly.
* **Communication:**
  Ability to articulate data-driven findings clearly to both ground-level operational staff and senior stakeholders.
* **Location:**
  Based at DTDC Bhawan, Kolkata, with occasional visits to local hubs/clusters for data validation.

**Selection Process**

1. **Resume Screening & Initial Discussion**
2. **Practical MIS & Advanced Excel Assessment Test**
3. **Operational & Technical Interview**

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst – Billing & Quote to Cash
description:

**Overview**

The analyst will act as a subject matter expert for one or more applications and will help ensure that systems, integrations, data, and business processes work together effectively across the quote-to-cash lifecycle.
  
  
The role will support both strategic initiatives and ongoing application improvement, including new products and capabilities, system enhancements, process optimization, integration activities, and resolution of complex application and business-process issues.
  
  
The Senior Business Systems Analyst will work directly with business stakeholders, application teams, developers, and quality assurance resources throughout the solution lifecycle, including requirements definition, process and data analysis, functional design, testing, implementation, and post-implementation support.
  
  
Experience with TNS's business, products, customers, and billing environment is a strong plus.

* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to understand business objectives and translate them into clear, actionable business and system requirements.

* Evaluate the downstream impacts of new products, customer requirements, pricing models, acquisitions, and business-process changes on billing and quote-to-cash applications.
* Support application integrations and data flows between commercial, ordering, billing, financial, and enterprise platforms.
* Investigate and help resolve complex application and process issues, identifying root causes and sustainable solutions rather than relying on manual workarounds.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve data quality, eliminate manual effort and waste, strengthen controls, and increase automation.
* Serve as a liaison between business stakeholders, application teams, development teams, and other technology functions.
* Support application and process changes through requirements, design, testing, implementation, stakeholder communication, and stabilization.
* Apply Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies as appropriate to the initiative.
* Demonstrate strong ownership, sound judgment, curiosity, and the ability to independently drive complex work across multiple stakeholder groups.

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

* Experience supporting billing, order-to-cash, quote-to-cash, ERP, CRM, CPQ, commerce, or other transaction-oriented enterprise applications.
* Experience working with software development, QA, architecture, and business teams throughout the application development lifecycle.
* Experience planning and supporting system testing and user acceptance testing.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to work across multiple interconnected systems and business processes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical audiences.
* Ability to prioritize and independently drive multiple initiatives in a changing business environment.

**Qualifications**
**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Experience with Salesforce, particularly in a complex enterprise environment involving commercial, quoting, ordering, or billing processes.
* Experience with Expedite Commerce or similar CPQ, product configuration, order management, or quote-to-cash platforms.
* Experience with enterprise billing platforms, billing integrations, invoicing, pricing, rating, usage-based billing, or recurring-revenue processes.

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - P and C - Staff
description:

**Staff, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!

We are looking for a Staff member to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.

As a Staff member within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Seniors, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members

* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Updating the report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.

Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Knowledge of how insurance works and basics of Actuarial profession
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc, will be a plus
* Ability to utilize AI tools to expedite current processes and workflows
* Good exam progress consistent with experience

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

**What We Look For**

* knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting.
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

title: Procurement Specialist
description:
**Job Summary:**

The Procurement Specialist is responsible for developing and executing assortment and inventory strategies that drive sales, gross margin, and inventory productivity across assigned client’s retail locations. This role owns vendor partnerships, negotiates cost and commercial terms, and ensures optimal product mix between Client’s internal and third-party brands where applicable. The Procurement Specialist actively manages budgets, sell-through, and aging inventory, collaborates cross-functionally on pricing and promotional strategy, and ensures compliance. The role leverages data analytics and market insights to optimize category performance and support Client’s financial objectives.

**Job Duties:**
Core duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

**Assortment Architecture & Strategy:**

* Assist the Client’s Leadership in developing assortment architectures that account for price bands,

depth of choice, and key vendor partnerships across all retail locations.

* Support the Client’s assortment architecture initiative by assigning brands to pricing tiers based

on product quality and cost, including recommended retail pricing and promotional components.

* Monitor shifts in consumer purchasing behaviour by package size and adjust assortment, pricing,

and promotional strategy to protect profitability.

* Actively manage the full product lifecycle from introduction through maturity and exit,

ensuring disciplined SKU onboarding, performance tracking, and rationalization.

**Buying & Purchasing Operations:**

* Responsible for identifying, selecting, and purchasing internal and third-party products for

assigned retail locations in adherence with the 5 Rights of Buying: Right Quality, Right Quantity,

Right Price, Right Placement, and Right Timing.

* Maintain purchase orders and track information in the designated system, ensuring orders are

received in full at designated locations and that Accounting has the necessary information to

complete vendor payment within agreed-upon terms.

* Support monthly Open-to-Buy budgets and report performance to company leadership.

**Vendor Partnerships & Negotiations:**

* Create and maintain effective partnerships with new and existing vendors, negotiating terms,

pricing, and supply agreements; partner with applicable internal departments to develop and

execute specific terms where applicable.

* Collaborate with cross-functional partners on incoming brands, product education, and

assortment updates.

* Stay connected to the industry and react with urgency to market trends through

frequent communication with field teams and consistent review of market data

available through various third-party platforms.

**Pricing Strategy & Margin Ownership:**

* Collaborate with the Client’s Leadership and Executive team to develop a pricing strategy that

is competitive in the market and achieves targeted margin thresholds.

* Own category gross margin performance with accountability for both gross margin dollars (GM$)

and gross margin rate (GM%), ensuring assortment and pricing decisions maximize absolute

profit contribution.

**Promotional Strategy & Inventory Health:**

* Partner with Retail and Marketing teams to strategically deploy promotions and markdowns

that accelerate aged inventory while protecting brand integrity and profitability.

* Recommend and inform monthly and seasonal promotional calendars, aligning vendor

funding, internal brand priorities, and inventory health objectives.

**Reporting & Cross-Functional Collaboration:**

* Work closely with Retail Leaders and Merchandise Planning on sales and inventory reporting to

ensure stores maintain adequate supply in key categories and products.

* Collaborate with fellow Buyers, Merchandise Planning, and the Business Strategy team to develop

and maintain robust sales reporting and product performance metrics down to the SKU level as

needed.

**Job Requirements:**

* Retail Management or related field, 5+ years’ experience or equivalent
* Experience with ERP and/or Inventory Management systems; advanced Microsoft Excel skills required.
* Proven ability to establish strong credibility and build relationships, operate in an environment

of ambiguity and maintain strict confidentiality.

* Highly analytical, capable of turning raw data into information and insights.
* Strong financial acumen and analytical skills, prior experience developing and managing a budget.
* Excellent organizational skills, ability to develop and implement operational best practices.
* Good judgment in a fast-moving environment with the ability to prioritize and execute multiple

tasks with urgency.

* Must possess excellent business judgment, strong written and oral communication skills, and a can-

do, common-sense approach to getting things done.

title: Founder's Office Intern - Strategy & Growth
description:
**About Dosbros & Divine Brands**

Divine Brands Pvt. Ltd. is the company behind DosBros Fresh Mexican Grill India, bringing the bold flavours of a US-origin Mexican QSR brand to the Indian market.

DosBros has
**60+ locations globally across the USA, India and Canada**

This is a high-ownership, generalist internship for someone who wants to understand how businesses are built, scaled and funded.

You will act as

You will be involved in evaluating new opportunities, coordinating strategic projects, strengthening brand presence, supporting investor outreach and helping convert business plans into execution.

**Key Responsibilities1. Strategy & Business Growth**

* Work directly with the Founder and senior management on strategic initiatives, business planning and growth strategies.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis and feasibility assessments to evaluate new business opportunities.
* Identify new revenue streams, business models and expansion possibilities.
* Assist in preparing business plans, financial models, management reports and presentations.
* Track business performance, analyse data and convert findings into actionable recommendations.

**2. Brand Management & Marketing**

* Contribute to strengthening DosBros' brand positioning, brand value, market presence and overall awareness across India.
* Work with external marketing consultants and the internal team to strategize, coordinate and follow up on marketing campaigns, promotional activities and brand-building initiatives, tracking timely execution and deliverables.
* Support new product launches, menu innovations, existing product promotions and seasonal campaigns, coordinating with restaurant teams for effective on-ground implementation and customer engagement.

**3. Fundraising & Investor Relations**

* Research and identify suitable investors, including angel investors, HNIs, family offices, strategic investors and funds interested in consumer, food and beverage, retail or brick-and-mortar businesses.
* Build and maintain a structured investor database and outreach pipeline, and support initial investor communication and follow-ups.
* Assist in preparing and refining investor presentations, fundraising proposals, financial models, unit economics and business expansion plans.
* Coordinate investor meetings, maintain communication records and support the fundraising process, including information sharing and due-diligence coordination.

**4. Business Development & Strategic Partnerships**

* Support franchise development, franchise partner coordination and expansion initiatives across India.
* Explore corporate partnerships, catering opportunities, packaged meals and institutional business opportunities.
* Coordinate with food delivery aggregators such as Zomato and Swiggy, POS providers, technology partners, franchise partners and other external stakeholders.
* Identify and evaluate strategic partnerships, new business models and opportunities to generate additional revenue.
* Manage business discussions, follow-ups and execution coordination with external partners.

**5. Project Management & Execution**

* Take ownership of assigned business projects and drive them from planning through execution.
* Coordinate cross-functional initiatives involving marketing, finance, supply chain, technology and business development teams.
* Track project timelines, identify execution bottlenecks and follow up with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure timely implementation of management decisions and strategic priorities.
* Prepare progress updates, reports and presentations for the Founder and senior management.

**Who Should Apply?**

We are looking for someone who:

* Has an entrepreneurial mindset and a genuine interest in startups, business strategy and company building.
* Is comfortable working in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.
* Takes ownership and follows through without requiring constant supervision.
* Has strong analytical, research, problem-solving and communication skills.
* Can manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Is comfortable with business research, Excel-based analysis, presentations and external stakeholder coordination.
* Is proactive, resourceful, detail-oriented and execution-focused.

Previous exposure to a Founder's Office, CEO's Office, business strategy, business operations, fundraising, investor relations, marketing or management consulting will be an advantage, but is not mandatory.

Freshers and candidates with 0–2 years of experience are welcome to apply if they demonstrate strong initiative, ownership and entrepreneurial thinking.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Management, Engineering or a related field.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint and Google Workspace.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok.
* Strong research, documentation, presentation and analytical abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to prepare business reports, investor presentations, research documents and analytical summaries.
* Interest in business strategy, fundraising, consumer brands and the food and beverage industry.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Direct Founder Exposure:**
  Work closely with the Founder on strategic business priorities and growth decisions.
* **Business-Building Experience:**

* **Fundraising Exposure:**

description:
**Key Responsibilities**
**Material Planning & On-Time Delivery**

* Ensure assigned indirect materials and services are delivered to internal departments on or before the scheduled requirement date.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, suppliers, stores and user departments to track purchase requirements, order status and delivery commitments.
* Proactively identify supply risks, expedite critical items and communicate potential delays with clear recovery actions.

**Cost Analysis & Commercial Management**

* Conduct detailed cost analysis, price benchmarking and total-cost evaluation to establish the appropriate purchase cost for indirect materials and services.
* Monitor pricing and cost trends across affiliated and approved suppliers, and maintain visibility of commercial changes.
* Lead commercial negotiations covering price, payment terms, delivery terms, freight, warranty and other relevant conditions.
* Identify and implement cost-reduction, value-engineering and process-improvement initiatives at the supplier end or within internal processes.

**Supplier Analysis & Development**

* Scan the market to identify capable suppliers and create alternate vendors wherever required to improve availability, competitiveness and supply continuity.
* Assess supplier capability with reference to technical competence, capacity, quality systems, delivery performance, financial/commercial suitability and responsiveness.
* Maintain an appropriate vendor base for assigned commodities and support supplier onboarding, evaluation and development.

**Supplier Performance Management**

* Analyze existing supplier performance using data and past experience, including rejection rate, rework issues, delivery issues, stock levels, supplier capacity and service responsiveness.
* Conduct periodic supplier performance reviews, agree corrective actions and monitor closure of identified gaps.
* Escalate recurring supplier risks and support decisions relating to development, alternate sourcing or supplier rationalization.

**Inventory & Quality Control**

* Ensure commodity-wise inventory control by monitoring stock levels, consumption trends, lead times, reorder requirements and excess or obsolete inventory risks.
* Monitor incoming quality and address commodity-wise quality issues in coordination with Quality, Stores, Engineering, Finance and user departments.
* Drive root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, replacement or rework, and timely closure of supplier quality concerns.

**Data, MIS & ERP Discipline**

* Prepare procurement data, management information reports and periodic dashboards covering spend, savings, supplier performance, inventory, delivery and quality.
* Ensure timely and accurate creation and maintenance of purchase-related data and transactions in the ERP system.
* Maintain complete procurement records, quotations, comparative statements, approvals, purchase orders, contracts and supplier documents in accordance with internal controls.

**Governance & Stakeholder Management**

* Follow the approved procurement process, delegation of authority, compliance requirements and ethical sourcing standards.
* Partner with internal departments to understand demand, define specifications, prioritize requirements and improve purchasing effectiveness.
* Support audits and provide procurement records, supplier data and transaction evidence as required.

* 15 +years of Supply chain & logistic management experience
* Exposure to Indirect purchase is preferred

**Role Purpose**

The Techno Commercial Executive will be responsible for
**vendor development, component sourcing, cost estimation, techno-commercial evaluation, and supplier negotiations**
for mechanical and/or electrical components. The role requires close coordination with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Planning, and Supply Chain teams to ensure components are sourced at the right cost, quality, and delivery timelines.

The position should have good exposure to engineering components and manufacturing processes, particularly
**castings, forgings, machined components, fabricated parts, and bought-out components**
. Similar sourcing requirements are reflected in existing Techno Commercial roles for Ahmedabad.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Vendor Development & Component Sourcing**

* Identify, evaluate, develop, and onboard new vendors for engineering components based on technical and commercial requirements.
* Develop vendors for
  **castings, forgings, machined components, fabricated parts, fasteners, and other mechanical/electrical bought-out components**
  .
* Coordinate with Engineering and Quality teams for vendor technical evaluation, capability assessment, sample development, and approval.
* Drive alternate vendor development to improve cost competitiveness and reduce supply-chain dependency.

**Techno Commercial & Costing**

* Review engineering drawings, specifications, BOMs, and technical requirements for sourcing and RFQ preparation.
* Perform
  **cost estimation, should-cost analysis, zero-based costing, and supplier quotation comparison**
  .
* Understand cost drivers related to raw materials, machining, casting, forging, fabrication, tooling, processing, logistics, and conversion costs.
* Conduct techno-commercial negotiations with suppliers covering pricing, lead time, payment terms, warranty, tooling, and delivery conditions.
* Prepare comparative statements and commercial recommendations for supplier finalization.

Internal sourcing examples also show practical experience with forged components, including closed-die, open-die and ring-rolled forgings, as well as sand, shell-mould and investment castings.

**Supplier & Cross-Functional Management**

* Monitor supplier performance against
  **Quality, Cost and Delivery (QCD)**
  parameters.
* Coordinate with Design, Engineering, Quality, Production, Planning, Finance, and Logistics teams.
* Support new product development through early supplier involvement and prototype/component sourcing.
* Follow up with suppliers for development schedules and timely delivery.
* Support supplier audits, cost-reduction initiatives, value engineering, and localization opportunities.

**Procurement & Commercial Activities**

* Handle RFQ/RFP processes, quotation analysis, negotiations, and commercial finalization.
* Support PO finalization and ensure adherence to agreed commercial terms.
* Track commodity/raw-material price movements and evaluate their impact on component costing.
* Maintain appropriate sourcing, costing, vendor-development, and commercial documentation.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* **B.E. / B.Tech. in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.**
* **3 to 10 years**
  of relevant experience in Techno Commercial, Strategic Sourcing, Procurement, Vendor Development, Component Development, or Costing.
