description:
Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities.
  
  
**Come Join Our Team!**

* As part of our robust Rewards & Recognition program, this role is eligible for our Ventra performance-based incentive plan, because we believe great work deserves great rewards

**Help Us Grow Our Dream Team — Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!**
**Job Summary**

* We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Healthcare RCM Supervisor, Accounts Receivable, to oversee our accounts receivable department. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills, a comprehensive understanding of healthcare revenue cycle management, and a proven track record of optimizing accounts receivable processes. The Supervisor will be responsible for managing a team of AR specialists, ensuring timely and accurate billing, claims processing, payment posting, and denial management.

**Essential Functions And Tasks**

* Lead and manage a team of accounts receivable specialists, providing guidance, support, and coaching to ensure high performance and productivity.
* Develop and implement strategies to optimize the accounts receivable process, reduce aging of accounts, and improve cash flow.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics related to accounts receivable, such as days in accounts receivable (AR days), denial rates, and cash collection ratios, and take proactive measures to address any deviations from targets.
* Oversee the billing and claims processing functions, ensuring that claims are submitted accurately and timely, and that any issues or errors are promptly addressed and resolved.
* Manage payment posting activities, reconciling payments received with billed charges, and identifying and addressing any discrepancies or variances.
* Coordinate denial management efforts, analyzing denial trends, implementing corrective actions, and appealing denials as necessary to maximize revenue recovery.
* Collaborate with other departments, such as coding, billing, and compliance, to ensure alignment and consistency in revenue cycle processes and workflows.
* Stay informed about changes and updates in healthcare regulations, payer policies, and industry trends related to accounts receivable management, and implement necessary changes to ensure compliance and optimization.
* Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews, providing feedback, recognition, and development opportunities to team members.
* Foster a positive and collaborative work environment, promoting teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a point of contact for escalated issues and inquiries from internal stakeholders, external partners, and patients related to accounts receivable matters.
* Keep accurate records of accounts receivable activities, performance metrics, and outcomes, and generate reports as needed to track progress and measure success.

**Education And Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in any related field.
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, with a focus on accounts receivable.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Previous leadership experience, preferably in a healthcare setting.
* In-depth knowledge of medical billing processes, reimbursement methodologies, and regulatory requirements.
* Strong understanding of healthcare payer policies and claims adjudication processes.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively lead and motivate a team.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on driving results and achieving objectives.
* Proficiency in healthcare revenue cycle management software and systems.
* Certified Professional Coder (CPC) or Certified Revenue Cycle Representative (CRCR) certification is a plus.
* Willingness to stay updated on industry trends and best practices through continuing education and professional development opportunities.

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - P and C - Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. **Role Name And Description**
**Staff, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Staff member to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Staff member within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
**On engagements, you will:**

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Seniors, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members

**Within the actuarial practice you will:**

* Estimate actuarial liability for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR model using the data supplied for estimation
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Updating the report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS, Alteryx, IGLOO, ResQ or other reserving software are good to have, but not must criteria
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Knowledge of how insurance works and basics of Actuarial profession
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc, will be a plus
* Ability to utilize AI tools to expedite current processes and workflows
* Good exam progress consistent with experience

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**

* Strong foundational understanding of actuarial concepts acquired through actuarial examinations, with the ability to apply these concepts to practical business and insurance scenarios.
* knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting.
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Lead – Partnerships, Grants & Impact
company: SB Global Educational Resources Pvt Ltd
description:
**About Buimerc India Foundation**

Buimerc India Foundation is a philanthropic platform dedicated to creating sustainable social impact across seven focus areas: Environment & Ecosystem, Animal Welfare, Child Welfare, Elder Care, Differently Abled, Youth & Women Empowerment, and Art, Culture & Heritage.

The Foundation partners with high-impact non-profit organizations, supporting them through grants, strategic guidance, networking opportunities, and capacity-building initiatives that strengthen their ability to deliver meaningful outcomes for communities.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and purpose-driven
**Lead – Partnerships, Grants & Impact**
to manage and strengthen the Foundation's portfolio of NGO partners across India. The role focuses on partner coordination, due diligence, grant stewardship, impact tracking, relationship management, and strategic partnership development.

The successful candidate will serve as a key link between the Foundation and its partner organizations, ensuring that funding is effectively translated into measurable and sustainable social impact.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Partnership Development & Stewardship**

* Identify and evaluate potential NGO partners aligned with the Foundation's strategic priorities.
* Build and maintain long-term relationships with partner organizations and sector stakeholders.
* Conduct organizational assessments and support partnership due diligence processes.
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned NGO partners.

**Grant Portfolio Management**

* Support grant evaluation, recommendation, and monitoring processes.
* Review programme proposals, budgets, progress reports, and outcome frameworks.
* Ensure compliance with grant agreements and reporting requirements.
* Monitor programmatic and financial progress across the partner portfolio.

**Impact Measurement & Learning**

* Track outcomes, impact indicators, and key performance metrics across funded initiatives.
* Consolidate partner reports and generate periodic impact summaries for Foundation leadership.
* Support knowledge-sharing and learning initiatives across the partner ecosystem.
* Document success stories, case studies, and best practices.

**Capacity Building & Engagement**

* Identify opportunities to strengthen partner capabilities and organizational effectiveness.
* Facilitate workshops, mentoring opportunities, and peer-learning engagements.
* Foster collaboration among partners working across complementary sectors.

**Stakeholder Representation**

* Represent the Foundation at sector forums, conferences, partner meetings, and community engagements.
* Build relationships with development sector experts, institutions, and ecosystem partners.
* Contribute to strategic discussions on grant-making priorities and partnership opportunities.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Postgraduate degree in Social Work, Development Studies, Public Policy, Sociology, Environmental Science, Rural Development, or a related discipline.
* 5-8 years of experience in philanthropy, CSR, non-profit management, grant-making, partnership management, or social impact initiatives.
* Experience reviewing project proposals, monitoring grants, or managing NGO partnerships.
* Strong analytical, communication, relationship management, and report-writing skills.
* Ability to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders across sectors and geographies.
* Willingness to travel

**Preferred Skills**

* Understanding of NGO governance, compliance, and organizational assessment.
* Experience in impact measurement and outcome-based reporting.
* Fluency in English, Hindi, Malayalam, and Tamil.
* Strong presentation and stakeholder engagement capabilities.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You believe that meaningful change happens when strong community organizations are empowered to succeed. You are relationship-oriented, analytical, and committed to building trust-based partnerships. You combine empathy with accountability and are motivated by the opportunity to strengthen organizations that create lasting social impact.

**Join Us**

At Buimerc India Foundation, you will play a pivotal role in identifying, supporting, and strengthening organizations that are transforming lives across India. Join us in building a collaborative ecosystem where philanthropy enables scalable and sustainable impact.

description:

Our purpose, at EY, is building a better working world. The Alliances Shared Services Bureau within EY GDS is a dynamic and cross-functional business unit spanning multiple locations across India in addition to Philippines and Argentina. **Role Summary**
The GDS Alliances Finance Budget Supervisor will function out of the ES Finance service function and will be responsible for providing ongoing Finance operations support to the Global Alliance & Ecosystem Finance and working closely with GDS Alliances Finance Budget Manager, as part of the broader global Ecosystem Relationship Enablement function. The incumbent will be responsible for facilitating financial transactions, project management, budget management support, and other operational activities as per the agreed scope of support, using EY’s global finance systems and tools.
  
  
**Description**
**Technical expertise:**

* Budgets & Planning: Support Annual financial planning - costs, expenses and yearly forecasts. Analyse actuals against the budget details and manage budget reallocations as needed. Summarise data weekly for the budget dashboards and process reclass entries wherever required. Manage year-end accruals to ensure effective utilization of available budget through recording and submitting to Finance accrual entries for expenses incurred through the year that are not processed during the same year.
* Engagement Code management: Ensure proper use of travel expenses and accurate code mapping across Global and Americas sponsoring entities. Manage cost movements across codes throughout the year.
* Annual fee: Track & manage annual alliance fee records and process journal entries for codes received. Manage monthly recurring entries and year end accruals.
* GDS budget Analysis / updates: Manage and update GDS headcount file with latest rates, headcount status, new roles and hiring/exit status. Reconcile general chargeback code to regularly assess and report available balance for GDS cost management. Provide details to stakeholders on required fees to manage GDS costs. Perform headcount analysis and savings through cost arbitrage. Connect with stakeholders as required to understand the budget usage, future expected costs and accruals. Manage GDS invoice records, billing inventory, and assist in periodic invoicing activities. Review & reconcile invoices and highlight any discrepancies in the GDS invoices.
* Reporting: Weekly budget to actuals for the charge codes assigned. Reporting monthly financials and other reports highlighting key performance parameters. Assist in monitoring and tracking the financial results against operational and strategic objectives as well as historical performance.Engage with the various alliance stakeholders regularly to provide custom reports and track upcoming anticipated costs and status against available budget.
* Operations: Provide Operational support/cost improvement studies to enable effective management to improve operations and increase the efficiency of resources/processes. Provide headcount reports to manage distribution lists on a monthly basis. Share invoices with the processing team and track payment status on a weekly basis. Coordinate with functional teams for collecting data.

Connect with GDS team on the open items, provide support on the invoicing process, offer any other finance support on the new programs / activities. Automation of reports wherever possible and provide inputs for process improvement, building efficiencies, and standardization
* Process Improvement and Standardization: Define processes and lead/support the design of processes and roles leveraging best-in-class practices and enabling technologies, to ensure optimum and consistent performance. * Focus on client and effectively use consultative approaches for stakeholder management.
* Capability to engage multiple stakeholders by quickly understanding the objectives.

* Help increase impact of the outlined strategies and run seamless day-to-day operations.

**Soft skills:**

* Capability to quickly understand the needs of the business and align with changing customer expectations.
* Ability to work under minimal supervision.
* Skilled at taking ownership and driving projects end-to-end.
* Self-motivated to learn new tools and technology.
* Strong inclination toward upskilling
* Ability to articulate concisely and think out-of-the-box.
* Ability to focus on solutions in case of ambiguity and overcome the problem.
* Display a positive attitude with the capability to work under pressure.

**Leadership and people management:**

* Effective in time management and project prioritization
* Shows high degree of professionalism and integrity.
* Uses outstanding speaking and writing skills to enhance understanding and encourage collaboration.
* Collaborative mindset with ability to identify risk or opportunity areas.

Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.

* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members

* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Updating the report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise

* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.

Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Knowledge of how insurance works and basics of Actuarial profession
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc, will be a plus
* Ability to utilize AI tools to expedite current processes and workflows
* Good exam progress consistent with experience

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification

* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. Senior/Chief Manager

Legal

***A. NBFC Advisory***

* Advise on Lending Service Provider (LSP) arrangements, critical technology contracts, API integrations and arrangements for— partner onboarding, allocation of roles and responsibilities.

* Advise on data collection, storage, consent and localisation requirements under the digital lending framework, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and RBI requirements.
* Financing documents review and advisory for fund-raising and investments for the NBFC.

***B. Group entity legal support***

* Provide general legal support across the group's legal entities (holding / platform company, the technology / LSP company and other subsidiaries).
* Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial contracts for group entities — vendor, services, intercompany, shared-services, SaaS and NDAs.
* Support intra-group arrangements and inter-company agreements across jurisdictions.

***C. Specialist advisory***

* Insurance – advise on key contracts and arrangements as per IRDAI Regulations.
* Intellectual property — advise on trademark and brand protection (registration, watch and enforcement for the app and brand), IP ownership and assignment, copyright and software IP, licensing, and the IP terms in technology and marketing contracts.
* Employment — advise on employment contracts, HR policies and workplace codes (including POSH), incentive and ESOP documentation, disciplinary, grievance and exit matters, and employment disputes.
* M&A / corporate transactions — support acquisitions and group restructurings, including legal due diligence, term sheets, definitive transaction documents.

***D. Cross-cutting***

* Provide clear, practical, risk-weighted advice that carries commercial context, not just legal analysis.
* Create self-serve guidance, checklists and playbooks that let business teams move quickly within guardrails.
* Uphold high standards of legal risk management, confidentiality and record-keeping.

**Experience:**
1-2 years

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct privacy gap assessments, Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), and privacy risk assessments for enterprise customers.

* Interpret applicable privacy regulations, including the India DPDP Act, GDPR, and CCPA/CPRA, map their requirements to customer processes and controls, and track regulatory developments that affect them.
* Identify privacy risks and compliance gaps, and recommend practical remediation measures and compliance roadmaps.
* Prepare Records of Processing Activities (RoPA), data maps, data flow diagrams, assessment reports, and risk registers, with findings supported by evidence.

* A good understanding of privacy principles and data protection requirements.
* Working knowledge of the DPDP Act, 2023 and GDPR, and familiarity with CCPA/CPRA and other global privacy regulations.
* Exposure to PIAs, DPIAs, privacy audits, gap assessments, privacy risk assessments and compliance reviews.
* Understanding of data mapping, RoPA, data flow diagrams, privacy governance, consent management, lawful processing, Data Principal and data subject rights, purpose limitation, data minimisation, retention and third-party processing.

title: Lead - Wholesale Risk
description:
**Job Description: Compliance & Risk Programs Manager**
**Location:**
Bangalore, India
**| Experience:**
5–9 years
  
  

* About the Company

Credit Saison Company Limited (Credit Saison Japan) was founded in 1951 and is one of Japan’s largest lending conglomerates with over 70 years of history and listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange with over 4,500 employees in Japan. The Company has evolved from a credit-card issuer to a diversified financial services provider across payments, leasing, finance, real estate and entertainment. Outside of Japan, there are over 1,500 employees working across Saison International’s global operations spanning five countries - Singapore, India, Vietnam, Mexico and Brazil. Kisetsu Finance India (Pvt) Ltd is a subsidiary of Credit Saison Japan, with an NBFC license and involved in both retail and wholesale lending.
  
  

* About the Role

This role sits in the risk management team. The candidate will be based out of the Bangalore office, India, reporting to SVP Risk and working closely with the risk team members covering non-financial risk and IT risk as well as in house legal counsels on legal matters and policies.
  
  
Group Compliance Oversight — Spanning Compliance With All Applicable Laws And Regulations, Underpinned By a Zero-tolerance Culture, Including But Not Limited To AML/CFT And Data Protection — Is Being Integrated Into The Risk Team's Existing Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Framework, With Oversight Routed Through The Risk Management Committee (RMC) Rather Than a Standalone Compliance Committee. It Combines Four Connected Areas Of Work Rather Than a Single Narrow Mandate
  
  

* Develop and implement a compliance program – working with senior management and legal counsels in setting minimum requirements and compliance standards for various businesses and prioritizing implementation of various compliance initiatives.
* Compliance oversight support – day-to-day support for compliance oversight across businesses (including AML/CFT and data protection, among other applicable regulatory areas), working with local first-line teams and escalating regulatory judgment calls to the Head of Compliance, senior risk team or legal counsels as required.
* RMC material coordination and standardization – supporting the end-to-end RMC reporting process: building and maintaining a standard template, chasing inputs from all contributing teams (deal review, financial risk, non-financial risk, GBD), consolidating them into a single governance-ready pack, and ensuring materials reach invitees on time.
* Data & IT risk implementation review – supporting information security, data confidentiality, and applicable privacy/data protection regulation (e.g., PDPA) implementation reviews, and helping consolidate findings into incident response guidelines, in partnership with the non-financial risk lead. Over time, this is intended to grow into closer, hands-on review of how data risk controls are actually implemented – for example, checking data classification and tagging coverage, reviewing access control matrices, and testing endpoint controls – independently verifying that what IT/InfoSec has built meets the group's minimum standards, and reporting gaps for remediation. This is a pure second-line check: the role does not build, configure, or specify the technical implementation itself, which remains entirely with IT/InfoSec.

This is a program-management and coordination role, not a final decision-making seat: accountability for regulatory judgment calls and second-line risk opinions remains with the Head of Compliance and the senior risk team. The candidate will, over time, help make RMC reporting and compliance/data risk documentation processes that do not depend on any single individual, with room to grow hands-on technical fluency in reviewing data risk implementation along the way.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* Work with senior management to develop a group compliance program which sets minimum standards for businesses.
* Monitor/guide local compliance programs and provide assurance to senior management that they meet minimum group standards and frameworks.
* Support setting the priorities for roll out of various group policies and ensure roll out covers end to end implementation including training, clear roles and responsibilities and full lifecycle of incidents.
* Support day-to-day compliance oversight across businesses — covering all applicable laws and regulations, including AML/CFT and data protection — coordinating with local first-line teams and flagging issues for senior review rather than resolving them independently.
* Co-ordinate the RMC material process: improve and maintain a standardized template, chase and consolidate inputs from all contributing teams, and ensure the RMC pack is circulated to invitees at least one week ahead of each meeting, with all sections populated on time.
* Drive standardization of RMC reporting so outputs are consistent across various businesses, and packaged in a way the RMC can act on.
* Support information security, data confidentiality, and applicable privacy/data protection regulation (e.g., PDPA) implementation reviews, and help consolidate findings into incident response guidelines together with the non-financial risk lead.
* Independently check and test what IT/InfoSec has implemented against defined data risk standards – for example, data classification and tagging coverage, access control matrices, and endpoint controls – and report gaps for remediation; the build and configuration of these controls remains with IT/InfoSec.
* Maintain clear documentation of RMC, compliance, and data & IT risk review processes so they are transparent, auditable, and not dependent on any one individual.
* Escalate regulatory judgment calls, high-stakes findings, and any ambiguity in scope to the Head of Risk and/or Head of Compliance promptly.
* Qualifications and Skills
* Experience in a compliance, risk, or program-management role at a financial institution, ideally with exposure to a broad regulatory compliance landscape (e.g., AML/CFT, data security/privacy regimes such as PDPA or LGPD, and other applicable regulations) across multiple jurisdictions.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders across entities and geographies to run a recurring reporting or governance cadence (e.g., committee or board reporting processes).
* Comfortable engaging with technical detail when reviewing IT/InfoSec's implementation of data risk controls (e.g., data classification and tagging, access controls, endpoint controls) as a growth area – prior hands-on IT/security engineering experience is not required, but the ability to interpret and test technical controls against policy is important.
* Strong process discipline and attention to detail, with the ability to design and enforce templates and checklists rather than rely on ad hoc formats.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to coordinate senior colleagues without having direct authority over them.
* A business, finance, or related degree; certifications such as CAMS, CISA, or similar compliance/IT risk credentials are a plus but not required.
* Why Join Us?
* Opportunity to join a fast-growing team within a large and stable company, as part of large group.
* Exposure to compliance, non-financial risk, and data & IT risk all within a single role – including hands-on technical fluency in reviewing how data risk controls are implemented – leading to a well-rounded risk profile.
* Chance to shape the governance process – the compliance program – from the ground up, during a live organizational transition.
* Exposure to global markets and diverse geographies.
* Chance to work on impactful projects that promote financial inclusion.
* Collaborative and innovative work environment.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.

title: Operational Risk Policy Governance Analyst
description:
Are you a policy and governance specialist who thrives on bringing structure, clarity, and rigour to complex frameworks? Do you have a foundational grounding in operational risk and a passion for designing policy architectures that genuinely drive sustainable governance? If so, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact at one of the world's leading reinsurance companies.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Operational Risk Policy Governance Analyst at Swiss Re, you will be at the heart of building and shaping a central second line of defence (2LoD) policy governance capability for selected operational risks — spanning evolving and high-priority areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Operational Resilience, Third Party Risk Management, and Finance. This role is fundamentally about policy and standard creation, framework design, and lifecycle governance. You will define the architecture, draft the requirements, manage the end-to-end lifecycle, and provide independent oversight — all within an operational risk context. Working closely with first line teams and subject matter experts, you will bring the structure and expertise needed to make policy governance a genuine enabler of sound risk management across the organisation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and evolve policy architecture — build and maintain the structural framework for selected operational risk policies and standards, ensuring clarity, consistency, and alignment with Swiss Re's governance standards
* Draft policy and standard requirements — create clear, concise, and practical policy requirements and standards that provide effective second line oversight and meaningful guidance to first line teams
* Manage the end-to-end policy lifecycle — oversee policies and standards from inception through periodic review to retirement, maintaining high-quality documentation and producing meaningful governance reporting
* Coordinate approvals and governance processes — manage structured review and approval cycles end-to-end, ensuring timely completion and accurate record-keeping
* Provide trusted second line oversight and constructive challenge — act as a credible and collaborative partner to first line teams and subject matter experts, applying sound judgement and an independent perspective grounded in operational risk principles
* Engage and manage stakeholders across functions and seniority levels — build strong professional networks and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences
* Drive continuous improvement — proactively identify opportunities to enhance policy governance frameworks, processes, and tools in a dynamic and evolving risk environment

**About The Team**
The ORM Policy Governance team sits within Group Functions Risk Management (GFRM) at Swiss Re. The team is responsible for building and maintaining a central 2LoD policy governance capability for selected operational risks, working across the organisation to ensure that policy requirements are clear, robust, and fit for purpose. The team collaborates closely with first line teams and subject matter experts to promote consistent, sustainable governance across a broad range of evolving operational risk topics.
  
  
**About You**
You are a structured, detail-oriented, and proactive professional whose expertise lies in policy and standard creation and governance. You know how to design a policy framework, manage its lifecycle with rigour, and write requirements that are both practical and robust. Alongside this, you bring a foundational understanding of operational risk management — enough to apply sound judgement on governance matters and engage credibly with risk and control teams. You are a confident communicator who can challenge constructively, navigate complexity, and manage multiple priorities, all while contributing to a team culture built on knowledge sharing, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements**

* Policy and standard creation expertise — demonstrated, hands-on experience in drafting, designing, and managing policies and/or standards, including the ability to build and maintain a structured policy framework and govern its full lifecycle from inception through to retirement
* Policy governance and lifecycle management — proven experience managing governance processes such as approvals, periodic reviews, version control, and documentation, with a strong ability to write clear, concise, and practical policy requirements
* Foundational understanding of operational risk management — solid grounding in operational risk concepts and the three lines of defence model, with the ability to apply this knowledge to inform sound policy design and provide credible second line oversight
* Specialist domain knowledge — solid knowledge and demonstrable skills in at least one of the following areas: Artificial Intelligence (AI) governance, Operational Resilience, Third Party Risk Management, or Finance — this specialist grounding is key to enabling credible policy design and meaningful oversight in an evolving risk landscape
* Academic foundation — university degree in business, finance, law, risk management, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* Communication and stakeholder engagement skills — strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and challenge constructively across all levels of the organisation

**These Are Additional Nice To Haves**

* Experience working in a second line of defence or oversight function within a large, complex financial services or insurance organisation
* Familiarity with evolving operational risk topics such as AI governance
* Experience working in a multinational or cross-cultural environment
* Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Strong organisational skills with high attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple topics and deadlines simultaneously
* A collaborative mindset with a genuine passion for knowledge sharing and continuous improvement
* Ability to move fluidly between detailed analytical work and strategic, big-picture thinking

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
  
  
**About Swiss Re**
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
  
  
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
  
  
If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
  
  
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

**Job Description**
About the role
  
  
This role will be responsible for ensuring the organization maintains strong controls across HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, client contractual requirements, and emerging AI governance standards. The ideal candidate will have direct experience supporting healthcare organizations, healthcare technology companies, RCM providers, or business process outsourcing environments that handle protected health information (PHI), payment data, and other sensitive healthcare information. The GRC Manager will work closely with Information Security, IT, Operations, Legal, Privacy, Human Resources, Client Services, Engineering, and executive leadership to manage compliance obligations, reduce organizational risk, support customer audits, and enable responsible use of artificial intelligence across healthcare operations.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
Governance & Compliance
  
  

* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve the organization’s enterprise GRC program.
* Lead compliance activities related to:

+ HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules
+ HITRUST CSF
+ SOC 2 Type II
+ PCI-DSS

* Ensure controls appropriately protect PHI, personally identifiable information (PII), payment card data, and other sensitive healthcare information.
* Maintain policies, standards, procedures, risk methodologies, and control documentation.
* Support compliance with Business Associate Agreements (BAAs), client security requirements, and healthcare customer contractual obligations.
* Monitor changes in healthcare regulations, cybersecurity requirements, and industry standards.
* Coordinate internal and external assessments, certifications, client audits, and regulatory reviews.

Risk Management
  
  

* Conduct enterprise risk assessments and maintain the organizational risk register.
* Perform third-party/vendor security risk assessments.
* Develop mitigation strategies and monitor remediation activities.
* Present risk metrics and executive reports to senior leadership.
* Support business continuity and disaster recovery governance.

AI Governance & Responsible AI
  
  

* Develop and maintain an AI governance framework for the responsible use of artificial intelligence within healthcare RCM.
* Establish policies and controls governing generative AI, machine learning, automation, and AI-enabled decision-support technologies.
* Evaluate AI use cases involving:

+ Coding assistance
+ Denial prediction
+ Claims analytics
+ Prior authorization
+ Patient communication
+ Revenue forecasting

* Assess AI solutions for privacy, security, accuracy, bias, transparency, explainability, and regulatory risk.
* Ensure PHI is appropriately protected when using internally developed or third-party AI tools.
* Establish approval and risk-review processes for new AI use cases and vendors.
* Maintain an inventory of approved AI systems, use cases, owners, data sources, and associated risks.
* Align AI governance practices with frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and ISO/IEC 42001 where appropriate.

**Audit & Client Assurance**

* Lead preparation for SOC 2, HITRUST, HIPAA, PCI DSS, and customer security assessments.
* Coordinate evidence collection and control testing across business and technology teams.
* Manage remediation plans for audit findings, control deficiencies, and client security observations.
* Respond to customer security questionnaires and due diligence requests.
* Participate in security and compliance discussions with healthcare providers, health systems, physician groups, payers, and other clients.
* Maintain a centralized repository of compliance evidence, audit documentation, and client assurance materials.

**Third-Party Risk Management**

* Lead or support vendor security and compliance assessments.
* Evaluate vendors that access, process, transmit, or store PHI, PII, payment information, or other sensitive data.
* Review security documentation including SOC reports, HITRUST certifications, penetration tests, and risk assessments.
* Ensure appropriate BAAs, data protection agreements, and security requirements are in place.
* Monitor critical vendors for changes in risk posture.

**Security & Privacy Governance**

* Partner with Information Security and Privacy teams to maintain administrative, technical, and physical safeguards required by HIPAA.
* Support identity and access management governance for systems containing healthcare information.
* Participate in incident response activities involving potential PHI exposure, security incidents, or compliance concerns.
* Support breach assessment and regulatory notification processes where required.
* Oversee security and compliance awareness programs for employees and contractors.
* Promote appropriate handling of healthcare data across operational teams.

**Program Management & Reporting**

* Develop GRC dashboards and executive reporting for risk, audit status, remediation, vendor risk, and compliance metrics.
* Track key risk indicators and key performance indicators for the compliance program.
* Manage compliance calendars and recurring control activities.
* Lead cross-functional remediation and compliance initiatives.
* Present significant risks, findings, and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Drive automation and continuous improvement within the GRC program.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Business, or related field or equivalent years of experience.
* 6-8+ years of experience in Governance, Risk, and Compliance.
* Demonstrated experience managing:

+ SOC 2
+ HITRUST
+ PCI DSS

* Experience leading external audits and remediation efforts.
* Strong understanding of information security principles, risk management, and internal controls.
* Experience implementing governance programs across multiple departments.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience using GRC platforms.
* Project Management experience.

**One Or More Of The Following Certifications Is Preferred**

* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
* Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC)
* HITRUST Certified CSF Practitioner (CCSFP)
* Certified HIPAA Professional (CHP)
* PCI Professional (PCIP)
* ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor
* Certified in Governance, Risk and Compliance (CGRC)
* AI governance or risk certifications (e.g., ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer, NIST AI RMF training, or equivalent).

**You Will Be a Good Fit If**

* You are known for being thorough and crossing every “T”.
* You enjoy collaboration and building relationships at every level.

* Excellent organization and planning skills, both technical and strategic.

title: Assistant Manager - Advisory Services
description:
Role: Assistant Manager – Advisory Services

Practice Areas: Transaction Advisory | Risk Advisory | Strategic Business Advisory

Reporting to: Senior Manager – Advisory

Location: Bangalore (100% On-Site)

Experience: 2 – 5 Years (Chartered Accountants with 2–3 years in deal/consulting execution)

**About Advith:**

Advith is an integrated finance, tax, corporate advisory, and global delivery firm combining a 40+ year legacy with a modern execution backbone. Our Advisory practice operates across three core pillars:

1. Transaction Advisory: M&A, valuations, 360° due diligence, deal structuring, and fundraise management.

2. Risk Advisory: Internal Financial Controls (IFC), process re-engineering, SOPs, and governance frameworks.

3. Business Advisory: Founder’s Office support, family business succession, ESOP design, and Transfer Pricing strategy.

**The Opportunity: Front-Line Advisory Execution**

This is an intense, front-line execution role for a driven professional who wants genuine exposure to live transactions, corporate restructurings, and boardroom advisory.

Working directly alongside our Senior Manager, you will serve as the core coordinator and execution engine for client mandates. You will not be doing isolated back-office research—you will build financial models, manage Virtual Data Rooms, analyze operational risks, draft executive deliverables, and ensure engagements move forward with strict momentum.

**Key Responsibilities & Deliverables:**

* India Entry & Cross-Border Advisory: Support global businesses entering India with entity structuring, regulatory landscape mapping, location analysis, and operating model setups.
* Strategic Business Advisory: Assist in founder’s office mandates, family business succession frameworks, ESOP/incentive design, and corporate restructuring assignments.
* Risk & Governance Frameworks: Participate in process reviews, mapping operational workflows, drafting SOPs, and testing Internal Financial Controls (IFC).
* Financial Modeling & Deal Support: Build dynamic three-statement financial models, valuation schedules, and assist in due diligence coordination and data room management.
* Research & Executive Collateral: Conduct market and regulatory research, competitor benchmarking, and prepare executive-ready presentations, advisory notes, and strategy decks.
* Mandate Coordination & Delivery: Serve as the central execution coordinator across client engagements—tracking milestone delivery and liaising seamlessly between clients and internal multidisciplinary teams.

**Who We Are Looking For:**

* Qualification: Chartered Accountant who has hunger to execute, problem-solving attitude, and raw capability matter far more than tier-1 pedigree).
* Core Technical Knowledge: Strong conceptual grounding in financial statement analysis, corporate finance, valuation methods, deal mechanics, and internal control frameworks.
* Analytical & Presentation Skills: High proficiency in MS Excel (financial modelling, formulas, scenario building) and MS PowerPoint (creating structured, executive-grade presentations).
* Execution Mindset: A proactive "doer" who takes end-to-end ownership of tasks and drives deliverables to completion with zero follow-up.
* Professional Maturity & Coordination: Clear written and verbal communication, structured thinking, and the confidence to follow up actively with senior stakeholders and client leadership.
* Work Ethic: High energy, resilience, and adaptability to excel in a fast-paced, high-performance on-site consulting environment.

**Why Join Advith Advisory?**

* Direct Live Exposure: Immediate immersion in live mandates, due diligence reviews, and strategic consulting assignments from day one.
* Steep Learning Curve: Daily problem-solving alongside experienced Chartered Accountants, transaction advisors, and practice leaders.
* High Ownership & Growth: Fast-track career progression driven entirely by your delivery capability, reliability, and measurable impact.

**IMPORTANT FITMENT NOTE (PLEASE READ CAREFULLY BEFORE APPLYING):**

* This role is focused strictly on Transaction Advisory, Risk Advisory, Strategic Business Advisory, financial modelling, deal structuring, and mandate execution.
* This is NOT an accounting, bookkeeping, routine tax filing, or compliance-management role.
* Candidates whose primary interest, background, or career intent is limited to routine accounting or statutory compliance management are requested NOT to apply.
* We are looking for candidates who want to understand how businesses grow, make strategic decisions, raise capital, structure transactions, manage risk, and create value—not simply record or report what has already happened.

title: Sr Analyst, Procure to Pay
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

* Ensure compliance with policy and regulatory requirements throughout the third-party lifecycle.
* Identify and address issues impacting the third-party management program, providing effective remediation.
* Innovate and improve business processes, user experience, and systems involved in the third-party lifecycle.
* Analyze data to assess inventory health, identify trends, and provide actionable recommendations.
* Lead and mentor team members, fostering creativity and providing direction with a high degree of latitude.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:**

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft applications (Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint), including advanced Excel skills for reporting and analysis
* Minimum 4-6 years of work experience with Ariba modules, including demonstrated ownership of Contract Compliance or comparable processes
* Advanced understanding of procurement and contracting processes, with the ability to interpret contract terms and apply judgment to nonstandard situations
* Proven track record independently identifying, building the case for, and implementing process improvement initiatives
* Deep background in the field of procure to pay, purchasing, contracts and/or compliance, with exposure to cross-functional or global operating environments
* Strong oral and written communication skills, with experience presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders and mentoring more junior team members

YOE: 8+ years of experience, with 4+ years in procurement / procurement operations

title: Compliance Specialist
description:
**About Hevo**

Hevo is a fully-managed, no-code data pipeline platform that helps organizations move, transform, and activate their data in real time. With 150+ pre-built, battle-tested connectors, Hevo lets data teams focus on insights instead of pipeline maintenance — trusted by 2,000+ organizations globally to keep their data flowing reliably, securely, and in compliance with standards like SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA, DORA and HIPAA.

**About the Role**

As Hevo's enterprise customer base grows, security and compliance reviews are an increasingly visible part of how deals get done. We're looking for a Senior Compliance Engineer to own our GRC program end-to-end — audits, risk, vendor management, and policy — and to be the technical face of security and compliance to customers and prospects during due diligence. Strong communication is essential: this role is regularly customer-facing and needs to translate technical detail into language that builds trust.

**What You'll Do**

* Own and operate our compliance programs (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, DORA, DPDP as applicable) end-to-end — control implementation, evidence collection, and audit management
* Be the primary point of contact for external auditors; manage audit timelines and evidence collection
* Own the risk assessment program — identify, assess, score, track, and report risks via a risk register
* Manage vendor and third-party risk assessments and due diligence
* Respond to customer and prospect security questionnaires (RFPs, due-diligence requests, trust-portal access) with accuracy and speed — a high-visibility, customer-facing part of this role
* Support Sales and Customer Success on security & compliance calls with prospects and customers, translating technical controls into business language
* Draft, maintain, and drive review of security policies and procedures
* Track and report on compliance posture and drift to leadership
* Partner with engineering and security teams to close compliance gaps pragmatically, balancing rigor with velocity
* Use GRC tooling (e.g., Sprinto, Vanta, Drata, or similar) to automate evidence collection and monitoring

**What We're Looking For — Must-Haves**

* 4+ years in GRC/compliance engineering or related roles (compliance, audit, information security)
* Hands-on experience running SOC 2/ISO 27001 (or similar) audits end-to-end
* Strong understanding of data protection & privacy — GDPR, HIPAA, PII/PHI handling
* Proven ability to manage vendor/third-party risk assessments
* Excellent written and verbal communication — comfortable presenting to and negotiating with external customers, auditors, and executives
* Experience responding to customer security questionnaires / RFPs
* Working knowledge of cloud environments (AWS) — enough to assess and discuss controls with engineering
* Strong organizational skills — able to manage multiple audits and timelines independently

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with GRC automation platforms (Sprinto, Vanta, Drata, OneTrust)
* Relevant certifications (CISA, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer, CIPP)
* Experience in a B2B SaaS company handling enterprise customer data

title: Employee Experience Specialist (Reasonable Accomodation / Leave of Absence)_Director_HR Solutions (Night Shift)
description:

**Director - HR Employee Services**
leader who will be responsible for complex HR advisory, Reasonable Accommodation, Reduction in Force, case management, and employee services activities across the HCMES Service Delivery portfolio.
  
  
In the Human Capital Management division, we provide advice and insight to attract, retain, reward and develop a talented global workforce, giving employees the support and tools, they need to succeed. This is a Director level position within the HCM Employee Services team which provides commercially oriented HR guidance, employee support, operational execution, risk management, governance, and service delivery across global HR processes.
  
  
Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.
  
  
**What You'll Do In The Role**

* Lead complex Reasonable Accommodation case management from intake through resolution, including review of supporting documentation, policy interpretation, operational feasibility assessment, stakeholder consultation, and risk-balanced recommendations.
* Act as the senior subject matter expert for sensitive accommodation, leave, ergonomic, employee relations, and workforce matters requiring independent judgment, confidentiality, and escalation discipline.
* Provide end-to-end support and governance for Reduction in Force activities, including coordination with HR Business Partners, Legal, Employee Relations, business leaders, and delivery teams to support confidential workforce actions.
* Interpret Firm policies, regulatory expectations, historical case precedents, and operational guidelines to drive consistent, fair, and defensible outcomes across complex employee situations.
* Influence and advise senior stakeholders, HR Business Partners, managers, employees, Legal, and regional HR partners on sensitive workforce matters, balancing employee experience, business requirements, operational constraints, and compliance risk.

* Lead operational governance for assigned HCMES processes, including case tracking, documentation quality, audit readiness, service standards, controls, and timely closure of matters in Firm systems.

* Drive process simplification, standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across HR Employee Services, ensuring SOPs, templates, playbooks, and knowledge materials remain current and fit for purpose.

* Strong process governance mindset, including SOP ownership, audit readiness, controls discipline, and continuous improvement orientation.
* Proficiency in Workday, AskHR, HRCM, ServiceNow, or similar HR/case management platforms, along with strong Microsoft Office capability across Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* High level of ownership, accountability, integrity, discretion, and professionalism when handling employee data and confidential workforce matters.
* Ability to work effectively across global teams, navigate ambiguity, adapt communication style, and operate in a dynamic service delivery environment.
* Experience supporting complex employee matters in a regulated environment, preferably Banking and Financial Services.
* Experience partnering with Legal, Employee Relations, Compliance, HR Business Partners, business leaders, and regional HR teams on sensitive or high-risk matters.
* At least 10 years' relevant experience would generally be expected to find the skills required for this role with strong exposure to HR Operations, Employee Services, Employee Relations, Reasonable Accommodation, RIF support, or complex case management.
