* Strong knowledge of labor laws, ER & IR practices
* Hands-on experience in contract labor and payroll handling
* Excellent grievance handling and negotiation skills
* Strong people management and stakeholder coordination abilities
* Proficiency in MS Excel (advanced level) and PowerPoint for data analysis and presentations
* Good communication, documentation, and reporting skills
* Ability to work independently and handle pressure situations

**Educational Qualification**

* MBA / MSW / PG Diploma in HR or Labor Laws (preferred)
* Certification in Labor Laws or IR (added advantage)

* Transaction management experience including negotiating documents to conclusion
* Experience working for or advising MNCs
* Experience in managing a pool of very demanding clients
* Strong commercial awareness
* Good management skills in a multicultural, decentralized environment
* Effective communication skills, both verbally and in writing
* Ability to work irregular hours to accommodate global time differences
* Excellent interpersonal skills

**Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture**
At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests — we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Excellent verbal and written communication, negotiation, follow-up and liaison skills, attention to detail, problem-solving, multitasking, and composure under pressure

title: Manager -Legal & Compliance
description:

Since 2018, we've redefined the traditional expert network model with a tech-driven approach that delivers high-impact insight at the speed of modern dealmaking. Arbolus stands out through its unique database of customer reviews accessible via the Arbolus Customer Review Library, Canopy, our market-first automated Q&A tool, and our unmatched standard of client service — because great technology should always be backed by great people.
  
  
Headquartered in London, Arbolus is a venture-backed scale-up with employees across four global hubs, including Barcelona, Costa Rica and Gurgaon. Following a $20M Series B, we are rapidly expanding our U.S. presence as we execute our mission: to digitize human knowledge and make it instantly accessible and actionable.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Manager – Legal & Compliance to join our team, with a primary focus on managing and overseeing client-specific compliance requirements across global business accounts. The role will be responsible for ensuring that client contractual obligations, compliance standards, policies, and regulatory requirements are effectively understood, implemented, monitored, and adhered to throughout the client engagement lifecycle.
  
  
This is a hands-on, operational role involving close collaboration with Commercial, Professional Services, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to ensure compliance with client requirements, manage client audits and assessments, oversee compliance documentation, address client queries, and drive timely closure of compliance gaps and remediation actions.
  
  
In addition to client compliance management, the role will oversee contract lifecycle management, support legal and regulatory matters, and contribute to the protection of the organization's intellectual property. The ideal candidate should combine strong legal and contractual knowledge with practical experience in managing client compliance obligations and translating contractual commitments into effective operational controls.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
Client Compliance & Operational Support
  
  

* Take ownership of client-specific compliance requirements and ensure their effective implementation across the organization.
* Review, interpret, and operationalize client contracts, compliance policies, codes of conduct, security requirements, and other contractual obligations.
* Manage client onboarding compliance, including due diligence, compliance documentation, assessments, certifications, and required approvals.
* Ensure internal teams adhere to client-specific policies, contractual commitments, applicable regulatory requirements, and agreed operational standards.
* Work closely with Commercial, Professional Services, Operations and other relevant teams to implement and monitor client-specific compliance controls.
* Manage client compliance questionnaires, vendor assessments, due diligence requests, audits, and periodic compliance reviews.
* Monitor compliance obligations across active client engagements and proactively identify gaps, risks, and areas requiring corrective action.
* Ensure that compliance commitments made during client onboarding and contract negotiations are effectively implemented and sustained throughout the engagement.

Contract Management, IP & Execution
  
  

* Own the end-to-end global contract lifecycle, including intake, drafting, review, negotiation support, internal approvals, execution, storage, amendments, and renewals.
* Review, draft, and manage client agreements, including Master Services Agreements (MSAs), Statements of Work (SOWs), Service Agreements, NDAs, and other commercial contracts.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and client legal teams to negotiate contractual terms and resolve legal and commercial deviations.
* Support business teams in partnership agreements, vendor contracts, and client service agreements.
* Review contractual clauses relating to liability, indemnification, confidentiality, termination, warranties, payment terms, and service-level obligations.
* Maintain and update contract templates, standard clauses, playbooks, and approval workflows to streamline contract execution.
* Actively contribute to building, managing, and protecting the organization's intellectual property (IP) portfolio.
* Identify potential IP risks, infringements, or violations and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure timely mitigation.
* Legal, Data Privacy & Regulatory Support
* Ensure compliance with applicable laws, data protection regulations, and confidentiality requirements.
* Review privacy clauses, data processing agreements, and information-sharing arrangements.
* Develop and maintain legal policies, compliance procedures, and standard documentation.
* Provide legal support to internal teams on contracts, client requirements, disputes, and regulatory matters.
* Coordinate with external counsel and support legal notices, audits, and compliance training.

Requirements to succeed in this role
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business Administration, or related field.
* 6–8 years of experience in contract management, legal operations, or corporate legal support.
* Strong background in client compliances ,contract drafting and contract lifecycle management.
* Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills

title: Manager -Legal & Compliance
description:
**About Arbolus**
Arbolus is the next-generation customer diligence platform, redefining how private equity investors and consultants access real, actionable and differentiated customer insight on SaaS and technology companies.
  
  
At the core of our platform is the world's largest database of attributable B2B customer reviews, giving investment and origination teams direct access to unique customer sentiment and a true strategic advantage to run faster, more confident diligence on the world's leading software assets.
  
  
Since 2018, we've redefined the traditional expert network model with a tech-driven approach that delivers high-impact insight at the speed of modern dealmaking. Arbolus stands out through its unique database of customer reviews accessible via the Arbolus Customer Review Library, Canopy, our market-first automated Q&A tool, and our unmatched standard of client service — because great technology should always be backed by great people.
  
  
Headquartered in London, Arbolus is a venture-backed scale-up with employees across four global hubs, including Barcelona, Costa Rica and Gurgaon. Following a $20M Series B, we are rapidly expanding our U.S. presence as we execute our mission: to digitize human knowledge and make it instantly accessible and actionable.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Manager – Legal & Compliance to join our team, with a primary focus on managing and overseeing client-specific compliance requirements across global business accounts. The role will be responsible for ensuring that client contractual obligations, compliance standards, policies, and regulatory requirements are effectively understood, implemented, monitored, and adhered to throughout the client engagement lifecycle.
  
  
This is a hands-on, operational role involving close collaboration with Commercial, Professional Services, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to ensure compliance with client requirements, manage client audits and assessments, oversee compliance documentation, address client queries, and drive timely closure of compliance gaps and remediation actions.
  
  
In addition to client compliance management, the role will oversee contract lifecycle management, support legal and regulatory matters, and contribute to the protection of the organization's intellectual property. The ideal candidate should combine strong legal and contractual knowledge with practical experience in managing client compliance obligations and translating contractual commitments into effective operational controls.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
**Client Compliance & Operational Support**

* Take ownership of client-specific compliance requirements and ensure their effective implementation across the organization.

* Manage client onboarding compliance, including due diligence, compliance documentation, assessments, certifications, and required approvals.
* Ensure internal teams adhere to client-specific policies, contractual commitments, applicable regulatory requirements, and agreed operational standards.
* Work closely with Commercial, Professional Services, Operations and other relevant teams to implement and monitor client-specific compliance controls.
* Manage client compliance questionnaires, vendor assessments, due diligence requests, audits, and periodic compliance reviews.
* Monitor compliance obligations across active client engagements and proactively identify gaps, risks, and areas requiring corrective action.

* Maintain and update contract templates, standard clauses, playbooks, and approval workflows to streamline contract execution.
* Actively contribute to building, managing, and protecting the organization's intellectual property (IP) portfolio.

* Legal, Data Privacy & Regulatory Support
* Ensure compliance with applicable laws, data protection regulations, and confidentiality requirements.
* Review privacy clauses, data processing agreements, and information-sharing arrangements.
* Develop and maintain legal policies, compliance procedures, and standard documentation.
* Provide legal support to internal teams on contracts, client requirements, disputes, and regulatory matters.
* Coordinate with external counsel and support legal notices, audits, and compliance training.

Requirements to succeed in this role
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business Administration, or related field.
* 6–8 years of experience in contract management, legal operations, or corporate legal support.
* Strong background in client compliances ,contract drafting and contract lifecycle management.
* Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.

title: Senior Business Integrity Advisor
description:
**Company Description**

**Ramboll in India**
Ramboll has more than 1,000 experts working across five offices in India applying their passion to deliver innovative solutions in markets as diverse as Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health and Energy. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering culture.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Sr. Business Integrity Advisor (Gurugram- India)**
**Join Ramboll’s global business integrity and compliance team as a Sr. Business Integrity Advisor (India).**
Ramboll is seeking an experienced and talented, business-oriented professional with a global mindset and strong analytical skills to join our corporate business integrity and compliance team as a Business Integrity Consultant. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in conducting our Compliance risk monitoring within anti-corruption, international sanctions and human rights risk of ongoing projects across multiple jurisdictions; entailing direct advisory to the business, third party audits, data analysis and documentation.
  
  
This position is ideal for individuals passionate about being part of a larger organization and global team where excellence and streamlined services, digitalization, and leveraging AI and emerging technologies to continuously improve how we work and deliver value. You will report to the Senior Global Integrity Business Partner and collaborate closely with colleagues worldwide to advance integrity and accountability within our organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Undertake hands on compliance monitoring activities and lead Critical Risk Project Monitoring of selected projects including identifying emerging risks and red flags during project execution, assess their potential compliance implications, and support the determination of appropriate risk mitigation measures.
* Support the end-to-end Critical Risk Project Monitoring Programme from project kick-off through execution and closure in close dialogue with the business. Ensure consistent application of the established monitoring methodology.
* Maintain regular dialogue and engagement with Project Managers / Project Owners to gather relevant project information, understand changes in project scope, status, and circumstances, and follow up on agreed actions and risk mitigation measures throughout the monitoring process.
* Prepare monitoring reports and progress updates ahead of planned meetings with Project Managers (PMs), Project Owners (POs), providing clear visibility into identified risks, mitigation status, outstanding issues, and actions requiring attention or follow-up.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and audit-ready documentation of all risk assessments, monitoring actions, findings, and follow-up activities in designated repositories including our digital Business Integrity Portal, ensuring proper record-keeping and clear traceability throughout the project lifecycle.

**Qualifications**
**Core key requirements and competencies: -**

* 7+ years of relevant experience in compliance, risk management, Internal audit, ABAC audits or a comparable risk-focused function within an international organization, consulting firm, or law firm.
* Relevant experience applying anti-bribery and anti-corruption laws and compliance frameworks, which includes strong knowledge of the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA), UK Bribery Act (UKBA), ISO 37001, and Anti-Bribery and Anti-Corruption (ABAC) principles
* Experience working in a multinational and cross-cultural business environment would be advantageous, particularly where projects involve different jurisdictions and risk environments.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills and experience working and communicating with senior management
* Hands-on experience in reviewing invoices, contracts, project documentation, approvals, financial records and other supporting evidence to assess compliance with internal controls, policies and contractual requirements. This includes demonstrated ability to identify documentation gaps, control deficiencies and unusual transactions, and to maintain a clear evidence trail supporting findings and remediation.
* Demonstrated experience in identifying compliance and integrity red flags in the ordinary course of business, with the ability to recognize unusual transactions, behaviors, documentation or business arrangements that may warrant further review.
* Proficiency in English communication, both verbal and written. Experience with communicating compliance risks clearly, concisely, and effectively, translating risk findings into practical insights and actionable messages
* Willingness to adjust working hours across different time zones when business needs require it.

**Additional Information**
**Why join Ramboll’s Business Integrity Team?**

* Be part of a globally respected organization at the forefront of advancing business integrity and compliance initiatives.
* Work alongside a dynamic, multicultural team committed to upholding the highest standards of business ethics.
* Contribute to our impactful Critical Risk Project Monitoring Programme that shaped decision-making and promote accountability across Ramboll’s international network.
* Benefit from professional development opportunities and exposure to a broad range of industries and regulatory environments. Help drive meaningful change and foster a culture of integrity within a leading global company.

**Personal qualities that will help you succeed in this role include:**
self-motivated, solution mindset, attention to detail. A team player with ability to work independently with minimum supervision Flexible attitude, in agile environment with frequently changing deadlines can be relied on to meet deadlines, committed to both their work and personal development, with a willingness to widen their experience, including knowledge base and leadership skills. Good communication skills both written and verbal
  
  
  

* The ability to build relationships and trust, so your business colleagues see you as their partner, focusing on creating value for the business.
* The ability to understand and navigate a complex, relationship-based matrix organization to achieve key objectives.
* Being able to adopt a team-oriented approach to solving problems.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

What we can offer you
  
  
  

* Investment in your development
* Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles
* Be valued for the unique person you are.
* Never be short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects.
* The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

We offer:
  
  
  

* A challenging and interesting workday characterized by continuous learning, in an environment where you have many to spar with and learn from.
* Opportunity to work with varied work tasks, across the organization.
* Opportunity to develop and influence your own area of responsibility.

Ready to join us?
  
  
If you are eager to make a difference and ready for a new challenge, we would love to hear from you. Apply today to join our growing team! We will review applications on an ongoing basis.
  
  
**Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll**
Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll employs more than 18,000 people globally across 35 countries. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Buildings, Transport, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, Management Consulting, and Architecture & Landscape. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we help shape the societies of tomorrow.
  
  
**Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion**
Equality, diversity, and inclusion are at the heart of what we do. At Ramboll, we believe that diversity is a strength and that different experiences and perspectives are essential to creating truly sustainable societies. We are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone is able to flourish and reach their potential. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We invite applications from candidates of all backgrounds and characteristics. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

title: Compliance Manager - Commercial Services
description:
**Commercial Services Compliance Manager**
**Gurugram, India | Controls & Assurance**
Purpose of the Role
  
  
The Commercial Services Compliance Manager provides independent Second Line oversight, challenge, and assurance across the Commercial Services control environment, covering both Sarbanes-Oxley compliance and wider internal controls.
  
  
The role works with Commercial Services leadership, process owners, and control owners to support effective risk assessment, control design, documentation, testing, and remediation, while reinforcing clear First Line ownership and accountability.
  
  
The role oversees Commercial Services control testing performed in India and coordinates relevant activities with Group Internal Audit (GIA), external auditors, and other assurance providers. It also provides risk and control advice and challenges for transformation, automation, transition, and continuous-improvement initiatives.
  
  
The role requires someone with recent and extensive PCAOB and SOx external audit experience, ideally gained at manager level or above within a Big Four firm or through an equivalent role. The role holder will apply this experience to strengthen control design and documentation, improve testing quality, anticipate external auditors’ expectations, and support technically robust discussions with external auditors.
  
  
The role provides functional guidance and coaching to junior team members and leads through influence in a matrix environment without direct line-management accountability.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  
Risk and Control Framework
  
  

* Prepare risk assessments and control documentation within the scope of Commercial Services, liaising with relevant stakeholders to agree on scoping, key risks, and controls.
* Partner with process and control owners to design, document and maintain effective SOX and internal controls.
* Oversee the completeness and accuracy of Commercial Services Risk and Control Matrices and supporting documentation.
* Assess whether controls appropriately address identified risks and are sufficiently precise, sustainable, and evidence based.
* Identify control gaps, duplication, and unnecessary complexity, and recommend proportionate improvements.
* Reinforce First Line ownership and accountability for risks, controls, evidence, and remediation.

Testing, Assurance and Remediation
  
  

* Oversee and coordinate the Commercial Services Sox, internal control and substantive testing performed in India.
* Establish clear expectations for testing quality, evidence, documentation, and conclusions.
* Review testing outcomes and identify recurring issues or broader implications for the control environment.
* Support the evaluation of control deficiencies, including root-cause analysis and assessment of potential broader impact.
* Drive the development and implementation of practical, sustainable remediation plans with control owners, secure auditor agreements, and ensure timely closure.
* Collaborate with external auditors and internal stakeholders to drive data analytics and automation initiatives, including continuous control monitoring, to enhance assurance coverage and efficiency.

Audit and Stakeholder Coordination
  
  

* Coordinate Commercial Services engagement with GIA, management testers, and external auditors.
* Support responses to audit enquiries, evidence requests, and control observations.
* Constructively challenge audit findings where appropriate, using relevant evidence and a clear understanding of the control environment.
* Monitor audit actions and support their timely and sustainable resolution.
* Act as a trusted risk and control adviser to Commercial Services leadership, process owners, and control owners.

Escalate significant control issues, delays, and emerging risks to the relevant leadership.
  
  
Continuous Improvement and Change
  
  

* Identify opportunities to standardise, simplify, rationalise and automate controls and assurance activities.
* Promote preventive and automated controls where these provide a more effective and sustainable response to risk.
* Provide independent risk and control advice for Commercial Services transformation, transition, and automation initiatives.
* Support project teams with appropriate control requirements into new or changing systems.
* Ensure that control ownership is established, and material control gaps are addressed before transitioning into business-as-usual operations.
* Contribute to strategic and one-off Controls & Assurance projects affecting Commercial Services.

Functional and Matrix Leadership
  
  

* Provide day-to-day functional guidance, coaching and technical support to junior members of the Commercial Services compliance team.
* Promote consistent application of SOX and internal control methodologies.
* Foster collaboration, accountability, constructive challenges, and continuous improvement.
* Lead through influence across Commercial Services and the wider Controls & Assurance network.
* Champion Rio Tinto’s values of care, courage and curiosity and maintain high professional standards.

Reporting and Governance
  
  

* Prepare and review risk assessments, control assessments, deficiency evaluations, and remediation updates.
* Maintain clear and accurate documentation of significant control matters and conclusions.
* Prepare concise reporting on testing, deficiencies, remediation, audit actions, and improvement initiatives.
* Present relevant control and assurance matters to Commercial Services and Controls & Assurance leadership.

**Experience, Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or related discipline.
* CA, CPA, or equivalent professional qualification is preferred; CISA or another relevant qualification is desirable.
* 10+ years of recent and relevant experience in PCAOB and SOx external audit experience is essential, ideally gained at manager level or above within a Big Four firm or through an equivalent role.
* Strong practical knowledge of PCAOB expectations, Sox requirements, internal control over financial reporting, control design, testing, deficiency evaluation, and remediation.
* Demonstrated experience working directly with external auditors on walkthroughs, risk assessments, control identification and documentation, testing, audit evidence, deficiencies, and remediation.
* Strong knowledge of Commercial Services and related financial and operational processes, or the ability to develop this knowledge quickly.
* Experience providing independent Second Line oversight and constructive challenges.
* Experience supporting internal audit, transformation, automation, or continuous improvement initiatives.
* Working knowledge of relevant ERP systems; data analytics experience is desirable.
* Strong stakeholder management, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Experience providing functional leadership, coaching, or mentoring within a matrix environment.

Success Measures
  
  

* Stronger and clearer First Line ownership of Commercial Services risks and controls.
* Complete, accurate and current risk and control documentation.
* Effective and timely delivery of SOX and internal control testing.
* Improved testing quality, evidence, and assurance coverage.
* Timely and sustainable remediation of control deficiencies and audit findings.
* Reduced recurrence of control issues.
* Effective coordination with GIA and KPMG.
* Increased standardisation, simplification, automation, and Continuous Control Monitoring.
* Effective integration of controls into transformation and process-change initiatives.
* Clear and timely reporting of significant control matters.

**About Rio Tinto**
Rio Tinto is a leading global mining and materials company. We operate in 35 countries where we produce iron ore, copper, aluminium, critical minerals, and other materials needed for the global energy transition and for people, communities, and nations to thrive.
  
  
We have been mining for 150 years and operate with knowledge built up across generations and continents. Our purpose is finding better ways to provide the materials the world needs – striving for innovation and continuous improvement to produce materials with low emissions and to the right environmental, social and governance standards. But we can’t do it on our own, so we’re focused on creating partnerships to solve problems, create win-win situations and meet opportunities.

We treat each other fairly and with dignity regardless of race, gender, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, age, sexual orientation or anything else that makes us different.

title: Director – Risk ,Control & Compliance
description:
Risk & Compliance Director
  
  
**| India | Group Services**
Purpose of the Role
  
  
The Risk & Compliance Director is responsible for leading the Risk & Compliance team supporting Financial Accounting Services (FAS), Procure-to-Pay (PTP), Employee Services and Payroll Solutions (ESPS), and Commercial Services (CS).
  
  
Acting as a key member of the Second Line of Defence (2LoD), the role provides leadership, subject matter expertise, independent challenge and assurance across the Group Services (GS) control environment. The role is accountable for strengthening control ownership, improving control effectiveness, maximising the assurance obtained from 2LoD activities and supporting the continued evolution of the Operating Model (OM).
  
  
The role acts as a key interface between GS leadership, Global Internal Audit (GIA), external auditors and other assurance providers, ensuring effective coordination of assurance activities while continuously strengthening the control environment.
  
  
As GS continues to evolve, the role plays a critical part in ensuring risks and controls are appropriately considered as new entities and processes transition into the OM (e.g. Asset Management, OT, Simandou). In addition to leading a team, the role holder is expected to personally develop assessments, methodologies, governance papers, assurance reviews, strategic recommendations and control documentation.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  
Leadership and Culture
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop the Risk & Compliance (R&C) team, creating a high-performing and engaged culture.
* Foster an environment of collaboration, inclusion, accountability and continuous learning.
* Build technical capability across the R&C team in internal controls, assurance and governance.
* Establish clear objectives, performance expectations and development plans for R&C team members.
* Promote employee respect, wellbeing, engagement and psychological safety.
* Champion Rio Tinto values, leadership behaviours and expected standards of conduct.
* Support succession planning and capability development across the Controls & Assurance function.

Controls and Assurance Leadership
  
  

* Lead R&C activities across FAS, PTP, ESPS and CS.
* Act as the primary subject matter expert and trusted advisor on internal controls, governance and assurance matters.
* Provide independent challenge and oversight from a 2LoD perspective.
* Support the development of a strong controls culture focused on ownership, accountability and continuous improvement.
* Promote effective risk management practices and control discipline throughout GS.
* Support the General Manager Controls & Assurance in delivering strategic objectives and priorities across Group Services.

Control Ownership and Operating Model Governance
  
  

* Maintain ownership of the R&C control framework across the supported functions.
* Partner with 1LoD to ensure risks and controls remain appropriately designed and operated as the OM evolves.
* Ensure 1LoD accountability and ownership for key controls are clearly defined, documented and understood.
* Review and challenge existing control design to ensure controls remain effective, efficient and sustainable.
* Support the embedding of controls into new operating models, organisational structures and service delivery arrangements (e.g. Asset Management, OT, Simandou, or legacy-Arcadium).

Stakeholder Partnership
  
  

* Act as the primary R&C partner for the General Managers of FAS, PTP, ESPS and CS.
* Build strong and trusted relationships with leaders across GS.
* Provide pragmatic and commercially focused advice on risk, controls, governance and assurance matters.
* Influence decision-making through constructive challenge, insight and recommendations.
* Support leaders in addressing control deficiencies and strengthening their respective control environments.
* Facilitate collaboration between GS and stakeholders across Rio Tinto (e.g. M-ERP project).

Assurance and Monitoring
  
  

* Develop and execute risk-based assurance activities across GS.
* Continuously seek opportunities to increase assurance coverage and stakeholder confidence while reducing burden on the 1LoD and 2LoD when it comes to testing.
* Consolidate assurance obtained from audits, reviews, monitoring activities, management oversight and other assurance sources.
* Identify control deficiencies, emerging risks and systemic issues.
* Perform root cause analysis and assess the effectiveness of remediation activities.
* Develop meaningful assurance metrics and reporting to support leadership decision-making.
* Drive the adoption and expansion of tools such as Continuous Control Monitoring and data-driven assurance methodologies.

Internal Audit and External Assurance Coordination
  
  

* Act as the primary R&C representative for GIA reviews impacting GS.
* Assess audit observations and determine broader implications for the GS control environment.
* Support the development of practical and sustainable remediation plans.
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with external auditors.
* Act as the primary coordination point for external audit activities impacting FAS, PTP, ESPS and CS.
* Review and coordinate responses to external auditor enquiries and requests.
* Challenge and discuss auditor observations where appropriate, ensuring findings are accurately understood and supported by evidence.
* Identify opportunities to increase auditor reliance on existing assurance activities and controls.
* Promote efficient audit delivery whilst minimising disruption to 1LoD.

Continuous Improvement and Control Excellence
  
  

* Identify opportunities to standardise, simplify and automate controls and assurance activities.
* Promote preventive and automated controls wherever possible.
* Challenge inefficient, duplicated or low-value control activities.
* Drive initiatives aimed at improving both control effectiveness and operational efficiency.
* Lead initiatives that strengthen the overall maturity of the GS control environment.
* Stay abreast of emerging risks, industry developments and leading practices in internal controls, governance and assurance.

Operating Model Transformation and Strategic Projects
  
  

* Partner with transformation teams to assess the control implications of new entities (e.g. OT, Simandou, legacy-Arcadium), processes (e.g. asset management) and services transitioning into GS.
* Ensure appropriate governance, control ownership and accountability arrangements are established for new activities entering the OM.
* Provide controls and assurance leadership to major organisational, system and OM change initiatives.
* Ensure lessons learned from previous operating model transitions, audits and assurance activities are incorporated into future projects.
* Work closely with stakeholders to embed sustainable, scalable and efficient control environments during periods of change.

Documentation and Governance
  
  

* Independently prepare and maintain risk assessments, control assessments and assurance reviews.
* Independently prepare governance, position papers, recommendations, training materials, methodologies, standards, guidance documentation and leadership presentations.
* Ensure documentation remains accurate, complete and aligned with regulation requirements.
* Present findings, recommendations and assurance outcomes to senior stakeholders and governance forums.
* Support the preparation of materials for leadership teams, governance committees and strategic decision-making forums.

Financial and Resource Management
  
  

* Monitor the R&C cost centre and review actual expenditure against budget on a monthly basis.
* Support forecasting, budgeting and resource planning activities.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and optimise costs whilst maintaining assurance outcomes.
* Provide regular financial updates and insights to the General Manager Controls & Assurance.
* Support decisions relating to sourcing, resource allocation and delivery models to optimise value and assurance outcomes.

Success Measures
  
  

* Strengthened control environment across FAS, PTP, ESPS and Commercial Services.
* Increased assurance coverage and stakeholder confidence in Second Line activities.
* Successful support of OM evolution and entity transitions.
* Improved control ownership and accountability across the 1LoD.
* Increased use of automation, analytics and Continuous Control Monitoring.
* Reduction in repeat audit findings and control deficiencies.
* Improved standardisation and simplification of controls and assurance activities.
* Strong engagement, performance and development of team members.
* Effective management of budget and resources.
* Positive feedback from General Managers, senior stakeholders, GIA and external auditors.
* Continued enhancement of assurance effectiveness whilst reducing burden on the 1LoD.

**About Rio Tinto**
Rio Tinto is a leading global mining and materials company. We operate in 35 countries where we produce iron ore, copper, aluminium, critical minerals, and other materials needed for the global energy transition and for people, communities, and nations to thrive.
  
  
We have been mining for 150 years and operate with knowledge built up across generations and continents. Our purpose is finding better ways to provide the materials the world needs – striving for innovation and continuous improvement to produce materials with low emissions and to the right environmental, social and governance standards. But we can’t do it on our own, so we’re focused on creating partnerships to solve problems, create win-win situations and meet opportunities.
  
  
**Respect and Inclusion**
At Rio Tinto, we particularly welcome and encourage applications from Indigenous Peoples, women, the LGBTQ+ community, mature workers, people with disabilities and people from different cultural backgrounds.
  
  
We are committed to an inclusive environment where people feel comfortable to be themselves. We want our people to feel that all voices are heard, all cultures respected and that a variety of perspectives are not only welcome – they are essential to our success. We treat each other fairly and with dignity regardless of race, gender, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, age, sexual orientation or anything else that makes us different.

**About The Role**
As a Senior Manager Contract Management Services you are responsible for the teams entrusted by the CPS Market Unit to oversee and optimise the financial aspects of the Contracts they agree with our customers, you will provide direction and leadership to your team of professionals to ensure that Contract costs are controlled, revenue is maximised and all key contractual obligations are met.
  
  
Your team will support Market Unit customer facing Contract Managers to prep for contract negotiations and management, reviewing contracts to ensure favourable terms and conditions which align with our financial goals, including assessing risks, identifying cost saving opportunities and ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
  
  
You will implement processes and controls within your team to monitor and manage costs associated with CPS contracts, leading a team of professionals who will analyse financial data, identify cost variances and implementation strategies to mitigate risks and optimise cost efficiency.
  
  
In support of customer facing Market Unit contract managers, you will develop strategies to optimise revenue generation from contracts, including pricing optimisation, revenue recognition and contract performance analysis. Your teams will undertake financial analysis and reporting to assess financial impact of contracts, track revenue and cost trends, they will identify and mitigate financial risks such as financial fluctuations, contract disputes or non-compliance by implementing risk assessment frameworks, developing contingency plans and ensuring adherence to internal controls and regulatory requirements.
  
  
You will drive strong stakeholder management/ partnership capability within your team, delivering professional and effective stakeholder relationships with legal, finance, sales and operations team to ensure alignment and effective communication regarding contract terms, financial implications and performance metrics.
  
  
You will collaborate with Service Control colleagues to ensure that ITIL framework principles are deployed across your team and supporting ITIL capabilities available in the Managed Service space are utilised to further enhance the professionalisation of your function.
  
  
You will drive transformation within your function, sponsoring the design and delivery of a major transformation programme designed to optimise a strategic system driven approach to cost assurance and revenue management to optimise the service we offer at best cost and utilise our professional resources on the highest value activities within the function.
  
  
Overall you will play a crucial role in optimising financial outcomes related to the contracts we manage on behalf of the Market Unit customer facing contract managers, you and your teams will be seen as trusted partners of the Market Unit Contract Management teams, you will help ensure that our contracts are financially viable, costs are controlled, revenue is optimised and risks are mitigated, ultimately contributing to the CPS aorganisations financial success.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
**Strategic Oversight**
Accountable for the strategic direction, organisation, operational performance and cost-to-serve of Contract Management Services (CMS), leveraging industry best practices and strategic tooling.
  
  
Develop and implement strategies to enhance customer trust, satisfaction and colleague experience while delivering professional services at optimum customer value.
  
  
Define end-to-end CMS processes in alignment with Market Unit Contract Management partners.
  
  
Champion emerging industry practices and leverage ITIL principles across Service Control to continuously improve CMS capabilities.
  
  
**Operational & Commercial Management**
Lead implementation of the Service Operations strategy and delivery of contractual service requirements, maximising service profitability and customer outcomes.
  
  
Provide SME leadership across complex, high-risk commercial opportunities, including negotiations, SLAs, contract management and P&L responsibilities.
  
  
Accountable for implementation of CMS governance across CPS contracts in partnership with customer-facing Contract Managers.
  
  
Define processes and governance, coordinate cross-functional teams, and drive improvement and quality assurance plans.
  
  
Optimise resources, demand, capacity and cost base to support operational and commercial objectives.
  
  
Drive integration and transformation across CMS, working with Service Control, Design & Delivery, Procurement, Product, Finance, Legal and Market Units to improve customer experience, reduce costs, optimise revenue and maintain regulatory compliance.
  
  
**Quality Assurance & Performance**
Establish and monitor quality assurance standards across CMS and matrix teams.
  
  
Define and track KPIs to measure operational effectiveness, efficiency and service quality.
  
  
Translate performance data into actionable insights that improve quality, resource allocation and business outcomes.
  
  
Drive governance and best practice, particularly across processes impacting cost, revenue and customer experience.
  
  
**Team Leadership & Development**
Lead and develop CMS leaders and teams, creating an inclusive, collaborative and high-performance culture.
  
  
Coach leaders to improve performance, navigate challenges and deliver customer and operational objectives within a matrix environment.
  
  
Develop training and communication programmes to strengthen CMS capability and service standards.
  
  
Build strong partnership and stakeholder-management capabilities across the team.
  
  
Promote appropriate professional accreditation and continuous development to strengthen expertise.
  
  
**Stakeholder & Customer Management**
Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, department heads, internal partners and customers.
  
  
Understand business requirements and align CMS priorities with customer and organisational objectives.
  
  
Drive a strong understanding of customers within CMS, protecting their brand, customers and service expectations.
  
  
Act as the customer champion for CMS across Service Control, Managed Services and the wider business.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement & Crisis Management**
Drive continuous improvement, innovation, process automation and strategic tool optimisation across CMS and matrix teams.
  
  
Identify, analyse and resolve complex operational issues, implementing proactive measures to maintain service continuity and improve outcomes.
  
  
Lead change initiatives that enhance efficiency, quality, customer experience and colleague experience.
  
  
**Essential Skills / Experience**
**Operational Expertise:**
Proficiency in ITIL principles and experience working within a Contract Management, Cost Assurance and Revenue Management environment, preferably within a global context. A good understanding of BT products and services and the e2e customer lifecycles process. Strong working knowledge of Managed Services, CPS contract tooling ecosystem. Possesses the ability to take well-evaluated risks and be audacious in making decisions and taking action.
  
  
**Customer Focus:**
Ability to understand customer needs, infrastructure, brand and business objectives and foster positive relationships at a Senior level to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty. Strong customer focus and drive to provide proactive, pre-emptive and best in class service.
  
  
**Communication Skills:**
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders and customers at all levels.
  
  
**Problem-Solving Abilities:**
Proven track record of identifying root causes, analysing data, and implementing effective solutions to resolve operational issues. Demonstrable tenacity in driving improvements through matrixed teams.
  
  
**Change Management:**
Experience managing organisational change and driving transformational initiatives to improve operational performance. Proven ability to lead teams through transformation and continuous change Clear focus on continuous improvement and uses initiatives such as upskilling, automation and process improvement on a regular basis across their area of expertise and specific processes.
  
  
**Leadership Standards:**
Demonstrated leadership qualities, including integrity, accountability, customer-centricity, and a growth mindset.
  
  
**Commercial Acumen:**
Understanding of commercial and financial drivers impacting service and business performance, with the ability to translate business plans into operational priorities.
  
  
**Team Management:**
Experience leading and developing diverse teams, fostering a culture of inclusivity, high performance, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Matric Management:**
Experience of driving governance and engagement across matrixed teams and stakeholders, proven ability to drive Change Management across teams outside of own operational control.
  
  
Previous experience in managing teams of CMS professionals or similar roles within a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Good understanding of the Managed Service, CPS Contract strategic tooling ecosystem.
  
  
Good understanding of existing barriers and challenges impacting CMS.
  
  
Experience of sponsoring major transformation programmes
  
  
Proven ability to lead large teams and drive performance improvements.
  
  
Track record of building successful relationships with stakeholders and managing customer expectations.
  
  
Familiarity with digital trends and market dynamics impacting contract management, cost assurance and revenue management processes.
  
  
Strong financial abilities and commercial acumen.
  
  
A very good understanding of ITIL environments including ITIL Foundation (V4) accreditation
  
  
In depth knowledge of managed customer solutions and market dynamics in a service context.
  
  
The role holder must have significant experience in working and leading in an IT environment using ITIL framework.
  
  
Understanding of how effective implementation of these services will enable the business to be best in class in the industry.
  
  
**Desirable Skills / Experience**
Sirion Deployment
  
  
Supplier Management
  
  
Contractual Accounting Background
  
  
BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.
  
  
BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.
  
  
Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.
  
  
We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. title: Financial Crime Compliance Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About AML RightSource**
We are AML RightSource, the leading technology-enabled managed services firm focused on fighting financial crime for our clients and the world. Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, and operating across the globe, we are a trusted partner to our financial institution, FinTech, money service business, and corporate clients.
  
  
Using a blend of highly trained anti-financial crime professionals, cutting-edge technology tools, and industry-leading consultants, we help clients with their AML/BSA, transaction monitoring, client onboarding (KYC), enhanced due diligence (EDD), and risk management needs.
  
  
We support clients in meeting day-to-day compliance tasks, urgent projects, and strategic changes. Globally, our staff of more than 6,000 highly trained analysts and subject matter experts is the industry's largest group of full-time compliance professionals. Together with our clients, we are Reimagining Compliance.
  
  
**About The Position**
As a Manager within the Financial Crime Compliance Delivery Team, you will be responsible for leading a team of analysts by providing the coaching and oversight needed to ensure all projects meet organizational and client objectives. You will serve as a coach and mentor to ensure successful outcomes of engagements. In this position, you will also have direct client contact while establishing cross-functional communication across multiple internal business units.
  
  
You are a subject matter expert in KYC and AML domain. Your areas of focus will be to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements related to KYC, AML, and CTF, develop, implement, and maintain effective KYC, and AML policies and procedures and conduct regular reviews and audits of KYC processes and records to identify areas of improvement and ensure compliance.
  
  
We are seeking individuals with a high level of client orientation and customer focus, experience in consulting, a dynamic fast-paced environment with strong Financial Crime Compliance subject matter expertise and the ability to coach, mentor and lead.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Manage a team of 25+ analysts
* Identify top talent among the team and coach and develop leaders into Senior Analyst II roles.
* Evaluate team members for purposes of hire, termination, advancement, promotion or other job change.
* Manage client projects
* Interact regularly with major clients to strengthen the partnership, report results, and identify new opportunities for services provided.
* Oversee the team's production and results, seeking opportunities for improved efficiency and streamlined processes and conduct quality control review as necessary.
* Provide production/service reporting to senior leadership and clients.
* Work directly with partnership team to develop subject matter expertise and expand advisory services and consulting opportunities with clients.
* Involvement in certain internal strategic initiatives across the Managed Services practice working closely with Sr. Managers and others

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree with 10+ years or more of Anti-Money Laundering (AML), or KYC Management experience
* Management experience and proven decision-making ability
* Ability to lead projects, develop timelines, coordinate project teams and implement action items during the life of a project.
* Ability to multi-task, work independently and as part of a team, establishing cooperative and collaborative working relationships.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional Certification (CAMS)
* Experience in a consulting or managed service environment
* Master’s degree
* Strong entrepreneurial spirit, highly collaborative, able to express ideas readily, manage change fluidly, able to influence and identify opportunities.

AML RightSource is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
**Recruitment Scam Alerts**
**We’re aware of an increase in recruitment scams where individuals falsely claim to represent AML RightSource. These scammers may ask for money or personal information by offering fake job opportunities through e-mail, text message or social media. Please verify the source of any job-related communications carefully. All official AML RightSource communications are conducted through "@amlrightsource.com" email addresses. If you encounter suspicious messages, do not respond.**

title: Professor of Law
description:
1. About the Institution

Kingston Educational Institute (KEI) is a higher education institution committed to providing quality education, academic excellence and professional development. The institution focuses on developing students through effective teaching, practical learning, research and industry-oriented academic initiatives.

2. Job Purpose

The selected candidate will be responsible for delivering quality legal education, developing students' legal knowledge and practical skills, conducting academic and research activities, and contributing to the overall development of the Law Department.

3. Key Roles & Responsibilities

**A. Teaching & Academic Responsibilities**

* Deliver lectures in assigned subjects of the undergraduate and postgraduate Law programmes.
* Prepare lesson plans, academic calendars and subject-wise teaching schedules.
* Complete the prescribed syllabus within the stipulated academic timeline.
* Develop teaching materials, presentations, case studies and assignments.
* Conduct internal assessments, examinations and student evaluations.
* Ensure effective classroom management and student participation.

**B. Research & Academic Development**

* Undertake research activities and publish papers in reputed journals.
* Participate in national and international seminars, conferences and workshops.
* Encourage students to participate in legal research, moot courts and academic competitions.
* Contribute to curriculum development and academic improvement initiatives.

**C. Practical Legal Education**

* Guide students in moot court activities, mock trials and legal drafting.
* Organise legal aid camps, legal awareness programmes and guest lectures.
* Provide guidance on case analysis, legal research and interpretation of statutes.
* Coordinate internships, court visits and practical learning activities.

* Mentor students regarding academic performance and career development.
* Monitor student attendance, academic progress and participation.
* Conduct remedial and additional classes where required.
* Guide students in research projects, dissertations and assignments.
* Maintain proper student mentoring and academic records.

**E. Institutional & Administrative Responsibilities**

* Participate in departmental meetings, academic reviews and institutional audits.
* Maintain lesson plans, attendance records, assessment records and academic documentation.
* Coordinate with the Principal, HOD and Academic Director.

* LL.B. and LL.M. from recognised universities.
* Ph.D. in Law will be preferred for senior academic positions.
* Eligibility and experience must comply with applicable Bar Council of India (BCI) and university regulations.

* Strong knowledge of Indian laws, legal principles and judicial precedents.
* Excellent teaching, presentation and communication skills.
* Strong legal research, analytical and academic writing abilities.
* Ability to guide students in moot courts and practical legal activities.
* Proficiency in academic documentation and digital teaching tools.
* Strong organisational, mentoring and teamwork skills.

6. Experience

* **Professor:**
  As per applicable BCI and university eligibility requirements.
* **Associate Professor:**
  As per applicable BCI and university eligibility requirements.
* **Assistant Professor:**
  Relevant qualifications and eligibility as prescribed by applicable regulatory norms.

7. Documents Required

* Updated CV / Resume.
* Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets.
* Ph.D. certificate, if applicable.
* Previous employment and experience certificates.
* Research publications and list of academic contributions, if applicable.
* Identity and address proof.

8. Selection Process

* Initial resume screening.
* Academic and subject knowledge interview.
* Teaching demonstration.
* Final interview with institutional management.

Appointment and designation will be based on the candidate's qualifications, experience and applicable regulatory eligibility requirements.

title: FAAS FO Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. **EY GDS FAAS (Control and Compliance) - Senior position**
**The opportunity**

As an SOX professional, the individual should be a qualified CA/CPA/ACCA/MBA with experience in IFC and strong knowledge of SOX audit processes. * Flexible work attitude

title: Group Secretarial
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**AEL Corporate Services (AEL CS):**
AEL Corporate Services plays a pivotal role in managing essential corporate functions such as finance, insurance, and secretarial services at a group level for all Adani business units. By centralizing these critical operations, AEL CS ensures efficiency, standardization, and strategic alignment across the conglomerate. Its expertise in risk management, governance, and financial stewardship supports the Group's dynamic growth while maintaining compliance with global standards. Through innovation and a commitment to excellence, AEL CS underpins the Adani Group’s vision of sustainable value creation and nation-building. 
  
  
**Job Purpose**
This role is responsible for ensuring that unlisted companies within the business unit comply with all relevant corporate governance and regulatory requirements. This includes monitoring compliance thresholds, handling routine documentation, overseeing the statutory filings, and managing internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Compliance Monitoring for Unlisted Companies**

* Monitor unlisted entities within the company’s portfolio to ensure they comply with regulatory thresholds, such as the appointment of independent directors, if the company’s capital exceeds specific limits.
* Regularly review the Articles of Association (AOA) and Memorandum of Association (MOA) of unlisted subsidiaries to ensure they are up-to-date and in line with regulatory changes.
* Support in the development of governance frameworks for unlisted entities, ensuring that appropriate corporate governance measures are in place, including the establishment of key committees.

**Subsidiary Governance and Committees**

* Ensure subsidiaries have the required governance committees in place, such as the Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Committee, and monitor their compliance with governance standards.
* Oversee the appointment of members to key committees such as the Audit Committee and ensure adherence to corporate governance standards across unlisted entities.

**Internal Audit and Compliance**

* Oversee the appointment of internal auditors, ensuring proper approvals are obtained and the correct internal audit processes are in place.
* Respond to queries related to the requirement for an internal auditor, ensuring compliance with corporate governance practices.
* Conduct regular compliance checks and audits to ensure that all legal and regulatory filings for unlisted companies are accurate and timely.

**Appointment and CSR Compliance**

* Monitor the company’s capital and profits to assess whether it meets the criteria requiring the appointment of a Managing Director (MD) or full-time executive director, and handle any exceptions as per legal provisions.
* Work with senior leadership to ensure any necessary appointments are made in compliance with the Companies Act and other regulatory requirements.
* Track compliance with regulations concerning the appointment of women directors, ensuring companies that meet the capital or profit thresholds appoint a woman director to their board.
* Coordinate with the Adani Foundation and other CSR partners to confirm contributions, ensuring they are in line with statutory obligations.
* Ensure CSR contributions are accurately reflected in the Directors' Report.
* Prepare and file the necessary CSR forms with the Registrar of Companies (ROC), ensuring timely and accurate submissions.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Ensure all company filings are publicly available and accessible to shareholders, ensuring transparency and proper communication in line with regulatory requirements.
* Manage statutory reporting requirements for unlisted entities, including the preparation and submission of annual returns and financial statements.
* Coordinate with legal teams to ensure all subsidiary entities comply with relevant laws, including the Companies Act, SEBI regulations, and other statutory bodies.
* Provide guidance to the Board of Directors and senior management on matters related to corporate governance, legal compliance, and corporate strategy.
* Advise on changes in governance and compliance regulations, ensuring the company's processes are updated in line with legal and regulatory developments.
* Ensure that the unlisted companies have the balances in place, supporting their long-term sustainability and compliance with all relevant laws.

**Routine Documentation and Administrative Tasks**

* Accurately record and maintain minutes of board meetings, shareholders' meetings, and business meetings, ensuring that all decisions are properly documented and communicated.
* Ensure the timely update of statutory registers, including the Register of Directors and Register of Members, ensuring proper maintenance and accuracy.
